title: 健檢正常卻全身不對勁？頭暈、耳鳴、乾眼竟同源，補對荷爾蒙眩暈風險降9成
summary:
自律神經系統是維繫我們生命活動的關鍵系統，細膩地調節著內臟器官與神經內分泌系統的精確運作，包含呼吸、心跳、血液循環、血壓、體溫、排汗、腸胃消化、生殖、荷爾蒙分泌、睡眠和新陳代謝等。這個系統由交感神經和副交感神經組成，交感神經如同汽車的油門，負責加速；副交感神經則像是煞車，負責減緩。這兩者之間的平衡和協調對於保持我們的生命活動至關重要。

吳佳鴻指出，現代人繁忙的生活節奏和普遍不健康的生活方式很容易破壞這種平衡，導致交感和副交感神經系統失調，進而引發各種症狀，如頭暈、注意力不集中、記憶力衰退、心跳血壓不正常、胸悶、情緒波動、焦慮易怒、睡眠質量差、消化問題、代謝異常和免疫系統疾病等，從頭到腳影響著全身。中年女性面對這些之前未曾經歷的症狀時，常會擔心自己的健康狀況，尋求各種醫療協助，但自律神經失調在常規的健康檢查中難以被診斷出來，這增加了她們的焦慮和擔憂。幸運的是，隨著網路資訊的普及，許多人開始意識到這些症狀可能源自於自律神經失調。

title_en: Your health checkup is normal but something is wrong with your whole body? Dizziness, tinnitus, and dry eyes actually come from the same source. Supplementing the right hormone reduces the risk of vertigo by 90%
summary_en:
The autonomic nervous system is a key system that maintains our life activities. It delicately regulates the precise operation of internal organs and neuroendocrine systems, including breathing, heartbeat, blood circulation, blood pressure, body temperature, perspiration, gastrointestinal digestion, reproduction, hormone secretion, sleep and metabolism, etc. This system is composed of sympathetic nerves and parasympathetic nerves. The sympathetic nerve is like the accelerator of a car, responsible for accelerating; the parasympathetic nerve is like the brake, responsible for slowing down. The balance and coordination between these two is essential to keep our life moving.

Wu Jiahong pointed out that modern people’s busy life pace and generally unhealthy lifestyle can easily destroy this balance, leading to imbalance of the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems, which in turn can lead to various symptoms, such as dizziness, inattention, memory loss, abnormal heartbeat and blood pressure, chest tightness, mood swings, anxiety and irritability, poor sleep quality, digestive problems, metabolic abnormalities and immune system diseases, etc., affecting the whole body from head to toe. When middle-aged women face these symptoms that they have never experienced before, they often worry about their health conditions and seek various medical assistance. However, autonomic nervous system disorders are difficult to diagnose during routine health examinations, which increases their anxiety and worry. Fortunately, with the popularity of online information, many people are beginning to realize that these symptoms may stem from autonomic nervous system disorders.

title: 壓力愈大 為什麼愈想穿舒服的鞋？ 心理師：鞋款藏著不同心理訊號
summary:
鞋子不僅反映出個人的心理狀態，也會影響別人對自己的看法。研究發現，人們會根據對方穿著的鞋子，迅速對其個性、社會地位，甚至生活方式做出判斷。

我們對於陌生人的第一印象，有一部分來自觀察對方所穿的鞋子。對方偏愛穿什麼款式的鞋子，多少會透露出其內心世界和生活哲學，若能深入了解鞋子所暗藏的意義，或許可以更快找到跟對方相處適當的方式。

打開鞋櫃，算算看自己擁有多少雙鞋子？什麼款式最多？

在日常生活當中，鞋子對我們而言擁有多重功能：保護雙腳、搭配衣服、參加宴會、從事運動，都需要不同功能與款式的鞋子。

從心理的角度來看，鞋子是具有象徵性意義的配件，我們選擇的鞋子不僅是服飾的一部分，還反映了自我認同和心理狀態。無論是個人喜好、生活方式，還是性格特質、情感狀態，鞋子都扮演著一個非語言的溝通角色。

summary_zh: 曾經工作、有勞保，離職照顧家人後改繳國保，兩段年資究竟能不能一起算？勞保局10月推出「我的退休年資算盤」，提醒勞工65歲時若勞保年資未滿15年，可併計已繳費的國保年資來判斷能否請領勞保老年年金。不過，能「湊年資」不代表能把保險給付合併計算，更有一項常被忽略的限制：一旦請領勞保老年年金，國保年金就只能採B式，與可選A式的人相比，月領金額可能差上數千元。
title_en: Pay careful attention to national insurance 2/ Labor insurance and national insurance years can be combined! Receive a double annuity at the age of 65. Be careful 1. The monthly difference is limited to 2,403 yuan.
summary_en: I once worked and had labor insurance, but after leaving my job to take care of my family, I switched to national insurance. Can the two periods of seniority be counted together? The Bureau of Labor Insurance launched "My Retirement Age Calculator" in October to remind workers that if their labor insurance years are less than 15 years when they turn 65, they can combine their paid national insurance years to determine whether they can claim the labor insurance old-age annuity. However, being able to "make up the seniority" does not mean that the insurance benefits can be calculated together. There is another limitation that is often ignored: once you apply for the labor insurance old-age annuity, the national insurance annuity can only be in type B. Compared with those who can choose type A, the monthly payment amount may be thousands of dollars different.

title_en: The national insurance plan is prudent 1/Interest is exempted for up to 100 yuan of national insurance arrears. Please note that if it exceeds 10 years, you may not receive your pension.
summary_en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare will raise the interest exemption threshold for national insurance arrears from October 1, relaxing it from less than 30 yuan to less than 100 yuan. It is estimated that more than 100,000 people will benefit every year. The official calculation is based on the monthly premium payment of 1,329 yuan in 2026. There is a chance of interest-free if the single monthly premium is delayed for about 4 years. What really cannot be ignored is the 10-year statute of limitations for repayment. In principle, repayment cannot be made after the expiration date. Not only will the retirement age be underestimated, but it may also affect the eligibility for National Security Old Age Annuity Types A and B.

title_en: Grandpa gives grandson 2 million tax-free! He sprayed $100,000 after his death, the IRS reveals the reason
summary_en: Grandpa gave 2 million yuan to his grandson, which obviously did not exceed the annual gift tax exemption of 2.44 million yuan. Unexpectedly, after his death, his grandson would have to bear 100,000 yuan in inheritance tax! The Taipei National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance reminded that the "Inheritance and Gift Tax Law" was revised in September this year. Property donated to specific relatives within 2 years before the death of an elder must be included in the total estate for taxation. The new system changes so that the person who receives the property will bear the tax in proportion, and the heirs will no longer pay the entire bill. "Full text..."

title_en: Concussive Money Saving Technique 1/He entered the market after the Taiwan stock market plummeted! Zheng Shihan unveiled the "magic moving average" and bought this ETF for the first time
summary_en:
The road to the 50,000-point mark for the Taiwan stock market has intensified. The market fell more than a thousand points on October 15, falling below the monthly line and the 47,000-point mark. Faced with the sharp decline in the market, investment expert Zheng Shihan bluntly said that the main force has regarded 50,000 points as a short-term ceiling. Once it reaches a high, it will be pushed back. Investors are most taboo about all-in at this time.

In July, he has reduced his holdings from 90% to 50%, and his first choice for defensive positions is investment bond ETFs. When the market fell sharply on 10/15, he bought active ETF 00981A for the first time. He used the "magic moving average" to observe that the bulls are not over yet, but he must be more vigilant in the first half of next year.

title: 財經時事／專訪！憂台灣升級AI島網路韌性不足　CBIT理事長王鴻紳：鬆緊箍咒助有線電視業尋活水

title_en: Financial Current Affairs/Exclusive Interview! Concerned about the insufficient resilience of Taiwan’s upgraded AI island network, CBIT Chairman Wang Hongshen: The tightrope will help the cable TV industry find vitality.
summary_en: At the end of last year (2025), the Cable Broadband Industry Association of Taiwan (CBIT) re-elected its chairman, and was succeeded by Fubon Chairman Cai Mingzhong and former Kaibo Broadband Chairman Wang Hongshen. Faced with the avalanche of "cord-cutting" in cable TV, he actively sought solutions after taking office. In July this year, the Legislative Yuan read for the third time the clauses that loosened the restrictions on the party, government, and military. It was supposed to inject vitality into the industry, but it failed to obtain the counter-signature of the Executive President Zhuo Rongtai. In an exclusive interview with this magazine, Wang Hongshen said frankly that in the face of geopolitical threats, Taiwan has to upgrade to an artificial intelligence (AI) island, and network resilience is very important. Not only does it call on its peers to "put aside the past grudges" and organize the establishment of a second broadband high-speed network to help the government prepare for assistance, it also hopes to loosen policy restrictions so that the cable TV industry can obtain capital and vitality, and jointly realize Taiwan's vision of transforming into an AI island.

title: 焊接工做到上櫃董座1／唯一拿到二次配6個認證　半導體大廠配管不能沒有他　純純的概念股月底掛牌
summary:
騏億鑫是半導體大廠二次配工程領域少有取得6項認證的公司。董事長洪國庭原本是漢唐集成的一名焊接工，如今，他協助半導體大廠，從台灣一路到美國、日本建廠。去年營收17.58億元，並在10月下旬上櫃。

洪國庭能成功，靠的是從工程現場一路磨出來的基本功。為了挖角人才，他曾把自己的房子讓給同事住，自己睡車上。二次配並非漢唐主力，洪國庭笑稱：「我們是一群不被漢唐愛的人。」當年不被看重的一群人，如今卻組成自己的「二次配大聯盟」，成為台灣半導體大廠不可或缺的夥伴。

title: 焊接工做到上櫃董座2／漢唐工作十多年薪水不到5萬元　他集結一群「不被愛的人」成為二次配大聯盟　如今身家數億元
summary: 從焊接基礎工做起的騏億鑫董事長洪國庭，受訪時牛仔褲配上休閒襯衫，流露出濃濃的工程人氣息。「我爸爸是公務人員、重視教育，他讓我從小念私立學校，但我整天會想東想西的，不太喜歡讀書。考上逢甲大學後，我一個南部小孩到台中，覺得每樣東西都很新鮮，把所有心思都放在校外，到夜市顧電玩機台，大三時被二一退學，只能去當兵。」

title: 焊接工做到上櫃董座3／他把房子讓給員工自己睡車上　從工程跨製造　領軍百名焊工赴美月賺20萬
summary: 洪國庭能成功，除了自己懂技術，懂帶人也是關鍵。半導體大廠工程從南到北布局，他為了求才，大方把房子讓給同事住，自己往返奔波回台南，或把車停在7-ELEVENn前、睡在車上。「我在漢唐時，北中南四處亂跑。我可以適應每個地方，不代表員工也有辦法。我現在如果能力所及，一定會幫他們安排好住宿跟交通。」騏億鑫海外事業單位副總劉佳諻說：「只要我們提出需求，不管用他個人，還是公司資源，他都會support（支援），讓我們掏心掏肺對這間公司。」

title: 65歲長者免健保費 立院三讀 政院說遺憾 將採合法合憲因應作為

title: 人際關係也需要斷捨離！遠離消耗你的人 才有機會遇見真正的貴人
summary: 只要結得一個善緣，就有機會像滾雪球般孕育出一個更大的緣。在日語中，「縁起がいい」這句話，現在雖然單純是用來表示「吉祥」、「幸運」之意，但其原來的意涵則是期望在「緣起」之時所結的就是善緣。只是，一如前述，人有時也會在無意間結下惡緣。例如當感到「咦！好像不太對勁喔！」或者「這樣下去不太妙喔！」的時候，就是即將被捲入惡緣的徵兆。當面臨這種情況，就要有停下腳步，「重整人際關係」的勇氣。從這個角度來解釋，則每年寺院會在除夕夜至元旦之際敲響「除夜之鐘」，就絕非徒具形式的習俗，而是讓人隨著一百零八響的鐘聲，洗滌煩惱與內心的汙垢，同時「省思自己與過去一年來受其照顧的人，或者有關事物的互動成果」，並讓「惡緣當斷則斷」的一種淨化心靈的儀式。至於新年伊始的初詣（新年參拜），則是期許「在新年伊始結下善緣」的另一種儀式。無論如何，欲祈求新的一年有好的發展，前提是要在懷有一顆清淨心的條件下重新孕育「善緣」。為此，才要趁除夕夜至元旦之際，重整人際關係，再次校正自己的生活模式。沒錯，我們或許無法單靠敲個鐘或者新年參拜，整個人就脫胎換骨，但藉由這樣的儀式，絕對可讓本來理不盡的繁亂思緒稍微有個喘息的機會。

title: 為何有些人總能遇到貴人？遠離惡緣、留住善緣 先養成這2個習慣
summary: 作者：枡野俊明如前所述，若結得善緣，即生善果，反之一旦惡緣纏身，自會招來惡果。那麼，要如何才能避惡結善呢？最重要的，就是不要輕易被所謂的「好康」誘惑。說到底，在日常生活中，每個人都是踏實且努力地過日子，很難想像真的有什麼能夠輕鬆賺大錢的「捷徑」存在。因此，應該要警惕自己，不要在網路上被那些連容貌和來歷都不清楚的人的話術所惑，毫無戒心地上了賊船。只是，棘手的地方就在於，基本上惡緣都是披著「好康」的外衣，要看穿它並不容易。尤其是那些所謂社會上的成功人士，往往更易於收到來自各方的「好康」，也因此，只要有人招手：「怎樣？要不要一起賺一票？」就會不管三七二十一地心動起來，這種情況就稱為「鬼迷心竅」。而且，遺憾的是，不論是再怎麼善良的人，都會有迷惑自己的鬼靠過來，這是難以避免的事。那該怎麼辦呢？我們以德川家康25為例，他在江戶開府之際，就為了截斷邪魔入侵的道路，在被視為不吉方位的鬼門（東北方）與裏鬼門（西南方）興建寺院和神社，供奉了怒目邪魔的不動明王。這些被供奉在江戶城周邊的不動明王統稱為江戶五不動，分別是：目黑不動、目白不動、目赤不動、目青不動以及目黃不動。除了江戶外，在京都和奈良

title: 「請幫幫我」竟可能讓主管反感？聰明人求助前都會先做一件事
summary: 人在溝通時的用字遣詞會視彼此間的「距離感」而異。比方說，對方是長輩？是跟自己同年？還是晚輩？又或者是在工作上的職稱、經驗值如何……我們自然會依狀況的不同而改變搭話的方式和敬語的使用。尤其，在向上司、前輩求助時，如果只是說：「請幫幫我！請教教我！」可能會給人不先好好努力看看就想把事情「完全丟給對方」，那種輕率向人求助的印象。其實，對於上司或者前輩，在尋求建議時，最好是讓對方感受到「在請託之前你已經盡力嘗試過了」，這樣一來對方也會比較樂於提供意見。例如讓對方知道「到某部分為止我都是靠自己完成的，可是目前遇到瓶頸，如果您能提點一下的話就太好了」。如此，對方也會判斷你的求助是合理的，認為「這樣啊，已經努力過了還是搞不定，那就由我這個前輩出馬吧」。附帶一提，請教「前輩在年輕時遇到這樣的障礙是如何克服的呢？」類似這樣的經驗談，其實也是意外受歡迎的話題喔。說到底，不論是誰，在分享自己的成功經驗時，都是很愉快的事。

title: 與其做疲憊的「好人」，不如做個「對自己誠實的人」
summary: 即便如此，我還是覺得，與其「明明不想去……」卻壓抑自己真實的想法，不如實話實說：「抱歉，今天有點累」、「下次一定要約我」，對彼此而言都會比較圓滿。坦白說，含糊其辭或者心不甘情不願的態度是藏也藏不住的，對方必定會有所察覺，到頭來反而會形成疙瘩。結果，轉了一圈，最重要的還是得回到做個對自己誠實的人這個基本原則上。畢竟，比起扮「好人」讓身邊的人對你有無謂的顧慮，還搞到你自己身心俱疲，不如直接告知對方自己的想法或狀況，才能加深彼此間的信賴關係。我的意思是，所謂真正平等的關係，基礎在於「互相體諒」的精神。道理很簡單，只要你直接告知狀況，對方也會覺得你是「可以放心請託」、「真的沒辦法，就會直說」的人，是可以平等往來的對象，進而加深信賴。相反地，一直扮「好人」，對方也會難以判斷你真實的想法，最終讓彼此都感到疲憊。況且，講白一點，有這種期待你「做好人」的人，跟他斷絕往來也是剛好而已。總之，試著放鬆自己思考一下，根本沒必要扮「好人」。做個對自己誠實的人，不僅是讓自己自在，同時也是和身邊的人建立更為舒適關係的方法。

title: 一個丟鈔動作，為什麼氣到要動手？研究揭人被挑釁後失控的真正原因
summary:
許多人開車時，一旦被別人擋了一下，就會下車與對方發生衝突。然而，也有人會選擇忍讓，因為他們認為自己可能這輩子都不會再見到那個人。事實上，再次遇見同一個陌生人的機會非常低，幾乎可以忽略不計。因此，我們的憤怒其實沒有必要。

憤怒往往只會帶來衝突和暴力，而這些暴力的結果大多不好。無論是你受傷，還是對方受傷，都不是我們想要的結局。

簡少年建議，當面臨衝突時，可以反覆思考：「我真的需要生氣嗎？我的憤怒源於何處？我是否有更好的應對方法？這件事情對我真的有影響嗎？我今天發脾氣真的是必要的嗎？」

很多時候，我們的憤怒來自文化和原生家庭的影響，包括成長環境、家庭從事的職業、生活的地區等因素，這些都可能塑造我們的價值觀和反應方式。然而，現在我們擁有了選擇的自由。

我們可以選擇生氣，也可以選擇原諒。大多數衝突其實沒有太大的意義，面對衝突，第一件事是冷靜下來思考，以和為貴。只有在冷靜的情況下，我們才能進行有效溝通，而這正是解決問題的

title_en: Why would you be so angry as to throw money away? Research to reveal the real reasons why people lose control after being provoked
summary_en:
Many people will get out of the car and conflict with the other person once they are blocked by others while driving. However, some people will choose to be patient because they think they may never see that person again in this life. In fact, the chance of meeting the same stranger again is so low that it’s almost negligible. Therefore, our anger is actually unnecessary.

Anger often only brings conflict and violence, and most of the consequences of this violence are not good. Whether you are injured or the other person is injured, this is not the ending we want.

Jane suggested that when facing a conflict, you can think over and over: "Do I really need to be angry? Where does my anger come from? Do I have a better way to deal with it? Does this matter really affect me? Is it really necessary for me to lose my temper today?"

Many times, our anger comes from the influence of culture and family of origin, including the environment in which we grew up, the occupation our family engages in, the region we live in, and other factors, which may shape our values and responses. However, now we have the freedom of choice.

We can choose to be angry, or we can choose to forgive. Most conflicts actually don't make much sense. When faced with conflicts, the first thing to do is to calm down and think, and value peace. Only when we are calm can we communicate effectively and that is what solves the problem

title: 投了89封履歷還沒上？從履歷到自我介紹 先學會站在企業角度說話
summary:
新鮮人起薪創13年新高，找工作卻沒有因此變得容易。有人履歷一封封投、面試一場場跑，最後仍等不到那句「錄取」。近期一項調查甚至估算，新鮮人平均可能要投89封履歷，才換來一次錄取機會。當企業一邊喊缺工，求職者一邊苦等offer，真正的問題或許不只是職缺夠不夠，而是從履歷到面試，你傳達的內容有沒有讓企業在最短時間看懂：為什麼這個職位應該選你？

很多時候，面試不成功，不是你的能力不行，而是你根本沒有站在企業的角度去考慮他們想要什麼樣的人。面試其實就是銷售自己的過程，你越能滿足企業的需求，你就越搶手，你的「價錢」也就越高。

演說與口語表達訓練師劉仕祥在《深度溝通力：最紛擾的時代，練就最會說話的自己》中談到，從履歷、自我介紹到面試問答，真正重要的並不是一味展示自己，而是站在招聘人員與企業的角度，理解對方究竟想知道什麼。

title_en: I submitted 89 resumes but still haven’t uploaded them yet? From resume to self-introduction, first learn to speak from the perspective of the company
summary_en:
The starting salary for freshmen has reached a 13-year high, but finding a job has not become easier. Some people have gone through a letter of rejection and a series of interviews, but in the end they still can’t wait for the word “acceptance”. A recent survey even estimated that freshmen may need to submit an average of 89 resumes in order to get one chance of admission. When companies are complaining about job shortages and job seekers are waiting for offers, the real problem may not be whether there are enough job vacancies, but whether the content you convey from resume to interview allows the company to understand in the shortest possible time: why should they choose you for this position?

Many times, if the interview is unsuccessful, it is not because you are not capable, but because you have not considered the kind of person they want from the perspective of the company. Interviewing is actually the process of selling yourself. The better you can meet the needs of the company, the more popular you will be and the higher your "price" will be.

Speech and oral expression trainer Liu Shixiang said in "Deep Communication: In the Most Troubled Era, Develop Your Most Conversant Self" that from resumes, self-introductions to interview questions and answers, the really important thing is not to blindly present yourself, but to understand what the other party wants to know from the perspective of the recruiter and the company.

title_en: Are you capable but never recognized by senior managers? You may be missing this invisible communication detail
summary_en:
After making several phone calls, the big shot always said he didn't have time; after finally getting on the line, the other party always said he would try it next time. Why is it so difficult to interact with big shots in the workplace? Sometimes, the problem does not lie in eloquence, but in an invisible detail.

There was once a business executive who organized the company's dealer conference and also served as the host. There was a guest introduction session at the beginning of the conference. He started with the highest position. When he was introduced to the company's marketing department, since the job titles and ranks of Mr. Ma from the Marketing Department 1 and Mr. Li from the Marketing Department 2 were the same, he introduced them like this: "There is also Mr. Ma, the Marketing Director from the Marketing Department 1, and Mr. Li from the Marketing Department 2." Upon hearing this, Mr. Li's face immediately darkened. After the meeting, Mr. Li asked him: "Do you know how to host? The positions and ranks were introduced wrong!" Only then did he wake up.

Liu Shixiang, a speech and oral expression trainer, shared this friend's personal experience in his book "Deep Communication: In the Most Troubled Times, Develop Your Most Conversant Self." He bluntly said that in fact, this mistake was not big, but it was infinitely amplified by Mr. Li's "sense of identity" in his human nature. Humans are very strange animals. On the surface, they often say that they don’t value these nihilistic identities, but they still care a lot about them in front of everyone, especially big shots. Therefore, when dealing with big figures in the workplace, the sense of identity is a communication secret that must not be bypassed.

What is a sense of identity? It is the perception of a person’s origin and social status. People usually have status hierarchies. For example, in ancient China, status hierarchies were strict. As the saying goes: "The king wants his ministers."

title: 雞蛋被誤會太久？ 研究：適量吃蛋與較低死亡風險、阿茲海默症風險有關
summary:
雞蛋到底能不能每天吃？過去一提到蛋黃，不少人第一個想到的就是膽固醇，甚至因此把雞蛋列入「少吃為妙」的食物。但近年愈來愈多研究發現，雞蛋與膽固醇、心血管疾病之間的關係，可能沒有想像中那麼直接。更有研究指出，適量吃蛋除了未必增加死亡風險，還可能與阿茲海默症風險降低有關。

「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，既然膳食膽固醇不再被過度擔憂，我們對雞蛋的看法也應調整。過去，雞蛋因膽固醇含量而被視為「高風險食物」。如今，多數專家認為，對膽固醇數值正常的成年人而言，每天1顆，或每週最多7顆，不僅安全，更是健康飲食的一部分。

更進一步的研究顯示，即使每週食用7顆以上雞蛋，也未與總膽固醇（TC）、低密度脂蛋白膽固醇（LDL-C）、三酸甘油酯（TG）或高密度脂蛋白膽固醇（HDL-C）呈現顯著負面關聯。

分析更顯示，雞蛋可能對血脂分型有益。攝取膳食膽固醇，主要來自雞蛋，可能促使形成較大顆的LDL顆粒，同時減少小顆LDL，也就是sdLDL的濃度，而後者被認為更具動脈粥狀硬化風險。

title: 英國知名插畫家 Julia Gash 城市藝術托特包首度登台　10月19日TSUTAYA BOOKSTORE信義店全台獨家首賣
summary:
以手繪地圖創作風格享譽國際的英國知名插畫家 Julia Gash，其深受全球旅人與設計愛好者喜愛的城市藝術帆布托特包系列，將首度於台灣正式登場。營運團隊得利影視宣布，將於2026年10月19日（星期一）晚間18時起，在TSUTAYA BOOKSTORE信義店（統一時代百貨台北店5樓）舉辦全台獨家首賣活動。

本次活動最大亮點，為Julia Gash全新創作的「Taiwan」手繪地圖款首度商品化，並於全球搶先上市。現場也同步販售倫敦、巴黎、東京、紐約等11款經典城市系列作品，限量引進200個城市藝術托特包，其中包含藝術家親筆簽名款（限台灣款與台北款），邀請喜愛藝術設計、旅行文化與生活美學的消費者親臨體驗收藏。

Julia Gash自創立同名品牌以來，始終秉持「熱愛身邊世界（Loving the World Around Her）」創作理念，透過細膩的墨水線條與溫暖樸實的手繪風格，描繪世界各地城市獨特的人文風景與生活記憶。多年來，其作品已遍及全球眾多城市與觀光景點，深受國際市場肯定。

此次首度在台推出的全新「Taiwan」款手繪地圖，以藝術家獨特視角勾勒出台灣多元的人文特色與自然風貌，融合代表性地標、文化元素與地方風情，展現台灣豐富且鮮明的島嶼魅力。該圖樣過去雖曾於品牌官網公開展示，但本次為全球首次製作為實體商品，並由TSUTAYA BOOKSTORE信義店取得此款全台為期兩個月的獨家首賣資格，別具紀念價值。

本次引進之Julia Gash城市藝術托特包系列，皆由通過公平貿易認證的專業工廠製造，採用100%純棉厚磅帆布製成，兼具耐用性與舒適手感。包款提把則採品牌標誌性的海軍藍白條紋織帶設計，展現鮮明識別度與旅行風格美學，適合作為日常通勤、閱讀休閒及旅行外出的隨身配件。

為回饋台灣消費者與藝術愛好者的支持，主辦單位特別向英國原廠爭取由Julia Gash事先親筆簽名之「台灣款」與「台北款」限定托特包，並於首批販售商品中限量提供。消費者選購台灣款或台北款時，即可購得具收藏價值的親筆簽名款商品。為維持購買公平性，親筆簽名款每人限購乙件，售完為止。

此外，TSUTAYA BOOKSTORE信義店也將同步設置「Julia Gash手繪台灣意象打卡牆」。自活動開跑日起，凡於現場購買任一款Julia Gash城市藝術托特包，並於打卡牆前拍照打卡，將照片發布至Instagram貼文或限時動態並標記官方帳號@tbs_xinyi，於結帳時出示畫面，即可獲得信義店限定「Julia Gash手繪LOVE書籤」乙份，數量有限，送完為止。

TSUTAYA BOOKSTORE信義店表示，希望透過此次Julia Gash城市藝術托特包首度登台販售活動，結合閱讀空間、人文藝術與生活選物，帶領消費者感受插畫藝術所傳遞的溫暖與城市故事。活動當日除商品正式上架販售外，也將透過主題陳列與拍照互動空間，營造沉浸式藝術氛圍，提供讀者與消費者兼具美感與文化體驗的生活提案。

title: 牛奶一定要喝低脂、吃肉先去肥？ 醫師：我們可能怕錯脂肪50年
summary:
1960年代，英美兩國的學者對冠心病的致病機轉，提出了不同觀點。英國生理學家John Yudkin認為，添加糖是冠心病的主要致病因素；美國生理學家安塞爾．基斯（Ancel Keys）則認為，總脂肪、飽和脂肪和膳食膽固醇，才是冠心病的主要致病因素。

由於當時很少有科學家相信英國學者的論點，第一份《美國膳食指南》便聚焦於減少總脂肪、飽和脂肪和膳食膽固醇，以預防冠心病。這也促使「低脂飲食」成為主流健康建議，進一步推動加工低脂食品的興起。諷刺的是，這些食品為了彌補風味，往往添加過量的糖和精製碳水化合物，反而帶來其他新的健康問題。

多年來，媒體報導也加劇了這種恐懼。複雜的營養科學被過度簡化，「脂肪使你變胖」、「脂肪導致心臟病」等籠統說法大行其道。媒體也常突出支持低脂論述的研究，卻淡化持不同意見或更為細微的科學發現。超過半個世紀的「恐脂症」因此難以消除，許多人即使面對當前科學證據，仍會本能選擇低脂食品，甚至極力避免攝取任何油脂。

title: 紅肉真的該少吃嗎？ 醫師引603萬人大型研究：心血管、癌症風險沒那麼單純
summary:
膽固醇與飽和脂肪：比起雞肉、魚肉和豆類，紅肉含有較多的飽和脂肪。美國心臟學會認為，攝取高量的飽和脂肪會增加膽固醇，進而增加心臟病的風險。然而，阿根廷人均每年消費約46公斤牛肉，遠高於美國的人均每年消費約38公斤；但根據2021年的數據，阿根廷每10萬人中約151人死於心血管疾病，卻低於美國的每10萬人中約165人死於心血管疾病。

癌症風險：有些人懷疑食用紅肉可能與較高的大腸癌風險有關聯。但是阿根廷人每10萬人中有26人罹患大腸癌，低於美國的每10萬人中有39人罹患大腸癌。此外，阿根廷人從20世紀90年代人均每年消費約70公斤牛肉；到了2020年，消費降到50公斤。然而，大腸癌卻增加25％。

summary: 豬油、牛油、奶油，今天多數人聞之色變。但如果飽和脂肪真的是心血管殺手，為什麼吃得最油的那幾個民族，反而沒有現代文明病？被譽為「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，在現代文明病出現之前，人類數千年來賴以為生的食用油，像是豬油、牛油、羊油、奶油和棕櫚油，都是以飽和脂肪為主。許多原始部落的飲食中，飽和脂肪的比例也很高。南太平洋的托克勞人飲食中60％是飽和脂肪，肯亞倫迪爾人的飲食63％是飽和脂肪，非洲馬賽人的飲食66％是飽和脂肪，北美洲北部因紐特人的飲食中75％是飽和脂肪。

title: 七大光電公協會駁汙名：漁電共生最新合規逾八成六　力挺依法去蕪存菁、攜手漁民共榮
summary:
針對近日立法院關切漁電共生查核、少數案場遭廢止許可。部分媒體以「恐淪光電垃圾場」、「七成不養殖」等聳動標題進行報導，製造社會混亂，光電相關七大公協會發表聯合聲明，呼籲勿以「過期數據、移花接木」的方式誤導視聽，傷害光電產業。公協會強調：產業界嚴守自律，並全力支持政府依法嚴查、淘汰不肖業者。

依據官方最新統計已證實查核合規率超過 86%；誠懇呼籲，各界能以客觀數據與實務現況看待漁電共生，避免因少數早期個案抹煞多數業者與在地漁民長期深耕的心血。

七大公協會指出，漁電共生推動的核心始終是「漁電共榮」。針對外界爭議，公協會提出四大聲明與訴求。

一、回歸官方最新查核實況：逾八成六案場穩健營運，展現產業自律成果

關於審計部抽查數據產生的疑慮，相關內容多屬早期「併聯試運轉」階段之樣態。根據農業部日前於立法院公布的最新數據：

全台已營運的漁電共生案場中，主管機關已完成查核 294 件，其中經審查需廢止者為41件。換言之，完成查核案場中有86.1% 皆合規且正常維持養殖運作。據了解，被廢止的案場，大多為早期小型的室內型案場，還在摸索期。

而此數據反映出多數案場已逐步走過初期摸索期，走向穩定經營。公協會期盼社會大眾看見超過八成五案場的第一線付出，以全貌理解產業轉型的扎實步伐。

二、重視環境與設備責任：電廠具法定除役與復原機制，絕非隨意棄置

對於部分「垃圾場」或「爛尾」等情緒性形容煽動社會不安，公協呼籲應以事實為基礎，中立報導：

  1. 案場皆有完善的法定管理規範：太陽光電案場從建置到營運，均受到《電業法》與農業法規嚴格規範，主管機關對於案場清理與場地恢復原狀皆有法定程序與保證機制，設備本身亦具備循環利用資產價值。
  2. 坦然面對問題、依法處置：對於早期極少數因經營不善或規範未明而停滯的案件，公協會堅定支持主管機關依法督促改善或勒令退場，產業不護短，期盼透過法規落實去蕪存菁，讓產業環境更為健康。

三、正視第一線養殖實況：籲建立實務彈性的管理制度

據農業部說明，遭廢止案場多半設置於早期規範尚未明確時，且部分被廢止案場「仍有實際養殖行為」，僅因環境變化而未依原計畫養殖特定魚種，顯示查核標準仍有調整與精進的空間。

水產養殖深受天候、水質與市場波動而影響，漁民必須因時制宜調整放養物種。若因經營彈性調整而被一概認定為「無心養殖」，實非第一線漁民所樂見。公協會誠懇建議：

l 優化管理機制：期盼主管機關在嚴謹管理之餘，能針對具養殖事實但需因應市場調整魚種的案場，建立更具彈性的報備與改善機制。

l 全力支持漁青進場承接：針對農業部規劃引導青年漁民承接具養殖潛力案場之政策，產業界樂觀其成並全力配合，願開放優質場域的電力與水利設施，攜手青年漁民深耕在地。

四、以實績累積社會信任：能源挹注傳統漁塭，推動智慧升級與人才回流

公協會推動漁電共生的核心理念是「漁電共榮」。近年來，許多案場不僅維持放養，更引進光電資金重建老舊魚塭、建置智慧水質監控、自動投餌與循環水設備，使白蝦、鱸魚、台灣鯛等水產穩定收成進入產銷體系。這證明了跨領域的整合，確實能為傳統漁村注入活水，創造產業升級與綠色經濟並行的可能。

理解社會監督，堅持攜手共榮

七大公協會由衷希望:在推動能源轉型的路上難免面對挑戰，產業界不迴避任何問題，更願以開放的心態持續自我提升；同時也堅持捍衛每一位踏實投入養殖的漁民與合法業者的尊嚴。我們期盼在政府、漁民與產業的共同努力下，讓制度更彈性與周延、養殖更永續，攜手實踐漁電共存共榮的長期目標。

台灣順豐攜手北市監理所推機車駕訓 同步深化職場與家庭關懷
summary:
台灣順豐連續五年攜手臺北市區監理所投入交通公益，從過去偏鄉交通支持進一步延伸至今年的機車安全駕訓，透過企業資源投入，協助更多民眾在上路前建立正確駕駛觀念；同時持續提供第一線員工高溫津貼，並舉辦家庭電影日，從道路安全、職場守護到家庭陪伴，讓企業關懷由營運現場延伸至員工家庭與社會參與。

台灣順豐持續從物流本業出發，將交通安全作為長期公益投入的重要方向，過去透過偏鄉幸福巴士等行動，支持偏鄉交通與民眾移動需求，今年則進一步將投入重點延伸至道路安全，16日臺北市區監理所舉辦捐贈儀式，由所長戴邦芳致贈感謝狀給台灣順豐總經理潘逸俊，感謝公司長期投入交通公益，並持續以企業資源支持道路安全推廣。臺北市區監理所所長戴邦芳強調：「企業願意持續投入交通安全，是推動道路安全很重要的力量。此次與台灣順豐合作，希望透過機車駕訓，讓更多民眾在上路前建立正確觀念，也讓交通安全從教育與實際行動中慢慢累積。 」

本次贊助超過百位民眾參與機車駕訓，鼓勵用路人在正式上路前建立正確駕駛及防禦駕駛觀念。根據陽明交通大學統計，同時參加機車場訓及道路訓練者，違規風險降低64%、事故風險降低51%，顯示完整駕訓對建立安全駕駛觀念及降低道路風險具有實質助益。從偏鄉交通到機車安全駕訓，也展現台灣順豐持續依循社會需求，逐步擴大交通公益行動的投入面向。台灣順豐總經理潘逸俊表示：「物流與道路環境密不可分，安全不只是企業營運的重要基礎，也是每一位用路人共同的責任。此次透過公私協力推動機車駕訓，希望讓安全觀念從源頭扎根。」

面對高溫酷暑對戶外工作者帶來的挑戰，台灣順豐今年持續在夏季提供第一線同仁高溫津貼，以實際補助回應收派及相關現場人員在炎熱環境下工作的辛勞。公司同時透過內部宣導，強化防暑、補水、適時休息及熱傷害預防等觀念，降低高溫作業帶來的身體負荷，讓對第一線同仁的照顧真正落實在日常工作現場。

此外，台灣順豐持續將企業關懷由職場延伸至員工家庭，延續去年活動好評，今年暑假再度舉辦員工「家庭電影日」，在全台舉辦超過10場電影包場活動，邀請超過千名同仁及家屬共同參與；伴隨著觀影過程中的歡笑聲與一家人並肩觀影的溫馨時刻，電影日不僅是一場觀影活動，也成為一場同仁與家人的溫暖聚會，讓平時忙碌的同仁暫時放慢腳步，陪伴家人、共享相聚時光，在工作之外留下更多珍貴回憶。

title_en: Sangu Dharma Conference/Alliance with Zhengyang Biomedical Platelet Lysis Solution Shipment, Phase III of New Drug Plan for Dry Eye Disease
summary_en: Sangu (3224) held a press conference on the 15th. Chairman Chen Zongji said that the company has strategically cooperated with Zhengyang Biomedical to lock in two major products: human platelet lysate (hPL) and new dry eye drug Elate Ocular. It will combine Sangu’s manufacturing capabilities with Zhengyang’s technology and market layout. Among them, platelet lysis solution has begun to be shipped, and a new drug for dry eye disease is planned to enter the third phase of clinical trials in Taiwan.

title: 外資史上最狠提款3025億！台股崩1655點失守4萬7 金融、電信成「綠海避風港」｜Yahoo財經掃描
summary:
電子、塑化全面失守，電信、金融撐場，台股仍重挫1655點、摜破4萬7！今(15)日加權指數終場下跌1655.96點、跌幅3.41%，收46,969.87點，創史上第六大收盤跌點，成交金額放大至1兆3226.70億元。美國通膨升溫與AI融資疑慮引爆賣壓，盤中一度狂瀉1830.45點；櫃買指數重挫5.53%，電子指數下跌3.84%，金融指數則逆勢上漲0.73%。

 台積電(2330)盤中最低下探2420元，終場收2440元、下跌50元，跌幅2.01%，盤後法說會的AI需求與營運展望成為市場焦點。電子權值股普遍承壓，聯發科(2454)、台達電(2308)重挫，日月光投控(3711)更跌停作收；封測、測試介面與先進封裝設備族群賣壓沉重，旺矽(6223)、穎崴(6515)等均鎖跌停，緯穎(6669)也亮綠燈，千金股縮水至48檔。台塑四寶同樣由強轉弱，南亞(1303)、台化(1326)雙雙跌停。相較之下，資金轉向金融股與電信三雄避風頭，永豐金(2890)、玉山金(2884)上漲逾3%，兆豐金(2886)、第一金(2892)、中信金(2891)、華南金(2880)等也有強勢表現。電信股由中華電(2412)領軍，盤中一度漲逾3%至154元、改寫歷史新高，終場收152.5元；台灣大(3045)、遠傳(4904)皆走強，成為弱勢盤面中少數亮點。

亞洲市場同步遭遇賣壓，日經指數下跌4.90%，韓國綜合指數重挫7.57%，香港恆生指數下跌1.29%，上海綜合指數下跌1.59%。

華爾街科技股率先遭遇通膨與融資壓力夾擊，美國9月CPI年增3.7%、高於預期，油價居高不下也增添月底升息疑慮；博通執行長指出，資金是AI建設擴張的最大瓶頸，進一步打擊市場信心。美股四大指數全數收跌，道瓊指數下跌0.09%、那斯達克指數下跌1.88%、標普500指數下跌1.11%，費城半導體指數重挫4.30%、連續六個交易日走跌。

summary: 正崴集團旗下風電公司富崴與台電為了「台電離岸風電二期」風機接管問題槓上，富崴日前遭質疑偽造債權，引發外界關注。為此，富崴董事長林坤煌於本月13日下午在律師陪同下接受本刊訪問，回覆外界質疑。他強調富崴並未點交風機予台電，仍擁有風機所有權。至於將30組風機設定抵押，林坤煌解釋，主要是因應聯貸銀行團要求提供擔保。此外，富崴向崴強借貸是為了支付包商費用，不僅是真實支出，更曾以重訊方式公開揭露，台電方面也知情。

title: 富崴求去盼調解2／大賠200億元卻成「裝潢蟑螂」 富崴盼合意解約走工程會調解
summary: 今年9月底，為了「台電離岸風電二期」風機所有權歸屬，富崴一句「國家級洗劫」引爆與台電間的戰火，雙方互槓多時卻無法解決問題，富崴甚至遭批「裝潢蟑螂」。富崴董事長林坤煌受訪時坦言，「付出200億元代價，卻被罵裝潢蟑螂，真的很冤。富崴只希望能真正解約，包含未來的營運、保固也交付給台電。」他建議，「雙方應儘速回歸工程會調解機制，並納入銀行團作為協商對象。」近日富崴就會重新向工程會申請調解，讓一切回歸正軌。

title: 富崴求去盼調解3／郭台強無奈認栽　直言風電產業需要國家資源

title: 熙特爾攜手 Volvo、漢吉 搶攻 AIDC 電力商機

title_en: Xiter joins hands with Volvo and Hanji to seize AIDC power business opportunities
summary_en: Xitel-Tron (7740) announced on the 14th that it has entered the AI ​​Data Center (AIDC) self-contained power generation market. Its subsidiary Chenxi Precision signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Hanji Co., Ltd., the Taiwan general agent of Swedish Volvo Penta, to jointly build a 10MW modular self-contained power system by combining international gas power generation technology with Taiwan’s local manufacturing strength. Xite will also appear at the "2026 Taiwan International Smart Energy Week" from October 14 to 16, with the theme of "Letting Power Keep Up with Computing Power". For the first time, it will fully demonstrate the AIDC full-chain power solution covering power generation, transmission and distribution, energy storage, UPS/BBU backup and EMS smart energy management, demonstrating its ambition to expand into AI critical power infrastructure from the energy storage field.

title_en: Cathay Securities Investment Viewpoint for October: The AI ​​craze has entered the acceptance period and the industry chain welcomes new business opportunities
summary_en: As the time series enters the fourth quarter, the market focus gradually shifts from interest rate policy to corporate profit performance. Whether AI investment can further create substantial profits has also become the focus of investors. Cathay Securities observed that after the U.S. economy experienced strong growth in the first half of the year, recent consumption and employment data have cooled slightly, reflecting that the economy is gradually returning to a more robust pace of growth. As salary growth slows and the cost of living remains high, consumption growth may become moderate in the future. Therefore, the market is also paying more attention to whether corporate investment can continue to support economic growth, among which AI-related expenditures have become an important observation indicator.

summary_en: Tropical depression TD33 was generated at 8 a.m. this morning. According to the meteorological expert "Taiwan Typhoon Forum | Weather Emergency", it is expected to develop into Typhoon Qiangbi. In the next 7 days, guided by the Pacific high pressure, it will first move westward along the edge of the high pressure, and its intensity will gradually increase. It is currently estimated that the peak may reach a strong typhoon.

title_en: Will your marriage be in danger after your children grow up and you retire? Doctors reveal the relationship crises most easily overlooked by mature couples
summary_en: In recent years, the issue of mature divorce has attracted attention. When children grow up and couples enter retirement life, the work and childcare responsibilities that originally maintained the family operation gradually fade away, and marital problems accumulated over the years may also surface. Psychiatrists say that the breakdown of a marriage may not necessarily be due to major events such as an affair. Problems such as a long-term lack of emotional communication, failure to understand efforts, repeated criticism and control, etc., if never repaired, may gradually erode the relationship between husband and wife.

summary_en: The 2026 Tainan Hot Air Balloon Party will be held on the 17th and 18th at the west side square of the Yonghua Civic Center and Siraya Plaza of the Tainan City Government. title_en: Xinxing Electronics Yangmei Factory suffered a work safety accident on the 13th! Taoyuan Labor Inspection Office orders work to be suspended
summary_en: An industrial safety accident occurred at Xinxing Electronics Yangmei Factory on the 13th. An employee was pinched by a machine while repairing the machine and died after being rushed to the hospital. The Taoyuan City Labor Inspection Office stated that it has asked Xinxing Electronics to stop work. A preliminary investigation found that the cause of the accident was that the machinery that caused the disaster did not have safety equipment and measures. Since Xinxing Electronics is a listed company, it can impose a fine of up to 3 million yuan.

title_en: Video/AI drives electricity demand President Lai Qingde: Expand green energy and energy storage construction to stabilize power supply
summary_en: The "2026 Taiwan International Net Zero Sustainability Exhibition and Taiwan International Smart Energy Week" was held at the Nangang Exhibition Center in the morning. President Lai Ching-te said in his speech that in the face of the power demand brought about by the development of AI and the increasingly severe climate challenges, the government is actively improving energy resilience. Currently, Taiwan's renewable energy installation capacity has grown from 4.7 GW in 2016 to 25 GW, an increase of more than 4 times; the cumulative total offshore wind power installation capacity ranks fifth in the world. In the future, the government will continue to promote diversified green energy, energy storage, energy conservation and the construction of a strong power grid to stabilize power supply, implement energy security and achieve net-zero transformation.

title: 「出前一丁」泡麵未標過敏原 遭紐澳召回 台灣也有輸入 食藥署說話了

title_en: "Demae Itcho" instant noodles were not labeled with allergens and were recalled by New Zealand and Australia. They were also imported from Taiwan. The Food and Drug Administration spoke out.
summary_en: The common Japanese instant noodle brand "Nissin" has one of its "Demae Itcho Salted Sesame Oil Noodles" that was urgently recalled by the Food Standards Agency of New Zealand and Australia. The reason is that the product is adulterated with milk, but the manufacturer did not label this allergen, which may cause consumers with a history of allergies to accidentally eat it and suffer allergic reactions. In this regard, the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare of my country pointed out that after confirming with the industry, although the same product has inspection records for import into the country, the industry has added allergen information in the Chinese label, so this consumer warning is listed as the lowest level of "green light."

title_en: Countdown to underground opening to traffic! On the "last night" of Tainan Station on the 16th, the train blew three whistles to bid farewell to the century-old platform
summary_en: The Tainan Railway will be opened underground on the 17th. The Taiwan Railways will hold the "Last Night: Forever Tainan" commemorative event at Tainan Station at 9 pm on the 16th to bid farewell to the above-ground railway that has accompanied the city for a hundred years. The last Southbound Ziqiang train No. 145 to leave the above-ground platform that night is expected to depart at 10:29 p.m. The driver will blow the whistle three times to symbolize farewell to the past, thank you for your company, and look forward to the future, leaving a historic moment for Tainan's above-ground railway.

title_en: Obtained the "Excellent" certification for a friendly workplace for middle-aged and elderly people. Major buyers create a workplace that is inclusive and happy for generations.
summary_en: Facing the advent of a super-aged society, middle-aged and elderly talents have become an important force for the sustainable development of enterprises. title: 達發攜手母公司聯發科參展　協助電信業者打造下一代網路
summary:
達發科技攜手母公司聯發科技共同參展Network X 2026，於現場展示下一世代 50G-PON AI 網路閘道器 (Gateway) 處理器與基於代理型 AI 固網寬頻網路診斷與自行修復解決方案。達發科技 50G-PON 可實現 50+50Gbps 對稱式雙向效能，具低功耗優勢，相較 XGS-PON 傳輸速度最高提升 5 倍、延遲最高降低 80%，並將高速 PON、乙太網、Wi-Fi 8 與 Edge AI 能力整合於下一世代固網寬頻網路閘道器平台。達發科技 50G-PON AI 網路閘道器處理器此次入圍 Network X Awards 2026「Outstanding Multi-Gigabit Fibre Access Innovation」。

隨著 AI、Cloud、4K/8K 影音、AR/MR、智慧製造等應用持續增加，固定寬頻網路除了需要更高的傳輸速度，也必須兼顧低延遲、封包處理效能與邊緣運算能力。達發科技 50G-PON 採高度整合 SoC 架構，具備強大的封包處理能力與 20 核心，並支援高速 Wi-Fi 8，可同時處理 50 Gbps PON、乙太網路接口、Wi-Fi 8 及各類加密封包處理，支援住宅、企業及產業應用持續成長的頻寬需求。

達發科技執行副總經理暨發言人謝孟翰表示：「固網寬頻正從高速接取進一步朝智慧化網路演進。達發科技將 PON、乙太網、Wi-Fi、封包處理與 Edge AI 整合於單一平台，不只持續提高網路頻寬與降低延遲，也讓 Gateway 逐步具備網路診斷與自我修復能力。在達發科技與母公司聯發科技『大小平台，分工合作』的策略下，高度整合光纖高速網路與 Wi-Fi、5G CPE 三個技術平台，協助全球電信業者提升網路服務品質與營運效率，並為未來 AI 原生寬頻服務建立可持續演進的基礎。」

除了高速傳輸，達發科技 50G-PON AI Gateway Processor 亦內建 TOPS-level 算力，可支援多種主流 AI 模型，讓電信業者進一步在 Gateway 上部署加值服務。相關 AI 能力可運用於網路異常偵測、自動故障診斷與自我修復能力，並支援生成式 AI 應用。平台亦支援後量子密碼學 PQC (Post-Quantum Cryptography)，提前因應未來量子運算環境下的網路安全需求。

針對無線網路收訊不佳、組態錯誤 (misconfiguration)、光網路單元 (ONU) 狀態異常、連線不穩定或裝置過載等常見家庭寬頻問題，該方案將具備晶片導向的專業知識 LLM AI 代理人部署於 Gateway 或 ONU。使用者可透過自然語言描述問題，由 AI Agent 結合設備遙測、網路狀態及診斷知識庫辨識根本原因，並進一步提供處理建議或執行安全的修復動作。

目前已驗證企業級 AI 輔助診斷可部署於既有 Fiber Gateway。達發科技的固網寬頻晶片透過 CPU 與 RISC-V 的架構執行基於大型語言模型的智慧代理 (LLM-based Agent)，降低導入 AI Agent 對高 TOPS 終端裝置運算的依賴，同時維持核心路由效能。

中東衝突再度升溫，布蘭特原油突破106美元，影響美國科技指數走弱，中國記憶體廠宣布技術突破，拖累美光及韓國記憶體股重挫，引發韓股盤中一度跌幅逾7%，連帶拖累周二台股跳空開低下跌，台積電、台光電等AI電子股遭遇賣壓，加權指數下跌1.95%，失守10日線並回測月線附近，OTC指數則重挫逾3%。

title_en: Before the market opens on October 14th/Taiwan stocks are back-testing the monthly line due to external negative news, waiting for TSMC’s legal announcement to make a bullish breakthrough
summary_en:
Yesterday's market trend
The conflict in the Middle East heated up again. Brent crude oil exceeded US$106, affecting the weakening of the US technology index. China's memory factory announced a technological breakthrough, which dragged down Micron and South Korean memory stocks, causing the Korean stock market to fall by more than 7% during the session. This also caused Taiwan stocks to jump lower and fall on Tuesday. TSMC, Taiwan Optoelectronics and other AI electronics stocks encountered selling pressure. The weighted index fell by 1.95%, fell below the 10-day line and retested the monthly line, and the OTC index fell by more than 3%.
The funds on the market have been transferred to the financial and manufacturing groups. Formosa Plastics Group has made impressive profits in the first three quarters and has been favored by funds. Formosa Plastics has a strong light and has a strong daily limit performance.
In the electronics sector, Yujing Optoelectronics and Zhongyang Optoelectronics, which have only some optical lenses that cut into the subject of optical communications, have been sought after by funds, and their stock prices have reached their daily limit.
In terms of weight stocks, TSMC fell by 1.97%, Hon Hai fell by 1.84%, MediaTek fell by 2.16%, Quanta rose by 0.31%, and Delta Electronics fell by 6.58%.
Strong stocks on the market, including Formosa Plastics, Guoqiao, Yujingguang, Zhongyangguang, Qiyang, Guangji, Binchuan, China Probe, and Meisheng Securities, a total of 24 stocks have reached daily limit; Lizhi, Dunyangke, Guanxi Dian, Medei Medical-DR, Nanliu, Dashan, Donglian, etc. have increased by more than 8%.
Weak stocks on the market, including Brand New, Lianya, Daduo, Dajia, Weihuake, Yingguang, etc., fell by the limit in 13 levels; Changyuan, Taiwan Optoelectronics, IET-KY, Shangquan, Jiada, etc. fell by more than 9%. At the end, the Taiwan Weighted Index fell 960.65 points to close at 48341.31 points, with a trading volume of 1.12 trillion yuan.
Stocks in the three major sectors were mixed, with electronics falling.

summary_en: I can’t find my glasses and forget what I ate yesterday. Is this dementia? Geriatrics expert Chen Naijing pointed out that the key to judgment is whether the elder has lost the ability to be familiar with it; from asking repeated questions, misunderstanding the things in front of them, to losing discretion in spending money, family members must understand the changes in the life of the elderly, but they must not let their concern turn into a test in class.

summary_en: The more parents degenerate, the more their children will blame themselves; they have hired help, but they dare not leave even for a moment. The difficulty of dementia care is often caused by the fact that family members don’t know how to deal with it. Geriatrics expert Chen Naijing shared her outpatient experience and reminded the public that care goals should be adjusted according to the course of the disease, and division of labor and respite should be arranged early to take care of the patient, themselves and the entire family.

title: 麥可戴爾稱AI數據中心建設未放緩，能源挑戰不致妨礙2027年成長
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】戴爾科技(美股代碼DELL)創辦人、董事長兼執行長麥可戴爾(Michael Dell)美東週二(13日)上午在紐約證券交易所，接受美國財經媒體CNBC《Squawk on the Street》主持人David Faber專訪時表示，AI數據中心建設並未放緩。儘管能源消耗與建設阻力受到關注，他認為相關挑戰尚不構成公司2027年成長前景的重大障礙。戴爾指出，產業正透過提升系統效率、降低能源消耗及發展模組化數據中心，因應基礎設施擴張的限制。模組化設計也可能縮小環境足跡，顯示業者正調整建置方式，以支援持續增加的AI運算需求。他對2027年前景的表態，延續公司對相關業務成長的正面看法。面對市場對AI泡沫的疑慮，戴爾認為，目前供應仍不足以滿足需求，並表示晶片供應吃緊可能延續至2030年。這番談話正值投資人更嚴格檢視AI融資成本與資本支出回報，提供設備供應商對建設需求的另一種觀察，但不代表所有數據中心專案均能順利推進。戴爾也提到，AI必須具備安全防護與控制措施，政府在其中有角色，但未具體說明應如何介入。他認為，圍繞數據中心的討論具有價值，業界應持續改善能源效率。

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，國際貨幣基金組織(IMF)方面認為，美國僅靠經濟成長無法足夠快地解決不斷上升的債務和財政赤字問題，還需要採取其他措施。IMF總裁格奧爾基耶娃(Kristalina Georgieva)週三表示，美國政府非常依賴強勁的經濟成長。成長當然會有幫助，但無法足夠快地帶來必要的調整。格奧爾基耶娃在曼谷舉行的IMF和世界銀行年會期間表示，有必要採取一些措施。美國財長貝森特認為美國可以依靠強勁的經濟成長來改變債務和財政赤字的發展軌跡。貝森特上週表示，重要的是債務占GDP的比重，我們將開始扭轉這條曲線並把它降下來。這可能會很快發生。貝森特指出，如果國內生產毛額持續以超過3%的速度成長，將有助於實現這一目標，而上一季度已經有機會達到這一增速。貝森特本週未出席IMF會議。

summary: 數發部先前舉行「臺灣主權AI訓練語料庫」啟動民間語料徵集活動，為強化臺灣主權AI訓練語料庫的在地文化內涵與語料深度，推動民間語料徵集計畫，不過，相關語料授權及付費機制也引發關注，立委今日質詢時擔憂，未來徵集範圍若擴及新聞媒體，是否可能要求業者無償提供內容，影響新聞產業權益。

title: 遷松山機場打造台北AI園區？林宜敬：市中心不適合蓋算力中心
summary: （中央社記者趙敏雅台北14日電）台北市長蔣萬安日前宣布，規劃遷移松山機場，整合機場及周邊共300公頃腹地，打造成台北人工智慧（AI）園區。數發部長林宜敬今天表示，市中心地段較不會用於蓋工廠或AI算力中心，較可能吸引跨國企業總部進駐；至於AI算力中心，彰濱或高雄亞灣較適合設置，數發部都有相關規劃。

AI晶片競爭重心轉向先進封裝，從製程微縮延伸到晶片排列、連接與堆疊。

title_en: AI chips become stronger not just by the manufacturing process! Advanced packaging becomes the new key, TSMC’s layout attracts attention
summary_en:
The focus of AI chip competition has shifted to advanced packaging, extending from process shrinkage to chip arrangement, connection and stacking.
TSMC integrates AI computing chips and HBM with advanced packaging, expanding its packaging capacity several times. It will announce its quarterly financial report on Thursday.
Advanced packaging has become a new focus, driving business opportunities for TSMC and equipment manufacturers. Applied Materials estimates that packaging revenue will grow by more than 70% this year.

title: 微軟推新 AI 晶片 將降低對輝達、超微的依賴 台積助攻
summary: 微軟宣布，推出最新自研AI晶片「Maia 300」，計劃明年部署可能超過100萬顆，以降低對輝達、超微等晶片供應商的依賴。

title_en: Microsoft launches new AI chip to reduce dependence on Huida and Advanced Micro Devices, TSMC assists
summary_en: Microsoft announced the launch of its latest self-developed AI chip "Maia 300" and plans to deploy more than 1 million chips next year to reduce dependence on chip suppliers such as Huida and Advanced Micro Devices.

title: IMF 估台 GDP 增10.7% 冠全球 提醒 AI 熱潮、中東衝突讓世界經濟 K 型發展
summary: 國際貨幣基金（IMF）13日發布最新版「世界經濟展望」（WEO），在多數國家今年經濟成長率預料大致將持平之際，台灣表現一枝獨秀，獲大幅上修一倍多至10.7%，不管是上修幅度、還是成長速度，都傲視全球主要經濟體，明年成長率預估也依然稱冠東亞經濟體。

title_en: The IMF estimates that Taiwan’s GDP will increase by 10.7%, ranking first in the world. It reminds that the AI ​​boom and the conflict in the Middle East will cause the world economy to develop in a K-shaped manner.
summary_en: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) released the latest version of the "World Economic Outlook" (WEO) on the 13th. While the economic growth rate of most countries this year is expected to be roughly flat, Taiwan's performance is unique, with a sharp upward revision of more than double to 10.7%. Both the upward revision and the growth rate are superior to the world's major economies, and next year's growth rate forecast is still the highest among East Asian economies.

title: 長鑫出大招 完成「4F²」設計 DRAM 市場嚇壞
summary: 大陸DRAM龍頭長鑫存儲稱領先全球同業，完成記憶體新的單元架構「4F²」設計，藉此提高DRAM密度，預計今年底前推出以該架構設計的DDR5產品，揮軍伺服器市場。
title_zh: 長鑫出大招 完成「4F²」設計 DRAM 市場嚇壞

title_en: Changxin makes a big move to complete the “4F²” design, frightening the DRAM market
summary_en: Mainland China's DRAM leader Changxin Memory claims to be ahead of its global peers in completing the design of a new memory cell architecture "4F²" to increase DRAM density. It is expected to launch DDR5 products designed with this architecture before the end of this year to enter the server market.

title: 全球記憶體股遭血洗 華強北報價不跌反漲
summary: 全球記憶體股遭血洗之際，大陸深圳華強北市場昨（13）日開出的最新一周報價透露新訊號，主要DRAM規格持續上漲，周漲幅最高達5.45%，與全球記憶體股重挫形成強烈對比，呈現「股票市場殺很凶，現實通路搶貨也搶很凶」的兩極現象。

title_en: Global memory stocks suffered a bloodbath, Huaqiangbei’s quotation rose instead of falling
summary_en: As global memory stocks are being bloodbathed, the latest weekly quotation from Shenzhen Huaqiangbei Market in Mainland China revealed new signals yesterday (13th). The main DRAM specifications continued to rise, with a weekly increase of up to 5.45%. This is in sharp contrast to the sharp decline in global memory stocks, showing a bipolar phenomenon of "the stock market is very fierce, and the real channel rush for goods is also very fierce."

title: 記憶體台廠遭血洗…無妄之災 主力產品壓根不同
summary: 長鑫存儲完成記憶體新的單元架構「4F²」設計的消息，引發全球記憶體股大賣壓，業界直言「市場真的反映過度了」，尤其台廠主力不在長鑫存儲這次鎖定的DDR5，且DDR5機台無法降規生產DDR3等利基型DRAM，市場恐將尚待兌現的技術進展，提前當成供給大增的隱憂，「台廠真的是無妄之災」。
title_zh: 記憶體台廠遭血洗…無妄之災 主力產品壓根不同

title_en: The Taiwanese memory factory suffered a bloodbath...an unforeseen disaster. The main products are fundamentally different.
summary_en: The news that Changxin Memory has completed the design of a new memory cell architecture "4F²" has triggered a huge selling pressure on global memory stocks. The industry bluntly said that "the market has really overreacted." Especially since the main force of Taiwanese manufacturers is not DDR5, which Changxin Memory has targeted this time, and DDR5 machines cannot reduce specifications to produce niche DRAMs such as DDR3. The market may regard the technological progress that has yet to be realized as a hidden worry for the surge in supply in advance. "The Taiwanese factory is really an unforeseen disaster."

title: 台股多頭回歸 要看四要素
summary: 台股昨（13）日重挫960點，加上匯市爆歷史天量、新台幣重貶，市場氛圍轉空，法人指出，台股多頭回歸再次上攻要看四大指標，包括台積電法說會明顯優於預期、技術面守住月線、美通膨降溫，外資轉向，若能達成多數指標，台股10月中旬就有機會轉攻向上。

title: 台積目標價 美銀喊3,260元 累計八家外資調升
summary: 台積電明（15）日舉行法說會前夕，外資爭相推出新報告，累計已有八家外資券商上調目標價，最高喊到4,410元，最新報告來自美銀證券，看好台積電受惠先進製程訂單強勁，加上先進封裝產能擴張，上調2026年至2028年獲利，考量本益比仍相對偏低，將目標價由3,100元調升至3,260元，給予「買進」評級。

title: 台泥歐洲上市 股臨會過關 董座張安平：集團「增加一隻腿」
summary: 台泥昨（13）日召開股東臨時會，會中以94.74%贊成比率，通過子公司Cimpor International Holdings於海外證券交易市場申請首次公開發行股票及掛牌交易案。台泥日前預告，Cimpor International將以英國倫敦證券交易所或泛歐交易所作為可能的掛牌市場。

title: 台泥：低碳優勢 難敵低價競爭
summary: 進口水泥低價競爭，台廠喊苦。水泥業者表示，受到東南亞高碳水泥低價競爭影響，儘管國內業者持續投入減碳，卻未能轉化為價格優勢，加上進口水泥市占率已突破三成，每公噸較國產品便宜約600元，產業面臨不小壓力。

title: TISA 租稅優惠 獲共識
summary: 台灣個人投資儲蓄帳戶（TISA）租稅優惠有譜，財政部次長陳勇勝昨（13）日鬆口表示，財政部與金管會已達成初步共識，方向朝提供免稅優惠規劃，但實際免稅額度、新制施行日期等，仍待進一步討論，施行時程要視修法進度而定。

title: 聯發科、達發射三箭 攻 AI 網通 協助電信業者打造下一代網路
summary: 聯發科與子公司達發攜手於歐洲全球網路與電信產業大會（Network X 2026）火力全開，大秀WiFi、5G CPE與PON等三大連網平台技術肌肉，透過三箭齊發，協助全球電信業者打造下一代網路，大咬AI時代帶來的網路通訊新商機。

title: 聯發科、達發攜手網通廠 全球攻城掠地
summary: 家用端網通設備（路由器或閘道器）整合多種傳輸技術已經是標配，聯發科與子公司達發近年整合橫跨WiFi、5G CPE、PON及AI解決方案，成為歐、美、亞等電信業指定晶片供應商，更攜手智易、亞旭、啟碁、中磊、仁寶、正文及合勤科技等網通廠，在全球市場攻城掠地。

title: 京元電赴美設廠 輝達搶產能 雙方簽訂客戶預付款協議
summary: 半導體晶圓測試大廠京元電昨（13）日公告，與輝達簽訂客戶預付款協議，由輝達先付錢、京元電赴美設廠，為輝達保留測試服務產能。

title: 三原因...京元電獲 AI 一哥青睞
summary: 京元電成為輝達第一家自掏腰包協助赴美建廠的台灣半導體供應鏈夥伴，引發關注。業界分析，京元電獲得輝達青睞，主因擁有AI GPU成品測試領導地位、自製預燒爐與液冷技術，以及銜接新世代晶片量產的能力。

title: 力成躍起 封測大黑馬
summary: 力成先前已獲博通攜手搶進先進封裝，伴隨京元電獲得輝達倚重，兩大美系晶片巨頭接連選中台廠，凸顯台灣封測業多年累積的技術與量產實力，已成為AI晶片搶攻市場的重要底氣，力成與京元電也將成為全球半導體封測業兩匹黑馬，順勢突圍而出。

title: 愛普發 GDR 募資 133 億元 將用於購料與擴大營運規模
summary: 客製化記憶體設計商愛普昨（13）日公告，完成海外存託憑證（GDR）發行訂價，每股折合新台幣898元，較12日收盤價947元折價約5.22%，共募得4.16億美元（約新台幣133億元），將用於支應外幣購料需求，以及因應營運規模擴大所需的資金周轉。

title: 微軟衝伺服器 代工廠就位
summary: 微軟（Microsoft）全力衝刺ASIC伺服器市場，除了ASIC運算效能提高外，網通、散熱、機殼等相關搭配應用也同步升級，目前鴻海、緯穎等AI代工大廠已準備就緒，後續有望擴大拿下微軟ASIC伺服器大單。

title: 外資大撤退 股匯遇亂流 台股公股救援單日買超412億元
summary: 台股昨（13）日浮現恐慌性賣壓，開低走低，盤中一度重跌1,235點，直接回測48K整數支撐。外資殺紅眼，賣超1,652.9億元改寫史上第三大，幸賴公股券商、投信等國家隊進場護盤，終場險守48K。

title: 櫃買明年搬家 考慮兩地點
summary: 櫃買中心現址租約將於2027年6月到期，正緊鑼密鼓尋找新辦公室。由於搬遷事關重大，櫃買中心預計一個月內拍板定案。目前已傳出兩個可能地點，包括自來水博物館附近大樓、富邦信義A25；惟櫃買強調，還在評估中，希望一個月內拍板。

title: Meta 推最強 AI 模型 Muse Wonder 號稱效能比肩對手 帶旺台鏈
summary: Meta於12日推出人工智慧（AI）模型Muse Wonder，號稱效能可與OpenAI、Anthropic等對手的產品相比擬，技術躋身領先之列。執行長祖克柏宣稱已追上對手，並將持續投入巨資開發新模型挑戰，資本支出上看2,000億美元。

title: Meta AI 模型能處理複雜任務 實力直追第一梯隊
summary: Meta推出最新AI模型Muse Wonder和Muse Wonder Full，且在程式設計、金融及法律應用上甚至可媲美業界頂尖模型，且能記憶數月的相關資訊，處理複雜任務上，AI還能夠自行更換策略，顯示Meta本次在AI模型實力上正全面追趕第一梯隊。

title: 超微實現機櫃級代理運算
summary: 晶片大廠超微（AMD）宣布，推出Helion代理式AI機櫃，以實現機櫃級代理式AI運算。隨著相關業務拓展，外界預期，相關供應鏈包括鴻海、緯穎、雲達等廠商都將受惠。

title: 電路板展下周二舉辦 機械廠大搶商機
summary: 2026台灣電路板產業國際展覽會（TPCA Show）將於10月20日登場，AI伺服器、高階PCB、IC載板與先進封裝製程升級，吸引東台、東捷、恩德、大銀、直得等機械與零組件大廠領軍參展，展示鑽孔、成型、雷射加工、自動化及高階製程設備，積極爭取AI相關擴產商機。

title: 海外訂單 機械設備廠新成長動能

title: LME期銅週二震盪下跌0.28%，市場權衡AI基礎設施過熱隱憂與供應風險
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，倫敦銅價週二震盪走低，市場在AI基礎設施投資過熱擔憂和供應風險之間權衡。倫敦金屬交易所(LME)期銅下跌40.50美元或0.28%，報14,578.00美元/噸。在一系列警告稱數據中心快速擴張將越來越難以獲得融資後，全球市場的AI和科技股下跌。看漲銅價的人士認為，未來十年AI基礎設施將成為銅需求的重要來源，因此任何對相關支出速度的疑慮都可能打擊市場情緒。其他基本金屬價格表現方面，LME期鋁下跌0.4%，報3,039美元/噸；LME期鎳下跌0.2%，報15,587美元/噸；LME期鋅下跌0.7%，報3,731.5美元/噸；LME期錫下跌2.7%，報51,767美元/噸；LME期鉛上漲1%，報1,902美元/噸。

title: 美銀調查顯示，創紀錄比例投資人選擇避開法國股票
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】根據美國銀行(美銀)發表最新一項調查指出，隨著法國國內政治與財政壓力持續給區域股市蒙上陰影，創紀錄數量的投資人明確表示，計畫在未來控制並削減對法國股票的風險敞口。這項於10月2日至8日期間進行的區域基金經理人調查顯示，多達56%的基金經理人表示將在未來12個月內低配法國股票。如此高比例的低配意向，直接使法國一舉成為當前歐洲地區最不受青睞的股票市場。 近幾週以來，市場對法國財政赤字與政局動盪的疑慮急遽升溫，引發法國股市與主權國債同步遭到法人大舉拋售。此舉推升法國政府的借貸成本顯著上揚，融資成本甚至飆升至接近25年來的最高水準。受此賣壓籠罩影響，法國藍籌股指標CAC 40指數今年迄今累計已下跌3.95%。反觀，道瓊歐洲600指數同期漲7.8%，顯示出法國股市表現明顯落後於歐洲大盤。

title: 美債週二報價漲跌互見，紐約聯儲總裁鴿派言論支撐，長債價格上漲
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】美國公債價格週二漲跌不一，長天期債券價格上漲，主要受到聯準會紐約分行行長鴿派言論支撐。根據債券交易報價，2年期公債價格下跌，殖利率上揚0.21個基點，報4.7890%；5年期公債價格上漲，殖利率下跌1.44個基點，報5.0013%。10年期公債價格上揚，殖利率下跌2.94個基點，報5.2084%；30年期公債價格揚升，殖利率滑落3.86個基點，報5.5569%。聯準會紐約分行行長威廉姆斯表示，今年再升息一次將是合適的，但目前認為聯準會2027年無需再次升息。與聯準會會期掛鉤的隔夜指數互換(OIS)保持穩定，顯示市場大體預計今年年底前升息一次、幅度為25個基點，以及到明年年中累計升息75個基點。美國公債期權方面，週三關鍵消費者物價指數(CPI)數據公佈前，期權市場也出現一些資金流。當日出現看跌需求，其中兩筆較為突出的交易似乎押注長端債券拋售延續。另一筆交易似乎是專門針對消費者物價指數(CPI)事件風險的對沖，是一筆押注截至週三收盤殖利率將走高的短期交易。

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】紐約金價週二下跌，因市場權衡聯準會官員對於未來政策路徑的評論。紐約12月份黃金期貨價格下跌13.30美元或0.32%，報每盎司4,177.30美元；紐約黃金現貨價格則是下滑11.49美元或0.28%，報每盎司4,160.74美元。隨著油價波動和美國利率前景成為交易員關注焦點，金價走勢缺乏明確方向。金價收盤跌幅收窄，此前聯準會紐約分行行長威廉姆斯表示，他仍認為今年年內再升息一次是合適的，但目前預計明年沒有升息必要。道明證券全球大宗商品策略主管Bart Melek表示，威廉姆斯的言論應該利多黃金，因為這降低了2027年稍晚時持倉成本上升的風險。

title: 韓國研議再減公債發行規模5兆至10兆韓元，運用超額稅收穩定債市
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國媒體News1報導，韓國政府正研議運用超額稅收，進一步削減公債發行規模5兆至10兆韓元，以因應公債殖利率居高與市場波動。討論方案包括11月至12月合計減發10兆韓元，或年底前減發5兆韓元，目前尚未定案，相關部門對資金應優先用於穩定市場或挹注未來基金，仍存在不同意見。這項研議是在10月已減發5兆韓元的基礎上，考慮進一步降低供給。韓國財政部門先前公布，10月公債競標發行規模約12兆韓元，低於9月的16兆韓元，並表示將持續觀察市場，必要時再調降發行量。財政部長李亨一也曾指出，政府可視情況採取緊急債券買回等穩定措施。韓國政府減少發債的財政空間，部分來自半導體產業景氣帶動的稅收增加。除了降低新券供給，10月也規劃將公債提前買回規模，由前月的1.5兆韓元提高至3.5兆韓元，透過減發與買回並行，緩解債市供需壓力，降低高利率對政府及民間融資環境的衝擊。從市場供需角度看，若追加減發落實，有助減輕投資人承接新券的壓力，但不代表殖利率必然回落，後續仍受通膨、貨幣政策及全球債市走勢影響。市場將關注政府最終削減規模、執行月份與各期限配置，以及超額稅收的分配決定，藉此評估措施對債市的支撐程

title: 惠譽警告全球十大發達經濟體債息攀升，政府債務料突破75兆美元
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】國際信用評級機構惠譽(Fitch)發表最新報告顯示，政府公債殖利率上升，正使主要發達經濟體更難穩定債務負擔，法國、美國及英國面臨日益嚴峻的財政挑戰。今年以來，全球十大發達經濟體的指標10年期公債殖利率平均上升81個基點；惠譽預估，發達市場政府債務總額將增加近4兆美元，升至逾75兆美元，其中十大發達經濟體債務合計將達68.5兆美元。惠譽指出，主要發達經濟體目前的10年期公債殖利率中位數，比未償債務的平均利率高出161個基點。隨著既有債務到期、政府以較高利率重新融資，利息負擔將逐步增加，使穩定債務占國內生產毛額(GDP)比率所需的財政調整更加困難。法國方面，惠譽估計，若要穩定債務負擔，須將不含利息支出的基本赤字，由今年預估占國內生產毛額(GDP)的2.9%降至0.4%；若實際借貸成本升至目前市場殖利率水準，還須進行相當於GDP約3.1%的進一步財政調整。惠譽預期，到2030年法國債務占GDP比率將上升12個百分點至128%，為所比較國家中增幅最大者。美國今年政府整體預算赤字預估達GDP的7.5%，約2.4兆美元，為惠譽所比較國家中最高。相較之下，日本債務占GDP比率預計

title: 中國Q3手機出貨年減15.4%，華為市占21.1%，IDC料Q4仍低迷
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】市場研究機構IDC週二發表最新調查報告顯示，今年第三季中國智慧型手機出貨量約5,790萬台，年比下降15.40%，相較上半年約4%的減幅，市場萎縮速度明顯加快。記憶體及其他零組件成本攀升，推動終端售價上漲並促使廠商調整產品配置，已開始抑制消費需求。IDC預期，第四季市場仍難有起色，成本壓力更可能延續至2027年大部分時間。IDC指出，第三季市場呈現「量跌價升」特徵，消費者仍需時間適應較高售價，換機週期進一步拉長，直接拖累出貨表現。零組件漲價不僅影響手機售價，也牽動產品規格與配置，使成本壓力成為左右中國手機市場走勢的關鍵因素。品牌表現方面，華為是主要廠商中唯一實現出貨量年比雙位數成長的品牌，第三季市占率達21.10%；蘋果以17.80%居次。IDC表示，蘋果新品上市後的市場接受度優於預期，但因今年機型數量減少，出貨量仍較去年同期小幅下滑，顯示新品熱度尚不足以完全抵銷出貨壓力。展望後市，IDC預估中國智慧型手機市場仍將延續明顯下滑趨勢，但主要品牌憑藉較強的品牌吸引力，以及相對有限的漲價幅度，有望在既有市場中爭取更多消費者。隨著消費者逐步適應新的價格體系，並迎來下一輪換機

title: Apple TV 4K第4代大升級！A19晶片效能翻倍 免拿遙控器就能呼喚Siri
summary: Apple發表新一代Apple TV 4K（第4代），針對運算效能、家庭劇院音訊與智慧家庭控制全面升級。新機搭載A19晶片，CPU效能較上一代提升最多50%，GPU效能最高達上一代2倍，並首度內建遠距麥克風，讓使用者不必拿起遙控器，就能透過Siri操作影音內容與智慧家庭配件。Apple TV 4K（第4代）即日起開放預訂，建議售價9,900元，預計11月13日開始供貨。

title: 中華電信工會啟動罷工投票 年輕員工嘆訴求恐導致升遷卡關
summary: 中華電信工會因不滿資方在加薪、勞退提繳率等承諾跳票，近期醞釀罷工行動，各界討論中除了力挺員工爭取自身保障，也有年輕人員提出不同意見。近來一篇以中華電信年輕員工處境為題的Threads貼文引發熱議，指工會提出延後退休、提高勞退提撥等訴求，恐讓年輕員工面臨升遷卡關、世代資源分配失衡等問題，引發正反議論。

title: 捷克摩瑟水晶巡迴展登場 國際雕刻大師現身台中大遠百
summary: 捷克摩瑟水晶「2026 Moser奇幻摩瑟」巡迴展以「藝境之巔，耀世鋒芒」為主題，集結經典水晶雕刻作品與當代藝術創作，13日起至15日在台中大遠百8樓展出。國際雕刻大師史沃博達（Radek Svoboda）也到場，分享創作歷程、雕刻技藝與藝術理念，邀請收藏家及水晶愛好者近距離感受摩瑟水晶傳承百年的工藝之美與藝術魅力。

title: 「陸勝二號」明起10天9夜旅對抗演習 M1A2T戰車、無人機納入驗證
summary: 陸軍年度「陸勝二號」演習將從明天起展開10天9夜實兵對抗操演。今年的操演除了磨練兩軍攻防、指管外，也將M1A2T戰車、無人機以及陸區第3代系統等新式裝備，納入戰術驗證。

title: 褒忠樂活長照館溫馨落成開館 打造長照托嬰共構的全齡照顧基地
summary: 雲林縣褒忠鄉「樂活長照館」今天下午舉行落成典禮，總工程經費約5千多萬元，館舍採地上2層樓設計，1樓規畫日間照顧中心、2樓設置公設民營托嬰中心，打造全鄉首座長照與托育服務共構的福利大樓，從嬰幼兒到高齡長者提供連續性照顧，落實在地安老及育兒支持，今天溫馨開館，熱鬧滾滾。

title: 96歲阿未奶奶再展大愛！任台中榮總志工逾22年…今再捐1輛中巴
summary: 96歲的「阿未桑」江林阿未曾任台中榮總志工逾22年，今再次展大愛，捐一輛全新21人座中型巴士給台中榮總，由院長傅雲慶代表受贈並致贈感謝狀。江林阿未早年風雨無阻騎單車、轉乘公車到中榮服務，如今再捐車支援醫療團隊，用行動陪伴更多有需要的病友與偏鄉民眾。

title: 全民運聖火傳遞今起跑 張善政邀市民共襄盛舉
summary: 2026全民運動會將於10月17日至22日在桃園登場，桃市府今天在市府前廣場舉行市內聖火傳遞起跑儀式為賽事揭開序幕。市長張善政表示，本屆全民運共設32個競賽種類，選手年齡橫跨6歲至88歲，將在43處場地競技，期盼透過聖火傳遞凝聚市民熱情，帶動全民運動風氣，邀請民眾共同迎接這場運動盛會。

summary: 台南地下站預計本周六正式啟用，宣告服役百年的既有台南站即將走入歷史，台鐵也少見的舉辦「最後一夜紀念活動」，以路牌交接與三響鳴笛向地上鐵道致敬。而為迎接新站，台鐵也推出限量便當，邀請鐵道迷共襄盛舉。

title: Re系再擴大！Prada發表Re-Wool、Re-Cashmere企劃 用好料、負責任！
summary: 義大利時尚品牌Prada過往曾發表過Re-Nylon系列，品牌本月發表了全新Re-Wool與Re-Cashmere企劃，透過專責原料採購與精緻工藝，重新詮釋時尚代表性的羊毛與喀什米爾羊絨，落實降低環境影響的長期承諾，兩項新系列並強調義大利匠人技術，將嚴謹的服裝工藝轉化為具雋永風格與當代精神的服裝作品。

title: 締造華人威士忌里程碑！王方杰晉升全球第3位華人雙料至高榮譽精英
summary: 蘇格蘭威士忌產業重要榮譽，再添華人面孔。英國威士忌業者懷特．馬凱（Whyte & Mackay）大中華區總監王方杰（Kenny Wang），日前於蘇格蘭高地布萊爾城堡（Blair Castle）舉行的「蘇格蘭威士忌雙耳執杯者（Keepers of the Quaich）」授勳典禮上，獲頒「蘇格蘭威士忌雙耳執杯大師（Master of the Quaich）」榮譽，肯定他長期深耕大中華市場、推廣蘇格蘭威士忌文化的產業貢獻。

title: 換手機、清衣櫃都能賺回饋！愛買量販回收舊手機加碼送百元折價券
summary: 秋季換機、換季衣物整理潮帶動回收需求，愛買量販推出多項回收加碼優惠，讓民眾汰舊換新也能省荷包。愛買觀察，受iPhone新機上市帶動，BUNNIT手機自助回收機台短短2週回收量，相較過往單月暴增3倍。即日起至10月27日，民眾於指定門市透過BUNNIT成功回收指定舊手機，除可獲得回收金，還能加領「滿1,000元折100元」電子抵用券；回收二手衣滿5件可兌換50元抵用券，回收5顆燈泡或燈管則可獲得光源系列商品20元電子抵用券，讓家中閒置物品變身消費回饋。

title: 癌症標靶生物相似藥毒素試驗超標 沙國緊急回收 食藥署發布黃燈警訊
summary: 與5FU化療藥物合用於治療轉移性大腸直腸癌，與太平洋紫杉醇化療藥物合併用於治療轉移性乳癌癌症標靶藥物bevacizumab，包括癌思停等原廠藥品，其生物相似藥、由印度公司Biocon Biologics Limited製造的「KRABEVA 400 mg」，在沙烏地阿拉伯被發現藥品細菌內毒素試驗超出規格上限、啟動回收，我國食藥署指出，經評估同批號品並無輸入台灣，消費紅綠燈列為中等級「黃燈」。

title: 此生必看！莫札特《女人皆如此》 《灰姑娘》 法國名導版本上演
summary: 今年是莫札特270歲誕辰，臺中國家歌劇院年度旗艦歌劇《女人皆如此》，將帶來2022年在法國香榭麗舍劇院首演、鬼才導演羅杭．佩利的版本，透過錄音室裡的一場「戲中戲」，讓這齣18世紀的「交換伴侶」喜劇，有了當代的觀點和樣貌，10月29日至11月1日將在大劇院連演4場。

title: Apple HomePod mini 2登場！5色選擇、聲波光暈 還可組成環繞音響系統

title: 馬斯克坦承不懂晶片製造 還有非常多知識要學
summary:
全球首富、特斯拉創辦人馬斯克承認他不知道如何製造半導體，並坦言晶片製造仍有極大量的知識需要學習、不知道該如何製造晶片，但是，作為一個貫徹始終的樂觀主義者，馬斯克相信他與Terafab的團隊最終能夠弄懂並掌握這一切。

馬斯克表示，我們接下來要做的，就是先從傳統的標準設備切入，接著我們會改造這些設備來提升機台吞吐量，然後在我們看到瓶頸的地方，我們會打造客製化設備，以實現大幅提升的晶圓產出量，這些計畫可能需要好多年的時間才能實現，目標是在同一個廠區內，建立涵蓋光罩製作、晶圓製造以及封裝得流程，透過改進這些迭代，實現更高的晶元吞吐量和改善效益。。

有趣的是，馬斯克上月底才向中國媒體宣稱，中國將在兩、三年內克服晶片製造限制，解決為穎與晶片製造方面的算力瓶頸，並稱讚中國國家主席習近平是偉大領袖，如今卻承認自己不知道如何製造半導體，說法反覆。

summary: 928前夕，央行總裁楊金龍意外宣布房市管制雙鬆綁，第一時間地產業者紛紛拍手叫好，並期許房市反轉向上。不過事與願違，本刊實際走訪發現，除中古屋市場外，預售案場仍未見看屋人潮，業者直言928檔期冷到爆炸。「股市夯與科技業擴廠吸走大量資金，房貸戶還是借不到錢，加上擔心選後央行可能升息，2大利空夾擊下，即便央行放水，第4季房市仍如一灘死水，大家只能自求多福。」地產業者搖著頭說。

title: 房市寒冬未解2／升息陰影罩頂　預售解約、房貸逾放、法拍3警鈴響起
summary: 房市除了貸款難，第2大隱憂則是升息。美國聯準會9月宣布升息1碼，為2023年以來首度升息，並暗示年底前可能再升。台北市不動產開發公會理事長陳勝宏擔心，台灣也有可能升息，「世界各國都在升息，資金緊繃的問題只會更緊，對房市就是雪上加霜。」

summary_en: Power supply leader Delta Electronics announced yesterday (12th) that its September consolidated revenue was 65.4 billion yuan, the strongest September ever, with a monthly increase of 1.3% and an annual increase of 14.6%. The main driving force came from the growth in data center-related power supply shipments. In the third quarter, consolidated revenue was 197.059 billion yuan, setting a new record for the second consecutive quarter, with a quarterly increase of 7.5% and an annual increase of 31%.

summary_en: The AI ​​wave has boosted power demand for semiconductors and data centers. In the past, the power supply planning was dominated by power companies, and towards joint decision-making by both supply and demand parties to cope with the rapidly expanding power demand of the technology industry.

summary_en: Demand in the AI ​​industry is strong, and listed companies have achieved three outstanding results. In September, revenue hit 6.59 trillion yuan, a new monthly high in history, and exceeded the 6 trillion yuan mark for two consecutive months. Revenue in the third quarter was 18.4 trillion yuan, a record high in a single quarter. Revenue in the first nine months totaled 48.5 trillion yuan, with an annual growth rate of 37.6%, also a record high for the same period in history. title_en: The impact of price increases! Buy air-cooled game consoles and hit Taiwanese chains such as Hon Hai, Pegatron, Hongzhun, and Delta Electronics
summary_en: The global shortage of memory and storage parts is severely impacting the video game industry. According to market research firm Circana, sales of video game hardware in the United States dropped by 15% year-on-year in August to 559,000 units, the lowest in the same period in 13 years. This reflects that the three major players, Microsoft, Nintendo, and Sony, have successively raised prices to offset rising component costs and the impact of previous tariffs. This has had an impact on sales and affected the shipments of related supply chains such as Hon Hai, Pegatron, Hongjun, and Delta.

title: 心臟病、癌症、糖尿病都和它有關 醫師揭密：「0克」也可能吃進反式脂肪
summary:
一種能讓食品「保鮮」數年的成分，為何同時被證實與心臟病、癌症、糖尿病脫不了關係？當你在超市拿起標示「0克反式脂肪」的產品，是否想過那個數字可能是精心設計的假象？有「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，反式脂肪這種人工產物，之所以能為加工食品帶來誘人的延長保鮮期優勢，原因在於細菌難以消化其特殊的雙鍵結構。

然而不幸的是，我們自身的粒線體，這個細胞內的能量工廠，也同樣缺乏分解這種鍵結的酵素。因此反式脂肪一旦攝取，便容易在肝臟中累積，進而導致脂肪肝和心血管疾病。攝取反式脂肪，無異於讓身體攝取難以排出的毒素。

曾嶔元強調，反式脂肪的危害早已被證實，它與一系列嚴重疾病息息相關，包括心臟病、肥胖、癌症和糖尿病。更令人擔憂的是，反式脂肪的攝取並沒有所謂的「安全劑量」。研究數據顯示，每增加2％的反式脂肪熱量攝取，心臟病風險幾乎增加至2倍。

title: 雞蛋、全脂奶、紅肉真的有罪？ 醫師回看70年飲食史：真正該怕的可能不是膽固醇
summary:
真正值得重新思考的，並不是要把脂肪從「壞人」改判為「好人」，而是我們是否曾經太快把一項仍在發展中的科學假說，當成唯一答案。

物理學家史蒂芬．霍金（Stephen Hawking）曾引用歷史學家丹尼爾．布爾斯廷（Daniel Boorstin）的名言：「知識的最大敵人不是無知，而是擁有知識的錯覺。」

這句話提醒我們，許多看似經典的理論，也可能隨著新證據出現而必須重新檢視。因此，我們需要回到科學的根本，仔細檢視每一個理論背後的證據。

我們的信念應該建立在科學根據之上，而不是寄望於某些人提出的標準答案。許多健康政策的確會影響我們的生活環境，但真正決定健康命運的，始終是我們每天做出的選擇。

正因如此，如果希望改變健康，就必須依循科學邏輯，而不是單純依賴他人的觀點。真正能夠帶來改變的力量，始終來自我們自己。

High interest rates may last longer, and funds will turn to high-coupon, short-duration non-investment bond ETFs.
00989B Taishin U.S. Preferred Income Non-Investment Grade Bond ETF targets U.S. non-investment grade corporate bonds with maturities of 1 to 5 years.

title_en: Vietnam imports cold-rolled stainless steel at low prices, and the Ministry of Economic Affairs initially determines that the domestic industry is damaged
summary_en: Vietnam's cold-rolled stainless steel products are imported at low prices, impacting the domestic steel industry. The Ministry of Economic Affairs held a trade remedy review meeting on the 12th to review the anti-dumping case of Vietnam's specific cold-rolled stainless steel flat-rolled steel products. It initially determined that there were reasonable signs that the domestic industry had suffered substantial damage, and will subsequently transfer it to the Ministry of Finance to launch a dumping investigation. The public version of the preliminary investigation report on damage to related industries is scheduled to be released on the website of the Trade Administration of the Ministry of Economic Affairs from November 12.

summary_en: New Taipei City MRT construction continues to improve the transfer network! The new entrance and exit project of the New Taipei Circular Line Banqiao Station was completed on the 12th. The main structure beam was completed on the 12th. Mayor Hou Youyi presided over a blessing ceremony, symbolizing that the project has entered an important milestone. Banqiao Station brings together multiple transportation systems such as the Taiwan Railways, High Speed ​​Rail, MRT Bannan Line and New Taipei Circular Line. Once the new entrances and exits are completed and opened, the existing transfer lines will be optimized. The transfer time from the Taiwan Railway station to the circular line platform can be shortened from about 12 minutes to 5 minutes, saving half the time, creating a more convenient and friendly transfer environment.

title: 快訊／美股開盤漲跌互見　費半挫262點、台指期夜盤49K瀕臨失守
summary: 美國迎來哥倫布日聯邦假日，債市休市使交投較清淡，油價則因地緣政治消息震盪。科技股方面，美銀罕見將Salesforce評級大幅調升至買進，看好其AI技術難被取代。同時，長鑫存儲宣布DRAM技術突破並將量產DDR5，引發市場對供應鏈衝擊的疑慮，美光與SK海力士等記憶體大廠盤前股價應聲下跌。

title: 聯光通轉型成功 股價持續衝高
summary: 聯光通（4903）近年來積極轉型，布局工程及能源領域，已初見成效，9月營收創下近13年來新高紀錄，帶動股價持續攻高，今早跳空開高後，股價便一路衝高，不到半小時便牢牢鎖住漲停，漲停價50.5元，即將挑戰上周高點50.7元。

title: 數發部攜手衛福部推數位核銷 明年服務831家社福團體
summary: 數位發展部攜手衛生福利部推動「數位核銷服務網」，將AI導入社福補助核銷流程，透過辨識發票、收據影像，自動擷取單據資訊並帶入填報欄位，減少人工登打及補件往返時間。數發部表示，服務預計2027年涵蓋約831家社福團體、1,330件補助核銷案件，涉及經費約15億元；其中，較大型補助案件的行政整理時間，可望從原本約10天縮短至1天以內。

title: 聯徵新制10月底上路，券商、銀行端初期融資必然保守!
summary:
金管會公告聯徵中心建跨業信用查詢平台，預計10月底上線。
券商與銀行經客戶同意後，可雙向調用借款、融資等信用資訊，掌握是否過度槓桿。
在台股四貸同堂熱潮後，新制初期券商恐偏保守；銀行資金也偏緊，LCR Q3傳跌破120%。

title: 映智非洲專案客戶啟動出貨 9月合併營收年月雙增
summary: 生物辨識晶片IC設計公司映智科技今日公告9月合併營收新台幣465萬元，較上月及去年同期分別成長654％、90％，累計前九月合併營收4,134萬元；公司表示，日9月營收成長，係映智偕同系統整合商（SI）獨家取得的非洲大國「國民身分建檔採集系統」專案，相關指紋識別採集設備已於9月進入出貨階段，開始小量出貨，第四季為出貨高鋒。

title: 注意荷包！竹市新增6處科技執法 明年1月12日啟用
summary: 新竹市地狹人稠，市府為提升交通秩序與行人安全與停讓文化的友善行人政策，新竹市警方新增建置6處科技執法設備（2處固定式、4處移動式）並遷移1處原設置移動式科技執法，即日起至明年1月11日實施宣導期，並自明年1月12日起啟用執法。警方說，此舉是市府積極推動「人本交通」理念的重要一環，透過科技手段有效改善交通違規行為，保障市民及行人安全。

title: 骨痛、貧血、高血鈣、腎衰竭 侯信安：當心多發性骨髓瘤四大警訊
summary: 60多歲陳先生退休後常覺腰痠背痛，以為腰椎退化、骨刺，看過骨科、復健科，物理復健幾個月，但不見起色。在一次輕微碰撞，竟意外骨折，血液檢查發現，嚴重貧血、腎功能惡化，轉介至血液腫瘤科，確診為「多發性骨髓瘤」。

title: 2歲男童只說簡單詞彙 醫師提醒早療：別只等「長大就會」
summary: 男童小星2歲時因僅會簡單詞彙、較少主動與人交流，經評估診斷為「發展遲緩」，接受多年早期療育與定期追蹤，小星已能完整表達、主動參與團體活動，今年進入小一生活。豐原醫院復健科醫師張憲伯提醒，兒童發展遲緩不只是「比較晚說話」，若語言、動作、認知或人際互動等面向明顯落後同齡孩子，應及早接受專業評估，把握早療重要時機。

title: 共軍今沿海軍演 顧立雄：國軍密切關注 研判為一般砲兵射擊訓練
summary: 中共解放軍今天起在渤海、黃海、東海、南海密集展開實彈射擊操演。國防部長顧立雄表示，國防部均有充分掌握相關情況，這些初判都是沿海的砲兵射擊之類訓練，但國軍秉持料敵從寬原則會持續密切關注。顧立雄強調，共軍不斷的在印太地區製造不安軍事威脅演練，值得大家予以譴責。

title: 共軍連6天5海域實彈軍演 航港局：非我搜救責任區 對周邊船舶尚無影響
summary: 雙十國慶剛結束，中國大陸隨即公告，今日起在渤海、黃海、東海與南海等至少5處海域，密集展開實裝訓練、實彈射擊及各項軍事活動，相關演訓將持續至10月17日。交通部航港局表示，上述海域非我國搜救責任區內，經評估，對我國周遭海域船舶尚無影響。

title: 7個月邀31位諾貝爾獎得主來台 台灣橋樑計畫閉幕 賴總統：搭起3座橋
summary: 中研院與國內12所學研機構共同推動「台灣橋樑計畫 (Taiwan Bridges Program)」，在2025年至2026年期間，7個月內邀請31名諾貝爾獎得主來台舉行系列演講與學術交流。該活動今日於台灣大學舉辦閉幕式，兼任「台灣橋樑計畫」榮譽主席的總統賴清德表示，該計畫搭建了三座橋，分別是知識之橋、世代之橋及和平之橋。

title: 台南車站地下化17日通車 3出入口、停車轉乘動線曝光
summary: 台南市區鐵路地下化工程將在17日通車，新台南地下車站也同步啟用，成為全台首座國定古蹟車站與新車站並存，旅客仍可由舊站進出。交通局表示，新站設有3個出入口，並重新規畫前鋒路轉乘設施，也提供汽車停車56席、臨停13席、機車停車339席及計程車排班區，方便旅客轉乘。

title: 轉乘環狀線時間省一半僅需5分鐘 板橋站新出入口2027下半年啟用
summary: 搭乘台鐵、板南線與高鐵的民眾，要轉乘環狀線需要12分鐘以上，新北市府增設板橋站新增出入口工程今天完成主體結構上梁，由市長侯友宜主持祈福儀式。新北市捷運局表示，新增出入口完工啟用後，將優化既有轉乘動線，台鐵車站至環狀線月台轉乘時間可縮短至5分鐘，節省一半時間，打造更便捷、友善的轉乘環境。

title: Apple本月又有新驚喜！首款有螢幕的HomePad將登場？10月13日正式揭曉
summary: Apple下半年新品一波接一波，搶在iPhone Duo正式上市前，突襲宣布將於10月13日舉辦以「Welcome home」為主題的新品發表活動。本次特別攜手澳洲雙胞胎藝術家Maricor & Maricar，以充滿手作溫度的多彩蘋果刺繡作品打造預告短片，透過細緻針線勾勒出獨特的工藝質感，也為這場以智慧家庭生態系為核心的發表活動增添溫馨氛圍。

title: 秋季醫美雷射療程受關注 苗栗醫院提醒術後初期4大照護撇步

title: 凌晨3點突然醒來？ 中醫師揭「肝、肺」兩大警訊 伴隨這些症狀要小心
summary: 累了一整天，好不容易入睡，卻總在凌晨3點左右突然醒來，翻來覆去再也睡不著。不少人以為是壓力太大或自律神經失調，中醫師提醒，半夜固定時間醒來，也可能與身體狀態有關。從中醫經絡理論來看，凌晨3點正好是「肝經」與「肺經」交替的時段，這時間中斷睡眠多與肝經氣血不暢、情緒壓力大或肝火旺盛有關。

title: 陳志鴻教授：健康台灣形塑醫療產業生態鏈 打造護國群山

title: 無人機概念股錦明總座遭收押　股價打入跌停
summary:
無人機概念股錦明上週遭到調查局搜索，今天再度發布重大訊息指出，總經理簡豪廷已經在九日被桃園地方法院裁定羈押，總經理職務暫由董事長蔡翔峰代理，錦明表示，目前公司營運及財務狀況正常，國內外既有業務未受重大影響，並首度揭露無人機國防相關訂單佔整體營收比重僅約一．一％。

錦明八日曾經發布重大訊息指出，法務部調查局到公司進行搜索調查，公司尊重司法程序，並依法配合調查，但基於偵查不公開原則，不便對調查細節發表評論，今天總經理收押的消息公布後，錦明股價打入跌停。

根據錦明公布的重訊指出，截至今年九月底，主要五金沖壓模具業務佔整體營收約八五．八％，無人機業務佔比約三．三％，其中國防相關訂單僅佔整體營收約一．一％，九月分營收四千一百萬元，年增率一九．八％，累計前九月營收三．二八億元，則是比去年同期增加七．七四％。今年六月的時候，錦明股價曾因傳出接獲無人機大單消息，從二七．九元飆漲到五七．六元，今天打入跌停後，剩下三五．九五元。

title: 地緣風險干擾復甦，卡達LNG出口恢復或需至2028年
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】市場機構最新分析顯示，9月卡達液化天然氣(LNG)運輸船經荷姆茲海峽的通行量雖有回升，但恐難以標誌著供應將迎來持久性復甦。由於多數貨物目前仍透過關閉定位系統(暗航)的方式運出，整體航運流量依然極易受到地緣衝突反覆升級的威脅與干擾。報告指出，儘管卡達可以透過擴大穿梭運輸模式來嘗試增加出口，但航行安全風險居高不下，顯著限制出口增長的空間。若荷姆茲海峽的通行風險持續延長至2029年初，全球LNG出口量可能要等到2027年底甚至2028年底，才有希望恢復至衝突爆發前的正常水準，具體進程將高度取決於卡達穿航作業的修復速度。市場人士分析，荷姆茲海峽作為全球極為關鍵的能源咽喉要道，任何持續性的封鎖或高風險運營，都將顯著拉高全球天然氣的運輸成本與保險費用。卡達作為全球主要LNG出口國之一，其出貨受阻將直接加劇歐洲與亞洲市場的天然氣供需失衡壓力。法人認為，全球LNG供應鏈短線難以擺脫地緣政治的陰霾，能源價格受風險溢價支撐恐維持高檔震盪。隨著替代航線與穿梭運輸成本居高不下，各國能源進口商預期將加快尋找非中東地區的替代氣源，全球天然氣貿易格局正面臨深遠的結構性重塑。

title: 高盛估美股明年新增發行規模衝6,000億美元，淨供給創2000年來最大
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】華爾街投行一哥--高盛策略師發表最新研究報告預測，受經濟成長、股價上揚及人工智慧(AI)投資需求推動，2027年美國股票發行規模將達6,000億美元，美國上市股票淨供給將出現2000年以來最大增幅。不過，該行認為，股票供給增加不會終結本輪牛市。由史奈德(Ben Snider)領軍的策略師團隊指出，經濟與股市走強，加上AI投資擴張，將推動企業透過股票市場籌資。股價上升有利企業募資，但新增股票也會增加市場需要吸收的供給，使資金需求與企業獲利成長成為重要觀察因素。高盛同時預估，2027年美國企業股票回購規模將升至約1.7兆美元，為股市需求提供支撐。回購可吸收部分流通股票，抵銷新增發行的影響，但6,000億美元發行額與1.7兆美元回購額，不能直接相減視為完整的淨供給變化，仍須考量其他影響上市股票數量的因素。高盛判斷，供給擴張本身不足以扭轉牛市，關鍵仍在企業獲利、資金需求及回購計畫能否落實。AI投資帶動籌資之際，相關支出能否轉化為營收與現金流，也將影響市場承接新股供給的能力及後續評價。

summary_en: Tomorrow and the next two days, the weather will continue to be stable and good in various places. Zeng Zhaocheng, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, said that the northeast monsoon will strengthen from Wednesday, the probability of rainfall in the northeast will increase, and the temperature will drop slightly. After the northeast monsoon weakens on Friday, it will return to sunny and cloudy weather. In addition, tropical disturbances are expected to develop in the sea near Guam next weekend, and continuous observation is required.

Yuqing-KY's revenue in September was 429 million yuan, a monthly increase of 75.29% and an annual increase of 43.98%. Revenue from January to September was 3.007 billion yuan, an annual increase of 12.46%.

title_en: AI explosion! Taiwan’s exports this year will overtake Japan and South Korea and surpass Hong Kong, and it is expected to become the world’s fifth largest exporter.
summary_en: The global AI explosion has promoted the rapid expansion of AI applications, and Taiwan's exports have grown along with the explosion. The Ministry of Finance estimates that exports in 2026 are expected to exceed the US$900 billion mark. If the General Accounting Office predicts in August that export value will reach US$903.6 billion in 2026, my country will move from the top 12 exporting countries in the world last year to become the fifth largest exporting country in the world, surpassing South Korea, Japan, and Hong Kong.

title_en: Hon Hai and its subsidiaries are subject to US Section 337 investigation, stressing that operations and shipments are normal and a team has been formed to clarify response
summary_en:
The USITC launched a Section 337 investigation against Vicor Corporation's patent infringement claims. Taiwanese manufacturers and related companies such as Delta Electronics, Hon Hai and Quanta were included in the investigation.
The patents covered by this investigation include specific vertical power supply systems, related components and computing systems equipped with the systems.
Hon Hai said that it has not affected production, shipments and customer cooperation at present, and has set up a professional team to deal with it and will safeguard its rights and interests in accordance with the procedures.

title_en: U.S. bond yields fluctuated at high levels; the banking industry added a total of 689 billion yuan in bonds in the first eight months
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 11th) The capital market was volatile in July, coupled with the rebound in domestic and foreign bond yields, the banking industry increased its overweight in bonds to NT$236.3 billion in July, and then reduced its overweight in bonds by NT$36.9 billion in August, bringing the cumulative overweight in bonds to NT$689 billion in the first eight months of this year. As the stock market index soared, the banking industry increased its overweight in Taiwan stocks by a total of NT$108.4 billion in the first eight months, but it has been a reduction in overweight for three consecutive months.

title_en: Nanyao Palace goes around the border and throws thousands of gashapon eggs, worth 18,000 yuan, and 15 lobsters are thrown along the way
summary_en: Changhua Nanyao Temple started a 9-day and 8-night Bingwu New Year prayer circumambulation event starting from the 3rd of this month. Today, when returning to Changhua City, 11 real-life art cars tossed thousands of gashapon eggs along the way. The gifts ranged from toys, home appliances, high-quality toilets worth NT$18,000, to Boston lobsters. The wide variety of gifts surprised the public. The most special thing is 15 freshly frozen Boston lobsters, which are placed directly in Styrofoam boxes and thrown to the believers.

title_en: Mailiao King Boat Festival, Baishatun Mazu comes to visit for the first time "Pink Supercar" appears at the exhibition venue and attracts crowds
summary_en: The 5-year King Ship Festival held every five years at Kaiyuan Palace and Zhen'an Palace in Yunlin County's Mailiao Township was held today. This year, it was expanded and held in conjunction with the Mailiao Township Office. Baishatun Mazu was invited as a guest for the first time, attracting a large number of people. In addition to the peace patrol, the office also held a "King Ship Static Exhibition" and a "King Ship Image Exhibition" in the social education park. Through multiple forms such as physical crafts and digital images, the historical context and belief culture of the Mailiao King Ship culture were presented.

title_en: Land value tax will be levied in November! Landowners pay attention to the lump sum household system and discounts for owner-occupied residences
summary_en: The 115-year land price tax will be levied on November 1. The Hsinchu City Taxation Bureau reminds the public that after receiving the tax bill, they should first confirm whether the name of the taxpayer, taxable land lot, land number, number of transactions, and applicable tax rate are correct before paying according to the limit. In addition, land value tax is calculated using the "general household system" and "progressive tax rate". Land value taxes held by the same land owner in the same county (city), regardless of the number of transactions, will be calculated together and a tax bill will be issued to remind taxpayers to pay attention to relevant information.

summary_en: The "Environmental Protection Specialist and Technical Personnel" certificate test (referred to as the environmental certificate test), which has been in place for 37 years and has been taken by 330,000 people across the country, is ushering in major changes! The current paper-based tests will gradually be transformed into computer-based tests. The National Environmental Research Institute held a test on "Training Personnel for Noise Condition Inspection or Appraisal in Public and Private Places" on the 17th, using computers for the first time. Zhang Shunqin, dean of the National Institute of Environmental Protection, specially reminded candidates to carefully read the relevant precautions before taking the exam.

title_en: In autumn, you may suffer from insomnia if you sleep well. Doctor: It may not be because of high stress, but because the pace of life has changed. Five major symptoms to pay attention to
summary_en: Many people think that insomnia is caused by being too hot in the summer and too cold in the winter. When the weather turns cooler in autumn, it should be easier to sleep. Unexpectedly, they start to have problems such as "laying down for a long time at night and being unable to fall asleep", "waking up easily in the middle of the night", and "waking up too early in the morning". Song Wanzhen, a Chinese medicine practitioner at the Hanmingtang Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic, said that in autumn, the climate gradually turns cooler, the temperature difference between day and night becomes larger, and the daytime gradually shortens, which may lead to changes in daily life, mood, and physical state. Therefore, sleep quality may also decline in autumn.

The co-signing schools include South No. 1 Middle School, Xiongzhong, Changzhong, Jiazhong, Normal University Affiliated High School and Zhuke Shi Middle School, hoping that the Ministry of Education will establish a path from high school to university. title: 美發動337調查 系統組裝廠靜觀其變
summary: 美國國際貿易委員會（USITC）宣布對特定垂直供電系統，以及這類系統零組件和含有該系統的運算系統啟動337條款調查，被調查公司包括許多台灣大廠。事實上，此案是Vicor之前控訴台達電侵權案的延伸，台達電也已經表示，並沒有侵權，並在美國法院提出反訴，指控Vicor侵害台達電的專利，因此，被波及的系統組裝廠目前只能靜觀其變。

title_en: Jiang Wanan’s relocation of the loosening machine raises medical concerns about medical care in the east and outlying islands. Shi Chongliang: Highlights the need for wider discussion
summary_en: As the election campaign in Taipei City heats up, Taipei Mayor Chiang Wanan abandons Songshan Airport and relocates it to build an AI park. The medical community has expressed concerns that it may have an impact on the medical industry in the east, affecting physician support and patient access. Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang said that the medical community is worried about manpower exchange and transportation problems in remote rural areas, which highlights the need for more extensive and detailed planning and discussion on migration issues, and medical evacuation absolutely needs to be included in the discussion.

title_en: National Day Speech/President Lai: We are happy to see dialogue between the United States and China, but we will never allow distortion of the history of World War II
summary_en: Today is the 115th National Day of the Republic of China. President Lai Qingde pointed out in his speech at the National Day Conference in the morning that in response to the previously concluded Sichuan-Xi meeting, President Lai said that we are happy to see the United States and China manage competition through dialogue and reduce the risk of conflict and war. However, we must also point out that It is pointed out that in order to maintain regional security, peace and stability, we must not only correctly understand historical development and never allow distortion of the history of World War II, but also respect the right of the Taiwanese people to survive. We must also combine the common strength of democratic countries in the Indo-Pacific region to prevent the status quo of regional peace and stability from being changed.

summary_en: Today is the 115th National Day of the Republic of China. President Lai Qingde delivered a speech at the National Day meeting in the morning. In response to the energy issues of concern to the outside world, President Lai said that in the face of energy and climate challenges, we aim to achieve stable power supply, energy security and net-zero transformation, promote the construction of diversified green energy, energy storage, energy conservation and grid resilience. We will also pragmatically evaluate various energy options based on scientific evidence, legal procedures and safety standards.

summary_en: Today is the 115th National Day of the Republic of China. Legislative President Han Kuo-yu delivered a speech as the chairman of the National Day Convention. He said that this is the year when Taiwan is seen by the world. We must not forget the plans of the late President Chiang Ching-kuo and former President of the Executive Yuan Sun Yun-Chuang to promote the semiconductor industry. I believe that if the founding father, Mr. Sun Yat-sen, could travel through time and space and see today's Republic of China and today's Taiwan, he would be proud.

It is our common responsibility to select the talented and capable without threats and inducements. Political parties can compete and have different opinions, but the Taiwan we are based on should not be divided because of this.

summary_en: The Kaohsiung Qiaotou Sugar Factory's 100-hectare forest development project has caused controversy. Jiang Huangnu, who has worked in the sugar factory for nearly 30 years, is running for city council at the age of 83. She went north today to plead for the rights of the sugar factory's 100-hectare forest in front of the Presidential Palace, hoping to preserve the integrity of the century-old sugar factory culture and landscape. Civil society groups also called for the adjustment of the 60-meter road that cuts through the sugar factory, reducing the size of the road and redirecting it to the back of Xingtang Elementary School.

title: 打電動都超專心、工作卻老分心 醫揭成人ADHD注意力迷思
summary: 你從小到大是否經常被說「不夠專心」、「做事總拖到最後一刻」？即使進入職場，開會時腦袋仍像開了十幾個分頁，工作時不斷在回信與滑手機之間游移，忙了一整天，真正完成的事情卻沒幾件。精神科醫師提醒，這些表現未必是懶惰或不夠努力，也可能與大腦注意力及自我調節功能有關，是成人注意力不足過動症（ADHD）的表現。

title_en: I am super focused when playing video games, but I am always distracted at work. Doctors reveal the attention myths of adults with ADHD.
summary_en: Growing up, were you often told that you were "not attentive enough" or "always put off doing things until the last minute"? Even after entering the workplace, my head still seems to have more than a dozen tabs open during meetings, and I keep flitting between replying to emails and scrolling through my phone at work. I have been busy all day long, but very few things have actually been completed. Psychiatrists remind that these symptoms are not necessarily laziness or lack of effort, but may also be related to the brain's attention and self-regulation functions, and are manifestations of adult attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD).

title_en: Paper industry welcomes peak season in 4th quarter, demand picks up moderately, raw material cost is variable
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 10th) The paper industry has entered the traditional peak season of the fourth quarter. Paper mills have observed that demand has recovered, but the strength of pulling goods has not been significantly increased. Yongfeng Yu said that the demand for cartons and industrial paper is generally stable, and customers are mainly replenishing stocks in batches. Zhenglong expects Taiwan's fourth quarter shipments to be slightly better than the third quarter, and Vietnam's demand is relatively strong. The rising prices of international waste paper, pulp and other raw materials are variables that will affect profits in the fourth quarter.

title: 「泰國不是跳板，是基地」南僑陳正文揭接班布局　台滬曼谷共同接單攻全球
summary: 南僑投控（1702）董事長陳正文接棒後，首要任務不是另起爐灶，而是把南僑在台灣、中國大陸及泰國累積多年的食品製造、餐飲客戶及通路資源重新整合。陳正文在泰國接受媒體聯訪時表示，南僑要把泰國視為走向全球市場的「基地」，而非用完即走的「跳板」，未來將串聯台灣、上海與曼谷三地產品、產能及客戶資訊，以共同接單、分工生產方式拓展東協、美國、歐洲及澳洲市場。

summary_en: The Taiwanese stock market is hovering before the 50,000 point mark. There are 16 "big four stocks" including Zhending-KY, Huaxinke, Huatong, Huaxin, and Wenmao. summary_en: President Lai Ching-te will deliver a speech at the National Day Convention today (10th). It is understood that this speech will focus on the people's livelihood economy, focus on Taiwan's economic performance that has broken multiple historical records this year, and talk about how to transform economic fruits into welfare policies shared by all people. In terms of geopolitics, we will respond to the US-China dialogue with a confident and firm attitude and reiterate that Taiwan is the guardian of peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.

summary_en: The Taiwan stock market has been bullish recently, and it is only a matter of time before it hits 50,000 points. Although "50K" is a psychological level, the legal representative reminds that with the expansion of short-term positive deviation, the countdown to the US midterm elections, the financial reports of US and Taiwan technology stocks and other variables, be careful to guard against short-term "bullish reversal" in mid-to-late October. However, it is still expected to attack higher amid the shock.

title_en: Xinhua’s target price is set at 24,000. Foreign investors point out that it will not be affected by Marvel’s new products.
summary_en: The stock price of Wang Xinhua has rebounded after breaking through the 20,000 yuan mark. Recently, it has faced competition concerns caused by the launch of new products by Marvell, a major chip manufacturer. However, foreign securities firms such as Morgan Stanley and UBS Securities supported the company and maintained target prices of 24,000 yuan and 22,000 yuan respectively. They all believe that Marvell's new products will not threaten Xinhua's position in the short term, and the subsequent impact remains to be seen.

title_en: Free travel in the stock market/Upgraded specifications and bright prospects Focus on the group
summary_en: As we enter mid-to-late October, looking back at the performance of global stock markets so far, the stock markets of the United States, Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea surged in the first half of the year, driven by extreme supply shortages in the AI ​​supply chain. However, the market trend changed in the third quarter, and investors' doubts and uneasiness about whether AI would eventually become a bubble began to spread. Coupled with the fact that the war between the United States and Iran has not yet ended, and concerns about inflation resurrected, global stock markets faced large fluctuations in the third quarter.

The major power supply manufacturer LITE-ON announced yesterday (9th) that it has signed an engineering contract with a turnkey contractor on behalf of its American subsidiary LITE-ON, INC., and will invest US$348 million (approximately NT$11.059 billion) to build a new plant in McKinney, Texas, through local construction.
