title_en: The 5-year survival rate of pancreatic cancer is only 9.8%. Taipei Rongzong's "precise integration of polymorphisms" reverses the cancer king's dilemma
summary_en: Pancreatic cancer is known as the "king of cancers". According to the cancer journey survey of the National Health Insurance Agency of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, the five-year survival rate is the lowest among 11 types of cancer, only 9.8%. Taipei Veterans Affairs Association held an international symposium today. Dean Chen Weiming said that pancreatic cancer is currently one of the most challenging and difficult cancers to treat. In recent years, with the integrated development of systemic therapy, surgery, particle therapy and boron neutron capture therapy (BNCT), some patients who were originally unresectable may also have the opportunity to undergo conversion surgery.

title_en: "I'm not the God of Medicine" Drug Shortage Version There is a shortage of chemotherapy drugs and iron elimination drugs... Food and Drug Administration's project to import Indian drugs
summary_en: The Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare recently announced that two cancer chemotherapy drugs and one drug for acute iron poisoning have requested manufacturers to import pharmaceutical drugs from India due to lack of drugs. The plot of the mainland Chinese movie "I'm Not the God of Medicine", in which a patient cannot afford high-priced cancer drugs and asks someone to buy Indian medicine to take, is actually happening in China, but the reason is the lack of medicine. Pharmacists criticized that the Food and Drug Administration allowed Indian drug importers to free ride on long-term imports without formal drug inspection and registration, which may become a management loophole.

summary_en: There have been reports of shortages of the ADHD medication Ritalin since early this year. On June 9, the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare approved the project of "Methylphenidate® Tablets" by "Methylphenidate® Co., Ltd." Pharmacists pointed out that the price of Ritalin tablets paid by the National Health Insurance is 2.8 yuan per tablet, but the core price of Xinqing tablets is as high as 8 yuan. If the price of Ritalin tablets is increased, manufacturers may continue to supply. The high price of alternative drugs may lead to pharmacies being canceled by the National Health Insurance, which has caused grassroots pharmacies to "not dare to administer drugs."

Except for mountainous areas where rainfall has reached the standard for suspension of work and classes, the weather in Kaohsiung is still quite unstable and there is a risk of more severe and heavy rainfall. title_en: Taiwan’s family structure changes: for the first time, less than 2 people account for more than half, and 1-person households exceed 4 people
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Pan Ziyu, Taipei, 22nd) The concept of marriage and childbearing has changed, and the trend of low birthrate continues, and Taiwan’s family structure has changed accordingly. The latest 114-year household income and expenditure survey released by the General Accounting Office shows that for the first time, Taiwan’s households with less than 2 people account for more than half, reaching 51.6%, of which 17.33% are 1-person households and 34.27% are 2-person households, both hitting record highs.

title_en: Taipei can’t catch up! Household income in Hsinchu County and City exceeds NT$2 million, ranking highest in Taiwan
summary_en: The same family's income exceeds one million yuan, but the "methods of making money" in different counties and cities are very different. The 2025 Household Income and Expenditure Survey of the General Accounting Office shows that the average income per household in Hsinchu City and Hsinchu County both exceeded NT$2 million, firmly ranking among the top two in Taiwan, mainly supported by high-tech industry salaries and bonuses. Although Taipei City ranks third, the average property income per household reaches NT$180,000, the highest in Taiwan, showing a completely different income structure.

title_en: "Have land but no money"! There is a secret behind rich dad’s troubles. 15 years later, the whole family thanks him
summary_en: Faced with the elderly’s unstable gait and memory decline, it is crucial to prevent the risk of asset freeze caused by dementia. In the case of a man with assets of 140 million yen, because most of his assets were real estate, which caused a cash flow shortage, he established a civil trust with the eldest son as the trustee to ensure that the property could still be flexibly disposed of after his father became disabled. Subsequently, by selling the empty house and reorganizing assets, the inheritance tax was significantly reduced from 23.74 million yen to 1.16 million yen, successfully saving more than 22.58 million yen in tax burden. Financial experts remind that estate planning should comprehensively consider the risk of dementia, pension needs and secondary inheritance issues. Only through professional structure and asset reorganization can the smooth inheritance of assets be truly realized and avoid falling into the dilemma of having land but no cash.

The amount of power investment is rising year by year, and global AI power funds are strengthening.

title_en: The population is getting smaller and smaller, and the proportion of households with less than two people exceeds half for the first time
summary_en: Taiwan's family structure continues to become smaller, with households of two or fewer people becoming the mainstream. Statistics from the General Accounting Office show that the proportion of one-person households rose to 17.33%, and that of two-person households reached 34.27%. The two combined accounted for 51.6%, exceeding 50% for the first time. In contrast, the proportion of households with three or more people fell across the board, reflecting the continued shrinkage of the proportion of traditional multi-person households due to demographic changes such as declining birthrates and aging.

summary_en: Taipei Arena Far East Garden City today (22nd) entered a new milestone of opening to the entire district. title: 【台股壓力測試】千萬大戶錢進境內基金　九成重押台股科技
summary: 全球金融市場今年波動加劇，高資產投資人卻沒有因此縮手，反而加快資產配置腳步。根據「鉅亨買基金」觀察，平台投入成本達1,000萬元以上的大戶，今年前7月申購金額較2025年同期大增170%，顯示市場震盪不僅沒有澆熄投資意願，反而促使大戶加速調整資產配置。值得注意的是，這波資金移動不只是規模放大，更出現明顯的市場與基金類型轉向。

title_en: [Taiwan Stock Stress Test] Tens of millions of money from large households poured into domestic funds, and 90% of the money was heavily invested in Taiwan stock technology
summary_en: Global financial markets have become more volatile this year, but high-asset investors have not shrunk because of this, but have accelerated their asset allocation. According to the observation of "Juhengmai Fund", the subscription amount of large investors with investment costs of more than 10 million yuan on the platform increased by 170% in the first seven months of this year compared with the same period in 2025. This shows that the market shock not only did not dampen the willingness to invest, but also prompted large investors to accelerate the adjustment of asset allocation. It is worth noting that this wave of capital movement is not only an increase in scale, but also a clear shift in market and fund types.

title: SOGO挑戰商場新霸主1 / 挑戰北台灣百貨龍頭！遠東Garden City全區盛大開幕 打造「停留經濟」新地標
summary:
歷經長達1,200天的精心籌備與分階段布局，台北大巨蛋「遠東Garden City」今（22）日迎來最後一塊拼圖——B區「莫內花園」試營運，宣告全區正式盛大開放！這座總開發金額「上百億元」、總面積達3.6萬坪的新型態消費聚落，不僅集結高達560個品牌，遠東SOGO董事長黃晴雯更於開幕記者會上宣示，Garden City明年全年業績目標直指100億元，並將全力挑戰台中以北百貨市場的市占龍頭地位。

遠東Garden City打破了傳統百貨單純強調「購物」的封閉框架，以「City Green Hub」為核心理念，主打延伸消費者停留時間的「停留經濟」。全區公共設施比例高達40%，遠高於一般購物中心的15%至20%，並規劃超過10個大型公共空間。

其中，最吸睛的莫過於高達10米的香水體驗空間，將香氛與保養巧妙融入日常生活提案，讓消費者能在大巨蛋賽事人流、捷運網絡與周邊藝文動線之間，無縫穿梭於室內與戶外空間，使商場轉化為城市生活基礎設施的一環。

在業種布局上，Garden City以「餐飲」為最大主力，整體餐飲空間超過1萬坪、品牌逾150個，占全區面積高達三成；其次則為占地4,500坪的「國際精品」，涵蓋約65個精品櫃位，預計帶動整體兩成業績。此外，商場特別針對年輕家庭的需求，集結45個品牌打造業界規模最大的「親子專區」，搶攻家庭客群。

黃晴雯指出，Garden City首日已有約65%品牌正式開開，其餘品牌將於今年第4季至明年第1季陸續到位，全區最終將擁有約200個「全台首店」。目前初步數據顯示，Garden City成功將SOGO的核心客群從過去的35至55歲，大幅向下延伸至20至50歲，其中20至40歲的年輕族群占比已達37.5%。隨著Garden City全區開放，不僅引領百貨業邁向體驗型零售的新紀元，也為台北信義與忠孝商圈注入強大的活化動能。

title_en: SOGO challenges the new overlord of shopping malls 1 / Challenges the leading department store in northern Taiwan! Grand opening of Far East Garden City, creating a new landmark of "Stay Economy"
summary_en:
After 1,200 days of careful preparation and phased layout, the Taipei Arena "Far East Garden City" ushered in the last piece of the puzzle today (22nd) - the trial operation of "Monet Garden" in Area B, announcing the official grand opening of the entire area! This new type of consumer cluster with a total development value of "tens of billions" and a total area of ​​36,000 square meters not only gathers 560 brands, but Huang Qingwen, chairman of Far East SOGO, announced at the opening press conference that Garden City's annual performance target for next year will be 10 billion yuan, and will fully challenge the leading position in the department store market north of Taichung.

Far East Garden City breaks the closed framework of traditional department stores that simply emphasize "shopping". With "City Green Hub" as its core concept, Far East Garden City focuses on the "stay economy" that extends consumers' stay time. The proportion of public facilities in the area is as high as 40%, which is much higher than the 15% to 20% of ordinary shopping malls, and more than 10 large public spaces are planned.

Among them, the most eye-catching one is the 10-meter-high perfume experience space, which cleverly integrates fragrance and care into daily life proposals, allowing consumers to seamlessly shuttle between indoor and outdoor spaces between the Dome event flow, MRT network and surrounding art and cultural lines, transforming the mall into a part of urban life infrastructure.

In terms of industry layout, Garden City focuses on "catering", with an overall catering space of more than 10,000 square meters and more than 150 brands, accounting for up to 30% of the area; followed by "International Boutique" covering an area of ​​4,500 square meters, covering about 65 boutique counters, is expected to drive 20% of the overall performance. In addition, the mall specifically caters to the needs of young families and has assembled 45 brands to create the industry's largest "parent-child zone" to capture family customers.

Huang Qingwen pointed out that about 65% of the brands in Garden City have officially opened on the first day, and the remaining brands will be in place from the fourth quarter of this year to the first quarter of next year. The district will eventually have about 200 "first stores in Taiwan." Preliminary data currently shows that Garden City has successfully extended SOGO's core customer group from the past 35 to 55 years old to 20 to 50 years old, of which the young group aged 20 to 40 has accounted for 37.5%. With the opening of the entire Garden City area, it will not only lead the department store industry into a new era of experiential retail, but also inject strong activation momentum into Taipei's Xinyi and Zhongxiao business districts.

title_en: Notice! The bank announced new "account control" rules that will limit daily withdrawal and transfer limits
summary_en: Yushan Bank announced the latest security protection measures. Starting from September 1 this year, it will implement automated equipment transaction limit control for Taiwan dollar deposit accounts that have no transaction records for more than three years and have a balance of less than 10,000 yuan. The limit for daily ATM withdrawals, transfers, and consumption deductions for affected accounts will be reduced to NT$20,000. The bank emphasized that this move is aimed at reducing the risk of improper use of accounts and ensuring the safety of customer assets. If people still need to use the account, they can go to any Yushan Bank branch in Taiwan with their identity documents to restore the normal limit, or choose to close the account and cancel it to protect their personal financial rights.

title: 國巨1000元與500元差在哪？專家點出關鍵差異
summary: 財經專家葉育碩分析國巨股價從千元跌至五百元的過程，指出市場交易的不僅是基本面，更是心理情緒。在千元高點時，投資人受FOMO心態驅使，追逐成長夢想與情緒溢價；跌至五百元時，同樣利多卻被解讀為騙局，充滿恐懼折價。此現象印證了敘事經濟學，市場情緒常左右投資判斷。葉育碩強調，投資需綜合基本面、估值、籌碼與情緒分析，切勿盲目跟風。

title_en: What’s the difference between Yageo’s NT$1,000 and NT$500? Experts point out key differences
summary_en: Financial expert Ye Yushuo analyzed the process of Yageo's stock price falling from 1,000 yuan to 500 yuan, and pointed out that market transactions are not only fundamentals, but also psychological emotions. When the price reached a high of 1,000 yuan, investors were driven by the FOMO mentality and chased growth dreams and emotional premiums; when the price dropped to 500 yuan, the same profit was interpreted as a scam and was discounted due to fear. This phenomenon confirms narrative economics, where market sentiment often affects investment judgments. Ye Yushuo emphasized that investment requires comprehensive analysis of fundamentals, valuation, chips and sentiment, and must not blindly follow the trend.

summary: 看報紙的人越來越少了。主計總處近期公布「家庭主要設備普及率」調查，家中仍有報紙的比率持續下滑至4.36%，若與2000年的43.61%相比，25年間大減近九成；相較之下，2025年洗衣機普及率99.33%最高，行動電話以98.04%居次，幾乎已是家家戶戶必備。
title_zh: 報紙成時代的眼淚？普及率剩4.36% 25年來縮水近九成
summary_zh: 看報紙的人越來越少了。主計總處近期公布「家庭主要設備普及率」調查，家中仍有報紙的比率持續下滑至4.36%，若與2000年的43.61%相比，25年間大減近九成；相較之下，2025年洗衣機普及率99.33%最高，行動電話以98.04%居次，幾乎已是家家戶戶必備。
title_en: Are newspapers the tears of the times? The penetration rate remains at 4.36%, which has shrunk by nearly 90% in the past 25 years.
summary_en: Fewer and fewer people read newspapers. The General Accounting Office recently released a survey on the "Penetration Rate of Major Household Equipment". The proportion of people who still have newspapers in their homes continued to decline to 4.36%. Compared with 43.61% in 2000, it has dropped by nearly 90% in 25 years. In comparison, the penetration rate of washing machines will be the highest in 2025 at 99.33%, followed by mobile phones at 98.04%, which is almost a necessity for every household.

summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the third reading yesterday (21st) of the draft amendments to some provisions of the Inheritance and Gift Tax Law (hereinafter referred to as the Legacy Tax Law), in response to the Constitutional Court's 113-year-old Constitutional Court Judgment No. 11. title_en: Universal cash of 10,000 yuan, tax reduction gift package, international travel subsidy... small blessings continue. Five major financial events that you must know this week
summary_en: President Lai Ching-te announced on the 17th that NT$10,000 in cash will be distributed next year. On the 20th, the Finance Committee of the Legislative Yuan passed the amendment to the Income Tax Act, and the third reading is expected to be completed in August. Two small tax cuts will be received when filing tax returns in May next year. The "tourism two-wheel drive plan" launched by the Tourism Administration of the Ministry of Transport is expected to stimulate consumption in the tourism market. The following are the five most noteworthy financial news this week: 1. President Lai calls for universal sharing of AI dividends. 10,000 yuan in cash will be distributed next year, and will be distributed as soon as before the Spring Festival. President Lai Qingde announced on the 17th that 10,000 yuan in cash will be distributed next year. The Political Yuan will allocate 235.7 billion yuan in next year’s general budget so that AI dividends can be shared by all. As for when to get it? People familiar with the matter said that depending on the review process of the Legislative Yuan, if the review is completed before the end of the year, it is estimated that the earliest receipt will be before the Lunar New Year next year. The Ministry of Finance stated that the specific distribution schedule must respect the review progress of the Legislative Yuan. The operation schedule after the third reading will take five months and will be carefully planned. Legislators expect to issue 10,000-yuan red envelopes before the Lunar New Year at the earliest, but if it is estimated based on the work schedule, the outside world believes that the difficulty is quite high. Gao Xiangui, deputy chairman of the National Development Council, said that it is initially estimated that it will drive the growth of gross domestic product (GDP) by about 0.35 percentage points, which is slightly lower than last year's contribution of 10,000 to economic growth, which was about 0.415 percentage points. This is mainly due to the growth in GDP scale. As for whether it will lead to price fluctuations, Gao Xiangui believes that the widespread use of cash will indeed drive consumption growth, but will have little impact on inflation. 2. The economy is growing at a crazy pace and domestic low wages have improved. The Ministry of Labor estimates that the minimum wage will be raised by more than 5% next year as soon as September.

title_en: Is the surge in Taiwanese stocks hurting health food stocks? These two companies have fallen to a low level. Experts reveal a metaphysics
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have been rising sharply recently, but financial expert Ye Yushuo has observed that the performance of health food stocks is weak. The stock prices of Grape King and Dayan Biomedical are at relatively low levels. Ye Yushuo proposed the theory of "health care anxiety" and speculated that due to the wealth effects brought about by the surge in the stock market, investors' mood has improved and their stress has been reduced, which has led to a reduction in anxiety about health care, thereby delaying the purchase and consumption of health food. Although this view is interesting, Ye Yushuo also reminded that there are various reasons for the weakening of stock prices and cannot be entirely attributed to the performance of the stock market.

title_en: The population is getting smaller and smaller, and Taiwan’s family structure is becoming smaller...For the first time, more than half of households with two or fewer people
summary_en: Taiwan's family structure continues to become smaller, with households of two or fewer people becoming the mainstream. Statistics from the General Accounting Office show that the proportion of one-person households rose to 17.33%, and that of two-person households reached 34.27%. The two combined accounted for 51.6%, exceeding 50% for the first time. In contrast, the proportion of households with three or more people fell across the board, reflecting the continued shrinkage of the proportion of traditional multi-person households due to demographic changes such as declining birthrates and aging.

title_en: Does he really like you, or is he just being polite? 7 small actions to show your true favorability
summary_en: In 2005, Tom. Cruise went on "The Oprah Winfrey Show" to express his love to his then-girlfriend Katie. Holmes expressed his love and jumped on Oprah's sofa. He seemed extremely excited and excited, and his body language was exaggerated and a little out of control, reflecting the uncontrollable excitement of love in his heart. Such an overly strong physical expression may be that he is trying to prove the authenticity of his relationship to the public. He cannot help but use "extremely passionate" behavior to reduce the outside world's suspicion of his feelings. He is eager to express his sincerity in the relationship, so he expresses his love in such an exaggerated way. But his exaggerated and out-of-control body language also shows that when he faces the person he likes, he has multiple emotions in his heart at the same time, such as: happiness, nervousness, and uneasiness. He lacks good emotional regulation ability, so these emotions will be released in the form of body movements. In the end, when the two parties ended their marriage due to different parenting concepts, he also took extreme measures to withdraw from the relationship, not even having any contact or interaction with his daughter. Lin Cuifen analyzed that when boys express their affection for the person they like, if their body movements are exaggerated and out of control, such as suddenly hugging, jumping, talking loudly, or even like Tom. Cruise's behavior of jumping on the sofa all stems from the emotional outburst that cannot be suppressed in the heart. Especially in the early stages of love, when emotional needs are high, over-enthusiastic physical or emotional expressions are prone to occur. Exaggerated body movements also imply that you hope to show a "romantic, passionate, and desperate" image in the eyes of the other person (or the outside world). When the inner pressure cannot be balanced with reason or words, you will react through the body.

In order to solve the pain point of delayed construction, Taichung Times Construction responded to the new "same-floor drainage" regulations and introduced Japan's "integrated bathroom" construction method. The construction was almost free of dust and construction waste, setting a new benchmark for domestic residential buildings.

title_en: 210 billion budget ignited! Century Minsheng has stepped into unmanned boats and built an "air and sea dual domain" AI platform
summary_en: Century Minsheng (5314) officially announced its entry into the surface unmanned watercraft market, incorporating AI unmanned vehicle systems into the core of its development, and integrating existing IC design and edge AI technology to build an "air and sea dual domain" platform. Locking in the government's independent national defense budget and the purchase opportunity of 1,320 small unmanned boats, Century Minsheng will make every effort to enter the large-scale mass production market. Relying on six major technical advantages, including autonomous control, communication links and anti-interference communication, the company not only complies with non-red supply chain specifications, but also demonstrates its strong ambition to successfully transform from traditional IC design into an AI unmanned vehicle system integrator. Facing the long-term business opportunities brought by the special defense budget of 210 billion yuan, Century Minsheng is fully prepared and committed to providing overall solutions with high security and defense capabilities to seize market opportunities in the future defense supply chain.

summary_en: Yaxin Group, known as the "King of Linkou" in the domestic real estate industry, has not been afraid of the cold winter of the real estate market. It has increased cash capital for three consecutive years, doubling its share capital to more than 7 billion yuan. Its business scope has not only extended from residential to commercial offices and restaurants, but also expanded into overseas real estate, investing 50 billion yuan in a large-scale development project in Malacca, Malaysia. Yao Liandi, president of Asia Xin Group, said bluntly in an exclusive interview with this magazine that builders in Taiwan now "just buy land for processing." Facing the era of low profit margins in real estate, "the group must diversify its development in order to create a second growth curve."

title: 表面誇你、背後捅你一刀　心理師教你三招識破職場「笑面虎」
summary: 科技業曾發生過一起震驚社會的「笑裡藏刀」職場悲劇，受害者是一位擁有專業職能的技術長，施暴者則是親自延攬他至公司的董事長。最初幾年兩人關係良好，然而隨著公司規模擴大，遇到客訴危機與新產品的研發瓶頸，雙方管理理念的分歧逐漸浮現。技術長認為產品的技術品質與長期穩定性才是公司核心，但董事長更關心市場策略，時常以「外行領導內行」的方式干涉技術決策，技術長在專案推動上屢屢受挫，還在高層會議上常被當眾數落，感覺自己被羞辱、被霸凌，離職的念頭越來越強烈。最終，技術長決定離職，離職前一天，他在社群媒體上發表感言，寫下他在公司內部的掙扎與困難，點出管理層面的問題。離職當天，董事長特地安排了最後一次會面，在會議中感謝技術長的貢獻，並再度請他刪除這篇離職文章，技術長僅說「我再想想」，沒有明確答應。

title_en: Praising you on the surface but stabbing you in the back. A psychologist will teach you three ways to spot the "Smiling Tiger" in the workplace.
summary_en: There has been a workplace tragedy in the technology industry that shocked society. The victim was a technical chief with a professional function, and the perpetrator was the chairman of the company who personally recruited him to the company. In the first few years, the two had a good relationship. However, as the company expanded and encountered customer complaint crises and new product development bottlenecks, differences in the management philosophies of the two parties gradually emerged. The chief technology officer believes that the technical quality and long-term stability of the product are the core of the company, but the chairman is more concerned about market strategies and often interferes in technical decisions in a "layman leads an expert" manner. The chief technology officer has been repeatedly frustrated in project promotion and is often scolded in public at high-level meetings. He feels humiliated and bullied, and his thoughts of leaving his job are getting stronger and stronger. In the end, the chief technology officer decided to resign. The day before his resignation, he posted a speech on social media, writing about his struggles and difficulties within the company, and pointing out management-level problems. On the day of his resignation, the chairman specially arranged a last meeting. During the meeting, he thanked the technical chief for his contribution and asked him again to delete the resignation article. The chief technical officer only said "I will think about it again" without explicitly agreeing.

title_en: The wave of housing transfers is coming 1/The "death cross" in the housing market is coming! The number of housing handovers exploded, but buying sentiment fell to the lowest level in 26 years.
summary_en: The desperate housing handover wave is coming. The pre-sale houses that have been snapped up by bulls in the real estate market in recent years have gradually entered the completion and handover period this year, but they have been hit by the cold winter of the real estate market. In the first half of this year, Taiwan's total housing sales reached 68,225, the second highest in the same period in the past 10 years, indicating an explosion of housing sales. However, the volume of pre-sale housing transactions in the first quarter fell to the second lowest in 26 years, forming a death cross of "high housing volume, low purchase sentiment". title_en: The wave of house transfers is coming 2/The old house cannot be sold, and the new house must be handed over!  The thing that house-swapping people fear most has happened
summary_en: The wave of handovers of pre-sale houses is coming, and those who are most suffering may be those who are changing their houses! When the housing market was bullish, I bought a pre-sale house and planned to sell the old house before handing over the house. Now that my new house is built, I am experiencing a sudden freeze in buying sentiment. The old house was not sold, and the new house was immediately recognized by the bank as the second household. The mortgage loan is up to 60%, and there is no grace period. I want to sign a "buy now, sell later" agreement to sell the old house, but the bank has difficulty in "post-loan management" and is unwilling to undertake it. People who want to change houses are in a race against time and are under great financial pressure.

summary_en: The Accountant General Office of the Executive Yuan released the latest household income and expenditure survey. The average total household income in 2014 was NT$1.529 million, an annual increase of 3.3%; the average disposable income per household was NT$1.21 million, an increase of 3.9%. Both hit record highs. Analysis of household income structure shows that salary is the main source of household income, but there are regional differences in different counties and cities. Taipei City households use dividends and rents to make money, and earn a lot of income; Hsinchu County and Hsinchu City have a large number of high-tech industries, plus year-end bonuses and overtime pay, which greatly supplement their income. The average household income has exceeded the 2 million yuan mark.

title_en: Taiwan stocks are in shock! Anti-1 and high-interest ETFs become hedging tools. The "18-tier" ETF bucked the trend and broke through!
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market has recently fallen into a pattern of high-end shocks and consolidations. Risk aversion in the market has increased, and funds have flocked to targets with downside protection. A total of 18 Taiwan stock ETFs, including Qunyi Taiwan Weighted Inverse 1, 00919, 00713 and 00940, bucked the trend and posted profits, demonstrating excellent earthquake resistance. The legal person suggested that investors should adopt flexible strategies in the face of fluctuations and use inverse ETFs for short-term hedging, or use high-interest ETFs as long-term stock deposit options. Despite the short-term market tug-of-war, Taiwan is in a key AI supply chain and has good long-term operating prospects for semiconductors and electronic components. Experts remind that inverse ETFs are expensive and should not be held for a long time. They should be regarded as short-term hedging tools and participate in the mid- to long-term market through regular fixed-amount high-interest ETFs. They should make a steady layout in the alternating long-short market situation and seize investment opportunities in Taiwan stocks.

title: 工程師殺進AI新商機1／他就不想被管　44歲創業賣房也要救公司　雷朋AR眼鏡沒他做不出來
summary:
AI算力競賽愈打愈烈，GPU之外，高階晶片檢測、矽光子到機器視覺也被推上浪頭。台亞半導體子公司和亞智慧，規模雖不大，卻靠著深厚的光學與影像演算底子切進半導體、CPO光電模組與無人載具，而掌舵的董事長石文機，創業路比科技浪潮更顛簸。

因為不想被人管，石文機從踏入社會就在為創業做準備。他44歲白手起家，曾替華為首款3D結構光人臉辨識手機做精密調教及檢測，創業不到3年營收破億元，卻因市場驟變，訂單一夕歸零。賣房、借錢、忍痛裁員，他硬是把公司從谷底撐了回來。11年後，這名不服輸的工程師不只活了下來，還把當年最熟悉的光與影像押進AI最火熱戰場，帶著和亞朝9月上櫃邁進。

title_en: Engineer enters AI new business opportunities 1/He doesn’t want to be controlled. At the age of 44, he starts a business and sells his house but still wants to save the company. Ray-Ban AR glasses cannot be made without him.
summary_en:
The competition for AI computing power is becoming more and more intense. In addition to GPUs, high-end chip inspection, silicon photons and machine vision are also being pushed to the forefront. Taiya Semiconductor's subsidiary Heya Intelligent Technology, although not large in scale, has relied on its strong foundation in optics and image processing to branch into semiconductors, CPO optoelectronic modules and unmanned vehicles. However, at the helm of the company, Chairman Shi Wenji, has had a bumpier road to entrepreneurship than the technological wave.

Because he doesn’t want to be controlled by others, Shi Wenji has been preparing to start a business since he entered society. He started from scratch at the age of 44. He once did precision tuning and testing for Huawei's first 3D structured light face recognition mobile phone. Less than three years after starting his business, the revenue exceeded 100 million yuan. However, due to sudden changes in the market, orders fell to zero overnight. Selling houses, borrowing money, and reluctantly laying off employees, he managed to bring the company back from the bottom. 11 years later, this unyielding engineer not only survived, but also took the light and images he was most familiar with back then into the hottest battlefield of AI, taking Heya towards the launch of the product in September.

title_en: Engineers enter AI new business opportunities 2/If you don’t have money to start a business, you even want to open a breakfast shop. You have also received unemployment benefits. The company will be listed on the OTC market next month.
summary_en: "From the moment I came out of the society, I decided to start a business." Shi Wenji, chairman of Heya Wisdom, may seem gentle and polite, but he has always harbored the dream of being a boss deep in his heart. With no money, he once even looked at a breakfast shop; he finally waited until the company wanted his department to become independent, but in the end it was still aborted. The dream of starting a business has been waiting for nearly 20 years. This long journey has allowed him to master mobile phones, car mounts and optical inspections from digital cameras, which also laid the foundation for his future entrepreneurship.

title_en: Engineer enters AI new business opportunity 3/God advised him to "start a business as late as possible". Sure enough, he broke through 100 million in 3 years. After entering Huawei, he fell to the bottom overnight.
summary_en: After working in major listed companies for nearly 20 years, Shi Wenji has never forgotten his dream of starting a business. However, because his deceased mother warned him on behalf of the gods, "It can't be too early, the later the better." So he endured it until he was 44 years old. Unexpectedly, the wait seemed to be right. In the third year of starting the business, the revenue exceeded 100 million yuan, and it also entered the Huawei supply chain. The company increased from 2 people to 80 people, and even big names such as Xunde, UMC, and Pegatron came to invest. Just when Shi Wenji thought it was finally his time, a Sino-US trade war brought business to zero in an instant.

summary_en: Huawei's business dropped to zero, and epidemics followed one after another. Haotian Optoelectronics, founded by Shi Wenji, was on the verge of bankruptcy. Just when it hit rock bottom, Taiya Semiconductor's investment not only brought life-saving money, but also gave the team a semiconductor "training ground" and changed the company's destiny. Haotian later changed its name to Heya Intelligence. Relying on years of accumulated optical imaging, imaging software algorithms and AI core technologies, Haotian has evolved from traditional mechanical "visibility" to "understanding and instant decision-making", and has cut into wafer inspection, silicon photonics, CPO and robot vision. This has also allowed this company that almost disappeared to get back on the AI ​​wave.

title_en: Even less than the memory! The fatal gap in CPO explosion of indium phosphide...Mainland actually holds "three major production lifelines"
summary_en: Lumentum, the leader in optical communications in the United States, warned that due to the rapid expansion of AI data centers, the demand for indium phosphide laser chips has increased exponentially, and the shortage crisis may be more serious than that of memory. However, mainland companies have a considerable degree of control over the three core links of indium phosphide wafers, from raw indium smelting, indium purification to indium phosphide wafer manufacturing, making this supply chain crisis even more uncertain.

title_en: Third reading of the "Big Wife Clause": Gifts made 2 years before death are subject to proportional taxation
summary_en:
[Reporter Xu Yongqing/Reported from Taipei] The Legislative Yuan passed amendments to relevant provisions of the "Inheritance and Gift Tax Law" on the third reading yesterday, commonly known as the "Big Wife Clause." The provisions include that for property donated to specific relatives two years before the death of the deceased, each recipient shall bear the corresponding "fictitious estate" tax based on the proportion of the donated property to the total estate. This prevents the deceased from evading taxes through gifts during his or her lifetime, and at the same time distributes the tax burden equitably.
This revision of the law originated from the Constitutional Court’s decision in October 2024…

title_en: How much did you buy Innolux for? Fa said target price differences after the meeting
summary_en: Innolux's gross profit margin rebounded to 14.6% in the second quarter of this year. Although the panel industry's outlook for the second half of the year tends to be conservative due to weak consumer electronics demand, the company is actively transforming and deploying in the advanced packaging market. Innolux leverages its existing large-size manufacturing advantages and invests heavily in fan-out panel-level packaging (FOPLP) and glass substrate technology. It relies on high technical thresholds and AI PC replacement needs to create a long-term growth engine. The market is highly concerned about the cooperation potential between Innolux and TSMC in the field of advanced packaging, which is expected to lead to a comprehensive upgrade of the profit structure. Although the panel industry is facing downward pressure, some legal persons have raised the target price to 65 yuan due to the prospect of an explosion in the packaging business. At present, Innolux has abundant cash in hand and will focus its resources on developing high-margin businesses. Investors should pay attention to industry cycle risks and make prudent assessments.

summary_en: There is a new place for shopping and dining around Taipei Arena! After more than 3 years and about 1,200 days of preparation and zone opening, Far East Garden City will be put into trial operation today (22nd) with the addition of the last area B. The park is expected to open in mid-September. Huang Qingwen, chairman of Far East SOGO, said that there are about 560 brands in Garden City, of which more than 200 are the first or new stores in Taiwan, and there are more than 150 brands in catering alone. summary_en: After the bankruptcy of China Pictures Tubes (Chinese Pictures), lawyers and accountants were appointed as bankruptcy administrators. After many failed bids for China Pictures Longtan Factory, on July 29, three legal persons, Ruilin Trading, Qingfeng Assets and Yusheng Assets, finally joined forces to win the bid. summary_en: [Newtalk News] As the U.S. and Iran remain at an impasse over an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a key energy waterway, investors assessed the U.S. Treasury Department’s approach to lowering long-term borrowing costs. Most of the four major U.S. stock market indexes closed higher on the 21st. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 517.80 points or 0.98%, the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq Index both rose 0.43%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 0.51%, and TSMC ADR rose 0.71% to close at $418.95. According to foreign media reports, the U.S. government has taken measures to curb the sell-off in the government bond market. After U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent suddenly announced on the 19th that he would double the scale of bond repurchases, he once again stated on the 20th that the government may further increase the amount of government bond repurchases. On the 21st, long-term bond yields continued to rise, with the 10-year U.S. bond yield rising to 4.737% and the 30-year yield climbing to 5.276%, approaching their highs in more than ten years. As yields move higher, investors will be watching Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh speak at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium next week for a clearer picture of where interest rates are headed. Next week will release the U.S. personal consumption expenditures price index for July, which is the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation indicator. title_en: Afraid of being homeless when I grow old! The couple used their life savings to buy a house but ignored one thing. They sold their house with blood and tears in their later years and still worked part-time.
summary_en: Many people worry about being refused rent by landlords after retirement and choose to take on mortgage loans to buy houses in their later years, but often ignore the financial risks. A Japanese couple in their 70s bought an apartment for stability. However, after retirement, they were forced to continue to work part-time jobs due to mortgage pressure and living expenses that made them unable to make ends meet. Their health deteriorated. In the end, they had to reluctantly sell their apartment and move to public housing. Experts remind that middle-aged and elderly people do not need to blindly pursue home ownership. With the development of an aging society, the rental market and government subsidies have gradually improved. The sense of security in old age does not lie in owning a house, but in being able to live leisurely and comfortably. Excessive debt will drag down the quality of retirement. It is recommended that the quality of life should be taken into consideration when planning finances.

title_en: TSMC’s Arizona plant’s revenue contribution increases. Analyst: Depreciation pressure remains to be seen
summary_en: Foreign investment reports pointed out that TSMC’s Arizona plant’s second-quarter revenue reached NT$45 billion, an annual increase of 145%, accounting for approximately 4% of TSMC’s total revenue. Analysts pointed out that as overseas production capacity continues to be opened, the revenue contribution of the Arizona plant is expected to increase, but cost pressures such as equipment depreciation have not yet been fully reflected, and the impact is expected to emerge after 2027. A Bank of America report pointed out that TSMC's Arizona plant's second-quarter revenue increased by 17% quarterly and 145% annually, reaching NT$45 billion, accounting for about 4% of TSMC's total revenue. After excluding subsidies, the second-quarter net profit margin was about 38%, a significant improvement from the negative 90% in 2025, but still lower than TSMC's overall level of about 50%. Foreign media Wccftech cited Bank of America data and pointed out that after TSMC's Arizona plant turned a profit for the first time in the first quarter of 2025, its revenue and profit contribution have shown an overall upward trend. In the first quarter of this year, the profit ratio once exceeded 3%, and the revenue ratio was also about 3%. In the second quarter, the revenue ratio further rose to about 4%, but the profit ratio fell slightly. Analyst Weng Weijie pointed out that TSMC's Arizona plant has gradually contributed to revenue, and as local production capacity continues to expand, the revenue share is expected to further increase in the future. In addition to revenue contribution, it is also necessary to observe changes in the revenue structure of TSMC's Taiwan and overseas production capacity, and whether the manufacturing and order-taking layout will be adjusted accordingly. title_en: The market ended the week down 1.28%! "He" bucked the trend and soared 13.45%, becoming a safe haven for funds!
summary_en: Taiwan stocks faced a retracement correction this week, with the weighted index closing at 45,224.29 points, a weekly decrease of 1.28%. The total market value of all listed companies evaporated by nearly 1.9 trillion yuan in a single week. Market funds showed significant sector rotation, and electronic stocks encountered retracement pressure. Among them, the computer and peripheral equipment index fell by 5.97%, while shipping stocks became a safe haven for funds and bucked the trend, rising 13.45%. In terms of transaction momentum, semiconductor and electronic component stocks continued to dominate the transaction list, accounting for more than 60% of the total. Although the market volume has shrunk this week, the cumulative average daily transaction volume this year has remained at a high level of more than 1 trillion yuan, indicating that market trading momentum is still active and investors can continue to pay attention to the flow of industrial funds and the performance of value stocks.

summary_en: Known as the "King of Linkou" in the domestic real estate industry, Asia Xin Group has not been afraid of the cold winter of the real estate market. It has implemented cash capital increases for three consecutive years, doubling its share capital to more than 7 billion yuan. Its business scope has not only extended from residential to commercial offices and restaurants, but also branched into overseas real estate, investing 50 billion yuan in a large-scale development project in Malacca, Malaysia. Yao Liandi, president of Asia Xin Group, said bluntly in an exclusive interview with this magazine that nowadays builders in Taiwan "just buy land for processing." Facing the era of low-profit real estate, "the group must develop diversified in order to create a second growth curve."

title_en: The list of mobile tax filing winners is out, with nearly 20,000 people claiming prizes and a maximum of NT$50,000.
summary_en: In order to encourage people to use mobile phones to file taxes, the Ministry of Finance once again held the nationwide "Mobile Tax File GO Gifts and Fun" lottery this year. A total of more than 2,642,000 people were eligible, and 19,586 lucky winners were selected, with the first prize being a cash of NT$50,000. The winning list was announced on the afternoon of the 21st, and the public can check it on the official website. The redemption period is until November 25, 2015.

title_en: Hon Hai spends RMB 6 billion to expand AI production capacity in the United States, and outsiders speculate to expand local manufacturing scale
summary_en: Hon Hai announced yesterday (21st) that it will increase its investment in its US subsidiary Q-Edge Corporation by US$188 million (approximately NT$6 billion). It is speculated that it will expand the production capacity related to artificial intelligence (AI) products in the United States and expand the scale of US AI factories.

title_en: ASE buys building in California to expand production
summary_en: Global packaging and testing leader ASE Investment Holdings is expanding its U.S. semiconductor manufacturing footprint. Yesterday (21st) ISE Labs, a wholly-owned subsidiary of ISE Labs, announced that its board of directors decided to purchase a building in San Jose, California, for US$29.5268 million (approximately NT$950 million) to meet future production capacity expansion needs.

title: 能源管理法修正 新用電大戶 須有發電設備
summary: 立法院會昨（21）日三讀通過修正《能源管理法》部分條文。三讀條文規範，增訂能源用戶新設或增設的契約容量達規定容量者，應於期限內設置一定裝置容量以上的自用發電設備或儲能設備，以強化能源自給能力，降低對電網依賴。

title_en: Amendment to the Energy Management Law requires new large electricity consumers to have power generation equipment
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the third reading yesterday (21st) to amend some provisions of the Energy Management Law. The third reading article stipulates that if the contracted capacity of new or added energy users reaches the specified capacity, they should set up self-use power generation equipment or energy storage equipment with a certain installation capacity or above within the period to strengthen energy self-sufficiency and reduce dependence on the power grid.

title_en: Opposition parties proceed to second reading of Zhuo Kui condemnation case
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan People's Party filed a censure case against Zhuo Kui at the Legislative Yuan meeting yesterday (21st) because Executive President Zhuo Yongtai announced that he would not countersign the "Taiwan Children's Growth and Future Account Ordinance" and the amendments to the "Cable Broadcasting and Television Act" that were passed on the third reading of this session. After a vote in the Senate, the opposition group took advantage of its seat advantage and moved the condemnation bill to the second reading.

summary_en: The Ministry of Finance held a symposium yesterday (21st) and announced after taking stock of the situation of unified invoice redemption, it announced that in the second half of this year, 500,000 groups of exclusive cloud invoice awards of 500 yuan will be added, increasing the number of groups of 500 yuan awards from 3.85 million to 4.35 million, and the total number of groups exceeded 4 million for the first time.

title_en: The boom in Taiwanese stocks has driven a wave of financing for securities companies, and they are fully committed to enriching their working capital.
summary_en: Taiwan stock trading is booming, and securities companies have set off a fundraising wave this year. Key securities companies such as KGI Securities and Uni-President Securities announced the latest financing projects yesterday (21st). The board of directors of the former has authorized a joint loan of no more than 21.3 billion yuan, and the latter has signed a contract with a group of banks to finalize a joint loan of 17.1 billion yuan. The purpose is to supplement medium-term working capital, which means that the brokerage companies are still not optimistic about the market outlook for Taiwan stocks.

title_en: From transmission industry to AI materials stock? It has ABF equipment, advanced packaging, and CCL. Orders are expected to be in 2028.
summary_en: Changguang Precision Machinery, a subsidiary of Xing, holds 61.7% of the shares. It mainly produces vacuum molding machines and has a high market share in the global mid-to-high-end market. AI servers have boosted the demand for high-end ABF carrier boards above 16 layers, and also driven the expansion and replacement of related equipment. Order visibility has been extended to 2028. We are optimistic about the centralized delivery of vacuum molding machines and revenue recognition in the second half of 2026, which is expected to boost operating performance in the second half of the year. The high added value of the equipment business will also further optimize Changxing's overall product portfolio and become an important catalyst for profit growth.

title: 一座AI機櫃狂吃100萬顆被動元件！國巨、華新科訂單升溫　跌深反攻有戲？
summary: 由於AI伺服器機櫃消耗大量高階被動元件，被動元件報價持續喊漲。此外，高階伺服器採用 800V 等高壓直流供電架構，使被動元件必須具備耐高溫、耐高壓與高可靠度特性，推升平均售價(ASP)，有助毛利率提升。由於一般伺服器被動元件的需求約2000~3000 顆；AI 伺服器晶片用約3萬顆，為一般伺服器 13~15 倍、AI伺服器機櫃最高用量約 60 萬顆；至於NVIDIA Vera Rubin約80萬顆；NVIDIA Feynman約 100 萬顆，可見AI帶動的需求相當驚人，國巨（2327）與華新科（2492）股價跌深後將展開反攻。

title_en: An AI cabinet consumes 1 million passive components! Yageo and Huaxinco's orders are heating up. Is there any chance of counterattack after falling deep?
summary_en: Since AI server cabinets consume a large number of high-end passive components, the quotations of passive components continue to rise. In addition, high-end servers adopt high-voltage DC power supply architectures such as 800V, which requires passive components to be resistant to high temperatures, high voltages, and high reliability, pushing up the average selling price (ASP) and helping to increase gross profit margins. Since general server passive components require about 2,000 to 3,000 pieces; AI server chips use about 30,000 pieces, which is 13 to 15 times that of general servers. The maximum consumption of AI server cabinets is about 600,000 pieces; as for NVIDIA Vera Rubin, about 800,000 pieces; NVIDIA Feynman about 100 pieces Ten thousand pieces, it can be seen that the demand driven by AI is quite amazing. Yageo (2327) and Huaxinke (2492) will launch a counterattack after their stock prices plummet.

summary_en: The baby boomer generation lives in a "customer first" social atmosphere and grew up in an era of scarcity of resources after the war. title_en: AI chip power consumption exceeds kilowatts! Silicon capacitors become the new savior of advanced packaging power supply. Taiwanese manufacturers actively seize business opportunities
summary_en: As the power consumption of new generation AI chips such as Blackwell and Rubin exceeds 1000W, the huge current leads to long power supply paths and voltage drops, posing severe challenges to traditional power integrity. In order to solve the power supply bottleneck in AI data centers and high-end chip packaging, "package-level silicon capacitors (Si-Cap)" that are closer to the chip emerged and became an indispensable key component in the advanced packaging field.

title_en: AI makes semiconductors popular, but affects wages? Popular science departments in universities undergo the biggest reshuffle in five years
summary_en: Indeed, there is a wave of anxiety in the student community: "When AI has the ability to write programs, will junior software engineers be eliminated?" Including the United States, the registration rate of university employment departments has dropped sharply, with an annual decrease of 8.4% last year, and a decrease of more than 50,000 four-year university students. In this regard, Chris Piech, an associate professor in the well-known Department of Engineering at Stanford, said that the most valuable skill in the Department of Engineering has never been just writing code, but how to collaborate with AI and humans to solve complex problems in the real world. In response to the challenge, the payroll department must take action! Su Wenyu, a professor in the Department of Engineering at Chengdu University, shared that in February this year, he also began to require students with the strongest laboratory ability to design their own requirements and specifications during development. However, 90% of the subsequent work includes: writing code, testing, logic verification and debugging, all have to be handed over to AI. The purpose is to take students away from the role of programming and focus more on high-level tasks such as system architecture that cannot be replaced by AI.

summary_en: During this period, the company used different suction cup designs, tested hundreds of wafers, recorded millions of pieces of data, and burned tens of millions of dollars. "My colleagues all said this won't work, we will collapse!" But Que Shengzhe decided to persevere. Later, someone suggested: Since hundreds of pieces have been tested and so much measurement point data has been accumulated, it is better to try to use big data algorithms to find patterns - what kind of curvature corresponds to a good yield rate, and what kind of curvature corresponds to a bad yield rate. Finally, Itex went to the big manufacturer with the simulation forecast report.

title: 離岸風電首見火災 學者：別光聚焦滅火「要強化預防」
summary: 台灣離岸風電首起火災事故，發生於大彰化西北離岸風場編號Ｇ○五風機，二○二五年十一月首次發電，風機運作時間未滿一年。究竟是Ｇ○五剛好就是「機王」？還是該批風機在設計上或設備上有改進空間？是否有系統性風險？有待能源署及業者釐清；專家認為，不宜過早判定起火原因，火災預防及初期控制相當重要。

title_en: Fire breaks out in offshore wind power for the first time. Scholars: Don’t just focus on firefighting, but “strengthen prevention”
summary_en: Taiwan's first offshore wind power fire accident occurred at the Changhua Northwest Offshore Wind Farm No. G05 wind turbine. It first generated electricity in November 2025 and the wind turbine had been in operation for less than a year. After all, G-05 happens to be the "King of Machines"? Or is there room for improvement in the design or equipment of this batch of fans? Are there systemic risks? It remains to be clarified by the Energy Department and the industry; experts believe that it is not advisable to prematurely determine the cause of the fire. Fire prevention and initial control are very important.

summary_en: The central bank announced yesterday (21st) the latest loan commitments of the five major banks in July. Among them, the weighted average interest rate of new loans undertaken by the Bank of Taiwan, the Bank of China, the Bank of China, the Bank of China and the Bank of Turkey in July was 2.167%, an increase of 0.012 percentage points from 2.155% in June.

summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the third reading yesterday (21st) to amend the "eldest wife clause", which is part of the "Inheritance and Gift Tax Law". The third reading article stipulates that for property donated to specific relatives (fictitious inheritance) within two years before the death of the deceased, inheritance tax should be calculated based on the ratio of the donated property to the total estate, and the donee shall be the taxpayer. Applicable to cases starting from October 28, 2024.

title_en: Tax reduction gift package third reading of Legislative Yuan
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed two tax reduction packages. Yesterday, it passed the third reading of amendments to some provisions of the "Income Tax Law". The tax exemption for minor children will be increased by 50%. In addition, insurance premiums for labor insurance, rural insurance, national pension, and military, public and educational insurance will be fully deducted when filing taxes, similar to health insurance premiums. The law's enforcement date will be retroactive to January 1 this year, so it will be fully applicable when filing taxes next May.

summary_en: Data from the Xinyi Housing Collection Center pointed out that in April this year, the number of dual mortgage borrowers (mortgage + credit) reached 423,000, reaching a new high; among them, credit borrowers accounted for 18.7% of mortgage households, that is, nearly 19 people out of every 100 mortgage borrowers took out credit at the same time. title_en: New public security crisis! Offshore wind turbine catches fire for first time, disaster relief challenges
summary_en: Taiwan's development of renewable energy and the widespread installation of onshore and offshore wind turbines and offshore photovoltaics have created new public security crises. A fire accident was reported in an offshore wind farm turbine in the early morning of August 8. This was the first offshore wind turbine fire accident since the development of offshore wind power in Taiwan. The No. 17 onshore wind turbine of Taipower Mailiao Wind Farm caught fire at the end of May. Fire trucks were unable to put out the fire, and the fire burned for seven hours. There are offshore photovoltaic farms all over the sea off Changhua. In November last year, there was a photovoltaic fire on the Lunwei seawall. Firefighters had to wait for the manufacturer to lift the access control and cut off the power. It took half an hour to enter the fire site to put out the fire. The new fire protection challenges of renewable energy equipment have attracted much attention from the outside world.

summary_en: Yesterday, the Legislative Yuan passed the third reading of amendments to some provisions of the "Energy Management Law". The content focused on the provisions for large power consumers. It was finally passed according to the preliminary version. For large power users, it is necessary to install power generation and energy storage equipment. The content passed on the third reading is limited to "new" and "additional" large power users, and enterprises can choose between setting up "self-use power generation equipment or energy storage equipment." Taichung Shin Kong Mitsukoshi's "Second T368 Urban and Rural Products Exhibition" and Hanshin Intercontinental Shopping Plaza's "Pingtung Products Exhibition" were launched simultaneously on the 21st. title: 工程師殺進AI新商機1／他就不想被管　44歲創業賣房也要救公司　雷朋AR眼鏡沒他做不出來
summary: AI算力競賽愈打愈烈，GPU之外，高階晶片檢測、矽光子到機器視覺也被推上浪頭。台亞半導體子公司和亞智慧，規模雖不大，卻靠著深厚的光學與影像演算底子切進半導體、CPO光電模組與無人載具，而掌舵的董事長石文機，創業路比科技浪潮更顛簸。因為不想被人管，石文機從踏入社會就在為創業做準備。他44歲白手起家，曾替華為首款3D結構光人臉辨識手機做精密調教及檢測，創業不到3年營收破億元，卻因市場驟變，訂單一夕歸零。賣房、借錢、忍痛裁員，他硬是把公司從谷底撐了回來。11年後，這名不服輸的工程師不只活了下來，還把當年最熟悉的光與影像押進AI最火熱戰場，帶著和亞朝9月上櫃邁進。

title_en: Engineer enters AI new business opportunities 1/He doesn’t want to be controlled. At the age of 44, he starts a business and sells his house but still wants to save the company. Ray-Ban AR glasses cannot be made without him.
summary_en: The competition for AI computing power is becoming more and more intense. In addition to GPUs, high-end chip inspection, silicon photons and machine vision are also being pushed to the forefront. Taiya Semiconductor's subsidiary Heya Intelligent Technology, although not large in scale, has relied on its strong foundation in optics and image processing to branch into semiconductors, CPO optoelectronic modules and unmanned vehicles. However, at the helm of the company, Chairman Shi Wenji, has had a bumpier road to entrepreneurship than the technological wave. Because he didn't want to be controlled by others, Shi Wenji had been preparing to start a business since he entered society. He started from scratch at the age of 44. He once did precision tuning and testing for Huawei's first 3D structured light face recognition mobile phone. Less than three years after starting his business, the revenue exceeded 100 million yuan. However, due to sudden changes in the market, orders fell to zero overnight. Selling houses, borrowing money, and reluctantly laying off employees, he managed to bring the company back from the bottom. 11 years later, this unyielding engineer not only survived, but also took the light and images he was most familiar with back then into the hottest battlefield of AI, taking Heya towards the launch of the product in September.

title: 工程師殺進AI新商機2／沒錢創業連早餐店都想開　還領過失業救濟金　公司下個月將上櫃
summary: 「我出社會的那刻起，就決定要創業。」和亞智慧董事長石文機看似溫文規矩，骨子裡卻一直藏著老闆夢。沒錢，他曾連早餐店店面都看好了；好不容易等到公司要讓他的部門獨立，最後卻胎死腹中。創業夢一等近20年，這段漫長的蹲馬步，卻讓他從數位相機一路摸透手機、車載到光學檢測，也替日後創業埋下伏筆。

title_en: Engineers enter AI new business opportunities 2/If you don’t have money to start a business, you even want to open a breakfast shop. You have also received unemployment benefits. The company will be listed on the OTC market next month.
summary_en: "The moment I came out of society, I decided to start a business." Shi Wenji, chairman of Heya Wisdom, may seem gentle and well-mannered, but deep down he always harbors the dream of being a boss. With no money, he once even looked at a breakfast shop; he finally waited until the company wanted his department to become independent, but in the end it was still aborted. The dream of starting a business has been waiting for nearly 20 years. This long journey has allowed him to master mobile phones, car mounts and optical inspections from digital cameras, which also laid the foundation for his future entrepreneurship.

title: 工程師殺進AI新商機3／神明勸他「愈晚創業愈好」　果真3年破億　打入華為後卻一夕跌落谷底
summary: 在各大上市公司磨了近20年，石文機始終沒忘記創業夢，卻因乩身母親代神明告誡「不能太早，愈晚愈好」，硬是忍到44歲才出手。沒想到這一等似乎真等對了，創業第3年營收就破億元，還打進華為供應鏈，公司從2人暴增到80人，連迅得、聯電、和碩等大咖都來投資。正當石文機以為終於等到自己的時代，一場中美貿易戰，卻讓生意瞬間歸零。

title_en: Engineer enters AI new business opportunity 3/God advised him to "start a business as late as possible". Sure enough, he broke through 100 million in 3 years. After entering Huawei, he fell to the bottom overnight.
summary_en: After working in major listed companies for nearly 20 years, Shi Wenji has never forgotten his dream of starting a business. However, because his deceased mother warned him on behalf of the gods, "It can't be too early, the later the better." So he endured it until he was 44 years old. Unexpectedly, the wait seemed to be right. In the third year of starting the business, the revenue exceeded 100 million yuan, and it also entered the Huawei supply chain. The company increased from 2 people to 80 people, and even big names such as Xunde, UMC, and Pegatron came to invest. Just when Shi Wenji thought it was finally his time, a Sino-US trade war brought business to zero in an instant.

title_en: Engineer enters AI new business opportunities 4/"I can't sleep a day" The house is mortgaged until the third child. The noble man brought him back to life and now he is an AI golden chicken
summary_en: Huawei's business dropped to zero, and epidemics came one after another. Haotian Optoelectronics, founded by Shi Wenji, was on the verge of bankruptcy. Just when it hit rock bottom, Taiya Semiconductor's investment not only brought life-saving money, but also gave the team a semiconductor "training ground" and changed the company's destiny. Haotian later changed its name to Heya Intelligence. Relying on years of accumulated optical imaging, imaging software algorithms and AI core technologies, Haotian has evolved from traditional mechanical "visibility" to "understanding and instant decision-making", and has cut into wafer inspection, silicon photonics, CPO and robot vision. This has also allowed this company that almost disappeared to get back on the AI ​​wave.

summary: 高雄近年雖減債有成，公債仍高達二一八一億元，居全台之冠，人均負債八萬元。國民黨市長參選人柯志恩說，高雄需要持續招商引資、協助產業轉型升級、活化公有資產及擴大地方稅基。民進黨市長參選人賴瑞隆主張，未來會控制新增債務，提高重大建設自償能力，並透過中央資源、促參、聯合開發及民間投資等方式，兼顧減債與城市發展。

title_en: Kaohsiung’s debt reduction countermeasures…Ke Zhien calls for attracting investment, Lai Ruilong wants to control debt increase
summary_en: Although Kaohsiung has successfully reduced its debt in recent years, its public debt is still as high as 218.1 billion yuan, the highest in Taiwan, with an average debt of 80,000 yuan per capita. Kuomintang mayoral candidate Ke Zhien said Kaohsiung needs to continue to attract investment, assist industrial transformation and upgrading, activate public assets and expand the local tax base. Democratic Progressive Party mayoral candidate Lai Ruilong advocated that in the future, new debt will be controlled, the self-solvency of major construction projects will be improved, and debt reduction and urban development will be balanced through central resources, participation promotion, joint development, and private investment.

title_en: U.S. stocks rebounded on Friday, "three major indexes closed in the red"! Dow Jones rises more than 500 points, still unable to escape weekly decline
summary_en: The U.S. stock market has recently been affected by the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, and the overall trend has been volatile. On Friday, investors tried to regain their momentum, driving the three major U.S. stock indexes to rebound. The Dow Jones Industrial Average surged more than 517 points, or about 0.98%, while the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq closed in the red simultaneously, with both gains reaching 0.43%. Although the market rebounded on Friday, the major indexes still closed in the black due to the heavy selling pressure overall this week. In addition, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index performed relatively weakly, falling slightly by 0.51% on Friday, indicating that the semiconductor industry is still under pressure amid market fluctuations. Investors will need to pay close attention to the trend of bond market yields in the future to assess whether the stock market can further stop falling and stabilize.

title: 1800萬買房前夕夢碎！65歲翁敗給老母「神祕一擊」  五年心血全泡湯
summary: 日本一對65歲熟齡夫妻原規劃退休後移居濱海城市，卻因88歲獨居母親擔心而被迫喊卡。面對長照與退休夢的兩難，夫妻倆透過諮詢地區綜合支援中心，決定採取「先蹲後跳」策略，將移居計畫暫緩兩年，期間透過定期評估母親狀況並建立照護監測機制，試圖在孝道與生活品質間取得平衡。此案例凸顯高齡社會下，「長照缺口」已成退休規劃關鍵變數。專家建議，規劃退休生活時，應及早與長輩溝通照護需求，並善用政府資源，避免因突發狀況導致多年籌劃化為泡影，確保雙方生活品質皆能獲得保障。

title_en: The dream of buying a house for 18 million was shattered! The 65-year-old man was defeated by his mother's "mysterious blow" and five years of hard work were wasted.
summary_en: A 65-year-old Japanese couple originally planned to move to a coastal city after retirement, but they were forced to cancel the plan because their 88-year-old mother, who lives alone, was worried. Faced with the dilemma of long-term care and retirement dreams, the couple consulted the regional comprehensive support center and decided to adopt a "squat first and then jump" strategy, suspending their emigration plan for two years. During this period, they tried to strike a balance between filial piety and quality of life by regularly assessing the mother's condition and establishing a care and monitoring mechanism. This case highlights that in an aging society, the “long-term care gap” has become a key variable in retirement planning. Experts suggest that when planning for retirement, you should communicate with your elders about their care needs as early as possible, and make good use of government resources to avoid years of planning being wiped out due to emergencies, and to ensure that the quality of life of both parties is guaranteed.

title_en: Should you sell out your stocks as soon as you retire? Don’t get out of the car in a hurry. Experts reveal the answer is not as simple as you think.
summary_en: After working hard for most of my life, I finally retired. Should I sell all the stocks I hold? Many people's first thought may be: "After retirement, you can no longer take risks with your money, so you can put your money in fixed deposits as soon as possible for peace of mind!" summary_en: A 47-year-old former TSMC engineer surnamed Zhang colluded with a logistics company after leaving his job due to health reasons. In fact, he helped domestic businesses importing clothing from South Korea to provide underground exchanges. The Criminal Bureau launched three waves of search operations and arrested 11 Zhang men. It is estimated that the amount of underground exchanges Zhang handled in the past eight years was as high as 3.4 billion yuan, and he made more than 64 million yuan in profits. After police inquiries, Zhang Nan and others were transferred to the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office for investigation in accordance with the banking law, money laundering and leaking secrets. After the prosecutor reviewed the case, they ordered Zhang Nan to post a bail of NT$500,000.

title_en: Taiwanese consumers can only wait. The trial operation of the first Japanese grocery store 3COINS has been postponed!
summary_en: In May this year, the Japanese grocery store 3COINS was released on the social platform. Taiwan’s first official store will open in August, which immediately attracted a large number of consumers to discuss and look forward to the opening and related promotions. This magazine previously learned that the trial operation is expected to be launched on the 21st of this month, but there was no movement when visiting the store today. The news pointed out that the Japanese brand is still making final preparations and adjustments, and has quietly postponed the trial operation time. It is hoped that the customer flow and service links at the opening can meet the expectations of Taiwanese consumers.

title_en: As the global heat wave continues, the Ministry of Environment joins hands with New Taipei to practice high temperature adaptation actions at the end of the month
summary_en: In order to strengthen the ability to adapt to extreme high temperatures, the Ministry of Environment and the New Taipei City Government will hold the "115 Years of Extreme High Temperature Instant Adaptation Action Exercise" on the afternoon of the 28th. Using the extreme high temperature of 40°C in the Beitao area for three consecutive days as a scenario, the Ministry of Environment and the New Taipei City Government will focus on the two major aspects of "health" and "life-sustaining infrastructure", and pay attention to groups vulnerable to high temperatures such as the elderly, young children and outdoor workers.

summary: 新北市日前宣布提供農漁民長者，每兩年提供一次免費健康檢查，將新增「失智症評估」，盼能篩出極輕度或輕度失智患者，及早治療；衛福部長石崇良今被問及，衛福部是否規畫成人健康檢查中，也納入失智評估，他指出，篩檢無症狀失智症患者，是否為有效的介入工具，還是會增加危害，還需要科學評估，目前尚需進一步討論。

title_en: New Taipei City health screening increases "dementia assessment" Minister of Health and Welfare: Whether screening is effective or harmful needs further discussion
summary_en: New Taipei City recently announced that it will provide free health examinations for the elderly farmers and fishermen every two years, and will add a "dementia assessment" in the hope of screening out patients with very mild or mild dementia for early treatment. Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang was asked whether the Ministry of Health and Welfare plans to include dementia assessments in adult health examinations. He pointed out that whether screening for asymptomatic dementia patients is an effective intervention tool or will increase harm requires scientific evaluation and further discussion is currently needed.

title: 從小含金湯匙誕生！東京富二代遭遇恐怖慘劇　億萬家產最終流向太驚人
summary: 日本一名坐擁12億日圓房產的富二代隆介，因缺乏理財規劃且過度依賴家庭資產，不僅婚姻生活以離婚收場，家產更因高額遺產稅與變賣修繕等因素迅速縮水，最後僅剩1億日圓。專家分析，隆介父親拒絕聘請專業稅務會計師，導致資產在兩代間幾乎蒸發。此案例警示大眾，坐擁大量不動產並不代表財富永固，若缺乏專業稅務規劃與現金流管理，資產極易因稅務負擔與管理不善而快速流失。理財專家強調，提早進行遺產規劃與諮詢專業意見，才是真正守護家族財富的關鍵策略。

title_en: Born with a golden spoon! The second generation of rich people in Tokyo suffered a horrific tragedy. The final whereabouts of their billions of assets were astonishing.
summary_en: Ryusuke, a rich second-generation Japanese man with a real estate worth 1.2 billion yen, not only ended his marriage in divorce due to a lack of financial planning and over-reliance on family assets, but his family property shrank rapidly due to factors such as high inheritance taxes and sales and renovations, leaving only 100 million yen left. Experts analyzed that Ryusuke’s father refused to hire a professional tax accountant, causing his assets to almost evaporate between two generations. This case serves as a warning to the public that sitting on a large amount of real estate does not mean that wealth is permanent. Without professional tax planning and cash flow management, assets can easily be lost quickly due to tax burdens and poor management. Financial experts emphasize that early estate planning and professional advice are the key strategies to truly protect family wealth.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lu Yanci, Miaoli, 21st) In order to reduce the pressure on married families, the Legislative Yuan passed the amendment to the Income Tax Law on the third reading today, stipulating that the tax exemption for minor children will increase by 50% starting this year. The Ministry of Finance stated that it is expected to benefit 2.37 million people, with tax reduction benefits of approximately NT$8 billion.

The New Taipei City Disaster Response Center strengthened the opening of three levels at 4 p.m., and the water conservancy, transportation, public works, MRT firefighting, and police bureaus stationed in the disaster response center to conduct various disaster response operations. Hou Youyi also arrived at 4:55 this afternoon to pay attention to the disaster management situation in various districts of the city.

summary_en: As the Mid-Autumn Festival approaches, Yunlin Douliu Bundan is scheduled to be harvested around the "White Dew" next month. This year's production has been reduced by about 30% due to continuous heavy rains in June. The Douliu City Office is scheduled to hold an evaluation on September 1. Today's publicity meeting emphasized that this year's Douliu Bundan will be reduced due to heavy rains in June, but many pomelo farmers are lucky to survive, and the total output is still 3,800 metric tons. title_en: The U.S. ETF market is strong in attracting money and capital inflows are expected to exceed US$2 trillion this year
summary_en: Picture/This newspaper’s database business media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei report The U.S.-listed index stock fund (ETF, an investment tool that tracks the performance of a specific index, commodity or asset class, and is traded on an exchange like a stock) market is ushering in historic growth. According to "Markets Media", U.S. ETF capital inflows are expected to reach US$2 trillion in 2026, a 40% increase from 2025. U.S.-listed ETFs have attracted more than $1 trillion in funding in the first half of this year, pointing to record highs for the full year. Alongside overall growth, active ETFs have become a significant driver of the market. 35% of the money flowing into ETFs so far this year has gone to active funds. Jackson Isaacs, head of Americas equity ETF trading at Goldman Sachs' global banking and markets division, pointed out that active funds are indeed a big driver of the growth of the ETF market. As of the end of July this year, the total assets under management of U.S.-listed ETFs reached $16.1 trillion, of which active funds accounted for about 13%. ETFs are also active in investing in specific themes. In June, semiconductor ETFs attracted more than $19 billion in inflows in a single month, setting a new high. title_en: The Ministry of Environment will build a new building and environmental park. Peng Qiming: Fight for the current location of the Ministry of Economic Affairs
summary_en: The Ministry of Environment held a celebration event today to celebrate the third anniversary of its upgrade. Environment Minister Peng Qiming announced that the agencies under the Ministry of Environment are currently scattered in various places, and the current Ministry of Environment building is old. He will strive to build the Ministry of Environment building and an environmental park at the current site of the Ministry of Economic Affairs on Fuzhou Street, hoping to move there in 10 years. He also said that next year’s government budget will reach 11.2 billion, an increase of 34%. Next, he will promote the national urban forestry plan and the carbon cap and trade system (ETS). title: 人形機器人將大爆發？宇樹創辦人：可能「這時候」
summary: 宇樹科技創辦人王興興於世界機器人大會指出，人形機器人迎來「ChatGPT時刻」的關鍵，在於能進入陌生家庭並透過語音指令完成八成工作，預計最快2年、最慢10年實現。儘管宇樹科技近期於上海掛牌上市引發市場熱烈追捧，股價一度暴漲，但王興興坦言機器人適應不同環境與精準控制仍是產業難題。目前宇樹正致力於建立「自我進化開發循環」，透過AI模型優化控制程式。根據摩根士丹利預測，全球人形機器人市場成長迅速，2026年出貨量將顯著攀升，且中國業者佔據主導地位。隨著資本市場熱度升溫，宇樹能否克服技術瓶頸、將展示性能力轉化為實際商業應用，將成為市場下一階段關注焦點。

title_en: Will humanoid robots explode? Founder of Yushu: Maybe "at this time"
summary_en: Wang Xingxing, founder of Yushu Technology, pointed out at the World Robot Conference that the key to ushering in the "ChatGPT moment" for humanoid robots is to be able to enter strangers' homes and complete 80% of the work through voice commands. This is expected to be achieved in 2 years at the fastest and 10 years at the lowest. Although Yushu Technology's recent listing in Shanghai has aroused enthusiastic market enthusiasm and its stock price has skyrocketed, Wang Xingxing admitted that robots' adaptation to different environments and precise control are still industrial problems. Yushu is currently working on establishing a "self-evolution development cycle" to optimize control programs through AI models. According to Morgan Stanley's forecast, the global humanoid robot market is growing rapidly, and shipments will increase significantly in 2026, with Chinese players dominating the market. As the capital market heats up, whether Yushu can overcome technical bottlenecks and transform demonstrated capabilities into practical commercial applications will become the focus of the market in the next stage.

title_en: Taiwan stock volume shrank to 45,000, foreign investors bought more than 28.3 billion yuan, and purchased financial and shipping stocks for two days in a row.
summary_en: Taiwanese stocks rose today (21st), with TSMC rising and financial stocks and shipping stocks showing strong stances. title: 台灣創新板鏈結精準健康 助攻生醫資本化 聚焦精準醫療四大賽道
summary: 延續台灣創新板（tib-創）在半導體、AI基礎建設、電動車與新經濟雙引擎領域的資本化實績，生技醫療與精準健康產業正成為下一波接軌國際資本市場的核心動能。台灣生技資本市場於2026年迎來最熱絡的掛牌潮，第2季即有5家生技公司掛牌上市，橫跨新藥、再生醫療、基因工程、醫療AI等多元領域。同時，衛福部於2026年5月29日正式函頒《醫療機構應用生成式人工智慧指引》，協助醫療機構在導入生成式AI之全生命周期，有明確的檢視重點與評估指標，讓台灣生醫產業正式邁入「法規確定期」，而法規確定性正成為吸引外資醫療科技投資的關鍵差異化優勢。面對這一波結構性變化，能否讓已具備臨床驗證能力、正處於營運規模化關鍵期的精準健康新創企業，及早對接長期資本，將是決定台灣生醫產業能否在國際競爭中站穩優勢地位的關鍵課題。

title_en: Taiwan Innovation Board links precision health, assists in the capitalization of biomedicine, and focuses on the four major tracks of precision medicine
summary_en: Continuing the capitalization achievements of the Taiwan Innovation Board (tib-Innovation) in the dual-engine fields of semiconductors, AI infrastructure, electric vehicles, and the new economy, the biotech medical and precision health industries are becoming the next core driving force in integrating with the international capital market. Taiwan's biotech capital market will usher in the hottest wave of listings in 2026. In the second quarter, five biotech companies were listed, spanning diverse fields such as new drugs, regenerative medicine, genetic engineering, and medical AI. At the same time, the Ministry of Health and Welfare officially issued the "Guidelines for the Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Medical Institutions" on May 29, 2026, to assist medical institutions in the full life cycle of introducing generative AI, with clear inspection focus and evaluation indicators, allowing Taiwan's biomedical industry to officially enter the "regulatory certainty period", and regulatory certainty is becoming a key differentiating advantage to attract foreign medical technology investment. Facing this wave of structural changes, whether precision health startups that already have clinical verification capabilities and are in the critical period of operational scale can access long-term capital as early as possible will be a key issue that determines whether Taiwan's biomedical industry can maintain its dominant position in international competition.
