title_en: The European and American TPMS replacement wave is coming! "This major manufacturer" hits 5-year high in revenue, old cars turn into new gold mines
summary_en: Chengde Electronics (4554), a major manufacturer of tire pressure monitoring systems (TPMS), announced that its consolidated revenue in July 2026 reached 44.97 million yuan, an annual increase of 5.63%, setting a new high for the same period in the past five years; cumulative consolidated revenue from January to July 2026 reached 310 million yuan, an annual increase of 12.57%, and a new high for the same period in the past ten years. Revenue growth in July benefited from the strong sales momentum of the AM business in Europe. Not only did the single-month revenue maintain annual growth for five consecutive months, but it also benefited from regional dealers’ increased stocking efforts, which further drove sales in Europe to increase by 99% year-on-year in July, which supported the overall operation to maintain good growth momentum.

title_en: Global port congestion has swallowed up about 1.7 million boxes of shipping capacity, accounting for 5% of the total shipping capacity, Yang Ming and Hanxin Ocean Shipping combined
summary_en: The Danish shipping agency Sea-Intelligence quantifies the capacity loss caused by port congestion through the dual dimensions of late arrival vessel proportion and average delay time. It is estimated that in the first half of this year, about 5% of the world's container ship capacity was completely absorbed by problems such as port delays, operational congestion, and schedule interruptions, resulting in the inability to participate in normal market flows. The corresponding capacity is estimated to be about 1.7 million boxes (20-foot containers), which is equal to the combined capacity of the world's eighth and ninth largest container shipping companies Hanxin Ocean Shipping and Yang Ming Shipping. summary_en: The environmental impact assessment report for the Shuanglun general utility waste disposal site development project in Pinghe Village, Dachun Township, Changhua County was reviewed today. title_en: Software and hardware are on both tracks! "This big company" Q2 revenue soared 294% year-on-year, and EPS went straight to 5.12 yuan
summary_en: Dalian General Assembly, the leader in the semiconductor channel, announced its second quarter financial report, with consolidated revenue reaching 456.211 billion yuan, net profit after tax of 8.62 billion yuan, and EPS of 5.12 yuan. All four major financial indicators exceeded financial forecasts and hit record highs. The performance in the first half of the year was equally strong, with net profit after tax increasing by nearly 247% year-on-year. Dalian pointed out that operational growth momentum comes from diverse fields such as power management, servers, network communications and automotive electronics, and software and hardware integration services also bring benefits. Looking forward to the third quarter, revenue is expected to continue to grow, reaching 500 billion yuan. In response to operational expansion needs, the board of directors decided to issue the fourth domestic unsecured convertible corporate bond (CB) to maintain the flexibility of the capital structure and reduce the impact of equity dilution, and continue to deepen the global semiconductor supply chain market.

summary_en: Pork is an indispensable ingredient for Taiwanese people's daily dinner tables, Mid-Autumn Festival barbecues and Mid-Autumn Festival barbecues. title_en: Lettuce can be grown even in the extremely hot weather in Chiayi! The technology greenhouse cools down by 3 to 4 degrees Celsius and each plant has its "identity" traceable
summary_en: The high summer temperatures in Chiayi are a big test for vegetable cultivation. Xu Yonghui, a 43-year-old young farmer, built a high-tech greenhouse in Dalin Town. Through equipment such as water curtains, environmental control, shading, and steel frame cooling coatings, the temperature inside the greenhouse is about 3 to 4 degrees lower than the outdoor temperature. It is equipped with a hydroponic system to produce "live lettuce" year-round. The production and sales history has been verified, and the source can be traced from the production end to the dining table.

title_en: China Eastern Airlines' application for a charter flight from Xi'an to Taoyuan was blocked. Civil Aviation Administration of China: Not during the festival charter flight period
summary_en: China's Taiwan Affairs Office stated on the 19th that the Civil Aviation Administration of China had accepted China Eastern Airlines' (China Eastern Airlines) charter flight application from Xi'an to Taoyuan, but Taiwan's civil aviation authorities rejected it on the grounds that it was not within the scope of holiday charter flights. In response, the Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transport responded that China Eastern Airlines applied for a Xi'an-Taoyuan-Xi'an charter flight on August 21. Since the flight date did not meet the festival charter flight regulations, China Eastern Airlines has been asked to clarify the application date.

title_en: FamilyMart introduces self-service checkout in more than 1,000 stores Chairman Ye Rongting: Consumption polarization has become more obvious
summary_en: As supermarkets face continued labor shortages and pressure on labor costs, FamilyMart (5903) accelerated testing of different store operation models. FamilyMart Chairman Ye Rongting said on the 19th that there are currently more than 1,000 stores that allow consumers to use self-service checkout. However, judging from experimental experience, it takes time to change consumer habits. It will take at least about a month to be guided by a dedicated person in the initial stage; more than 30% of successful cases have seen consumers use self-service checkout on their own. As for whether some stores will adjust their operating methods during late-night hours, he emphasized that they are still in the testing phase and are not fully promoting "unmanned stores".

title: 宏達電推 AI 專家團隊互動平台 搶攻 AI 應用商機
summary: 宏達電（2498），19日宣布推出全新AI專家團隊互動平台－VIVE圓桌（VIVE Roundtable）。在前期測試已吸引超過 80 萬名使用者體驗，此次正式推出健康、科技與藝術三大主題圓桌。不同於一般生成式 AI 與使用者進行「一問一答」，平台依據不同主題，由各具專長的 AI 專家組成團隊，與使用者展開即時互動討論，使用者可隨時追問、指定不同專家回應或引導話題方向，帶來「與AI 專家團隊討論」的全新互動體驗。

title_en: HTC promotes interactive platform of AI expert team to seize AI application business opportunities
summary_en: HTC (2498) announced on the 19th the launch of a new AI expert team interactive platform-VIVE Roundtable. It has attracted more than 800,000 users to experience it in early testing. This time it officially launched three themed round tables: health, technology and art. Different from general generative AI "question and answer" with users, the platform forms a team of AI experts with different expertise based on different topics to conduct real-time interactive discussions with users. Users can ask questions at any time, designate different experts to respond or guide the direction of the topic, bringing a new interactive experience of "discussing with the AI ​​expert team".

title_en: The whole family is rushing into the life circle of seniors. Supermarkets are transformed into "big living rooms" and all 20 stores in Taiwan have introduced elder-friendly services.
summary_en: Taiwan has entered a super-aged society, and supermarkets have also entered the senior living circle. FamilyMart (5903) announced on the 19th that it has joined hands with the Neighborhood 123 Symbiotic Association to launch the "Family Together Coexisting Community for the Elderly" project, and introduced senior-friendly services into its stores for the first time, building the first "Symbiotic Community Friendly Concept" store in Shunhui Store, Wenshan District, Taipei City. Nian Store" has now expanded to 20 stores across Taiwan, including the addition of "crutch safety clips", magnifying glasses for reading glasses, blood pressure monitors and machine operation instruction, etc., further extending the supermarket from a consumption area to a base for the daily life and community interaction of the elderly.

title_en: The stock market will encounter three major variables next week. Legal persons: look here for stock selection.
summary_en: Increasing pressure on the global bond market and the negative performance of U.S. stocks triggered a decline in Asian stocks on the 19th. In addition, today is the settlement day of the Taiwan Index futures. Taiwan stocks opened lower and fell 1,000 points during the session. They closed below the quarterly line. Short-term capital attitudes tended to be cautious. Yushan Investment Trust said that next week will include the release of the U.S. PCE Personal Consumption Expenditure Price Index, NVIDIA's financial report and the annual meeting of global central banks. Investors must beware of relevant variables. However, it is judged that the fundamentals and technical aspects of Taiwan stocks in the third quarter are supportive, and the index can be increased in the high-end range.

summary_en: The storm of hollowing out of the major shareholders of the leading leasing management company, Zhaoji Housing Management, has spread. The National Development Fund has also invested. It will require Zhaoji Housing Management to file a lawsuit and urge the company to rebuild its management team.

title_en: 2026 Smart Robot Exhibition The Ministry of Economic Affairs released 16 innovative technologies focusing on AI bionics to accelerate industrial implementation
summary_en: The Department of Industrial Technology of the Ministry of Economic Affairs today (19th) unveiled the "Robot Technology R&D Theme Pavilion" at the 2026 Taiwan Intelligent Automation and Robotics Exhibition (TAIROS), displaying 16 innovative smart robot technologies. Among them, the artificial intelligence (AI) bionic "dexterous palm" debuted for the first time, breaking through the limitations of traditional low-degree-of-freedom claws and using modular design to flexibly expand to 5 fingers and 20 degrees of freedom. Combined with AI training, it can perform precision operations such as electronic assembly and medical material sorting. ; "Quadruped robot" integrates AI autonomous control and domestic key components, and joins hands with Compal, Inventec, Salomon and other industries to create a domestic R&D platform to accelerate the implementation of applications such as firefighting and disaster relief, industrial safety inspections, and improve the independent capabilities and localization ratio of key technologies.

title_en: Taiwan Stocks Arena/"Q Queen" Liu Liangmei: The market is testing quarterly support and will still challenge upwards after the shock
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market started to fluctuate after rising to 46,000 points, mainly due to the rebound in oil prices driven by the stalemate in the US-Iran war, and the rise in US 10-year and 30-year Treasury bond yields again. The 30-year Treasury bond yields even rose to the high before the financial tsunami in 2007. Long-term bond yields continued to rise, which easily put some pressure on highly valued technology stocks. In addition, the current net short positions of foreign investors in Taiwan index futures are still as high as more than 80,000, and the market will inevitably be more cautious in the short term.

summary_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs released statistics on manufacturing output value in the second quarter of this year on the 19th. Benefiting from the continued strong demand for applications such as AI, high-performance computing and cloud data services, which drove the production momentum of the information electronics industry, and due to the increase in demand from the information electronics industry in some traditional industries and the low comparison base for the same quarter last year, the manufacturing output value in the second quarter of 2026 was 6.8657 trillion yuan, an increase of 27.10% from the same quarter last year, and positive growth for 10 consecutive quarters.

title_en: Implementing friendly parenting, MaiCoin provides an additional 30 days of fully paid sick leave upon joining the company
summary_en: MaiCoin Group has long been committed to promoting the mainstreaming of the virtual asset industry and regards talents as an important foundation for continuous innovation and sustainable development. In order to allow employees to balance career development and family care needs with peace of mind, MaiCoin provides systems and resources such as maternity allowance, home office, and an additional 30 days of fully paid sick leave upon joining the company. It also holds parent-child activities and lectures from time to time, and relevant measures have enabled Modern Wealth Technology Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of MaiCoin Group, won the Taipei City Government's "Friendly Parenting Award" again this year, recognizing the group's efforts in promoting a friendly workplace and fulfilling corporate social responsibility.

title_en: Following TSMC, Samsung wafer foundry is not in a hurry to use High-NA EUV for mass production
summary_en: TSMC (2330) executives have publicly stated many times that they are not in a hurry to use High-NA EUV for mass production, but will first use it as a research and development tool. Samsung wafer foundry recently updated information in a technology forum and expressed the same view. It said that the biggest problem facing High-NA EUV lithography equipment is that the cost of use is much higher than that of existing EUV equipment, and it is not expected to be introduced into mass production until 2030 at the earliest.

title: 歐洲熱浪重創企業營運 傳統保險難以彌補損失凸顯新缺口
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜葉安庭／綜合外電報導極端高溫席捲歐洲，導致企業蒙受重大損失，同時也凸顯了傳統商業中斷保險（當企業營運因特定事件中斷時，彌補其收入損失的保險）在應對氣候變遷風險方面的不足。今年八月，歐洲已歷經第五波熱浪，衝擊了當地企業，導致消費者活動減少、員工生產力下降以及營運成本上升。 不同於洪水或風暴等事件會造成直接財產損害，極端高溫本身通常不會破壞建築物或設備，這使得相關的財務損失難以透過傳統保險政策獲得保障。Marsh 公司氣候與永續發展部門執行董事 Swenja Surminski 指出：「高溫本身並非傳統認定的受保風險。」此外，高溫還可能與乾旱、野火及缺水等問題相互作用，形成複合式風險，而非單一可明確識別的損失事件，這增加了熱浪風險的建模與承保難度。 去年夏天，穆迪（Moody’s）估計歐洲熱浪造成約 430 億歐元（約 500 億美元）的經濟產出損失，但保險理賠金僅約 5 億歐元。在義大利帕多瓦及其周邊地區，一項針對約 600 家餐飲業者的調查發現，近期熱浪期間超過八成業者營收下降約兩成。此外，碳揭露專案（CDP）的數據顯示，其追蹤的企業中有 35% 將熱浪列為主要風險因

title_en: Three major legal entities jointly expanded sales to exceed NT$70.8 billion. Taiwan stocks continued to fall by 589 points, retreating to 44,700 points.
summary_en: On the 19th, the Taiwan stock market was hit by the heavy decline of US stocks. It fell nearly a thousand points and fell below 45,000 points at the beginning of the session. Although the intraday decline was slightly converged, it still fell 589.33 points to close at 44,719.35 points, falling below the 10-day line. The transaction value dropped sharply to 847.9 billion yuan; the intraday high and low prices fluctuated up to 762.63 points, and the tug-of-war between long and short continued. A total of 731 stocks rose and 1,111 stocks fell in the centralized market and counter buying market, with 17 stocks hitting the daily limit and 3 stocks falling below the limit. The three major legal persons joined forces to expand sales to over 70.848 billion yuan, and Investment Bank also joined the sellers.

title_en: 20 years after the opening of high-speed rail, the city’s map has been reshaped. Nine major station areas have transformed from farmland to new technological hubs.
summary_en: Taiwan's high-speed rail has entered its 20th year. It has not only changed the travel time between north and south, but has also quietly reshaped the population, industry and land appearance of the cities along the route. From Qingpu in Taoyuan and Zhubei in Hsinchu to Sharon and Zuoying in Tainan, and then to Houlong in Miaoli, Tianzhong in Changhua and Huwei in Yunlin, the high-speed rail station area that used to be mainly farmland and rural areas has gradually transformed into a new settlement for technology, commerce, medical care and tourism as transportation dividends, industrial settlement and public construction are in place.

title_en: The culprit behind Taiwan’s stock market’s two-day plunge has been found. Analysts emphasize the clarion call for counterattack. The six major AI groups will give priority to buying.
summary_en: The four major U.S. stock indexes all closed lower on Tuesday, with the fee half plunging 4.98%. The memory community suffered a bloodbath. Taiwan stocks opened at 45,071.34 points on the 19th. It fell 237.34 points, and the index opened lower, once reaching 44,308.71 points, a sharp drop of 999.97 points. Securities analysts bluntly said that there are two reasons for the sharp decline in Taiwan stocks. One is the surge in U.S. government bond yields, and the other is the rise in geopolitical risks. However, analysts emphasize that as the U.S. midterm elections approach, historical experience shows that U.S. stocks will rise in October, and Taiwan stocks are expected to hit another high.

title: 技術司發表16項智慧機器人創新技術 聚焦AI仿生、服務、工業型應用

title: 信實：清潔機器人非取代人力　助輕鬆有效率工作

summary:
台股連兩日重挫、4萬5千點與季線雙雙失守！台股今(19)日開低後一度下探44,308.71點，盤中跌幅逾千點，隨後低接買盤進場、跌勢略為收斂，終場仍下跌589.33點、跌幅1.30%，收在44,719.35點，成交金額達8,493.45億元。權王台積電(2330)下跌30元、跌幅1.26%，收在2,350元，電子指數同步下挫1.38%；致茂(2360)重挫逾8%，記憶體族群賣壓沉重，南亞科(2408)下跌逾6%。不過，資金轉進被動元件與部分高價電子股避風，日電貿(3090)、大毅(2478)、信昌電(6173)、金山電(8042)逆勢亮燈漲停，健策(3653)也勁揚6.02%；另外，受地緣衝突影響搶艙需求升溫激勵，航運股陽明(2609)震盪走高，終場大漲近5%，長榮(2603)、萬海(2615)亦由黑翻紅；散裝航運方面，四維航(5608)強攻漲停，新興(2605)、慧洋-KY(2637)同步走強，也成為盤面撐盤亮點。

 亞股普遍收跌，韓國綜合指數重挫5.80%，日經指數大跌3.16%，上海綜合指數下挫2.40%；香港恆生指數則小漲0.09%，成為主要亞股中唯一收漲市場。

中東停火希望降溫推升油價，美國長天期公債殖利率攀上多年高點，半導體類股帶領科技股下殺，美股四大指數全面收跌，道瓊工業指數下跌0.22%、標普500指數下挫0.69%、那斯達克指數收低1.33%，費城半導體指數更重挫4.98%。

title: 蘇元和觀點》當錢變貴 AI高估值還能走多遠？
summary: [Newtalk新聞] 這一波全球科技股真正值得注意的不是NVIDIA一天跌了多少，也不是AI需求突然出了什麼問題，而是債券市場正在告訴投資人一件更重要的事：「錢變貴了。」 8月18日，美國30年期公債殖利率一度升至5.34%，創下2007年以來新高。當天Nasdaq 100下跌約1.7%，費城半導體指數重挫5.6%，NVIDIA也下跌逾2%。 表面上，看是科技股遭遇賣壓；但真正發生的事情，是市場開始重新計算：AI股票未來的成長，到底值得現在付出多少價格？ 殖利率上升，並不是直接把NVIDIA的基本面打壞。因為GPU需求還在，AI伺服器還在出貨，資料中心仍持續擴建，大型科技公司的AI資本支出也沒有因為一天的股價下跌而消失。 但真正改變的是「價格」的期待。過去市場願意給AI龍頭40倍、50倍甚至更高的本益比，是因為投資人相信未來幾年的高速成長足以支撐今天的高估值。 但當30年期美債殖利率站上5%，無風險資產本身就開始提供更高的報酬率。投資人自然會重新思考：既然美國長債殖利率已超過5%，投資人自然會問：為什麼還要用高昂價格，承擔AI股票更大的波動與不確定性？ 假設一家AI公司每股獲利10元

title: SK海力士宣布286億美元股票回購，強化股東回報計畫
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，韓國記憶體晶片製造商SK海力士表示，作為股東回報計畫的一部分，該公司將回購價值40兆韓元(286億美元)的股份。SK海力士的股東回報計畫一直受到投資者的熱切期待，投資者將其視為因應晶片熱潮不可避免降溫的一種新對策。根據週三提交的監管文件，SK海力士表示將在8月20日至11月19日期間回購多達2,400萬自家股份。隨著人工智能需求引發記憶體晶片供應緊張，SK海力士正產生創紀錄的現金流。隨著價格漲幅開始放緩，回購和股息可能提供下一個催化劑，並可能為股價提供支撐，因為投資者將目光放在了盈利成長見頂之後。SK海力士表示，將把2025年至2027年的股東回報目標擴大至累計自由現金流的50%以上。該公司將推進額外的股票回購和註銷。eToro亞太及中東地區首席分析師Josh Gilbert表示，此次回購的規模是SK海力士發出的強烈信號，滿足了投資者長期以來的呼聲，也就是將不斷成長的現金儲備用於營運和改善股東回報。Gilbert補充稱，如果公司認為記憶體晶片價格即將回落，就不會在未來三個月內投入如此大規模的資金回購自家股票。

title: 快查簡訊！手機報稅抽獎1.9萬人成幸運兒　頭獎5萬元名單「這天看」
summary: 財政部為推廣手機報稅，舉辦「手機報稅GO好禮大FUN送」抽獎活動，114年度綜所稅使用手機申報件數達289萬件，成長顯著。本次活動共抽出19,586名幸運得主，獎項包含頭獎5萬元現金及多項電子禮券，中獎名單已於財政部官網與臉書公開。國稅局提醒，現金獎項將以掛號通知，電子禮券則透過111政府專屬短碼簡訊發送。請中獎者務必於115年11月25日前完成兌領，逾期視同放棄。此次活動旨在鼓勵民眾善用數位化報稅服務，提升繳稅便利性，未來將持續優化申報系統，落實智慧化稅務管理，讓報稅流程更加簡便高效，落實便民政策目標。

title_en: Qian Jing Your Family 1/Don’t hold on to stocks that are locked up! Shi Yatang: If it falls below this line, cut it in half first
summary_en: The Taiwanese stock market went on a rollercoaster ride in July. In the past, investors who were bullish on the stock market were "four mortgages under one roof" and had put all their mortgages, credit and even financing into the stock market. When the market took a turn for the worse, they discovered that not only were their hands full of stocks, but they also had no cash to add to their bets. Investment guru "U.S. Stocks Dreamer" Shi Yatang bluntly said in the "Money Mirror Your Home" program that the real test of the stock market crash is not to guess the low point, but whether to have done a good job in asset allocation beforehand; his approach is to first reduce leverage, cut off short-term holdings that have weakened, and then transfer the freed funds into ETFs and leading stocks, relying on a "wealth pyramid" to survive the long and short shocks.

title: 槓桿風險消退、盈利前景強勁，匯豐上調韓股評級至「增持」
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，匯豐將韓國股票評級從「中性」上調至「增持」，認為過度槓桿已被消除，企業盈利增長前景依然強勁。匯豐方面認為，儘管市場波動性依然較高，但已從高點回落，流入個股槓桿ETF的資金也已放緩，但韓國當地股票需求依然強勁。同時，預計2026年收益將增長300%或更多，2027年還將再增長30%。匯豐指出，關鍵在於隨著更多記憶體供應的到來，盈利預期上調是否會開始降溫，但如果美國數據中心支出保持強勁，那麼利多因素不僅限於記憶體領域，還可以擴展到電力設備、儲能和工程等其他領域。

title: 企業獲利主導美股創新高 分析師指是重要風險晴雨表

title: 債券殖利率攀升拖累科技板塊，KOSPI週三暴跌5.80%，三星、海力士領跌
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】韓國股市週三下跌，連續第二個交易日下跌，主要因為債券殖利率攀升，加劇市場對大型科技公司投下巨資的疑慮。收盤時，Kospi指數下跌398.66點或5.80%，報6,471.17點；追蹤創業板市場行情的Kosdaq指數則是下滑9.74點或1.17%，報824.46點。隨著市場對通膨和政府債務攀升的憂慮令債券殖利率居高不下，美國半導體股及其他AI相關股票先前已下挫。隨著伊朗戰事的不確定性揮之不去，借貸成本上升的風險進一步加重市場憂慮。Fibonacci Asset Management Global首席執行長Jung In Yun表示，儘管AI的長期成長題材依然完好，但利率上升和地緣政治風險，使得投資人較不願為這種成長支付溢價。Jung In Yun補充稱，在經歷異常強勁的漲勢後，這波下跌也在一定程度上反映了獲利回吐。在個股表現方面，三星電子股價下滑7.82%；SK海力士股價下跌9.75%；現代建設股價上漲5.81%；DB保險股價上揚3.02%。

title: 日經指數週三重挫3.16%，債券殖利率飆升打擊AI交易
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】日本股市週三走跌，延續週二下滑跌勢，因對債券殖利率飆升的擔憂，削弱了投資人對人工智能交易的風險偏好。收盤時，東證第一部指數下跌127.91點或3.09%，報4,012.31點；日經225指數下滑2,134.31點或3.16%，報65,326.42點。週三日股隨週二美股下滑跌勢起舞，追蹤半導體股價的費城半導體指數收跌4.98%。大和資產管理公司首席策略分析師Kazunori Tatebe表示，更高的殖利率將增加超大規模數據中心營運商的借貸成本，引發人們對資本支出前景以及對受益於投資熱潮的人工智能基礎設施公司可能產生的影響的擔憂。週二日本10年期公債殖利率一度攀升至1996年以來的高點，主要受日本央行可能下月升息的猜測影響。Tatebe表示，中東衝突持續的不確定性可能會加劇週三的避險情緒。同時，油價持續走升，因美國和伊朗在解決爭端問題上陷入僵局。Iwai Cosmo證券資深市場分析師Shoichi Arisawa表示，投資人擔心借貸成本會進一步上升，這促使他們對估值已經很高的科技股採取避險態度。Arizawa指出，債券殖利率的整體擔憂正給人工智能和晶片相關股票帶來壓力。

title: 錢鏡你家2／高股息、主動式ETF怎麼選？  施雅棠曝最簡單解法
summary: ETF愈出愈多，從市值型到高股息、產業型、主題型及主動式ETF，投資人最怕的已不是沒商品可買，而是不知道該買哪一檔。投資超過15年、30歲就財務自由離開職場的投資達人施雅棠認為，ETF不必每種都買，最重要的是先分清楚「核心」與「衛星」的角色。他把大盤ETF當成資產地基，先取得市場平均報酬，再以3成衛星ETF增加攻擊力，並透過定期再平衡，解決何時該買、何時該賣的難題。

title_en: Qian Jing Ni Jia 2/How to choose high dividend and active ETFs?  Shi Yatang reveals the simplest solution
summary_en: There are more and more ETFs, ranging from market capitalization to high dividend, industry, theme and active ETFs. What investors fear most is not that there is no product to buy, but not knowing which one to buy. Shi Yatang, an investment expert who has invested for more than 15 years and left the workplace with financial freedom at the age of 30, believes that it is not necessary to buy every type of ETF. The most important thing is to distinguish the roles of "core" and "satellite" first. He regards large-cap ETFs as the foundation of his assets. He first obtains the average market return, then uses 30% of satellite ETFs to increase his attack power, and solves the problem of when to buy and when to sell through regular rebalancing.

title: 山西供應吃緊加劇，中國焦煤期貨價格飆漲至2024年10月以來最高
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，受到三個月前山西發生致命礦難，導致供應繼續收緊影響，中國焦煤價格大幅上漲。焦煤這種煉鋼關鍵原料的庫存降至低水位，大連商品交易所的焦煤期貨價格本週隨之飆升15%，一度觸及每噸1,583.5元人民幣(235美元)，創2024年10月以來最高水準。2009年以來最嚴重的煤礦事故發生後的大規模安全檢查，對占到中國產量近一半的山西省造成了最大衝擊。根據金融媒體行業研究，5月下旬的安全檢查導致超過1.3億噸的年產能停產。CRU Group分析師Banmeet Khurmi表示，目前仍有約5,000萬-6,000萬噸產能處於離線狀態。Khurmi表示，這加劇了對中國的嚴重短缺局面將持續到年底的擔憂。摩根士丹利表示，在湖南一個煤礦上週又發生事故之後，監管審查可能保持較大力道。

title_en: The rain gods are preparing to stay long. Experts: The most concentrated rainfall will occur in the next 4 days from tomorrow and will last until at least next Tuesday.
summary_en: Rain God, prepare to stay long. Meteorological expert Lin Deen said on the "Teacher Lin Weather Station" Facebook fan page today that Taiwan is currently located in a large low-pressure belt, and there are two small low-pressure systems within the large low-pressure belt, namely 94W near Ryukyu and 95W in the South China Sea. As the large low-pressure belt gradually moves northwest, the southwesterly wind on the south side of the low-pressure belt gradually approaches. As a result, the environmental instability increases, abundant water vapor begins to be transported to Taiwan, and the chance of rainfall increases significantly.

summary: 誕生於1976年的宏碁，今年9月將歡度50歲生日。當年以100萬元創業、率領宏碁走過半世紀的創辦人施振榮，以分家方式提供人才多元舞台，如今已養成緯創、佳世達、友達等多達46家上市櫃企業，無人能出其右。日前，宏碁集團創辦人施振榮接受本刊專訪，自揭比血緣傳承的「家族企業」更具威力的「企業家族」養成術，並回首成立半世紀的宏碁，他所看到的重要轉折，並即將把故事搬上音樂劇舞台，讓外界能一同回顧宏碁的發家成長史。

title_en: Acer’s Half-Century Legend/From a Family Business to a Business Family Shi Zhenrong reveals the secrets of Acer’s 46 companies
summary_en: Acer, which was born in 1976, will celebrate its 50th birthday in September this year. Shi Zhenrong, the founder of Acer who started his business with RMB 1 million and led Acer for half a century, provided a diverse stage for talents through the separation of companies. Today, it has cultivated as many as 46 listed companies such as Wistron, Qisda, and AUO, and no one can surpass him. A few days ago, Shi Zhenrong, the founder of Acer Group, accepted an exclusive interview with this magazine and revealed the "business family" cultivation technique that is more powerful than the "family business" passed down by blood. He looked back on the half-century-old establishment of Acer and saw the important turning points. He will soon put the story on the stage of a musical, so that the outside world can review the history of Acer's fortune and growth.

title_en: Starting from next year, electric vehicles can be exempted from tax and goods tax can be exempted from collection first and then refunded.
summary_en:
[Reporter Zheng Qifang/Taipei Report] The exemption of goods tax for electric vehicles has been extended until the end of 2030, but in a "collect first and then later" approach, the Ministry of Finance revised and released the "Excise Tax Collection Rules" yesterday. From next year, electric vehicles can be guaranteed to be tax-free for factory or import, which can reduce the backlog of funds for manufacturers. It is understood that Tesla's backlog of funds is about 500-600 million yuan a year due to the mechanism of collecting goods tax first and then withdrawing it. It is initially estimated that it will be reduced by about 80% next year.

title: 出口強勁＋低估效應，美國銀行上調人民幣兌美元年底預期至6.60
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，美國銀行全球研究部將美元/人民幣的年底匯率預測從之前的6.7調至6.6，所持的理由是出口強勁及人民幣被低估。Claudio Piron等美國銀行分析師在報告中寫道，這意味著人民幣較當前即期匯率水準升值約2%。這份報告指出，出口收入結匯和人民幣低估是支撐這一觀點的關鍵因素，此外，G7要求解決貿易失衡問題的壓力也在不斷增加。儘管如此，中國的通縮風險仍然是人民幣升值的隱憂。內需疲軟固然有助於維持較高的經常帳戶順差，但也帶來債務通縮風險，在壓力情景下可能引發資本外流。

title: 上銀訂單能見度拉長至6個月，機器人佔比達12%，估下半年比上半年好
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】上銀(2049)董事長卓文恒今天指出，AI及半導體需求旺，訂單能見度已拉長至6個月，預期到年底時滾珠螺桿產出會較年初增加20%，線性滑軌則增加10-15%，整體下半年營運比上半年好，全年營收雙位數成長。上銀今天參展2026台灣機器人與智慧自動化展，卓文恒說，產線持續拉升產能，預計到年底還會再提升，其中滾珠螺桿產出會較年初增加20%，線性滑軌則增加10-15%。卓文恒認為，現階段市場仍有缺貨，交期拉長，不過目前沒有漲價計畫。因應需求，上銀採取加班、增加人力及添購設備等方式擴充產能。機器人業務部分，卓文恒指出，目前相關業務營收占比約12％，上銀以專案型團隊負責產品開發及後續量產。以地區來看，亞洲及美國市場成長最強，其次是歐洲。人力擴充部分，年初至今已增加超過200人，預計下半年還會再增加100-200人，年底時總計增加300-400人。卓文恒指出，上銀前三年資本支出30多億元，主要是大舉投資設廠，因已告一段落，去年約27億元，預估今年與去年相當，主要為現有產線擴充、人力增加及部分設備添購。

title: 川普尋求最快11月會晤金正恩，美韓軍演傳縮短一半
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】《華爾街日報》週二引述美國官員報導，川普正敦促幕僚推動最快今年秋季與北韓領導人金正恩舉行會晤，並曾私下討論利用下一次亞洲行程安排面對面會談，時間可能落在11月。川普預計可能前往中國深圳參加亞太經合會(APEC)峰會，美方因而評估在亞洲行程期間加入川金會。不過，目前尚未正式啟動籌備工作，會晤地點、議程及北韓方面是否同意均未確定。川普週一表示，金正恩已對其接觸作出回應，但未說明溝通方式及內容。川普第一任期內曾三度與金正恩會面，包括2018年新加坡峰會、2019年越南河內峰會，以及同年在板門店的短暫會晤，但雙方最終未能就北韓無核化與解除制裁達成協議。與此同時，川普已下令大幅削減美軍參與年度「乙支自由護盾」美韓聯合軍演的規模。韓國媒體報導，原定持續至下週的演習可能縮短約一半，反攻階段及部分實兵訓練將取消或延後，顯示華府正試圖降低半島軍事緊張，為重啟川金外交預留空間。

title: 韓元一度急升突破1400關卡至11個月新高，4個月反彈10.5%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓元兌美元繼上日反彈0.38%後，週三早盤再急升0.78%至1400.60韓元兌1美元，盤中一度升抵1398.95韓元，為2025年9月24日以來近11個月最強，並首度自去年10月以來突破1400韓元重要心理關卡。若與6月5日觸及的1562.29韓元、17年低點相比，韓元不到四個月已強彈約10.5%。美元指數東京匯市早盤翻空下跌，加上市場預期韓國當局將持續抑制匯率過度波動，帶動出口商結匯及空頭回補買盤湧入。韓元強勢與韓股表現明顯背離。首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)盤中一度下探6400.81點，最新仍重挫392.29點或5.71%，報6477.54點；科技與晶片類股遭遇沉重賣壓，韓國交易所並啟動SIDECAR機制，暫停程式化賣盤。市場人士指出，韓元能在股市急殺時逆勢走強，顯示匯市交易主軸暫由美元轉弱、出口商結匯及政策維穩預期主導，而非單純追隨風險情緒。不過，全球債券殖利率急升、中東衝突推高能源進口成本，加上韓股外資流向變化，仍可能限制韓元突破1400關卡後的升值空間。

title: KDI上調韓國今明年GDP至3.2%及2.2%，半導體出口與AI投資成主動能
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導出，韓國國有智庫韓國開發研究院(KDI)上調了對今年和明年的經濟增長預測，理由是半導體出口和人工智能投資表現強勁。KDI在週三發佈的經濟展望報告中表示，目前預計2026年國內生產毛額(GDP)將增長3.2%，遠高於其5月份預測的2.5%。韓國是亞洲第四大經濟體，也是三星電子和SK海力士等全球儲存晶片製造商的大本營。KDI預計韓國GDP將在2027年增長2.2%，高於此前1.7%的預估。KDI在報告中指稱，隨著全球半導體需求超出預期，經濟影響預計將主要透過今年的強勁出口和設備投資顯現，然後到明年會部分傳導至民間消費。該機構預計，2026年和2027年消費者通膨率將分別為2.7%和2.2%，與此前的預測持平。

title: 日本6月核心機械訂單月增9.7%，遠超預期、設備投資動能回升
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，日本6月份核心機械訂單月比值上揚，中斷前月下滑跌勢，且表現優於預期。日本內閣府公佈的數據顯示，6月份衡量民間設備投資領先指標，也就是扣除船舶與電力項目後的核心機械訂單額為10,560億日圓，較前月的9,620億日圓增加9.7%。此前調查統計顯示經濟專家預估中值為下滑7.2%。前月數據為月減12.4%。與去年同期相較，6月份核心機械訂單則是上揚16.9%，經濟專家預估中值為上漲9.6%。前月數據為年減1.9%。這項數據顯示，6月份來自製造業的機械訂單額較前月增加19.9%，較去同期上揚27.4%；來自非製造業的機械訂單則是較前月增加4.5%，較去年同期增加8.5%。

summary_en: Global layout and regional manufacturing have long been a trend. Hon Hai currently has more than 240 production bases in 24 countries and regions around the world, making it the biggest winner under this wave of geopolitical risks. Especially for AI servers and smartphones, under the strong request of the Trump administration in the United States, customers have requested to increase non-Mainland China production capacity in recent years. Driven by this wave of regional manufacturing trends, Hon Hai's market share in these two major products has continued to increase.

title: 荷姆茲航運風險升溫，兩大期油電子盤追高連四漲，布油向92美元挺進
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】國際油價週三亞洲電子盤初延續升勢締造連四彈的佳績，布蘭特10月期油再漲0.7%，報每桶91.65美元；紐約9月期油追高0.5%，報85.34美元，雙雙維持三週高位附近。油價續漲主要因美伊外交前景進一步惡化。川普表示目前沒有與伊朗進行或安排任何談判，並要求美方特使暫停與伊朗接觸；伊朗則堅稱荷姆茲海峽仍然關閉，重啟航運的條件包括解除港口封鎖、石油制裁及凍結資產限制，市場對短期恢復正常運輸的期待降溫。海上安全事件進一步推升供應風險溢價。阿聯酋表示偵測到兩枚伊朗發射、意圖攻擊海上交通的彈道飛彈，最終均落入海中；荷姆茲海峽另有船隻遭不明投射物擊中，造成機艙損壞及船員傷亡。分析師指出，相關事件顯示全球最重要能源航道仍面臨持續中斷風險。目前荷姆茲海峽每日通行船舶仍維持個位數，遠低於戰前水準，且大型油輪與液化天然氣船通行有限。在伊朗態度轉趨強硬、紅海航運同步受壓之際，交易員持續買入地緣政治風險溢價；若海峽衝突進一步升級，布油可能再次測試每桶92美元以上區域。

title: 韓國SK海力士深耕記憶體晶片市場 產品應用廣泛
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導韓國半導體巨擘SK海力士（SK Hynix）主要業務為半導體記憶體的製造與銷售。其核心產品包含動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM，類似電腦或手機中的短期記憶體，用於快速讀寫資料）、NAND flash（一種用於長期儲存資料的非揮發性記憶體，常見於固態硬碟和USB隨身碟），以及多晶片封裝（MCP）等。 此外，SK海力士也生產並銷售接觸式影像感測器（CIS）。這類感測器被廣泛應用於多種消費性電子產品，例如手機、筆記型電腦、平板電腦、數位相機，甚至醫療設備、汽車與安全監控裝置等。 SK海力士的產品銷售範圍涵蓋國內市場，並積極拓展海外，銷售區域遍及美國、德國、英國、日本、新加坡、印度以及中國等全球主要市場。 在股價表現方面，截至7月10日，SK海力士前一個交易日收盤價為168.01美元，市值達到1兆1,926億2,720萬2千美元。根據7月10日的數據，其52週內最高價曾達到177.00美元，最低價為166.19美元。截至7月11日，該公司已發行股份總數為70億9,854萬8,910股。

title: 法國興業銀行稱，人民幣升破6.70空間有限，出口商結匯態勢減弱
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，法國興業銀行策略分析師Kiyong Seong認為，人民幣升破1美元兌6.70的空間有限，因為出口商將外匯轉換成人民幣的態勢正在減弱。Seong在一份報告中寫道，未來數月，美元/人民幣即期匯率或測試6.70。不過，並不確信人民幣進一步升值具備足夠的基本面支撐，尤其是在出口商完成對累積外匯持倉的結匯之後。Seong表示，已有跡象顯示，出口商賣出美元、買入人民幣的步伐「開始放緩」。出口商的結匯比例「似乎已經見頂，並在逐步下降」。此外，銀行客戶淨結匯規模也有所減少。同時，出口商與進口商的轉換比例之差「明顯收窄」。Seong指稱，中國經濟成長前景弱於預期，加上中國央行仍有進一步降息的可能，這些因素均不利於人民幣。鑒於人民幣利率處於低水位，Seong表示，我們仍傾向於將人民幣作為融資貨幣，用於做多美元或建立其他區域貨幣部位。

summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，美國柴油零售價週二升至每加侖5.47美元，距歷史最高的5.82美元僅約6%，過去一個月累計上漲8%。柴油相較美國原油的溢價、即裂解價差，近日更升至每桶約100美元的歷史新高，為2025年平均水準逾三倍，顯示成品油供應緊張程度遠甚於原油市場。這波漲勢源於美伊戰事導致荷姆茲海峽航運受阻及中東煉油設施受損，同時烏克蘭持續以無人機攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，壓縮全球主要柴油出口來源。美伊衝突2月28日爆發以來，柴油裂解價差已翻逾一倍，8月迄今再漲超過20%；隨華盛頓與德黑蘭談判停滯，供應風險進一步升高。中東與俄羅斯大量煉油產能停擺後，美國已成為全球柴油市場最後主要供應來源，煉油廠接近滿負荷運轉並以創紀錄速度出口燃料，但國內庫存持續下降，系統幾乎沒有備用能力。分析師警告，任何戰爭、設備事故或颶風造成的額外停產，都可能把柴油價格推升至每加侖6至7美元的極端水準。柴油成本上升正直接衝擊卡車運輸與農業，並透過物流、食品及零售供應鏈擴散至整體通膨。農民同時承受燃料與化肥價格上漲，家庭冬季取暖油與零售商假日備貨需求亦即將增加；在11月期中選舉逼近之際，川普政府可能面臨釋放戰略儲備或調整

title_en: Taipower: Power generation costs increased by more than NT$120 billion, seeking government subsidies. No word yet on whether electricity prices will be frozen or raised in October
summary_en: After the 2026 central government general budget passed the third reading, the Executive Yuan is planning a supplementary budget for 2026. Taipower said yesterday (18th) that the war in the Middle East has pushed up international energy prices, and China National Petroleum Corporation has "raised the natural gas used for power generation very high and lowered it very little." Taipower estimates that the cost of power generation will increase by more than 120 billion yuan due to the increase in gas prices this year. It hopes to receive government subsidies to stabilize Taipower's operations and people's living prices.

title_en: Lion unveils autumn and winter tourism trends, theme-oriented and in-depth experiences are popular
summary_en: The autumn and winter tourism season has started ahead of schedule. Lion Travel announced the 2026 autumn and winter tourism data yesterday (18th). According to statistics on orders from September to February 2027, "Aurora, maple viewing, hot springs, and skiing" have become the four most popular themes. Among them, the number of aurora bookings doubled compared with the same period last year, maple viewing increased by 50%, and hot springs increased by nearly 40%. Japanese ski products have been on sale for only one month, and sales have reached 50% of last year. The average booking period for the overall autumn and winter itineraries has also been advanced from 4.5 months last year to 5.2 months, indicating that passenger consumption is accelerating from "destination-oriented" to "theme-oriented, in-depth experience".

summary_en: Taipower announced yesterday (18th) that in order to enhance urban power resilience, Taipower will invest NT$5 billion in two years from next year to promote the underground line renewal plan in 18 districts of the six cities. The market expects that the biggest beneficiaries will be wire and cable companies, including heavy electric stocks such as Daya, Pacific, and Walsin Lihua.

summary_en: After Far East Garden City (SOGO Arena) joined the operation, the revenue growth momentum has attracted market attention. In 2027, the performance of the Arena Mall is expected to reach 10 billion yuan in one fell swoop, driving Far East SOGO's Taiwan-wide sales to exceed 60 billion yuan. In order to support the new shopping mall's revenue target of 10 billion yuan, SOGO has also simultaneously increased its catering layout. Wu Suyin, general manager of SOGO, said yesterday (18th) that the catering area in the district accounts for one-third, and catering is expected to contribute at least 30% to the performance.

summary_en: Formosa Plastics' new smart car battery has obtained two key automotive industry certifications: R100.03 E-Mark and IATF 16949. Liu Huiqi, general manager of Formosa Plastics New Intelligence, said that the two certifications are not only for the European market, but an important condition for vehicle batteries to enter the international market. They are also the basic threshold for domestic vehicle manufacturers to apply for relevant subsidies.

summary_en: Since its establishment in 2022, Formosa New Intelligence has made new breakthroughs every year. Under the leadership of Chairman Wang Ruiyu, last year's revenue exceeded 2.5 billion yuan and began to make profits. This year, it is expected to exceed 10 billion yuan, tripling the year-on-year increase. Order visibility will reach 2030, making the entire Formosa Plastics Group the fifth largest enterprise after the four major companies.

summary: 面對極端氣候、淨零轉型與國際供應鏈碳揭露要求，企業減碳已不再只是做好自身節電與能源管理，更要帶動供應商共同轉型。中華電信長期推動永續供應鏈管理，從自身營運減碳出發，逐步延伸至產品與服務碳足跡、循環經濟、供應商分級、CDP供應鏈專案與供應商減碳行動，並進一步導入AI智慧治理，將低碳理念落實到採購與供應鏈管理之中。

title_en: Chunghwa Power Sustainability uses AI to manage and reduce carbon emissions
summary_en: In the face of extreme climate, net-zero transformation and international supply chain carbon disclosure requirements, corporate carbon reduction is no longer just about doing their own power saving and energy management, but also driving suppliers to transform together. Chunghwa Telecom has long been promoting sustainable supply chain management, starting from the carbon reduction of its own operations, and gradually extending to the carbon footprint of products and services, circular economy, supplier classification, CDP supply chain projects and supplier carbon reduction actions, and further introducing AI smart governance to implement low-carbon concepts into procurement and supply chain management.

title_en: Asia Ni promotes Aboriginal culture and attracts attention
summary_en: Asia Cement said yesterday (18th) that the fifth "Taroko Mountain Market" was recently held at the Old Railway Pedestrian Area in Hualien City, bringing together six settlements of the Bosgan tribe. It attracted thousands of participants in two days, and the turnover hit a record high. All proceeds went to the vendors. This year, everything from event planning, vendor recruitment, marketing and on-site operations to on-site operations were completed independently by the tribe, allowing cultural performances, special crafts, tribal food and youth cultural creativity to be transformed into industrial benefits, demonstrating the independent tribal governance and local creative energy.

title: 走過極限 直視死亡 極地超馬世界冠軍陳彥博分享挑戰自己超越不可能

title_en: The proliferation of AI resumes has increased the demand for manual screening, and U.S. human resources stocks have rebounded 183% from their lows.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Generative AI has not replaced the U.S. recruitment industry as quickly as the market originally feared. Instead, the influx of large numbers of AI-generated resumes has made it more difficult for companies to screen and verify job applicants, and has re-highlighted the value of professional human resources companies. With better-than-expected second-quarter results and improved hiring demand, the stock prices of ManpowerGroup (US stock code MAN) and Robert Half (US stock code RHI) have rebounded sharply by about 94% and 120% respectively from this year's lows. This wave of gains has spread to the overall human resources services sector. The index tracking professional services companies has risen 44% since April. ZipRecruiter (US stock code ZIP) has surged approximately 183% from its March low. The depositary receipts of Japan's Recruit Holdings traded in the United States have also rebounded approximately 170% from their lows. The above-mentioned stock lows coincided with the "SaaS apocalypse" panic in the market due to the rapid spread of AI tools. Investors were worried that automated technology would replace resume screening, job vacancy writing and part of the interview process. William Blair analyst Trevor Romeo pointed out that AI has significantly reduced the cost of job seekers submitting resumes in large quantities. The problem faced by companies has changed from insufficient resumes to too many applications. On the contrary, it has increased the value of identifying true abilities and matching suitable candidates. Recruitment companies have also begun to use AI as a tool to improve efficiency. ManpowerGroup has introduced relevant technologies into the interview assistance process to reduce operating costs and improve human resources.

title: 美債價格週二收高，超長債大單壓低殖利率、曲線趨陡暫歇
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】美國公債價格週二上揚，收復了稍早時的跌幅，這主要得益於超長期公債期貨出現的一筆大宗買盤，該交易似乎也遏制了殖利率曲線趨陡的態勢。根據債券交易報價，2年期公債價格上揚，殖利率下滑0.44個基點，報4.1709%；5年期公債價格上漲，殖利率下跌0.89個基點，報4.3656%。10年期公債價格上升，殖利率滑落1.59個基點，報4.7060%；30年期公債價格揚升，殖利率滑落2.03個基點，報5.2858%。美國上午時段，一筆29萬美元/DV01的超長期公債期貨大宗買盤似乎遏制了稍早時的殖利率曲線熊市趨陡態勢。同時，西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨接近三週高點，美國與伊朗在荷姆茲海峽控制權的問題繼續陷入僵局。此外，週二當天公司債發行最終有3家發行人籌資64億美元，低於市場對當日發行規模的預期。不過，週三供給壓力仍將持續，屆時將有160億美元20年期通膨保值公債拍賣，其得標殖利率預計將達到該期限品種自2020年5月份恢復發行以來的最高水準。

title_en: U.S. bond prices closed higher on Tuesday, as large orders for ultra-long bonds pushed down yields and the curve steepened for a while.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] U.S. Treasury bond prices rose on Tuesday, recovering from earlier losses, mainly due to a large buying in ultra-long-term Treasury futures, which also appeared to curb the steepening trend of the yield curve. According to bond trading quotes, the price of 2-year government bonds rose, and the yield fell by 0.44 basis points, to 4.1709%; the price of 5-year government bonds rose, and the yield fell by 0.89 basis points, to 4.3656%. The price of 10-year government bonds rose, with the yield falling 1.59 basis points to 4.7060%; the price of 30-year government bonds rose, with the yield falling 2.03 basis points to 5.2858%. During the morning session in the United States, a large purchase of ultra-long-term Treasury futures at US$290,000/DV01 seemed to curb the earlier bearish steepening trend in the yield curve. Meanwhile, West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude oil futures were near three-week highs as the U.S. and Iran continued to be at a standoff over control of the Strait of Hormuz. In addition, three issuers of corporate bond issuance on Tuesday ultimately raised US$6.4 billion, which was lower than market expectations for the scale of issuance that day. However, supply pressure will continue on Wednesday, when there will be an auction of $16 billion of 20-year inflation-protected government bonds, and the winning yield is expected to reach the highest level since the issuance of this maturity type was resumed in May 2020.

title_en: Oracle's "Stargate" natural gas pipeline rejected twice, Jupiter project seeks diversion
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] The natural gas pipeline that supplies fuel to Oracle (US stock code ORCL)'s large AI data center is seeking to be rerouted after being rejected by New Mexico regulators twice. Transwestern, a subsidiary of Energy Transfer, which is responsible for construction and operation, has applied to the U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to re-lay part of the 17.8-mile, approximately 28.6-kilometer pipeline on federal land under the jurisdiction of the U.S. Bureau of Land Management (BLM). Transwestern said in an Aug. 17 filing that the new route would avoid state land managed by the New Mexico Land Office. The office has twice previously denied pipeline right-of-way applications, most recently in July on the grounds that the land lease was "not in the best interest of the state." The pipeline called Green Chile was originally scheduled to open on August 15, but has been postponed to February 1, 2027. The pipeline will supply natural gas to the Jupiter data center located in Doña Ana County, New Mexico, near the U.S.-Mexico border. This project is one of the key infrastructures of Oracle's "Stargate" AI contract. It will provide services to OpenAI and plans to build 2.5 GW of natural gas fuel cell power generation facilities. The total investment may reach up to US$165 billion, but it has triggered local protests due to water use, emissions and other environmental impacts. Oracle said last week that the Jupiter project overall remains on schedule. Market on Project Delays and Oracle AI

title: 台灣大收購精誠正式開始受理應賣，目前已獲董事大股東14.13%應賣承諾
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】台灣大哥大(3045)透過100%持股子公司「台信電訊」公開收購精誠資訊(6214)，於昨（18）日上午9時正式開始受理應賣，期間至10月6日下午3時30分止。本次預定公開收購最高157,900,979股，約占精誠資訊已發行股份總數58%；最低收購成就門檻為106,174,796股、約占39%。目前已取得精誠包含董事長林隆奮、其他2位董事及5位大股東合計38,461,385股應賣承諾書、約占精誠已發行股份14.13%。精誠資訊董事長林隆奮表示，電信與資訊業整合為全球趨勢，此次公開收購案將進一步深化精誠與台灣大策略結盟，為台灣產業立足海外帶來競爭優勢。雙方自2024年合作至今，已在企業服務、AI及海外市場驗證互補性，未來將整合算法、算力、算術，擴大精誠Ai4iA服務客戶的能力與市場範圍，為客戶、員工及股東創造更長期價值。台灣大表示，本次公開收購所有符合資格的精誠股東，不論持股多寡，均適用相同條件，每1股精誠普通股可換取現金92.5元及台灣大普通股0.84股，現金與股票並行的對價設計，讓股東在實現部分獲利同時，仍可透過持有台灣大股票，繼續參與深度策略合作後的加速

title_en: Taiwan's major acquisition company Jingcheng has officially begun accepting applications for sale, and has currently received 14.13% of the sale commitment from the directors and major shareholders.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Liu Juquan] Taiwan Mobile (3045) publicly acquired Jingcheng Information (6214) through its 100%-owned subsidiary "Taixin Telecommunications", and officially started accepting applications for sales at 9:00 am yesterday (18th), and the period will end at 3:30 pm on October 6. The maximum number of shares scheduled for public acquisition this time is 157,900,979, accounting for approximately 58% of the total issued shares of Jingcheng Information; the minimum acquisition achievement threshold is 106,174,796 shares, accounting for approximately 39%. At present, Jingcheng has obtained commitment letters for a total of 38,461,385 shares to be sold, including Chairman Lin Longfen, two other directors and five major shareholders, accounting for approximately 14.13% of Jingcheng’s issued shares. Lin Longfen, chairman of Jingcheng Information, said that the integration of telecommunications and information industries has become a global trend. This public acquisition will further deepen the strategic alliance between Jingcheng and Taiwan and bring competitive advantages to Taiwan's industry based overseas. Since the cooperation in 2024, the two parties have verified complementarity in enterprise services, AI and overseas markets. In the future, they will integrate algorithms, computing power, and arithmetic to expand Jingcheng Ai4iA's ability to serve customers and market scope, and create longer-term value for customers, employees, and shareholders. Taiwan University stated that the same conditions apply to all qualified Jingcheng shareholders in this public acquisition, regardless of the number of shares held. Each share of Jingcheng common stock can be exchanged for 92.5 yuan in cash and 0.84 shares of Taiwan University common stock. The parallel consideration design of cash and stock allows shareholders to realize partial profits while still continuing to participate in the acceleration of in-depth strategic cooperation by holding Taiwan University shares.

title_en: Apple made concessions to the EU, canceled core technology fees and reduced App Store commissions, and its stock price bucked the trend and closed higher
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Apple (US stock code AAPL) announced on Tuesday a comprehensive adjustment to the App Store business rules in the European Union, canceling the controversial "Core Technology Fee" (Core Technology Fee) calculated based on the number of application installations, and instead charging a 5% commission for digital transactions generated by distributing applications outside the App Store. The new system will take effect from October 1. Apple said the adjustment had resolved differences between the company and the European Commission over commercial terms and alternative distribution channels. In terms of transactions within the App Store platform, Apple has reduced in-app purchase commissions in the European Union from the standard 30% to 26%. For developers who participate in specific partner programs or provide automatic renewal services, the commission is 15%. Apple will expand the scope of European companies that can distribute and sell iPhone applications outside the App Store, allowing developers to also provide third-party payment options; for users under the age of 18, parental authorization is required before transactions through alternative payment channels or web links. The concession is the latest development in a long-running battle between Apple and the European Union over the Digital Markets Act (DMA). The European Union previously fined Apple 500 million euros, or about $579 million, for restricting developers from providing external purchase links. Apple's attempt to overturn the penalty in July this year also failed. The European Commission welcomed the revised terms, but emphasized that it will continue to monitor the actual implementation, showing that the two parties have made great efforts in third-party payment and alternative application providers.

title: 債券遭拋售提振美元，紐約期金和現貨金週二下跌1.19%、1.85%
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】紐約金價週二下跌，未能延續此前兩個交易日連續上揚升勢，因為隨著全球政府債券遭到拋售，促使交易員權衡美國通膨和利率前景。紐約12月份黃金期貨價格下跌53.10美元或1.19%，報每盎司4,420.60美元；紐約黃金現貨價格下滑81.49美元或1.85%，報每盎司4,334.50美元。近期債券遭到拋售推動殖利率上升，並提振了美元，給黃金帶來雙重壓力。與此同時，隨著美國與伊朗在有關荷姆茲海峽控制權的問題陷入僵局，原油價格上漲。美國總統川普表示，美國目前未與伊朗舉行或安排任何談判，使得這場持續發酵的衝突陷入懸而未決的狀態。雙方在一系列問題上仍存在巨大分歧，其中包括誰將控制荷姆茲海峽此一對於全球能源市場至關重要的航運咽喉。交易員將研究定於週三公佈的聯準會7月份政策會議記錄，以尋找有關利率路徑的線索。同時，本月稍晚時，聯準會主席華許在傑克遜霍爾年會上的講話也將受到密切關注。

title: 美銀調查，基金經理股票配置創近五年最高，現金比重降至極低水準
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國銀行(美銀)週二公布最新全球基金經理調查顯示，投資人進一步提高股票部位，淨56%受訪基金經理超配股票，創2021年11月以來最高水準；現金配置則降至僅3.5%的「極低」區間。由哈奈特(Michael Hartnett)領軍的策略團隊指出，當前市場幾乎已看不到明顯空頭，整體看多情緒為2022年以來第三高。8月7日至13日進行的調查涵蓋180名基金經理，合計管理資產達5,250億美元。市場目前形成四項主要共識，包括全球經濟不會明顯「著陸」、聯準會(Fed)不會升息、AI資本支出不會削減，以及民主黨不會在11月期中選舉中大勝並破壞股市漲勢。做多全球半導體仍是目前最擁擠的交易，但集中程度已較先前下降。AI泡沫被受訪者列為最大尾部風險，超大規模雲端服務商的資本支出則被視為最可能引發信用事件的來源；儘管如此，淨71%受訪者仍預測今年AI支出不會下調，58%認為AI最快要到2028年才會對勞動市場造成明顯衝擊。標普500指數8月13日創收盤新高後，市場警戒情緒略有升溫，長期公債殖利率攀升、債務驅動的AI投資熱潮及能源通膨風險均帶來壓力，川普拒絕延長與伊朗的臨時協議亦再度推高油

title: Anthropic數週內啟動IPO，擬擴大循環信貸至逾100億美元

title: 賓州祭全美最嚴數據中心規範，費半週二挫5%，AI基建成期中選舉敏感議題
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】AI數據中心大量耗電推高電價，引發的民間反彈正迅速成為美國11月期中選舉敏感議題。美國銀行策略師Michael Hartnett團隊指出，若共和黨在選舉中維持強勢，可望推動美股續漲；但若民主黨拿下參議院並贏得德州州長職位，反映反AI基礎設施情緒已跨越黨派界線，美股明年跌幅可能超過10%。Evercore ISI及BCA Research近期亦警告，選民對AI的民粹式反彈可能成為股市新壓力。賓州州長夏皮羅(Josh Shapiro)週二簽署被視為全美最嚴格的數據中心行政命令，要求開發商自行解決電力供應並負擔相關成本，逐步提高清潔能源使用比例，且須取得社區同意、提高資訊透明度、優先聘用當地勞工及提出實質社區利益協議。開發商並須簽署具有法律約束力的同意令，若未遵守相關GRID規範，將面臨嚴格處罰，保密協議亦遭禁止使用。數據中心監管收緊已由賓州擴散至德州及紐約州。德州州長艾波特(Greg Abbott)本月下令全面審查申請接入電網的數據中心項目，監管重點逐漸轉向要求業者採用「自帶發電」(BYOG)模式；紐約州則暫停興建大型數據中心。相關政策令卡特彼勒及部分受監管公用事業股承

title: 俄羅斯改道哈薩克原油至黑海，釋出波羅的海港每日10萬桶出口能力
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透引述四名知情人士透露，俄羅斯正把原由波羅的海烏斯季盧加港(Ust-Luga)出口的哈薩克原油，改道至黑海新羅西斯克港(Novorossiysk)，以騰出波羅的海港口能力，增加俄羅斯本身的原油出口。這項安排預計自8月底持續至至少9月底。至少兩批原定8月底在烏斯季盧加港裝載的哈薩克KEBCO原油，已被轉移至新羅西斯克港，9月暫無KEBCO在烏斯季盧加裝船的計畫。相關調整可釋出每日約10萬桶出口能力，供俄羅斯原油使用，協助莫斯科重新配置受戰事與制裁影響的能源出口路線。俄羅斯出口商近期難以為黑海貨運取得油輪，主因烏克蘭無人機持續攻擊俄羅斯港口及能源設施，船東擔心安全風險，不願承運俄羅斯原油，已造成部分裝船作業延誤。相較之下，哈薩克原油的制裁及軍事風險較低，且烏克蘭已承諾停止攻擊運載非俄羅斯原油的黑海油輪，因此較容易取得船舶。哈薩克生產商亦支持這項安排，因目前經黑海出口的獲利高於波羅的海路線。KEBCO原油主要銷往地中海煉油廠，或供應哈薩克國營石油公司KazMunayGas在歐洲持有的煉油設施；這項調度顯示，俄羅斯正利用哈薩克原油較低的航運風險承擔黑海路線，再把較安全的波

title: 普丁會晤緬甸總統敏昂萊，洽建煉油廠、油氣開採及俄羅斯LNG轉運
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，俄羅斯總統普丁週二在莫斯科與緬甸軍政府領袖、現任總統敏昂萊(Min Aung Hlaing)舉行會談，雙方討論能源、國防及太空探索等領域合作。俄羅斯是敏昂萊今年4月出任總統後，首個到訪的非鄰國，顯示兩國在西方制裁壓力下正進一步深化關係。普丁會後表示，俄羅斯正與緬甸商討興建煉油廠，並參與陸上及緬甸大陸棚的石油與天然氣勘探及生產。俄羅斯亦看好向緬甸供應液化天然氣(LNG)的前景，除滿足當地能源需求外，還可能利用緬甸作為轉運據點，向其他國家輸送俄羅斯LNG。敏昂萊因軍事政變及緬甸人權問題遭到多項西方制裁，自今年在軍方支持政黨主導的國會選舉中當選總統後，持續尋求國際承認。俄羅斯與中國均支持緬甸軍政府，莫斯科近年除擴大武器及國防合作，也積極為受到西方市場限制的俄羅斯能源企業尋找當地投資機會。緬甸自2021年軍方推翻翁山蘇姬政府後持續陷入內戰，但敏昂萊仍多次訪問俄羅斯，去年並與普丁在克里姆林宮會談，雙方同意由俄羅斯國營核能企業在緬甸興建小型核電廠。此次再把合作範圍擴展至煉油、油氣開採與LNG轉運，顯示俄羅斯正把緬甸視為東南亞能源與戰略布局的重要支點。

title: 美國7月份工業生產月增0.2%，增幅略低於預估
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，美國工業產值7月連續第二個月成長，主要受製造業和公用事業產值成長所推動。聯準會週二公佈的數據顯示，衡量製造業、採礦業和公用事業整體產值的工業生產在7月的月比值成長0.2%，增幅略低於經濟專家預估中值的0.3%。6月份數據上修至增長0.3%。這份數據顯示，占整體工業產值四分之三的製造業產值在7月成長0.2%，前一個月增幅上修至0.3%。公用事業產值7月創三個月來最大增幅，採礦業產值也實現成長。這份報告進一步展現製造業成長動能，消費者需求保持韌性，企業投資穩健，尤其是與人工智能基礎設施建設相關的投資。聯準會的報告顯示，企業設備產值成長0.8%，國防和航太設備產值躍升1.8%。建築用品產值創1月以來最大增幅。按行業劃分，電腦和電子產品產值成長1.9%。與此同時，汽車業產值下降2.1%，為10月份以來最大降幅。剔除機動車後，製造業產值成長0.4%。

title: Metaplanet 戰略收購 2,100 枚比特幣 股價應聲漲逾 5%
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導日本上市公司 Metaplanet Inc. (3350.T) 近日宣布，公司股價在週二交易中上揚 5.07%，收於 228 日圓。這一漲幅主要受到該公司一項戰略性比特幣投資計畫的推動。 根據《Blockonomi》報導，Metaplanet 已透過注入 2,100 枚比特幣（當時價值約 1.321 億美元）以及 250 萬美元現金，取得了美國上市公司 Super League Enterprise 近 95.7% 的控股權。此舉使得 Super League Enterprise 將更名為 Superplanet Inc.，並成為在美國那斯達克上市的「比特幣財庫載體」（即主要存放比特幣等數位資產的實體）。 此次收購後，Superplanet 將持有 2,100 枚比特幣的資產，同時維持 Super League 原有的遊戲媒體業務。Metaplanet 計畫為 Superplanet 提供戰略支援，運用其資產負債表實力及資本市場專業知識。這項架構將賦予 Metaplanet 在日本及美國市場同時擁有公開交易的比特幣資產載體，母公司可透過東京市場的工具

title: 賓州祭全美最嚴數據中心規範，開發商須自備電力並承擔全部成本
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，美國賓州州長夏皮羅(Josh Shapiro)簽署行政命令，針對新建數據中心推出被視為全美最嚴格的監管規範。開發商在推動項目前，必須取得當地社區同意，並不得利用保密協議限制居民取得項目資訊。新規要求開發商簽署具有法律約束力的同意令，承諾遵守GRID規範，違反者將面臨嚴格處罰。開發商須自行解決新增電力供應並承擔相關用電及電網建設成本，避免數據中心龐大能源需求轉嫁給一般家庭與其他用戶。數據中心亦須逐步提高清潔能源使用比例，公開項目對電力、水資源及環境的影響，優先聘用當地勞工，並與地方政府及居民簽署具實質內容的社區利益協議。相關要求顯示，地方監管重點已由爭取AI投資，轉向能源成本分攤及社區權益保障。隨AI數據中心用電需求快速增加，美國多州居民擔心電價上升、公共電網負擔及環境衝擊，反對聲浪已成為期中選舉議題。賓州新制可能成為其他州制定監管規範的參考，並推動數據中心業者加速採用自帶發電模式，同時提高項目建設成本與審批難度。

title: 從晶片到面板　26H2電子業最強選股16檔
summary: AI需求強勁擴散，硬體供應鏈如PCB、被動元件與電源管理晶片產能吃緊，帶動台灣科技業強勢成長。法人預估2026年AI伺服器機櫃出貨倍增，成為投資主軸，看好台積電、奇鋐、台達電等供應鏈。反觀傳統PC與手機需求疲弱，旺季效應不明顯，且記憶體漲價亦衝擊消費電子。網通產業則面臨零組件缺貨挑戰，車用零件隨關稅調降有望回溫。總體而言，下半年科技業選股仍以AI伺服器及相關關鍵零組件為核心，投資人應審慎評估市場風險。

title: USCC示警中國將數據升級為戰略資產，具身AI與軍用機器人競賽恐超美
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，美國國會轄下美中經濟與安全審查委員會(USCC)最新報告指出，中國正把數據視為國家戰略資產，透過商業化、貨幣化及跨產業整合，推動AI與科技發展，相關政策可能使中國在部分AI應用領域取得領先美國的優勢。報告指出，北京正系統性調動企業營運、工業生產及實體世界數據，以提高生產力，同時增強情報蒐集與軍事能力。相較美國主要AI企業已大致用盡可公開取得的網路資料，中國仍能透過製造、交通、物流及其他實體產業，取得難以由網路直接抓取的高價值數據。這類資料對自動駕駛、人形機器人及具身AI尤其重要，因相關模型除文字與影像外，還須學習機器與現實環境互動產生的動作、感測及作業數據。中國龐大的先進製造業與工業機器人生態系統，可持續提供大量實際運作資料，形成模型訓練、設備部署及新數據回流的循環。USCC認為，數據規模及實體產業基礎可能使中國在商業及軍事機器人軟體開發方面取得先機。人形機器人已成為北京自上而下推動科技創新的重要項目；若中國能把製造能力、供應鏈與國家數據政策相互結合，美國即使在頂尖基礎模型與晶片領域保持優勢，也可能在具身AI的大規模應用及資料累積速度方面承受更大競爭壓力。

title: 美國期中選舉初選戰火延燒三州，阿拉斯加參院與佛州數據中心成焦點

title: 搶攻數位生活服務商機，遠傳「5G家用寬頻」居家娛樂再升級

title_en: LINE Pay transaction volume exceeds 445 billion
summary_en: The mobile payment leader LINE Pay (7722) held a corporate briefing yesterday (18th) to announce its operating results for the first half of 2026 and explain its annual outlook. As of June 2026, LINE Pay transaction volume exceeded 445 billion yuan; the number of users in Taiwan exceeded 13.7 million, with an average of one out of every two people being a LINE Pay user; the number of users with linked cards exceeded 21.8 million, accounting for more than one-third of the cards in circulation in the Taiwan market, and there were more than 840,000 payment locations worldwide. As of July 2026, the cumulative operating income reached 4.95 billion yuan.

title_en: Two questions to Han Kuo-yu late at night Zhuo Rongtai: Everything happens for a reason. The political Yuan’s failure to countersign is a passive act
summary_en: Legislative Yuan Hanguo-yu said today that no matter how powerful the governing power is, it cannot be greater than the constitution. title: 肝指數正常也可能脂肪肝！別只看體重　小心4大飲食地雷
summary: 高糖：尤其是液態果糖，比如隱藏在含糖飲料的高果糖糖漿，果糖與葡萄糖代謝途徑不同，果糖主要由肝臟進行，過量攝取會增加肝臟脂質新生作用，促進三酸甘油酯生成與脂肪堆積。另外，麵包、蛋糕中的「精製糖、精製澱粉」長期攝取過量也會增加慢性疾病風險。高油：過量攝取油脂，尤其是飽和脂肪會誘發身體氧化壓力與慢性發炎，增加心血管疾病及脂肪肝等風險。超加工食品：超加工食品（如零食、甜食、香腸、培根、熱狗、肉鬆等）通常具有高糖、高油、高鈉、低膳食纖維且含有多種食品添加物，容易造成熱量攝取過多、體脂肪增加及代謝異常，進而提高脂肪肝風險。膳食纖維缺乏：導致腸道菌相失衡，腸道屏障受損，腸道通透性增加（俗稱「腸漏」）會讓細菌內毒素（Lipopolysaccharide, LPS）進入肝臟，增加發炎反應。

title_en: Normal liver index may also lead to fatty liver! Don’t just look at your weight, beware of the 4 major dietary landmines
summary_en: High sugar: especially liquid fructose, such as high-fructose syrup hidden in sugary drinks. Fructose and glucose metabolism are different. Fructose is mainly processed by the liver. Excessive intake will increase liver lipid regeneration and promote triglyceride production and fat accumulation. In addition, long-term excessive intake of "refined sugar and refined starch" in bread and cakes will also increase the risk of chronic diseases. High oil: Excessive intake of fat, especially saturated fat, can induce oxidative stress and chronic inflammation in the body, increasing the risk of cardiovascular disease and fatty liver. Ultra-processed foods: Ultra-processed foods (such as snacks, sweets, sausages, bacon, hot dogs, meat floss, etc.) are usually high in sugar, high in oil, high in sodium, low in dietary fiber and contain a variety of food additives, which can easily lead to excessive calorie intake, increase in body fat and metabolic abnormalities, thereby increasing the risk of fatty liver disease. Lack of dietary fiber: It leads to an imbalance of intestinal bacteria, damaged intestinal barrier, and increased intestinal permeability (commonly known as "leaky gut"), which allows bacterial endotoxin (Lipopolysaccharide, LPS) to enter the liver and increase the inflammatory response.

title_en: Stronger than memory, this type of stock holds orders and is red at 12 levels.
summary_en: The AI ​​computing power revolution has triggered demand for 800G and 1.6T optical modules. The supply gap of the key material indium phosphide (InP) substrate has expanded sharply, and the price has risen sharply. Lumentum, a major American manufacturer, warned that the demand for laser raw materials in AI data centers has doubled, and the shortage may be more severe than that of memory. There are rumors in the industry that indium phosphide substrates will increase by more than 10% in the fourth quarter, and the strong theme has stimulated the performance of the related supply chain of Taiwan stocks. Major index manufacturers including Lianya, Brand New, IET-KY, Wenmao and Guangsheng are all regarded as core beneficiaries of this wave of price increases. According to legal analysis, with the influence of global geopolitics and export control factors, indium phosphide has become a strategic material. Taiwanese factories are expected to use this to inject operational growth momentum and become the focus of market funds. Investors still need to carefully assess the risk of market fluctuations.

title: 宏碁半世紀傳奇／從家族企業走向企業家族　施振榮親揭宏碁開枝散葉46家企業祕辛
summary: 誕生於1976年的宏碁，今年9月將歡度50歲生日。當年以100萬元創業、率領宏碁走過半世紀的創辦人施振榮，以分家方式提供人才多元舞台，如今已養成緯創、佳世達、友達等多達46家上市櫃企業，無人能出其右。日前，宏碁集團創辦人施振榮接受本刊專訪，自揭比血緣傳承的「家族企業」更具威力的「企業家族」養成術，並回首成立半世紀的宏碁，他所看到的重要轉折，並即將把故事搬上音樂劇舞台，讓外界能一同回顧宏碁的發家成長史。

title_en: Acer’s Half-Century Legend/From a Family Business to a Business Family Shi Zhenrong reveals the secrets of Acer’s 46 companies
summary_en: Acer, which was born in 1976, will celebrate its 50th birthday in September this year. Shi Zhenrong, the founder of Acer who started his business with RMB 1 million and led Acer for half a century, provided a diverse stage for talents through the separation of companies. Today, it has cultivated as many as 46 listed companies such as Wistron, Qisda, and AUO, and no one can surpass him. A few days ago, Shi Zhenrong, the founder of Acer Group, accepted an exclusive interview with this magazine and revealed the "business family" cultivation technique that is more powerful than the "family business" passed down by blood. He looked back on the half-century-old establishment of Acer and saw the important turning points. He will soon put the story on the stage of a musical, so that the outside world can review the history of Acer's fortune and growth.

title_en: [Taiwan stock market pre-market] Fei Ban collapsed by nearly 5%! The Taiwan stock index fell 561 points in overnight trading. Taiwan stocks may fall again at the opening today.
summary_en: All major U.S. stock indexes closed in the black on Tuesday (18th). As international oil prices rose, the market was once again worried about rising inflationary pressures. In addition, corporate financing costs may continue to rise. There was significant selling pressure in the global bond market, with technology and semiconductor stocks bearing the brunt. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 116.38 points, or 0.22%; the S&P 500 Index fell 53.3 points, or 0.69%; the Nasdaq Index plummeted 355.2 points, or 1.33%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plummeted 628.55 points, or 4.98%, becoming the market's largest short warning. The four major U.S. stock indexes all closed in the black, with the index plunging nearly 5%. Taiwan index futures fell 561 points in overnight trading, and TSMC futures fell 34 yuan. Taiwan stocks may face heavy selling pressure at the opening today (19th).

title: AI 榮景卻造成 K 型經濟 最低工資的「既有公式」失靈該怎麼辦？
summary: 最低工資已經連調升10年，現（2026年）最低工資月薪已調升至29,500元，時薪調升至196元，接下來明年往上突破至3萬元。但超亮麗的經濟成長率背後，卻是K型經濟不均衡發展，經濟榮景僅出現在半導體及AI相關供應鏈。因此過去最低工資既定公式、勞資默契已面臨挑戰。今年對勞動部最大困難是，如何能提出一個全新論述，讓最低工資持續往上調升，並且調幅也令勞工大眾滿意。

title_en: The AI ​​boom has caused a K-shaped economy. What should we do if the "existing formula" of the minimum wage fails?
summary_en: The minimum wage has been raised for 10 consecutive years. Now (in 2026), the monthly minimum wage has been raised to 29,500 yuan, and the hourly wage has been raised to 196 yuan. Next year, it will exceed 30,000 yuan. But behind the ultra-bright economic growth rate is the uneven development of the K-shaped economy. Economic prosperity only appears in semiconductor and AI-related supply chains. Therefore, the established minimum wage formula and the tacit understanding between labor and management in the past have faced challenges. The biggest difficulty for the Ministry of Labor this year is how to come up with a new argument that will allow the minimum wage to continue to increase and the extent of the increase to satisfy the working public.

title_en: Want to live 5 to 7 more years? 7 longevity habits from top cardiologists
summary_en: With the support of AI, big data and billions of dollars in funding, scientists and longevity startups are working hard to innovate and develop various anti-aging technologies. Examples include “organ clocks” that detect the possibility of disease long before symptoms appear, new drugs that eliminate “zombie cells” that cause inflammation, immunotherapy that adjusts immune function to more effectively fight disease, and epigenetic re-editing technology that restores old cells to their youthful state. title_en: Tens of millions of yuan in pension funds were defrauded into buying a "ghost tower". Families with dementia must be careful about financial exploitation.
summary_en: Grandma Wang, an 80-year-old woman who lives alone, received a call one day from someone claiming to be an investment consultant. The person claimed that the ossuary tower could be resold at a high price in the future to attract investment. At first, Grandma Wang only bought one tower seat, but the other party continued to call and express concern, emphasizing that "the more you buy, the higher the profit." She therefore invested in her retirement savings one after another. It was not until her family discovered an abnormality in the account that they were shocked to realize that what Grandma Wang had bought was a "ghost tower seat" that did not exist at all, resulting in a loss of more than 10 million yuan.

title: 薪水砍3成、工作卻沒少！退休回聘殘酷真相：公司想用便宜老將
summary: 雖然這麼說有些失禮，但公司組織其實只把延長退休年限的員工，當成便宜又好用的棋子。如果不想被捲入榨取責任感的惡性循環，請務必開始尋找脫身的出路。當你在網路上看到同世代的同儕發展順遂、大放異彩，或許也會有些情何以堪？與他人比較確實不會讓心情愉快，但明明是從等級差不多的大學畢業、進了差不多程度的公司，為什麼彼此的差距會如此懸殊？隨著臨近退休，這種落差更是讓人百感交集。即使自我催眠：「既然是在公司上班，這也是無可奈何。」但想必有許多人，內心深處始終難以釋懷。如果能晉升為公司董事，雖然有任期限制，卻能領到3,000萬甚至5,000萬日圓的豐厚薪酬，依據企業規模不同，甚至還能享有股票選擇權等特權。

title_en: Salary cut by 30%, but no less work! The cruel truth about rehiring after retirement: The company wants to use cheap veterans
summary_en: Although it is rude to say this, the company organization actually only regards employees who have extended their retirement years as cheap and easy-to-use pawns. If you don’t want to be sucked into a vicious cycle that squeezes accountability, be sure to start looking for a way out. When you see on the Internet that your peers of the same generation are developing smoothly and shining brightly, you may feel a little embarrassed. Comparing yourself with others certainly doesn't make you feel happy, but you obviously graduated from a university with a similar level and entered a company with a similar level. Why is there such a huge gap between them? As retirement approaches, this gap is even more confusing. Even if you hypnotize yourself: "Since I work in a company, there is nothing you can do about it." But there must be many people who still find it difficult to let go deep down. If you can be promoted to a company director, although there is a term limit, you can receive a generous salary of 30 million or even 50 million yen. Depending on the size of the company, you may even enjoy privileges such as stock options.

title: 拚供應鏈金融　銀行有意兼營VASP業務
summary: （中央社記者蘇思云台北18日電）金管會今天表示，透過穩定幣提供供應鏈金融服務，對金融業而言是一個不得不面對的新業務，銀行希望擴大與虛擬資產服務提供商（VASP）合作，包含兼營VASP部分業務，或是持有部分穩定幣等方式，相關模式都還在研究中。

title_en: Fighting for supply chain finance, banks intend to run VASP business as well
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 18th) The Financial Supervisory Commission said today that providing supply chain financial services through stable coins is a new business that the financial industry has to face. Banks hope to expand cooperation with virtual asset service providers (VASPs), including concurrently operating part of VASP business, or holding part of stable coins. Related models are still under study.

title_en: Citizens set fire to a truck on elevated ground. People watched the truck smoke and then fully burn. Loud noises and flames were heard frequently.
summary_en: A car fire occurred on Citizen Avenue in Taipei City this evening. The driver surnamed Luo noticed that the vehicle was smoking and stopped on the shoulder to avoid it and called the police for help. The vehicle immediately burst into flames. When the police and firefighters arrived at the scene, the vehicle was completely in flames. After spraying water to extinguish the vehicle, it was confirmed that there were no casualties at the scene, but the vehicle was completely burnt to black. The exact cause of the fire is yet to be investigated.

title: 影／桃機三航廈明年底試營運　CIQS人力待補1166人

title_en: Film/Peach Aircraft Terminal 3 will be put into trial operation at the end of next year, CIQS manpower needs to be filled by 1,166 people
summary_en: The Taoyuan International Airport Terminal 3 project continues to advance and is expected to be completed and enter the trial operation stage by the end of 2027. With the opening of the new terminal, the business volume of passenger customs clearance, personnel security inspection and border quarantine will increase simultaneously. The relevant CIQS border control units estimate that the total new manpower demand is about 1,166 people. The Office of Personnel and Administration of the Executive Yuan led experts, scholars and an evaluation team to Taoyuan Airport for an on-site inspection this morning as an important reference for future manpower increase review.

title_en: Han Kuo-yu’s harsh words were refuted by the Political Yuan: Not countersigning the unconstitutional bill is the responsibility to safeguard the constitutional order
summary_en: Legislative President Han Kuo-yu was dissatisfied with the Executive Yuan's failure to countersign the bill for the third reading of the Legislative Yuan. The Executive Yuan said that Executive President Zhuo Rongtai was exercising his right to countersign in accordance with the authority granted by the Constitution; every passive action was to protect the democratic constitutional system. For unconstitutional bills, not countersigning is the responsibility to safeguard the constitutional order.

title_en: [Pre-market] Targeted by foreign investors for 2 days in a row, more than 100,000 copies of "This Big Factory" were sold! 700,000 shareholders are green in the face
summary_en: Taiwan stocks fluctuated lower yesterday (18th), with the weighted index falling 548.59 points to close at 22546.09 points. Among them, the wafer foundry Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. (6770) was heavily sold by foreign investors. It sold more than 100,000 units in two consecutive days, causing the stock price to plummet 6.57% to 69.7 yuan, which broke the heart of about 700,000 shareholders. According to stock exchange statistics, foreign investors sold the top ten stocks yesterday, with Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. leading the list with 35,000 shares. AUO, Innolux and many financial stocks were also adjusted. On the other hand, the overbuy list of foreign investors is dominated by shipping stocks such as Evergreen, Yangming and Hanxiang. Analysts remind that with the recent market volatility, investors should carefully assess risks and operate rationally to maintain asset safety.

title_en: A small truck caught fire on Citizen Avenue in Beishi City! The driver jumped out of the car to seek help. Police and firefighters rushed to the scene and sprayed water to put out the fire.
summary_en: A man surnamed Luo drove a truck westbound along the Taipei Citizen Avenue Elevated Road at 6:56 this evening. He found that the vehicle suddenly burst into smoke and caught fire. He hurriedly stopped and got out of the vehicle to avoid the situation. When the police and firefighters were called to the scene, the vehicle was fully in flames. After spraying water to extinguish the fire, the fire was extinguished at 9:32 pm. There were no casualties at the scene. The cause of the fire is yet to be investigated.

title: 70歲還在工作很可憐？這群退休前輩用第二職涯找回成就感

title_en: Is it miserable to still be working at 70? This group of retired seniors used their second careers to find a sense of accomplishment
summary_en: In modern society, about half of the elderly aged 65 to 69 are still active in the workplace, ranging from full-time to part-time work a few days a week. How do these retired seniors work? Some people even resolutely change careers after reaching the peak of their careers and usher in a gorgeous turn. Ask those who have retired at the age of 60 and are currently in the period of re-employment before the age of 65. Almost everyone’s plan is to work until the age of 70. Some people work because their children are still in school and to support their families; some people work for a sense of accomplishment or health, and many people combine all of the above reasons. Even, many of my predecessors are still engaged in certain jobs after the age of 70. Do you think they are pitiful? Quite the opposite is true. At the age of 70, the biggest regret is having nothing to do and having no focus in life. I would like to share an example of someone who is still working at the age of 70, that is Mr. F who founded an agriculture-related company. He once served as a department head in a large company. After leaving the company at the age of 47, he first served as a director and consultant in other companies. However, perhaps because he was born in a family of dairy farmers, he later decided to start his own business and start an agriculture-related company. Even at the age of 70, he still enjoys it and lives a life between Tokyo and the farm. He originally planned to continue his career until he was 75 years old, so he began to prepare for the end when he was about 73 years old. He even gave up his residence near the farmland to the local people who took care of him, ending his career neatly. During his working life, he worked in a job that had nothing to do with dairy farming or agriculture, but after retirement, he devoted himself to the first job related to the family business.

title: 63歲前人資專家：退休前5年起，絕對不能做的事
summary: A先生曾在一家綜合電機大廠擔任管理職。他55歲屆齡退下主管職後，轉任成為子公司的經理，不僅將多年累積的國外業務技能與人脈，發揮得淋漓盡致，還支撐了業績，也積極指導後進同仁。「他是一位很會照顧人、沒架子的主管，能和他輕鬆商量事情」，部屬與年輕員工都非常尊敬他。A先生本人也從中獲得成就感，不僅努力完成公司交辦的工作，也毫不吝惜的將自己的專業知識與人脈傳授給後輩。終於，來到他屆齡退休的那一天。他帶著些許離別的寂寞，但也懷抱著「已經盡力」的成就感離開職場。休息一段時間後，他想：「差不多也該找點事做了。」便開始尋找機會。結果，沒想到他竟大受打擊。「想找一份工作，發揮自己近四十年來的海外業務經驗，卻連一個職缺都沒有。」保全、社區管理員、清潔員這類的工作隨處都有，但若要找能發揮專業知識的職位，他不管怎麼找都找不到。

title_en: Human resources expert before 63 years old: Things you must not do 5 years before retirement
summary_en: Mr. A once held a management position in a large comprehensive motor manufacturer. After he retired from the supervisory position at the age of 55, he was transferred to become the manager of the subsidiary company. Not only did he fully utilize the foreign business skills and contacts accumulated over the years, he also supported the performance and actively guided the underachieving colleagues. "He is a very caring and low-key supervisor, and I can easily discuss things with him." His subordinates and young employees respect him very much. Mr. A also gained a sense of accomplishment from it. He not only worked hard to complete the tasks assigned by the company, but also passed on his professional knowledge and connections to the younger generations without hesitation. Finally, the day came for him to retire. He left the workplace with a little parting loneliness, but also with a sense of accomplishment that he had "done his best." After resting for a while, he thought: "It's about time I found something to do." Then he started looking for opportunities. As a result, he was unexpectedly hit hard. "I want to find a job to use my nearly 40 years of overseas business experience, but there is not even a vacancy." Jobs such as security guards, community managers, and cleaners are available everywhere, but if he wants to find a position that can use his professional knowledge, no matter how hard he looks, he can't find it.

title: 胡正杰是誰？喊每張50元收森崴能源7成股權、千萬元入主！會變力積電2.0？他說股市有多瘋狂、人生有多無常
summary: 森崴能源(6806)在6/23終止上市，森崴能源於周一(8/17)公告，接獲胡正杰申報及公告等有關收購通知，公開資訊觀測站顯示，胡正杰擬自8/18起，以每股0.05元、也就是每張50元，公開收購森崴50.98%至72.82%股權，算算只要砸約1000萬元就能成為大股東。 森崴能源表示，將在接獲公開收購人收購通知後15日內召開審議委員會，審查公開收購人身分與財務狀況、收購條件公平性及收購資金來源合理性之查證情形，並委請獨立專家表示意見。 森崴能源是否能起死回生備受關注，財經網紅葉育碩發文表示：「森崴能源雖然下市沒多久，現在竟然有人願意出手，而且一出手就是要買下超過一半的股權」？ 不少人都想知道胡正杰是誰？有媒體報導，胡正杰君帆工業總經理，但也有傳出是前森崴能源總經理胡惠森之子，今周刊記者詢問正崴，正崴表示不敢確定、只是被告知。

title: 循環雙法說明會前進雲林 串聯農業循環與產業低碳轉型
summary: 資源循環署18日於國立雲林科技大學召開「循環雙法推動說明會」，邀集雲林在地產官學研代表共襄盛舉。近年雲林大力推動有機農業、資材循環與前瞻綠能產業，將在地產業優勢轉化為低碳轉型的核心驅動力，展現在地產業朝低碳與資源循環轉型的發展潛力。本次會議深入解析《資源循環推動法》與《廢棄物清理法》之新法制藍圖，並廣納各界建議，作為子法研訂與配套措施的重要參考，後續將持續於全台辦理巡迴說明會，深化與各界的溝通交流。

title_en: The circular dual method briefing will advance to Yunlin to connect agricultural recycling and industrial low-carbon transformation
summary_en: The Resource Recycling Department held a "Recycling Dual Method Promotion Briefing" at the National Yunlin University of Science and Technology on the 18th, inviting Yunlin's real estate, government, academic and research representatives to participate in the event. In recent years, Yunlin has vigorously promoted organic agriculture, material recycling and forward-looking green energy industries, turning the advantages of local industries into the core driving force of low-carbon transformation, demonstrating the development potential of local industries in transforming towards low carbon and resource recycling. This meeting provided an in-depth analysis of the new legal blueprint of the "Resource Recycling Promotion Act" and the "Waste Cleanup Act" and solicited suggestions from all walks of life. This meeting serves as an important reference for the development of sub-laws and supporting measures. In the future, itinerant briefings will continue to be held throughout Taiwan to deepen communication with all walks of life.

title_en: China United Carcinogen Oil Prosecution, Yu Lingchong and 4 other defendants were detained during the investigation. The court ruled that they were detained and prohibited from seeing.
summary_en: The Taichung District Prosecutor's Office began investigating the carcinogen "benzopyrene" in oil products of Zoomlion Oil Company on July 3. During the investigation, several searches were conducted. Zoomlion General Manager Yu Lingchong, Zoomlion Factory Director Chen Mingrong, Taishan Company's former general manager Shen Yijun, and current general manager Cai Guoliang were accused of violating the food safety law and were detained by the prosecutor. After 47 days of investigation, the Central Prosecutor's Office concluded the investigation today. They prosecuted 15 people including Yu Lingchong and 4 corporate companies including China United for violating the food safety law. They transferred the case to the Taichung District Court. From 5 pm to 8 pm this evening, the court successively ruled that Yu Lingchong and other 4 defendants were detained during the investigation and continued to be detained without permission.

title_en: Zhuo Rongtai did not countersign. Hanguo Yu said harshly: No matter how great the power of power is, it is not as powerful as the constitution.
summary_en: Legislative Yuan Han Guo Yucai shouted that the Political Yuan should not countersign the bill for the third reading of the Legislative Yuan. As a result, Executive President Zhuo Yongtai decided not to countersign the children's future account regulations on Monday. Han Kuo-yu issued a statement on Facebook tonight, solemnly reminding the Executive Yuan that "no matter how great the power of governance is, it is not greater than the constitution." The Executive Yuan must administer in accordance with the law and there is no room for bargaining. He solemnly called on the Executive Yuan to fulfill its constitutional obligations.

title_en: 13F reveals the massive withdrawal of foreign capital! Wall Street slashes TSMC holdings, Bridgewater sells "this" hardware stock
summary_en: The latest 13F report in the United States revealed the capital trends of Wall Street giants. SoftBank slashed more than 70% of its ADR holdings in TSMC, and Bridgewater Fund even cleared out Micron, showing that foreign investors’ attitudes towards AI hardware stocks have become more conservative. Analyst Wang Zhaoli pointed out that market funds are shifting from semiconductor manufacturing to AI application models and S&P 500 ETF hedging. Investors are now paying close attention to Huida's upcoming financial report, worried that the market may repeat the trend of "buying rumors and selling facts", triggering short-term selling pressure. As the high valuation of AI hardware triggers alarm, the capital momentum of the Taiwan stock market may face a test, and investors should carefully assess the risks of sector rotation and valuation correction.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 18th) CITIC Financial Holdings General Manager Gao Lixue said today that the financial holding's net worth in the first half of the year exceeded NT$700 billion, an increase of nearly 60% from the end of last year. title_en: Is it possible that consumer personal information will enter the underground transaction chain? Hackers are asking if 700,000 members’ data can be sold
summary_en: It is suspected that member information of the hand-cranked drink brand "Keku Mature Black Tea" was leaked. Hackers claimed to have access to 700,000 members' information on the underground information trading platform BreachForums and published 30,000 samples. This incident is still a unilateral claim by the attacker and has not yet been officially confirmed; however, security experts remind that BreachForums is not an ordinary hacker chat forum, but a world-renowned underground information trading platform. It remains to be seen in the future whether the leaked information will enter the underground trading chain.

title: 從朱鎔基到習近平 兩次經濟轉型
summary: 大陸國務院前總理朱鎔基於8月12日在北京病逝，再度引起外界對大陸改革路線的討論。朱鎔基與習近平分處不同發展階段，面對的經濟任務也不同。朱鎔基處理市場化、工業化與全球化，習近平處理科技自主、智能化與生產率提升。兩個時代的共同主線，是國家依照生產力結構重新組織關鍵資源。

title_en: Taiwan dropped 4 places in per capita AI ranking? Huang Zhifang warns: Hardware giant, application dwarf
summary_en: The per capita AI usage intensity in Taiwan has regressed! It dropped from 2.29 in 2025 to 2.08. During the same period, the global usage ranking dropped from 19th to 23rd. Huang Zhifang, chairman of the Trade Association, described the current situation of Taiwan's AI as "a giant in hardware, a dwarf in applications." He said that Taiwan plays an important role in the global AI hardware supply chain, but the actual intensity of AI use lags behind the major Asian markets, and it is the only one among the four places that is declining.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 18th) Egg production has decreased recently. Costco said that it will adjust the egg packaging from 30 to 20 eggs, and will first test the sales in Zhonghe and Xizhi stores so that more members can purchase them. Egg industry operators said that mainly due to high temperatures, previous bird flu and the culling of old hens during the summer, there will not yet be an egg shortage. It is expected that supply will gradually return to normal starting in September.

title_en: The content of the prosecution in the case of carcinogenic oil products directly points to the failure of self-management by the industry. The central government calls on the central government to establish an early warning mechanism.
summary_en: The Zhonglian carcinogen oil case has now been investigated and prosecuted by the prosecutors. The prosecutors seized the mobile phone and computer communication records of the senior executives involved in the case, and found that shareholder factories such as Fumao Oil, Fushou, and Taishan had long known that the oil products had tested positive for the carcinogen "benzopyrene" exceeding the standard, but failed to report the knowledge and attempted to cover it up. In response, the Taichung City Government called on the central government to establish an early warning mechanism and strengthen risk management and control.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Wu Jiahao, Taipei, 18th) Taiwan Mobile has publicly acquired Jingcheng Information through its 100%-owned subsidiary Taixin Telecommunications.
