title_en: South Korean won hits a new low against the US dollar this year, and the market is concerned about whether it can continue to weaken.
summary_en: Picture / Our Database Business Media | Wu Chengyue / Taipei Report The recent trend of the Korean won against the U.S. dollar has attracted much attention. According to the "News" report, the weekly closing price of the Korean won against the U.S. dollar has fallen to the 1,410 won range, setting a new low this year. Taking the average in the second week of August, the exchange rate was 1,417.6 won, a significant drop from the third week of May, when it stayed above 1,500 won for two consecutive months. The sharp decline in the Korean won exchange rate this time was mainly affected by multiple factors. Domestically, SK Hynix’s move to convert U.S. dollar funds into Korean won after issuing American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) exerted considerable downward pressure on the exchange rate. In addition, export companies have also joined the ranks of selling, and the selling activities of foreign investors who had previously taken profits or rebalanced due to the adjustment of the domestic stock market have reduced their selling activities, which further improved the supply and demand situation in the domestic foreign exchange market and supported the strength of the Korean won. From an international perspective, expectations that the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise interest rates at the end of the year have weakened, leading to a weakening of the U.S. dollar and also providing support for the Korean won. As the U.S. Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Producer Price Index (PPI) were both lower than market expectations, the market generally believes that the Federal Reserve will not adopt radical tightening policies. Meanwhile, Bank of Korea Vice President Yoo Sang-dae said that although inflation may not accurately reach the 2.0% target, it will continue to rise as long as it fails to stabilize.

title: 日本即時支付市場估 2034 年達 264 億美元 年複合成長近 3 成

title_en: Japan’s instant payment market is estimated to reach US$26.4 billion in 2034, with a compound annual growth rate of nearly 30%
summary_en: Picture/Schematic Diagram Merchant Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei Report According to the latest report from Imarc Group, Japan’s instant payment market is experiencing explosive growth. The market size has reached US$2.4 billion in 2025 and is expected to expand rapidly at a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 29.17%, an indicator that calculates the average compound growth over many years and reflects the stability of return on investment, and is expected to reach US$26.4 billion by 2034. This strong growth momentum mainly comes from the acceleration of the digitization of financial services, the rise of the 24-hour economic operating model, and the growing demand of consumers and businesses for real-time and transparent transactions. Regulatory initiatives are also key, with regulators actively promoting frameworks that reduce fraud, increase transparency and promote financial inclusion. The high penetration rate of smartphones and the popularity of mobile banking applications have further contributed to the popularity of instant payments. The Bank of Japan has announced a blueprint in April 2026, planning a comprehensive transformation to a new generation payment system by 2030. The formal introduction feasibility decision of this project is expected to be made within fiscal year 2026 (Japan’s fiscal year to March 2027). The goal is to create a globally competitive, 24/7 real-time financial infrastructure that can support stablecoins and tokenized deposits. In terms of operation, he suggested adopting the strategy of buying low and selling high. It is expected that the price will fluctuate between 40,000 and 46,000 points in August, and it can be accepted in the event of a sudden drop. summary_en: "My belly is getting bigger, I keep getting up in the middle of the night to pee, and my blood pressure is getting higher. Is this all happening as we age?" title_en: Yuanta Securities, Nasdaq and Bloomberg host the Decisive 2026 Investment New Landscape International Forum
summary_en: In 2026, the growth of re-entrustment will be strong. Chinese people will continue to invest cross-border in leading global companies, and the enthusiasm for overseas investment will set a new historical record. According to statistics from the Securities Dealers Association, the amount of overseas investments made by Chinese people through multiple entrustments in the first five months of 2026 has soared to 7.86 trillion yuan, an increase of 114% compared with the same period in 2025, doubling the growth. Among them, investment in the United States topped the list with a transaction value of 5.56 trillion yuan, accounting for 70% of the total overseas investment. Further analysis of relevant data also shows that from January to May, Chinese investors in the United States mainly participated in direct participation in U.S. stocks, accounting for 58.7%, and ETFs accounted for 32.5%. The two combined exceeded 90%, showing that Taiwanese investors are highly ambitious in investing in overseas markets and pursuing diversified asset allocation returns.

title_en: Tesla’s “Crystal Sun” cost 323.4 billion! Are there any clues about Musk’s secret visit to Taiwan factory?
summary_en: Tesla, owned by Musk, the world's richest man, has launched the "Crystal Sun Project", spending US$10.1 billion to build a large-scale solar plant in Texas, with the goal of putting it into operation in 2029. This move is intended to lay out a complete supply chain from ingots to modules, and actively explore perovskite solar technology to support space AI data centers. Taiwan's solar supply chain, such as United Renewables, Yuanjing and Sino-American Crystal, has already secured its position in advance. Not only is it deeply engaged in perovskite technology, but it has also passed satellite application testing and is expected to enter Musk's global supply chain. Despite facing challenges from U.S. tariff policies, Taiwanese manufacturers continue to exert a key influence in the green energy field by relying on their technological competitiveness and niche product layout. Experts suggest that if Taiwanese manufacturers want to further seize business opportunities, they should shift their production strategies to the midstream and upstream to meet Musk's huge energy transformation needs. Investors should note that although relevant industry dynamics have potential, market risks still need to be carefully assessed.

title_en: Taiwan stocks encounter small head and neckline! Unable to stand, 46,000 adjusts the selling pressure and comes out? Analyst reveals backtest buying point
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have rebounded strongly recently, soaring to about 6,700 points in 11 trading days. However, they failed to challenge the 46,000 point mark on the 14th, triggering market concerns about holding up selling pressure. Moore Investment Consulting analyst Xie Chenyan pointed out that 46,250 points is a technical satisfaction point, and the retracement adjustment is reasonable. Although expectations of a rate cut by the Federal Reserve have cooled, foreign investors have bought 5 times in a row and the New Taiwan Dollar has strengthened, and the fundamentals remain solid. Xie Chenyan believes that if the index backtests 45,000 points, it will be a good opportunity to enter the market at low prices. In addition, Taiwan stocks’ full-year profits are expected to exceed the 7 trillion yuan mark. Supported by strong demand for AI servers and infrastructure, the long-term bullish pattern has not changed. Investors should pay attention to the subsequent settlement of Taiwanese index futures and economic data. There is no need to panic excessively in the face of shocks. It is recommended to carefully assess risks and seize the layout opportunities of market pullbacks.

title_en: New target price after the meeting of Yaohua Medicine
summary_en: Yaohua Pharmaceutical (6446) has outstanding operating performance, benefiting from strong sales in the United States and Japan. In the second quarter, EPS reached a new high of 6.13 yuan. The legal person pointed out that the sales momentum of its new blood cancer drug BESREMi has continued, and the indication for essential thrombocythemia (ET) will gradually obtain drug licenses in many countries, which is expected to become the next stage of growth engine. In addition, the newly launched Ropeg injection pen can help improve patients' medication compliance and further boost revenue. The legal person is optimistic about the medium and long-term growth potential. It is estimated that as ET indications bloom in many countries around the world, Yaohua Pharmaceutical's revenue and profits will increase significantly, and EPS is expected to continue to grow. Many legal entities have given it strong buy and positive investment ratings, with a target price of 2,090 yuan. Investors are reminded that market fluctuations still exist and investment risks should be carefully assessed when making decisions.

title: 從指數剔除？MSCI擬新規鎖定「非營運公司」　1台灣大藥廠入觀察名單
summary: 指數編製商MSCI日前發布提案，擬將「非營運公司」自全球可投資市場指數（GIMI）中剔除，並啟動市場諮詢。MSCI透過設立「核心篩選」與5項財務指標排除機制，嚴格審視企業營運資產及現金流表現。此次調整雖未直接點名，但被視為針對高度依賴外部資本、囤積資產的企業，包括微策略等持有大量比特幣的公司皆受波及。台灣晟德大藥廠因轉型生技投資控股，營運模式符合相關條件而被列入公開觀察名單，若在後續評估中持續未達標，恐面臨被移除風險。MSCI預計於10月中旬公布最終結果，相關指數調整最快將於11月執行，投資人需密切留意相關個股波動與後續動態。

title_en: Removed from index? MSCI plans new rules to target "non-operating companies" and 1 major Taiwanese pharmaceutical company will be added to the watch list
summary_en: Index compiler MSCI recently issued a proposal to remove "non-operating companies" from the Global Investable Market Index (GIMI) and launched market consultation. MSCI strictly examines the company's operating assets and cash flow performance by establishing a "core screening" and five financial indicator exclusion mechanisms. Although this adjustment was not directly named, it was seen as targeting companies that relied heavily on external capital and hoarded assets, including companies such as MicroStrategy that held large amounts of Bitcoin. Taiwan Shengde Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. has been included in the public watch list due to its transformation into a biotechnology investment holding and its operating model meets relevant conditions. If it continues to fail to meet the standards in subsequent evaluations, it may face the risk of being removed. MSCI is expected to announce the final results in mid-October, and the relevant index adjustments will be implemented as early as November. Investors need to pay close attention to the fluctuations of relevant stocks and subsequent developments.

title_en: Revenue soared by nearly 50% in July after listing, but the industry was squeezed and revenue declined.
summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange stated that the revenue announced by listed companies in July 2015 showed that the revenue of all listed companies in this (July) month totaled 5.3925 billion yuan, an increase of 1.7529 billion yuan (48.16%) compared with the same period in 2014. There were 786 companies with revenue growth and a total of 265 companies with decline. In addition, as of July 2015, the total revenue of all listed companies totaled 33.2575 billion yuan, an increase of 8.5255 billion yuan (34.47%) compared with the same period in 2014. There were 711 companies with revenue growth and a total of 340 companies with decline. A total of 1,051 listed companies (excluding 32 companies in the finance and insurance industry and 33 companies in the Sanshang Investment Holdings Co., Ltd.) have completed their July 2015 revenue declaration before August 10, 2015.

title_en: Demand for Token explodes! "This major memory manufacturer" earned more than 11 shares in a single quarter, with EPS as high as 118.57 yuan
summary_en: Phison (8299), a major memory control chip manufacturer, announced its second quarter financial report. Benefiting from the explosive demand for AI applications, its single-quarter revenue reached 67.888 billion yuan, after-tax net income reached 26.219 billion yuan, and EPS reached 118.57 yuan. It earned more than 11 equity shares in a single quarter, and both revenue and profit hit record highs simultaneously. In addition, the board of directors decided to distribute a cash dividend of 60 yuan per share in the first half of the year, setting a record since its establishment. Despite recent stock price fluctuations, Phison continues to promote its "Phison 3.0" transformation strategy and actively deploys AI storage, enterprise-level SSD and AI infrastructure. CEO Pan Jiancheng emphasized that in the future, it will deepen cooperation in the global AI ecosystem, reduce reliance on the standardized retail market, and transform and develop high-margin customized storage solutions to cope with the growth of structural demand brought about by the AI ​​era. The market is optimistic about its future development potential.

summary_en: Global market information updates are accelerating, ranging from US stock indexes, US dollar trends, gold hedging, crude oil prices to changes in supply and demand of agricultural products, all of which may become key clues affecting the market. Facing the rise of cross-asset linkage, traders no longer only look at a single market direction, but also need to establish a set of tools and perspectives that can quickly identify market signals. title_en: TECO’s new target price revealed after Q2 revenue
summary_en: TECO (1504) has benefited from strong demand in electromechanical and data centers in North America, Taiwan and Southeast Asia, as well as the emergence of layout benefits. Local securities firms are optimistic about the strengthening momentum of its power and energy business and raised the target price to NT$98. TECO's second-quarter financial performance was impressive, with net earnings per share (EPS) reaching 1.12 yuan, an annual increase of 62%. Looking into the market outlook, U.S. CSPs continue to expand investment in AI data centers, driving demand for power equipment. TECO is seizing business opportunities by expanding overseas production capacity. In addition, TECO is actively exploring Southeast Asia, strengthening its modular data center (MDC) delivery capabilities through the acquisition of Malaysian engineering companies, and successfully obtained orders of approximately 2.5 billion yuan from Malaysia and Thailand. The legal person predicts that as the proportion of high-gross-profit projects increases, TECO's profit structure will continue to be optimized. It is expected that EPS will grow year by year in 2026 and 2027. It maintains a buy rating and recommends investors to carefully assess market risks.

title_en: Xingyu's second art machine "Kongshan Gold" arrives in Taiwan! First flight to Narita on August 20, future flight plans revealed
summary_en: The second A350-1000 art aircraft "Sorayama Gold" jointly built by Starlux Airlines and Japanese artist Hajime Sorayama arrived in Taiwan at 9:43 this morning. It was also surprisingly combined with Sorayama Gin. It is expected to make its maiden flight to Tokyo on August 20 on JX800 Narita, starting from October 1st, theme flights will officially fly to Tokyo (JX800/801), Phoenix and Prague on a regular basis. It is also planning to fly to Bangkok on August 26th to bring passengers a limited-time artistic flight experience.

summary: 國民旅遊卡存廢再掀討論，有公務員在公共政策網路參與平台提案，表達希望廢除國旅卡制度，恢復無法休假時的不休假加班費。行政院人事行政總處以現行制度已兼顧公務員健康保障與額外勞務補償為由，表達了不認同的態度，2028年前將維持現行規定，後續每三年檢討一次。

title_en: Will there be no vacation and overtime pay if the CITS card is reissued? The General Office of Personnel only agrees to conduct a review every three years
summary_en: Discussions on the abolition of the National Travel Card have resumed. Some civil servants have proposed on the public policy network participation platform, expressing their hope to abolish the National Travel Card system and restore overtime pay for non-leave work when it is impossible to take vacations. The General Office of Personnel and Administration of the Executive Yuan expressed its disapproval on the grounds that the current system already takes into account the health protection and additional labor compensation of civil servants. The current regulations will be maintained until 2028 and will be reviewed every three years thereafter.

title: 夫妻贈與房產連3年破1.5萬棟！2020-2026一次看　房屋稅、土增稅規劃成資產配置新焦點
summary: 房價高檔、稅制調整下，夫妻間不動產移轉近年明顯增加。根據內政部統計，2025年全台夫妻贈與建物移轉達15,854棟，創近年統計新高；2026年上半年也已有6,768棟。從2016年至2025年觀察，夫妻贈與平均每年約1.36萬棟，近3年更連續站上1.5萬棟，夫妻間如何配置房產與稅負，逐漸成為高房價時代的重要課題。

title_en: The number of properties donated by couples has exceeded 15,000 for three consecutive years! A look at 2020-2026: Housing tax and land tax increase planning become new focus of asset allocation
summary_en: Due to high housing prices and adjustments to the tax system, real estate transfers between couples have increased significantly in recent years. According to statistics from the Ministry of the Interior, in 2025, 15,854 buildings donated by couples across Taiwan were transferred, setting a new statistical high in recent years; in the first half of 2026, there were also 6,768 buildings. From 2016 to 2025, couples donated an average of about 13,600 houses per year, and in the past three years it has reached 15,000 houses. How couples allocate real estate and tax burdens has gradually become an important issue in the era of high housing prices.

summary_en: "Tianbao", the fourth special exhibition in the Qijiaotou series of Pingtung Wangchuan Cultural Center, will be launched today. With the theme of "Dingzhong Street", one of Qijiaotou in Donggang, the century-old mikoshi on Dingzhong Street will be displayed for the first time to understand the inherited spirit of the Jiaotou settlement. title_en: The rain is increasing! Special warning of heavy rain in 19 counties and cities, protection against lightning strikes and strong wind gusts
summary_en: At 15:30 pm, the Central Meteorological Administration issued a special warning of torrential rain and heavy rain for all 19 counties and cities in Taiwan, pointing out that convective cloud systems are developing vigorously and short-duration heavy rainfall is likely to occur. Today (16th) there will be local heavy rain or torrential rain in Taichung City, and there is a chance of local heavy rain in the western half, Hualien, Taitung and Yilan Mountains. Please be careful of lightning strikes and strong gusts, beware of water accumulation in low-lying areas, and beware of landslides, falling rocks and swollen streams in mountainous areas.

summary_en: The COVID-19 epidemic will reach its peak as soon as this week. This newspaper reported today that the rapid screening reagents currently covered by health insurance are only available to high-risk groups. title_en: He secretly gave 2.4 million yuan to his parents over five years to "fulfil his filial piety". His wife angrily accused him of maliciously transferring property and filed for divorce.
summary_en: A couple in Shaoxing, Zhejiang were involved in a marital dispute over 500,000 yuan (RMB, the same below, approximately NT$2.4 million) in family property. 40-year-old Ms. Yang recently consulted the Shaoxing City Women and Children Family Service Center. During the five years after their marriage, her husband kept the secret from her and transferred 100,000 yuan (approximately NT$480,000) to her parents every year, totaling 500,000 yuan. Ms. Yang believes that this expenditure exceeds the scope of normal support and is suspected of malicious transfer of joint property between husband and wife, and is preparing to defend her rights through divorce proceedings.

title_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs launches toy inspection mobilization! If you list the product without completing the inspection procedures, you may be fined up to RMB 2 million.
summary_en: There are many types of toys at home and abroad and new ones are introduced, which may lead to various risks in use. The Bureau of Standards and Inspection of the Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that it will continue to collect the development trends of international standards, evaluate the characteristics of emerging commodities and possible hazards, and review inspection regulations on a rolling basis; it will also conduct market inspections and sample purchase inspections every year, especially emerging popular toys as key inspection objects. If inspection procedures are not completed, a fine of NT$200,000 to NT$2 million will be imposed.

title_en: China Airlines' EPS in the first half of the year is 1.08 yuan. The legal person is optimistic about the second half of the year and estimates the full year to be 2.1 yuan.
summary_en: China Airlines (2610) announced an after-tax profit of 6.582 billion yuan in the first half of this year, and an after-tax profit per share (EPS) of 1.08 yuan. Analysts said that due to the sharp rise in international oil prices stimulated by the US-Iraq War, the after-tax profit in the second quarter was 1.413 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 63.3%, and the EPS was 0.23 yuan, and it is estimated to be 2.1 yuan for the full year.

title_en: Marriage and childcare subsidy upgraded, Fubon Financial and its subsidiaries won six awards in the "Friendly Parenting Award"
summary_en: The Labor Bureau of the Taipei City Government held the third "Friendly Parenting Business Award" award ceremony on August 14. Fubon Financial Holdings and its subsidiaries performed well. In the "Outstanding Business Group", Fubon Financial Holdings and Fubon Life won the award for the third consecutive year, and Taipei Fubon Bank won the award for the second time. In addition, among the "Individual Outstanding Business Groups", Fubon Financial Holdings, Fubon Life Insurance and Taipei Fubon Bank were recognized respectively in the "Economic Support, Subsidy Measures", "Organizational Culture and Policies", and "Child Care and Parenting Support Network and Measures" projects, demonstrating Fubon Group's long-term concrete results in promoting a child-friendly workplace and supporting employees' family care needs.

title_en: House prices in Zhongzheng District, Bei City are approaching Da'an, with an annual increase of more than 10%. Scarcity of supply has become a driver of house prices.
summary_en: While the housing market has cooled down, Taipei City bucked the trend in the first half of this year, with Zhongzheng District leading the gains due to "scarce housing supply." In the first half of this year, the average residential house price in Zhongzheng District reached 1.192 million yuan per square meter, an increase of 10.7% from 1.077 million yuan in the same period last year. The increase ranked highest among the 12 administrative districts in the North City. The average house price closely followed the Daan District's 1.21 million yuan per square meter, and the price difference between the two districts was only 18,000 yuan.

title_en: Taiwan stocks fell 210 points on Friday, revealing 3 risks before opening
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have rebounded strongly this week. Although they failed to hold 46,000 points on Friday due to profit-taking, the three major legal entities have been overbuying for five consecutive days, and foreign capital has made strong efforts to cover the market. According to expert analysis, benefiting from the long-term trend of AI and the upward revision of corporate profits, the mid- to long-term performance of Taiwanese stocks is still promising. The index is expected to consolidate between 42,000 and 49,000 points in the third quarter. Investors are advised to adopt a stock-picking rather than a market-picking strategy, focusing on leading AI stocks and laying out technology groups such as power supply, cooling, PCB and advanced packaging equipment. Although the market still has short-term fluctuations, as financing is eliminated and chips are accumulated, subsequent long-term rotation opportunities are expected, and investors must still carefully assess risks when operating.

title_en: Next stop for sports! Take Sanying to enjoy 31 discounts at Sanxia and Yingge Sports Center
summary_en: Take the Sanying Line and go exercise at the next stop! The New Taipei MRT Sanying Line connects the living areas of Sanxia and Yingge, making sports and leisure along the line more convenient. The New Taipei City Sports Bureau has joined hands with the National Sports Center of Sanxia and Yingge to launch the second wave of "Ride Sanying" from now until August 31 The "Enjoy 31" discount event connects two sports centers with the MRT and offers four major discounts on fitness, courses, courts and sports equipment. It encourages people to take the MRT to exercise with their relatives and friends, and then visit the old streets, art galleries and surrounding attractions. A MRT trip extends into a Sanying healthy trip that combines sports, leisure and sightseeing.

summary_en: DeFi Technologies, a financial technology company, announced its second-quarter financial report. In an environment where the cryptocurrency market weakened and assets under management shrank, revenue dropped from US$13.1 million in the same period last year to US$7.8 million, and operating losses expanded from US$900,000 in the same period last year to US$2.3 million. Excluding realized and unrealized asset price changes, core operating income was $5.5 million, also down from $6.7 million in the same period last year.

title_en: Breaking the Myth of Landlord Rent Subsidy and Tax Increase
summary_en: Every August, just before colleges and universities start school, it is the peak rental season for students. Many tenants often encounter landlords who are unwilling to cooperate with the application or take advantage of the trend to increase the rent on the grounds that "application for rent subsidies will increase the tax burden." Hsinchu Mayor Gao Hongan said that this is actually a common misunderstanding. If the landlord rents the house to a tenant who is eligible for rent subsidies and is recognized as a "public lessor", not only will the tax burden not be increased, but he will be able to enjoy three tax benefits, including housing tax, land price tax and comprehensive income tax, which will help reduce the cost of housing ownership. Hsinchu Mayor Gao Hongan said on the 16th that creating a livable city where young people can "study, find a job, and raise a family with peace of mind" is an important goal of the city government team's continued efforts. In addition to cooperating with the central government in promoting rent subsidy policies to substantially reduce the financial burden on renters, the city government also actively uses tax incentives for "public lessors" to increase the willingness of homeowners to rent, so that young students, freshmen and renting families can rent, afford, and live with peace of mind, and jointly create a better rental environment. Mayor Gao Hongan explained that after the new 2.0 housing tax system is put into effect, it will be targeted at non-owner-occupiers...

title_en: Is this stock going to rush at the opening of the Taiwan stock market? Guo Zherong: God sends money
summary_en: Financial Center/Li Wenzhen reported that Taiwan stocks opened higher and lower last Friday (14th). They rose by more than 400 points in early trading and broke through the 46,000 mark strongly during the session. However, selling orders broke out in the late trading and the index fluctuated lower. The index fell by 210.47 points at the end, failing to hold on to the 46,000 point mark. As for the Taiwan stock market's "open high and then fall" on the last trading day last week, Moore Investment Consulting's chief investment officer Guo Zherong (Zhe Zhe), who just fulfilled his promise a few days ago and spent about 100 million yuan to buy 1,100 Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050), bluntly said on the 14th that "don't be alarmed." He believed that "last week was up every day, and it is normal to have a slight correction today." He also specifically mentioned Phison (8299) in the memory group. He bluntly said that Phison's sharp decline was "really a bit too unfair." He also threw out two key profits and believed that the current stock price retracement was actually "God gave us money to spend."

The eye-catching dividend payment has left investors in a tangle, and online forums have heated discussions. Some netizens are optimistic about the long-term trend of the technology industry and believe that it is still valuable to enter the market now; conservatives remind that they need to pay attention to the performance of interest filling after ex-dividend and the risk that the current stock price is at a relatively high level. Experts suggest that if investors cannot withstand short-term fluctuations, they can observe the market trend after ex-dividend before making plans. The last purchase day is August 17, and dividends are expected to be recorded on September 11. Investors should carefully evaluate risks and rewards and allocate assets rationally.

title_en: With an annual salary of 1.36 million, "losing money on the stock market by saving money", get out 20 million! 42-year-old man regrets instantly after seeing this scene
summary_en: Sakamoto, a 42-year-old IT office worker in Japan, has accumulated as much as 120 million yen in assets through extreme frugality and long-term index investment. However, when he witnessed the sudden death of his manager who lived alone due to illness and did not enjoy his savings during his lifetime, he was deeply shocked and realized that life should not just be about the accumulation of numbers. This incident made him re-examine his view of money and began to learn to "spend money" to improve his quality of life, including moving to a comfortable new home and choosing high-quality ingredients. Sakamoto emphasized that work is not only about receiving a salary, but also the key to connecting with society to avoid the same fate of dying alone.

title_en: The low-pressure belt will still have more moisture and there will be heavy thunderstorms in the afternoon. Wu Derong: The rainfall will be more obvious starting from Friday.
summary_en: Bring an umbrella when going out. Wu Derong, adjunct associate professor of the Department of Atmospheric Science of National Central University, published a column in the "Treasure Classroom" of the "Meteorological Application Promotion Foundation" today (http://www.metapp.org.tw/index.php/bossweathernews/3941-2026-08-15 -20-51-19) pointed out that from today to Thursday, the monsoon circulation weakens and moves westward, and the area near Taiwan is transformed into a low-pressure belt. There is still a lot of water vapor, and the "atmospheric instability" pattern continues. There are occasional local rainfalls in various places, and strong convection often develops in the afternoon. From Friday to next Sunday (21st to 23rd), the low-pressure belt moves northward through Taiwan, and the rainfall becomes more obvious.

title_en: The low-pressure belt takes over, causing the rainfall to become heavier. Fanzhuan: 2 Tropical Disturbance is about to happen.
summary_en: The weather is unstable, so you still need to bring an umbrella when you go out. Weather expert "Teacher Lin Weather Station" pointed out today that starting from Monday (17th), the low-pressure belt will begin to take over, and Taiwan's weather will become more unstable. In addition to the windward area moving from the current south of the central part to the eastern half, there will not only be rainfall, but the chance of brief thundershowers in the afternoon will increase in some areas, and the rainfall will also be more significant than last week. We should also pay attention to the trend of tropical disturbances in the South China Sea and the waters east of the Philippine Islands that are ready to move and develop in the second half of the week.

title_en: The most powerful thing about Chinese Valentine's Day is not worshiping the moon! Folklore experts reveal the truth: ask for help from heaven and take action from yourself
summary_en: Chinese Valentine's Day is often regarded as Valentine's Day in modern times. Numerologist Ke Baicheng pointed out that the traditional meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day is "begging for skill." The ancients not only prayed for marriage, but also hoped to increase wisdom, skills and the ability to manage life. He believes that the spirit of Chinese Valentine's Day that is truly worthy of continuation by modern people can be condensed into three words: "coincidence, fate, and blessing."

title_en: Sleeping pills don’t just stop right away! Avoid triggering epilepsy: Here's what doctors warn you to do
summary_en: Many people rely on sleeping pills for a long time to help them sleep due to insomnia, and then stop taking them. Doctors remind that not only can they not fall asleep easily, but anxiety, tremors, and heart palpitations may ensue. In severe cases, epilepsy may even occur. It is recommended that the latest international guidelines call for a gradual reduction in dosage.

title_en: Xinxin.com’s consolidated revenue reaches new high
summary_en: Fully integrated e-commerce operation service provider - Xinxin.com (2949) consolidated revenue reached NT$3.165 billion, an annual increase of 23.15%, a record high for the same period last year; operating gross profit was 385 million yuan, an annual increase of 22.96%, gross profit margin was 12.17%, operating profit was NT$73 million, net profit after tax was NT$54 million, and EPS was NT$1.68, all equivalent to the same period last year. At the same time, the company’s revenue in July was 534 million yuan, an annual increase of 33.10%, maintaining double-digit growth. Xinxin.com pointed out that in the past, with the rapid expansion of service brands and business scale, the company had to simultaneously increase operating manpower, warehousing space and logistics capacity. Therefore, the increase in related costs caused by early investment usually caused a decline in operating profits in the first half of the year. It is worth noting that while revenue has grown rapidly this year, the number of Xinxin Online employees has not increased in the first half of the year, and the per capita revenue output value has simultaneously increased by more than 20%. title_en: Attention 440,000 shareholders! SinoPac Capital Increases Capital to 640 Million Shares, Tentative Price "23% off Market Value" Super Affordable
summary_en: SinoPac Financial Holdings has recently formally submitted documents for a cash capital increase, and is expected to issue 640 million shares. The funds raised will be used to invest in subsidiaries, repay debts, and optimize the financial structure. The procurement and application process for this capital increase is expected to take effect on August 28 if the procedures go smoothly. The reference issuance price is tentatively set at 31.25 yuan per share, which is a discount of approximately 73% compared to the closing price of 40.55 yuan on the 14th. The final pricing will be determined with the authorization of the chairman after it becomes effective. According to the plan, 80% of the shares issued this time will be subscribed by original shareholders, and employee subscriptions and public sales will each account for 10%. This move demonstrates SinoPac's determination to strengthen its capital resilience. The market is highly concerned about the subsequent capital market performance and the impact of equity dilution. Investors should continue to pay attention to relevant announcements.

title_en: The water outage in Taoyuan prompted the use of force to desilt the Amping Tunnel to help the Shimen Reservoir freeze for 10 years
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Xie Yixuan, Taoyuan, 16th) As soon as the huge arc-shaped gate opened, a large amount of silt and turbid water immediately vented down, going straight to Dahan River. In mid-August, Typhoon White Dolphin brought violent storms to northern Taiwan, but it also created a good opportunity for reservoir desilting. The rolling yellow water carried a large amount of sediment and rushed into the Amping anti-siltation tunnel and rushed to the downstream river. This prevented the precious reservoir capacity from being "eaten up" by the silt, allowing the Shimen Reservoir, which has stood for more than a month, to extend its service life.

title_en: Break the myth about landlords’ “rent subsidy and tax increase”! Mayor Gao Hongan: Become a public lessor and enjoy three tax benefits
summary_en: Every August, just before colleges and universities start school, it is the peak rental season for students. Many tenants often encounter landlords who are unwilling to cooperate with the application or take advantage of the trend to increase the rent on the grounds that "application for rent subsidies will increase the tax burden." Hsinchu Mayor Gao Hongan said that this is actually a common misunderstanding. If the landlord rents the house to a tenant who is eligible for rent subsidies and is recognized as a "public lessor", not only will the tax burden not be increased, but he will be able to enjoy three tax benefits, including housing tax, land price tax and comprehensive income tax, which will help reduce the cost of housing ownership. Hsinchu Mayor Gao Hongan said on the 16th that creating a livable city where young people can "study, find a job, and raise a family with peace of mind" is an important goal of the city government team's continued efforts. In addition to cooperating with the central government in promoting rent subsidy policies to substantially reduce the financial burden on renters, the city government also actively uses tax incentives for "public lessors" to increase the willingness of homeowners to rent, so that young students, freshmen and renting families can rent, afford, and live with peace of mind, and jointly create a better rental environment. Mayor Gao Hongan explained that after the new 2:00 housing tax system is put into effect, it will be targeted at non-owner-occupiers...

title_en: Chinese cargo ship sails to Europe via the Arctic Ocean, Arctic route begins regular sailing in summer
summary_en: (Central News Agency, Taipei, 16th) China has coveted Arctic resources in recent years, including opening up Arctic sea routes between China and Europe. Official media reported that a Chinese container ship left Zhoushan Port in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province at about 7 o'clock last night and will sail to the United Kingdom via the Arctic route, which is currently in a state of melting ice. It is the beginning of normalization of Arctic summer shipping. The voyage will only take 20 days, half of the 40-day voyage via the Suez Canal.

title_en: TSMC’s stock price soared 80% in one year. “Can I still buy it?” Foreign media analysis gave the answer
summary_en: Thanks to strong global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) chips, TSMC's stock price has soared nearly 80% in the past year, and its market value has exceeded the US$2 trillion mark. Although the market is worried that the craze may have peaked, foreign media "Motley Fool" analyzed that TSMC's second-quarter net profit increased by as much as 77.4% year-on-year, demonstrating strong operating strength. In addition to the AI ​​field, TSMC has also joined hands with Sony to lay out next-generation image sensors, which are expected to be mass-produced in 2029 to expand physical AI applications. Experts believe that although TSMC's stock price is no longer at a low point, considering its future growth potential, for long-term investors, the stock still has the value of buying and holding, and it is a high-quality target worthy of continued attention in the semiconductor industry.

title_en: Trump takes action in China with "100% of the most intense lessons in one item"! The contrast in Taiwan is only 15%...the transfer business opportunity is here
summary_en: Financial Center/Comprehensive Report U.S. President Trump has once again imposed heavy tariffs on imported products, this time targeting the drone industry! The Trump administration announced that it would impose tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and related components, hoping to reduce the United States' dependence on overseas supply chains and strengthen the local drone industry. Although it did not mention that this decision was directed at "China," it was still considered by the outside world to be a decision to decouple from China. In addition, Taiwan, Japan and other countries have reached trade agreements with the United States. If the hardware and technology source conditions are met, a 15% tariff can be applied, which is a full 85 percentage points less than the maximum 100% tax rate. As the U.S.-China drone supply chain accelerates the diversion, Taiwan is also expected to usher in potential transfer business opportunities.

summary_en: Financial Center/Chen Yanlin Chen Yulin Taipei reported that whenever there is a power outage, Taipower will send emergency personnel to repair it. They even take advantage of the loopholes of the supervision office and use the supervision office to remove 3.5 tons or less. A small truck was disguised as a "Taipower Engineering Vehicle" and wandered around the Shuangbei area. It was kicked by the public. It was a habitual offender and a dangerous driver. It drove very fast and honked the horn randomly. Now Taipower has confirmed that this vehicle is not owned by Taipower and will notify the police department for investigation.

title_en: Breaking the myth of landlords "renting subsidy and tax increase", public welfare lessors can enjoy 3 tax discounts
summary_en: Every August, just before colleges and universities start school, it is the peak rental season for students. Many tenants often encounter landlords who are unwilling to cooperate with the application or raise rents on the grounds that "applying for rent subsidies will increase their tax burden." Hsinchu Mayor Gao Hongan said that this is actually a common misunderstanding. If the landlord rents the house to a tenant who is eligible for rent subsidies and is recognized as a "public lessor", not only will the tax burden not be increased, but he will be able to enjoy three tax benefits, including housing tax, land price tax and comprehensive income tax.

summary_en: Yageo (2327), the leader in passive components, surged past the daily limit last Thursday (13th). It ended up plunging 6.04% to close at 622 yuan, dragging down Huaxinke (2492) and He Shentang (3026). summary_en: The Taiwan stock market fluctuated violently in July, and the amount of regular fixed deductions for ETFs and mutual funds in July showed a monthly decrease. Interestingly, according to statistics from the Investment Trust and Investment Consultants Association, the Taiwan Personal Investment Savings Account (TISA) level unexpectedly hit a high, with a total deduction amount of more than 1.09 billion yuan. Some people have zero income and the highest level of insurance, and some people have the lowest level of insurance if they earn more than one million. "The consequences may not only be confiscation of premiums." The worst thing is that even this life-saving benefit is completely gone.
summary_en: The latest report of the Audit Department revealed the chaos of labor insurance application by professional unions. It is estimated that as many as 17,000 people in Taiwan have "zero income" throughout the year and are classified as dependent relatives, but they apply for insurance at the highest level of labor insurance of NT$45,800. The Bureau of Labor Insurance has confirmed that it is improving the inspection and screening mechanism; experts remind that to apply for insurance in professional unions, you must meet the two major conditions of having actual work facts and joining the relevant industry union, so as not to affect future claims for rights.

title_en: Cutting through rocks to save lives, a tunnel of more than 3 kilometers has left Shimen Reservoir frozen for 10 years
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Xie Yixuan, Taoyuan, 16th) As soon as the huge arc-shaped gate opened, a large amount of silt and turbid water immediately vented down, going straight to Dahan River. In mid-August, Typhoon White Dolphin brought violent storms to northern Taiwan, but it also created a good opportunity for reservoir desilting. The rolling yellow water carried a large amount of sediment and rushed into the Amping anti-siltation tunnel and rushed to the downstream river. This prevented the precious reservoir capacity from being "eaten up" by the silt, allowing the Shimen Reservoir, which has stood for more than a month, to extend its service life.

title: 年薪3千萬的執行長，比準時回家吃晚飯的人幸福嗎？研究揭露：收入超過「這數字」後，多賺未必更快樂
summary: 沒有人說成為千萬富翁很簡單，必須付出代價。對大多數人來說，代價就是你投入職涯的時間。每天認真工作、日積月累，成為千萬富翁的機會就愈大。但到某個時間點，我們都必須想清楚：多少才夠？一年要賺多少，才能達成你的目標？每個人的答案都不一樣，因為每個人的欲望和生活成本不同。 我的薪資經歷從麥當勞時薪4美元（編按：約新台幣129元，以下幣值同），到後來自己創業，跨度不小。 但我深信，幸福感來自家人、朋友、健康和人生目標，而不是財富多寡。當你賺到足以支付基本生活開銷的收入之後，讓你持續快樂的是好的人際關係、健康的身體和清楚的目標，不是更多的錢。

title_en: Is a CEO with an annual salary of 30 million happier than someone who gets home on time for dinner? Research reveals: After your income exceeds "this number", earning more may not necessarily make you happier
summary_en: No one said becoming a multi-millionaire was easy, you have to pay the price. For most people, the price is the time you put into your career. The more you work hard every day and accumulate over time, the greater your chances of becoming a multi-millionaire. But at some point, we all have to figure out: How much is enough? How much do you need to earn in a year to achieve your goals? The answer is different for everyone because everyone's desires and cost of living are different. My salary experience ranges from being paid 4 US dollars an hour at McDonald's (Editor's note: about NT$129, the following currency values ​​are the same) to starting my own business, which is quite a span. But I firmly believe that happiness comes from family, friends, health and life goals, not wealth. title_en: Japan’s GDP in the second quarter is estimated to increase by 2.1%; wage consumption and AI investment support continued economic expansion
summary_en: Japan's Cabinet Office will announce the initial value of gross domestic product (GDP) for the second quarter of this year (April to June) on August 17. Jiji News Agency quoted the average forecast of 10 private think tanks and pointed out that the real GDP in the second quarter will increase at an annual rate of 2.1%, which is the third consecutive quarter of expansion. The market expects that the Japanese economy will maintain a moderate recovery, driven by continued wage increases, a rebound in private consumption, and the resilience of corporate investment, and its growth performance may be better than some markets originally expected.

title_en: Can’t AI optical transmission wait? CPO Xuexuetai Factory 14th gear
summary_en: AI data centers have driven an explosion in demand for high-speed transmission, and the optical communications industry has ushered in a wave of upgrades. As 800G moves towards 1.6T high-speed transmission, silicon photonics and co-packaged optics (CPO) technology have become key. Lumentum also expects that the demand for CPO laser chips will increase from 2027, and the commercialization schedule will become increasingly clear. As the demand for AI computing power continues to rise, optical connections have become the mainstream of data centers, driving strong performance in Taiwanese supply chain operations such as Zhibang, Lianjun, New, Lianya, and Guangsheng. The market's future performance has attracted great attention from the market. Investors can continue to pay attention to the investment opportunities brought about by the long-term growth trend of the industry and related technology upgrades.

In the evening, the Executive Yuan pointed out that there were seven irrational deletions and freezes in the general budget. "Every budget you pass has been used frugally by the government." He passed it as early as possible to keep advanced medical equipment and outstanding medical talents in the central region. summary_en: Taiwan's high-speed rail has been in operation for 20 years, and the current fare is the same as the fare when it opened. After the first set of new-generation trains arrived in Taiwan, Chairman Shi Zhe also requested orders from the Ministry of Transportation on the spot. Transportation Minister Chen Shikai issued a three-year promise as a prerequisite for a fare increase. It is understood that the high-speed rail is expected to propose a fare "adjustment" plan after the first set of new trains go online on July 1 next year. It will not only increase prices, but also include diversification and flexibility of ticket types. The new fares will be implemented as soon as September 2028.

summary_en: Minister of Culture Li Yuan attended the press conference of Taipei Mayoral Candidate Shen Boyang of the Democratic Progressive Party in the afternoon. Before the meeting, he was interviewed about the central government's general budget that was read out by the Legislative Yuan yesterday. About 1 billion yuan was cut from the Ministry of Culture and 386 million yuan was frozen. He said that it was very sad because it reminded him of a saying, "If you want to destroy a country, destroy its history first; if you want to destroy a clan, destroy its culture first; if you want to silence a person, delete media publicity expenses first."

summary_en: President Lai Ching-te went to Taichung this afternoon to attend the 52nd National Annual Conference of the International Kiwanis Association of Taiwan and delivered a speech. The General Accounting Office estimated yesterday that Taiwan’s economic growth rate this year will exceed 11%. To achieve economic progress, national stability is very important. The Legislative Yuan should become a force that stabilizes the country’s progress and development. However, this year’s general budget was only passed yesterday. summary_en: Taiwan's first high-speed rail new-generation train "N700ST" has withstood the test of Typhoon White Dolphin and Southwest Air Current, and traveled across the ocean for more than three days. Chairman Shi Zhe lamented that when new cars arrived in Hong Kong 22 years ago, society said they were "scrap iron" when questioned, but now they are the focus of society's attention. summary_en: Liver cancer ranks second among the top 10 cancers in my country. Driven by viral hepatitis prevention and treatment policies, my country has reached the United Nations goal of eliminating hepatitis C and continues to promote the prevention and treatment of hepatitis B. The Academic Foundation for the Prevention and Treatment of Liver Disease continues to organize the "National Abdominal Ultrasound Project" to encourage the public to undergo abdominal ultrasound examination to detect liver disease. Yu Zhongren, director of National Taiwan University Hospital, mentioned at the foundation's 32nd anniversary event today that viral hepatitis is gradually declining and the public should pay attention to steatohepatitis. Slimming injections for weight loss have been approved for severe fatty liver disease abroad, and my country's health insurance benefits should also be included as soon as possible.

The main reason is that the Accountant General Office predicts that this year's economic growth rate will be maintained at a high level of 9.64%. It also predicts that government tax and non-tax revenue will reach 3.8 trillion this year. Therefore, next year's budget can increase significantly without increasing the deficit. Although various overall economic indicators have been booming recently, many scholars have also pointed out some hidden problems behind it, including uneven industrial development and widening differences in wage distribution.

summary: 台股近期在AI族群帶動下重新站回4.5萬點，然而，市場對AI資本支出擴張、企業現金流承壓及融資風險的疑慮卻尚未完全消退。面對AI投資是否能順利轉化為營收與獲利，以及是否能帶動台股下半年進一步再創新高，本國銀行認為，在科技巨頭的自由現金流承壓、融資槓桿去化風險未除，以及各國央行利率政策的不確定性之下，短期內科技股估值增長空間有限，但仍看好中長期股市向上。

title_en: Concerns about the expansion of AI capital expenditures in Taiwan’s stock market remain. Can it hit another high in the second half of the year?
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have recently regained 45,000 points, driven by the AI ​​community. However, the market's concerns about the expansion of AI capital expenditures, corporate cash flow pressure, and financing risks have not yet completely subsided. Faced with whether AI investment can be smoothly converted into revenue and profits, and whether it can drive Taiwan stocks to further hit new highs in the second half of the year, local banks believe that with the free cash flow of technology giants under pressure, the risk of de-leveraging of financing, and the uncertainty of interest rate policies of central banks, there is limited room for growth in the valuation of technology stocks in the short term, but they are still optimistic about the stock market in the medium and long term.

summary: 英特爾執行長陳立武近日受訪坦言，公司曾錯過行動網路、雲端及AI浪潮，未來將不再缺席。陳立武堅持垂直整合模式，強調AI時代競爭已非單看GPU，CPU的運算、資料傳輸與封裝技術同樣關鍵。此外，英特爾正研發新型存儲架構，並延攬SK海力士前執行長李錫熙，意圖透過CPU、儲存、封裝與製造的系統化整合，打造全新技術優勢。陳立武引入「謙遜、傾聽、回應」管理哲學，目標帶領英特爾重拾產業核心地位，積極布局下一波科技浪潮，展現重返榮耀的決心。

title_en: Returning to the memory market? Chen Liwu said: Intel will not miss the fourth wave
summary_en: Intel CEO Chen Liwu admitted in a recent interview that the company had missed the wave of mobile networks, cloud and AI, and would no longer be absent in the future. Chen Liwu adheres to the vertical integration model and emphasizes that competition in the AI ​​​​era is no longer just based on GPUs. CPU computing, data transmission and packaging technology are also critical. In addition, Intel is developing a new storage architecture and has recruited former SK Hynix CEO Lee Seok-hee, aiming to create new technological advantages through the systematic integration of CPU, storage, packaging and manufacturing. Chen Liwu introduced the management philosophy of "humility, listening, and response" with the goal of leading Intel to regain its core position in the industry, actively deploying the next wave of technology, and demonstrating its determination to return to glory.

title: 退休夫妻移居鄉下圓夢！遇無邊界感鄰居　體會「適度冷漠」才是真自由
summary: 一對65歲退休夫婦賣掉東京公寓，帶著千萬存款移居大分縣山區圓夢，卻因鄉村過度熱情的鄰里互動感到壓力，妻子更陷入孤獨，最終決定搬回東京。此次移居代價高昂，房屋修繕、購車與搬家總支出逾1500萬日圓，存款大幅縮水。這段經歷提醒民眾，退休移居鄉村不僅需財務規劃，更要評估個人對人際關係的心理適應力，唯有親身體驗才能釐清適合的生活樣態，重新體會都會區適度人際冷漠的自在與重要性。

title_en: Retired couple moves to the countryside to fulfill their dream! Meeting neighbors with no sense of boundaries and experiencing "moderate indifference" is true freedom
summary_en: A 65-year-old retired couple sold their Tokyo apartment and moved to the mountains of Oita Prefecture with tens of millions of savings to realize their dream. However, they felt pressured by the overly enthusiastic neighbor interactions in the countryside, and the wife fell into loneliness, and finally decided to move back to Tokyo. The move was costly. The total expenditure on house repairs, car purchases and moving exceeded 15 million yen, and the savings were significantly reduced. This experience reminds the public that retiring and moving to the countryside requires not only financial planning, but also an assessment of one's psychological adaptability to interpersonal relationships. Only personal experience can clarify a suitable lifestyle and re-understand the comfort and importance of moderate interpersonal indifference in urban areas.

title_en: "You are not suitable to be a manager" The supervisor was publicly humiliated by his subordinates. Experts reveal the truth about the workplace: This is the most fatal point
summary_en: Workplace bullying is not limited to superiors versus subordinates. There have been recent cases of supervisors being verbally humiliated by subordinates. The 47-year-old manager Kitano was subjected to long-term verbal attacks just because he corrected his subordinates' mistakes. As a result, he suffered severe physical and mental injuries, lost 13 kilograms in two weeks, and was eventually forced to resign. A survey by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare shows that power harassment inquiries top the list, and more than 70% of companies report that the difficulty of managing subordinates has not improved. Experts warn that if companies excessively adopt sex-friendly management and lack clear communication and boundary standards, the workplace will become a place for emotional venting. They call on companies to establish specific codes of conduct to maintain workplace integrity and employee mental health and prevent the loss of outstanding talents due to bullying.

title_en: Anthropic overtakes SpaceX? It is rumored that the listing in October will challenge the valuation of 2 trillion yuan. Experts pour cold water: It will be difficult
summary_en: Anthropic, a new AI startup, is rumored to launch an IPO as soon as October. The market is optimistic about its astonishing annualized revenue growth, and its valuation is even speculated to be as high as US$2 trillion. It may surpass SpaceX and become the largest IPO in history. However, financial expert Block Tao pointed out that Anthropic still faces multiple difficulties if it wants to challenge SpaceX’s high valuation. In addition to facing fierce competition from powerful enemies such as OpenAI and Google, AI industry model price cuts and API price wars have also compressed profit margins, and huge computing power costs will affect long-term gross profits. SpaceX has a deep moat of physical assets and satellite networks. It is still unclear whether Anthropic can support a 20-fold stock price-to-revenue ratio with only software and AI model services. The market reaction to this IPO will be key, and investors need to carefully assess the valuation premium risks of the AI ​​industry.

title_en: High-speed rail fares have not been adjusted in 20 years Shi Zhe: A review will be carried out after the first new train goes online on July 1 next year
summary_en: Taiwan’s high-speed rail fleet has ushered in a new generation of trains for the first time in 22 years. The first set of 12 N700ST trains purchased from Japan by Taiwan High-Speed ​​Rail (2633) officially arrived at Kaohsiung Port on the 15th. Shi Zhe, chairman of Taiwan High-Speed ​​Rail, said that with the successful introduction of new cars and the improvement of ride quality, the high-speed rail will review the fares that have not been adjusted in 20 years after the new cars go on the road on July 1 next year. In addition, the arrival of new cars also means that high-speed rail has entered a new stage. In the future, it will face three major challenges: parallel operation of two models, financial sustainability and deepening of "High-speed Rail 2.0".

title_en: Port Company was recognized by HR Asia with double awards as the Best Employer for four consecutive years and won the Technology Empowerment Award for the first time.
summary_en: The 2026 awards list of the Asian human resources publication "HR Asia" has been announced. Taiwan Port Company has won double awards this year. It not only won the "HR Asia Best Companies To Work For In Asia" for the fourth consecutive year, but also won the "Tech Empowerment Awards" for the first time. Talent sustainability and digital transformation achievements were both recognized. The award ceremony was held on the 14th. Zhou Yonghui, chairman of the Port Company, received the Asia's Best Corporate Employer Award on behalf of the company, while Su Jianrong, general manager of the Keelung Branch, received the Technology Empowerment Award on behalf of the company.

title_en: Foreign investors buy five in a row! Buying exceeded 206.1 billion yuan this week. Foreign investors bought and sold more than 10 yuan this week. Take a look at the top 10
summary_en: Taiwan stocks performed strongly this week, rising 1,585 points in a single week. Although the market fluctuated and fell on the 14th, foreign investors still continued to make efforts. Statistics show that the three major legal persons' overbuying amounted to 264.53 billion yuan this week, of which foreign investment amounted to 260.13 billion yuan. Observing the chips of individual stocks, foreign investors are actively buying more than 310,000 chips of Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Memory groups and large-scale manufacturing leaders such as Huaxin and Sinosteel are favored; on the other hand, China Airlines and financial stocks have been subject to withdrawal regulations. Currently, the Taiwan stock market is focusing on the mainstream status of AI and memory, and is also observing whether funds will spread to traditional manufacturing. As the market challenges the 46,000-point mark, the subsequent buying momentum of foreign investors and the rotation of stocks will become important key indicators for the market to challenge historical highs.

title_en: Net asked Ruan Muhua to talk about "Will the Taiwan stock market rise or fall?" I responded
summary_en: The latest economic data in the United States are weak, with retail sales falling 0.6% month-on-month, the largest decline in recent times, and an unexpected decrease in non-farm employment, indicating a weakening consumer and labor market. Senior financial media person Ruan Mu Hua warned that if prices cannot fall simultaneously, there may be a risk of "stagnant inflation." When netizens asked about the market outlook for Taiwan stocks, Ruan Muhua humorously responded that he did not have a crystal ball, emphasizing that general economic data may not be directly related to the short- and medium-term trends of the stock market. Investors should formulate clear strategies and carefully assess risks, and do not blindly predict the market. Investment decisions still need to be responsible for their own results.

title_en: The listed company's profit last quarter exceeded 2 trillion, and the drone project passed the test. Five major financial events you must know this week
summary_en: The after-tax net income of listed companies in the second quarter crossed the 2 trillion yuan mark for the first time. The unmanned vehicle budget totaling 63.4 billion yuan was fully approved on the 14th. In addition, MSCI announced the results of quarterly adjustments, and the weight of Taiwanese stocks in MSCI's three indexes increased across the board. The following are the five most important financial news worth reviewing this week: 1. The profit of listed companies in the second quarter exceeded 2 trillion yuan 175 EPS hit highs. The second quarter financial reports of listed companies were released. Thanks to factors such as the explosion of AI business opportunities and Taiwan's stock market reaching new highs, the overall after-tax net income in a single quarter exceeded the 2 trillion yuan mark for the first time, climbing to 2.0 8 trillion yuan, a quarterly increase of 33.25%, an annual increase of 172.01%, a new high; the net profit after tax in the first half of the year was 3.65 trillion yuan, crossing the 3 trillion yuan mark, an annual increase of 116.85%, setting a new high for the same period in the past. In terms of profit in the second quarter, TSMC (2330) ranked first with 706.561 billion yuan, followed by Hon Hai (2317) with 59.973 billion yuan, Nanya (2408) with 50.192 billion yuan, UMC (2303) with 42.259 billion yuan, and Quanta (2382) with 28.651 billion yuan. Among them, the single-quarter profits of TSMC, Nanya, UMC, and Quanta not only set a new record high for the same period in history, but also reached a new single-quarter record high. Looking forward to the whole year, based on the opinions of two experts, corporate profits for the whole year have a chance to reach the 7 trillion yuan mark. In particular, technology stocks are expected to have significant profit growth driven by strong demand for AI and the price increases of various components. 2. title_en: Jen-Hsun Huang was named Best CEO! 99% of employees praise him as a rock star. Huida ranks among the top 3 choices in the workplace.
summary_en: Glassdoor, a world-renowned job search platform, announced the list of the "Top 50 Best CEOs" in 2026. Huida CEO Huang Renxun won the title with a high employee praise rate of 99%. His forward-looking vision and leadership charisma were highly recognized. Despite the overall downward trend in workplace satisfaction, Huang has still managed to unite employees and is known as a rock star in the technology industry. In addition, Huida also jumped to third place in the "Best Workplaces" ranking, surpassing technology giants such as Google and Apple. This selection shows that at a time when the AI ​​industry is undergoing drastic changes, having a clear sense of direction and establishing a high degree of trust among employees have become core key indicators for companies to maintain market competitiveness and attract top talents. It has also made Huida the first choice in the workplace for global technology talents.

title_en: Is there a U.S. economic warning? Ruan Muhua's "7-word warning": Be careful of this risk
summary_en: The U.S. economic alarm bell has sounded. Senior financial media person Ruan Muhua pointed out that due to the sharp decline in retail sales in July and the weakening job market, the market has become cautious about the resilience of consumption in the second half of the year. Data showed that retail sales fell by 0.6% month-on-month in July, the largest decline in recent times, and non-farm employment performance was lower than expected. In addition, the U.S. household savings rate fell to a four-year low of 2.7%, reflecting constraints on spending power. Ruan Muhua warned that despite the support provided by the AI ​​industry, if consumption and employment continue to decline and prices remain high, the United States may face severe risks of "stagnant inflation."

title: 房市只剩兩種人？富人買豪宅、首購擠16坪　最慘是「不上不下」換屋族
summary: 經過一年多信用管制與交易量收縮，2026年房市沒有全面崩盤，反而出現更明顯的分化。一邊是高資產族照樣買核心區、品牌宅、大坪數產品；另一邊是首購族為了壓低總價，只能把坪數越買越小。真正卡在中間的，反而是想從兩房換三房、老公寓換電梯宅的一般換屋家庭。
title_zh: 房市只剩兩種人？富人買豪宅、首購擠16坪　最慘是「不上不下」換屋族
summary_zh: 經過一年多信用管制與交易量收縮，2026年房市沒有全面崩盤，反而出現更明顯的分化。一邊是高資產族照樣買核心區、品牌宅、大坪數產品；另一邊是首購族為了壓低總價，只能把坪數越買越小。真正卡在中間的，反而是想從兩房換三房、老公寓換電梯宅的一般換屋家庭。
title_en: Are there only two types of people left in the housing market? Rich people buy luxury houses and squeeze out 16 square meters for their first purchase. The worst situation is for those who are "neither upgrading nor downgrading".
summary_en: After more than a year of credit control and shrinking transaction volume, the housing market will not completely collapse in 2026, but will instead see more obvious differentiation. On one side are the high-net-worth individuals who still buy core areas, branded residences, and products with large square footage; on the other side are the first-time buyers who can only buy smaller and smaller square footage in order to keep the total price down. Those who are really stuck in the middle are ordinary families who want to upgrade their homes from two-bedroom apartments to three-bedroom apartments, or from old apartments to apartments with elevators.

The Association for Foreign Trade released the first round of the "APEC Economic and Trade Index" for 2026. Enterprises' attention to operating cost risks has increased significantly, ranking first among various risk indicators. title_en: Peach City links international resources to assist new ventures
summary_en: Taoyuan Mayor Zhang Shanzheng presided over the municipal meeting and listened to the special report "Taoyuan Industrial Re-Upgrading: Transformation, R&D, and New Business Opportunities" by the Economic Development Bureau. He said that in addition to technology and R&D strength, gaining recognition from the international market and funding is also key to the development of new innovations. In recent years, the city government has been actively linking up international new startups and venture capital sources, and has successfully secured the entry of the world-renowned startup accelerator PLUGANDPLAY into the Hutoushan Innovation Park. title: 國合會30周年新書發表 林佳龍：寫下台灣走向世界的故事
summary: 外交部長林佳龍14日出席《國合30共創新局》新書發表會並表示，國合會自1996年成立至今已屆30周年，30年來承接一項又一項海外援助與國際合作計畫，用一雙雙溫暖的手，讓台灣緊緊擁抱世界。從加勒比海的海地、非洲的史瓦帝尼，到太平洋上的吐瓦魯，都留下台灣努力的足跡與汗水。他指出，《國合30共創新局》寫的不只是國合會的故事，也是台灣人胼手胝足走向世界的故事。

title_en: New book released on CCICED’s 30th anniversary: ​​Lin Jialong: Writing the story of Taiwan’s journey to the world
summary_en: On the 14th, Foreign Minister Lin Jialong attended the launch of the new book "Cooperation in 30 Years" and said that the Council for Economic Cooperation and Development has celebrated its 30th anniversary since its establishment in 1996. Over the past 30 years, it has undertaken one overseas aid and international cooperation project after another, and has allowed Taiwan to embrace the world with warm hands. From Haiti in the Caribbean, Eswatini in Africa, to Tuvalu in the Pacific, Taiwan’s footprints and sweat have been left behind. He pointed out that "China Council 30 Innovations" tells not only the story of China Council, but also the story of Taiwanese people going global.

title_en: Is food delivery inflation coming? Who will pay the cost after the special method is put on the road?
summary_en: New changes in food delivery 2 (Central News Agency reporter Jiang Mingyan, Taipei, 15th) When you open the food delivery app, the familiar meals are still there, but the membership fees and service fees have become more expensive, the waiting time seems to be longer, and the meal prices may also quietly change. After the special delivery method is launched, the labor protection of delivery workers will be more complete, but the new operating costs will inevitably be redistributed among the platform, stores, and consumers. Experts worry that in the oligopoly-structured food delivery market, consumers must be forced to foot the bill, which could lead to a situation of "delivery inflation" coming true.

title_en: When the unit price increases, the number of delivery people increases. The impact of supply and demand transformation in a four-party game
summary_en: New changes in food delivery 1 (Central News Agency reporter Jiang Mingyan, Taipei, 15th) The "delivery special law" has been on the road for two weeks. New guarantees such as a 45 yuan minimum guarantee and 1.25 times the basic hourly wage have taken a step forward for the rights and interests of delivery workers, but it seems to have affected chain effects such as an increase in the number of delivery workers, a decrease in the average number of orders, and an increase in platform costs. Industry insiders analyze that "the cake has not become significantly bigger, but more people are sharing it," which shows that the food delivery industry is facing a new supply and demand change.

title_en: Supermarkets seize 100 billion handheld drinks business opportunity! 7-ELEVEN expands product line layout, FamilyMart spends 250 million to expand front line
summary_en: Supermarkets are seizing the 100-billion-yuan hand-crank beverage business opportunity, and tea drinks have become the focus of the next wave of ready-made beverages. 7-ELEVEN’s Double Tea brand has launched 7 new and returning items since August 19, continuing to expand its tea product line; FamilyMart (5903) has been in the tea business for more than ten years and has invested more than 250 million yuan in upgrading production lines and equipment. Last year, the annual sales volume of the entire Let’s Tea series exceeded 10 million cups. Supermarket tea drinks have gradually transformed from a supporting role in the past to an important battlefield for ready-made drinks. As supermarkets take advantage of their 24-hour operation and high-density locations to continue to increase their presence, the competition in the handheld beverage market has become even more intense.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Dai Yazhen, Tokyo, 15th) The Bank of Japan may raise interest rates again in the autumn, and financial market expectations are rising. After the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan started buying yen at the end of July, the United States also rarely intervened. The two countries once again joined forces to prevent the depreciation of the yen after 28 years. With exchange rate intervention temporarily suppressing yen shorts, the market focus is shifting from "when will the government intervene again" to "when will the Bank of Japan raise interest rates?"

title_en: After the poisonous oil incident, the sales of imported oil products on shopping websites increased by more than 70% year-on-year, becoming Pudu’s new favorite for stocking up.
summary_en: Soybean salad oil was found to exceed the standard for benzene and pyrene. During the peak purchasing period of Zhongyuan Purdue, Yahoo Shopping announced the "2026 Zhongyuan Desktop Best Sellers" and found that due to recent food safety issues, the performance of imported oil products has increased by as much as more than 70% year-on-year. Olive oil, avocado oil, etc. have become This year's new darling of Pudu stockings, the Mid-Autumn Festival gift-giving period organized by Shin Kong Mitsukoshi has also started. In addition to launching more than 255 Mid-Autumn gift boxes, pastries such as egg yolk cakes are selling well. Due to the oil incident, consumers pay attention to food safety issues, and the sales volume of imported oil products has more than doubled.

title_en: Su Weiyuan: Chongyue Electric crosses fiberglass cloth, CCL, PTFE and heat dissipation and becomes the key winner of AI materials

Chongyue Electric is the hidden champion of Shin-Etsu Chemical Special Materials. Su Weiyuan said that Chongyue Electric has a very deep relationship with Japan's Shin-Etsu Chemical. Shin-Etsu Chemical is not only its agent, but also directly holds shares and becomes a major shareholder. It has a first-come-first-served advantage. Chongyue Electric's special silicone materials are widely used in the production of CCL copper foil substrates, fiberglass yarns and fiberglass cloths. It has been officially shipped in volume in March this year, and has directly entered the AI ​​material supply chain of the four major CSP factories. The breadth of themes is extremely rare among ethnic groups. He stressed that Taiwan Optoelectronics has rebounded by 50% to 60% since the crash, Taiyao has rebounded by more than 80%, but Chongyue Electronics has only rebounded by 17.8%, and its quarterly EPS growth rate is not inferior to its peers at all. title_en: Chen Jianquan: Zhenyao electronic labels welcome the surge in goods, and the three major profit engines accelerate their progress
summary_en: Forum Center/Comprehensive Report 1,250 stores across the country announced that they will spend more than 3 billion yuan to completely replace electronic tags within three years. The American Independent Society has taken the lead in completing the replacement, and the electronic tag ESL business opportunity has officially exploded. Senior analyst Chen Jianquan pointed out in "Financial Sunday Party" that the most direct beneficiary of this paperless wave is Zhenyao, a downstream supplier that helps Yuantai assemble electronic labels and electronic advertising billboards. The continued high prepayment amount means that the order visibility is extremely high, and the revenue from the end of the third quarter to the fourth quarter is expected to spurt out. This stage is the best time for low-end layout. Chen Jianquan said that the business opportunities for electronic labels extend far beyond supermarkets. Taoyuan Airport advertising billboards, MRT station posters, and shopping mall event signs are accelerating to use non-reflective electronic paper billboards. Coupled with the rise of AI dynamic pricing systems, shelf pressure sensors are used with electronic labels to adjust prices in real time. The entire application scenario extends from retail to the smart retail ecosystem, and the market scale continues to expand. He emphasized that if 7-11, Wanjiafu, and Daqolian follow up and completely replace them, Zhenyao's order explosive power will far exceed market expectations. On the topic of reinvestment, Chen Jianquan named Peiheng Semiconductor (6291), in which Zhenyao holds 40% of the shares. This core supplier of optical fiber transmission has earned 6.36 yuan in the first half of this year. The continued rise in contract liabilities shows that the momentum in the second half of the year will not decrease, contributing a stable source of profit to Zhenyao. He emphasized that Zhenyao's business orders have exploded, its investment in Peiheng has made huge profits, and its biomedical materials layout has balanced profits and losses. It has three legs and is standing firm at the same time. The revenue in the fourth quarter is expected to hit a new high since its listing. title_en: Claims dispute: He received 32 treatments in 1/3 years, but the insurance only paid out 11 times. The key to his two wins was this clause in the policy.
summary_en: A man in Keelung received high-frequency thermocoagulation therapy 32 times in 3 years due to cervical and lumbar disc herniation and knee joint degeneration. The insurance company only paid for 11 surgeries on the grounds that "treatment of the same area should be separated by 6 months." The man won both lawsuits. It is understood that the key to this claim dispute is that the lifetime surgical insurance policy clearly states that the insured amount for high-frequency thermocoagulation therapy is multiplied by the minimum multiple of 10 times, and there is no upper limit on the number of claims. But most medical insurances now have stipulated annual claims caps.

title: 理賠爭議2／保險拒賠別急著認了！　理賠專家教戰「3關」還有機會翻案
summary: 保險買了多年，真正出事申請理賠，最怕等來一句「不符合條款」或「沒有醫療必要性」。但保險公司第一次拒賠，並不代表理賠爭議就此定案。從日前高頻熱凝療法32次手術、保險公司卻只願意賠付11次爭議可看出，保戶若認為理賠不公，除了要求保險公司重新審查，還能循申訴、金融消費評議甚至訴訟爭取權益。只是想翻案，光說「不公平」沒有用，保單、拒賠理由及醫療證據才是真正關鍵。

title_en: Claim Dispute 2/Don’t be too hasty to accept the insurance denial! Claims experts teach you how to fight "3 levels" and have a chance to reverse the case
summary_en: I have purchased insurance for many years, and when I apply for a claim if something goes wrong, I am most afraid of waiting for the words "does not meet the terms" or "is not medically necessary." However, the first refusal of a claim by an insurance company does not mean that the claim dispute has been finalized. From the recent controversy over 32 high-frequency thermocoagulation surgeries, but the insurance company was only willing to pay compensation for 11 of them, it can be seen that if policyholders believe that the claim settlement is unfair, in addition to asking the insurance company to re-examine, they can also fight for their rights through appeals, financial consumption reviews, and even litigation. If you just want to reverse the case, just saying "unfair" is useless. The policy, reasons for denying compensation and medical evidence are the real key.
