title_en: Financial Current Affairs/Taking a direct look at the entrepreneurial work of the eldest grandson of the third generation of Taishan, Zhan Yuelin aims at the cat slave business opportunity and strives for a comeback
summary_en: A check-in hotspot has recently emerged in southern Taiwan. Located in the "Agricultural Science and Technology Park" in Changzhi Township, Pingtung, a huge white cat lying prone greets people with a smiling face, attracting the attention of many tourists. It turns out that this is a brand new tourist factory built by Zhan Yuelin, the third-generation eldest grandson of the Zhan family in Taishan, an established food factory and founder of the pet brand "Cat Love Life", and his partners invested nearly 300 million yuan. Ten years after stepping down as the director of Taishan, Zhan Yuelin decided to invest in a new business after seeing the business opportunity of tens of billions of dollars a year. He recently accepted an exclusive interview with this magazine in the new factory. He took this magazine to the top of the factory and looked at the mountains in front of him. He said with a smile: "This faces Dawu Mountain to the east, which represents a comeback."

title_en: You can do it without a high degree of education! "This profession" is experiencing huge job shortages, with annual salary estimated at NT$9.6 million
summary_en: The U.S. aviation industry is experiencing a serious manpower shortage, and aviation maintenance technicians have become a popular high-paying position. This occupation does not require a 4-year degree and only requires about 21 months of training and FAA certification to practice. The median annual salary is about US$79,000. If overtime and promotion are added, the total salary is expected to exceed US$300,000. It is predicted that there will be a shortage of more than 400,000 maintenance personnel worldwide in 2034. Although the working environment is difficult and often overlooked, with the development of technical vocational needs and AI infrastructure, aviation maintenance has become a career choice with high development potential, which is highly competitive in the market and has room for salary growth.

summary_en: The U.S. stock market has been shadowed by the "September Curse" for a long time. Why is the stock market performance in this month always the worst of the year? Experts remind investors to stay vigilant. Research shows that as major coffee chains begin to specialize in pumpkin flavored lattes in late summer and early autumn, consumer sentiment is prone to decline as the end of summer is approaching. This psychological change is likely to be the invisible driver of the stock market's weakness.

title_en: Hui Huiyi’s Column》How can Southeast Asia use localization of AI to reshape digital sovereignty?
summary_en: In the past, Southeast Asia was often regarded as a mere technology importing country or a huge consumer market for multinational technology companies. However, with the advancement of the ASEAN Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA), ASEAN countries are working together to establish AI standards that are “in line with local culture and business ethics.” This is not only to ensure that the content produced by the algorithm can accurately fit the local context, but also a precise strategic arbitrage for Southeast Asian countries to use their huge demographic dividend and multicultural heritage to materialize "digital sovereignty" in the cracks of international technological competition. Southeast Asia bridges the contextual gap and realizes localization needs. Currently, the internationally mainstream generative AI training database is highly concentrated in specific language families and digital footprints in mature markets. This phenomenon of data partiality has caused general-purpose AI systems to show obvious acclimatization when faced with the complex local context of Southeast Asia. In practical business applications, this contextual gap has substantial economic losses. If FinTech or multinational e-commerce companies in Southeast Asia introduce AI intelligent customer service, the system cannot accurately identify local slang and business etiquette in Indonesian, Thai or Vietnamese, and may even misjudge local consumption habits and regulatory red lines, which will directly lead to a decline in service experience and potential compliance risks. For Southeast Asian countries that are actively embracing digital economic transformation, allowing foreign super-brains without local fine-tuning to be directly embedded into public sector services, medical care, education and financial systems is equivalent to giving up the right to interpret local data. title_en: More than 70% of adults in Taiwan have "this problem"! The longer medical treatment is delayed, the higher the cost will be, which may further hurt the wallet in the future.
summary_en: Many people think that acne is only reserved for teenagers, but when you enter adulthood or even mature age, acne problems may still reoccur. The Taiwan Society of Dermatology and Cosmetic Surgery points out that up to 76.8% of people in Taiwan are troubled by acne and oiliness, and adults aged 30 to 49 are the main group. It is worth noting that if acne is not controlled early, acne scars will be left in the future, which will not only increase the difficulty of treatment, but also increase the cost of treatment.

title_en: The main focus of credit card tax payment is "this county and city"! The biggest coffee maker broke 10 figures in one stroke
summary_en: Life Center/Gao Shuting reported that credit cards have become one of the main ways for Chinese people to pay taxes due to their convenience. The United Credit Card Processing Center released the latest analysis of credit card tax payment patterns yesterday (14th). This year, the amount of credit card tax payments reached 270 billion yuan, approximately 1.53 million transactions, an increase of 23.6% and 9.3% respectively over last year, both hitting record highs. The amount of tax paid by credit card accounts for 83.92% of the overall comprehensive income tax, which is equivalent to nearly 84 yuan of every 100 yuan of comprehensive income tax paid through credit cards. It is worth noting that the top 1% of large tax payers have a threshold of 2.5 million yuan to enter the list, and the highest amount exceeds 2.5 billion yuan. The amount paid by this group of people accounts for 52.44% of the total, even more than the remaining 99% of taxpayers combined.

title_en: My passport has been suppressed! Xie Jinhe revealed "Taiwan's confidence" and choked the CCP: There is no need to spend money to gain diplomatic relations
summary_en: Recently, Chinese people traveling abroad have been frequently blocked from getting visas. Following Morocco, some people going to Uganda have their passports confiscated and forced to use Chinese passports to enter the country. Faced with diplomatic pressure, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs took a tougher stance, taking countermeasures such as chip export restrictions and trade boycotts, and advised Chinese people to postpone traveling to Uganda. In response to this chaos, Xie Jinhe, chairman of Caixin Media, analyzed that Taiwan’s economic aggregate ranks 22nd in the world, and its strength is far superior to many countries that are tempted by China. He emphasized that the size of a country should be defined by economic output rather than land and population. Taiwan's economy is fully confident and there is no need to fear the CCP's bluff of spending money to gain diplomatic relations internationally. title: 房子送趙建銘還扛6千萬房貸！專家：陳幸妤犯了「全台灣人容易犯的錯」
summary: 前總統陳水扁女兒陳幸妤將店面贈與前夫趙建銘，離婚後不僅無法分產，還獨扛六千萬房貸。房市專家何世昌指出，此案凸顯民眾常犯兩大財務法律錯誤。首先，婚內贈與不動產屬於受贈方個人財產，離婚時無法列入夫妻剩餘財產差額分配請求權範圍，導致贈與方財產權益受損。其次，陳幸妤採取無償贈與卻未轉移房貸，成為冤大頭。專家建議，若要贈與房產，應採取「贈與附有負擔」將房貸一併轉移，或透過「附帶條件贈與」。（記者：簡浩正）

title_en: Give Zhao Jianming a house and still shoulder a 60 million mortgage loan! Expert: Chen Xingyu made "a common mistake that all Taiwanese people make"
summary_en: Chen Xingyu, the daughter of former President Chen Shui-bian, donated a store to her ex-husband Zhao Jianming. After the divorce, not only was she unable to divide the property, but she also had to bear the 60 million mortgage loan alone. Housing market expert He Shichang pointed out that this case highlights two major financial and legal mistakes that people often make. First of all, real estate donated during marriage is the personal property of the donee and cannot be included in the scope of the claim for the distribution of the difference between the couple's remaining property in the event of divorce, resulting in damage to the property rights of the donor. Secondly, Chen Xingyu made free gifts but did not transfer the housing loan, making her the biggest victim. Experts suggest that if you want to give away real estate, you should use a "gift with a burden" to transfer the mortgage together, or use a "conditional gift." (Reporter: Jian Haozheng)

title_en: All monthly salary is paid! Husband discovers his wife’s shocking secret, breaks down and confronts him, only to be met with a cold response from his wife with “this sentence”
summary_en: A 58-year-old senior executive in Japan, Kaneko Akihiko, worked hard for a happy life after retirement and handed over all his salary to his wife for management. Unexpectedly, with only two years left before retirement, he unexpectedly discovered that his wife had concealed an astonishing secret for 30 years. There were multiple bankbooks and credit card statements hidden deep in the closet, revealing that his wife had long squandered the family income to buy high-quality goods and travel abroad. When questioned, his wife coldly replied that she had saved enough money, causing Jin Jin to collapse on the spot. This incident not only triggered heated discussions in society about financial trust between couples, but also highlighted that differences in consumption concepts are often the trigger for the breakdown of marriages. According to judicial statistics, divorce cases among older adults in Japan have increased in recent years. Among them, money disputes and wasteful habits are the key factors leading to the breakup of relationships. The public is reminded to pay attention to the communication of values ​​and financial transparency between couples.

title_en: The test of Taiwan stocks is coming! Leading index stocks began to soften. He exposed "the biggest pitfall for retail investors" and shouted: Do 2 things quickly
summary_en: U.S. stocks have hit new highs recently, but Taiwanese stocks failed to extend their gains. On the 14th, they opened higher and then fell 210 points. TSMC's plunge became the hardest hit area on the market. Analyst Zhou Daiyun warned that the weakness of popular Taiwan stock index stocks such as Yageo and UMC shows that the market is not just a problem of a single stock, but the emergence of structural selling pressure. Zhou Daiyun reminded that the previous continuous rises resulted in excessive financing balances and heavy floating amounts. Investors should no longer blindly pursue prices with a "tailwind market" mentality. He called on investors holding profit-making positions to re-examine the stop-profit and stop-loss mechanism. High-leverage operators must actively reduce risk levels to cope with the upcoming shock correction period and avoid being caught off guard when the market reverses. They must respond to market changes prudently.

summary_en: Taiwan stocks continued MSCI's weight increase in early trading yesterday (14th), and foreign capital's replenishment encouraged them to open higher. However, as they were approaching the lock-up zone of the previous wave, they were not willing to chase prices, and there was even profit-taking selling pressure. The market fell 210 points from red to black to close at 45,811 points; however, it rose 1,585 points on the week, two consecutive reds. Foreign capital over-bought every day every week, and the cumulative buying exceeded 200 billion yuan, reaching 206.13 billion yuan. Legal persons are optimistic. Through a gentle change of hands, the market is expected to gradually advance to a high of 48K.

summary_en: A check-in hotspot has recently emerged in southern Taiwan. Located in the "Agricultural Science and Technology Park" in Changzhi Township, Pingtung, a huge white cat lying prone greets people with a smiling face, attracting the attention of many tourists. It turns out that this is a brand new tourist factory built by Zhan Yuelin, the third-generation eldest grandson of the Zhan family in Taishan, an established food factory and founder of the pet brand "Cat Love Life", and his partners invested nearly 300 million yuan. Ten years after stepping down as the director of Taishan, Zhan Yuelin decided to invest in a new business, eyeing the business opportunity of tens of billions of dollars a year. He recently accepted an exclusive interview with this magazine in the new factory. He took this magazine to the top of the factory and looked at the mountains in front of him. He said with a smile: "This faces Dawu Mountain to the east, which represents a comeback."

summary_en: The Accountant General Office of the Executive Yuan announced yesterday (14th) that the "median disposable income per person" in 2025 is 367,000 yuan. According to this estimate, the basic living expenses per person is expected to increase to 220,000 yuan this year, an increase of 7,000 yuan from last year's 213,000 yuan. It has been increased for the ninth consecutive year. It will be applicable when reporting comprehensive income tax in May next year. It is initially estimated that more than 2 million households will benefit, and families with multiple people are expected to save taxes.

title: 南亞科逼近新高、華邦電還落後　記憶體漲價潮下誰更有補漲空間？
summary: 雖然現階段記憶體產業趨勢的多空仍是有相當多雜音，不過自需求面與重要研調機構的推估，顯示今年記憶體業績依舊是逐季成長，包括威剛董事長陳立白表示，第三季DRAM合約價格將再調升20%至30%，NAND Flash價格預估上漲35%至40%；三星也認為第三季將通用型DRAM均價較上季調升20%。此外，根據DRAMeXchange資料，DDR4 8Gb 於7月平均固定合約價升至24美元，較 6月漲14.3%，128Gb MLC NAND 於7月平均價格升至30.05美元，創下歷史新高，DDR4 8Gb今年累計漲幅約109%；128Gb MLC NAND 今年累計上漲約218%。故隨著第二季財報與7月營收的公告，都可驗證記憶體的業績沒有問題，在南亞科（2408）股價逼近歷史新高之際，華邦電（2344）股價就顯得被低估，研判股價有機會上演一波反攻。

title_en: Nanya is approaching a new high, while Winbond is still lagging behind. Who has more room to make up for the increase in memory prices?
summary_en: Although there is still a lot of noise about the long and short trends in the memory industry at this stage, estimates from the demand side and important research institutions show that memory performance will still grow quarter by quarter this year. Chen Libai, chairman of ADATA, said that DRAM contract prices will increase by another 20% to 30% in the third quarter, and NAND Flash prices are expected to increase by 35% to 40%. Samsung also believes that the average price of general-purpose DRAM will increase by 20% in the third quarter compared with the previous quarter. In addition, according to DRAMeXchange data, the average fixed contract price of DDR4 8Gb rose to US$24 in July, an increase of 14.3% from June. The average price of 128Gb MLC NAND rose to US$30.05 in July, setting a record high. The cumulative increase of DDR4 8Gb this year is approximately 109%; the cumulative increase of 128Gb MLC NAND this year is approximately 218%. Therefore, with the announcement of the second quarter financial report and July revenue, it can be verified that there is no problem with memory performance. When the stock price of Nanya (2408) is approaching a record high, the stock price of Winbond (2344) appears to be undervalued, and the stock price has the opportunity to stage a counterattack.

The stock price hit a record high of 1,2525 yuan, becoming the third 10,000-dollar stock in Taiwan. Foreign investors directly raised the target price to 15,000 yuan. This is exactly what I have always emphasized, in July As South Korea's double leverage broke, the adjustment in the Taiwanese stock market was a fundamental correction. title_en: The market sentiment is conservative before the weekend! All four major U.S. stock indexes closed down, and TSMC ADR fell 0.96%.
summary_en: [Newtalk News] U.S. retail sales fell by 0.6% month-on-month in July. In addition, a survey released by the University of Michigan showed that the consumer confidence index fell in August, ending two consecutive months of growth. Due to the uncertain outlook for the U.S. economy and the war in the Middle East, investors were conservative and cautious before the weekend, and the major U.S. stock market indexes closed down on the 14th. The S&P 500 Index fell back from its all-time high, down 0.17%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 107.58 points, 0.20%, the Nasdaq Index fell 0.28%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 0.31%. According to comprehensive foreign media reports, Applied Materials fell 5.1% on the 14th. Due to the strong demand brought by the construction of artificial intelligence (AI) smart data centers, the chip equipment manufacturer’s stock price has surged this year. However, despite the optimistic quarterly performance forecast released recently, it failed to attract investors. Other chip manufacturers such as Broadcom fell 5.94% on Friday, Intel fell nearly 2%, Huida fell 0.06%, and TSMC ADR fell $4.14 or 0.96% to close at $426.35. Regarding the situation in the Middle East, after two oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, a key energy waterway, traffic in the Strait almost came to a standstill. US President Donald Trump declared in a public speech on the 14th that after defeating Iran, he would soon declare the Strait of Hormuz to be "US territory." At the same time, the United States stated that it may maintain a naval blockade against Iran indefinitely. A senior Iranian source previously claimed that talks to end the war would be futile.

title: 大稻埕碼頭再掀西區新風華 水岸、文化、商業三引擎驅動發展
summary: 近年台北城市發展逐漸回到西區，擁有百年歷史的大稻埕，正因水岸景觀、文化觀光與重大建設齊頭並進，再度成為各界關注焦點。從淡水河畔的大稻埕碼頭，到雙子星開發案、西區門戶計畫，以及未來捷運民生汐止線，形成一條串聯歷史、人文、交通與國際商業的新發展軸線，也讓這座百年聚落重新展現城市新魅力。大稻埕碼頭曾是清末台灣最重要的國際商港之一，茶葉、樟腦、糖業等物產皆由此出口世界，不僅孕育出台灣近代商業文明，也帶動大稻埕成為當時全台最繁華的商業聚落之一。

title_en: Dadaocheng Pier brings a new splendor to the Western District. The development is driven by the three engines of waterfront, culture and commerce.
summary_en: In recent years, Taipei's urban development has gradually returned to the West District. Dadaocheng, with its century-old history, has once again become the focus of attention due to its waterfront landscape, cultural tourism and major construction going hand in hand. From the Dadaocheng Pier on the banks of the Tamsui River, to the Twin Star Development Project, the Western District Gateway Project, and the future MRT Xizhi Line for People’s Livelihood, a new development axis is formed that connects history, culture, transportation and international business, allowing this century-old settlement to re-show the new charm of the city. Dadaocheng Wharf was once one of Taiwan's most important international commercial ports in the late Qing Dynasty. Products such as tea, camphor, and sugar were exported to the world. It not only gave birth to Taiwan's modern commercial civilization, but also helped Dadaocheng become one of the most prosperous commercial settlements in Taiwan at that time.

title_en: Foreign capital buys Taiwan stocks every day, accumulating more than 200 billion yuan
summary_en: Taiwan stocks continued MSCI's weight increase in early trading yesterday (14th), and foreign capital's replenishment encouraged them to open higher. However, as they were approaching the lock-up zone of the previous wave, they were not willing to chase prices, and there was even profit-taking selling pressure. The market fell 210 points from red to black to close at 45,811 points; however, it rose 1,585 points on the week, two consecutive reds. Foreign capital over-bought every day every week, and the cumulative buying exceeded 200 billion yuan, reaching 206.13 billion yuan. Legal persons are optimistic. Through a gentle change of hands, the market is expected to gradually advance to a high of 48K.

title_en: Upgraded for 9 consecutive years! Basic living expenses are estimated to increase by 7,000 yuan, which will be applicable to next year’s tax filing
summary_en: The Accountant General Office of the Executive Yuan announced yesterday (14th) that the "median disposable income per person" in 2025 is 367,000 yuan. According to this estimate, the basic living expenses per person is expected to increase to 220,000 yuan this year, an increase of 7,000 yuan from last year's 213,000 yuan. It has been increased for the ninth consecutive year. It will be applicable when reporting comprehensive income tax in May next year. It is initially estimated that more than 2 million households will benefit, and families with multiple people are expected to save taxes.

title_en: Retail data is weak! U.S. stocks closed with "all four major indexes down" and the Dow Jones fell 107 points
summary_en: U.S. President Trump officially signed an announcement on the 13th to impose tariffs on imported drones and related components. Among them, drones and large aircraft with sensitive functions such as thermal imaging are subject to a tax rate of up to 100%, while products from Taiwan, the European Union, Japan and South Korea are subject to a 15% tariff. The move is aimed at strengthening national security. At the same time, U.S. retail sales data in July decreased by 0.6% month-on-month, reflecting signs of slowing consumption. Affected by this economic data, the four major U.S. stock indexes collectively closed in the black on Friday. The Dow Jones, S&P 500, Nasdaq and Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell slightly simultaneously, and market sentiment turned conservative and cautious.

title: 掏空退休金資助孫女學費！老婦討債遭兒冷回不認帳　專家揭這點超重要
summary: 一名67歲獨居老婦晴子，為資助孫女圓大學夢，不惜掏空積蓄匯款120萬日圓支付學費與教材。未料家庭經濟陷困窘向兒子請求分期還款時，竟遭對方冷回「不記得借錢」，心寒之餘也揭開高齡者財務風險。專家提醒，即便親屬間金錢往來，也應白紙黑字簽訂贈與或借貸契約。根據日本稅制，祖父母直接支付學費可免贈與稅，但若經由子女轉手恐引發稅務爭議。此案例不僅凸顯長者退休金遭侵蝕的經濟隱憂，更警示親情間若缺乏明確財務規範，恐導致錢財兩失，建議民眾務必透過法律文件保障自身權益，避免因一時心軟而讓晚年生活陷入困境。

title_en: Use your retirement savings to fund your granddaughter’s tuition! Old woman refuses to acknowledge her debt when she asks for debt, experts reveal this is extremely important
summary_en: A 67-year-old woman, Haruko, who lives alone, spent her savings to remit 1.2 million yen to pay for her granddaughter’s college dream and pay for tuition and teaching materials. Unexpectedly, when the family was in financial straits and asked for installment repayment from his son, he was met with a cold reply saying "I don't remember to borrow the money." In addition to being disappointed, it also revealed the financial risks of an elderly person. Experts remind that even if money is exchanged between relatives, a gift or loan contract should be signed in black and white. According to the Japanese tax system, grandparents paying tuition directly are exempt from gift tax, but if it is passed on to children, tax disputes may arise. This case not only highlights the financial worries of the elderly’s pension being eroded, but also warns that the lack of clear financial regulations among family members may lead to the loss of money. It is recommended that the public must protect their rights and interests through legal documents to avoid being trapped in difficulties in later life due to a moment of weakness.

summary: 近期，美國私募基金貝恩資本（Bain Capital）宣布，收購台灣手搖飲品牌貢茶（Gong cha）。根據《日經亞洲》報導，這一起收購案金額超過6.35億美元（約新台幣204.7億元），預計2026年第四季完成交割。消息一出，立即在台灣餐飲業界掀起討論。事實上，這並不是貢茶第一次易主，而是它創辦以來第三度被國際私募基金接手。

title_en: There are less than 10 stores in Taiwan, but nearly 2,200 stores worldwide. Why did Gongcha get private equity funds to buy it three times in a row?
summary_en: Recently, American private equity fund Bain Capital announced the acquisition of Taiwanese hand-held beverage brand Gong Cha. According to Nikkei Asia, the acquisition value exceeds US$635 million (approximately NT$20.47 billion) and is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2026. As soon as the news came out, it immediately sparked discussion in Taiwan's catering industry. In fact, this is not the first time Gongcha has changed hands, but the third time it has been taken over by an international private equity fund since its inception.

title_en: Is it too unfair that Quanta’s stock price is less than 330 yuan? Guo Zherong appeared first and saw the financial report: I want to buy it back...The latest target price reveals "there is still 50% room"
summary_en: The stock price of Quanta (2382), a leading AI server manufacturer, opened lower and higher on Friday (8/14), reaching an intraday high of 336.5 yuan. It ended up rising by 2.5 yuan, or 0.77%, to close at 327.5 yuan. Quanta's stock price rose, benefiting from the recent eye-catching financial report released by China Securities Regulatory Commission. Quanta's revenue in the second quarter of 2026 hit 1.04 trillion yuan, a quarterly increase of 28% and an annual increase of 106%, setting a new single-quarter high; the net profit attributable to owners of the parent company also exceeded market expectations, with single-quarter earnings per share (EPS) reaching 7.43 yuan, an increase of 35% from the first quarter's 5.5 yuan, and an annual increase of 70%. In this regard, financial analyst Guo Zherong (Zhe Zhe) said that the Taiwan stock market has reached 46,000 points, and Quanta's current price-to-earnings ratio is less than 11 times. "The stock price is too cheap." As a heavyweight AI value stock, Quanta's evaluation seems quite aggrieved. He admitted that although he had previously entered the market at 327 yuan, he "wanted to buy it back" after seeing this financial report. And Quanta’s latest target price is released! According to the latest FactSet survey, the market's target price for Quanta continues to increase, with the median rising from 400 yuan to 412.5 yuan, an increase of approximately 3.13%; the highest valuation is 472 yuan, and the lowest is 250 yuan. Local investment firm Gu Kaiji is optimistic about Quanta's market outlook and has raised its target price significantly from 430 yuan to 500 yuan. It predicts EPS in 2026 will be 27.06 yuan and will further grow to 31.75 yuan in 2027. Yuanta maintains its optimistic view and slightly raises the target price from 385 yuan to 395 yuan, predicting E in 2026.

title: 《奧德賽》安海瑟薇教養心法：跟孩子開口前先做一件事
summary: 近期參演電影《奧德賽》的好萊塢巨星安海瑟薇分享，她從英國凱特王妃身上學到「先蹲下、平視孩子溝通」的育兒技巧，透過積極傾聽，讓孩子感受到尊重與理解。她也坦言自己並不追求完美育兒，而是學會管理情緒、從挫折中成長。現年43歲的好萊塢影星安海瑟薇（Anne Hathaway），參演的電影《奧德賽》（The Odyssey）近期正於全球上映中；而育有兩子的她，6月也宣布懷上第三胎，事業與家庭同步迎來新篇章。她身為母親，在分享自己的教養體會時，表示最受用的啟發，是得知英國威爾斯王妃（Princess of Wales）凱特（Kate Middleton）與孩子的互動方式：每次說話前，先蹲下身，讓彼此視線齊平。安海瑟薇認為，這樣的技巧，能讓孩子感受到尊重與傾聽。於是，這也成了她一路陪伴兩個兒子成長的重要教養方式。

title_en: "The Odyssey" Anne Hathaway's parenting skills: Do one thing before talking to your children
summary_en: Hollywood superstar Anne Hathaway, who recently starred in the movie "The Odyssey," shared that she learned the parenting skills of "crouch down first and communicate with your children at eye level" from Britain's Princess Kate. Through active listening, she can make her children feel respected and understood. She also admitted that she does not pursue perfect parenting, but learns to manage her emotions and grow from setbacks. The 43-year-old Hollywood movie star Anne Hathaway is starring in the movie "The Odyssey" which is currently being released around the world. She has two sons. She also announced in June that she was pregnant with her third child, marking a new chapter in her career and family. As a mother, when she shared her experience of upbringing, she said that the most useful inspiration was learning about the way Kate Middleton, Princess of Wales, interacts with her children: before speaking, she squats down so that they are at eye level. Anne Hathaway believes that such techniques can make children feel respected and listened to. Therefore, this has become an important parenting method for her to accompany her two sons as they grow up.

title: 「最害怕的是員工」當死亡來到長照機構，如何陪伴善終走完最後一程？
summary: 位於台北市陽明山仰德大道上的至善老人安養護中心，占地約9000坪，逾300位長者在這裡生活。沿著走道前行，一扇門旁掛著一塊木匾，上面刻著「善福園」，下方另有「至終平安 善盡伴寧」八個字。推開門，採訪當天房內沒有人。裡面只設一床，陳設簡樸。一旁的櫃子裡，放著臨終及身後護理所需的彩妝品、襪子與鞋子；另一格則擺放佛教、基督教與天主教的宗教聖像，依住民各自的信仰取用。善福園不是醫院型態的安寧病房，而是一間僅設一床的安寧關懷室，提供生命末期長者及家屬較具隱私的陪伴空間。至善的安寧照護則由機構工作人員執行日常照顧，並由台北市立聯合醫院安寧團隊、耕莘醫療體系提供醫療後援。長者離世後，工作人員也會替其清潔身體、更換衣物，穿上平常喜歡的衣服，整理儀容。

title_en: "The most fearful thing is the staff." When death comes to a long-term care institution, how to accompany the hospice on the final journey?
summary_en: The Zhishan Nursing Center for the Elderly is located on Yangde Avenue in Yangmingshan, Taipei City. It covers an area of ​​about 9,000 square meters and has more than 300 elderly people living here. Walking along the corridor, there is a wooden plaque hanging next to a door, with the words "Garden of Good Fortune" engraved on it, and below it are the words "Peace in the End, Goodness Accompanying Peace". Opening the door, there was no one in the room on the day of the interview. There is only one bed inside and the furnishings are simple. In the cabinet on one side, there are cosmetics, socks and shoes needed for end-of-life and post-mortem care; on the other side, there are religious icons from Buddhism, Christianity and Catholicism, which are used by the residents according to their respective beliefs. Shan Fook Yuan is not a hospital-type hospice ward, but a hospice care room with only one bed, providing a more private space for the elderly and their family members at the end of life. Supreme hospice care is performed by agency staff on a day-to-day basis, and medical support is provided by the hospice team of Taipei United Hospital and the Gengsin Medical System. After the elderly pass away, the staff will clean their body, change their clothes, put on their usual favorite clothes, and tidy up their appearance.

summary: 近期房市最熱的話題，莫過於前幾周的兆基事件。從事件發展來看，恐怕還需要一段時間才能釐清；但從產業發展的角度，這場危機未必全是壞事，反而讓消費者、業者與主管機關，有機會重新檢視過去被視為理所當然的做法，也重新用「治理」的角度，看待一家公司與一個產業。

title_en: Chartered Escrow: From Industrial Governance to Corporate Governance
summary_en: The hottest topic in the housing market recently is the Zhaoji incident in the past few weeks. Judging from the development of events, it may take some time to clarify; but from the perspective of industrial development, this crisis is not necessarily a bad thing. Instead, it gives consumers, businesses, and competent authorities the opportunity to re-examine practices that were taken for granted in the past, and to re-view a company and an industry from the perspective of "governance."

title: GDP上修至11.05％ 39年來新高
summary: 主計總處14日公布最新經濟預測，受惠AI產業發展，出口、投資、民間消費表現都優於預期，將今年全年經濟成長從9.64％上修至11.05％，創39年以來新高；明年經濟成長預測值也有6.04％水準，連續3年高度經濟成長，明年每人GDP預估有4萬9874美元，朝5萬美元大關邁進。
title_zh: GDP上修至11.05％ 39年來新高
summary_zh: 主計總處14日公布最新經濟預測，受惠AI產業發展，出口、投資、民間消費表現都優於預期，將今年全年經濟成長從9.64％上修至11.05％，創39年以來新高；明年經濟成長預測值也有6.04％水準，連續3年高度經濟成長，明年每人GDP預估有4萬9874美元，朝5萬美元大關邁進。
title_en: GDP was revised upward to 11.05%, a 39-year high
summary_en: The General Accounting Office announced the latest economic forecast on the 14th. Benefiting from the development of the AI ​​industry, exports, investment, and private consumption have all performed better than expected. The economic growth for this year has been revised upward from 9.64% to 11.05%, a record high in 39 years. The economic growth forecast for next year is also 6.04%, marking three consecutive years of high economic growth. The GDP per capita next year is estimated to be US$49,874, heading towards the US$50,000 mark.

title: 基本生活費調高3.2％ 四口最多省1.1萬
summary: 主計總處14日公布民國114年度每人可支配所得中位數年增3.2％，依法規，115年度的基本生活費對應調升為22萬元，相較於113年度的21.3萬元，增加7000元。以四口之家計算，可以省稅1400元到1萬1200元，明年5月報稅就可適用，預估超過202萬戶受惠。

title_en: The basic living expenses will be increased by 3.2%, saving up to 11,000 for a family of four
summary_en: The General Accounting Office announced on the 14th that the median disposable income per person in 2014 increased by 3.2% annually. According to regulations, the basic living expenses in 2015 was correspondingly increased to 220,000 yuan, an increase of 7,000 yuan compared to 213,000 yuan in 2013. Calculated for a family of four, it can save 1,400 yuan to 11,200 yuan in tax. It will be applicable when filing taxes in May next year. It is estimated that more than 2.02 million households will benefit.

summary: 公股取得國票金經營權後引發一連串爭議，財政部14日發表「全力支持國票金檢討與整併」聲明，全力支持國票金檢討薪酬，以及積極推動國票金改革。據透露，公股陣營將進行3大改革，包含檢討國票金副董薪水、評估國票金是否要設副董一職（廢掉副董），以及未來朝「公股整併」的方向進行。

title_en: Ministry of Finance: Fully supports the review and consolidation of national bills
summary_en: A series of controversies arose after the public shares obtained the right to operate the national banknotes. The Ministry of Finance issued a statement on the 14th "fully supporting the review and consolidation of the national banknotes." It fully supported the national banknotes' review of salaries and actively promoted the reform of the national banknotes. According to reports, the public equity camp will carry out three major reforms, including reviewing the salary of the deputy director of the National Bank, evaluating whether the National Bank should establish a deputy director (abolition of the deputy director), and moving towards "public equity consolidation" in the future.

title_en: Wealth and poverty are expanding, but the Ministry of Finance report blocks taxes on the rich
summary_en: The difference between the highest 20% and the lowest 20% in the 2014 Household Income and Expenditure Survey was 6.17 times, a new high in the past 14 years. In the past, we discussed imposing a "rich tax" and raising the comprehensive income tax rate to 45% to redistribute income. However, the review report completed by the Ministry of Finance decided not to increase the tax rate to 45% for reasons such as "retaining and recruiting talents".

title: 持股高達九成逢高狂砍台積電？杜金龍揭獲利入袋關鍵轉折
summary: 台股第二季財報表現亮眼，資深分析師杜金龍指出，在AI產業強勁基本面支撐下，台股仍有機會挑戰48000點大關。儘管看好長線趨勢，但杜金龍提醒投資人切勿盲目追高，應建立獲利落袋的轉折觀念。他分享個人操作策略，在近期強勁反彈中採取逢高減碼，並將台積電持股降至三成，目標將資產配置調整為五成持股與五成現金。此舉並非看空後市，而是考量季線壓力下，建議投資人應靈活調整，穩健應對市場震盪，落實資金控管以保障獲利。

title_en: Holding as much as 90% of the shares, are you going to buy TSMC on the highs? Du Jinlong reveals the key turning point in pocketing profits
summary_en: Taiwan stocks performed well in the second quarter financial report. Senior analyst Du Jinlong pointed out that with the support of strong fundamentals of the AI ​​industry, Taiwan stocks still have a chance to challenge the 48,000-point mark. Although he is optimistic about the long-term trend, Du Jinlong reminds investors not to blindly chase high prices and to establish a turning concept of taking profits. He shared his personal operation strategy, taking advantage of the recent strong rebound to reduce his position on rallies and reduce his holdings in TSMC to 30%, with the goal of adjusting the asset allocation to 50% stock holdings and 50% cash. This move is not to be bearish on the market outlook, but to consider the quarterly pressure. It is recommended that investors should adjust flexibly, respond to market shocks steadily, and implement capital control to ensure profits.

title_en: Circular economy has become a global mainstream. Zhuo Kui hopes to assist small, medium and micro enterprises through policy and budget investment.
summary_en: When Executive Director Zhuo Rongtai visited the "Taiwan Cocoa and Chocolate Industry Association" in Pingtung County on the 14th, he said that Taiwan's chocolate industry has been brave in transformation and innovation in recent years. Locally produced chocolate has repeatedly won good results in international competitions and continues to create circular economy value. In the future, the government will use the "Ordinance on the Transformation, Upgrading and Development of Small, Medium, and Micro Enterprises" to help small, medium, and micro enterprises "fit, grow, upgrade, and excel." It will also listen to the needs of the industry, help expand international channels, and build Taiwan into a truly progressive civilized country.

title_en: Revenue in July increased by 43% year-on-year! 648 companies listed on OTC grow; 3 major groups form the strongest engine
summary_en: The OTC Buying Center stated that all 890 listed OTC companies (including 30 KY companies) had completed their revenue declaration for July 2015 before August 10, 2015. According to the revenue announcement data of listed companies in July 2015, the monthly revenue of all listed companies in July totaled 357.6 billion yuan, an increase of 107.6 billion yuan (43%) compared with the same period in 2014. There were 648 companies with revenue growth, 239 companies with decline, and 3 companies with flat revenue. In addition, as of July, the total revenue of all OTC companies totaled 2.2101 billion yuan, an increase of 480.6 billion yuan (28%) compared with the same period in 2014. Among them, there were 619 companies with growth in revenue, 270 companies with decline, and 1 company with flat revenue, showing that the fundamentals of OTC companies have grown steadily.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lu Yanci and Su Siyun, Taipei, Taipei, 14th) The July card payment report card of the five major card-issuing banks has been released. title_en: Vishbo turns profit from loss in the first half of the year and rushes into the CW Laser optical communication market in the second half of the year
summary_en: Optical communications manufacturer Visible (7930) is not afraid of the rising prices of some raw materials in the first half of the year, which will have a short-term impact on gross profit performance. In addition, the company continues to invest in the research and development of new products such as high-power CW Laser, customer development, talent expansion, and processing of new cabinets, which has caused the overall operating expenses to rise simultaneously. The net profit after tax attributable to the parent company in the first half of the year was 6.16 million yuan, successfully turning a loss into a profit compared with the same period last year, with net earnings per share reaching 0.19 yuan.

title_en: GDP growth rate looks at 11.05%, exports are expected to hit record highs
summary_en: The General Accounting Office predicts that next year's economic growth rate will be 6.04%. Comptroller-General Chen Shuzi said that the growth of AI will remain unchanged, Taiwan's supply chain has opened up high-end production capacity, and through expansion of factories and investment in research and development, exports are expected to continue to grow. Cai Yutai added that he is still optimistic about investment and exports next year, with exports reaching US$172.5 billion. Due to strong demand, the supply chain is expected to increase investment in order to increase production capacity. Private investment has grown at double digits last year and this year, and is estimated to grow 4.32% next year, which will still be the main supporting force.

title_en: The revenue of "this cloud giant" soared 454%! "The Big Short" I increase my short selling: AI fanaticism reaches its peak
summary_en: AI cloud giant Nebius reported impressive second-quarter financial results, with revenue increasing 454% year-on-year to US$582.3 million, and its core AI cloud business soaring 514%, inspiring the stock price to surge 34.14% in a single day. However, the well-known investor Berry bucked the trend and increased his short selling, questioning the strange phenomenon of "backward pricing" in Nebius, that is, customers are willing to buy short-term computing power at high prices, showing a lack of confidence in long-term stability. In addition, Berry even pointed out that Nebius has a trick in extending the depreciation life of servers, suggesting that GPU equipment may face the risk of depreciation. Although the company is actively expanding its AI infrastructure and has received large amounts of advance payments, Berry's warning still adds uncertainty to the booming AI market, reminding investors that they should carefully assess the risks of industrial bubbles and technology depreciation.

title_en: Yearning for slow life in the fields, he becomes a lonely old man! Retired man flees back to the city in panic, revealing hidden dangers in country life
summary_en: A 65-year-old retiree from Tokyo decided to move to Nagano to realize his dream because he yearned for life in the countryside. He originally thought he could enjoy a leisurely and leisurely life, but due to the dependence on driving in rural life, difficulty in social integration, and declining physical strength, he decided to return to Tokyo after only two years. Experts remind that when migrating in later years, life functions and actual needs should be the primary consideration, rather than choosing a place of residence based solely on longing. Data from Japan's Hometown Relocation Exchange Promotion Agency shows that the number of relocation consultations is increasing year by year. It is recommended that the elderly first conduct a short-term experience to evaluate whether the medical, transportation and social environment are suitable, and avoid impulsively emigrating only to find out that they are not suitable, so as to ensure the quality of life and mental health in their later years.

title: 台積電毛利率65%引爆賣壓？ 總經專家吳嘉隆戳破：玩假的

title_en: TSMC’s gross profit margin of 65% triggers selling pressure? General manager Wu Jialong reveals: it’s fake
summary_en: TSMC’s recent concerns about the cost of setting up factories in the United States have triggered market concerns about declining gross profit margins, causing the stock price to fluctuate. General economist Wu Jialong bluntly said that the sharp decline in the market just because of slight fluctuations in gross profit margin was "fake" and was actually an opportunity to wash the market. He emphasized that TSMC’s gross profit margin remains above 65%, which is still a very high level of profitability for the manufacturing industry. In addition, TSMC can effectively pass costs on to customers by virtue of its strong technological advantages and market pricing capabilities. Under the long-term trend of the AI ​​industry, TSMC's global core supply chain position remains unshakable. Recent market corrections are mostly due to chip cleaning. Investors should carefully evaluate and not blindly sell low due to short-term issues to avoid missing out on long-term capital dividends.

title: 50歲後身體有沒有退化？五動作在家測：全做到代表肌力、平衡都不差
summary: 美國健身教練荷普斯（Sam Hopes）的專長是活動性訓練，她特別喜歡讓新學生做5項長壽測試。你可以常常用這些測試確認自己的狀態，特別是40或50歲以後，平衡、肌力與活動度等體能組成會開始自然下降，更應該確保自己沒有迅速退化。若沒有透過訓練去建立、維持，瘦體重與肌肉量的流失就會在這個階段開始加速。不論你平常有沒有規律運動，荷普斯都建議試試這5項測試。如果全都做得到，代表你目前的身體活動表現、實用功能與肌力都相當不錯。如果有哪一項無法完成，可以考慮更常練習，或加入阻力訓練、活動度訓練來慢慢改善。

title_en: Does your body deteriorate after the age of 50? Five movements tested at home: all of them represent muscle strength and balance.
summary_en: American fitness trainer Sam Hopes specializes in mobility training, and she especially likes to ask new students to do five longevity tests. You can often use these tests to confirm your status. Especially after the age of 40 or 50, physical fitness components such as balance, muscle strength and mobility will begin to decline naturally, and you should make sure that you are not deteriorating rapidly. If it is not established and maintained through training, the loss of lean body mass and muscle mass will begin to accelerate at this stage. Whether you exercise regularly or not, Hope recommends trying these 5 tests. If you can do all of them, it means that your current physical activity performance, practical functions and muscle strength are quite good. If any of them cannot be completed, you can consider practicing more often, or adding resistance training or range of motion training to slowly improve.

title: 明明沒生病卻頭痛、疲倦？醫師揭7個脫水警訊　口臭、易餓都上榜
summary: 保持充足的水分對於整天維持活力非常重要。水分有助於身體將關鍵營養素輸送到細胞中、維持器官正常運作。如果沒有足夠的水分來執行這些功能，會讓你覺得身體沉重、步履蹣跚。此外，水分攝取會直接影響睡眠品質。睡眠基金會（Sleep Foundation）解釋，「水分對人體的大多數系統都很重要，因此脫水會引發多種症狀，包括影響睡眠。」不過喝水過量也會影響睡眠、造成多次夜尿，引發疲勞感。飲水務必重視平衡。每天到底應該喝幾杯水？萊波建議，一般情況下渴了就喝，不渴就停止。不過你不能只看口渴這個訊號決定要不要喝水，特別是老年人對口渴的敏感度可能已經降低。梅約診所等機構警告，你口渴的時候很可能已經處於輕度脫水的狀態了。最重要的是，要帶著補充水分的意識生活，並提前做好規劃。像是隨身攜帶一個環保水壺，有標示時間、目標的水壺更好。如果你不愛喝純水，可以考慮草本茶或加水果的水。萊波表示：「如果你打算在炎熱的天氣外出、知道會流汗，就必須做好充足準備。理想情況下，你應該前一天就開始多喝點水。」

title_en: Have a headache and feel tired even though you are not sick? Doctors reveal 7 warning signs of dehydration: bad breath and easy hunger are on the list
summary_en: Staying well hydrated is important to stay energized throughout the day. Water helps your body transport key nutrients to your cells and keep your organs functioning properly. Not having enough fluids to perform these functions can leave you feeling heavy and sluggish. In addition, water intake will directly affect sleep quality. The Sleep Foundation explains, "Water is important for most systems in the human body, so dehydration can cause a variety of symptoms, including affecting sleep." However, drinking too much water can also affect sleep, cause frequent nocturia, and cause fatigue. Be sure to pay attention to balance when drinking water. How many glasses of water should you drink every day? Lebo suggests that under normal circumstances, drink when you are thirsty and stop when you are not thirsty. But you can't just look at the signal of thirst to decide whether to drink water, especially in the elderly, whose sensitivity to thirst may have been reduced. The Mayo Clinic and others warn that by the time you're thirsty, you're probably already mildly dehydrated. Most importantly, live with an awareness of hydration and plan ahead. For example, carry an environmentally friendly water bottle with you. It is better to have a water bottle with time and goals marked on it. If you don't like drinking pure water, consider herbal tea or water with fruit. "If you're going to be out on a hot day and you know you're going to sweat, you have to be prepared," says Lebo. "Ideally, you should start drinking more water the day before."

title_en: Yongfengyu: Demand for paperware in Vietnam continues to strengthen this year, while the mainland Chinese market remains flat
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 14th) Luo Bingzheng, general manager of Yongfeng Yu Investment Holdings, said that the demand for paper products in Vietnam is strong, and product prices and sales have increased. Driven by factors such as supply chain restructuring, geopolitics and tariffs, he has a positive view on the Vietnamese market in the second half of the year; in comparison, the growth of domestic demand in China's industrial paper market is slow, and the overall demand is roughly flat.

title_en: Hua Paper reduces pulp production in the third quarter in response to high costs; pulp prices are expected to stop falling
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 14th) Chen Ruihe, general manager of Hua Paper, said today that the third quarter was faced with high wood chip prices and summer electricity prices, which were the most expensive quarter of the year. Before pulp prices rebounded, pulp production was reduced in response, while papermaking production remained normal. As Chinese companies resume large-scale purchases, and global pulp mills continue to reduce production, it is expected that supply may tighten in the next 2 to 3 months, and the chances of pulp prices rising will increase.

title_en: Sharp point's second-quarter profit nearly triples year-on-year and continues to expand drill bit production capacity
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Jiang Mingyan, Taipei, 14th) PCB drill needle factory Jianidian’s net profit attributable to the owner of the parent company increased nearly three times in the second quarter, with earnings per share of 2.08 yuan. Jianidian said that benefiting from the continued growth in global AI server and high-performance computing market demand, the proportion of high-end products has increased, and new production capacity has been gradually opened. The monthly production capacity of drill needles is planned to reach 70 million units by the end of 2027 and 90 million units by the end of 2028.

title_en: The third reading of the 2026 general budget deletes 48 billion yuan and Zhuo Rongtai’s salary is frozen for four months
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the 2026 central general budget on third reading on the 14th. The original budget was 334.9 billion yuan. After deliberation by the government and the opposition, the total budget was deleted by 1.689%, totaling 48 billion yuan, which is about one-fifth of the 207.5 billion yuan deleted last year. In addition, the Kuomintang group proposed a freeze on the executive president’s salary of NT$1.488 million from September to December, which was also passed in the vote. Since the case has passed the third reading, there will be no additional meeting on the 17th.

title_en: The El Niño phenomenon causes drought! Impact on Panama Canal shipping: ONE cargo ship pays "such a sky-high price" for tolls
summary_en: Affected by the strong El Niño phenomenon, the Panama Canal is facing a severe drought, forcing authorities to tighten ship draft restrictions, causing global shipping costs to soar. Japan's Ocean Network Shipping Company (ONE) recently paid a sky-high price of US$4 million to seize the priority right of passage in the Panama Canal, which shows that shipping companies are willing to spend a lot of money to compete for passage time in order to avoid delays in shipping schedules. Data show that the average price during the recent canal auction period has reached 16 times last year, and as draft restrictions become more stringent, large container ships are facing load reduction pressure. Amid climate change and geopolitical interference, the global shipping chain may continue to face the risk of rising freight costs, and shipping costs may continue to rise, affecting global trade logistics operations.

title: 兆基大老闆財務爆雷，10萬社宅租戶金流、業者內控危機浮現...包租代管監管漏洞怎麼補？
summary: 兆基事件爆發，讓政府視為活化空屋、擴大租屋供給利器的包租代管產業陷入信任危機。從租金、押金管理到業者財務透明度，制度長期存在的風險，也隨兆基案一一浮現。全國最大包租代管業者兆基集團爆發債務危機，兆基屋管前董事長暨大股東李建成涉嫌違法吸金及挪用公司資金，8月7日經檢調約談後，遭法院裁定羈押。事件爆發後，兆基屋管原由第2大股東宏碁法人代表李文詳接任董事長，但宏碁發現公司內控缺失，兩天後又閃辭；總經理一職隨後則由中纖集團的王貴增代理。由於兆基屋管目前負責管理全國2萬7千餘戶房屋，其中「社會住宅包租代管」物件更占60％，假使兆基資金斷鏈，可能影響房東租金收入與房客預繳的押金，令業界憂慮，一場由企業主個人財務缺口而起的風暴，是否將蔓延至整個包租代管產業，甚至衝擊社會對包租代管政策的信心。

From rent and deposit management to industry financial transparency, the long-term risks of the system have also emerged one by one with the Zhao Kee case. A debt crisis broke out at Zhaoji Group, the country's largest leasing and management company. Li Jiancheng, the former chairman and major shareholder of Zhaoji Housing Management, was suspected of illegally attracting money and misappropriating company funds. After an investigation and interview on August 7, he was ordered to be detained by the court. After the incident broke out, Li Wenxiang, the legal representative of the second largest shareholder Acer, originally took over as chairman of Zhaoji Housing Management. However, Acer discovered that the company's internal controls were lacking and resigned two days later; the general manager position was subsequently replaced by Wang Guizeng of China Fiber Group. Since Siu Kee Housing Management is currently responsible for the management of more than 27,000 houses across the country, of which "social housing leasing and management" properties account for 60%. If Siu Kei's funds are disconnected, it may affect landlords' rental income and tenants' prepaid deposits, causing the industry to worry about whether a storm caused by a business owner's personal financial gap will spread to the entire leasing and management industry, and even affect society's confidence in the leasing and management policy.

title_en: From starting from scratch to looking at others from time to time, the CEO of Caesar Bathroom: Always worry about troubles, otherwise you will be trampled to death! From one-piece basins to plasma faucets, how to build tall walls
summary_en: Looking at Taiwan's tens of billions of sanitary ware market, Caesar Sanitary Ware is at a critical stage of "sitting back and forth"; from being the only one in Asia with high-temperature refractory porcelain technology to the world's first plasma sterilization faucet, it has adopted a "differentiated" layout to embrace a broader future. "Can you tell what's different about this basin?" As soon as we arrived at Caesar Bathroom's display center in Neihu, Taipei, and before we could even sit down, chairman Xiao Junxiang opened an unpublished product catalog and pushed it in front of the reporter of "Today's Weekly". What is on the page is Caesar's most classic product - the one-piece square basin. Many housewives and plumbers know Caesar because of this basin. "One-piece molding" may seem simple, but the technical threshold is unusual. It was in 2002 that Caesar introduced high-temperature refractory porcelain technology (FFC) from high-end European brands to reduce the shrinkage ratio of porcelain during firing and make the basin less likely to deform.

title_en: Hitting the highest record in 39 years, the Accounting and Accounting Office revised up this year’s GDP growth rate to 11.05%
summary_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) business opportunities have exploded, stimulating the dual engines of exports and investment. The General Accounting Office has revised this year's economic growth rate up to 11.05%, a substantial increase of 1.41 percentage points from the May forecast of 9.64%, setting a 39-year high since 1988; the economic growth rate in 2027 will be 6.04%. However, the annual growth rate of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) this year was revised upward to 2.07%, and the price situation is relatively severe.

title_en: The United States imposes high tariffs on drones, Taiwan obtains a 15% non-overlapping tariff, and industry operators welcome the opportunity to transfer orders
summary_en: The United States announced that it will impose a 100% tariff on large and sensitive drones, of which the tax rate for Taiwan is 15% and does not include MFN. In this regard, the Executive Yuan's Taiwan-U.S. Economic and Trade Working Group stated that Taiwan is a country that applies relatively low tax rates, which will help maintain the relative competitive advantage of our country's products exported to the United States. It is expected that as the United States continues to strengthen its reliable supply chain and the drone market demand grows, Chinese companies will have opportunities to secure potential transfer orders and expand business opportunities exported to the United States.

title_en: TSMC and AUO enter advanced packaging industry to benefit 24 factories
summary_en: The demand for AI chips has surged, and TSMC has announced plans to cooperate with AUO. It plans to use AUO's Zhongke factory to expand advanced packaging production capacity, and is expected to develop fan-out panel-level packaging (FOPLP) based on the Innolux model. With the advancement of advanced technologies such as CoPoS and COUPE, the semiconductor supply chain has entered a new round of growth. According to legal analysis, advanced packaging is developing towards large size and high density, driving the demand for testing equipment and materials. Major optical testing manufacturers such as Quantum, Mude and Jingcaike, as well as equipment manufacturers such as Reco and Tisheng, have recently been overtaken by foreign investment. As the cooperation model between TSMC and panel manufacturers takes shape, the local equipment and material supply chain will usher in long-term growth opportunities. Investors should carefully assess market risks.

summary_en: The United States announced that retail sales in July fell by 0.6% month-on-month and the drop exceeded expectations, showing signs of slowdown in domestic consumption and further weakening the market's bets on the Federal Reserve raising interest rates in September. The major U.S. stock indexes turned from red to black during the session. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 108.72 points or 0.20% to temporarily close at 53,731.27 points. The S&P 500 index It fell 10.72 points or 0.14% to temporarily report 7,788.27 points. The Nasdaq Composite Index fell 99.22 points or 0.37% to temporarily report 26,703.81 points. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 112.42 points or 0.90% to temporarily report 12,343.58 points, reflecting that the technology and semiconductor groups are facing greater selling pressure.

title_en: The revenue of listed OTC companies in July was impressive. CITIC Investment Bank: Taiwan stocks are expected to continue their bullish trend in the fourth quarter.
summary_en: The revenue of listed OTC companies in Taiwan in July was outstanding. According to statistics from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the revenue of other 1,051 listed OTC companies, excluding 32 companies in the financial and insurance industry and three commercial investment companies, reached 5.39 trillion yuan in July, an annual increase of 48.16%. In addition, the revenue of listed OTC companies totaled 2.2101 billion yuan, an annual increase of 28%. Xu Qiwei, manager of China Trust Taiwan Vitality Fund, said that revenue data shows that the fundamentals of Taiwan's listed OTC companies continue to grow steadily. Benefiting from the continued strong demand for AI and the return of foreign funds, the rebound of Taiwan stocks is worth looking forward to.

summary_en: A netizen recently saw a building + sky building project and locked in the room type with front yard parking. He also emphasized that the house's 59 square feet plus the agreed land of 9 square feet equals 68 square feet. The total price must be calculated using 68 square feet, and it can be sold together in the future if it is resold. They couldn't help but wonder: "Will the bank appraisal also be included?"

title_en: Chen Xingyu gets divorced/the house is given away, but the debt is still there! Chen Xingyu stepped on the thunder by donating a house. Lawyer teaches 1 trick to leave a way out
summary_en:
"Chen Xingyu's real estate was transferred to Zhao Jianming in the form of a 'spousal gift', but the loan was left to himself. The relationship between the couple is good, what's yours is mine, and what's mine is yours, of course there is no problem," Wu Shenghuang, a lecturer in the Department of Real Estate Management of Hongguo Delin University of Science and Technology, emphasized, "But from a legal perspective, after the house is given to the other party, 'yours "It's yours," but the loan remains with you, "What's mine is still mine."

Lawyers advise that before making a gift, a contract such as "donation with burden" or "donation with conditions" should be signed, stating the recipient's obligations in black and white. If the recipient fails to perform, the donor can revoke the gift and take the house back in accordance with the law.

title: Vanguard 國際高股息 ETF 今年表現強勁，超越美股兩大指數型基金

title_en: Vanguard International High Dividend ETF performed strongly this year, outperforming the two major U.S. stock index funds
summary_en: Picture/This newspaper’s database Merchant Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports So far in 2026, Vanguard’s International High Dividend ETF (VYMI), which tracks international markets, has shown outstanding performance, and its returns and dividends have surpassed two popular U.S. market index funds: Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) and Total Stock Market ETF (VTI). According to "Pluang.com", VYMI has achieved better results than the US stock market this year, and this achievement did not rely on any leverage or complex financial operations. The International High Dividend ETF (VYMI) seeks to invest in a portfolio of stocks of companies that pay higher dividends in global (excluding the United States) markets. The performance of this fund provides a worthy reference for long-term investors seeking overseas asset allocation. In comparison, the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) tracks the performance of the 500 largest U.S. public companies by market capitalization, while the Total Stock Market ETF (VTI) covers the overall U.S. stock market. VYMI's ability to surpass these two representative U.S. stock funds this year highlights the investment potential that international markets may have at certain times. [Reminder] Overseas investment involves exchange rate fluctuation risks. This article is for reference only and does not constitute investment advice.

title_en: Travel expenses have increased, but demand has not been refunded? There’s a mystery behind why Taiwanese people go abroad and “buy sooner,”
summary_en: Travel is getting more and more expensive, why do Taiwanese people still fly anyway? In the fourth quarter of this year, tour fares in Japan, Australia, Europe, Central Asia and Africa generally rose. In Australia, they even increased by 18% compared with the same period last year. It stands to reason that rising prices should suppress demand, but what travel agencies see is a different picture: Not only do travelers not significantly shrink, but they also buy earlier and earlier. The visibility of orders has been increasing, and some operators have even seen the third quarter of 2027. High travel costs have not cooled down the tourism craze, but are changing Taiwanese people's understanding of "how to play, when to buy, and where to spend money."

title_en: Japan’s ICT market is growing steadily and will reach US$533.3 billion in 2034
summary_en: Picture / Database Business Media | Wu Chengyue / Taipei Report According to the latest report from market research firm Imarc Group, Japan’s information and communication technology (ICT, which refers to the use of information and communication technology to process and transmit information) market is expected to grow steadily in the next eight years, reaching a scale of US$533.3 billion by 2034. The main driving force for the growth of Japan's ICT market comes from the acceleration of enterprise digital transformation (DX) and the strengthening of artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductor ecosystems. Various industries, including government services, manufacturing, healthcare and retail, are actively investing in technologies such as cloud computing, data infrastructure, AI and automation to improve productivity and operational efficiency. In particular, the widespread adoption of generative AI and advanced computing has stimulated the need for more powerful digital infrastructure. The Japanese government also regards strengthening AI and semiconductors as a focus and further promotes investment in computing, communications, data and security technologies. \nIn addition, labor shortages and demographic changes have also prompted companies to adopt AI, automation and cloud solutions to increase productivity with limited human resources. title_en: The AI ​​industry sector is rapidly expanding and investment portfolios need to have “multi-level” thinking
summary_en: Picture/This newspaper’s database Shang Media | Ye Anting/Comprehensive foreign news reports With the rapid development of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, the past investment strategy of simply betting on a few technology giants has become insufficient. The AI ​​craze is no longer limited to a few leading fields, but has spread to multiple levels such as chips, cloud platforms, agents (intelligent agents), memory, networks, power and software, making the construction of AI investment portfolios more complex. According to "InvestorPlace", the evolution of the market has allowed the AI ​​economy to include model manufacturers, consumer platforms, chip designers, memory suppliers, network builders, power suppliers and software companies. These companies each have different profit models and bear different risks. For example, the Muse Glimmer model launched by Meta, the new Agent function of Google Maps, Microsoft's potential Maia 300 customized AI chip, and the Nemotron 4 ecosystem promoted by Nvidia all show that the AI ​​industry has fully expanded. The report pointed out that owning a group of well-performing AI stocks does not mean that a sound "investment portfolio" can be formed (that is, a strategic allocation that brings together a variety of investment targets to diversify risks and achieve specific financial goals). The key lies in the coherence and interplay between holdings, and understanding the role of each holding in the portfolio.

summary_en: Innolux (3481) announced its second-quarter financial report on the 14th, with single-quarter consolidated revenue of 63.7 billion yuan, a quarter-on-quarter decrease of 4.4%. Benefiting from the continued optimization of its product mix and increasing the proportion of niche high-margin businesses, the gross profit margin bucked the trend and rose slightly to 14.6%, and the EBITDA margin reached 14. 3%, the operating profit of the industry was 1.63 billion yuan, and the net profit attributable to owners of the parent company was 4.532 billion yuan, a significant increase of 178.09% from the first quarter. It not only maintained profits for 4 consecutive quarters, but also set a new high in the past 6 quarters.

title_en: Korean cosmetics have dominated the global market for ten years, and the ODM/OEM model has become the biggest driving force behind the scenes.
summary_en: Picture / Our database Business Media | Wu Chengyue / Taipei report In the past ten years, the rise of K-Beauty in the global market has not only relied on brand marketing, but more importantly, the driving force behind the scenes comes from South Korea's powerful ODM/OEM (Original Design and Manufacturing/Original Production) industry. These manufacturers have evolved from simple OEMs to comprehensive beauty solution providers integrating R&D, production, supply chain and global market services. Initially, Korean cosmetics manufacturers mainly operated under the OEM (Original Manufacturing) model, that is, they produced according to the concepts and specifications provided by the brand. Subsequently, manufacturers developed the ODM (original design and manufacturing) model, which is not only responsible for production, but also invests in product research and development, formula design, and even proactively proposes products in line with market trends to brands, and is responsible for production and quality control. This model allows the manufacturer to become a solid backer of the brand. Major Korean manufacturers such as Cosmax, Kolmar Korea Co., Ltd. and Cosmecca Korea Co., Ltd have transcended their mere OEM role to become global providers of beauty solutions. They not only analyze consumer trends and develop patented formulas and materials, but also assist client brands in expanding overseas markets. title_en: Vietnam's trade deficit reached US$20.3 billion in the first seven months, and the deputy prime minister instructed many ministries to rescue exports
summary_en: Picture/This newspaper’s database Shang Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports Vietnam’s Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc chaired a meeting on Thursday to discuss how to significantly increase exports and control the expanding trade deficit. In the first seven months of this year, Vietnam's total import and export volume reached approximately US$659 billion, an increase of 28.1% over the same period last year, of which export value was US$319.7 billion, an increase of 21.7%. However, a trade deficit of approximately US$20.3 billion was recorded during the same period (meaning imports were greater than exports), highlighting the challenges Vietnam faces in balancing trade. Vietnamese officials predict that, barring major adverse factors, full-year exports are expected to grow by about 15% to 16%. The analysis pointed out that Vietnam's foreign direct investment (FDI) sector performed strongly, with import and export volume reaching approximately US$255 billion, a growth of 26.5%; while the import and export volume of the domestic economic sector was approximately US$64.6 billion, a growth of 5.8%. In terms of exports, processed industrial products such as computers, electronic products and components grew significantly, with a value of approximately US$85 billion, an increase of 50%; machinery equipment and parts accounted for approximately US$40 billion, an increase of 24.6%; telephones and components accounted for approximately US$38 billion, an increase of 18.6%. However, the growth of some traditional export industries such as textiles, footwear and wood products has slowed down, and the export value of agricultural products such as coffee, rice, rubber and tea has even declined. The expansion of the trade deficit is mainly due to the use of computers, electronic products and components for domestic production and investment

title_en: Trump’s tariffs rewrite global trade rules, companies move towards a new order, and the battle for supply chain resilience officially begins
summary_en: The global economic and trade order is moving from "fighting for costs" to "fighting for resilience." Faced with Trump's use of tariffs, investment and economic security tools to reshape trade rules, Taiwan must not only strive for a stable and predictable Taiwan-US economic and trade structure, but also companies must bid farewell to the past era of simple actuarial tariff costs and re-examine every supply chain risk from raw material sources, origins to investment layouts.

title_en: Rongcheng Dharma Conference/Mainland Industrial Paper has emerged from the economic low point, and paper prices still have a chance to rise during the peak season in the second half of the year
summary_en: Rongcheng (1909) held a press conference on the 14th and stated that the industrial paper market in mainland China has gradually come out of the low point of the economy in the past few years, and the industry is basically heading towards positive development. Although the price of industrial paper has experienced some high-end consolidation due to the large cumulative increase in the second quarter from the end of July to the beginning of August, the current overall supply and demand situation remains healthy, and no obvious weakening of demand has been seen. Depending on the demand in the peak season, paper prices will still have the opportunity to rise. Regarding operations in the second half of the year, the company maintains a cautiously optimistic view.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zhao Minya, Taipei, 14th) The housing agency said today that the number of residential properties without farmhouses in the first half of the year reached 50,723, a 28.2% decrease from the same period last year, a record low for the same period since 2018. title: 超哥不幹了！被酸開一間倒一間　認了是「超倒體」宣布收攤：不拖累家人
summary: 知名網紅「超哥」近期因經營餐飲事業屢屢傳出關店消息，被網友戲稱為「超倒體」。對此，超哥拍片正面回應，坦言因自身經營能力不足，加上先前大腸癌開刀後體力有限，決定結束餐飲事業以停損。他感嘆創業初衷原是為了幫助朋友並傳承美味，未料卻虧損不斷且惹來諸多是非，全家人更曾一同在店內端菜洗碗，讓他感到相當心酸。如今決定收攤，他表示心情反而鬆了一口氣，不再讓不成熟的決策拖累家人。雖然創業之路以失敗告終，但他對過程心懷感恩，並慶幸學會了廚藝能親自下廚，為這段創業旅程正式畫下句點。

title_en: Brother Chao quits! After being forced to open one shop and then another, he admitted that he was a "super inverted body" and announced that he would close the stall: He would not be a drag on his family.
summary_en: The well-known Internet celebrity "Chao Ge" has recently been reported to have closed stores because of his catering business, and he was nicknamed "Chao Ge" by netizens. In response to this, Brother Chao responded positively to the film, saying frankly that due to his lack of business capabilities and his limited physical strength after previous surgery for colorectal cancer, he decided to end his catering business to stop losses. He lamented that the original intention of starting the business was to help friends and pass on delicious food, but he unexpectedly suffered constant losses and caused a lot of trouble. The whole family even served food and washed dishes in the store together, which made him feel very sad. Now that he has decided to close the stall, he said he feels relieved and will no longer let his immature decision-making drag down his family. Although his entrepreneurial journey ended in failure, he was grateful for the process and was glad that he had learned cooking skills and was able to cook himself, which officially brought this entrepreneurial journey to an end.

title_en: Huazhi Dharma Conference/Reduce production and protect prices until mid-October! Mainland China customers begin to buy large amounts of goods, and pulp prices are brewing to rebound
summary_en: Hua Paper (1905) held a press conference on the 14th. General Manager Chen Ruihe said that in the face of low pulp prices and high wood chip and transportation costs, it is currently adopting a production reduction strategy to protect prices. The pulp production reduction is expected to continue until mid-October, after which production will resume. As global pulp mills continue to reduce production, mainland Chinese customers have begun to increase their purchases since the end of July, and the fourth quarter has entered the traditional peak season, pulp prices are expected to have a chance to rebound around mid-October.

title_en: Zhuo Kui: Promote "Taiwan's New Population Countermeasure Strategy" and increase support for families with children
summary_en: The Executive Yuan held a Parent-Child Day event on the 14th. Employees and their families participated in the event, with a total of 241 people, including as many as 100 children. Dean Zhuo Rongtai specially attended to celebrate with children of all ages, interacted cordially and took photos, and distributed "birth bonus" to each child. In addition to 16 groups of three-generation families at the scene today, there was also a group of 88-year-old grandma from a four-generation family attending. Zhuo Rongtai said, "It is 'good' for children to be young, and it is 'treasure' for the elderly." As long as there are "good things and treasures," the family will be happy. He hopes that everyone of all ages can enjoy the warm moment of family reunion today. He also encourages colleagues to take this opportunity to exchange work and family experiences with each other, so that children can get to know each other and become better friends in the future.

title_en: Coal dealer owes NT$4.5 billion but still takes new contract from Taipower: Taipower has filed for international arbitration
summary_en: Regarding media reports on the Taipower Coal Procurement Dispute, Taipower stated on the 14th that Taipower will hold relevant manufacturers responsible for negotiating contracts based on false market price information based on the facts of each case in accordance with the law and the contract. Among them, HVO was determined by the Public Works Commission to have clear illegal facts and was listed as a non-operator for three years according to the law. Taipower has also filed a civil lawsuit to request the refund of the disputed coal purchase amount; Whitehaven has resorted to international arbitration.

title_en: National Development Council: The new system for overseas Chinese students to stay in Taiwan has taken effect, with the number of people allowed to stay in Taiwan reaching 3,239 this year
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zhao Minya, Taipei, 14th) The National Development Council said today that a new system for overseas students who graduated with an associate degree or above to extend their stay and exempt from work permits will be implemented in January this year. As of the end of July, the number of valid permits has reached 3,239 people. Compared with last year when the new system was not implemented, the number of applicants for the whole year was only 281. title_en: Nanya is rumored to have raised the price of copper foil substrates by another 20%. The company responded.
summary_en: There are rumors in the market today that Nanya has submitted a price increase letter to customers. In response to the sharp increase in the cost of raw materials such as copper foil, fiberglass cloth, and resin, the prices of substrates and substrates will each be increased by 20%, effective from September 1. Nanya said today that the price increase is a fact. Since this year, it has negotiated with customers to increase product prices several times in response to rising material costs. However, this document is not a formal price increase notice issued by the company. The company has not raised prices to customers by 20% in a comprehensive and one-time manner. However, the price of electronic materials has been adjusted several times this year, and the cumulative increase has more than doubled.

title: 用了超過一甲子的糖尿病老藥 科學家終於發現關鍵機轉
summary: 二甲雙胍（Metformin）是治療第二型糖尿病超過 60 年的經典藥物。多年來，學界普遍認為它主要透過影響肝臟及腸道代謝來控制血糖。然而，美國貝勒醫學院（Baylor College of Medicine）的科學家發現，大腦竟是這款老藥的重要作用器官。本次研究顯示，二甲雙胍會直接影響腦內的神經迴路，幫助調節全身血糖。研究結果已刊登在國際期刊《Science Advances》，並讓人們重新認識這款用了數十年的藥物。
title_zh: 用了超過一甲子的糖尿病老藥 科學家終於發現關鍵機轉
summary_zh: 二甲雙胍（Metformin）是治療第二型糖尿病超過 60 年的經典藥物。多年來，學界普遍認為它主要透過影響肝臟及腸道代謝來控制血糖。然而，美國貝勒醫學院（Baylor College of Medicine）的科學家發現，大腦竟是這款老藥的重要作用器官。本次研究顯示，二甲雙胍會直接影響腦內的神經迴路，幫助調節全身血糖。研究結果已刊登在國際期刊《Science Advances》，並讓人們重新認識這款用了數十年的藥物。
title_en: After using an old diabetes drug for more than a decade, scientists finally discovered the key mechanism
summary_en: Metformin is a classic drug used to treat type 2 diabetes for more than 60 years. For many years, academic circles generally believe that it mainly controls blood sugar by affecting liver and intestinal metabolism. However, scientists at Baylor College of Medicine in the United States discovered that the brain is actually an important organ for this old drug. This study shows that metformin directly affects neural circuits in the brain and helps regulate systemic blood sugar. The research results have been published in the international journal "Science Advances" and have given people a new understanding of this drug that has been used for decades.
