title_en: Pre-market on August 14th/Inflation expectations cool, AI fundamentals support, Taiwan stocks fluctuate and firm
summary_en:
Yesterday's market trend
The U.S. CPI data for July was in line with expectations, expectations for interest rate hikes have cooled, and the sharp rise in the Federal Reserve Index encouraged Taiwan stocks to jump higher and rise sharply on Thursday, successfully closing at the 46,000 mark, and the trading volume also increased to more than 1 trillion. Funds on the market maintain a healthy stock rotation, benefiting from the expansion of AI and memory production, which extends all the way to the upstream materials end. According to the latest SEMI statistics, silicon wafer shipments are booming in the second quarter, and relevant groups have strong performance with multi-level lights and daily limits. In addition, with the surge in the stock prices of major Japanese manufacturers, the leading manufacturer Guoju has sounded the clarion call for counterattack due to the surge in stock prices of major Japanese manufacturers.
In terms of weight stocks, TSMC rose 0.83%, Hon Hai fell 2.96%, MediaTek rose 5.23%, Quanta fell 0.15%, and Delta Electronics rose 5.31%. The strong stocks on the market include Yageo*, Xinchang Electronics, Huaxinke, Global Crystal, Taiwan Sembcorp, Hejing, ASUS, Qihong, etc. 43 daily limit; Heyi, Yujingguang, Jingguo, Junbao, Creative, An Qi, Yingguang, etc. have increased by more than 7%. Weak stocks on the market, such as Jiaze and Fengqing, fell by the limit; Merida, Airtac-KY, IEI, Jiada, etc. fell more than 6%.
At the end, the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 503.41 points to close at 46021.48 points, with a trading volume of 1.04 trillion yuan. Observing the changes in the market, the three major categories of stocks had mixed gains and losses, with electronics rising 1.42%, transmission falling 0.27%, and financials falling 0.27%. Among the subgroups, information services, computers and peripheral equipment, and electronic components performed better, rising by 4.08%, 3.03%, and 2.45% respectively.

summary: 【財訊快報／黃啟乙】台股短線拉回，指數呈現突破各條均線後再度回測的走勢，其中台積電(2330)在2,400元上下震盪，加上被動元件股出現回檔，令大盤承壓。不過，整體盤勢仍屬反彈後的整理，後續仍須觀察主要權值股及強勢族群能否重新站穩。 值得注意的是，立法院已決定通過無人機法案，激勵相關軍工族群全面走強，包括漢翔(2634)、雷虎(8033)、亞航(2630)、長榮航太(2645)、龍德造船(6753)、創泓科技(7714)及邑錡(7402)等，紛紛攻上漲停，顯示政策題材加持下，資金重新聚焦無人機與軍工產業。 其中，龍德造船目前股價位階相對仍低，上半年EPS達6.55元，基本面表現亮眼。若後續軍工族群在政策利多帶動下重新展開攻勢，加上龍德造船技術面同步轉強，股價短線不排除進一步向上突破，並有機會成為類股輪動的重要觀察標的。

title: LG Innotek上半年營收或有逾10%來自蘋果，業務覆蓋光學模組與封裝
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，根據韓國LG集團旗下電子元器件製造商LG Innotek週五發佈的上半年報告，該公司上半年10%的營收有可能來自蘋果公司。今年上半年，LG Innotek來自某個客戶的營收合計達8.84兆韓元(62.4億美元)，該客戶業務覆蓋光學模組與封裝業務，占LG Innotek上半年總營收的超10%。LG Innotek表示，這一單筆銷售額是該公司在一年中前六個月向單一客戶達成的最高紀錄。儘管LG Innotek未正式公佈該客戶的名稱。不過，根據銷售金額及公司的業務結構，該客戶很可能為蘋果公司。LG Innotek為蘋果iPhone提供關鍵零組件，包括攝像鏡頭模組和基板。韓國當地時間15：04，LG Innotek(011070 KS)股價上漲7.87%，報658,000韓元。

title: 高盛收購 Upstart 押注主動型 ETF 市場
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導投資銀行高盛（Goldman Sachs）近期透過收購案進一步布局主動型指數股票型基金（ETF）市場，顯示大型金融機構持續看好主動式投資產品的成長潛力，也反映全球ETF市場的競爭正從傳統被動追蹤指數，逐漸延伸至由基金經理人主動管理的產品。主動型ETF（Active ETF）與一般追蹤大盤或特定指數的被動型ETF不同，基金經理人可以依據市場環境、企業基本面及投資策略主動調整持股與資產配置，藉此尋求超越市場平均報酬的機會。同時，這類產品仍保有ETF可於交易時間內買賣、交易方式相對便利等特性，因此近年逐漸受到投資人與資產管理公司的重視。根據《彭博》（Bloomberg）報導，高盛此次收購主動型ETF發行商Upstart，希望藉由外部併購方式強化相關產品與管理能力。由於ETF產業的收購交易相較其他金融領域並不常見，此次行動也凸顯高盛希望進一步擴大主動型ETF市場版圖的策略方向。目前全球ETF市場規模已達約22兆美元，隨著投資人對低成本、交易便利與多元投資策略的需求增加，ETF產品種類也持續擴張。除了傳統股票與債券指數型產品外，主動管理、特定產業及不同投資策略的

title: 泰國數位資產監管趨嚴 Bitazza攜手Sumsub落實Travel Rule
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導泰國數位資產經紀商 Bitazza Co., Ltd. 近日宣布，已完成其 Travel Rule（旅行規則）基礎設施的開發，並將其整合至營運中。此舉旨在強化數位資產交易的透明度與可追溯性，並因應泰國 Securities and Exchange Commission of Thailand 預計於今年稍晚實施的 Travel Rule 規範。 Travel Rule（旅行規則）是防制洗錢金融行動工作組織（Financial Action Task Force, FATF）提出的一項建議。此規定要求數位資產服務提供商（VASP）在進行符合條件的數位資產轉移時，必須蒐集並交換發送方與接收方的特定資訊，藉此加強反洗錢（AML）與打擊資助恐怖主義（CTF）措施，防範非法金融活動。這項規定通常適用於銀行等金融機構，現在延伸至數位資產領域，目的是減少匿名性，增加資金流動的透明度。 Bitazza Co., Ltd. 為泰國財政部許可並受 Securities and Exchange Commission of Thailand 監管的數位資產經紀商。

summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導日本股市近年持續受到海外投資人關注，在股價走高之際，市場也開始討論目前日本股票是否已進入估值偏高階段。日本多家網路證券公司、Asset Management One、Sumitomo Mitsui DS Asset Management及東京證券交易所日前共同舉辦研討會，邀請市場專家分析日本企業價值與尋找潛力股的方向。專家指出，日本股市的吸引力之一，在於市場上仍有不少企業估值相對偏低，未來若改善資本效率與獲利能力，企業價值仍有重新獲得市場評價的空間。其中，股東權益報酬率（ROE）是重要觀察指標之一。相較全球主要市場，日本企業整體ROE過去相對偏低，加上不少企業持有大量現金，使資本運用效率成為市場關注焦點。企業若能將閒置資金投入股票回購、資本支出或併購等用途，不僅有機會改善資本效率，也可能進一步提升股東報酬。為推動相關改革，東京證券交易所自2022年4月起將市場重新劃分為Prime、Standard及Growth三大市場，並自2023年起要求Prime及Standard上市企業更加重視資本成本與股價表現，鼓勵企業持續提升中長期價值。相關改革已逐漸反映

title: 韓國啟動24小時外匯交易逾月，日均成交量成長逾10%
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，韓國財政部週五表示，自7月推出全天候外匯交易以來，外匯市場日均即期交易量增長超過10%。韓國財政經濟部在一次工作組會議上公佈了上述資料。該工作組旨在審查韓元24小時交易系統。該系統於7月6日正式啟動，是韓國政府為改善外國投資者進入韓國金融市場所做努力的一部分。韓國財政部表示，自24小時外匯交易系統啟動以來，市場基礎設施運行平穩，未發生任何事故，韓元兌美元匯率與主要貨幣相比保持穩定。根據國政府統計，今年上半年外匯市場日均即期交易量為173.9億美元，而24小時交易系統啟動後增長10.1%，達到191.4億美元。與會人員指出，由於系統尚處於初期階段以及與海外市場存在時差等因素，深夜時段交易量的增長速度較為溫和。

title: 傳國民黨放行無人機預算，漢翔、亞航盤中股價奔漲停
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】受到國民黨團傳出放行無人機預算，相關概念股包含漢翔(2634)、亞航(2630)今(14)日盤中急拉漲停，而長榮航太(2645)、晟田(4541)及寶一(8222)盤中股價也都大漲。國民黨立法院黨團今日發出新聞稿，表示國民黨團全力支持發展無人機產業與強化國防，針對經濟部6年442億元「無人載具產業發展統籌型計畫」，及行政院各部會編列的192億採購預算，合計634億全數通過。受此激勵，相關概念股漢翔、亞航盤中急拉漲停，而長榮航太、晟田及寶一盤中股價也都大漲。不過值得留意的是，美國川普政府傳出對進口無人機課10%至100%關稅，其中台灣等六地適用15%。根據路透報導，美國總統川普(Donald Trump)簽署公告，以進口無人機及其零組件威脅國家安全為由，課徵10%至100%從價關稅，藉此降低美國對外國無人機技術與供應鏈依賴，並擴大國內無人機及關鍵零組件產能。包含來自歐盟、日本、列支敦士登、韓國、瑞士及台灣的無人機與零組件，適用15%關稅。

It also introduces the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) standard post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithm at the system level. title: 中國熊貓債年內發行突破2千億人民幣創高，超越過去兩年全年規模
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】據中國《證券日報》報導，人民幣融資成本優勢及境外機構籌資需求升溫，推動中國熊貓債市場加速擴張。Wind數據顯示，截至8月13日，今年熊貓債發行規模已達2,024.75億元(人民幣，下同)，年增73.57%，提前刷新歷年全年最高紀錄。今年迄今發行規模已超越2025年全年的1,835.6億元及2024年全年的1,948億元，顯示境外政府、國際開發機構、金融機構及跨國企業使用人民幣融資的意願持續升高。熊貓債是指境外發行人在中國境內債券市場發行、以人民幣計價的債券。主權發行人亦持續增加。巴西財政部日前表示，計畫在2026年內首次於中國市場發行人民幣計價主權熊貓債，擬發行規模為50億元；巴西已於6月25日向中國銀行間市場交易商協會遞交申請，若順利完成，將成為首個註冊發行主權熊貓債的拉丁美洲國家。市場人士認為，中國境內利率相對較低、人民幣匯率趨穩，加上熊貓債准入及資金使用制度逐步完善，共同提高境外發行人的籌資意願。巴西加入後，主權熊貓債發行人地域將進一步由歐洲、亞洲及非洲擴展至拉丁美洲，有助擴大人民幣跨境融資及國際使用範圍。

title: KOSPI自低點反彈逾22%步入技術性牛市，對沖基金低持倉恐觸發追價
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】《華爾街日報》報導，韓股週四延續強勁反彈，韓國綜合股價指數(KOSPI)收漲234.30點或3.56%，報6,813.34點，連續第四個交易日上揚，近四日累計漲約8.8%。指數較7月30日低點反彈逾22%，跨越自低點上漲20%的門檻，正式進入技術性牛市，從空頭市場翻轉至多頭市場僅花約兩週時間。記憶體雙雄為本輪反彈主力，三星電子收漲4.89%至26.8萬韓元，SK海力士大漲5.92%至159.3萬韓元。市場對AI數據中心投資及記憶體需求前景重拾信心，加上三星與SK海力士可能提高股東回報的預期，帶動科技股買氣；KOSPI波動率指數則較近期高峰近乎腰斬，顯示市場情緒已由7月恐慌性去槓桿轉向較穩定的風險承擔。高盛交易台數據顯示，外資近期淨買入KOSPI股票約12億美元，其中約11億美元集中於科技類股；韓國本地機構淨買入約3.83億美元，科技類股買超約4.32億美元。相較之下，散戶趁反彈獲利了結，單是科技類股便淨賣出約15億美元，形成外資與機構接手、散戶退場的資金結構。值得注意的是，對沖基金在7月暴跌後已大幅削減韓股部位，目前持倉回升速度明顯落後KOSPI逾22%的反彈幅度。

title: 茂達H1每股盈餘7.64元，H2多項產品展開、營運倒吃甘蔗
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】IC設計廠茂達(6138)公布第二季財報，單季歸屬母公司業主淨利2.9億元，季增7.79%、年增47.71%，每股盈餘3.96元；上半年歸屬母公司業主淨利5.59億元、年增44.7%，每股盈餘7.64元。茂達下半年將迎來多項關鍵成長動能，除了上半年已調漲部分產品報價0%至15%之外，由於AI運算對電源管理架構的複雜度及散熱效率要求更高，茂達產品的單機價值預期將隨之提升，特別是在高階伺服器與電競筆電領域，具備高平均銷售單價的三相風扇驅動IC需求轉強，目前散熱IC在客戶端進行測試中，預估2027年伺服器散熱應用開始貢獻收益，而伺服器電源產品則在今年第四季開始送樣給客戶，最快在2027年可見效益顯現。此外，DDR5記憶體模組的電源管理IC仍是核心增長引擎，茂達在該領域佈局領先，並持續供應英特爾與AMD新平台的電源方案，隨著市場主流由DDR4轉向DDR5的趨勢加速，茂達的滲透率將進一步擴大，確保下半年紮實的成長基礎。在車用電子方面，公司鎖定車用風扇與車內照明電源管理，目前已開始小規模貢獻營收。

title: 古澤滿宏示警日圓顯著低估，美日或再聯手干預、日銀9月可能加息
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】日本財務省前財務官古澤滿宏(Mitsuhiro Furusawa)接受外電訪問時表示，日圓匯價目前「顯然過低」，日本與美國可能隨時再次聯手入市干預；日本央行(日銀)為遏制日圓貶值及輸入型通膨，亦可能較市場原先預期更快加息。古澤指出，日圓過度疲弱持續推高能源、食品及原材料進口成本，正在損害日本經濟及家庭購買力。若美元兌日圓重新升至7月底美日聯合干預前的水準，日本與美國可能再次採取買進日圓的協調行動，以阻止匯價出現失序波動。在貨幣政策方面，古澤認為，日銀可能在9月會議加息，之後於12月或2027年1月再次採取行動，最終希望把政策利率逐步提高至1.5%至1.75%左右。市場目前反映日本央行9月加息機率約76%，較7月底聯合干預前的24%大幅上升。日圓在7月底至8月初的聯合干預後一度升值約5%，但近期升勢明顯消退。紐約匯市週四美元兌日圓收在159.50日圓，高於前一日的159.43日圓，並重新逼近160日圓關卡，顯示單靠匯市干預難以持續支撐日圓，日銀能否加快政策正常化將成為後續走勢關鍵。

title: 升息疑慮降溫，美國公債殖利率週四齊跌，10年期下滑4.98個基點
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】美國公債價格週四上揚，引領殖利率下滑，因交易員下調升息押注並佈局未來降息。根據債券交易報價，2年期公債價格上揚，殖利率下滑5.87個基點，報4.1424%；5年期公債價格上漲，殖利率下跌6.54個基點，報4.3164%。10年期公債價格上升，殖利率下跌4.98個基點，報4.6427%；30年期公債價格上揚，殖利率滑落4.49個基點，報5.2125%。週四發布的數據顯示，美國7月生產者價格指數(PPI)表現偏軟。同時，隨著交易員評估有關荷姆茲海峽運輸的說法，油價下跌助推債市漲勢。此外，250億美元30年期美債標售的得標殖利率較發行前交易水準高0.4個基點。一級交易商獲配比例為11.5%，高於上次。間接投標人獲配比例降至66.8%，而直接投標人獲配比例升至21.6%。投標倍數為2.39倍，而過去六次新券標售的平均水平為2.36倍。短天期利率方面，交易員繼續賣出10月聯邦基金利率期貨，這一交易主題貫穿本週。資金流包括一筆1.5萬份的大宗賣單等；空頭倉位押注聯準會可能在9月政策會議上升。美國有擔保隔夜融資利率(SOFR)期權方面，交易員對3月到期的降息押注有需求。

title_en: Taiwan stocks are likely to continue their rebound on Friday, pay attention to the performance of memory stocks
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Wei Shengfeng] Following the good performance of US CPI data the day before, the PPI index released on Thursday was also lower than market expectations, reducing the risk of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates in the short term and inspiring US stocks to rise for the second consecutive day on Thursday. However, after short-term gains in U.S. stocks on Thursday, gains converged in late trading, with none of the four major indexes rising more than 1%. However, the memory group performed well. Micron Technology's stock price rose 4.23%, Vetton Electronics' stock price rose 7.31%, SanDisk's stock price rose 13.67%, Seagate Technology's stock price rose 4.91%, and SK Hynix ADR rose 7.29%. title_en: Yutai International's EPS in the first half of the year was 0.87 yuan, maintaining a cautiously optimistic view on full-year operations.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Liu Juquan] Yutai International (7716) announced consolidated revenue of 1.001 billion yuan in the first half of the year, operating gross profit of 204 million yuan, operating profit of 31.33 million yuan, net profit after tax of 19.89 million yuan, and earnings per share (EPS) of 0.87 yuan. Single-quarter revenue in the second quarter was 556 million yuan, a quarterly growth of approximately 25%, and an annual growth rate of approximately 4.6%; single-quarter net profit after tax was 15.96 million yuan, an annual growth rate of approximately 134%. Single-quarter EPS in the second quarter was approximately 0.7 yuan, significantly better than 0.17 yuan in the first quarter, indicating that customer shipment demand is gradually recovering, and the overall operation has shown a trend of improvement quarter by quarter. Yutai International stated that its consolidated revenue in the first half of the year decreased by approximately 4.8% compared with the same period last year, and operating profits and profits also decreased slightly compared with the same period last year, mainly due to the relatively high base period of the same period last year. In the first half of last year, some manufacturing customers prepared goods in advance, resulting in better-than-average revenue and profit performance during the same period. In contrast, this year's market shipment pace gradually returned to normal, and the global shipping market in the first quarter was still affected by freight rate revisions and increased capacity supply, resulting in a slight decline in overall operating performance in the first half compared to the same period last year. However, as market demand gradually improved in the second quarter, customer shipment momentum continued to rebound, and operations were significantly better than in the first quarter. Yutai International stated that in recent years, more and more Taiwanese electronics, high-tech and manufacturing customers have continued to expand their investment layout in Vietnam, driving the steady growth of demand for cross-border logistics and supply chain integration services. Yutai International stated that the proportion of profits from Vietnam has increased from approximately 42% in the same period last year to 67%, indicating continued deepening in recent years.

title_en: With the support of festivals and exhibitions, Humble House Q2 catering and housing are booming simultaneously, and H1 earnings per share are 2.73 yuan.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Chen Haoning] Humble House (2739)'s second-quarter revenue was 1.268 billion yuan, an annual increase of 5.83%, setting a new high for the same period in previous years. Operating profit was 171 million yuan, an annual increase of 107.73%. After-tax net profit was 131 million yuan, an annual increase of 228.29%. EPS was 1.43 yuan, and the cumulative EPS for the first half of the year was 2.73 yuan. In the second quarter, thanks to the effects of Mother's Day dinner parties, the Dragon Boat Festival, the graduation season and the Taipei International Computer Show, catering and housing revenue increased simultaneously, driving overall profit performance. Humble House's net profit after tax in the first half of the year reached 250 million yuan, an annual increase of 158.28%, and earnings per share were 2.73 yuan. Excellent operating performance during the peak season in the first quarter, coupled with the upward trend of Taiwan's stock market, improved financial asset evaluations compared with the same period last year, driving an overall profit recovery. In the second quarter, with the help of festival business opportunities and international exhibition effects, it performed well in the off-season. Among them, in June, especially driven by the Taipei International Computex, the occupancy rate and average room price of its Taipei international hotels increased simultaneously. The Sheraton Taipei Hotel also received accommodation demand from the Rotary International Annual Meeting. In June, the occupancy rate of the Sheraton Taipei Hotel was nearly 80%, and the average room price was about 6,300 yuan. The occupancy rate of Le Méridien Taipei was nearly 90%, and the average room price was about 11,000 yuan. Entering the third quarter, Humble House said that summer travel demand and summer seafood catering schedules are expected to drive the family hotel and catering market, continuing the overall operating strength. title_en: JESPER pioneered four-in-one service to create new value in the automotive after-sales service market
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Dai Haiqian] As the demand for car maintenance increases, consumers’ expectations for services have also shifted from single functions to paying more attention to quality, efficiency, transparency and overall experience. Aiming at the market's shift from "functional demand" to "value display", JESPER (7831) has deepened the layout of automobile after-sales services in Taiwan and built JESPER's "all-round automobile service center" in the core member area of ​​Hsinchu. It is the first to integrate the four major services of "car beauty × maintenance × tires × micro sheet metal" into a one-stop composite store to respond to the more convenient and complete car maintenance needs of the new generation of car owners. Taiwan’s auto market is experiencing a consumption shift in which “car buying is cooling down and car ownership is heating up.” The annual number of new cars listed in Taiwan in 2025 will be 414,000, a year-on-year decrease of 9.4%, which has been in decline for two consecutive years. On the other hand, the number of cars in Taiwan has increased to 8.72 million, and the average ownership period has been extended to 11.1 years. "Buy fewer cars, drive them longer" has gradually become the new normal in the market. Compared with the cooling of the new car market, the auto beauty industry is still growing against the trend, with an estimated compound annual growth rate of 4.5% from 2025 to 2031, and the market size is estimated to grow to 98.6 billion yuan, indicating that the focus of consumption is gradually shifting from "functional cars" to "refined cars", driving the demand for automotive after-sales services to continue to grow. Peng Shibang, chairman of Jiebo, said that Jiebo does not just provide one-time services, but continues to build an automotive after-sales service ecosystem with car owners as the core, integrating car beauty, tires, maintenance and micro sheet metal, plus membership and cross-industry cooperation and other diversified services, through a comfortable store space

title: 證交所提醒，不法人士冒名董事長散布投資詐騙訊息，籲請民眾警覺
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】臺灣證券交易所近期發現，有不法人士於LINE、Facebook等社群平台及通訊軟體，冒用證交所董事長名義、照片，甚至利用人工智慧（AI）深偽技術製作影像或影音內容，發布投資訊息、招攬加入投資群組或推介金融商品，意圖誤導民眾並從事詐騙行為。證交所鄭重聲明，證交所董事長從未建立或經營任何投資群組，亦未以個人名義設立Facebook粉絲專頁、LINE官方帳號或其他社群帳號從事投資招攬活動；證交所及所屬員工亦不會透過社群媒體、通訊軟體或投資群組向民眾推薦個股、招攬投資、保證獲利，或要求提供個人資料、帳戶資訊及匯款。證交所呼籲，民眾如對涉及證交所或其員工之訊息真偽有任何疑問，可逕洽證交所投資人服務中心專線(02)2792-8188，或透過證交所民意信箱求證。若發現疑似詐騙情事，亦可檢具相關事證向警政署165反詐騙專線、165打詐儀錶板或警察機關檢舉，共同防範金融詐騙，維護自身財產安全。

title_en: The stock exchange reminded that criminals impersonated the chairman to spread investment fraud messages, and called on the public to be vigilant.
summary_en: [Financial News/Reported by Reporter Liu Juquan] The Taiwan Stock Exchange has recently discovered that criminals have used social platforms and communication software such as LINE and Facebook to impersonate the name and photo of the chairman of the stock exchange, and even use artificial intelligence (AI) deep fake technology to produce images or audio-visual content to publish investment information, solicit investment groups, or promote financial products, with the intention of misleading the public and engaging in fraud. The stock exchange solemnly declares that the chairman of the stock exchange has never established or operated any investment group, nor has he set up a Facebook fan page, official LINE account or other social account in his own name to engage in investment solicitation activities; the stock exchange and its employees will not recommend individual stocks to the public, solicit investments, guarantee profits, or require the provision of personal information, account information and remittances through social media, communication software or investment groups. The stock exchange appeals to the public that if they have any questions about the authenticity of information involving the stock exchange or its employees, they can contact the stock exchange investor service center hotline (02) 2792-8188, or seek verification through the stock exchange public opinion mailbox. If you discover a suspected fraud, you can also report it to the Police Department's 165 Anti-Fraud Hotline, 165 Anti-Fraud Dashboard or the police with relevant evidence to jointly prevent financial fraud and maintain the safety of your own property.

title: 泰山擬投標街口全數股權，街口回應尚未進入任何拍賣程序
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】針對泰山(1218)指出要參與街口電子支付100%股權拍賣投標案，街口電子支付昨晚回應指出，目前母公司與泰山之訴訟結果並未確定，亦並未進到任何拍賣程序。公司6、7月已連續兩月獲利，今年有望首度達成全年獲利轉正。泰山先前支付街口金融科技36億元投資款，雙方後續爆發投資交易爭議，泰山於2023年8月30日提起返還投資款訴訟，要求返還35億9580萬元，2025年5月13日獲台北地方法院一審判決勝訴且得為假執行。泰山目前已聲請假執行，並扣押街口金融科技相關財產，其中包括街口金融科技持有的街口電子支付5000萬股，相當於街口電子支付100%股權。針對泰山昨天發布重訊指出，董事會決議參與街口電子支付5000萬股的拍賣投標，後續仍須召開股東臨時會討論及表決。街口支付指出，目前母公司與泰山之訴訟結果並未確定，亦並未進到任何拍賣程序。由於相關訴訟屬於母公司（街口金融科技）之事務，街口支付對此並不了解，亦不便代為回應。街口支付強調，目前發展相當穩健，各項業務及財務數據持續強勁成長，公司6、7月已連續兩月獲利，今年有望首度達成全年獲利轉正。

title_en: Taishan plans to bid for the entire equity of Jiekou, but Jiekou responded that it has not yet entered into any auction process.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Dai Haiqian] In response to Taishan (1218)’s request to participate in the auction bidding case for 100% equity of Jiekou Electronic Payment, Jiekou Electronic Payment responded last night by pointing out that the current outcome of the lawsuit between the parent company and Taishan has not been determined, nor has it entered into any auction process. The company has made profits for two consecutive months in June and July, and is expected to achieve positive full-year profits for the first time this year. Taishan previously paid Jiekou FinTech an investment of 3.6 billion yuan, but a subsequent dispute over the investment transaction broke out between the two parties. Taishan filed a lawsuit for the return of investment funds on August 30, 2023, requesting the return of 3.5958 billion yuan. On May 13, 2025, the Taipei District Court won the first-instance judgment and the lawsuit was falsely executed. Taishan has applied for leave and has seized Jiekou Financial Technology-related properties, including 50 million shares of Jiekou Electronic Payment held by Jiekou Financial Technology, equivalent to 100% of the equity of Jiekou Electronic Payment. In response to the important news issued by Taishan yesterday, the board of directors decided to participate in the auction bidding of 50 million shares of Jiekou Electronic Payment, and subsequent extraordinary shareholders' meetings must still be held for discussion and voting. Jiekou Payment pointed out that the current outcome of the lawsuit between the parent company and Taishan has not been determined, nor has it entered into any auction process. Since the relevant litigation is a matter of the parent company (Jiekou Financial Technology), Jiekou Pay does not know about it and is not in a position to respond on its behalf. Jiekou Payment emphasized that its current development is quite stable, and various business and financial data continue to grow strongly. The company has made profits for two consecutive months in June and July, and is expected to achieve positive full-year profits for the first time this year.

title: 昶瑞機電攜手大分三神，從足球躍進產業深化日本無人機布局

title_en: Changrui Electromechanical joins hands with Oita Sanshen to leap from football to industry and deepen the layout of Japanese drones
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Dai Haiqian] Changrui Electromechanical (7642) announced that it will cooperate with Japan’s Oita Trinita Football Club (Oita Trinita) in the 2026 and 2027 seasons. It will use sports exchanges as a starting point to further connect local governments, industries and business resources, and deepen the company’s layout in the Japanese market. Changrui has participated in the Japan Drone Exhibition (Japan Drone) for three consecutive years since 2024, continuing to showcase independently developed drone power systems and establishing exchanges with Japanese companies, industrial organizations and relevant units in Oita Prefecture through participation in the exhibition. This cooperation with Oita Sanshin will continue the local connections accumulated in the past, further expand from sports cooperation to industrial and business exchanges, and deepen the cooperative relationship with the Oita Prefectural Government and local partners. Yang Weicheng, general manager of Changrui Electromechanical, said that this cooperation is not only a sponsorship, but also hopes to enhance the awareness of Changrui Electromechanical in the Japanese market through the international influence of football and further create opportunities for industrial cooperation. Japan is an important overseas market for Changrui. We hope to leverage Oita Sanshin's influence in local communities and establish in-depth partnerships with the Oita Prefectural Government and industry. President Masakaze Ozawa emphasized that the long-term friendly relationship between Taiwan and Japan is the basis for cooperation. In the future, he hopes to combine football, drone technology and local industries to extend cooperation from brand marketing to actual industrial exchanges. At present, relevant cooperation has been valued by the Oita Prefectural Government and actively promoted. Changrui Electromechanical will be officially introduced to fans at home games to substantially promote the application of drone products in agriculture, fishery, cargo transportation, and disaster prevention and rescue.

title: 欣新網H1每股盈餘1.68元，擬投資逾3000萬元參與軒郁私募案
summary: 【財訊快報／記者陳浩寧報導】欣新網(2949)上半年營收達31.65億元，年增23.15%，創歷年同期新高；營業毛利3.85億元，年增22.96%，毛利率為12.17%，然在前期投資造成的相關成本上升下，營業利益0.73億元，年減8.97%，稅後淨利0.54億元，年增1.68%，EPS 1.68元。欣新網指出，過往隨著服務品牌與業務規模快速擴大，公司必須同步增加營運人力、倉儲空間及物流量能，因此前期投資造成的相關成本上升通常會造成上半年度的營業利益下滑。值得注意的是，今年在營收快速成長的同時，欣新網上半年員工人數並未增加，人均營收產值同步提升逾兩成。公司表示，這反映近年持續導入AI工具與推動流程重整已逐步產生效益，讓營運規模擴張不再需要與人力成長等比例增加。在AI應用方面，欣新網並非單純以降低費用或取代人力為目標，而是將AI導入業務、電商營運、數位行銷及物流等環節，提升既有人力的產出規模。欣新網總經理黃懷恩表示，AI對欣新網而言，不只是降低成本的工具，而是讓既有團隊可以服務更多品牌、管理更多通路、產出更多內容。當營收成長超過兩成、組織規模卻不需要同步擴張，我們看到AI開始真正轉化為營運

title_en: Xinxin.com H1 has earnings per share of 1.68 yuan and plans to invest more than 30 million yuan in the Xuanyu private equity case
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Chen Haoning] Xinxin.com (2949)'s revenue in the first half of the year reached 3.165 billion yuan, an annual increase of 23.15%, a record high for the same period in previous years; operating gross profit was 385 million yuan, an annual increase of 22.9% 6%, with a gross profit margin of 12.17%. However, due to the increase in related costs caused by early investment, operating profit was 73 million yuan, an annual decrease of 8.97%, and after-tax net profit was 54 million yuan, an annual increase of 1.68%. EPS 1.68 yuan. Xinxin.com pointed out that in the past, with the rapid expansion of service brands and business scale, the company had to simultaneously increase operating manpower, warehousing space and logistics capacity. Therefore, the increase in related costs caused by early investment usually caused a decline in operating profits in the first half of the year. It is worth noting that while revenue has grown rapidly this year, the number of Xinxin Online employees has not increased in the first half of the year, and the per capita revenue output value has simultaneously increased by more than 20%. The company stated that this reflects that the continuous introduction of AI tools and the promotion of process reorganization in recent years have gradually produced benefits, so that the expansion of operating scale no longer needs to increase in proportion to the growth of human resources. In terms of AI application, Xinxin.com does not simply aim to reduce costs or replace manpower, but introduces AI into business, e-commerce operations, digital marketing, logistics and other aspects to increase the output scale of existing manpower. Huang Huaien, general manager of Xinxin.com, said that for Xinxin.com, AI is not just a tool to reduce costs, but also allows the existing team to serve more brands, manage more channels, and produce more content. When revenue grows by more than 20% and the organizational scale does not need to expand simultaneously, we see that AI begins to truly transform into operations.

title_en: Thanks to non-industry income, Sanyang Industrial earned 3.14 yuan per share in the first half of the year
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Dai Haiqian] Sanyang Industrial (2206) announced its second-quarter financial report. The second-quarter net profit after tax was 1.356 billion yuan, an annual increase of 13.71%, and earnings per share was 1.77 yuan; the cumulative earnings per share in the first half of the year was 3.14 yuan. Looking forward to the second half of the year, Sanyang said that the two-wheel business is expected to continue the growth trend of the motorcycle market in the first half of the year, with the market size expected to reach 730,000 units throughout the year. The four-wheel business will usher in a new wave of product introduction cycles, injecting new growth momentum. Sanyang's consolidated revenue in the second quarter reached 15.617 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 9.26%, gross profit margin was 20.72%, consolidated operating profit was 1.254 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 31.33%, after-tax net profit was 1.356 billion yuan, an annual increase of 13.71%, and earnings per share was 1.77 yuan. Sanyang's cumulative consolidated revenue in the first half of 2026 was 30.564 billion yuan, an annual decrease of 5.36%, a gross profit margin of 20.96%, consolidated operating profits of 2.662 billion yuan, an annual decrease of 19.71%, after-tax net profit of 2.418 billion yuan, an annual increase of 0.1%, and earnings per share of 3.14 yuan. Sanyang said that in the second quarter, the business declined compared with the same period last year, but the profit growth was mainly due to the recognition of approximately 570 million yuan in disposal profits from the sales of part of the Yaoda joint construction project, which focused on single-quarter profits. In terms of second-round business, Sanyang pointed out that it continues to maintain its leading position in the market, with sales of 156,972 units in the first half of 2026, and a market share of 43.2%. Among them, the national model Dijue series performed well, with cumulative sales of “Dijue 125” and “New Dijue 125” in the first half of the year reaching 28,877 units and 2,000 units respectively.

title: 中環上半年營收獲利同步成長，EPS 0.99元，下半年營運續看旺
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】中環(2323)受惠Flash產品需求強勁及Storage and Power 「S’n’P」策略效益持續顯現，集團上半年合併營收39.56億元，年增16%，歸屬母公司稅後淨利10.74億元，每股盈餘(EPS)0.99元，營收及獲利同步成長，轉型成果加速顯現。中環表示，旗下Verbatim品牌憑藉全球品牌與通路布局，帶動記憶體及電力兩大產品線同步成長，產品組合持續優化，提升市場競爭力與獲利能力。展望下半年，旺季、漲價、AI需求與新品四大動能齊發。隨著傳統銷售旺季到來，市場需求可望持續升溫；光碟產品受惠價格調漲及供需緊俏，營運動能延續。加上AI應用加速普及，推升高速儲存需求，及新品持續推出，「S’n’P」策略效益可望進一步放大，帶動下半年營運續旺，全年營收與獲利成長動能可期。

title_en: Central's operating profit increased simultaneously in the first half of the year, with EPS of 0.99 yuan, and operations in the second half of the year are expected to continue to be strong.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Liu Juquan] Central (2323) benefited from the strong demand for Flash products and the continued benefits of the Storage and Power “S’n’P” strategy. The group’s consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 3.956 billion yuan, an increase of 16% year-on-year. The net profit after tax attributable to the parent company was 1.074 billion yuan, and the earnings per share (EPS) was 0.99 yuan. Revenue and profit grew simultaneously, and the results of transformation were accelerated. Zhonghuan said that with its global brand and channel layout, its Verbatim brand has driven the simultaneous growth of its two major product lines, memory and power, and continued to optimize its product portfolio to enhance market competitiveness and profitability. Looking forward to the second half of the year, four major driving forces are peak season, price increases, AI demand and new products. With the arrival of the traditional peak sales season, market demand is expected to continue to heat up; optical disc products will benefit from rising prices and tight supply and demand, and business operations will continue. Coupled with the accelerating popularity of AI applications, driving up demand for high-speed storage, and the continuous launch of new products, the benefits of the “S’n’P” strategy are expected to be further amplified, driving continued operations in the second half of the year, and promising full-year revenue and profit growth momentum.

title_en: Kai Fund's after-tax profit in the first seven months was 30.529 billion yuan, and EPS was 1.77 yuan, which has exceeded last year's full-year performance
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Liu Juquan] Kaifeng Holdings (2883) made a single-month after-tax profit of 2.089 billion yuan in July. The cumulative after-tax profit in the first seven months of this year was 30.529 billion yuan, and the earnings per share (EPS) was 1.77 yuan, which has exceeded last year’s full-year profit and last year’s earnings per share of 1.74 yuan. Since July, although the stock market has shown a correction pattern, it has still adjusted in a timely manner. FVOCI's stock disposal profits have been approximately 5.51 billion yuan. Adding single-month after-tax profits, the total contribution to retained earnings has reached 7.599 billion yuan. Since the beginning of this year, it has grasped the pulse of the market and realized stock disposal profits of 44.85 billion yuan. Adding after-tax profits, the total contribution to retained earnings has reached 75.374 billion yuan, continuing to hit a new high in the same period in history. Kaifeng Holdings said that in July, Taiwan stocks showed a correction pattern due to factors such as rising market doubts about the prospects of AI capital expenditures and foreign investors adjusting their weight stocks on the rise. Financial holding's securities, banking and life insurance businesses still show operational resilience and generate profit momentum. In terms of banking business, benefiting from the expansion of deposits, net interest income and wealth management business have driven fee income to continue to rise, becoming an important engine for bank profitability. KGI Bank's after-tax profit in July was 678 million yuan. The cumulative after-tax profit in the first seven months of this year was 4.954 billion yuan, an increase of 22% over the same period last year, demonstrating steady growth. In terms of securities business, due to the consolidation of Taiwan stocks, which affected the performance of self-operated operations and investment evaluation, the performance of brokerage and wealth management and futures derivatives products was relatively stable. title_en: Huimin's net income per share in the first half of the year was 0.82 yuan, outside industry notes
summary_en: The board of directors of Huimin Industrial (6971) yesterday (13th) approved its second quarter financial report. The net profit attributable to owners of the parent company in the single quarter was 25.386 million yuan, a quarterly increase of 313.2%, an annual increase of 17.1%, and a net profit per share of 0.66 yuan. In the first half of the year, the net profit attributable to owners of the parent company was 31.529 million yuan, an annual increase of 5.61%, and the net profit per share was 0.82 yuan. In view of the growth in net profit in the first half of the year, the net profit per share was slightly lower than the 0.85 yuan in the same period last year. This was mainly due to the over-the-counter cash capital increase last October, which resulted in the expansion and dilution of share capital.

title: 遺贈稅大老婆條款訂回溯機制 防止「金蟬脫殼」

title_en: Yuantai's net profit hits a high in the first half of the year; annual revenue growth is revised down due to rising memory prices
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Pan Zhiyi, Taipei, 13th) Electronic paper manufacturer Yuantai Technology's net profit attributable to the parent company in the first half of the year was NT$6.52 billion, a record high and an annual increase of 26%. Chairman Li Zhenghao said that consumer electronics products are affected by the continued increase in memory prices. This year, instead of not growing as expected, it may decline. The original forecast for this year's revenue is to grow by 20% to 25% compared with last year, which has been revised down to a growth of 10% to 15% at this stage.

title_en: Retail investor myth! A man in his 20s bet heavily on Huida and made a huge profit of 640 million. He retired early and revealed a golden goose.
summary_en: A 20-year-old software engineer in the United States successfully made a profit of about NT$640 million and retired early due to his precise re-bet on Huida, which attracted great attention from the market. He shared his investment mentality and emphasized targeting companies with long-term explosive potential rather than short-term speculation. Looking to the future, he is optimistic that "quantum computing" will become the next hot spot for wealth, naming concept stocks such as IonQ and Rigetti. However, he also reminded that the quantum field is extremely speculative and investors need to make careful assessments. For novice retail investors, he recommends adopting a strategy of regularly investing a fixed amount into the S&P 500 Index ETF, maintaining discipline and continuing to do homework, accumulating wealth through long-term investment, and being the first to tap the gold vein of the industry.

title_en: 【Pre-market】Foreign investors will kill without mercy, slashing 33,000 copies of "this old AI"! 1.13 million shareholders cried under the green light flash
summary_en: On the 13th, the bullish momentum of Taiwan stocks was strong, with the weighted index soaring 503.41 points to close at 46,021.48 points, and the market trading volume exceeded the one trillion yuan mark. However, Hon Hai, which has millions of shareholders, suffered massive withdrawals from foreign investors. More than 33,000 units were sold in a single day, causing the stock price to turn from red to black, and ended up falling 2.96% to close at 262 yuan. According to stock exchange statistics, the top ten stocks sold by foreign investors yesterday included Hon Hai, Innolux and Sinosteel, while the top ten stocks bought by foreign investors were led by Power Semiconductor, Nanya and Dacheng Steel. There are obvious differences in foreign capital operations, and investors should pay close attention to subsequent chip movements to cope with the risk of market shocks.

title_en: Doubts about interest rate hikes have dropped! U.S. stocks closed "all four major indexes rose"; the Nasdaq rose more than 200 points, and the S&P 500 hit a new high
summary_en: The United States recently announced that the producer price index (PPI) in July rose less than market expectations, effectively alleviating inflation concerns. The market is betting that the probability of the Federal Reserve (Fed) raising interest rates in September has been significantly reduced. Encouraged by this bullish trend, the four major U.S. stock indexes collectively closed in the red on Thursday, with the S&P 500 Index performing strongly, rising 50.49 points to close at 7,798.99 points, successfully setting a new all-time high. The Dow Jones Industrial Average, Nasdaq Index and Philadelphia Semiconductor Index also rose simultaneously.

title_en: Listing revenue of Taiwanese stocks in July hit 5.39 trillion, a year-on-year increase of 48%. These three major groups became the biggest winners!
summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange stated that a total of 1,051 listed companies (excluding 32 financial and insurance companies and 33 Sanshang Investment Holdings Co., Ltd.) had completed their July 2015 revenue declaration before August 10, 2015. According to the Qiankai listed company revenue announcement for July 2015, the revenue of all listed companies in this (July) totaled 5.3925 billion yuan, an increase of 1.7529 billion yuan (48.16%) compared with the same period in 2014. summary_en: The bullish momentum in Taiwan stocks was strong yesterday (13th), with the weighted index soaring 503.41 points to close at 46,021.48 points, with trading volume exceeding one trillion yuan. According to the latest data, in addition to Innolux, the national team’s over-buying also includes popular stocks such as Hon Hai, Asia Cement, Taiwan Enterprises Bank and Aviation Duo. title_en: Sold out the house and moved to a senior residence but feel lonely? On New Year's Eve, a seventy-year-old woman felt instantly relieved after hearing a neighbor's words.
summary_en: The 74-year-old Keiko lived alone in the house after her husband passed away. Because it was difficult to maintain and worried about safety, she followed her daughter's advice to sell the house and move into a silver-friendly house. Although her living facilities were complete and her finances were secure, Keiko felt lonely in the early days because her daughter was busy during the holidays. It wasn't until she talked with her neighbors on New Year's Eve that she realized the importance of neighborhood interaction, and based on the white paper on trends in Japan's aging society, she turned to actively participate in community activities and build friendships with her neighbors. After Keiko adjusted her mentality, she not only took the initiative to reduce her dependence on her daughter, but also successfully created a fulfilling life for seniors, which reflects the importance of the elderly adapting to the new environment and expanding their social circle.

title: 鷹浪變小 美PPI低於預期
summary: 美國通膨壓力持續降溫。美國勞工統計局13日公布，7月生產者物價指數（PPI）較前月持平，低於市場預期，年增率也由6月的5.5％明顯降至4.7％。繼前一日公布的消費者物價指數（CPI）降溫後，最新數據進一步顯示物價壓力正在減輕，但市場對聯準會近期升息的預期並未顯著改變，9月利率可能不變，另外，美股主要指數同日開盤後集體走揚。

title_en: Eagle wave becomes smaller, US PPI lower than expected
summary_en: Inflationary pressures in the United States continue to cool. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics announced on the 13th that the producer price index (PPI) in July was unchanged from the previous month, lower than market expectations, and the annual growth rate also dropped significantly from 5.5% in June to 4.7%. Following the cooling of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) released the day before, the latest data further showed that price pressure is easing. However, the market's expectations for the Federal Reserve's recent interest rate hikes have not changed significantly. Interest rates may remain unchanged in September. In addition, the major U.S. stock indexes collectively rose after opening on the same day.

summary: 國票金副董事長陳冠舟年薪高達2000萬元，引發肥貓的爭議，近日鬧得沸沸揚揚，但國票金12日由薪資報酬委員會檢討副董陳冠舟的薪酬案，結果5位獨立董事中只有1位表示反對，其他4位委員同意修正後通過，後續將提報董事會審議。而投下反對票的委員也僅認為，公司提供薪酬委員會參酌的副董事長職權範圍「資訊不足」，故反對據此逕行通過。

title_en: The financial fat cat that the Finance Minister cannot touch
summary_en: The annual salary of Chen Guanzhou, vice chairman of the National Bank, is as high as 20 million yuan, which has caused controversy among fat cats and has caused a stir in recent days. However, on the 12th, the salary and remuneration committee of the National Bank reviewed the remuneration case of Vice Chairman Chen Guanzhou. As a result, only one of the five independent directors expressed objections. The other four members agreed to the amendment and passed it. It will be submitted to the board of directors for review. The members who voted against only believed that the company provided "insufficient information" on the terms of reference of the vice chairman for consideration by the remuneration committee, so they opposed passing it accordingly.

title: 健全社會保障 才能穩住經濟發展
summary: 7月底中共中央政治局會議決定10月召開五中全會，也部署下半年經濟工作；強調實施更加積極的財政政策和寬鬆的貨幣政策，並加大調節力度、擴大內需與供給，落實保障和民生。不過，會議具體部署仍先提出加快財政支出、債券使用，推進兩重、兩新工作，後續才提出兜牢基層三保，擴大供給、服務消費潛力；至於民生保障和靈活就業、新就業形態的支持保障，以及一老一小服務保障、社會救助等社會保障則列於後段位置。

title_en: Only by improving social security can we stabilize economic development
summary_en: At the meeting of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee at the end of July, it was decided to convene the Fifth Plenary Session of the CPC Central Committee in October, which also planned the economic work for the second half of the year; it emphasized the implementation of more active fiscal policies and loose monetary policies, and increased adjustments, expanded domestic demand and supply, and implemented guarantees and people's livelihood. However, the specific plan of the meeting still proposed to speed up fiscal expenditures and the use of bonds, promote dual and two new tasks, and later proposed to secure the three guarantees at the grassroots level and expand supply and service consumption potential; as for people's livelihood security and support for flexible employment and new employment forms, as well as social security such as service security for the elderly and small children, social assistance, etc., were listed in the later stage.

title_en: Laptop peak season will be slow in the second half of the year, relying on AI to support the market
summary_en: Major OEMs Quanta and Compal held their second-quarter press conference on the 13th. title_en: These three high-priced stocks were named by Du Jinlong. The bargaining chips hide fatal worries!
summary_en: The earnings season for Taiwanese stocks is coming to an end, and electronic stocks have performed well. However, senior analyst Jinlong Du warned that the market is overly optimistic about high-priced stocks such as Chuanhu, Xinhua and Weiying, and buying based on EPS forecasts alone is extremely risky. Du Jinlong revealed the inside story of the chips, pointing out that the surge in high-priced stocks was mostly due to trust lock orders. Once the chips were loose, the stock price may face a crisis of being cut in half. Faced with the strong market rebound to quarterly counter-pressure, Du Jinlong adopted a profit-taking strategy and has significantly reduced his stake in TSMC and reduced his holdings to 50%, reminding investors that they should treat high-end shocks with caution. At this stage, Taiwan stocks are facing the pressure of quarterly deductions. If they cannot effectively break through, it may trigger huge selling pressure. Investors should pay close attention to the flow of funds and avoid blindly chasing higher prices. Investment decisions need to carefully assess potential risks.

However, there are still risks in investment, and investors are urged to carefully evaluate market conditions and be responsible for their own decisions.

title_en: Can 6 million become 21.65 million in 3 years? Super Marathon Guava reveals the doubling myth of "this ETF" and the "dark truth" exposed
summary_en: Recently, the Internet has been hotly discussing the investment strategy of "betting on ETFs to double in three years before buying a house", which has triggered widespread discussion in the market. ETF guru Super Horse Guale bluntly stated that this is a myth, and used historical data to slap it in the face, emphasizing that investment returns depend on the timing of entry, and do not blindly refer to past extreme gains. Faced with the high-level fluctuations in Taiwan stocks, experts recommend adopting regular quotas or entering the market in batches, and remind investors to pay attention to the U.S. Federal Reserve's policies and geopolitical variables, and get rid of the myth of huge profits. When investing in ETFs, you should carefully evaluate market risks and never use overly optimistic assumptions as a basis for long-term planning to avoid facing the risk of asset shrinkage.

title: 溫馨慶生宴竟變惡夢！5旬兒「1句」情勒　母子從此斷聯
summary: 69歲獨居的涼子與失聯半年的兒子直樹久別重逢，本以為是溫馨慶生，不料兒子竟在甜點時刻開口借款50萬日圓，甚至以斷絕關係威脅。涼子此次堅守底線，拒絕填補無底洞，母子關係因此陷入僵局。此事件反映出高齡長者在退休金拮据下，面臨子女索討財物的兩難。根據日本總務省數據，高齡單身族群收支入不敷出，經濟狀況難以支撐無止盡的援助。涼子感嘆親情不該以金錢維繫，也提醒大眾面對家人情緒勒索時，應理性評估自身財務能力，避免晚年生活陷入困境。

title_en: A warm birthday party turns into a nightmare! "One sentence" of love in 5 days, mother and son lost contact from then on
summary_en: Ryoko, 69, who lives alone, reunited with her son Naoki, who had been missing for half a year. She thought it was a warm birthday celebration, but her son unexpectedly asked for a loan of 500,000 yen during dessert and even threatened to sever ties. Ryoko sticks to the bottom line this time and refuses to fill the bottomless pit, so the relationship between mother and son reaches a deadlock. This incident reflects the dilemma that elderly people face when their children are asking for their property due to limited pensions. According to data from Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, elderly singles are unable to make ends meet, and their economic situation cannot support endless assistance. Ryoko lamented that family ties should not be maintained by money, and also reminded the public that when faced with emotional blackmail from family members, they should rationally evaluate their own financial capabilities to avoid getting into trouble in their later years.

title_en: The MSCI index in the third quarter saw a rare "three-up" increase in the weight adjustment result of Taiwan stocks.
summary_en: MSCI announced the third quarter related index adjustments at 11:00 pm Central European Time on August 12 this year (115) (5:00 am on the 13th in Taiwan), which is expected to take effect at the opening of September 1. The weight of Taiwan stocks in the global standard index (MSCI ACWI) increased by 0.05 percentage points, the weight of the emerging markets index (MSCI EM) increased by 0.25 percentage points, and the weight of the Asia ex Japan index (MSCI AC Asia ex Japan) increased by 0.28 percentage points. The adjusted weights were 3.13%, 26.85% and 30.03% respectively. The weight difference before and after adjustment only represents the change in the weight of Taiwan stocks on the adjustment base date after the change in constituent stocks, and does not represent the flow of funds in Taiwan stocks.

title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission targets accountants for deficiencies in money laundering prevention and fines 6 cases this year
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 13th) The Financial Supervisory Commission said today that international money laundering techniques are becoming increasingly complex. In 2025, it conducted money laundering prevention inspections on 27 accounting firms and found various deficiencies such as failure to identify and verify the actual beneficiaries of clients. This year, 6 cases were issued and fines totaled NT$650,000. It reminded accountants to implement customer due diligence (CDD) and suspected money laundering transaction reporting (STR) to prevent illegal money laundering activities.

title_en: Phison earned more than 11 shares per share in the first half of the year and plans to pay a dividend of 60 yuan
summary_en: storage flash memory (NAND Flash) control chip manufacturer Phison (8299) announced today (13th) its financial report for the second quarter of 2026. Benefiting from the growth in storage demand driven by AI, its single-quarter revenue was 67.888 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 65 .7%, an annual increase of 279.5%; after-tax net income was 26.219 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 72.8%, an annual increase of more than 34 times, and a net profit per share of 118.57 yuan. Revenue and profit simultaneously set a single-quarter record high. The board of directors decided to allocate a cash dividend of 60 yuan per share. Both the dividend per share and the total amount paid hit a record high in the company's history. However, the dividend payout rate was only 32%, which may disappoint shareholders.

title_en: Taiwan firmly ranks as the largest emerging market in MSCI, and the international competitiveness of listed companies has been reaffirmed
summary_en: MSCI announced the index adjustment results for the third quarter of 2026. The weight of the Taiwan market in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index was further increased from 26.60% to 26.85%, an increase of 0.25 percentage points; Taiwan’s weight in the MSCI ACWI and MSCI AC Asia ex Japan) weights were also raised to 3.13% and 30.03% respectively. The relevant adjustments will take effect after the close of trading on August 31, 2026.

title_en: Business opportunities for high-power AI testing are heating up. Hante’s net profit per share in the first half of the year is 21.5 yuan.
summary_en: Semiconductor wafer testing solution provider Hanmin Testing Systems (7856, hereinafter referred to as Hantest) announced its financial report for the first half of 2026 today (13th). Revenue in the first half of the year was 2.185 billion yuan, an annual increase of 114.50%; operating gross profit was 1.199 billion yuan, an annual increase of 155.62%. The gross profit margin was 54.88%; the operating profit was 734 million yuan, an annual increase of 446.67%, and the operating profit rate was 33.59%; the after-tax net income was 584 million yuan, an annual increase of 389.36%, and the net profit per share was 21.50 yuan, an annual increase of 328.29%. Both revenue and profit hit record highs.

title_en: Unscrupulous people use Lin Xiuming's name to publish investment fraud information. The stock exchange calls on the public to be more vigilant.
summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange recently discovered that unscrupulous individuals have used social platforms and communication software such as LINE and Facebook to impersonate the name and photo of the chairman of the stock exchange, and even use artificial intelligence (AI) deepfake technology to create images or audio-visual content to publish investment information, solicit members to join investment groups, or promote financial products, with the intention of misleading the public and engaging in fraud.

title: 台人在陸失聯、遭捕人數如何統計？梁文傑盼陸方提供相關資訊
summary: 針對台灣人在中國大陸失聯、遭逮捕等案件的統計方式，陸委會今（13）日表示，政府公布的數字，都是接獲通報後所呈現的已發生事實，但部分遭逮捕人士是否獲釋、返台，政府較難掌握。陸委會希望對岸接獲查詢時提供相關資訊，「這樣兩邊才不會對於同樣的一個數字，再有所爭執」。

title_en: How to count the number of Taiwanese missing or arrested in mainland China? Liang Wenjie hopes that Lu will provide relevant information
summary_en: Regarding the statistical method of Taiwanese people missing contact and being arrested in mainland China, the Mainland Affairs Council stated today (13th) that the figures released by the government are facts that have occurred after receiving notifications. However, it is difficult for the government to grasp whether some of the arrested people have been released and returned to Taiwan. The Mainland Affairs Council hopes that the other side will provide relevant information when receiving inquiries, "so that the two sides will no longer have disputes about the same number."

Offshore wind power orders will be filled until 2029, and the Indonesian plant will be completed and put into operation by the end of the year. title_en: How can 130,000 social housing units meet the standard? The Ministry of the Interior took inventory of 64 land parcels, 45 of which were occupied by the Six Capital Regions.
summary_en: The government's social housing policy will move from direct construction to diversified acquisition. The Ministry of the Interior stated that the central and local governments are expected to build an additional 30,000 social housing units by 2028 in the first phase, and maintain the target of 130,000 units by 2032. In the future, in addition to direct government construction, privately donated social housing will also be obtained through urban renewal allocations, volume incentives, and social housing land reserved in local overall development zones to increase supply. At present, 64 suitable locations have been inventoried across the country, including 45 in the six capitals and 19 in non-sixth capitals. Subsequent development will be carried out in cooperation with local governments and the introduction of private funds will be assessed.

title_en: Phison Financial Report/EPS in the first half of the year reached 187.43 yuan and 118.57 yuan in the second quarter
summary_en: Phison Electronics Corp., a leading manufacturer of NAND control chips and NAND storage solutions, announced its operating results for the second quarter of 2026 on the 13th. Benefiting from the continued strong demand for AI-related applications, Phison's consolidated revenue in the second quarter of 2026 reached NT$67.888 billion, a substantial increase in both quarterly and annual growth. Revenue in the second quarter showed double-digit quarterly growth. AI server revenue will double throughout the year, and customer order visibility will reach 2028. The growth rate of the notebook computer segment was better than previously expected, and important customers continued to purchase goods from the end of the first quarter into the second quarter. AI server production capacity will continue to expand, and the goal of doubling production capacity this year is expected to be achieved.

title_en: Taiwan firmly ranks as the largest emerging market in MSCI, and the international competitiveness of listed companies has been reaffirmed
summary_en: MSCI announced the index adjustment results for the third quarter of 2026. The weight of the Taiwan market in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index was further increased from 26.60% to 26.85%, an increase of 0.25 percentage points; Taiwan’s weight in the MSCI ACWI and MSCI AC Asia ex Japan) weights were also raised to 3.13% and 30.03% respectively. title_en: From TNFD to watershed governance! Zhenglong Zhubei Factory adopts Fengshan Creek to create a sustainable river bank
summary_en: Zhenglong (1904) continues to expand the sustainable layout of the company and extends environmental management from the factory area to the river basin. Zhenglong announced on the 13th that its Zhubei factory and the Second River Branch of the Water Conservancy Department of the Ministry of Economic Affairs signed a green beautification cooperation for the "Fengshan Stream Fenggang Embankment". title_en: Tour fees for overseas trips in autumn and winter are released! Japan’s price rose by up to 10%, and Australia’s price surged by 18%. These places are 10% to 20% cheaper.
summary_en: Facing the peak tourist season of maple viewing, skiing, aurora and Christmas and New Year in the fourth quarter, the Quality Assurance Association announced on the 13th a reasonable reference price for group travel from October to December this year. Judging from the quotations of various lines, the autumn and winter tourism market shows obvious differentiation. In Japan, driven by inflation, taxes and the peak maple viewing season, group fares have increased by about 7% to 10% compared with the same period last year; in Australia, the annual increase has reached 18%, and in Central Asia and Africa, the average has also increased by 8% to 12%. In comparison, the United States and Canada have entered the traditional off-season, with tour fares falling by 15% to 20% compared to the third quarter of this year. South Korea has also fallen by 5% to 10%, making it a relatively attractive market in the fourth quarter.

title_en: Can PRP be used to speed up the repair of fractures? 4 warning signs revealed by doctors: If you delay for too long, you may miss the opportunity for treatment
summary_en: If you can still walk after a fall or bruise, does that mean there are no fractures? After being injured, many people endure the pain and observe it, or even directly perform massage or chiropractic treatment. They do not seek medical treatment until the pain does not improve for weeks or even months. Lin Youlian, an attending physician at the Department of Orthopedics at Taiwan Adventist Hospital, reminded that "bone cracks" are also a type of fracture. Some minor fractures have no obvious deformation in appearance and are not even easy to detect from X-rays in the early stages. If pain and swelling persist after the injury or you are unable to bear weight normally, you should receive professional evaluation and do not massage yourself.

title_en: The total output value of the marine industry has reached 1.5 trillion yuan. The Political Yuan has finalized the marine technology and industry development plan.
summary_en: The Ocean Council recently announced that the total output value of my country's marine industry will exceed 1.5 trillion yuan (accounting for 5.9% of GDP) in 2024, demonstrating strong blue economic momentum. In order to continue the national policy vision of "exploring the ocean", the Executive Yuan has recently approved and released the "Marine Technology and Industry Development Plan." The Ocean Council stated that the plan takes "technological empowerment" as its core and fully implements the three strategic axes of "security, sustainability, and common prosperity" and will build a national-level blue ocean economic blueprint.

台積電與電子權值股攜手點火！台股今(13)日早盤站上4萬6千點，盤中一度衝抵46,216.41點，終場上漲503.41點、漲幅1.11%，收在46,021.48點，成交金額達1兆515.91億元，電子類股勁揚1.42%，金融類股則小跌0.27%。

亞股在美國AI與半導體股反彈帶動下漲跌互見，日經指數上漲1.16%，韓國綜合指數勁揚3.56%，主要受三星電子上漲、SK海力士勁揚助攻；香港恆生指數則小跌0.17%，上海綜合指數同步下滑0.50%。

投資人持續追逐AI與半導體題材，美股四大指數呈現漲多跌少，道瓊工業指數微跌0.04%，標普500指數上漲0.26%，那斯達克指數走揚0.54%，費城半導體指數則強彈2.49%。

title: 槓桿鏈危機1／AI還在天堂、投資人先墜地獄　大戶槓桿開到極致慘賠6千萬
summary:
AI狂潮把台股、韓股一路推上歷史高峰，投資人深信只要搭上AI列車，就能一路奔向財富終點。然而，當股價越漲越高，跟著膨脹的還有投資人瘋狂槓桿的行為。一場從韓國引爆的去槓桿風暴，短短數週讓牛變熊，也一路震回台灣；有人前一刻還坐擁千萬元獲利，下一刻卻因追繳、斷頭慘賠6,000萬元。

這波震盪揭開AI狂潮最危險的一面：產業榮景或許還沒結束，但當投資人把槓桿開到極致，市場根本不必等到泡沫破裂，一次超乎預期的修正，就足以讓財富瞬間歸零。

title: 槓桿鏈危機2／AI沒看錯、槓桿卻要命　揭台灣「六貸同堂」隱形危機
summary: 韓股去槓桿風暴蔓延至美股、台股，儘管現階段風暴暫歇，但台灣「隱形槓桿鏈」卻讓專家憂心忡忡。因為台灣的槓桿不只存在融資與期貨，更藏在房屋增貸、信貸、車貸、股票質押等不同金融體系中，交織成難以看清全貌的「隱形槓桿鏈」。當投資人瘋追AI行情，真正需要提防的，或許不是泡沫何時破裂，而是多頭行情掩蓋之下，早已悄悄膨脹的信用未爆彈。

title: 槓桿鏈危機3／25兆家庭借款藏風險　台灣「隱形槓桿」連主管機關都看不清

title_en: Big investment in AI/Huida launches huge financing plan of US$500 billion to ensure growth momentum in the next three years

title_en: Big investment in AI/Intel raises 640 billion yuan to catch up with TSMC
summary_en: At the same time that Huida announced a huge financing plan of US$500 billion, Intel had just completed a cash capital increase of up to US$20 billion (approximately NT$640 billion), setting the largest first issuance of new shares since the company went public in 1971. The main purpose of Intel's fundraising is to catch up with TSMC in the wafer foundry field. The US$20 billion in funds will be converted into capital expenditures to purchase more advanced semiconductor machinery and equipment.

title: 供應憂心緩解，LME鋁價盤中跌0.9%，連二黑
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，倫敦金屬交易所(LME)鋁價連續第二天下跌，中東一家大型鋁冶煉廠宣布計畫提前恢復生產，舒緩了市場對鋁供應日益緊張的擔憂。阿聯酋環球鋁業(Emirates Global Aluminium PJSC)計畫明年第一季度將產量提升至戰前水準，伊朗3月份發動的襲擊曾導致其主要冶煉廠停產。受消息影響，鋁價週三大幅回落。截至上海時間12:10，LME鋁價下跌0.9%，至每噸3,282.50美元。。此前，由於伊朗與美國似乎就重開荷姆茲海峽達成協議漸行漸遠，鋁價連續七個交易日上漲。倫敦金屬交易所的鋁庫存目前處於1990年以來最低水準。此外，澳洲最大鋁冶煉廠Tomago的所有者週四獲得25億澳幣(18億美元)政府紓困資金，使該廠得以繼續營運，進一步加大了供應端壓力。Tomago冶煉廠年產能59萬噸，雖然這項紓困計畫在意料之中，但這凸顯了各國政府為扶持虧損產能而採取的更廣泛舉措。Chaos Ternary Futures Co週四在報告中指出，目前鋁價處於相對較高的水準。隨著供需平衡逐漸轉為過剩，鋁價在中期內將面臨下滑壓力。

title_en: "Even camellia oil has problems!" Experts call for a comprehensive inspection of edible fats and oils and the establishment of standard refining processes
summary_en: After the Zhonglian case, at least six camellia oil factories in Taiwan reported excessive amounts of benzene and pyrene, exposing systemic concerns about the management of edible oils and fats. Chen Binghui, chair professor of the Department of Food Science at Fuyu University, pointed out that heating the oil production process may lead to the production of a variety of carcinogens, among which benzene pyrene is the most carcinogenic. As the key to inspection, the competent authorities should conduct large-scale inspections of edible oils and fats across Taiwan regardless of category, gradually establish a standardized edible oil production process, and formulate inspection standards for benzene pyrene at each node in the production process.

title: 食安法再修 康照洲：三級品管未落實 法令加嚴、再多人力 檢驗都不夠
summary: 2008年經過中國大陸毒澱粉事件後，我於2013年修訂食安法，強化業者自主管理、落實三級品管。時隔不到一年，就碰上強冠餿水油及頂新飼料油事件，2014年再度修法，增加對業者責任與罰則，但時隔十餘年，中聯油脂被驗出原油含致癌物苯駢芘，影響上千公噸食品，一再被強化的食安法讓政府開出史上最高罰金1億6520萬元，但似乎無法防堵重大食安事件再次爆發。
title_zh: 食安法再修 康照洲：三級品管未落實 法令加嚴、再多人力 檢驗都不夠
summary_zh: 2008年經過中國大陸毒澱粉事件後，我於2013年修訂食安法，強化業者自主管理、落實三級品管。時隔不到一年，就碰上強冠餿水油及頂新飼料油事件，2014年再度修法，增加對業者責任與罰則，但時隔十餘年，中聯油脂被驗出原油含致癌物苯駢芘，影響上千公噸食品，一再被強化的食安法讓政府開出史上最高罰金1億6520萬元，但似乎無法防堵重大食安事件再次爆發。
title_en: Food Safety Law Revised Kang Zhaozhou: Three-level quality control has not been implemented. Tighter laws and more manpower and inspections are not enough.
summary_en: After the poisonous starch incident in mainland China in 2008, I revised the Food Safety Law in 2013 to strengthen industry independent management and implement three-level quality control. Less than a year later, the scandal of rancid water and oil and Ting Hsin feed oil happened. In 2014, the law was revised again to increase the responsibilities and penalties for the industry. However, more than ten years later, Zoomlion Oil and Fat was found to contain the carcinogen benzene and pyrene in its crude oil, affecting thousands of metric tons of food. The repeatedly strengthened food safety law allowed the government to issue the highest fine of 165.2 million yuan in history, but it seems unable to prevent another major food safety incident from happening again.

summary_zh: 103年頂新事件後，政府推動「食安法」修法，蔡英文前總統任內推動「食安五環」，賴清德總統則推動「食安五環2.0版」，但近年國內仍爆發蘇丹紅辣椒粉、致癌毒油等重大食安事件。全民監督食安聯盟發起人蘇偉碩指出，食安五環標榜從農場至餐桌，但許多食材原料為國外輸入，政府追蹤「只到海關就斷鏈」，應設法就原料進口地及原料風險高低，分門別類落實控管。
title_en: This year’s budget is 760 million. The domestic and overseas inspection budget of the Food and Drug Administration is increasing year by year, but the traceability of raw materials is “broken at the customs.”
summary_en: After the 103-year-old incident, the government pushed for the revision of the "Food Safety Law". Former President Tsai Ing-wen promoted the "Five Rings for Food Safety" during her term, and President Lai Ching-te promoted the "Five Rings for Food Safety Version 2.0." However, in recent years, major food safety incidents such as Sudanese red pepper powder and carcinogenic toxic oils have still occurred in the country. Su Weishuo, founder of the Alliance for National Supervision of Food Safety, pointed out that the five rings of food safety are advertised from farm to table, but many raw materials are imported from abroad. The government tracks "the chain is broken as soon as it reaches customs." We should try to implement control by category based on the place of import of raw materials and the level of risk of the raw materials.

title: 中央總在出事後才稽查 中研院士陳培哲：事務官體系瓦解讓食安失守
summary: 每遇食安風暴後，政府提出修法、加強稽查等作法，卻無法阻止食安事件再次發生。中研院士陳培哲指出，國內食安事件最大問題為「徒法不足以致行」，除要求廠商自主管理，政府定期稽查、以公權力監督不可或缺，但蔡、賴二任總統執政下，國內事務官體系已遭破壞，科學食安把關以政治化方式處理，導致稽查不夠確實，以中聯案為例，食藥署至案件爆發後才派人查廠保留證據。

title_en: The central government only conducted inspections after the incident. Academician Chen Peizhe of Academia Sinica: The collapse of the affairs officer system has led to a loss of food safety
summary_en: After every food safety crisis, the government proposes measures such as amending laws and strengthening inspections, but it cannot prevent food safety incidents from happening again. Chen Peizhe, an academician of Academia Sinica, pointed out that the biggest problem in domestic food safety incidents is that "laws alone are not enough." In addition to requiring independent management by manufacturers, regular government inspections and public supervision are indispensable. However, under the administration of Presidents Tsai and Lai, the domestic affairs officer system has been destroyed. Scientific food safety control is handled in a politicized manner, resulting in insufficient inspections. Taking the Zhonglian case as an example, the Food and Drug Administration did not send personnel to inspect the factory until the case broke out to retain evidence.

title_en: Pegatron: Server business is better than expected and related performance will grow tenfold this year
summary_en: Pegatron will point out that the server business performance this year will be better than expected, with an increase of more than ten times, and it may become the top three business units. In order to enhance working capital, the company plans to issue domestic convertible bonds of up to 20 billion yuan and overseas convertible bonds of US$100 million.

title: Uber Eats 疊單計酬改制將上路 學者示警效率與成本脫鉤
summary: Uber Eats昨（12）日宣布，完整認列疊單重疊時間並回溯至7月21日的訂單，調整外送員整體獎酬結構，並公布消費者服務費每單平均增加4至6元。學者認為，重新調整外送員獎酬結構及消費端服務費，影響外送成本、供需效率與消費需求，恐衝擊消費者未來下單量，連帶影響外送員實際權益。

title_en: Uber Eats plans to reform its pay-per-order system, and scholars warn of decoupling between efficiency and cost
summary_en: Uber Eats announced yesterday (12th) that it would fully recognize the overlapping orders and trace them back to July 21, adjust the overall reward structure for delivery workers, and announce that the consumer service fee will increase by an average of 4 to 6 yuan per order. Scholars believe that readjusting the reward structure of delivery workers and consumer-side service fees will affect delivery costs, supply and demand efficiency, and consumer demand, which may impact the number of future orders placed by consumers and jointly affect the actual rights and interests of delivery workers.

title_en: Pegatron's second quarter net income per share was 1.68 yuan
summary_en: Pegatron's second-quarter after-tax net income reached 4.488 billion yuan, an increase of 187.5% from the previous quarter, and net income per share was 1.68 yuan, an increase of more than 14 times year-on-year. Net profit after tax in the first half of the year was 6.039 billion yuan, mainly driven by the shipment of AI servers and PCs. Shipments of information service products had the highest growth rate, with a quarterly increase of 82%.

title: 半導體先進製程需求放量，達興材料Q2 EPS 2.23元，Q3業績衝全年高峰

title: 韓國央行睽違13年重啟黃金投資，Q2小額買進海外現貨黃金ETF
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，韓國央行第二季透過海外上市的現貨黃金ETF，小規模增加黃金曝險，為2013年以來首度進行黃金相關投資。央行未公布買進金額，並強調此次購入的是交易所掛牌證券，而非實體黃金，因此不會計入官方黃金持有量。截至6月底，韓國央行持有實體黃金104.4公噸，估值約47.9億美元，僅占4,273.6億美元外匯存底的1.1%，持有量自2013年以來未曾增加。這批黃金目前全部存放於英國央行；以2025年底資料計算，韓國在全球央行黃金持有量排名約第39位。韓國央行表示，地緣政治風險升高，各國央行對黃金等安全資產的需求增加，加上韓國外匯存底中的黃金占比偏低，促使當局重新調整資產配置。近期金價自高點回落、買進成本降低，也是央行重啟黃金投資的考量之一。除購入黃金ETF外，韓國央行已與韓國交易所(KRX)、韓國證券保管結算院(KSD)及當地煉製業者建立實體黃金採購機制，未來將按國際金價買入原定出口的韓國境內生產黃金，以分散採購來源與存放地點。實際買進時間與規模尚未決定，相關交易將採協議鉅額交易，力求避免影響韓國國內黃金供需與價格。

title_en: Discussing the market situation/AI hardware supply chain, every situation layout
summary_en: Bridgewater Associates founder Ray Dalio once again warned of the AI ​​craze. However, judging from the recent chip structure and risk indicators, market sentiment has shown signs of being overly pessimistic. AI-related trading deleveraging has been quite complete, and high-leverage positions have been cleared significantly, which means that the most vulnerable chips have been washed away by the market. Although global technology stocks have significantly revised, corporate profit forecasts are not bad, and some leading companies will even continue to revise up EPS next year. It shows that this wave of correction is more biased towards valuation compression rather than profit collapse. Market concerns about the Federal Reserve raising interest rates may also be amplified.

summary_en: Last weekend, Grab co-founder and CEO Chen Bingyao arrived in Taiwan with his family. This was his seventh visit to Taiwan this year. When interviewed by the media, he occasionally dropped a few words in Fujian dialect and said what Taiwanese must know: "You will win if you work hard!" After more than an hour of media interviews, Chen Bingyao introduced to the media that he had specially prepared a souvenir for the media, a bottle of signature sambal from Village Park Restaurant, a famous store in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. title: 數泓科H1獲利回溫，EPS 4.15元，看好H2營收、毛利率向上
summary: 【財訊快報／記者陳浩寧報導】受惠手工具回補庫存加上新品挹注，數泓科(6855)上半年營收3.11億元，年增11.35%；毛利率48.78%，營益率32.79%，稅後純益0.97億元，年增97.76%，每股純益達4.15元，創下同期歷史次高。數泓科7月營收0.73億元，月增14.29%，年增59.85%；累計前7月營收3.85億元，年減3.12%，後續訂單持續維穩中。數泓科表示，在國際情勢緩和、美元走勢維穩下，受惠手工具市場客戶回補庫存及專業級工具新品的營收挹注，前七個月專業級出貨數量占比明顯由114年約52%提升到57%，預期下半年業績有機會再增長，今年營收成長可期。另在毛利率方面，公司指出，新產品帶動毛利增加下，已抵銷原物料、薪資等成本影響，第二季毛利率與第一季不相上下，看好今年整體毛利率有望持穩，甚至有機會再創高。此外，數泓科在半導體大廠的多年耕耘下，預期今年底前有機會試單出貨，隨著全球智慧製造應用持續成長，數位工具市場滲透率有望持續提升，看好公司未來的發展潛力。

title_en: Shuhongke's H1 profits are recovering, EPS is 4.15 yuan, optimistic about H2 revenue and gross profit margin
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Chen Haoning] Benefiting from the inventory replenishment of hand tools and the introduction of new products, Shuhongke (6855) recorded revenue of 311 million yuan in the first half of the year, an annual increase of 11.35%; gross profit margin was 48.78%, operating profit margin was 32.79%, and after-tax net income was 97 million yuan, an annual increase of 97.76%. Net earnings per share reached 4.15 yuan, the second highest in history during the same period. Shuhongke's revenue in July was 73 million yuan, a monthly increase of 14.29% and an annual increase of 59.85%; the cumulative revenue in the first seven months was 385 million yuan, an annual decrease of 3.12%, and subsequent orders continued to remain stable. Shuhongke said that with the international situation easing and the US dollar trend stabilizing, benefiting from the replenishment of inventory by customers in the hand tool market and the revenue injection of new professional-grade tool products, the proportion of professional-grade shipments in the first seven months has increased significantly from about 52% in 2014 to 57%. It is expected that the performance in the second half of the year will have the opportunity to grow again, and revenue growth this year is expected. In terms of gross profit margin, the company pointed out that the increase in gross profit driven by new products has offset the impact of costs such as raw materials and wages. The gross profit margin in the second quarter is similar to that in the first quarter. It is optimistic that the overall gross profit margin is expected to remain stable this year, and may even reach a new high. In addition, due to years of hard work in major semiconductor manufacturers, Shuhongke expects to have the opportunity to test order shipments before the end of this year. As global smart manufacturing applications continue to grow, the penetration rate of the digital tool market is expected to continue to increase, and the company is optimistic about the company's future development potential.

title_en: Alex's profits hit a new high in the first half of the year, it won new overseas orders from NVIDIA, and its performance continues to grow
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Dai Haiqian] The board of directors of Alexei (1514) approved the first half financial report. Benefiting from the substantial growth in demand for AI in the semiconductor industry, which has driven the growth of heavy electrical equipment, the cumulative revenue and profits in the first half of the year simultaneously set a new high in the same period in history, and the gross profit margin increased to 19.28%; the revenue in July before the end of the year was 6.27 billion yuan, a new high for the same period in previous years. Yali pointed out that the amount of orders received this year exceeds sales by more than 30%, and orders on hand exceed 12 billion yuan and continue to increase, reaching a record high. NVIDIA has also received new overseas orders from NVIDIA's investment in Central and South American subsidiaries. Future performance is expected to continue to hit highs. Yali's accumulated consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 5.346 billion yuan, an annual increase of 16.38%, operating profit was 562 million yuan, an annual increase of 29.81%, after-tax net profit was 453 million yuan, an annual increase of 27.29%, and earnings per share were 1.65 yuan, all of which set a new high for the same period. Yali's gross profit margin rose to 19.28% in the first half of 2026, higher than 18.47% in the same period last year, and its operating profit rate rose to 9.84% and net profit margin 8.47%, both higher than the same period last year; Yali pointed out that this was mainly due to the semiconductor industry's active construction of factories and expansion of production capacity due to the substantial growth in demand for AI, and the substantial growth in demand for heavy electrical equipment. Yali also recorded a consolidated revenue of 895 million yuan in July, an annual increase of 6.51%; the cumulative revenue for the first seven months was 6.27 billion yuan, an annual increase of 14.57%, a new high for the same period in previous years. Yali said that its current orders on hand exceed 12 billion yuan and continue to increase, reaching a record high, mainly due to the acceleration of the AI ​​wave.

title: MSCI季度調整全球標準型指數，台股新增景碩等6檔，剔除康霈等6檔
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】MSCI(明晟)今（13）公布最新一季度調整，其中全球標準型指數台股成分股新增景碩(3189)等6檔，剔除康霈(6919)等6檔，此次公布的季度調整結果將於8月31日收盤後生效。此次最新一季度調整，全球標準指數台股成分股新增景碩、南電(8046)、南亞科(2408)、群聯(8299)、台燿(6274)、華邦電(2344)等6檔。剔除康霈(6919)、力旺(3529)、鈊象(3293)、台企銀(2834)、台泥(1101)、陽明(2609)等6檔。MSCI每年2月、5月、8月及11月公布季度和半年度調整，除調整成分股外，台股權重的調整，也將牽動全球基金在台灣的分配和資金淨流；此次公布季度調整結果將於8月31日收盤後生效。

title_en: MSCI quarterly adjusts the global standard index. Taiwan stocks added 6 stocks such as Jing Shuo and eliminated 6 stocks such as Kang Pei.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Liu Juquan] MSCI announced the latest quarterly adjustment today (13). Among the Taiwan stock components of the Global Standard Index, 6 new stocks including Jingshuo (3189) were added, and 6 stocks such as Kang Pei (6919) were eliminated. The quarterly adjustment results announced this time will take effect after the close of trading on August 31. In this latest quarterly adjustment, 6 new stocks have been added to the Taiwanese Global Standard Index: Jingshuo, Nanjing Electric (8046), Nanya (2408), Phison (8299), Taiyao (6274), and Winbond (2344). Exclude 6 stocks including Kang Pei (6919), Liwang (3529), Yi Xiang (3293), Taiwan Enterprise Bank (2834), Taiwan Cement (1101), and Yang Ming (2609). MSCI announces quarterly and semi-annual adjustments in February, May, August and November every year. In addition to adjusting the constituent stocks, the adjustment of the weight of Taiwan stocks will also affect the allocation and net capital flow of global funds in Taiwan; the quarterly adjustment results announced this time will take effect after the close of trading on August 31.

title_en: Xibin H1 EPS hit a high of 9.04 yuan, H2 opened five more stores, and the annual revenue hit a new high
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Chen Haoning] Benefiting from the efficiency of new stores and the steady growth of existing stores, Xibin (7883)'s revenue in the first half of the year was 6.942 billion yuan, an increase of 25.41% over the same period last year; net profit after tax was 548 million yuan, an increase of 41.88% year-on-year; EPS climbed to 9.04 yuan, and the three indicators of revenue, profit, and EPS all hit new highs in the same period. Looking forward to the second half of the year, in addition to the newly opened Xuji and Restaurant Taichung Dayuan 100 stores in July, the group plans to open five more new stores, striving to set new high revenue records year after year. In terms of revenue in July, Xibin's monthly revenue reached 1.098 billion yuan, an increase of approximately 16.17% over the same period last year; the cumulative revenue from January to July reached 8.04 billion yuan, an annual increase of 24.07%, and the growth momentum continued. Chaobin pointed out that although the typhoon disrupted some business days and visitor numbers in July, revenue still maintained double-digit year-on-year growth. It is worth noting that the "Xuji" Taichung Dayuan 100 store, which opened on July 9 this year, ranked among the top three in the group in terms of single-store revenue in the first month of operation. Since its opening, it is still difficult to get a reservation. The popular brand "Caitai Duo", which opened at Yuanbai at the same time as Xuji, also delivered outstanding results, demonstrating the synergy of the multi-brand matrix of Cuisine in a single business district. After completing the core layout in the three major cities of Taipei, Taichung and Kaohsiung, Urban Paradise has taken a new step. The second store of its cutting-edge restaurant and wine brand "URBAN PARADISE" will officially open in Hsinchu Big City Far East Big City Shopping Center on August 17. It is expected to host the gathering of people with high consumption power in Zhuke.
