title_en: Watt City's Q2 profits recovered, H1 earned 3.47 yuan per share, and the United States launched its second brand "BOBO THAI"
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Chen Haoning] Wacheng (2729)'s second-quarter operating profit margin and after-tax net profit attributable to the parent company both rebounded significantly from the first quarter and were better than the same period last year. The single-quarter EPS was 1.83 yuan. Revenue in the first half of the year reached 3.290 billion yuan, an annual increase of 7.79%. The after-tax net profit attributable to the parent company was 148 million yuan, an annual decrease of 15.54%, and EPS was 3.47 yuan. Wacheng's revenue in the second quarter reached 1.636 billion yuan, an annual increase of 12.48%, setting a new high for the same period in history; operating profit was 118 million yuan, an increase of 15.32% from the first quarter; the net profit after tax attributable to the parent company was 77.84 million yuan, an annual increase of 4.49%, and EPS was 1.83 yuan. The operation in the first half of the year mainly benefited from the continuous demand for dinner parties during the three major festivals: Spring Festival, Mother's Day and Dragon Boat Festival, which drove the steady growth of customers and revenue of its brands, demonstrating the benefits of the group's multi-brand operation and market layout in Taiwan. Looking forward to the third quarter, Wacheng said that with the arrival of the summer travel season and the increased demand for family dinners on Father's Day, reservations at the group's brand restaurants are booming. It will actively seize summer dinner and tourism catering business opportunities and continue to strengthen its business capabilities. In terms of store openings in Taiwan, the group continues to follow the multi-brand and multi-regional layout strategy. In the third quarter, it is expected to officially enter the Taitung market and simultaneously open dual-brand stores "Wacheng" and "Shishixiang" to further improve the Taiwan market and grasp the local consumption and tourist catering needs in Eastern Taiwan. In terms of overseas markets, the group's first store in the United States, "Very Thai by Wa City", has performed stably since its opening and has gradually expanded.

title: 智冠上半年每股盈餘4.71元，王俊博轉任總裁，女兒王思淳接棒董座
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】智冠(5478)公布第二季季報，累計上半年每股稅後盈餘達4.71元，董事會也決議原董事長王俊博卸任並榮任集團總裁及持續擔任董事，董座職務由女兒王思淳接棒，總經理則由智冠AI及數位發展中心副總李殷獎擔任，正式完成世代交替。智冠第二季合併營收16.80億元，年增7%，稅後淨利3.45億元，每股盈餘2.32元。累計上半年合併營收36.15億元，年增14%，稅後淨利7.03億元，每股盈餘達4.71元。智冠自1983年成立以來，走過台灣遊戲產業40餘年的發展歷程，從遊戲軟體通路起步，逐步拓展遊戲研發與營運、數位內容服務、網路行銷及金融科技等事業，建構完整的數位娛樂產業服務體系。王俊博長期帶領智冠掌握產業變化、拓展多元事業版圖，奠定集團今日的發展基礎。因應集團長期發展與經營傳承，王俊博此次卸任董事長職務後，將榮任集團總裁並續任董事，延續40餘年來累積的產業經驗與企業精神。智冠未來由新任董事長王思淳及總經理李殷獎共同帶領，透過明確分工與組織協作，承接既有經營基礎，推動經營責任有序傳承。王思淳長期參與集團營運及公司治理事務，歷任智冠董事法人代表，並負責集團經營分析部門及跨事

title: 台股洗刷刷！短線震盪跌幅超過兩成　大跌後「恢復力」曝光
summary: 近期全球股市震盪劇烈，科技與半導體板塊修正幅度顯著，費半指數與韓股回檔逾兩成。法人指出，高成長伴隨高波動是市場常態，AI長線趨勢未變，投資人不宜因短期波動輕易離場。歷史數據顯示，市場修復速度快於極端熊市，建議投資人依個人風險屬性進行多元配置。若無法承受科技股劇烈震盪，可選擇產業分布較廣的美國股票基金分散波動，並善用投組方案，在追求長期成長的同時有效控制風險，避免將帳面波動轉化為實際損失。

title: 三率三升，華碩Q2大賺逾2.5個股本，再度上修今年伺服器成長目標至150%
summary: 【財訊快報／記者王宜弘報導】在AI伺服器強勁的需求之下，華碩(2357)第二季財報繳出超猛成績單，單季稅後盈餘高達190.48億元，季、年同步大增94%，EPS 25.6元。累計該公司上半年稅後盈餘達288.45億元，年增27.6%，EPS 38.83元。由於超乎預期的動能，該公司在週三(12日)線上法說會中再度上修今年伺服器成長展望至1.5倍。華碩在首季營運實績中，因記憶體與原物料影響，獲利未如預期，EPS 13.2元，第二季旋即扳回一城，不但合併營收以2577.33億元，品牌營收以2410.56 億元雙雙創下歷史新高紀錄，且毛利率大幅回升至16.5%，營益率8.1%，純益率7.9%，均創5季新高。因此，華碩第二季營業利益達196.38億元，較上季跳增87%，年增率更高達2.3倍，一舉刷新歷史紀錄，業外包含12.2億元的匯兌收益，共貢獻50.36億元利益，帶動單季稅後盈餘飆升到190.48億元，較上季與同期均大增94%，EPS 25.6元，表現超乎預期。而由於強勁的伺服器需求，華碩上次法說會中曾將今年伺服器成長目標由50-100%上修到100%以上，這次法說會二度上修此一目標至逾15

summary_en: Hotel stocks Humble House (2739) and Luk Fook announced their first-half financial results yesterday (12th). Humble House’s cumulative net profit per share (EPS) reached 2.73 yuan; Luk Fook’s accumulated small loss, with a net loss per share of 0.45 yuan. title_en: Nanbao’s EPS in the first half of the year was 13.82 yuan, the highest point in the same period
summary_en: Nanbao (4766), a major chemical materials company, announced its second-quarter financial report yesterday (12th). The net profit after tax for a single quarter was 877 million yuan, an annual increase of 58.4%, and the net earnings per share (EPS) was 7.27 yuan, a record high in a single quarter. In the first half of the year, the net profit after tax was 1.667 billion yuan, and EPS was 13.82 yuan, an annual increase of 29.9%, which was also a record high for the same period in history.

title_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs unveiled the mid- and long-term development blueprint for offshore wind power. Why have the rules for selecting companies for phases 3-4 and 3-5 changed significantly?
summary_en: In recent years, global wind power has experienced headwinds. U.S. President Trump has curbed the expansion of wind power and switched to an energy policy that supports fossil fuels. Europe, Japan and South Korea have worked hard to promote offshore wind power, but they all face major challenges such as rising costs. The Taiwanese government's offshore wind power policy has been recognized as a model by foreign investors. The Ministry of Economic Affairs attaches great importance to and strives to coordinate the opinions of developers. The Ministry of Economic Affairs also announced the "Medium and Long-term Development Plan for Offshore Wind Power" at the National Climate Change Countermeasures Committee of the Presidential Office in late July, with a target capacity of 19.9GW in 2035. This move declares that the Taiwanese government will continue to promote the offshore wind power policy. However, why did the Ministry of Economic Affairs also significantly adjust the rules for future business selection?

title_en: Low-income petty bourgeoisie groups support! TISA assets reach 16.5 billion, number of regular quotas doubles
summary_en: Jifutong's "TISA Enjoy Investment" service has reached its anniversary, attracting a total of 120,000 participants, driving the total assets to exceed 16.5 billion yuan. The platform has successfully flipped the contours of traditional financial management, showing four major structural changes: the user base has become significantly younger, with 45% under the age of 40; investors' risk tolerance has increased, with more than 70% able to withstand fluctuations of more than 15%; the proportion of petty bourgeoisie has expanded, and the per capita number of investments and deductions are better than in previous projects. Through expert base selection, a low threshold of 1,000 yuan and digital optimization, TISA has transformed into a basic financial management tool suitable for all ages. Jifutong said that in the future, it will continue to deepen its digital experience and connect the banking system to help everyone implement long-term financial planning and create a stable financial future.

title_en: Big brother is back! In the past week, 21 active ETFs have outperformed the market, with these two being the strongest
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have been volatile recently, and the performance of active Taiwan stock ETFs has attracted much attention. Data shows that Taiwan stocks have rebounded in the past week, with 21 active ETFs rising better than the market, among which Mega Taiwan Harvest, Nomura Taiwan Select and KGI Taiwan performed strongly. However, during the volatile period that lasted for nearly a month, only Nomura Taiwan Select and KGI Taiwan maintained positive returns, demonstrating excellent resilience. The research team pointed out that the AI ​​supply chain is ushering in a transition in the capital expenditure structure. As profits of Taiwanese manufacturers continue to be revised upward and market evaluations converge, there is still room for upside in the market outlook. Experts remind investors that investors should carefully assess risks and read the public prospectus carefully. The offensive and defensive performance of active ETFs will become a key indicator for subsequent review of stock selection strength.

title: 台泥上半年淨利飆241%   整合土葡非事業要海外上市
summary: 台泥今（12）日公布2026年第二季財報，累計上半年合併營收達712.9億元，較去年同期成長1%；歸屬母公司淨利達32.8億元，年增241%，每股盈餘為0.38元，在產業逆風中殺出重圍，展現出國際化經營的韌性。董事會也通過整合旗下土耳其、葡萄牙及非洲等水泥及混凝土建材相關業務，納入新設子公司Cimpor International，申請海外證券交易市場首次公開發行股票及掛牌交易。

title_en: Taiwan Cement's net profit soared 241% in the first half of the year, integrating Turkey's non-Portuguese business and planning to list overseas
summary_en: TCC announced its second quarter financial report for 2026 on the 12th. The cumulative consolidated revenue in the first half of the year reached 71.29 billion yuan, an increase of 1% over the same period last year; the net profit attributable to the parent company reached 3.28 billion yuan, an increase of 241% year-on-year, and the earnings per share was 0.38 yuan. It has fought against industry headwinds and demonstrated the resilience of international operations. The board of directors also integrated its cement and concrete building materials-related businesses in Turkey, Portugal and Africa, incorporated the newly established subsidiary Cimpor International, and applied for initial public offerings and listings in overseas securities exchange markets.

title_en: Taiwan spends a maximum of 29.1 billion yuan to acquire Jingcheng equity at a premium of 29.5%, with the target of holding more than half of the shares
summary_en: Taiwan announced that it will publicly acquire the common shares of Jingcheng through its wholly-owned subsidiary Taixin Telecom, with the goal of increasing its holdings by at least 39%, bringing the total shareholding to more than half, and the upper limit of the total purchase price of the whole case will reach 29.13 billion yuan. summary: 美國最新公布的7月消費者物價指數（CPI）數據符合市場預期，月增率約0.1%，年增率則從3.5%微幅降至3.4%，市場預期聯準會升息機率隨之降低，激勵美股週三表現。科技股強勢領軍，那斯達克指數上漲0.54%，費城半導體指數更大幅勁揚2.49%，標普500指數同步收紅。儘管道瓊工業指數小幅下跌21.58點，但在通膨降溫的正面訊號下，投資人信心回穩，整體市場情緒偏向樂觀，後續貨幣政策動向仍為市場高度關注之焦點。

title_en: U.S. CPI in July revealed reduced pressure to raise interest rates! Fees rose 300 points, Nasdaq rose 143 points
summary_en: The latest US consumer price index (CPI) data for July was in line with market expectations, with a monthly growth rate of about 0.1% and an annual growth rate that slightly dropped from 3.5% to 3.4%. The market expected that the probability of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates would subsequently decrease, which encouraged the performance of US stocks on Wednesday. Technology stocks strongly led the way, with the Nasdaq index rising 0.54%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rising sharply by 2.49%, and the S&P 500 Index closing in the red simultaneously. Although the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell slightly by 21.58 points, under the positive signal of cooling inflation, investor confidence has stabilized and the overall market sentiment is optimistic. The subsequent monetary policy trends are still the focus of the market.

title_en: Merida earned 2.15 yuan per share in the first half of the year, and the high base period affected profits by 20% year-on-year.
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Pan Zhiyi, Taipei, 12th) Bicycle manufacturer Merida today announced that the group's consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was NT$12.3 billion, net profit after tax attributable to the parent company was NT$640 million, and after-tax earnings per share (EPS) was NT$2.15. Due to the impact of the high base period in the same period last year, revenue and profit decreased by 16% and 21% respectively compared with the same period last year.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zeng Yuting, Taipei, 12th) There have been frequent incidents of fires and smoke coming out of mobile power supplies recently. According to product recall data from the Bureau of Standards and Inspection of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, so far this year, 8 brand manufacturers and more than 87,000 products have announced recalls. It also called on the public to proactively inquire about product recall information.

title_en: [Before the opening] Foreign investors went crazy and slashed 37,000 copies of "this big memory manufacturer"! 550,000 shareholders are half green
summary_en: Taiwan stocks showed strong bull momentum yesterday (12th), with the weighted index closing up 397.35 points, with trading volume reaching 858.7 billion yuan. However, selling pressure emerged in the market. Winbond, a major memory manufacturer with more than 550,000 shareholders, was heavily sold by foreign investors. More than 30,000 units were sold in a single day. The stock price opened high and then fell, finally closing at 177 yuan, which shocked many shareholders. According to stock exchange data, the top ten stocks that foreign investors oversold yesterday included Winbond, Nanmao, and South China Gold, while overbuying focused on Power Semiconductor, Compal, and Hon Hai. Experts remind that Taiwan's stock market has experienced intensified volatility recently, and investors need to pay close attention to foreign investment trends and carefully assess market risks. Investment decisions should be made independently to reduce transaction risks.

title_en: It took two years to prove that he is the "right person". Taiwan bids 29.13 billion to acquire Jingcheng Information
summary_en: On the afternoon of the 12th, Taiwan announced that it would hold a major news conference that evening, which immediately triggered discussions from all walks of life. The results were a bit surprising but familiar to the outside world. Lin Zhichen, the general manager of Taiwan, spoke on behalf of the company. After two years of coexistence and understanding, he deeply felt that Jingcheng Information, with whom he had previously become acquainted, was the "right person" and decided to increase his marriage proposal. title_en: Germans love their cars but don’t wash them? A writer who has lived in Germany for 7 years reveals that the reason for "deliberately leaving dirt" is unexpected
summary_en: Japan and Germany are both major countries in the global automobile industry, but there is a sharp contrast in the attitudes of the two countries towards vehicle maintenance. Japanese writer Oda Shiori, who has lived in Germany for seven years, observed that vehicles on German streets are generally not as bright and clean as Japanese cars, and even appear a little messy. After asking local roommates and friends, she was surprised to find that some German car owners actually "deliberately do not wash their cars." The reason behind this special habit is actually inseparable from the local parking environment and security risks.

title_en: Loans reached a new high in June, and the stock market crashed in July! Leveraged funds trigger market doubts? Li Hongji reveals: The problem lies in liquidity
summary_en: In June, Taiwan's personal loan growth reached a new high in a single month. In July, it suffered a stock market crash, which caused a lot of discussion in the market. Is this wave of stock market crash caused by people's crazy use of borrowed funds to invest in the stock market? In this regard, many investment experts have said that such an association is too far-fetched. Li Hongji, CEO of Quanliang International, warned: "Liquidity is indeed declining." Li Hongji analyzed that since it is difficult for the competent authorities to control and track the use of funds after people's loans, it is difficult to confirm the relationship between the loan surge and the stock market crash, but it is recommended to think in terms of "liquidity". Li Hongji said that the current volume of hedging transactions is quite large, but if investors want to borrow money from securities firms for hedging financing, "it is not easy to borrow money now."

title_en: Lin Chongji became the richest man in Taiwan with 2 iron bars! Xie Jinhe, Jiechuanhu, holds 3,600 patents, shocking revenue of 10,000-yuan shares revealed
summary_en: Lin Congji, chairman of server slide manufacturer Chuanhu, has become the richest man in Taiwan with a net worth of US$16.7 billion. Xie Jinhe, chairman of Caixin Media, praised Lin Congji as a model of "sharpening one sword in life". Chuanhu transformed from kitchenware slides to a global server linear slide faucet, holding 3,600 patents to create an unbreakable moat. Chuanhu not only has a gross profit margin as high as 87.4%, but its stock price has also jumped to Taiwan's third-tier "10,000-yuan stock", demonstrating its strong industrial competitiveness. Xie Jinhe analyzed that the AI ​​wave has become the core engine of current wealth creation. Chuanhu has successfully rode on the AI ​​wave, which is in sharp contrast to companies that rely on the Chinese market. Lin Chongji's family is united in business operations and continues to tap into the global market with excellent technology, becoming a legendary representative of Taiwan's industrial transformation and upgrading.

summary: 近期全球股市宛如坐上雲霄飛車，千點狂飆後又大幅重挫，尤其韓股、費城半導體指數以及台股的震盪更是劇烈，讓投資人直呼吃不消，甚至懷疑牛市是否結束。「鉅亨買基金」表示，這波修正主要集中在科技與半導體市場，但AI長線成長趨勢並未改變，長期投資人不宜因短期波動輕易離場，錯失良機；若無法承受科技股劇烈震盪，則可選擇產業更分散的美國股票基金，除了降低波動，也能兼顧長期成長機會。

title_en: When will Taiwan stocks rise? A table to understand the "resilience" of major stock markets after the crash
summary_en: Recently, the global stock market has been like a roller coaster, soaring by thousands of points and then plummeting sharply. The Korean stock market, Philadelphia Semiconductor Index and Taiwan stock market have been particularly volatile, leaving investors feeling overwhelmed and even doubting whether the bull market is over. "Juheng Buy Fund" stated that this wave of corrections is mainly concentrated in the technology and semiconductor markets, but the long-term growth trend of AI has not changed. Long-term investors should not leave the market easily due to short-term fluctuations and miss opportunities; if they cannot withstand the violent fluctuations of technology stocks, they can choose U.S. stock funds with more diversified industries. In addition to reducing volatility, they can also take into account long-term growth opportunities.

title_en: Taiwan acquires Jingcheng Information at a premium of 29.5%, NT$184.5 per share, and establishes an in-depth ICT strategic alliance
summary_en: Taiwan Mobile held its board of directors meeting today (12th) and decided to publicly acquire ordinary shares of Jingcheng Information through its wholly-owned subsidiary Taixin Telecommunications, with the goal of increasing its stake to at least 39%. Taiwan Mobile is the largest single legal person shareholder of Jingcheng Information, already holding 11.86% of the shares. With the public acquisition of at least 39% of the shares by the wholly-owned subsidiary "Taixin Telecommunications", the total shareholding will rise to more than 50.86%.

title_en: Foreign media: Foreign capital is back, abandoning South Korea and embracing Taiwanese stocks
summary_en: The artificial intelligence (AI) craze has pushed up the Taiwan and South Korea stock markets this year. After the violent sell-off in July, the Taiwan and South Korea markets are gradually recovering, but Taiwan stocks are more favored by foreign investors than Korean stocks! U.S. media pointed out on the 12th that compared with the Korean stock market, which is highly volatile and leveraged, Taiwan stocks have become an AI benchmark market due to their relatively stable corporate profits, more diversified technology supply chains, and lower leverage levels. Foreign investors have purchased more than US$1.7 billion (approximately NT$54.8 billion) of Taiwan stocks so far in August, while they have withdrawn US$6.2 billion (approximately NT$199.8 billion) from Korean stocks during the same period.

summary_en: In order to seize business opportunities in the AI ​​supply chain, Taiwan Land Bank established a Beishike branch in Beitou District, Taipei City on August 10 to actively explore business opportunities in the development of AI industry clusters. The opening ceremony kicked off with auspicious lions, treasures from the God of Wealth, and a five-drum array. Charity donation activities were also held simultaneously to implement corporate social responsibility with practical actions.

title: 當沖降稅鼓勵投機
summary: 日昨本報頭版報導，股市交易當沖降稅，有望再延長。我們認為萬萬不可，坊間早已戲稱股市為賭場，當沖降稅實即鼓勵股民投機而非投資，政府成為賭場莊家，鼓勵全民去賭，這適當嗎？這也不是證券市場媒介儲蓄與投資應有的功能。
title_zh: 當沖降稅鼓勵投機

title_en: When tax cuts encourage speculation
summary_en: Yesterday, the front page of this newspaper reported that the tax cut for stock market transactions is expected to be extended. We think it is absolutely not possible. People have long joked that the stock market is a casino. The tax cuts actually encourage investors to speculate rather than invest. The government becomes the casino banker and encourages all people to gamble. Is this appropriate? This is not the proper function of the securities market as a media for savings and investment.

title: 國票金高薪爭議 公股治理警鐘
summary: 國票金副董事長年薪逾2千萬元的爭議，最近成為立法院與金融市場關注的焦點。第一銀行公開表示，身為國票金股東，已要求所推派的法人董事透過董事會，檢討國票金及旗下公司的薪酬結構與合理性。事情發展至此，問題已不只是2千萬年薪合不合理，而是公股既然取得主導權，究竟誰應該為公股治理負責？

title_en: Controversy over high state-funded salary raises alarm for public stock governance
summary_en: The controversy over the annual salary of Vice Chairman of the National Bank of China, which exceeds 20 million yuan, has recently become the focus of attention of the Legislative Yuan and the financial market. First Bank publicly stated that as a shareholder of Kokutojin, it has asked the recommended corporate directors to review the remuneration structure and rationality of Kokuyojin and its subsidiaries through the board of directors. Now that things have developed, the question is no longer just whether the annual salary of 20 million is reasonable, but now that public shares have taken the lead, who should be responsible for the governance of public shares?

title: 通膨溫和 美7月CPI年增3.4％
summary: 美國官方12日公布的統計顯示，7月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增3.4％，低於6月的3.5％，也符合市場預期。整體通膨數據溫和，短期內緩解市場對物價超預期反彈的擔憂，但距離聯準會政策轉向升息所需仍有距離，市場維持9月會後利率持平的預測，美股三大指數開盤集體小幅走升。

title: 整併需透明化 王怡心示警政治干預
summary: 立法院財政委員會12日舉辦公股整併公聽會，台北大學會計學系教授、曾任第一金官派董事王怡心表示，在善待員工、保障股東權益前提下，支持公公併；她也警示，若合併過程政治干預愈多，合併後的綜效恐愈差。

title: 國票金董座喊併 讓大家搶親
summary: 公股銀行實質掌握國票金主導權與經營權，未來是否與公股整併成為焦點。立法院財政委員會12日舉行公股整併公聽會，會中，國票金董座張兆順直言「國票金這麼小，一定要併！」民眾黨立委劉書彬指出，財政部應在3個月內完成泛公股金融機構治理準則，並在半年內提出國票金整併的可行性評估。

title: 新北327投資案 總額近8千億
summary: 新北市政府透過招商投資、產業升級、園區開發、國際拓銷及淨零轉型等多面向布局，成功推動327件投資案，帶動7775億元資金投入，創造逾12.2萬個就業機會，其中ASML（艾司摩爾）投資約300億元於林口建造零碳智慧廠房；營利事業銷售額從民國107年4.96兆元成長至114年7.9兆元。市長侯友宜說，經發局招商引資帶動產業蓬勃發展，打造成宜居、產業城市。

title: 耐斯要搶第二席副董 學者促財政部出手
summary: 國票金控子公司國票證券將於明（14）日召開董事會，傳出將選任民股代表陳冠如續任副董事長，引發「肥貓不只一隻，還要養第二隻，而且是兄弟檔」爭議，雖然金控建議暫緩，但耐斯仍積極要搶第二席副董。對此，北商大財政稅務系教授黃耀輝直言，財政部當初過度妥協，如今應撥亂反正，盡速檢討設置副董的必要性，並踩煞車。

title_en: The number of digital deposit accounts of China National Bank reached 30.24 million at the end of June, and the annual growth rate hit a new low.
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 12th) Statistics from the Financial Supervisory Commission show that as of the end of June this year, the number of digital deposit accounts opened by China National Bank was approximately 30.24 million. Although the quarterly growth rate was 3.51%, which was a slight increase, the annual growth rate of 14.16% hit a record low. The Financial Supervisory Commission stated that the growth rate has slowed down mainly because the base period of the overall digital deposit account has been high, but the overall number of accounts is still increasing.

title_en: Taiwan's public acquisition of Jingcheng, with an upper limit of 29.1 billion yuan, holding more than half of the shares after the acquisition
summary_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045)'s board of directors approved a major investment case on the 12th. Taiwan Mobile's chief financial officer and spokesman Zhang Jiaqi said that through the wholly-owned subsidiary Taixin Telecommunications, it will publicly acquire Taiwan's largest information service industry Jingcheng (6214). It is expected to increase its holdings of at least 39% of the shares. The purchase price per share is about 184.5 yuan, a premium of about 29%. If the total purchase price reaches the upper limit, it will exceed 29.1 billion yuan. It became the largest investment case in the history of Taiwan Mobile. After the completion of the acquisition, Taiwan General held approximately 58% of Jingcheng.

title_en: Juhan's first-half revenue exceeded 4 billion yuan, surpassing last year's full-year EPS of 14.14 yuan, an annual increase of more than 4 times.
summary_en: Juhan System Technology (6903) held a corporate briefing for the first half of 2026 today (12th). Benefiting from the continued expansion of investment in global AI infrastructure and strong demand for advanced semiconductor processes and high-tech factory construction, Juhan's consolidated revenue in the first half of 2026 reached NT$4.005 billion, exceeding the total revenue for the whole year of 2025. Net profit after tax also hit a record high for the same period in previous years, with basic earnings per share (EPS) reaching NT$14.14. As of the end of July 2026, Juhan's orders on hand remained at a high level of approximately 11 billion yuan, with order visibility reaching the next 2 to 3 years, providing clear growth momentum for the company to continue to expand its operating scale and move towards its long-term goal of revenue exceeding 10 billion yuan in 2030.

title_en: Why did Rongcheng reorganize its holdings? Three major plans exposed: leaving room for investment, mergers and acquisitions, and listing
summary_en: Rongcheng (1909) announced its transformation into an investment holding company, which attracted market attention as to why it initiated organizational restructuring at this time. In this regard, Rongcheng said that this adjustment is not just a corporate reorganization, but hopes to establish a group holding platform first, so that each business unit will have greater operational flexibility in strategic cooperation, investment and mergers and acquisitions in the future. It also retains the possibility of introducing strategic partners and subsidiaries to be listed in the future, setting up a pre-structured structure for the next stage of international layout.

title_en: Industry, government and academia gather to exchange views on carbon reduction issues. The Ministry of Transport supports the industry towards the goal of net-zero sustainability.
summary_en: In response to global climate change and the 2050 net-zero emission target, the Ministry of Environment announced on March 4, 2014 that it has revised the "Emission Sources of Enterprises Should Inventory and Registration of Greenhouse Gas Emissions" to include the automobile transportation industry, railway transportation industry, and hotel industry that meet certain conditions into the greenhouse gas inventory registration. Greenhouse gas inventory is an important foundation for the industry to establish carbon management. In order to promote exchanges between industry, government and academia on greenhouse gas inventory and carbon reduction practices, the Ministry of Transport held the "Transportation and Hotel Industry Greenhouse Gas Inventory Practice Seminar - Inventory Deepening and Carbon Reduction Forward Sustainability Forum" on August 11.

title_en: Prime Minister of St. Vincent and the Grenadines visits Keelung Port to deepen maritime and port exchanges between Taiwan and St. Vincent and the Grenadines
summary_en: The delegation of Prime Minister of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (Dr. the Hon. Godwin Friday) and his wife visited Keelung Port on the morning of the 12th and were received by Su Jianrong, general manager of the Keelung Port Branch of Taiwan Port Corporation. summary: Counterpoint Research預估，iPhone 18系列受DRAM、NAND及2奈米製程成本上升影響，物料成本（BoM）將增加200到300美元。過去12個月DRAM均價上漲約400%、NAND逾300%，成本壓力預計至少持續18個月。蘋果可能採差異化定價，控制入門版本漲幅，高容量版本則有較大調價空間，果粉正關注最後的定價。

title_en: Components rise, Apple fans pay attention to iPhone 18 pricing strategy
summary_en: Counterpoint Research estimates that the bill of materials (BoM) cost of the iPhone 18 series will increase by US$200 to US$300 due to the rising costs of DRAM, NAND and 2nm processes. The average price of DRAM has increased by about 400% in the past 12 months, and that of NAND by more than 300%. Cost pressure is expected to last for at least 18 months. Apple may adopt differentiated pricing to control the price increase of the entry-level version, while the high-capacity version will have more room for price adjustment. Apple fans are paying attention to the final pricing.

summary_en: Taiben (1310), one of the three domestic styrene (SM) manufacturers, announced last month that it would stop the production of its main product styrene, which is expected to affect about 97% of its revenue. If continued production may further erode cash flow and expand losses, it has decided to suspend production from October and reserve resources for future transformation layout.

不需要大裝潢，也不用馬上換家具，只要從幾個小地方調整，客廳就能變得更好整理、更安全，也更有質感。

title_en: Zhong Fuji, Chairman of the All-China Federation of Finance and Economics: Employees’ rights and interests lack legal protection and employees are often sued after the merger
summary_en: What problems will employees' rights encounter when financial institutions merge? Zhong Fuji, chairman of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions, pointed out today that employee rights and interests have become empty talk due to the lack of participation before and after the event. He emphasized that the "employee resettlement plan" to protect the rights and interests of employees must go through a labor agreement. Whether it is a civil merger, a public merger, or a civil-private merger, the right of negotiation and retention between the new and old employers must be abolished, and the trade union must have the "right to know."

title: 微星攜手輝達 導入 XpertStation WS300與 EdgeXpert 平台
summary: MSI微星（2377）今日宣布，其XpertStation WS300與EdgeXpert平台現已支援輝達（NVIDIA） Nemotron 3.5 Lightning—專為Agentic AI打造的輕量化開源模型，以及NeMo Switchyard—開源模型路由函式庫。Switchyard透過系統化模型調度，將每個工作流程步驟導向最適合的模型，例如將複雜推理交由前沿規模模型處理，並將大量、專門化任務交由Nemotron 3.5 Lightning等輕量模型處理，藉此提升準確度、降低延遲並控制成本。

title_en: MSI joins hands with Huida to introduce XpertStation WS300 and EdgeXpert platforms
summary_en: MSI (2377) announced today that its XpertStation WS300 and EdgeXpert platforms now support NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a lightweight open source model specially built for Agentic AI, and NeMo Switchyard, an open source model routing library. Switchyard uses systematic model scheduling to guide each workflow step to the most suitable model. For example, complex inferences are handled by cutting-edge scale models, and large-scale, specialized tasks are handled by lightweight models such as Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, thereby improving accuracy, reducing latency, and controlling costs.

title_en: In response to the "public-public merger" of national bills, Chairman Zhang Siu-shun responded for the first time that now is not a good time
summary_en: The Finance Committee of the Legislative Yuan held a public hearing today on "How do pan-public financial institutions under the Ministry of Finance formulate short- and medium-term strategies and implementation plans for pan-public mergers in the face of the current fierce competition environment?" Zhang Zhaoshun, chairman of Guofan Financial Holdings, pointed out at the public hearing that he has three key tasks, which are "eliminating internal friction, improving operating performance, and strengthening corporate governance." The scale of Guofan Financial is too small, and it is necessary whether it is merged or merged with others. But he believes that now is not a good time to talk about a merger with the National Bank, and he should first make himself better and more beautiful.

title_en: High-rated bonds are under heavy pressure, investment thinking turns to stock-bond balanced funds
summary_en: Franklin Securities Investment Consulting stated that based on the rolling return analysis of U.S. stocks and bonds from 1950 to 2025, after investing for more than five years, the return range of the stock-bond balance has all been positive returns, and the winning rate and investment efficiency are ahead of bonds. Looking forward to the market outlook, as global central bank monetary policies will still focus on changes in inflation, short-term interest rates are still under upward pressure, and high-rated bonds are under heavy pressure, conservative and prudent investors have broken away from the traditional thinking of bonds as a source of income and turned to US balanced funds as the core to collect income and expand reward opportunities.

title_en: AI token usage reaches 45% of the world, mainland stock market rises with structural differences
summary_en: Xiao Zhengyi, manager of HSBC China A-share Convergence Fund, pointed out that one of the highlights of mainland China's capital market is that mainland AI-related companies have gradually increased their share of global stock market value and revenue, and AI token usage has reached 45% of the world. This shows that mainland China has become an indispensable part of the global AI ecosystem, especially in areas such as AI power infrastructure, data centers, and physical AI. It still has considerable global competitiveness. However, the current shareholding ratio of international investors in mainland AI-related stocks is still significantly low; as global AI investment continues to expand, international funds are expected to re-examine the allocation value of mainland technology assets, which will lead to the restoration of the evaluation of related stocks and the possibility of upward pricing. Its future growth potential and long-term allocation value are worthy of investors to incorporate mid-term strategies more prudently and make early arrangements.

title_en: Likai Electronics wins Tesla's biggest order in 20 years, spending 1 billion to settle in Tainan or Taichung
summary_en: The AI ​​craze has boosted the demand for computing power in data centers, but it has also set off a serious power shortage crisis in the United States, prompting an accelerated shift to the introduction of lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries for large-scale energy storage systems (ESS). Seizing the dividends from this wave of dual engines of green energy and AI, the board of directors of Taiwan's major battery materials manufacturer Likai-KY (5227) approved a major investment plan on the 11th. In addition to participating in the current increase of subsidiary Taiwan Likai Electric Power, it will also invest NT$1 billion to rent factories and purchase equipment. It will be officially opened in October this year and is expected to start contributing revenue in July next year, showing strong operating dynamics.

title: 房仲是炒高房價的元兇？張惠山：「房仲是市場的鏡子，不是導演！」
summary:
在房地產三十多年，最常被問到的一個問題就是：「你們房仲是不是把房價炒高的元兇？」

每次聽到這個問題，我都哭笑不得。房仲既不是高房價的元兇，也不是房價的推手。更精確地說，房仲是市場情緒的「放大器」，在漲勢中反映樂觀，在跌勢中反映悲觀。我們是市場的鏡子，不是市場的導演。

title: 哥倫比亞地震導致主要港口受阻，咖啡出口基本停滯

title: DRAM雙雄領軍，KOSPI週三收漲3.68%，站上6,500點
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓股甩開美股連續兩日收黑壓力，在DRAM雙雄三星電子和SK海力士領軍下，週三跳空開高，首爾綜合股價指數(KOSPI)盤中一度飆漲322.90點或5.09%，攻抵6,668.43點，觸發韓國交易所啟動程式交易暫停機制(SIDECAR)，暫停KOSPI程式化買盤，以抑制短時間內市場過度波動。大型製藥股午後賣壓湧現，壓縮大盤漲幅，KOSPI終場仍大漲233.51點或3.68%，連續第二個交易日收高，報6,579.04點，為8月5日以來最高收市水準。十九大類股中，主流電子股大漲5.92%，為表現最旺類股。低價股錦湖電機飆漲29.90%，收在5,300韓元；樂金電子急漲13.13%成為三十檔大型股(KTOP30)最旺個股，三星電子和SK海力士分別勁揚6.68%及5.54%，成為推升大盤的主要力量。反觀，製藥類股重挫3.53%，淪為盤面最大拖油瓶。兩大製藥業者柳韓洋行和塞爾群分別下跌2.92%及4.04%淪為KTOP30兩檔墊底個股，限制KOSPI終場漲幅，並使指數自盤中高點回吐近90點。

title: 盤後／台股漲397點高檔震盪　籌碼進駐4類股
summary: 台股今（12）日受美股科技股激勵，加權指數終場上漲397點，收在45518點，成交值達8587億元。盤面上AI概念股強勢領軍，PCB材料、光通訊及先進封裝供應鏈成為資金避風港，南電、華星光及萬潤等多檔個股攻上漲停。法人指出，儘管市場關注美國通膨數據及中東局勢，但AI基本面成長動能強勁，多方架構未遭破壞。分析師提醒，指數處於高檔震盪，投資人應留意獲利了結壓力，後續成交量能否持續放大，將是台股挑戰上方壓力區的關鍵指標。投資人於決策時須審慎評估市場風險。

title: 日本視訊會議市場前景看好 CAGR 8.12%成長至16.2億美元
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導日本視訊會議市場正經歷顯著成長，預計到 2034 年，市場規模將達到 16.2 億美元。根據 IMARC Group 的報告指出，從 2026 年至 2034 年間，該市場的年複合成長率（CAGR，指在特定時間範圍內每年成長的平均百分比）預期將達到 8.12%。這項成長趨勢建立在 2025 年市場規模已達 8 億美元的基礎上。 推動這波成長的主要動力來自於混合工作模式的普及，以及企業對可靠視訊會議解決方案的強勁需求。這些方案能有效連結現場與遠距員工，並提供穩定的影音品質、便捷的會議參與、螢幕分享及流暢的協作功能，進而降低差旅和會議成本。此外，雲端協作、即時翻譯、自動轉錄、會議摘要等進階功能，以及與數位工作流程的整合性也日益受到重視。 日本政府的數位轉型計畫也扮演關鍵角色。以日本經濟產業省為例，該單位已於 2026 年 2 月擴大資訊科技基礎設施現代化補助計畫，特別針對中小企業（SMEs）採用雲端通訊平台提供資金，大幅降低了這些企業導入的財務門檻。此外，日益嚴格的資安要求也促使企業採購具備端對端加密和符合資料管理規範的安全認證視訊會議方案。 人工智慧

title: 日經指數週三走升0.83%，銀行、服務類股領漲，惟油價大漲抑制漲勢
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】日本股市週三走升，銀行、服務類股領漲，但是原油價格上漲，程度上仍抑制了大盤漲勢。收盤時，東證第一部指數上揚38.39點或0.94%，報4,139.00點；日經225指數上漲553.84點或0.83%，報67,524.06點。日本央行提前升息的預期升溫，提振了三菱日聯等金融股股價行情。不過，中東局勢混沌不明，令油價走升。大和資產管理公司首席策略分析師Kazunori Tatebe表示，目前公佈的財報顯示，人工智能相關產業表現強勁，許多非人工智能領域的公司也取得了亮眼的業績。Tatebe表示，除了對匯率波動高度敏感的股票外，對潛在外匯干預的擔憂對日本市場整體的影響仍然有限。Tatebe指出，原油價格上漲和美國股市下跌構成不利因素，在美國消費者物價指數(CPI)數據公佈之前，市場不太可能出現大幅波動。Phillip證券研究部門主管Kazuhiro Sasaki表示，強勁的財報季提振了東證指數的買氣，日本整體市場似乎也相對穩定。Sasaki表示，在日圓匯價疲軟的背景下，對於日本央行加快升息腳步的預期升溫，這提振了銀行股的吸引力。銀行目前的獲利狀況已經非常強勁，投資者預期政策

title: 挪威主權基金揭露SpaceX持股 逾12億美元引發治理關注
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜何映辰／台北報導全球最大的主權財富基金，挪威主權財富基金（負責投資全球以確保國家長期財富），首次揭露其在馬斯克（Elon Musk）創辦的太空探索公司SpaceX的持股狀況。截至2023年6月30日，該基金持有SpaceX價值12.2億美元的股份，佔該公司0.05%股權。 根據《The Straits Times》報導，這項持股資訊是挪威主權財富基金於昨日（8月11日）在其更新後的持股清單中首次披露。該基金總資產高達2.3兆美元，平均持有全球約7,100家上市公司的1.5%股份。雖然12.2億美元是筆巨額投資，但相較於基金對其他科技巨頭的持股比例仍屬保守。 例如，該基金持有輝達（Nvidia）1.28%的股份，價值620億美元；持有蘋果（Apple）1.24%股份，價值520億美元；持有Alphabet公司1.17%股份，價值500億美元；持有微軟（Microsoft）1.27%股份，價值350億美元。值得注意的是，該基金還持有臺灣積體電路製造公司（Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing，簡稱臺積電）1.7%股份，價值340億美元，顯示其

title: 台灣首富換人當！「10檔」概念基金　跟著川湖一起發
summary: 伺服器導軌大廠川湖創辦人林聰吉身價飆升至167億美元，正式登上台灣首富寶座。受惠於全球AI伺服器需求強勁，川湖憑藉技術與高階產品組合優勢，帶動毛利率與營運表現亮眼，股價強勢推升。此波行情也讓布局川湖的台股基金績效大爆發，據統計，近一個月績效前十名基金中，高達9檔皆持有川湖，其中野村優質基金以逾7%報酬率奪冠。展望未來，隨AI伺服器平台持續升級與產能擴增，川湖營運成長動能持續看旺，成為市場關注焦點。

title: 中國宇樹科技IPO 預示機器人產業更大轉變

title: 鴻海法說1》獲利創高！上半年每股賺7.84元 年增25%

title: 榮成今停牌突發重訊　原因曝光！宣布全面轉為「這類型」公司
summary: 老牌紙業大廠榮成（1909）宣布重大組織調整，董事會決議將台灣工業用紙及紙箱業務分割，轉型為投資控股公司。此案預計於10月1日召開股東臨時會討論，暫定2027年1月4日為分割基準日。榮成表示，轉型投控後將負責集團策略規劃與資源配置，台灣業務則由全資子公司「榮成低碳紙箱」承接，形成區域分工架構。本次組織調整旨在透過各事業體聚焦市場，並引進策略夥伴強化營運動能。榮成強調，整體股東權益不受影響，股票代號維持1909。受此重訊影響，榮成股票自12日起暫停交易，待公告後申請恢復。未來公司將持續深耕低碳造紙與綠色包裝，並加速推動AI智慧製造及國際化布局，維持市場競爭優勢。

title: 韓亞航空99.3%壓倒性通過與大韓合併案，韓國航空龍頭即將誕生
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，大韓航空(Korean Air)和韓亞航空(Asiana Airlines)在一份聲明中表示，股東已批准合併協議，這為12月17日成立一家綜合航空公司邁出了重要一步。報導指稱，韓亞航空股東以99.3%的贊成票批准了合併案。在完成債權人保護程式和剩餘行政步驟後，公司合併登記預計將於12月17日完成。大韓航空在6月25日獲得韓國國土交通部的有條件批准後，正在推動航空營運許可證的修改和國際運營許可證的申請。

title: 明天許願特別靈！ 12星座吉時曝 喜迎高光時刻
summary: 明（13）日農曆七月初一，進入象徵慈悲、祈福與重新整理內心的「慈悲月」，恰逢獅子座新月，天空又上演六行星連珠、日全食等罕見星象。這是一個很適合替自己重新許願的時刻：不是只求「我要變幸運」，而是勇敢說出「我真正想成為誰、想過什麼樣的人生」。塔羅牌老師艾菲爾表示，獅子座掌管自信、魅力、愛與夢想，這次新月尤其適合把埋藏很久的心願重新寫下來。今晚不妨靜下來，選定一個最渴望實現的願望，想像它成真的模樣，再告訴自己：從今天開始，我願意為它走出第一步。

title: 高端疫苗第二季轉虧為盈！每股盈餘0.07元 總座樂看全年有望轉盈
summary: 高端疫苗（6547）第二季每股盈餘0.07元，帶動上半年每股虧損收斂至0.02元。總經理李思賢今（12）日表示，上半年虧損已大幅收斂，對於全年轉虧為盈抱持樂觀態度。展望後市，除了台灣腸病毒71型疫苗銷售維持穩定，7月起陸續出貨、8月開始認列業績的越南市場，也可望成為今年營運成長的重要動能。

title: 大學宅哪裡最好租、最會賺？雙北26大學城比一輪　淡江3.3%打敗台北名校
summary: 暑假進入尾聲，大學周邊租屋市場再度升溫。房仲業者盤點雙北26處大學城周邊近一年房價與租金發現，投報率高低不見得是名校所在位置，租金投報率冠軍由淡江大學周邊拿下，高達3.3%，而中國文化大學以3.2%居次，真理大學、台北市立大學天母校區則同為2.9%並列第三，反映房價基期相對低的大學城，更有機會撐出較高租金報酬率。

title_en: The real estate market is both old and new/New Qing’an 3.0 has spurred a wave of house viewings, while pre-sales have been stagnant and second-hand houses are picking up
summary_en: The "Young People's Safe Start-up House Purchase Preferential Loan Program 3.0" (referred to as Qing'an 3.0) was officially launched on August 1, and the market momentum for house viewing has also begun to change. This magazine’s on-site visit found that the reception center for pre-sales of new construction projects is still deserted. On the contrary, the second-hand house market is the first to feel the rebound in buying sentiment. The number of buyers viewing houses and making bids during the holidays has gradually increased. The real estate market is showing two sentiments: "pre-sales are cold, second-hand houses are warm".

summary: 預售屋市場買氣依舊冷清，建商坦言，即使祭出送裝潢、家電或工程款分期等優惠，購屋族仍期待房價進一步下修；然而在土地、營造、缺工與利息成本居高不下之下，建商能讓價的空間也愈來愈有限。

title_en: The housing market is old and new. 1/It’s cold to buy a pre-sale house. The builder reveals the reason for the high price and laments, “If the price is lowered, we will lose money.”
summary_en: The pre-sale housing market is still bleak, and builders admit that even if they offer discounts such as free decoration, home appliances or installment payments for construction, home buyers still expect housing prices to fall further. However, with land, construction, labor shortages and interest costs remaining high, builders have increasingly limited room to negotiate lower prices.

title_en: The new and old housing market 2/You can see that "you can move in once you buy it" Experts reveal the 4 keys to the differentiation of buying sentiment between old and new housing
summary_en: Why are second-hand houses starting to pick up, but pre-sale houses still lack interest? According to this magazine’s investigation, price and room for negotiation, whether the house can actually be seen, whether the house can be moved in immediately after purchase, and the uncertainty of handing over the house and bank loan approval, have become the four key factors in this wave of buying momentum towards second-hand houses.

title_en: The old and new situation in the housing market 3/Qing’an 3.0 has limited support for the housing market. The reasons why the central bank is unwilling to significantly loosen restrictions are exposed.
summary_en: Although Qing'an 3.0 is on the road to increase home purchases for first-time buyers and families getting married and raising children, the key to truly thawing the overall housing market still lies in the hands of the central bank. Experts point out that the strength of Taiwan's stock market has caused some funds to flow back into the housing market. If credit controls are significantly relaxed at this time, it may further push up housing prices and make it unlikely that the central bank will fully relax restrictions in the short term.

title: 四貸同堂入股風險是想像？李同榮反駁學者四大評論
summary: [Newtalk新聞] 近日，有學者針對「四貸同堂」入股恐引發金融風暴相關議題發表評論，並以「信度、效度、知識水平、信賴水準」四項指標，認為相關論述缺乏充分證據，較屬於「風險想像」。 房市趨勢專家李同榮針對學者的四項指標論述提出不同觀點，他認為學者曲解了「預警」與「預測」的區別。市場真正需要的不只是驗證，更需要預警；政府需要的不只是制度，更需要落實監理；學界需要的不只是研究，更需要貼近市場。對於金融風險的判斷，除了學術驗證，更不能忽略市場第一線的實務觀察，以及風險管理最重要的核心精神—預警永遠比事後驗證更重要。 李同榮表示，學者針對四貸入股恐引發金融風暴，提出四大評論，包括：「信度不足」「效度偏低」「知識水平」與「信賴水準極低」，這樣的批判與曲解，實在有必要逐一回應，藉以正本清源： 一、所謂「信度不足」，混淆了市場預警與事後驗證 學者認為，金融危機發生的可能性缺乏直接證據，因此「信度」偏低。 李同榮提出一個簡單的問題：金融風險究竟是看現在，還是看未來？學者提所謂「證據信度」，是指證據發生才來檢討，還是依市場多貸入股亂象及早提出示警而加以防範？何者為優？何者為先？ 如果一定要等到金融危機

title: 矽晶圓集體強攻！AI需求引爆漲價潮　4檔亮燈漲停

title: 全球流動性動能去年底見頂，Howell示警資金撤離金融市場美股難再飆
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，英國資深總體經濟策略師麥可．豪威爾(Michael Howell)表示，全球資金正由金融市場轉向實體經濟，意味美股已進入高波動、低報酬階段，投資人要從股市獲利將變得更加困難。豪威爾將全球經濟劃分為金融與實體兩大資金池。央行釋出的流動性通常先流入金融體系，推升股票、債券及其他風險資產，其流動性週期一般領先實體經濟約15個月，並領先資產價格約6至9個月，因此可作為判斷市場轉折的重要指標。他指出，全球流動性動能已於2025年底見頂回落，先前支撐美股估值與風險偏好的力量正在減弱。不過，這波金融條件收緊的主因並非央行升息，而是實體經濟保持強勁，企業投資及資本支出增加，吸收原本可能進入金融資產的資金。近期市場表現已反映這項資金轉向，債券殖利率上升、加密貨幣走弱，大宗商品則因實體需求與供應限制上漲。豪威爾認為，當資金由金融市場流向實體經濟，股票估值擴張空間便會收窄，即使企業獲利仍具韌性，美股也可能呈現波動升高、指數報酬下降及個股分化加劇的格局。

title: 宏碁旗下海柏特營收獲利衝高，入主大馬手機維修公司Miifix，業績添翼
summary: 【財訊快報／記者王宜弘報導】宏碁(2353)旗下售服子公司海柏特(6884)公布7月營收為1.74億元，年增89%，創單月歷史新高；上半年獲利亦寫歷史紀錄，EPS 0.88元。海柏特第二季營收達3.75​億元，稅後​淨利838​萬元，每股​盈餘EP​S 0.4​6元，累計​上半年營收6.8​2億元，稅​後淨利1612萬元​，每股盈餘​0.88元​，第二季及​上半年合併​營收，年成​長分別以3​4.1%及​20.3%​，雙雙創下​同期新高；​​上半年稅後​淨利亦為歷年新​高。海柏特指出，該公司於亞太市場的布局效益持續發酵​，7月營收​成長主要受​益於海外策​略投資效益，藉​由擴大區域​服務版圖與​市場覆蓋率​，持續強化​亞太市場布​局及跨國服​務能力。​​另海柏特7月累積取得馬來西亞公司Miifix Digital Sdn. Bhd.(Miifix)51%股權，並將其納入旗下子公司，為營收成長注入新動能。Miifix​主要於馬來​西亞從事手​機維修與買​賣服務，業​務亦涵蓋手​機、手機周​邊及信用卡​刷卡機，將拓展海​柏特的服務​範疇​。

title: 焦點股：Q2獲利倍增＋先進製程動能延續，中砂季線高檔震盪
summary: 【財訊快報／研究員周佳蓉】中砂(1560)為先進製程重要的鑽石碟供應商，主要有三大事業：砂輪事業部（ABU）、鑽石事業部（DBU）、晶圓事業部（SBU），Q2稅後純益5.23億元，年增96.6%，接近倍增；EPS 3.49元，毛利率升至40.1%。ABU受惠傳產機械、工具機需求回升，加上ABF客戶需求增加，營收季增16%，其中BD砂輪營收比重從過去的1/3提升至50%，公司計畫增加CVD鑽石鍍膜所需設備以推升ABU未來的獲利率。SBU在產能提前建置後維持滿載，加上特殊晶圓出貨增加，Q2季增4.4%，至於產能方面，中砂12吋產能6月起已增加至40萬片，目標2027年將增至43萬片，未來可望隨著客戶高階測試晶圓需求提升，由傳統再生晶圓進一步延伸至更多高階應用，並帶動毛利成長，DBU則受惠台積電2奈米/1.6nm製程出貨增加，營收季增9.1%，由於在CMP鑽石碟的高市佔，持續受惠先進製程投片增加，另外部分先進製程導入晶背供電，背面製程步驟將提高CMP製程道數，也將持續推升鑽石碟消耗。技術面來看，股價回測到季線附近震盪，籌碼持續沉澱，長短均線若能延續翻揚有利於挑戰新高。

title_en: TSMC’s Q2 dividend remains at 7 yuan, and it will invest 282 billion yen in a new joint venture with Sony
summary_en: TSMC held a board meeting yesterday (11th) to decide on four major proposals. It includes the confirmation of the second quarter financial report; the renewal of the second quarter quarterly dividend of 7 yuan, and foreign shareholders can choose US dollar dividends for the first time; and the establishment of a new joint venture with Sony, which will invest 282 billion yen, approximately NT$57.08 billion; and passed a capital budget of approximately 29.4425 billion US dollars, approximately NT$949.552 billion.

summary: 公益彩券盈餘如何回到社會、實際成為弱勢族群的支持力量？中信銀受財政部指定發行公益彩券，並委託台灣彩券公司執行，推出年度公益彩券形象宣傳短片《怪獸來襲》、《一帶宗師》及《神手奇蹟》，首度結合昭和特攝、武俠電影及醫療劇等類型片元素，以30秒內的劇情反轉，呈現公益彩券盈餘支持偏鄉兒童、二度就業婦女及青年職涯發展的實際案例。

title_en: Taiwan Lottery’s public welfare short film conveys positive energy
summary_en: How can charity lottery surplus be returned to society and actually become a supporting force for disadvantaged groups? CITIC Bank was designated by the Ministry of Finance to issue public welfare lottery tickets and entrusted the Taiwan Lottery Corporation to execute it. It launched the annual public welfare lottery image promotion short films "Monster Attack", "The Grandmaster of the Belt" and "The Miracle of the Magic Hand". For the first time, it combined elements from genre films such as Showa special photography, martial arts movies and medical dramas, and used plot reversals within 30 seconds to present actual cases of the charity lottery surplus supporting the career development of rural children, second-time employed women and young people.

title_en: The United States bans land-based drones and fully regulates five types of drones equipped with lidar and thermal imaging. Leihu, Hanxiang, Yaguang, etc. will benefit.
summary_en: The U.S. ban on drones from mainland China has escalated. The U.S. Federal Communications Commission (FCC) plans to expand the scope of mainland drone control from "blocking the launch of new aircraft" to "retrospectively blocking old aircraft" and comprehensively regulate all five major categories of drones. This is another policy-level move in the U.S.-China drone dispute after China blocked the export of drone components.

summary_en: The U.S. expansion of its ban on mainland drones is seen as a further response to the mainland’s comprehensive control of the export of drone components. In the future, the United States and China will form an invisible gap in the UAV industry. Taiwan and Taiwan are the three keys to winning the U.S. market because of their niches such as U.S. certification, export performance, and setting up factories in the United States.

summary_en: The government and the opposition have proposed a total of 14 versions of the drone regulations, which are still subject to negotiation by the party groups. A decisive battle is expected to be held in the Legislative Yuan at the end of this month. Taiwan's Drone Industry Technology Integration Association said yesterday (11th) that Taiwan should cultivate the drone industry into the next "national protector tree" based on chips, AI and other sacred trees. It hopes that the government and the opposition will integrate the advantages of each version, which will be a blessing to the industry.

summary_en: Huida grabbed six financial giants to set up a computing resource financing platform worth more than 500 billion US dollars, which impacted the market's confidence in technology stocks. Taiwan stocks opened lower yesterday (11th), but the three major legal entities ignited synchronization during the session, buying a total of more than 28.01 billion yuan, reversing the index from black to red, showing a strong washout pattern of "killing the long first, then shorting", and ended up rising 191 points to close at 45,120 points, recovering 45K lost ground.

title_en: Xinhua defaulted on delivery of RMB 18 million
summary_en: The over-the-counter buying index rose 0.02% to close at 391.68 points yesterday (11th), but the over-the-counter buying center received a notification from the Taichung branch of securities firm Cathay Pacific that the "King of Stocks" Xinhua defaulted on a delivery of 18.004 million yuan. summary_en: Silicon Precision, a major packaging and testing company under ASE Investment Holdings, held a groundbreaking ceremony for the new Douliu plant yesterday (11th). It is expected to invest nearly 100 billion yuan and introduce the CoWoS advanced packaging process. The first phase is expected to be opened in 2028 and is expected to create 1,300 job opportunities. When the entire factory is fully loaded in the future, the number of employees will exceed 2,200, further expanding Silicon Products’ advanced packaging production capacity layout in Central Taiwan.

summary_en: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi dominates the Taipei Station business district, triggering a new battle for the department store industry. Department store operators have recently established new locations in new business districts to compete for popular shopping malls. Among them, Shin Kong Mitsukoshi has taken over the operating rights of Taipei Station Mall, Far East SOGO Arena Garden City will compete in the entire district in the second half of the year, and Mitsui LaLaport Kaohsiung will also join the market as soon as this year. Department store operators have successively expanded their territory and started a new round of competition.

Zhang Yanjun, vice chairman of Silicon Pin Precision, said that semiconductors are in their golden decade, and 2026 to 2028 is the explosive period. The company has made advance arrangements to seize opportunities, but "our land is not enough." If Yun Lin still has land in the future, it will not rule out continued investment.

title: 新興市場7月轉獲188億美元資金淨流入，但中國持續失血
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】國際金融協會(IIF)週二公布最新數據顯示，外國投資人7月向新興市場股票與債券投資組合淨投入188億美元，扭轉5月淨流出252億美元及6月淨流出180億美元的局面，為三個月來首度恢復資金淨流入。債券仍是資金回流的主要來源，7月吸引267億美元淨流入；股票則淨流出78億美元，但較6月高達461億美元的撤資規模大幅收窄。IIF指出，股票市場的拖累已降至6月的一小部分，顯示先前集中於亞洲股市的壓力正在減弱，尚未蔓延至固定收益市場。區域方面，亞洲7月轉獲93億美元淨流入，扭轉6月淨流出270億美元的局面，但中國市場仍持續失血。先前投資人因AI支出及晶片需求疑慮，大舉撤出台灣與韓國等科技股權重較高的市場，導致新興市場股票與債券資金流向明顯分化。新興市場主權債7月發行額達創紀錄的190億美元，反映高殖利率及匯率波動相對有限，仍吸引國際資金。不過，Fed進一步升息、日本干預匯市及地緣政治緊張仍是後續風險；美國7月就業意外轉弱若令聯準會(Fed)延後緊縮，則可能繼續支撐新興市場資金流入。

Among them, the price of electronic components surged by 41.05%, becoming the main source of pushing up the overall index. The outside world is worried that AI inflation may come.

title: 格里爾將在華盛頓會見加國貿易官員，力拚8/19實施新關稅前達成協議
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，美國貿易代表格里爾(Jamieson Greer)將於週二下午在華盛頓會見加拿大高級貿易官員，雙方試圖在川普8月19日實施新關稅的最後期限前達成協議。根據加拿大負責對美貿易事務的部長Dominic LeBlanc辦公室發布的聲明，格里爾定於週二下午較早時段與LeBlanc以及加拿大首席貿易談判代表Janice Charette會面。預計加拿大官員不會在會前或會後接受媒體採訪。川普威脅動用一項可追溯至大蕭條時期的法律，如果美國提出的一系列貿易關切得不到解決，將對多種加拿大商品徵收新的50%關稅。加拿大總理卡尼(Mark Carney)尋求川普放寬針對鋼鐵、鋁、汽車和木材的行業性關稅。

title: 美元走勢聚焦CPI，美銀警示市場定價恐受挑戰
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，美國銀行方面認為，如果美國通貨膨脹報告意外低於預期，美元可能會出現相對而言更強烈的反應，因為這將「基本排除」聯準會9月份升息的可能性，並對當前的市場定價構成挑戰。包括Alex Cohen、Stephen Juneau和Meghan Swiber在內的美國銀行分析師週二在一份報告中寫道，繼6月份消費者物價指數(CPI)數據明顯疲軟之後，預計7月份CPI將更符合近期趨勢，整體CPI月比值上漲0.1%，核心CPI月比值上漲0.2%。不過，美國銀行這些分析師表示，在市場努力理解聯準會新的政策反應函數之際，週三公佈的CPI數據可能對美元非常重要。在其他條件相同的情況下，當前的倉位和對聯準會政策的定價可能意味著，如果數據低於預期，美元的下跌幅度會更大。這些分析指出，總體勞動力市場狀況仍然穩定，而聯準會的政策反應函數仍更偏重其通膨目標。

title: 恆生科技指數擬擴容至50檔，AI升格獨立主題、增設收入增長組
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中媒報導，恆生指數公司公布恆生科技指數歷來最大規模的修訂諮詢方案，擬將成分股由30檔增至50檔，並首次引入「市值＋收入增長」雙軌選股機制，讓業務高速增長但市值相對較小的科技公司有機會納入指數。新機制擬從恆生綜合大中型股指數成分股中，先按市值選出40家公司，再從尚未入選的合資格企業中，依過去12個月收入增幅選出10家。模擬結果顯示，收入增長組新增公司的收入增幅中位數達82%，遠高於現有成分股的13.8%。科技主題將重新劃分為數位平台及解決方案、人工智慧、先進硬體、機器人及自動化、雲端和前沿科技等六類，AI由子主題升格為獨立主題，子題總數由16個增至24個；前沿科技則涵蓋航太與衛星、量子運算、腦機介面及先進材料等領域。修訂後，前十大成分股權重占比估由70.6%降至66.3%，集中度略為下降。截至6月底，追蹤恆生科技指數的被動式產品管理資產達404億美元，若方案落實，相關ETF與指數基金將面臨系統性調倉。諮詢期將於9月18日截止，最終方案預計9月底公布，成分股調整最快在12月生效；在正式決定前，擴容及新增公司名單仍可能變動。

title_en: From furniture apprentice to richest man, Chuanhu Lin Congji relies on "two irons" to turn his life around?
summary_en: Lin Congji, chairman of Chuanhu, a major server slide manufacturer located in Luzhu, Kaohsiung, has become the new richest man in Taiwan. Neighbors are surprised that he has a simple and polite personality, and "doesn't look like a rich person at all." Lin Congji has low academic qualifications and started out as a furniture apprentice, but he has extremely high requirements for product quality. The company invests approximately 4.6% of its revenue as R&D expenses every year. He relies on "two irons" to turn his life around and become the leader in server slide rails.

title: 中國7月乘用車零售年減20.9%，新能源車銷量下滑3.9%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中國乘聯分會週二公布，7月全國乘用車市場零售146.1萬輛，年減20.9%、月減8.8%；今年前七個月累計零售1,017.3萬輛，年減20.3%，顯示車市在需求提前透支及季節性淡季影響下明顯降溫。7月新能源車零售年減3.9%，其中本土品牌下降4%，主流合資品牌逆勢增長36%，豪華品牌則重挫23%。乘聯分會指出，補貼大幅減少，對本土品牌經濟型電動車內銷造成較大衝擊。本土品牌7月零售104萬輛，年減14%、月減6%，但其國內零售市占率仍升至71%，較去年同期提高5.4個百分點，主要受惠於新能源車及出口市場表現相對穩定。乘聯分會表示，油價反彈、總體經濟走弱、淡季效應、前期需求透支及政策轉換，共同拖累7月車市。中國汽油價格今年累計每噸上調1,575元人民幣，壓抑燃油乘用車需求；新能源車安全新國標生效亦促使部分低階車型短期出清。不過，乘聯分會認為，最新擴大內需政策將為市場提供支撐，目前下滑屬於階段性結構波動，尚非產業趨勢全面惡化。

title: 鴻海旗下 工業富聯上半年獲利創高
summary: 鴻海旗下工業富聯（FII）昨（11）日公布上半年營收為人民幣5,578.6億元（約新台幣2.66兆元），年增54.6%，上半年淨利為人民幣237.4億元（約新台幣1,134.6億元），年增96%，雙創新高，主要受惠AI伺服器業務持續擴張。

title_en: Fii, a subsidiary of Hon Hai, achieved record profits in the first half of the year
summary_en: FII, a subsidiary of Hon Hai, announced yesterday (11) that its revenue in the first half of the year was RMB 557.86 billion (approximately NT$2.66 trillion), an annual increase of 54.6%, and its net profit in the first half was RMB 23.74 billion (approximately NT$113.46 billion), an annual increase of 96%, both record highs, mainly due to the continued expansion of the AI ​​server business.

title: 金磚國家研議支付系統與央行數位貨幣互通，盼降低跨境交易成本
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，印度央行總裁馬爾霍特拉(Sanjay Malhotra)週二表示，金磚國家成員正討論各國即時支付系統及央行數位貨幣(CBDC)相互連接的可能性，以降低跨境支付成本並提高交易效率。馬爾霍特拉指出，跨境支付是金磚國家及其他經濟體共同關注的領域，目前仍有很大的降本空間，各方正研究包括央行數位貨幣及快速支付系統互聯互通在內的多種方案。相關討論目前仍處於磋商階段，尚未確定技術標準、結算貨幣、監管架構及實施時間表。各國CBDC開發進度及支付系統規格不同，也使資料安全、反洗錢及跨境監管成為主要協調難題。金磚國家核心成員包括巴西、俄羅斯、印度、中國及南非，近年並持續擴大參與範圍。若支付網路最終完成連接，可望降低成員國間匯款及貿易結算成本，但目前尚不能解讀為已決定建立共同貨幣或取代美元的支付體系。

title: 那指金龍中國指數週二重挫2.94%近十週最殺，騰訊音樂ADR暴跌11.97%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中概股週二普遍下挫，那斯達克金龍中國指數重挫197.73點或2.94%，收在6,532.41點，創下6月5日重挫3.56%以來單日最殺，脫離前一交易日所創6月2日以來最高收市水準6,730.14點，表現明顯弱於同期美股主要指數。大型中概股中，騰訊音樂(美股代碼TME)暴跌11.97%至8.72美元，為主要拖累個股；網易(NTES)下挫4.12%至127.89美元，阿里巴巴(BABA)跌3.36%至127.85美元，反映網路及平台企業遭遇集中賣壓。相關ETF同步走弱，KraneShares中國網路ETF(KWEB)下跌3.54%至28.09美元，Invesco中國科技ETF(CQQQ)跌1.97%至51.83美元。追蹤中國A股中小型股的ASHS下跌約1.19%，滬深300指數ETF(ASHR)則跌0.80%。反觀，不含中國市場的MSCI新興市場ETF(EMXC)逆勢上漲0.96%，顯示週二賣壓主要集中於中國相關資產，而非全面撤離新興市場。那指金龍中國指數前一日才升至兩個多月高點，週二急挫亦反映短線獲利回吐壓力升高。

title: 法國央行估第三季GDP增長0.2%，服務業與通膨降溫提供支撐
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，法國央行週二表示，在主要產業活動增長及通膨降溫支撐下，法國經濟第三季可望延續增長動能，國內生產毛額(GDP)預計季增0.2%，與第二季增幅相同，並高於市場預估的0.1%。這項預測是根據法國央行最新月度企業調查作出。經濟活動預料繼續由服務業帶動，其中交通運輸、資訊及通訊等產業表現相對強勁，成為抵銷其他領域疲弱的主要力量。製造業活動在8月出現反彈，能源產業未來數月亦可望擴張；不過，由於公共工程合約減少，建築業可能進一步下滑，顯示法國經濟復甦仍不均衡。法國央行同時警告，經濟前景仍面臨重大不確定性，包括中東地緣政治局勢，以及夏季結束前的天氣變化。若法國再度出現熱浪，可能干擾生產、能源供應及消費活動，使第三季增長預測面臨下修風險。

title: Kalshi年化收入突破40億美元，洽談以400億美元估值融資
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】預測市場平台Kalshi業務快速擴張，據《信息報》(The Information)報導，其年化收入已超過40億美元，正洽談以約400億美元估值進行新一輪融資。以這兩項數字計算，估值約相當於年化收入的10倍；但年化收入是依近期營運速度推算，並非已實現的全年收入。融資消息傳出之際，美國商品期貨交易委員會(CFTC)週二動用緊急權力，命令KalshiEX繼續依照《商品交易法》核心原則營運，以維持市場穩定。這項命令是CFTC對紐約州試圖限制Kalshi營運所採取的直接介入。紐約州檢察總長詹姆斯(Letitia James)7月31日在州法院提告，指控Kalshi未取得州內博彩牌照，卻提供體育、選舉及其他事件合約，要求法院發布臨時限制令、禁止其在全美提供相關產品，並求償逾360億美元。CFTC則主張，Kalshi是聯邦登記的指定合約市場，相關事件合約屬於衍生性金融工具，應由CFTC專屬管轄。CFTC的命令並不代表紐約州訴訟已遭駁回，事件合約究竟屬於聯邦監管的金融商品，還是各州有權規範的博彩活動，仍待法院裁決。Kalshi雖以高速收入增長爭取400億美元估值，但州政府訴訟、潛

title: 美國7月NFIB小企業樂觀指數升至99.8，近一年來最高
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，隨著企業加快招聘並且通膨壓力有所舒緩，美國小企業樂觀情緒在7月升至接近一年來的最高水準。全美獨立企業聯合會(NFIB)的7月份小企業樂觀程度指數上升2.4點，達到99.8，為2025年8月以來的最高水準。經濟專家的預估中值為97.5。構成該指數的10個分類指數中有8個上漲，2個下降。計畫增加職位的美國小企業淨比重躍升至2022年10月以來的最高水準，計畫在未來幾個月進行資本支出小企業比例達到2024年底以來最高。通膨方面的擔憂有所舒緩。將通膨列為企業主面臨的最重要問題的受訪者比例出現今年以來首次下降。報告提高價格的企業淨比重也自2月份、也就是美國和以色列打擊伊朗並推動油價飆升之前以來首次下降。計畫在未來幾個月提價的企業比重也走低。儘管與對伊朗戰爭相關的不確定性可能仍然存在，企業仍在投資和擴張。NFIB首席經濟專家Bill Dunkelberg在一份聲明中表示，儘管目前不確定性較高，但小企業預計商業環境將繼續改善。

title: 美國通膨數據公布在即 國際黃金價格應聲走揚
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導全球黃金價格在美國重要通膨數據公布前夕應聲上漲，巴基斯坦當地市場黃金與白銀價格也隨之走揚。投資人正密切關注今日稍晚將公布的美國消費者物價指數（CPI）報告，該報告的結果將對美國聯準會（Federal Reserve）未來的利率政策走向產生關鍵影響。一般而言，當通膨預期升高時，投資人傾向購買黃金作為保值工具，以對抗貨幣貶值。 根據《The Express Tribune》報導，週二國際現貨黃金盤中上揚 0.2%，截至美東時間上午 11 時 5 分（格林威治時間下午 3 時 5 分），每盎司報價 4,396.87 美元。黃金價格在盤中稍早曾一度觸及 4,434.84 美元，創下自 6 月 5 日以來的最高點。市場普遍預期，若通膨數據高於預期，可能促使聯準會採取更積極的緊縮政策，而黃金通常在此類環境下被視為抗通膨的避險資產。 受國際市場漲勢帶動，巴基斯坦境內的黃金價格週二也普遍走高。每托拉（tola，當地貴金屬常用計量單位）黃金上漲 2,400 盧比（巴基斯坦當地貨幣），達到 459,736 盧比。十克黃金的價格也上漲 2,058 盧比，來到 394,149

title: 美國德州暫停數據中心接入電網，明年電力需求增幅由14%下修至5.6%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美國德州暫停新的數據中心項目接入州內電網後，當地電力需求增長預測遭到大幅下調。美國政府週二公布數據顯示，德州2027年電力需求預計增長5.6%，遠低於7月預估的14%。原先預測的14%年增幅，將是德州十年來最大電力負荷增長，主要反映人工智慧(AI)基礎設施投資帶動數據中心用電需求急升，但最新政策已使部分建設計畫及接電時程面臨延後。德州政府8月3日決定，對所有申請接入州內電網的數據中心項目展開審計，實際上暫停這個快速成長產業的新接電申請，以重新評估項目用電需求及其對電網穩定性的影響。此次大幅下修顯示，數據中心建設不僅受到晶片、融資及土地限制，電網承載能力與監管審查也正成為重要瓶頸。德州未來電力需求能否重新加速，將取決於審計進度、輸配電建設及數據中心項目恢復接網的時間。

title: OpenAI營運長萊特卡普將離職，擬投入尚未公開新項目
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，OpenAI管理高層萊特卡普(Brad Lightcap)將離開公司，著手推動一項尚未公開的新計畫。數月前，他才在OpenAI管理層改組中卸下營運長職務，其離任成為人工智慧(AI)業界最新一宗高層人事變動。萊特卡普在發給OpenAI員工的內部通知中表示，過去數月一直思考並探索下一步方向，並認為隨著AI產業進入下一階段，全球仍有若干重要問題需要妥善處理。他表示，將在不久後公布更多有關新計畫的資訊。萊特卡普2018年加入OpenAI，在公司擴展企業客戶及商業化業務過程中扮演重要角色。今年4月OpenAI進行大規模管理層調整後，他卸任營運長，轉而負責特別項目，並直接向執行長奧特曼(Sam Altman)報告。萊特卡普表示，他仍將在OpenAI留任數週，以協助相關工作交接。目前尚不清楚其新項目的具體內容、資金來源，以及是否仍與人工智慧領域相關。

title: Google擴建美洲海底光纜網路，新增Alisios等三套系統
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】Alphabet(美股代碼GOOGL)旗下Google週二宣布，將在美洲地區新增三套海底光纜系統，進一步強化加勒比海、拉丁美洲及美國之間的網路連結，支援雲端服務、人工智慧(AI)及數據傳輸需求。三套新系統分別為Alisios、Canoa及OlaLuz。其中，Alisios將連接多明尼加共和國、巴拿馬及智利，成為串聯加勒比海、中美洲與南美洲西岸的重要數位通道。Canoa將連接多明尼加共和國與百慕達，OlaLuz則把多明尼加共和國與美國佛羅里達州相連，藉此增加區域網路容量與路線多樣性，降低對單一傳輸路徑的依賴。智利近年積極吸引數據中心、雲端運算及海底光纜投資，希望成為拉丁美洲區域數位樞紐。Google此次尚未公布三套光纜系統的投資金額、鋪設長度及正式啟用時間。

title_en: Yaohua Pharmaceutical's profit exploded in the first half of the year, with an annual increase of 1.2 times, EPS of 11.35 yuan, and gross profit margin as high as 91%.
summary_en: Yaohua Pharmaceutical announced its first-half financial report yesterday (11th). The net profit after tax in the first half of the year was 4.679 billion yuan, an increase of 1.23 times year-on-year. The net earnings per share (EPS) was 11.35 yuan. The profit in the first half of the year increased significantly, pushing the new pharmaceutical industry into a new era of profitability. Yaohua Pharmaceutical will also be invited to participate in a legal conference today (12th). The legal representative expects that in addition to continued growth in revenue in the second half of the year, Yaohua Pharmaceutical is expected to earn more than two equity shares in full-year profits.

title: Apple Pay負責人貝莉10月底退休，蘋果股價週二續跌1.09%，8/3來最低
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】蘋果公司(Apple，美股代碼AAPL)支付及錢包服務長期負責人貝莉(Jennifer Bailey)將於10月底退休，結束在公司超過20年的職業生涯，成為蘋果近期高層更替的最新一員。蘋果股價繼上日跌1.62%後，週二追低3.35美元或1.09%至304.91美元，為8月3日以來最低，今年漲了12.16%。根據內部備忘錄，蘋果服務業務主管庫伊(Eddy Cue)向員工宣布貝莉退休消息。貝莉自2014年Apple Pay推出以來，一直擔任支付及錢包業務副總裁；蘋果計畫在她離任前公布接班安排，貝莉也將暫時以顧問身分協助交接。Apple Pay允許用戶透過iPhone等裝置在實體商店及網路完成付款，並已成為蘋果服務生態及維繫iPhone用戶的重要工具。分析師估計，蘋果支付服務每年創造的收入超過75億美元。貝莉任內推動蘋果向金融服務領域擴張，由Apple Pay延伸出Apple Wallet、Apple Card及相關金融產品。她的離任正值蘋果多個核心部門進行管理層調整之際，市場後續將關注接任者人選，以及公司支付和金融服務策略是否出現變化。

title_en: TSMC’s board of directors has decided to distribute a dividend of 7 yuan per share in Q2 and begin to provide US dollar cash dividend options.

title: 智崴上半年訂單量大增逾5倍，每股盈餘1.08元轉虧為盈
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】智崴(5263)公布上半年財報，累計上半年營收達8.56億元，較去年同期成長51.07%，每股盈餘為1.08元，較去年同期每股虧損3.97元，呈現轉虧轉盈。受惠全球沉浸式體感娛樂市場需求升溫，智崴上半年訂單量較去年同期大幅成長逾5倍，其中第一季接單金額更創下歷史新高。新接訂單涵蓋美洲、亞洲及中東等市場，並陸續取得美國、越南及中東地區多項大型體感遊樂設備專案，顯示新興市場對沉浸式體驗需求快速成長，公司於海外市場拓展成果持續顯現。為因應大型國際專案的訂單需求，智崴上半年投入產線與相關設備建置，並於今年5月正式啟用橋頭科學園區新廠，致使前期投產與產線建置相關支出相對增加。隨著各項投產準備工作陸續到位，新廠已正式啟動量產，將有效提升設備產能與交付效率，下半年開始將成為推升營運成長的重要驅動力。

title_en: Zhiwei's order volume increased more than five times in the first half of the year, and its earnings per share turned into a profit of 1.08 yuan.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Dai Haiqian] Zhiwei (5263) announced its first half financial report. The cumulative revenue in the first half of the year reached 856 million yuan, an increase of 51.07% compared with the same period last year. The earnings per share was 1.08 yuan, compared with the loss per share of 3.97 yuan in the same period last year, showing a turn from loss to profit. Benefiting from the rising demand in the global immersive somatosensory entertainment market, Zhiwei's order volume in the first half of the year increased by more than five times compared with the same period last year, with the order amount in the first quarter hitting a record high. New orders have been received covering markets such as the Americas, Asia and the Middle East, and a number of large-scale somatosensory amusement equipment projects have been successively obtained in the United States, Vietnam and the Middle East. This shows that the demand for immersive experiences in emerging markets is growing rapidly, and the company's achievements in overseas market expansion have continued to show. In response to the order demand for large-scale international projects, Zhiwei invested in the construction of production lines and related equipment in the first half of the year, and officially opened the new factory in Qiaotou Science Park in May this year, resulting in a relative increase in expenditures related to early production and production line construction. As all preparations for production are in place, the new factory has officially started mass production, which will effectively improve equipment production capacity and delivery efficiency, and will become an important driving force for operational growth starting in the second half of the year.

title_en: China Sarawak's Q2 gross profit margin exceeded 40%, spending 1.5 billion to expand diamond disc and 12-inch wafer production capacity
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Dai Haiqian] China Sarawak (1560) announced its second quarter quarterly report. The net profit after tax in the second quarter was 523 million yuan, an annual increase of approximately 96.6%. The gross profit margin exceeded 40%, and the earnings per share reached 3.49 yuan; the cumulative earnings per share in the first half of the year was 6.44 yuan. In response to follow-up orders, China Sarawak plans to spend about 1.5 billion yuan in capital expenditures. In the first half of the year, it has invested 510 million yuan. The funds are mainly used to expand the capacity of diamond discs, with a monthly production capacity target of 70,000 pieces, and a monthly production capacity of 400,000 12-inch wafers. China Sarawak's second quarter revenue was 2.492 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 8.7%, an annual increase of 17.9%, a gross profit margin of 40.1%, a quarterly increase of 5.1 percentage points, an annual increase of 8 percentage points, after-tax net profit of 523 million yuan, a quarterly increase of 19.9%, an annual increase of 96.6%, and earnings per share reached 3.49 yuan. China Sarawak's cumulative revenue in the first half of the year was 4.786 billion yuan, an annual increase of 23.1%, gross profit margin was 37.6%, an increase of 6 percentage points from the same period last year, after-tax net profit was 960 million yuan, an annual increase of 73.8%, and earnings per share was 6.44 yuan. Looking at the three major product lines of China and Saudi Arabia, diamond discs are still the business with the strongest growth momentum. title: 億光以34.58億元順利標售銅鑼廠予信邦，處分利益22.58億元
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】光電元件大廠億光(2393)順利處分位於苗栗銅鑼廠土地及建物，總交易金額34.58億元，預計該處分利益22.58億元，交易對象為國內連接器線大廠信邦(3023)。該閒置土地及廠房位於苗栗縣銅鑼鄉中興路26號，土地面積9,726.74坪、建物面積為14,142.18坪，億光是委由香港商世邦魏理仕台灣分公司依公開標售契約辦理，標售底價則依據中華徵信所估價20.18億元，與展茂不動產估價師聯合事務所估價21.83億元。億光表示，該資產處分目的於調整資產配置，提升資產報酬率。億光近年來因應國際政經局勢變化，積極佈局海外產能，2026年資本支出約30億元，其中近20億元投入泰國廠土地及廠房建設，而標售苗栗銅鑼廠資產利得將有助於公司海外產能佈局綜效。億光表示，隨著全球供應鏈區域化與近岸／離岸外包趨勢加速，響應客戶「China+1」戰略及擴大東南亞製造能量，深化全球供應鏈佈局，泰國新廠將成為集團在東南亞最大且最先進的生產基地，其整體建置規模預計將超越現有的蘇州廠。而泰國新廠預計於2027下半年完工並投入量產，其產能將直接供應全球車廠（OEMs）、一級供應商（Tier 1）

title_en: Everlight successfully sold Tongluo Factory to SINBON for NT$3.458 billion, with proceeds of NT$2.258 billion disposed of
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Optoelectronic component manufacturer Everlight (2393) has successfully disposed of the land and buildings at its Miaoli Tongluo Factory. The total transaction value is 3.458 billion yuan. The profit from the disposal is expected to be 2.258 billion yuan. The transaction target is Sinolink (3023), a domestic connector wire manufacturer. The idle land and factory building are located at No. 26 Zhongxing Road, Tongluo Township, Miaoli County, with a land area of ​​9,726.74 square meters and a building area of ​​14,142.18 square meters. Everlight has entrusted the Hong Kong business CB Richard Ellis Taiwan Branch to handle it in accordance with the public bidding contract. The base price for the auction is based on the valuation of 2.018 billion yuan by the China Credit Information Agency and the valuation of 2.183 billion yuan with Zhanmao Real Estate Appraisers. Yiguang stated that the purpose of this asset disposal is to adjust asset allocation and increase return on assets. In recent years, Everlight has actively deployed overseas production capacity in response to changes in the international political and economic situation. Capital expenditures in 2026 will be approximately 3 billion yuan, of which nearly 2 billion yuan will be invested in the land and factory construction of the Thailand factory. The proceeds from the auction of the assets of the Miaoli Tongluo Factory will help the company's overseas production capacity layout to achieve synergy. Everlight said that as the global supply chain regionalization and near-shoring/off-shore outsourcing trends accelerate, in response to customers' "China+1" strategy and to expand manufacturing capacity in Southeast Asia, and deepen the global supply chain layout, the new factory in Thailand will become the group's largest and most advanced production base in Southeast Asia, and its overall construction scale is expected to exceed the existing Suzhou factory. The new factory in Thailand is expected to be completed and put into mass production in the second half of 2027. Its production capacity will directly supply global automakers (OEMs) and first-tier suppliers (Tier 1).

title_en: TSMC and Sony jointly establish next-generation image sensor company for mobile phones, mass production in 2029
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Li Chunjun] TSMC (2330) announced on the evening of the 11th that it has established a new joint venture with Sony Semiconductor Solutions Corporation to develop and manufacture next-generation image sensors for mobile phones. Mass production is expected to begin in 2029. TSMC and Sony announced that they have signed a legally binding final agreement to establish Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation as a joint venture (JV) in Kashi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. The joint venture is responsible for the production of image sensors for smartphones and is expected to start mass production in 2029. Sony will become the sole controlling shareholder of the joint venture, which is expected to operate as a consolidated subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation. The representative director of the joint venture is expected to be appointed by Sony. Sony plans to invest approximately 465 billion yen in the joint venture through cash contributions and asset transfers through in-kind investments. TSMC plans to invest approximately 282 billion yen in cash. The above capital investment is expected to be carried out in phases based on market demand and other relevant operating conditions. summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】君帆(4584)公布上半年財報，累計上半年合併營收為5.39 億元，年減22%，毛利率為30%，低於去年同期34%，稅後淨利達3114萬元，年減48%，每股盈餘為1.04元。展望下半年，君帆指出，預期營運將呈現逐季成長態勢。君帆指出，上半年雖然整體工業環境受到台灣通用機械、鋼鐵產業需求減緩影響，加上中國傳統硫化機與模具需求降溫，導致業績下滑，但累計營收降幅已呈現大幅收斂趨勢，營運走勢明確回升。在產品與區域市場方面，台灣市場受惠於醫療器械與休閒船舶市場需求強勁回溫，有效抵銷了傳統產業的需求缺口；中國市場方面，無錫廠雖然受到傳統產業低迷拖累，但中國製造業轉型升級帶動自動化設備需求明顯成長，為當地營運注入新成長動能。展望下半年，君帆指出，持續投入半導體、醫療及高端自動化設備應用，鎖定高附加價值產品，透過產品差異化擴大市場份額，結合技術與區域布局雙重升級，預期營運將呈現逐季成長態勢。

title_en: Junfan’s earnings per share in the first half of the year were 1.04 yuan, and its operations in the second half of the year are expected to grow quarter by quarter.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Dai Haiqian] Junfan (4584) announced its first half financial report. The cumulative consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 539 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 22%, the gross profit margin was 30%, lower than the 34% in the same period last year, the after-tax net profit reached 31.14 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 48%, and the earnings per share was 1.04 yuan. Looking forward to the second half of the year, Junfan pointed out that operations are expected to show quarter-by-quarter growth. Junfan pointed out that although the overall industrial environment was affected by the slowdown in demand from Taiwan's general machinery and steel industries in the first half of the year, coupled with the cooling demand for traditional vulcanizers and molds in China, which led to a decline in performance, the cumulative revenue decline has shown a sharp convergence trend, and the operating trend has clearly rebounded. In terms of products and regional markets, the Taiwan market has benefited from the strong recovery in demand for medical devices and leisure ships, which has effectively offset the demand gap in traditional industries. In the Chinese market, although the Wuxi factory has been dragged down by the downturn in traditional industries, the transformation and upgrading of China's manufacturing industry has driven significant growth in demand for automation equipment, injecting new growth momentum into local operations. Looking forward to the second half of the year, Junfan pointed out that it will continue to invest in semiconductor, medical and high-end automation equipment applications, lock in high value-added products, expand market share through product differentiation, and combine dual upgrades in technology and regional layout. It is expected that operations will show a quarter-by-quarter growth trend.

title_en: The era of huge profits for passive components: Taiwanese manufacturers will be among the top 20
summary_en: Strong demand for AI servers and data centers has driven a surge in the use of high-end MLCCs. International major manufacturers Murata Manufacturing and Taiyo Yuden have successively raised their full-year financial forecasts, and their operating prospects are promising. Affected by this, Taiwan's passive component supply chain benefited simultaneously. The leading Yageo signed a long-term contract with a customer to lock in production capacity. Huaxinke's order-to-bill ratio soared to 1.8, indicating that market demand continues to heat up. The legal person pointed out that with the expansion of AI infrastructure, the structural growth trend of the passive component industry is clear, and related supply chains including Taiqingke, Huarong and other related supply chains are expected to usher in comprehensive business opportunities. Investors should closely observe the subsequent order-to-shipment ratio and long-term contract signing status, and carefully assess the market climate cycle and risks.

title: 電支轉盈，LINEPay Q2獲利回溫，H1每股盈餘4.35元

title_en: Telecommunications payment turned profitable, LINEPay Q2 profit recovered, H1 earnings per share were 4.35 yuan
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Chen Haoning] In the second quarter, LINEPay (7722) gradually reduced its electronic payment promotion expenses and verification costs compared with the first quarter. In addition, LINE Pay Money turned profitable, pushing the second quarter net profit after tax to 161 million yuan, a quarterly increase of 20%, an annual increase of 133%, and earnings per share of 2.37 yuan. In the first half of the year, the after-tax net profit was 296 million yuan, an annual increase of 28%, and earnings per share was 4.35 yuan. In terms of single-quarter operations, consolidated revenue in the second quarter reached 2.130 billion yuan, an increase of 14% over the same period last year. The payment business and marketing business simultaneously maintained a steady growth trend; operating net profit was 162 million yuan, a quarterly increase of 49%, mainly due to the increase in early promotion expenses and verification costs of electronic payment compared with the first quarter. The net profit after tax was 161 million yuan, a quarterly increase of 20%, an annual increase of 133%, and earnings per share of 2.37 yuan. Operating performance and profitability continued to improve. In the same period last year, due to the impact of foreign exchange losses, the profit base period was relatively low. If this factor is excluded, the profit in this quarter will still show an annual growth trend. LINE Pay said that in addition to the continued steady growth of its third-party payment business and marketing business, its electronic payment subsidiary LINE Pay Money also turned profitable in the second quarter. According to statistics from the Financial Supervisory Commission, LINE Pay Money continued to rank first among its peers in the three core businesses of collection and payment, transfer, and stored value in the second quarter. With the steady expansion of the number of users and transaction scale, it not only laid a solid foundation for the company's operational expansion, but also became an important engine driving the company's continued growth.

title_en: Xinli’s Q2 EPS was 0.22 yuan, a loss turned into a profit, the stocking of new autumn and winter products added momentum, and the performance in July was a new one
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Xinli (4303) announced its second quarter financial report. The net profit attributable to the owners of the parent company in the single quarter was 20.37 million yuan, which turned into a profit compared with the previous quarter and the same period last year, with earnings per share of 0.22 yuan. In the first half of the year, the net loss attributable to the owners of the parent company was 24.77 million yuan, and the net loss per share was 0.26 yuan. Xinli said that thanks to the steady growth in demand for environmentally friendly materials, increased shipments of high value-added products, further optimization of the overall product portfolio, and the recognition of non-industry revenue, operations in the second quarter returned to the profitable track. Xinli's consolidated revenue in July was 108 million yuan, a monthly increase of 20.69% and an annual increase of 16.88%, setting a record high in a single month. The cumulative consolidated revenue in the first seven months was 623 million yuan, an increase of 4.64% over the same period last year, setting a new high for the same period in the past. Xinli pointed out that July to September is usually the company's traditional peak season for shipments, which mainly benefits from downstream customers preparing goods in advance for the Christmas period and the launch of new autumn and winter products, which has led to a significant increase in the strength of the brand side to attract goods, which is the key to achieving high revenue in July. Xinli is committed to deepening the dual-track parallel strategy of vertical integration and cross-domain application, providing complete services from raw material formulation, surface treatment, lamination processing to customized applications. It continues to transform towards low-carbon, environmentally friendly and high-value materials, focusing on water-based PU, solvent-free process, low VOC, The development of products such as recycled materials and bio-based materials meets the requirements of international brands for rapid development, small quantity and variety, high consistency of quality and sustainable materials. In the second quarter, it benefited from the growth in shipments of high value-added products, which supported the gross profit margin of 21% in the second quarter of 2026. exhibition

summary_en: "Technology always comes from human nature." This famous saying is more suitable to be used in a super-aged society. title_en: Taiwan stocks pre-market/Fei Ban bucked the trend and rose 0.87%! Taiwan stock index rose 194 points in overnight trading; Taiwan stocks continue to advance today
summary_en: The U.S.-Iran peace agreement has yet to see substantial progress, and the market is waiting for the latest U.S. inflation data. Investors' willingness to pursue prices has become conservative, and the major U.S. stock indexes weakened on Tuesday (11th). The Nasdaq fell 159.91 points, or 0.60%, to close at 26,445.45 points; the S&P 500 fell 24.91 points, or 0.32%, to close at 7,728.20 points; the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 184.13 points, or 0.34%, to close at 53,791.85 points, with the S&P 500 closing in the black for the second consecutive trading day. The four major U.S. stock indexes fell more than they rose, but Fei Ban bucked the trend and rose 0.87%. The Taiwan Index futures rose 194 points in overnight trading, and TSMC futures rose 6 yuan. Taiwan stocks are expected to continue their bullish momentum today (12th).

title_en: Chen Guanru served as National Bank Securities and Lei Hu. Financial Supervisory Commission: Securities without asset-fund separation regulations
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 11th) The board of directors of Guobiao Securities will discuss the case of Chen Guanru’s renewal as vice chairman on August 14. However, Chen Guanru’s role as Leihu’s chairman has attracted attention. The Financial Supervisory Commission said today that there are currently no regulations on "separation of production and finance" in securities. Whether to set up a vice chairman is a matter of corporate governance. However, self-operated securities positions must pay attention to interest avoidance and cannot invest in Leihu-related stocks. Part-time jobs also need to be reviewed by the company.

title_en: ZTE Financial Report/Profit in the first half of the year increased by more than 20% year-on-year, EPS reached a record high of 4.5 yuan for the same period, and orders on hand exceeded 40 billion yuan
summary_en: ZTE Corporation (1513), a major heavy power company, announced its second-quarter consolidated financial report on the 11th. Benefiting from Taipower's power grid strengthening plan, semiconductor factory expansion and rising power demand for AI data centers, its single-quarter revenue and profit hit a record high for the same period last year. The cumulative after-tax net profit in the first half of the year was 2.224 billion yuan, an annual increase of 22.2%. The after-tax net profit per share was 4.5 yuan, continuing to hit a new high for the same period.
