title_en: Twin engines start! Nomura launches new fund; Sichuan Lake, TSMC and Japanese stocks perfectly complement each other
summary_en: Nomura Investment Trust will raise the country's first "Nomura Taiwan-Japan Select Multi-Asset Fund" from August 31 to September 4, targeting the twin growth engines of Taiwan's semiconductor technology supply chain and Japanese corporate value revaluation. The fund adopts a flexible multi-asset allocation, with stock positions accounting for 50% to 70% and bond positions accounting for 30% to 50%. Through the complementary characteristics of Taiwan and Japan's industries and a diverse bond portfolio, it can effectively diversify risks and enhance asset defense resilience. Historical data shows that Taiwan-Japan asset allocation can take into account return potential and anti-volatility characteristics, providing investors with new options for cross-border layout. It is an ideal target to participate in the dividends of AI growth and seize the transformation opportunities of Japanese stocks.

title: 台積與Sony成立合資公司 支援下一世代影像感測器
summary: 索尼半導體（Sony）與台積電今（11）日宣布雙方簽署具法律效力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司 Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於 2029 年開始量產。

summary_en: Sony Semiconductor (Sony) and TSMC announced today (11th) that they signed a legally binding final cooperation agreement to establish a joint venture, Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation, in Kashi City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. summary_en: The Taiwan stock market reversed after a volatile market yesterday (11th), rising 191.96 points to close at 22,901.64 points, with a trading volume of NT$434.2 billion. title_en: There are variables in the US-Iran negotiations! Three major U.S. stock indexes close in the red, Dow Jones drops 184 points
summary_en: Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council Rezai reiterated that unless the United States meets certain conditions, the Strait of Hormuz will continue to be blocked. This move will exacerbate concerns about global inflation and energy supply, and drive up international oil prices. Affected by the unclear outlook for inflation, U.S. stocks performed weakly, with the Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasdaq all closing in the black, down 0.34%, 0.32% and 0.60% respectively. Although the market atmosphere turned conservative, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index bucked the trend and rose 0.87%, showing that the technology hardware sector is still resilient. Investors need to pay close attention to the geopolitical situation and subsequent oil price fluctuations to judge global economic trends.

title_en: 1.24 million people support the market! The fourth legal person's first choice is "he". The more it falls, the more aggressive it is to buy.
summary_en: Taiwan stocks fluctuated violently in July. Retail investors showed the resilience of the "fourth legal person" and the momentum of regular quotas continued unabated. Statistics from the stock exchange show that the number of Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050), the leading market capitalization ETF, has exceeded 1.24 million, ranking first for 18 consecutive months and becoming the first choice for stock deposits in the market. Data pointed out that 0050 saw a huge increase of 37,000 people in a single month, and ranked first in the stock deposit rankings of children and all age groups of major securities companies. In addition, mature investors bucked the trend and increased their investment amid the shock. The single-month net subscription amounts of 0050 and Yuanta Taiwan 50 Positive 2 (00631L) reached 176.62 billion and 47.72 billion yuan respectively, setting a record high. This huge amount of private funds concentrated in large-capitalization stocks not only provided a strong escort for the violent fluctuations in Taiwan stocks, but also became a key cornerstone to support the subsequent bullish market.

AUO, a major panel manufacturer, was sold off more than 56,000 units by foreign investors, becoming the focus of foreign capital withdrawals. title_en: His dream house with a pension came to an end overnight. His mother told him that he was stuck! 20 million pension may be wiped out
summary_en: Retirement planning faces unexpected challenges! A 65-year-old man originally planned to use his 20 million yen savings to buy a house for retirement with his wife, but on the eve of signing the contract, he discovered that his 87-year-old mother, who lived alone, was showing signs of dementia. The refrigerator was full of unopened letters and she was hallucinating. The couple resolutely put their plan to buy a house on hold and instead sought help from long-term care resources. This incident highlights the risk of the "care trap" in an aging society. Japanese official data points out that the proportion of elderly people living alone will continue to increase in 2025, making it difficult for family members to detect abnormalities immediately. Experts suggest that in addition to living expenses, retirement financial planning must include medical and long-term care reserves to cope with the potential sudden needs of an aging society and ensure that the quality of life of the elders and themselves is guaranteed.

title_en: "Well-known catering group"'s July revenue hit the second-highest level in the same period, Kuroge House's performance surged 30% into Golden Chicken Hen
summary_en: Xingai catering leader Ganbei Group announced that its consolidated revenue in July 2026 reached 385 million yuan, an annual increase of 4.13%. The cumulative revenue for the first seven months reached 2.755 billion yuan, an annual increase of 6.26%, both setting the second highest record for the same period in previous years. Although July was affected by the typhoon, its performance grew against the trend, driven by the summer peak season, store exhibition efficiency and takeaway business. Its brands have performed well. Among them, Kurogeya has successfully boosted its revenue through summer limited hot pot products, increasing its revenue by more than 30% year-on-year. Looking forward to August, Ganbei Group will continue to seize holiday business opportunities. With the opening of the Black House Kaohsiung Dream Mall store, the number of stores in Taiwan will reach 58, and the total number of stores in the world will be 66. With the fermentation of new store benefits and diversified marketing strategies, the group's operating scale has steadily expanded, successfully injecting strong momentum into the catering market in the second half of the year, and demonstrating outstanding market capital-attracting strength.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zhao Minya, Taipei, 11th) The NCC has entered a window period since August 1, and the outside world is concerned about whether the iPhone 18 will be affected. The Ministry of Digital Development stated that this was not true and that the inspection business would be handled by the NCC.

title_en: EPS in the first half of the year was 1.75 yuan! Jianlin's auto market hit by tariff war, this product becomes new bright spot
summary_en: Jianlin Co., Ltd. (2228) announced consolidated revenue of 2.441 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, a decrease of 2.98% compared with the same period last year. Affected by the U.S. tariff policy and the weak demand in mainland China's auto market, some customers in the automotive industry were cautious in order scheduling, inventory adjustment, and new model purchases, resulting in a decrease in operations in the first half compared with the same period last year. The gross profit margin was 22%, an annual decrease of 2 percentage points; the net profit after tax was 139 million yuan, an annual decrease of 40.32%; the after-tax earnings per share was 1.75 yuan, an annual decrease of 40.27%.

summary_en: The Ministry of Environment invited department store retailers on the 11th to discuss issues such as source reduction, treatment and recycling of corporate food waste. Environment Minister Peng Qiming further proposed the concept of "food wise" cooperation at the meeting, advocating that the government and the department store, catering and hotel industries work together to reduce food waste from the consumer side. title_en: Vice Chairman Chen Guanzhou asked for leave due to controversy over national ticket money to avoid Legislative Yuan supervision
summary_en: The Finance Committee of the Legislative Yuan held a public hearing on the merger of public shares on the 12th. Since the national banknotes have been substantially controlled and operated by public shares, Vice Chairman Chen Guanzhou's annual salary is still as high as 20 million, which triggered criticism from legislators from both the ruling and opposition parties. The public hearing invited the chairman, vice chairman and general manager of the public financial holding bank to attend the meeting. However, Chen Guanzhou took leave and did not attend on the grounds that "there was a board meeting", which further stirred up controversy. Chen Guanzhou issued a 5-point statement yesterday.

title_en: Chairman's debt dispute was enforced, Chiayi Mingdu Hotel continues to operate
summary_en: The well-known Mingdu Tourist Resort Hotel by Renyi Lake in Chiayi has been hotly discussed on online social platforms. It was forced to be sealed due to the personal debt dispute of the chairman surnamed Zeng. The Chiayi District Court confirmed that a total of 3 pieces of land around the hotel, including parking lots, vacant land, and orchards, were sealed. However, the hotel building and the land on which it is located have not been sealed, and according to the law, it can still continue to operate and use the parking lot. title_en: 100 points up, 1000 points down Taiwan stock fake rebound?
summary_en: Today, the Taiwan stock market soared 191 points. On the surface, it looked like a scene of joy, but in fact, the market showed an extremely divergent trend with thousands of stocks falling. This is mainly because market funds are concentrated on specific groups and value stocks. However, judging from the overall chips and linear structure, the market has established strong support in the low-end area close to 40,000 points and will not easily break the bottom. Previously, I publicly spent 100 million yuan to buy 0050 when the market was at a low. Now it has successfully reached a new high in the band, and the profit has officially exceeded 12 million yuan! This once again proves that finding high-quality targets at low prices during times of panic is the only way to beat the market in the long term.

title_en: The illegal import of heavy-duty motorcycles into the mainland has been seized. The Ministry of Economic Affairs: The most serious thing is to abolish the exporter registration of the industry.
summary_en: Heavy motorcycles from Mainland China illegally entered Taiwan and were seized on the spot. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that mainland China's heavy-duty motorcycle operators disassembled heavy-duty motorcycle parts and imported them into Taiwan in batches, and then assembled them into vehicles domestically. On the 7th and 11th, the Ministry of Economic Affairs went to the business premises involved in the case in New Taipei City to conduct inspections. On the 11th, they discovered illegally imported heavy machinery. The customs seized the vehicles involved on the spot in accordance with the "Customs Anti-Smuggling Regulations", and the industry's registration as an import manufacturer will be revoked at the most.

title: 資策會攜手奇美醫院 發布智慧醫療 AI 人才教育成果
summary: 生成式AI正快速改變全球產業，也讓智慧醫療發展邁入新階段。由奇美醫院與財團法人資訊工業策進會（資策會）共同舉辦的「智慧賦能人才永續高峰論壇」，11日於奇美醫院展開，並發布雙方共同打造的智慧醫療AI人才培育成果。現場邀集資策會黃仲銘董事長、資策會簡立峰常務董事、奇美醫院林宏榮院長、成功大學資訊工程學系蔣榮先特聘教授，以及全臺多家醫療體系代表齊聚，共同探討AI驅動智慧醫療發展與人才永續等重要課題。

summary_en: Generative AI is rapidly changing the global industry and bringing the development of smart medical care into a new stage. Chairman Huang Zhongming of the Fund-raising Policy Association, Managing Director Jian Lifeng of the Fund-raising Policy Association, Dean Lin Hongrong of Chimei Hospital, Distinguished Professor Jiang Rongxian of the Department of Information Engineering of National Cheng Kung University, and representatives from many medical systems in Taiwan gathered to discuss important issues such as AI-driven smart medical development and talent sustainability.

title_en: More than 6,000 credit card disputes have not been processed in 10 years, and Heku Bank was fined 12 million yuan
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 11th) Heku Bank failed to immediately apply for refund or replacement from international organizations for 10 years due to credit card disputes, resulting in Heku Bank’s advance losses amounting to NT$101.64 million. The Financial Supervisory Commission said today that this was the first case in the industry and showed that the bank had not fully established and implemented internal controls. It fined the Bank NT$12 million and stopped accepting credit card business for one month.

The single-quarter net profit attributable to the parent company surged to 2.015 billion yuan, and the net profit per share was 0.96 yuan. summary_en: StarLux Airlines (2646) was hit by the surge in international aviation fuel prices in the second quarter. In addition, there was no pure cargo aircraft injection, which put pressure on profits. The company turned from profit to loss, which also hindered the turn from profit to loss in the first half of the year. StarLux Airlines' board of directors approved its financial report for the second quarter of 2026 on the 11th. The net loss after tax in the first half of the year was approximately 346 million yuan, and the after-tax loss per share was 0.11 yuan. With the launch of European routes and a more complete global aviation network, it will strengthen its air cargo layout and strive to turn losses into profits in the second half of the year.

title_en: Ministry of Economic Affairs: It is strictly prohibited to dismantle mainland heavy-duty locomotives, transport them in batches, and then assemble them into vehicles in Taiwan. Violators will be punished by law
summary_en: Recently, some operators demonstrated through social media that heavy motorcycle components were disassembled from mainland China and imported into Taiwan in batches, and then assembled into vehicles domestically. They were suspected of circumventing my country's import management regulations. On the 11th, the Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that it had invited the Customs Affairs Office of the Ministry of Finance, the Ministry of Transportation, and the National Police Service of the Ministry of the Interior to hold a meeting and set up a joint investigation team. They went to New Taipei City on August 7 and today respectively to conduct searches at the business premises involved in the case. According to the import declaration information provided by the operator of the heavy-duty motorcycle discovered during today's inspection, the customs seized the vehicle involved on the spot for follow-up procedures in accordance with the relevant provisions of the "Customs Anti-Smuggling Regulations".

title_en: TSMC is waiting for the arrival of memory chips. Can the chips be piled in factories? Ming-Chi Kuo refutes rumors: It didn’t happen
summary_en: The market has recently reported that TSMC is hoarding semi-finished products worth US$1 billion in Apple's 2nm processors at the factory due to a shortage of DRAM supply. In response, Tianfeng International analyst Ming-Chi Kuo came forward to refute the rumors, emphasizing that this statement is inconsistent with the logic of supply chain operations. Apple usually plans production capacity in advance and will not ask TSMC to mass-produce memory before it is available. Ming-Chi Kuo pointed out that the increase in inventory mentioned in TSMC's legal statement is a normal phenomenon of advanced process ramp-up, and the customer base includes many large manufacturers and cannot be directly interpreted as the accumulation of semi-finished products for a single customer. As the world's top companies, TSMC and Apple have extremely high supply chain management efficiency. External rumors are too dramatic and are not true.

title_en: My daughter is moving home with her grandson! A monthly payment of 30,000 was exchanged for a bill of 40,000. A retired couple lived together for half a year and finally had a showdown.
summary_en: A retired couple in Japan brought their divorced daughter and grandson back home to live with them. They thought they would live a comfortable life, but their daughter only paid 30,000 yen a month. As a result, the household's water, electricity and food expenses skyrocketed, and their pension was unable to make ends meet. It wasn't until they discovered that their daughter's loan was stuck that the two parties had a showdown and finally agreed to increase their living expenses and set a deadline to move out within one year. This case reflects the economic pressure faced by Japan’s elderly families. According to data, retired couples’ monthly consumption expenditures often exceed their incomes. Facing the return of their adult children, if financial and living boundaries are not planned in advance, the quality of retirement life and financial security may be seriously affected.

title_en: Jin Zongming re-elected Dong Ruibin as chairman of the board of directors, and Lin Yanmao, director of Heku, served as director and secretary-general
summary_en: The Taiwan Financial Federation will hold a membership meeting tomorrow to re-elect the board of directors. The current chairman Dong Ruibin, who represents the Banks Association, will be re-elected. The secretary-general will be replaced by Lin Yanmao, chairman of the Banking Association. It is reported that he will first be elected as a director on behalf of the Banking Association, and then be appointed as the secretary-general by the chairman ex officio. However, due to his busy business as the director of the Banking and Banking Association, he will be appointed as the general secretary-general of the Bank on a part-time basis.

title_en: Guoguang Biotech's subsidiary, Guomu, obtained its first animal vaccine drug certificate, aiming at pig vaccine business opportunities in Asia
summary_en: Guoguang Biotechnology's subsidiary, Cuimu Biotechnology, obtained the first animal vaccine drug certificate. The porcine circovirus (PCV) gene recombinant and porcine mycoplasma (SEP) bivalent vaccine developed in cooperation with the Academy of Agricultural Sciences was approved by the Ministry of Agriculture at the end of July. Since piglets must be vaccinated against these two infectious diseases, Daimu is targeting the huge pig vaccine business opportunities in Taiwan and Southeast Asia.

title_en: Discussing public mergers: Financial Supervisory Commission: It involves the wishes of major shareholders to respect the authority of the Ministry of Finance
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 11th) The outside world is paying attention to the possibility of the merger of public financial institutions. The Financial Supervisory Commission stated that it will provide a sound legal environment for the merger of financial institutions. However, the merger of financial institutions involves the wishes of major shareholders. The merger of pan-public financial institutions involves the handling of public equity. The Financial Supervisory Commission respects the Ministry of Finance’s public equity management authority.

title_en: <Tax Statistics> In the first seven months, securities tax revenue soared 1.9 times to 398.7 billion yuan, and the state treasury tax revenue reached 2.87 trillion yuan, a record high for the same period.
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance announced national tax revenue statistics for July today (11th). Thanks to the boom in securities transaction taxes driven by the boom in Taiwan stock trading, the cumulative net tax collection nationwide in the first seven months reached 2.8767 billion yuan, an annual increase of 25%, continuing to hit a record high for the same period in history. The cumulative securities tax in the first seven months has reached 398.7 billion yuan, a sharp increase of 2.5% compared with the same period last year.

title_en: Jingmei Financial Report/Profit in the first half of the year rewrote the full-year record, and revenue in the first seven months also exceeded last year's full year
summary_en: Jingmei (7899), a supplier of interface structural components for advanced process testing, announced its first-half financial report and July revenue on the 11th. Benefiting from the continued expansion of demand for AI, high-performance computing (HPC) and advanced process testing, its net profit after tax in the first half of the year was 58.579 million yuan, an annual increase of 163%, and net profit after tax per share (EPS) was 2.56 yuan. title_en: Han Guoyu urges the Kuomintang group to sign the general budget bill, which will be voted on on the 14th and 17th.
summary_en: The 2026 central government general budget has yet to come to fruition. Legislative Yuan Han Guoyu convened the third round of party group consultations on the 11th and urged the Kuomintang group to sign and agree. summary: 全球首富馬斯克旗下特斯拉與SpaceX宣布，將在德州斥資168億美元打造全球最大晶圓廠「Terafab」。因園區渲染圖出現疑似粒子加速器結構，加上馬斯克於X平台回應「FELFTW」，外界推測其可能採用「自由電子雷射」（FEL）技術挑戰現行ASML的EUV光刻光源。FEL技術具備高彈性與潛在效率優勢，若成功整合進超大型晶圓廠，將顛覆現有晶片製造流程。儘管ASML目前主導先進製程，但馬斯克試圖從物理層面重新設計整套晶片產出流程的野心，已引發產業高度關注與熱烈討論，後續發展值得密切追蹤。

title_en: Jinxing Financial Report/First half EPS 0.99 yuan, better than the same period last year
summary_en: Jinxing Precision (7732) Industrial Co., Ltd. held a board of directors meeting on the 11th and approved the consolidated financial report for the first half of 2026 (second quarter). Consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 533 million yuan, a decrease of 18.1% from 651 million yuan in the same period last year. The main reason is that due to the early purchase effect caused by the U.S. tariff policy in 2025, customers have entered a period of inventory adjustment this year, and the pace of purchase has slowed down compared with previous years.

title_en: Yongguan will be listed as changing its trading method and will cease trading from August 13th.
summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange stated that Yongguan Energy Technology (1589) previously had circumstances stipulated in Articles 49-1 and 49-3 of the Business Rules, and its listed securities were listed as changing the trading method and adopting the split-plate call auction trading method. Since all three independent directors of the company have resigned, there are less than two independent directors with registered residence in the Republic of China, and the by-election has not been completed within the prescribed time limit. In compliance with the circumstances specified in Article 49-1, Item 1, Paragraph 14 of the same Articles, it will be listed as a change of transaction method from August 13, 2026.

title_en: ASE's Silicon Products Group Co., Ltd. breaks ground on its new fab No. 6 and is expected to introduce the CoWoS advanced packaging process
summary_en: Facing the explosive demand for global AI and high-performance computing, Silicon Precision, a major packaging and testing company under the global packaging and testing leader ASE Investment Holdings (3711), held the "Groundbreaking Ceremony of the Douliu New Factory" at the Yunlin Douliu Base on the 11th. As a global packaging and testing leader, following the successful opening of the first phase of the Huwei plant in 2025, Silicon Products Precision will build a new factory in Douliu today. It is expected to introduce the CoWoS advanced packaging process. This not only announces that Silicon Products Precision will further expand its production capacity in Central Taiwan, but also means that driven by the strong linkage of the "Huwei and Douliu" dual factories, high-tech momentum and high-quality employment opportunities will be brought to Yunlin, promoting the transformation and upgrading of Yunlin's local industry, and accelerating the construction of the local semiconductor ecosystem.

title_en: Taiwan's digital advertising market will reach NT$66.177 billion in 2025, with audio-visual advertising ranking first among all types
summary_en: Taiwan's Digital Media Application and Marketing Association (DMA) recently released the "2025 Taiwan Annual Digital Advertising Volume Statistical Report". Taiwan's digital advertising market totaled NT$66.177 billion last year, with an annual growth rate of 3.9%. It has maintained positive growth, but the growth has slowed down for two consecutive years. The main growth momentum is concentrated on international platforms, while the overall performance of local media has declined. This shows that Taiwan's digital advertising market has entered a growth plateau, and brand budget allocation has become more actuarial and efficiency-oriented.

title_en: How to solve the problem of renting housing for disadvantaged families? The Department of Land and Resources unveiled three tracks of social housing, leasing and management, and rent subsidy in parallel
summary_en: The vigilante group held a press conference on the 11th to express concern about the rental housing needs of women and children who have been victims of violence. The Department of Land and Resources of the Ministry of the Interior stated that the government currently assists disadvantaged families through three tracks: direct construction of social housing, leasing and hosting, and rent subsidies. At least 40% of social housing is reserved for the economically or socially disadvantaged in accordance with the law. As of the end of July this year, leasing and hosting has assisted 116,390 households, of which economically or socially disadvantaged households account for 41.19%.

summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the Civil Code Amendment on the third reading in July 2026, officially deleting the "siblings' special share" provision and giving the deceased greater testamentary autonomy. At this critical moment, the largest "generational wealth transfer wave" in Taiwan's history, people are further thinking about wealth inheritance. Is it the assets that are being passed on, or the future of the family? Cai Shengwei, chairman of Gongsheng Insurance and Gongsheng Wealth Consulting, pointed out that high-net-worth families and business owners must break away from the traditional passive thinking of "distributing property after the fact" and turn to proactive and comprehensive "family wealth management."

title_en: The father's house is in his son's name, and the children will inherit it jointly after his death. Two words are missing from the record, and the insurance will pay more tax.
summary_en: The father paid for the house to be built, but it was registered in his son's name. After the father passed away, the brothers and sisters jointly inherited the house through court mediation. Unexpectedly, the word "inheritance" was missing from the mediation record, which almost led to deed tax issues. The Hsinchu Taxation Bureau reminds that if the real estate registered in a borrowed name involves inheritance, it is best to clearly state the reason for acquisition in legal documents such as court mediation records, otherwise the right to be exempted from deed tax may be affected.

title_en: AI demand triggers war for production capacity, memory, passive components and silicon wafer supplies are tight
summary_en: AI business opportunities have exploded across the board, and the battle for production capacity in the supply chain has become increasingly fierce. After the production capacity of major memory manufacturers has been booked by customers in advance, and there are rumors in the passive component market that customers are willing to increase prices to grab goods, silicon wafers have also joined the ranks of tight supply. The industry pointed out that the shortage of components caused by this wave of AI demand has extended from memory and passive components to upstream silicon wafers. Some products not only require customers to sign long-term contracts (LTA), but even start to cost a premium. The intensity of demand brought by AI exceeds market expectations.

title_en: Financial management topic/Inspiration from the Korean stock market stampede storm reveals the crisis of Taiwan’s invisible leverage chain
summary_en:
The AI ​​wave is sweeping the world, with Taiwanese and Korean stocks hitting record highs, and the market is filled with the atmosphere of "missing out on AI means missing out on wealth." However, behind this AI-driven bull market, it is not just the stock price that is really rapidly expanding, but also the credit and leverage of investors.

A stock market stampede in South Korea caused by deleveraging not only caused countless retail investors to liquidate their positions instantly, but also sounded the alarm for Taiwan. When home loans, credit, stock pledges and leveraged commodities are intertwined, how many invisible risks are accumulated under the iceberg? What this Korean stock market storm has revealed is not only the cost of deleveraging, but also a warning sign of Taiwan’s “invisible leverage chain”.

title: 理財專題／3步驟守住投資安全線　槓桿風暴下的生存術
summary:
借錢投資，全球皆有；但台灣特殊之處，是一個投資人可能同時背著4種、甚至6種槓桿進場，每筆借貸單獨看都可能符合風控規範，一旦跨體系層層疊加，真正的總槓桿與市場曝險卻成了監理盲區。

title_en: Financial Management Special Topic/3 Steps to Keep Investment Safety: Survival Techniques under Leverage Storm
summary_en:
Borrowing money to invest is available all over the world; but what is special about Taiwan is that an investor may enter the market with 4 or even 6 types of leverage at the same time. Each loan may meet the risk control regulations when viewed individually. Once layers are added across the system, the real total leverage and market exposure become a blind spot for supervision.

The stampede of Korean stocks has demonstrated that once the market takes a sharp turn, the most fatal thing is that multiple levers shrink at the same time. How to prevent the same situation from happening in Taiwan? From the government establishing a cross-system risk monitoring mechanism to investors calculating the total leverage, proactively reducing leverage and conducting worst-case scenario stress tests, everything should be done simultaneously. Real risk control is not to find a way out when a storm comes, but to build a defensive line while the market is still calm.

title: 8月11日盤前／美伊衝突猶存 台積電營收創新高 台股具基本面支撐
summary:
昨日盤勢
美國7 月非農爆冷轉負，使聯準會升息預期降溫，上週五台指期夜盤及費半皆走強，帶動週一加權指數開高，盤面電金傳皆走揚。權值股台達電率領電源管理強勢反攻；隨7月營收陸續公布，市場關注焦點回歸基本面，記憶體、AI零組件、CPO、被動元件、扇出型封裝等表現活躍。傳產方面，台灣自行車產業浮現谷底回升訊號，指標股巨大強勢漲停；帶領該族群穩健表現。
權值股方面，台積電上漲0.42%、鴻海上漲1.73%、聯發科上漲1.54%、廣達上漲5.20%，台達電漲停。盤面強勢股，台達電、光寶科、聯茂、群創、聯亞、台特化、南亞科、威強電、華新等共77檔漲停；順達、嘉基、華新科、訊芯-KY、文曄、瑞軒等漲幅7%以上。盤面弱勢股，元太、東科-KY等4檔跌停；台勝科、華航、合晶、愛山林、國精化、康和證、雷虎等跌幅7%以上。
終場台灣加權指數上漲702.85點，以44928.76點作收，成交量8473.72億元。觀察盤面變化，三大類股全面上漲，電子上漲1.80%、傳產上漲0.75%、金融上漲0.60%。在次族群部份，以電纜、生醫、光電表現較佳，分別上漲5.91%、4.38%、4.28%。

title_en: Pre-market on August 11/The conflict between the United States and Iran still exists, TSMC’s revenue hits a new high, and Taiwan stocks have fundamental support
summary_en:
Yesterday's market trend
The U.S. non-farm payrolls unexpectedly turned negative in July, cooling expectations for a rate hike by the Federal Reserve. Last Friday, the Taiwanese index futures and index prices strengthened in night trading, driving the weighted index to open higher on Monday. Delta, a heavyweight stock, led a strong counterattack in power management; as July revenue was released one after another, the market focus returned to fundamentals, with active performance in memory, AI components, CPO, passive components, fan-out packaging, etc. In terms of transmission, Taiwan's bicycle industry has shown signs of rebounding from the bottom, and the index stocks have reached a huge and strong daily limit; leading this group to perform steadily.
In terms of weight stocks, TSMC rose 0.42%, Hon Hai rose 1.73%, MediaTek rose 1.54%, Quanta rose 5.20%, and Delta Electronics rose by the limit. Strong stocks on the market, including Delta Electronics, Lite-On, Lianmao, Innolux, Lianya, Taiwan Special Chemical, Nanya, IEI, Huaxin, etc., have a total of 77 daily limit levels; Shunda, Jiage, Huaxin, Xunxin-KY, Wenye, Ruixuan, etc. have increased by more than 7%. Weak stocks on the market, Yuantai, Dongke-KY, etc. fell by the 4-stop limit; Taiwan Sembcorp, China Airlines, Hejing, Aishanlin, Guojing Chemical, Kanghe Securities, Leihu, etc. fell more than 7%.
At the end, the Taiwan Weighted Index rose 702.85 points to close at 44928.76 points, with a trading volume of 847.372 billion yuan. Observing the changes in the market, the three major categories of stocks rose across the board, with Electronics rising by 1.80%, Transmission Technology rising by 0.75%, and Financials rising by 0.60%. Among subgroups, cables, biomedical and optoelectronics performed better, rising 5.91%, 4.38% and 4.28% respectively.

title: 日圓若快速反轉恐震盪美債與科技股 牽動全球市場穩定

title: 小摩亞太企業銀行收入增逾20%，2027年維持擴大招聘
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，全美市值最高金融機構--摩根大通銀行(小摩，JPMorgan Chase，美股代碼JPM)亞太區主管表示，受亞洲企業加快海外擴張，以及人工智慧(AI)、數據中心和供應鏈投資增加帶動，今年以來亞太企業銀行業務收入成長遠超過20%，公司計畫2027年繼續以相近速度增聘人員。小摩今年將亞太企業銀行團隊擴編約15%，相關招聘已接近完成；2025年團隊人數則增加20%。新增人力將服務中型及大型企業、創新經濟、金融機構與非銀行金融機構，招聘範圍涵蓋亞洲多個市場及不同業務部門。台灣、韓國、中國及澳洲企業銀行業務增速均高於亞太整體水準，東南亞收入亦成長逾20%。其中，馬來西亞受惠AI及數據中心相關外資湧入，新加坡則持續發揮區域融資、資金調度與企業營運樞紐的作用。小摩指出，企業對數據中心及繪圖處理器(GPU)融資的詢問非常活躍，顯示AI基礎設施投資正轉化為銀行貸款、資本募集及顧問服務需求。隨著亞洲區內貿易增加，該行亦將投入更多資本發展貿易融資及營運資金融資業務，協助企業支付跨境貨物與供應鏈成本。

title: Austal美國業務獲韓華高達12億美元收購提議，週二股價飆近18%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，澳洲最大造船商Austal(澳股代碼ASB)週二宣布，韓國韓華集團(Hanwha Group)旗下Hanwha Defence USA提出以10.5億至12億美元，收購其美國業務及相關實體，藉此進一步擴大在美國國防與造船市場的布局。消息刺激Austal股價週二收盤大漲0.69澳幣或17.97%，報4.53澳幣，成為澳洲標普/澳證200指數表現最強個股。Austal已給予韓華四週進行盡職調查，目前尚未簽署具約束力的最終協議。Austal美國業務為美國海軍及海岸防衛隊設計和建造船艦，2025會計年度貢獻集團1.085億澳幣稅前獲利約90%。這項收購不包括Austal在澳洲、菲律賓和越南的核心業務，也不涉及其雪梨上市股份及與澳洲政府簽訂的戰略造船協議。韓華2024年已收購費城造船廠，並持有Austal約9.9%股份，另透過現金結算股權交換取得相當於9.9%的經濟權益。不過，Austal預估美國業務2026會計年度將因造船項目成本上升錄得1.75億澳幣營業虧損，拖累集團由上年度獲利1.134億澳幣轉為虧損1.13億澳幣。

summary: 面對升息壓力與油價震盪，高盛高層喊話：「我的建議是繼續投資。」他指出美聯儲今年不升息、油價將降及AI提升生產力三大利多，為市場注入強心針。

title: 中華電信與Nokia簽合作備忘錄 共推新世代AI網路技術
summary: 中華電信今（11）日宣布與Nokia簽署AI-RAN（Artificial Intelligence Radio Access Network）策略合作備忘錄，兩公司將共同研究行動網路與人工智慧技術之整合應用，探討AI-RAN技術研究、實驗室及場域驗證、AI運算架構與平台技術，以及次世代行動網路演進等合作。

title: 智譜發布ZCode升級版，實現AI Agent複雜任務獨立執行
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，人工智能(AI)大型語言模型開發商智譜發布ZCode升級版，實現AI Agent複雜任務獨立執行。智譜發布公告指出，在ZCode的更新中添加Goal、Subagents、Remote Control與閒時任務四大功能。其中Goal模式讓Agent可以自己把複雜任務跑完。Remote Control將當前ZCode桌面窗口臨時開放給手機訪問。同時，GLM Coding Plan全體用戶額度已於週二13:00統一重置，屆時全員額度全部回滿。

title: Rubin GPU出貨遞延　這家強勢股目標價被調降
summary: 輝達新一代Rubin GPU因散熱設計調整，出貨時程遞延至第4季放量，導致京元電子短期測試業務成長步調放緩。本土法人下修京元電第3季營收與獲利預估，並將目標價由370元調降至330元，但仍給予買進評等。儘管短期受影響，市場仍看好京元電長線動能，除輝達GPU測試需求外，2027年CSP自研ASIC及Google TPU出貨量預估將大幅成長，加上京元電具備自製Burn-in爐的成本優勢，預期在Rubin與ASIC雙引擎帶動下，中長期高階測試動能依然強勁。投資人應留意短期股價波動，審慎評估市場風險。

title: 美國ETF資產創新高 投資者策略分歧：追逐績效或著眼長期
summary: 商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導根據財經資訊供應商 FactSet 的分析，2026 年上半年美國 ETF（指數股票型基金）市場創下歷史新高，資產管理規模（AUM）及資金流動性均達到前所未見的水準。截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，美國 ETF 的管理資產總額已突破 15.7 兆美元，涵蓋 5,456 種產品，全年資金流量有望超過 2 兆美元。然而，在市場蓬勃發展的同時，投資者的策略卻呈現兩極化。 FactSet 將 ETF 市場細分為多個「市場區隔」（market segment），每個區隔主要依資產類別及證券分組方式界定，這有助於理解 ETF 市場的競爭結構。報告指出，股票型和固定收益型 ETF 佔了上半年所有資金流量的 98%，顯示這兩大資產類別仍是投資主力。相對地，商品和貨幣類 ETF 則出現資金流出。整體 ETF 市場包含 876 個市場區隔，其中有 28 種不同的投資策略。 近年來，投資者在 ETF 選擇上展現出兩種截然不同的偏好。一部分投資者對價格極為敏感，偏好選擇費用率較低、分散化的「一般型 ETF」（plain vanilla ETF），例如 Vanguard Total

title: 主動式 ETF 風險與報酬大對決！李其展：00407A 三大指標交叉驗證奪冠
summary: 主動式 ETF 風險與報酬大對決！李其展：00407A 三大指標交叉驗證奪冠 圖/pexels商傳媒｜記者陳宜靖／台北報導台股7月歷經劇烈震盪後，8月市場情緒雖逐步回穩，但AI投資熱潮究竟能否延續，市場開始從「追題材」轉向「看獲利」，尤其當AI投資進入驗證期，主動投資更考驗選股邏輯。財經專家李其展最新分析指出，在近 10 個交易日的市場極端震盪壓力測試下，全台首檔主動式不配息 ETF「主動凱基台灣（00407A）」在抗震回撤、Beta與含息報酬考驗下，都展現出防禦力與反彈力道。隨著美國政策變化加上中國模型衝擊，金融市場對於AI題材帶動的股價前景正出現變化，過去靠大型科技企業資本支出帶動的溢價逐漸消風，資金更加要求看到財報數字、實際訂單與現金流驗證，讓市場主流上漲類股進一步輪動轉移，尤其以S&P500再創歷史新高，但那斯達克與費半都還有一段距離為最明顯的現象。李其展認為，相對於過去市場全面追逐通用型零組件，或傳統景氣循環類股，現在開始轉變為高度謹慎與挑剔的結構買盤，財報報喜只是基本門檻，要確認是AI相關投資已經帶動營收成長者才被獎勵，低基期更有額外加成，這也主導了從7月底開始的市場反攻氣

title: 哥倫比亞強震已釀132死、570傷，全國32城嚴重受災
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，哥倫比亞政府最新通報，該國西部週一發生的強震已造成至少132人死亡、570人受傷，全國共有32個城市嚴重受災，搜救人員仍在倒塌建築物瓦礫中搜尋受困者，傷亡數字可能繼續上升。哥倫比亞地質調查局(SGC)測定，地震規模為7.4，震央位於西部喬科省聖何塞德爾帕爾馬爾(San Jose del Palmar)，震源深度約103公里，是哥倫比亞21世紀以來規模最大的地震。官方在最初通報階段已監測到至少18次餘震，並警告餘震仍可能持續。災情集中在卡利、佩雷拉、馬尼薩萊斯、亞美尼亞及喬科省部分地區，至少1575棟住宅受損、61棟建築完全倒塌，部分醫院和機場亦遭破壞。政府已宣布進入「國家災難狀態」，調派軍警及救援人員前往重災區，並設置臨時收容中心。

title: 荷姆茲海峽僵局威脅鋁供應，LME期鋁一度上漲1%，升至七週高點
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，週二倫敦鋁價連續第七個交易日上漲，因隨著荷姆茲海峽恢復通航協議短期內達成的可能性減弱，市場擔心中東地區鋁供應在可預見的未來仍將受限。美國總統川普對伊朗提出一系列新要求，包括要求德黑蘭就相關人員死亡作出賠償。川普新提出的這些條件很可能遭到伊朗拒絕。此前，伊朗也曾重申，希望將賠償問題納入結束衝突的談判內容。受此影響，上海時間13時15分，倫敦鋁期貨價格上漲0.6%，報每噸3,337美元。稍早價格一度上漲1%，升至6月23日以來最高水準。美、伊雙方立場趨於強硬，意味著達成協議可能仍需漫長時間。這削弱了市場對鋁供應恢復正常的預期，而全球鋁庫存目前正徘徊在數十年來低水位附近。衝突爆發前，中東地區約占全球鋁產量的十分之一。儘管來自中國和印尼的新供應正在增加，但倫敦金屬交易所(LME)倉庫中的鋁庫存今年持續下降，目前已接近25萬噸，為1990年11月以來最低水準。

title: 人口負成長衝擊房市？10年家戶增129萬　小宅需求反成主流
summary: 台灣正式邁入超高齡社會，人口減少是否就代表住宅需求同步萎縮？答案恐怕沒有這麼簡單。專家指出，近十年全台人口雖減少約24萬人，但家戶數反而增加129萬戶，每戶平均人口降至2.4人，一人家戶占比更達4成；隨著家庭結構小型化，全台成屋平均交易坪數縮小約5坪，2025年30坪以下住宅交易占比超過4成，住宅需求正從「人口多寡」轉向「家庭結構」。

title: 公務出國守住資安　數發部推資通設備3階段管理措施
summary: 數位發展部資通安全署今日（8/11）指出，公務人員出國執行公務時，手機、筆電等資通訊設備可能因使用公共網路、設備遺失或遭受資安滲透攻擊，而增加資料外洩風險。該署籲公務人員出國應落實「出國前、出國期間、返國後」三階段資安管理措施，包括做好設備安全整備、避免使用公共Wi-Fi、妥善保管公務設備及返國後完成資安檢查等，以降低跨境資安風險，確保公務資料安全。

title: Anthropic等AI創投帶動 Q2全球創投交易衝2274億美元
summary: 今年第1季全球創投金額達3329億美元，創歷史單季新高；KPMG今（11）日表示，雖然今年第2季創投較第1季明顯回落，但金額2274億美元，但在美國AI公司Anthropic完成650億美元募資，成為本季全球最大創投交易帶動下，仍寫下歷年最強第2季的成績。

title: 川湖逆襲再創新天價！林聰吉從家具學徒做起　靠「兩根鐵」拚出台灣首富
summary: 台股第三支「萬金股」、股后川湖（2059），歷經連3個交易日累計狂漲25.71%後，今（8/11）股價盤中再創下新天價12540元，盤中一度大漲逾5%，收盤為12,315元、漲410元（3.44%）。《富比士》（Forbes）即時富豪榜昨天也公布，川湖創辦人林聰吉單日身家暴增11億美元（約354億台幣），個人淨資產達到167億美元（約5386億台幣），超車國巨（2327）董事長陳泰銘，成為台灣新首富。85歲的林聰吉從家具工廠的學徒開始做起，靠「兩根鐵」做出AI伺服器最重要的「滑軌」，讓外界再次讚嘆台灣傳產轉型成功的經典範例。

title: 金興精密上半年每股盈餘0.9元，無人載具馬達小量出貨Q3完成佈建優化
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】車用散熱系統廠金興精密(7732)公布上半年財報，每股盈餘達0.9元，優於去年同期的0.83元。展望後市，金興指出，採取「跨域應用」與「國際深耕」雙策略，無人載具馬達第二季啟動小量樣品出貨，第三季完成設備布建與優化，高效能BLDC馬達今年對營收貢獻將會有顯著成長。金興上半年合併營收為5.33億元，因2025年美國關稅政策引發提前拉貨效應，致今年客戶進入庫存調節期，拉貨放緩，儘管營收受到市場環境波動影響，但整體稅後淨利年成長15.7%，每股盈餘達0.9元，優於去年同期的0.83元。金興指出，2026年是公司技術跨越的重要里程碑，以深厚的馬達研發實力，在鞏固全球售後市場（AM）領先地位的同時，也投入AI自動化與智慧移動領域。高效能BLDC馬達部分，針對新能源車（HEV/BEV）市場，持續優化直流無刷馬達（BLDC）的能效與智慧控制邏輯，預計2026年該系列產品對營收貢獻將顯著成長。跨產業應用開發部分，研發團隊將車用技術延伸至無人載具馬達與輕型自動導引車（AGV）驅動電機，現已啟動送樣測試，目標實現馬達動力技術與AI自動化設備的無縫接軌。產線布局升級則配合新技術與

title: SK海力士導入PSM技術，推進High-NA EUV製程布局下一代DRAM
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】韓國科技媒體ZDNET報導，SK海力士(韓股代碼000660，美股代碼SKHY)正加快推進極紫外光(EUV)微影技術，並全面展開相移光罩(Phase Shift Mask，PSM)的導入工作，為下一代DRAM量產預作準備。SK海力士去年首次引進高數值孔徑極紫外光(High-NA EUV)設備，今年已全面啟動相關製程研發。High-NA EUV可提供較傳統EUV更高的解析能力，有助於在晶片線寬持續縮小的情況下，製作更精細的電路圖案。PSM藉由調整光線相位，提高曝光圖案的對比度與清晰度，可改善EUV微影的成像品質及製程精準度。若能與High-NA EUV設備順利整合，將有助SK海力士降低先進DRAM製程的圖案缺陷，並提升良率與生產效率。隨著人工智慧(AI)伺服器推升高頻寬記憶體(HBM)及高階DRAM需求，三星電子、美光和SK海力士持續競逐更先進製程。SK海力士加快導入High-NA EUV與PSM，顯示記憶體業者的競爭正由產品堆疊與封裝，進一步延伸至前段微影技術。

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，印尼銅出口正面臨延誤，因為超大型礦場Grasberg的配套冶煉廠在週末因鍋爐洩漏而停產。以無權公開討論相關事宜為由要求匿名的知情人士表示，Gresik冶煉廠的銅買家已被告知，該廠將在未來數週暫停營運，以進行評估和維修。Greski冶煉廠負責加工Grasberg的礦石，該礦由印尼政府與Freeport-McMoRan Inc共同擁有。消息人士表示，此次停產正值全球銅市場供應趨緊之際。隨著大量銅流向美國，以及近期運往中國的貨物增加，倫敦金屬交易所(LME)銅價基準合約已連續五個交易日維持在每噸14,000美元上方，創歷史紀錄。位於印尼巴布亞的Grasberg超大型礦場在去年因泥石流影響生產後，目前已恢復部分營運，但全面復產可能要到2028年。

summary: 【財訊快報／研究員周佳蓉】富世達(6805)近年營運結構已明顯由手機轉向伺服器。上半年營收占比約為伺服器55.7%，其餘為手機38%、NB 5.6%，伺服器已超越折疊手機、躍居最大業務。近期公司舉辦法說會公布上半年營收，最新營收為前七月92.84億元、年增53.9%，上半年EPS 25.77元。產能方面，AI液冷快接頭中國廠滿載，越南產能約300萬顆，未來產能將持續爬升。VR200、AWS滑軌於3Q26放量，TPU快接頭4Q26量產，快接頭的亮點是PBMC，可因應未來更高功耗平台的散熱需求，可特別關注QD應用由Cold Plate延伸至Rack Manifold需求的提升和單價上揚情況，伺服器滑軌部分，富世達首先自Q3開始出貨AWS的伺服器，輝達的Kyber架構滑軌則持續配合送樣，展望全年，看好伺服器液冷需求和伺服器的拉貨動能，公司預估全年AI營收占比可達60%，較去年明顯提高，加上手機進入下半年銷售旺季，看好蘋果折疊手機有高機率活絡市場。股價近期在拉回整理之後，收復季線關卡，KD指標進入鈍化，前波下跌跳空缺口宜儘快回補有利於反彈。

title: 中國法拍住宅前7月成交量年增42.7%，成交均價年減9.1%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中指研究院週二公布最新數據顯示，今年前七個月中國法拍住宅掛拍房源達24.5萬套，年增23.1%；成交拍品8.9萬套，年增42.7%，成交增速明顯高於掛拍房源增幅。期內法拍住宅清倉率為36.2%，較上年同期提高4.97個百分點；成交總金額達969.75億元人民幣，年增21.04%，顯示折價拍賣對部分購屋需求仍具吸引力。不過，前七個月法拍住宅成交均價為每平方米8081元人民幣，年減9.1%。成交量大幅增加但均價持續下滑，反映部分房源須以更明顯折讓才能完成處置。市場人士指出，法拍住宅供應與成交同步增加，顯示房地產市場的債務及資產處置壓力仍在釋放。成交量回升有助金融機構和債權人加快回收資金，但價格下跌亦反映中國住宅市場整體估值仍面臨調整壓力。

title: 全球Q2平板電腦出貨量年減10%，返校旺季效應罕見失靈
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】市場研究機構Omdia發表最新報告顯示，2026年第二季全球平板電腦市場進入下行週期，出貨量年減10%至3600萬台，反映消費電子需求轉弱及裝置換機動能不足。更值得注意的是，全球平板電腦出貨量罕見未能延續第二季季增的傳統走勢。過去市場通常會在第二季提前為返校購物季備貨，帶動出貨量較首季成長，但今年這項季節性規律遭到打破。市場人士指出，平板電腦需求在疫情期間提前釋放後，換機週期持續拉長；即使品牌商推出具備人工智慧(AI)功能的新產品，現階段仍不足以全面刺激消費者升級，教育與企業採購動能亦未能填補消費市場缺口。全球平板電腦出貨量重新轉為雙位數年減，可能加大品牌商及供應鏈的庫存與定價壓力。後續市場能否回穩，將取決於返校季實際銷售、年底消費旺季需求，以及AI平板能否形成更明確的換機誘因。

summary: 公務人員出國執行公務時，手機、筆電等資通訊設備可能因使用公共網路、設備遺失或遭受資安滲透攻擊，而增加公務資料外洩風險。數發部資安署署長蔡福隆11日表示，公務出國應落實「出國前、出國期間、返國後」三階段資安管理措施，包括做好設備安全整備、避免使用公共Wi-Fi、妥善保管公務設備及返國後完成資安檢查等。

title: 星巴克擬售日本業務 效法客美多咖啡轉型「輕資產」模式

title: 澳洲央行如預期維持利率4.35%不變，示警通膨回落恐延至2027年底

title_en: A fire broke out in the factory of a well-known listed cable company in Kaohsiung late at night. Waste paper boxes and cables burned... It took 20 minutes for the fire fighters to put it out.
summary_en: A fire alarm suddenly broke out at the factory of a well-known listed cable company on Gaonan Highway in Gao City at about 10 o'clock last night. The staff on duty found a fire in the waste storage area and called 119 for help. The fire department sent 15 vehicles and 34 people to rescue. When they arrived, they found that cartons and plastic waste were burning at the scene. After putting out water lines to put out the fire, the fire was extinguished in about 20 minutes. Fortunately, no one was injured.

title_en: Population growth has been negative for 31 consecutive months
summary_en: Taiwan's total population continues to decline. As of the end of July, Taiwan's population dropped to 23.235 million, a decrease of 8,563 from the previous month. The population has been experiencing negative growth for 31 consecutive months, and the total population has continued to hit a new low.

title: 中國多家中小銀行逆勢上調存款利率10-33個基點，屬階段性攬儲
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中國湖北、廣東等地多家中小型銀行8月以來陸續上調存款利率，調升幅度介於10至33個基點。在整體市場利率下行、銀行業持續降低負債成本之際，地方銀行逆勢提高利率，引發市場關注是否代表存款價格競爭重新升溫。近期調整利率的機構涵蓋城市商業銀行、農村商業銀行及村鎮銀行，部分調高掛牌存款利率，另一些則提高特色存款產品利率。由於調整集中於特定地區、期限或產品，並非全市場及所有存款類別同步上升。業界人士認為，此輪調整具有明顯的階段性攬儲特徵，可能與個別銀行補充穩定負債、因應存款到期或拓展地方客群有關，不具普遍性，也不代表中國銀行業存款利率下降趨勢已經逆轉。近期部分國有大型銀行重新推出五年期大額存單，同樣引起市場討論，但業界認為，兩者沒有直接關聯。大型銀行重啟長期產品主要是完善期限結構及滿足特定客戶需求，中小銀行提高利率則偏向局部競爭策略；若市場利率繼續走低，銀行淨息差承壓仍將限制存款利率持續上調的空間。

title: 大摩下調中國房市預測，估今年新開工、房地產投資分別降20%、17%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】摩根士丹利(大摩)發表最新研究報告下調2026年中國房地產市場多項主要指標預測，主因土地成交持續疲弱，並進一步拖累新屋開工、房地產開發投資及新房銷售。該行目前預估，全年新開工面積、房地產投資及新房銷售量將分別年減20%、17%及9.8%。大摩指出，今年前七個月，中指研究院追蹤的300個城市土地成交建築面積年減21%，並使上半年新開工面積下降23%。雖然7月土地成交金額明顯回升，但交易主要集中於一線城市的優質地塊，尚未反映全國土地市場全面回暖。考慮未來數月住宅銷售可能再次轉弱，房地產開發商補充土地儲備的態度預料仍將保持審慎。大摩認為，土地市場下半年可能繼續低迷，實體房市疲弱將限制建商拿地能力及意願，建築活動亦難以明顯改善。個股方面，大摩維持華潤置地(港股代碼01109)為中國房地產類股首選，主要看好其財務體質及核心城市布局；同時建議在未來數月零售銷售可能改善前，逐步關注新城控股(滬股代碼601155)，反映其商業地產與零售業務可能提供相對支撐。

title_en: Covered call strategy to resist volatility
summary_en: Taiwan’s active ETF investment strategies are increasingly diversified, and the “Covered Call Strategy” has joined my country’s active ETF market. Investors should carefully evaluate the characteristics of the product and their own risk tolerance, and should not simply rely on the interest rate as the only basis for investment decisions.

title: 中國自巴西進口牛肉達保障配額90%，額滿後將加徵55%關稅
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中國商務部週一公告顯示，截至8月10日，牛肉保障措施項下自巴西進口的牛肉數量，已達商務部2025年第87號公告所規定國別配額的90%，距離觸發額外關稅門檻僅剩10%。按照相關規定，當自巴西進口牛肉數量達到規定額度100%後，將自達標之日起第三天起(含當日)，在現行適用關稅稅率基礎上額外加徵55%關稅，使後續進口成本大幅上升。巴西是中國主要牛肉供應國之一，進口量迅速接近保障措施上限，顯示中國買家對巴西牛肉的採購需求仍然強勁。隨著剩餘配額縮減，進口商可能加快貨物報關，也可能轉向其他尚有配額空間的供應國。一旦配額用盡並啟動加徵關稅，巴西牛肉在中國市場的價格競爭力將明顯下降，並可能影響巴西出口商出貨安排及中國進口牛肉供應結構。市場將密切關注商務部後續公布的配額使用進度，以及55%額外關稅的確切生效日期。

title_en: During the astronomical spring tide, the lower road section of the base city is flooded again. Xie Guoliang investigates the disaster and strengthens pumping response.
summary_en: On the 8th, strong tides and typhoons in Keelung City helped to increase prices. Drainage was blocked along Aisi Road in Ren'ai District, causing some stores to suffer losses due to flooding. During the high tide period on the evening of the 10th, water overflowed from the drainage ditch and reached the lower section of Aisi Road. Shopkeepers were busy installing partitions and sandbags for protection. Mayor Xie Guoliang came to the scene to understand the situation, and the Public Works Department strengthened drainage to allow the stagnant water to gradually recede.

title: 理財專題／韓股踩踏風暴啟示　揭台灣隱形槓桿鏈危機
summary: AI浪潮席捲全球，台股、韓股屢創新高，市場充斥「錯過AI就錯過財富」的氛圍。然而，這場由AI驅動的多頭行情背後，真正快速膨脹的不只是股價，還有投資人的信用與槓桿。韓國一場由去槓桿引發的股市踩踏，不僅讓無數散戶瞬間爆倉，也替台灣敲響警鐘。當房屋增貸、信貸、股票質押與槓桿商品層層交織，冰山之下究竟累積了多少看不見的風險？這場韓股風暴揭露的不只是去槓桿的代價，更是台灣「隱形槓桿鏈」的警訊。

title: 理財專題／3步驟守住投資安全線　槓桿風暴下的生存術
summary: 借錢投資，全球皆有；但台灣特殊之處，是一個投資人可能同時背著4種、甚至6種槓桿進場，每筆借貸單獨看都可能符合風控規範，一旦跨體系層層疊加，真正的總槓桿與市場曝險卻成了監理盲區。韓股踩踏已經示範，一旦市場急轉直下，最致命的是多重槓桿同時收縮。如何避免同樣情況在台灣上演？從政府建立跨體系風險監測機制，到投資人算清總槓桿、主動降槓桿並進行最壞情境壓力測試，都應該同步進行。真正的風控不是風暴來了才找退路 ，而是趁市場仍風平浪靜時先築好防線。

title_en: Zhusheng's EPS in the first half of the year was 13.31 yuan, a new high for the same period
summary_en: The board of directors of Zhusheng Technology (6739), a semiconductor intelligent system integration factory, approved the second quarter financial report of this year yesterday (10th). The cumulative consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 644 million yuan, an annual increase of 96.6%; the gross profit margin was 67. 51%, an annual increase of 3.87 percentage points; after-tax net income was 311 million yuan, an annual increase of 133.7%; net earnings per share (EPS) was 13.31 yuan, earning more than one share capital, and all four figures hit a new high for the same period.

title: 油價飆與企業發債潮夾擊，美國公債價格週一下跌

title: Anthropic取消Sonnet 5漲價50%計畫，永久鎖定每百萬Token最低2美元
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】人工智慧新創公司Anthropic週一宣布，永久保留Claude Sonnet 5今年6月推出時的優惠價格，取消原定8月底調漲50%的計畫。輸入端將維持每百萬Token收費2美元，輸出端維持10美元，不再按原規畫分別調升至3美元及15美元。Anthropic將Sonnet 5定位為旗下「最具代理能力的Sonnet模型」，可自主制訂計畫，並調用瀏覽器及終端機等工具完成複雜任務。由於程式開發、研究及瀏覽器自動化等代理型工作通常涉及多輪模型調用，成本會隨任務複雜度迅速累積，取消漲價可讓已採用Sonnet 5建立工作流程的企業取得更穩定的長期成本預期。市場另傳Anthropic即將推出內部代號「Fennec」的Claude Sonnet 5.5，上下文視窗可能擴大一倍至200萬Token，並提升推理速度與智能體能力，整體效能逼近旗艦級Fable 5，但價格仍維持Sonnet級距。若消息成真，Anthropic可能藉由效能升級但價格不變的策略，進一步爭奪企業中高階AI工作負載。此次定價調整正值Anthropic加速商業化及籌備上市之際。公司6月1日已向美國證券交易委員會(SE

title: AI需求續強 阿斯麥股價盤中上漲1.7% 台積電營收同步告捷

summary_en: Xie Sunyuan, chair professor of the Department of Information Engineering at National Cheng Kung University, has long been engaged in research in the field of forward-looking intelligent computing, covering energy-saving computing, cloud scheduling computing, fault-tolerant computing, parallel and distributed computing, and artificial intelligence. In recent years, he has further applied artificial intelligence data enhancement technology to advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes. His research results have been recognized internationally and he was awarded the 2026 European Academy of Engineering Fellowship.

title_en: Jinghua’s first half EPS was 8.62 yuan
summary_en: Jinghua (2707) held a board meeting yesterday (10th) and approved the first half financial statements. Revenue was 3.611 billion yuan, an increase of 5.11% over the same period last year. Net profit after tax was 1.099 billion yuan, an increase of 53.9% year-on-year. Net earnings per share (EPS) was 8.62 yuan. title_en: CoWoS is not the only solution? The rise of Intel EMIB-T and AI advanced packaging usher in a competition between two heroes
summary_en: The boom in AI chips has driven a surge in demand, but advanced packaging bottlenecks have also affected output, including the competition between Intel EMIB-T and TSMC (2330) CoWoS. In addition to technology, it also includes who can mass produce faster. The industry points out that the two major solutions are not technically superior. EMIB-T focuses on local silicon bridges, ultra-large packaging and vertical power supply; CoWoS has advantages in wiring density, mass production experience and a complete 3D packaging ecosystem. At this stage, it is more like a technical route to meet different chip design and production capacity needs.

Although the announcement is coming to an end, the CPO-related stocks LUMENTUM and COHERENT that Taiwanese stocks are paying attention to will announce their results this week. It can be expected that supply will exceed demand and will be positive, but the stock prices have already risen sharply. In the recent past, US stocks, regardless of large or small stocks, have seen most stock prices gap up and fall after the quarterly report. Check whether the same is true for CPO stocks, a popular subject. Next, Wang Huida will announce his financial report on the 26th. title_en: Taijing*-KY Pixavir's Phase III IND was approved in South Korea, and Boryung launched clinical trials to attack the influenza drug market
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by reporter He Meiru] Taijing*-KY (4157) new influenza drug reported international clinical progress, and received notification from South Korean partner Boryung Biopharma that its new influenza drug Pixavir The Phase III clinical trial license application (IND) for marboxil (BRC-201) oral capsules has been officially approved by the South Korean Ministry of Food and Drug Safety (MFDS). The Boryung team will initiate follow-up clinical trials to promote the development and commercial layout of Pixavir in the South Korean influenza antiviral drug market. In January this year, Taijing completed the South Korean development and sales rights licensing cooperation with Boryung Biopharma of South Korea. The two parties quickly promoted clinical development after the cooperation, and now they have obtained phase III clinical trial approval from the South Korean competent authority, which shows the speed of both parties' advancement in clinical execution and regulatory applications. With the official launch of the Phase III trial, Pixavir's South Korean market development has entered the substantial clinical verification stage. If the subsequent trial is successfully completed and the drug certificate is obtained, it will further strengthen the overseas licensing layout of Taijing's new influenza drug. The approved Phase III clinical trial is a multi-center, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, which mainly evaluates the efficacy and safety of Pixavir in adult and adolescent patients with acute uncomplicated influenza. The main indicators of the trial include the time to relieve influenza symptoms, and simultaneously evaluate the antiviral effect, clinical recovery, and the ability to reduce influenza-related complications. title_en: Taiwan’s richest man has been replaced! Chuanhu Lin Chongji's net worth is US$16.7 billion, overtaking the giant Chen Taiming
summary_en: Lin Congji, chairman of Chuanhu Technology, a major artificial intelligence (AI) server slide manufacturer, overtook Yageo chairman Chen Taiming and became the new richest man in Taiwan. According to the real-time rich list updated by Forbes on the 10th, Lin Chongji's personal net worth of US$16.7 billion surpassed Chen Taiming's US$16.5 billion to become the richest man in Taiwan. Lin Chongji currently ranks 173rd among the world's richest people, with his net worth increasing by US$1.1 billion in a single day, an increase of 7.1%.

title: 佳世達Q3業績有望優於Q2，深化AI四大布局，Q4 AI產品小量出貨
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】佳世達(2352)第二季業績回溫，展望下半年營運，董事長陳其宏表示，目前所見景氣能見度，第三季營收與獲利有望優於前一季，期望第四季眾多AI新產品能順利小量出貨，2027年進而看到更顯著營收獲利貢獻，強化並轉換佳世達computing power賽道。另外，通常資通訊產業業績落在下半年，今年情況符合過往走勢發展。他進一步說明，佳世達已將AI納入核心成長策略，持續深化四大AI布局，發揮技術整合與場域應用優勢，掌握市場機會，尤其第四季許多AI產品出貨，對佳世達轉換賽道並強化AI佈局具有非常重要的策略意義。另外，過去佳世達在 400G、800G頻寬無法取得資料中心市場，期望藉由最新的1.6T高速交換器能夠「後發先至」打入市場。佳世達表示，智能方案事業受惠企業加速導入AI服務、邊緣AI與機器人自動化需求，營收連兩季突破100億元，第二季營收較去年同期成長19%，創單季新高。總經理柯淑芬表示，佳世達目標不只是賣產品，而是提供完整的AI垂直整合服務。持續聚焦｢AI視覺與顯示｣、｢AI基礎設施｣、｢AI解決方案與智慧製造｣，以及｢AI醫療與健康照護｣四大布局，強化跨事業協作

title_en: Qisda’s Q3 performance is expected to be better than Q2, deepening the four major AI layouts, and shipping Q4 AI products in small quantities
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Qisda (2352)'s second-quarter performance has recovered, and looking forward to operations in the second half of the year, Chairman Chen Qihong said that with the current boom visibility, third-quarter revenue and profits are expected to be better than the previous quarter. He hopes that many new AI products will be shipped smoothly in small quantities in the fourth quarter, and will see more significant revenue and profit contributions in 2027, strengthening and transforming Qisda's computing power track. In addition, the performance of the information and communications industry usually falls in the second half of the year, and this year's situation is in line with past trends. He further explained that Qisda has incorporated AI into its core growth strategy, continues to deepen its four major AI layouts, leverages its advantages in technology integration and field application, and seizes market opportunities. Especially the shipment of many AI products in the fourth quarter has very important strategic significance for Qisda to change its track and strengthen its AI layout. In addition, in the past, Qisda was unable to obtain the data center market with 400G and 800G bandwidth, and hopes to enter the market on a "last-come, first-served basis" with the latest 1.6T high-speed switch. Qisda stated that the smart solutions business has benefited companies from accelerating the introduction of AI services, edge AI and robot automation needs, with revenue exceeding 10 billion yuan for two consecutive quarters. Revenue in the second quarter increased by 19% compared with the same period last year, setting a new single-quarter high. General Manager Ke Shufen said that Qisda’s goal is not just to sell products, but to provide complete AI vertical integration services. Continue to focus on the four major layouts of "AI vision and display", "AI infrastructure", "AI solutions and smart manufacturing", and "AI medical and health care" to strengthen cross-business collaboration

title: 儲能事業轉型發酵，桓鼎-KY 7月營收2.74億元，改寫歷年同期次高
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】桓鼎-KY(5543)公布7月合併營收2.74億元，月增14.45%、年增0.21%，寫下歷年同期次高表現；累計前7月合併營收19.15億元，較去年同期成長4.21%。桓鼎表示，7月營收較上月明顯回升，主要受惠電池模組及儲能相關應用需求持續發酵，加上集團營運結構持續朝高附加價值業務優化，帶動單月營收成長表現。桓鼎指出，集團已完成處分中國金屬建材業務，7月已無中國金屬建材業務營收貢獻，惟單月營收仍較去年同期成長，顯示集團業務結構調整效益逐步浮現，旗下儲能事業轉型已成為支撐營運成長的重要動能，其中旗下電池模組業務受惠低軌衛星、智慧穿戴裝置、醫療儀器及儲能系統等多元應用出貨成長，帶動整體營運結構朝高附加價值業務持續優化。桓鼎於儲能事業佈局透過電池資源整合、模組設計、能源管理及終端應用能力，提供客戶產品設計、系統整合、認證及場域落地等一站式服務，逐步建立集團在儲能價值鏈中的垂直整合優勢，除電池模組銷售外，旗下B.E.S.T儲能牆系統採薄型、模組化設計，可結合太陽能、EV充電及能源管理系統，可提升用電彈性、降低尖峰用電壓力，並強化備援電力與電網韌性，同步持續推進商業化

title_en: The transformation of the energy storage business is fermenting. Huanding-KY’s revenue in July was 274 million yuan, which was the second highest in the same period in previous years.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Huanding-KY (5543) announced that its consolidated revenue in July was 274 million yuan, a monthly increase of 14.45% and an annual increase of 0.21%, marking the second-highest performance in the same period in previous years; the cumulative consolidated revenue in the first seven months was 1.915 billion yuan, an increase of 4.21% over the same period last year. Huan Ding said that revenue in July rebounded significantly from the previous month, mainly due to the continued fermentation of demand for battery modules and energy storage-related applications, and the continued optimization of the group's operating structure towards high value-added businesses, driving single-month revenue growth. Huan Ding pointed out that the group has completed the disposal of China's metal building materials business. There is no revenue contribution from China's metal building materials business in July. However, the single-month revenue is still higher than the same period last year, which shows that the benefits of the group's business structure adjustment are gradually emerging. The transformation of its energy storage business has become an important driving force to support operational growth. Among them, its battery module business has benefited from the growth of shipments of multiple applications such as low-orbit satellites, smart wearable devices, medical instruments and energy storage systems, driving the overall operating structure to continue to optimize towards high value-added businesses. Huanding's energy storage business layout provides customers with one-stop services such as product design, system integration, certification and field implementation through battery resource integration, module design, energy management and terminal application capabilities, gradually establishing the group's vertical integration advantages in the energy storage value chain, in addition to batteries In addition to module sales, its B.E.S.T energy storage wall system adopts a thin, modular design and can be combined with solar energy, EV charging and energy management systems to improve power consumption flexibility, reduce peak power demand pressure, and strengthen backup power and grid resilience, simultaneously and continuously promote commercialization.

title_en: Integrating four key technologies, Supreme officially enters the field of AI infrastructure
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Semiconductor distributor Supreme (8112) announced that it will further integrate key AI infrastructure technologies such as cooling, power supply and monitoring based on its existing memory and storage product advantages, and officially enter the AI ​​data center infrastructure market. Supreme said that in the future, in addition to providing a complete product line, it will also combine services such as pre-sales selection, introduction evaluation, testing and verification, and after-sales technical support to help enterprises complete data center construction and maintenance more efficiently. Zhi Shang pointed out that it has been observed that enterprises’ expectations for partners have shifted from pure product supply to seeking allies with technical support, resource integration and introduction planning capabilities. This has also become the core opportunity for Supreme to enter the field of infrastructure this time. We hope to gather original resources and technical energy to become the most trustworthy strategic partner for enterprises to build a new generation of AI data centers. Supreme gradually expands its AI infrastructure layout and builds complete solutions covering memory, cooling, power and monitoring. In the field of memory and storage, we continue to use Samsung-related products to support the high-speed memory architecture required for large language models and high-density computing; in the field of heat dissipation and thermal management, we integrate thermal management products such as Castrol coolant, Motivair by Schneider Electric liquid cooling solutions, and Emerson fluid control solutions. As for the power and monitoring field, Schneider Electric uninterruptible power supply systems, rack-mounted power distributors and monitoring management solutions are combined to improve supply.

title: 晶呈科技7月營收1.05億元、月減3.33%，H2有望重返獲利軌道、由虧轉盈
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】半導體特殊氣體廠晶呈科技(4768)公布7月合併營收1.05億元，月減3.33%、年增79.01%；累計前7月合併營收9.26億元、年增131.97%。晶呈表示，單月營收較前月略減，係因外銷市場出貨稍減，但內銷市場出貨較前月增加。晶呈上半年受到雷射氣體價格大幅下滑、玻璃穿孔（TGV）技術大量送樣及研發費用投入影響，第二季歸屬母公司業主淨損1,974萬元，每股淨損0.58元；上半年歸屬母公司業主淨損4,723萬元，每股淨損0.99元。法人指出，由於AI對記憶體的強勁需求帶動，NAND原廠產能利用率持續保持滿載，客戶回補庫存態度積極；而記憶體堆疊層數顯著增加，大幅推升了關鍵特殊氣體C4F6的消耗量，使得晶呈C4F6產能早已被預訂一空，預估全年出貨量將突破120噸。雖然現階段C4F6仍屬於毛利率較低的二級純化製造，但隨著第二條TGV產線進駐與剝離液（Stripper）業務呈倍數成長，預期下半年營運可望重返獲利軌道，帶動全年業績有望轉虧為盈。

title_en: Jingcheng Technology’s revenue in July was 105 million yuan, a monthly decrease of 3.33%. H2 is expected to return to the profit track and turn from loss to profit.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Semiconductor special gas factory Jingcheng Technology (4768) announced consolidated revenue of 105 million yuan in July, a monthly decrease of 3.33%, an annual increase of 79.01%; the cumulative consolidated revenue in the first seven months was 926 million yuan, an annual increase of 131.97%. Jingcheng said that its single-month revenue decreased slightly from the previous month due to a slight decrease in shipments to the export market, but shipments to the domestic market increased compared with the previous month. In the first half of the year, Jingcheng was affected by the sharp decline in laser gas prices, large-scale delivery of samples for glass perforation (TGV) technology, and investment in research and development expenses. In the second quarter, the net loss attributable to the owners of the parent company was 19.74 million yuan, and the net loss per share was 0.58 yuan. In the first half of the year, the net loss attributable to the owners of the parent company was 47.23 million yuan, and the net loss per share was 0.99 yuan. The legal person pointed out that due to the strong demand for memory by AI, NAND original factory capacity utilization continues to remain full, and customers are active in replenishing inventory. The number of memory stacks has increased significantly, which has greatly increased the consumption of the key special gas C4F6. As a result, Jingcheng’s C4F6 production capacity has already been booked, and the annual shipment is expected to exceed 120 tons. Although C4F6 is still a secondary purification manufacturing product with low gross profit margin at this stage, with the entry of the second TGV production line and the multiple growth of the stripper business, it is expected that operations in the second half of the year will return to the profitable track, driving the full-year performance to turn losses into profits.

title: 拉貨旺季已過，友達、群創7月營收回落
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】面板大廠友達(2409)、群創(3481)相繼公布7月業績，隨著面板上半年拉貨旺季已過，兩大面板廠7月營收回落，由於下半年訂單能見度偏低，法人預期受供給端零組件成本與終端售價調漲影響，下半年面板產業恐面臨衰退。友達7月合併營收203.7億元，月減18.36%、年減2.64%；累計前7月合併營收1,602.93億元、年減1.21%。群創公布7月合併營收188.9億元，月減12.96%、年減1.94%；累計前7月合併營收1,492.34億元、年增13.55%。研調機構TrendForce指出，8月面板市場需求節奏逐漸出現變化，電視面板因品牌客戶啟動年底旺季備貨，帶動需求動能回溫，使價格跌幅明顯收斂；顯示器與筆電面板則在需求相對平緩及成本壓力支撐下，價格維持全面持平格局。友達先前法說會亦預期第三季智慧移動營收與上季持平，垂直場域營收較上季有個位數成長，面板顯示營收則較上季微幅減少。法人指出，LCD面板市場正式由第二季的價格持穩轉為第三季下跌，尤其TV面板報價全面下滑，將直接影響面板廠的獲利表現現。

title_en: The peak season for buying goods has passed, and AUO and Innolux’s July revenue declined
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Zhang Jiawei] Panel manufacturers AUO (2409) and Innolux (3481) have successively announced their July results. As the peak season for panels in the first half of the year has passed, the revenue of the two major panel manufacturers fell in July. Due to low order visibility in the second half of the year, legal entities expect that due to the increase in supply-side component costs and terminal selling prices, the panel industry may face a recession in the second half of the year. AUO's consolidated revenue in July was 20.37 billion yuan, a monthly decrease of 18.36% and an annual decrease of 2.64%; the cumulative consolidated revenue for the first seven months was 160.293 billion yuan, an annual decrease of 1.21%. Innolux announced that its consolidated revenue in July was 18.89 billion yuan, a monthly decrease of 12.96% and an annual decrease of 1.94%; the cumulative consolidated revenue for the first seven months was 149.234 billion yuan, an annual increase of 13.55%. TrendForce, a research institute, pointed out that the demand rhythm of the panel market gradually changed in August. For TV panels, brand customers started stocking up for the peak season at the end of the year, which led to a recovery in demand momentum and significantly restrained price declines. Supported by relatively flat demand and cost pressures, prices for monitors and notebook panels remained flat across the board. AUO's previous press conference also expected that smart mobile revenue in the third quarter would be the same as the previous quarter, vertical field revenue would increase by single digits compared with the previous quarter, and panel display revenue would decrease slightly compared with the previous quarter. The legal person pointed out that the LCD panel market has officially changed from stable prices in the second quarter to falling in the third quarter. In particular, TV panel quotations have fallen across the board, which will directly affect the profit performance of panel manufacturers.

title_en: The bicycle market is recovering, with Huge’s July revenue increasing by 12.8% year-on-year, reaching a high of 11 months at Merida Station
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reporter Chen Haoning] With the European and Chinese markets recovering, Juju (9921)’s revenue in July was 5.758 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 12.8%; the cumulative revenue in the first seven months was 34.946 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 7.4%. Merida (9914)'s revenue in July reached a high point in the past 11 months; the cumulative revenue for the first seven months was 14.811 billion yuan, an annual decrease of 13%, and the annual decrease has continued to narrow. Huge said that in terms of its own brand business, in July, driven by the continued growth of the European market and favorable conversion rates, the overall revenue increased by more than 10% year-on-year. The European market benefited from the sales performance driven by the launch of new products, with single-month revenue increasing by nearly 20% year-on-year. Among them, the United Kingdom and the Netherlands performed well, with growth of nearly 30%. After the Chinese market converted to Taiwan dollars, single-month revenue increased by more than 10% year-on-year, and demand remained stable. However, the U.S. market continued to be affected by the WRO incident and the war in Iran affected consumer confidence, resulting in a decline in single-month revenue. In terms of OEM business, Huge also mentioned that the monthly revenue performance in July increased by 8% compared with both the previous month and the same period last year. This mainly came from the continuous shipment of vehicle orders in the new year, indicating that the momentum of customer demand for goods has steadily recovered. Merida's revenue in July was 2.456 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 1%. Among them, the Taiwan factory shipped 27,100 units in July, a year-on-year decrease of 22%; the overall shipments in July were 133,200 units, a year-on-year decrease of 3%; the cumulative revenue for the first seven months was 14.811 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 13%. Among them, the Taiwan factory shipped a total of 162,700 units, a year-on-year decrease of 21%, and the cumulative overall shipments were 680,100 units.

title: 遞延需求逐步回補，沛波7月營收創今年單月次高
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】鋼筋加工與配送通路廠沛波(6248)公布7月合併營收6.29億元，月增10.26%、年增9.24%；累計前7月合併營收37.39億元、年減19.07%。總經理黃霈櫻表示，隨著部分營建工程進度推進，遞延之拉貨需求逐步回補，帶動7月營收較去年同期及上月均呈成長，並創今年單月營收次高紀錄。黃霈櫻指出，隨時序進入第三季鋼市傳統淡季，氣候因素可能影響部分工程施工進度及用鋼需求，惟相關需求屬遞延性質，目前訂單仍具一定能見度，後續營運可望隨工程進度推進逐步反映。沛波目前接單需求維持穩定，科技建廠、商辦及公共工程等相關建築用鋼筋需求仍維持基本水準，將持續提升加工配送效率，發揮鋼筋加工與配送服務優勢，深化與客戶合作關係，配合客戶工程進度彈性安排出貨，穩健推動後續營運。

title: 億光泰國新廠動土，瞄準AI伺服器與車用市場
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】光電元件大廠億光(2393)於泰國北柳府的新製造基地正式動土興建。億光表示，泰國新廠將成為集團在東南亞最大且最先進的生產基地，其整體建置規模預計將超越現有的蘇州廠，新廠將導入高度自動化與智慧化生產線，極大化提升營運效率與產品品質穩定度。該興建工程於8月正式啟動，預計於2027下半年完工並投入量產貢獻營收。隨著全球供應鏈區域化與近岸／離岸外包（Nearshoring / Offshoring）趨勢加速，億光響應客戶「China+1」戰略及擴大東南亞製造能量，深化全球供應鏈佈局。億光表示，公司成長動能明確，其中光耦合器產品營收占比可望達到40%以上，而車用產品營收比重亦逐步提升。泰國新廠開出後，將直接提供全球車廠（OEMs）、一級供應商（Tier 1）及工控/AI伺服器客戶更具彈性且具備在地備援能力的生產鏈支持。億光強調，泰國新廠的動土是公司邁向下一個10年全球化戰略的重要根基。不僅能提升全球供應的競爭力，更透過優化成本結構與先進封裝技術，鞏固億光在全球光電半導體領域的領先地位。面對國際貿易局勢變化與地緣政治考量，億光泰國廠的設立，將協助客戶增加供應鏈的彈性與降

title: 大聯大7月營收1,460.96億元創歷史次高，電源管理與伺服器等需求強勁
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】大聯大(3702)公布7月合併營收1,460.96億元，月減24.27%、年增90.83%，為歷史單月營收次高，僅次於上月；累計前7月合併營收9,208.74億元、年增59.92%。大聯大表示，除了電源管理、伺服器、網通設備、儲能系統及高密度連接元件展現強勁拉貨動能，車用電子與工業控制需求亦穩步推進。隨著全球科技產業與下游客戶加速推進科技升級與能源基礎設施建置，強勁的企業資本支出帶動半導體及電子零組件的廣泛拉貨動能。此外，智能倉儲管理與資訊系統整合等高附加價值服務需求同步擴增；各市場多元終端應用與軟硬體服務的雙軌並進，為大聯大營運挹注穩健且具持續性的結構性成長動能。研調機構TrendForce預估，2026年全球九大CSP資本支出預估8300億美元，年增率由原本的61%提升至79%。AI浪潮推升AI伺服器、通用伺服器、高效能儲存、高速互連、記憶體、電源管理以及網通零組件等強勁拉貨動能。在終端客戶持續上修資本支出，大聯大下半年在AI伺服器與相關運算產品的業務持續暢旺，將推動業績維持在高檔。法人指出，AI基礎建設的強勁建置需求將成為推動大聯大的核心引擎，其成長力

title: 熙特爾-創上半年每股盈餘5.8元，揮軍美澳加速海外布局
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】熙特爾新能源-創(7740)公布上半年每股盈餘達5.8元，自結7月營收9.24億元、年增1528.78%，董事會也決議將發行12億元CB，並進軍澳洲市場，以加速推進海外市場，全面開展新一波成長攻勢。此外，董事會也決議通過改列一般板上市規劃。熙特爾表示，受惠於大型案場工程持續推進，以及電池模組出貨逐步發力，累計今年上半年合併營收達72.74億元，較去年同期大幅成長約1508%，創歷史新高，稅後淨利3.48億元，每股盈餘達5.8元。展望下半年，自結7月營收達9.24億元、年增1528.78%，推升前7月營收近82億元，直逼去年全年營收42.21億元的兩倍，呈現大幅跳躍爆發式成長。在營運表現持續創高之際，熙特爾因應AI能源基礎設施及全球業務拓展蓄積動能。董事會擬規劃辦理12億元國內第一次無擔保轉換公司債，發行期間3年，用於充實營運資金及償還銀行借款，進一步優化公司資本結構並提升中長期營運彈性。熙特爾也加速推進海外市場拓展，繼今年上半年成功取得美國首筆訂單、正式插旗北美市場後，將進一步展開美國市場布局，結合自身儲能系統整合能力與技術優勢，推動北美市場走向規模化發展。

title: 文曄7月營收1,830億元、年增94.85%，估H2整體業績優於H1
summary: 【財訊快報／記者張家瑋報導】電子元件通路商文曄(3036)公布7月合併營收1,829.66億元，月增0.67%、年增94.85%；累計前7月合併營收1.27兆元、年增111.03%。由於資料中心出貨節奏調整，文曄預期第三季營收與上季持平或微幅成長，但整體下半年表現將優於上半年。文曄預期第三季資料中心與伺服器受供貨排程影響，營收預計季減低個位數百分比，但年對年仍呈現倍數成長，下半年需求優於上半年。手機進入傳統旺季，預計第三季營收將季增高雙位數百分比。通訊出貨維持高檔，預計季增雙位數百分比，年增呈倍數成長。第三季工業與儀器預計季增個位數百分比，年增趨勢依然強勁。車用電子受到暑休等季節性因素影響，預計營收將季減中低個位數百分比。消費性電子因前兩季已拉貨，預計第三季營收將季減雙位數百分比。PC因上半年提前拉貨，第三季營收預計季減個位數百分比。文曄預估第三季合併營收中位數約為5,920億元、年增80%；營業利益預估中位數約140.4億元、年增148%；歸屬於母公司業主淨利預估中位數約101.7億元、年增167%；每股盈餘8.03元、年增136%。

title_en: Political Yuan: The first mobile network slowdown drill was successfully completed and various backup communications were activated immediately
summary_en: In conjunction with the "2026 Urban Resilience (Air Defense) Exercise", my country's first mobile communication network speed-down exercise was conducted in seven central counties and cities including Taichung City, Miaoli County, Nantou County, Changhua County, Yunlin County, Chiayi City and Chiayi County from 2:30 to 3:00 pm on the 10th. The Executive Yuan opened an inter-ministerial emergency response center at the Taipei Station Joint Disaster Prevention Center at 10 a.m., with Administrative Councilor Ji Liancheng as the commander. It integrates central ministries and committees and has real-time video contact with local governments to control communications, police, medical, transportation, finance and people's livelihood. Service operation status; after the drill, all local governments and relevant ministries immediately confirmed the operation of the communication system and various functions. The overall drill was successfully completed at 3 p.m., and the relevant systems returned to normal. The inter-ministerial response center was removed after completing its task at 3:20 p.m.

title: 富人消費占消金收入56%
summary: 受惠股市創新高，高資產客群規模持續擴大，萬事達卡全球報告指出，富裕族群消費動能占銀行消費金融業務收入高達56%，每卡平均消費為一般消費者的2.3倍，跨國消費與非必需品支出更達三倍與4.3倍。而年消費逾300萬元的頂級持卡人，前三大消費類別為百貨購物、旅遊規劃及保險，合計突破五成，其中保險支出反映其對保障與資產傳承的積極布局。

title_en: Prices of well-known canned nutritional supplements will increase starting in September. Pharmacist: As expected, economic pressure will become heavier
summary_en: Taiwan has entered a super-aging society, and more and more elders are tube-fed and need nutritional supplements for a long time. However, with inflation and rising prices, the well-known domestic tube-fed nutrition products, Aperamin canned water and Puxena bottled water, are expected to adjust their prices in September. Grassroots pharmacists said that with all things going up, it was expected that the price of Abbott Nutritional Products would increase. For office workers with elders at home, or those who need tube feeding for family members, the financial pressure is even heavier.

title_en: Want to lose weight quickly through surgery? Medical checks before surgery: gastroscopy, cardiopulmonary function, and mental assessment are indispensable
summary_en: Wang Mingyu, a well-known bariatric doctor at Antai Hospital in Kaohsiung, was involved in an incident last year where two female patients died within 10 days of undergoing gastrointestinal surgery. After an investigation by the Kaohsiung City Health Bureau, the Medical Punishment Commission decided to revoke his license. The Ministry of Health and Welfare recently released a special investigation report, pointing out that the main reasons are the lax standards for identifying indications for bariatric surgery by surgeons, insufficient surgical risk assessment, and the low alertness and emergency response capabilities of the medical team for postoperative care.

title: 製鞋大廠鈺齊、來億、中傑7月營收同步年月雙增 寶成也月增
summary: 製鞋產業景氣回溫，包括鈺齊-KY（9802）、來億-KY（6890）及中傑-KY（6965）三家製鞋大廠，7月營收都呈現年月雙增走勢，全球製鞋龍頭寶成（9904）7月營收雖較去年同期略減0.6%，但與上月比較成長3.2%。法人說，品牌客戶下單逐步回穩，下半年營運可望優於上半年。
title_zh: 製鞋大廠鈺齊、來億、中傑7月營收同步年月雙增 寶成也月增
summary_zh: 製鞋產業景氣回溫，包括鈺齊-KY（9802）、來億-KY（6890）及中傑-KY（6965）三家製鞋大廠，7月營收都呈現年月雙增走勢，全球製鞋龍頭寶成（9904）7月營收雖較去年同期略減0.6%，但與上月比較成長3.2%。法人說，品牌客戶下單逐步回穩，下半年營運可望優於上半年。
title_en: The revenue of major shoe manufacturers Yuqi, Laiyi and Zhongjie increased simultaneously in July, and Baocheng also increased monthly.
summary_en: The shoemaking industry is recovering, including Yuqi-KY (9802), Laiyi-KY (6890) and Zhongjie-KY (6965). The revenue in July showed a double-year increase. The global shoemaking leader Baocheng (9904), although its revenue in July decreased slightly by 0.6% compared with the same period last year, it increased by 3.2% compared with the previous month. The legal person said that orders from brand customers have gradually stabilized, and operations in the second half of the year are expected to be better than those in the first half.

title_en: Is it too early to reopen the Strait of Hormuz? All four major U.S. stock indexes closed in the black, with the Nasdaq falling 362 points and the Nasdaq falling 85 points.
summary_en: U.S. President Trump has recently put forward new conditions for U.S.-Iran relations, requiring that future peace negotiations must include Iran's war compensation clauses. This move has further stalled the U.S.-Iran negotiations to end the war and open the Strait of Hormuz, significantly reducing the possibility of reaching an agreement in the short term. Affected by geopolitical tensions and market concerns, all four major U.S. stock indexes closed down on Monday. The Dow Jones fell more than 60 points, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell nearly 3%, a drop of 362 points. Technology stocks performed weakly, and the market continued to pay attention to the volatile impact of subsequent diplomatic developments on global financial markets.

In the face of market fluctuations, they should still carefully assess the risks of holding shares and pay attention to changes in market chips to facilitate subsequent investment layout planning.

title_en: The Federation of Finance and Economics recommends: postpone tax cuts for 10 years and restart special laws on overseas funds
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 10th) This year’s financial advice white paper interim report of the Federation of Financial Services has been released. It is recommended that the current securities tax rate of 1.5% per thousand for listed counters should be extended for another 10 years to the end of the Republic of China. In order to attract funds back to Taiwan and achieve the goal of an Asian capital center, it is recommended to restart the Special Law 2.0 for overseas funds to return to Taiwan to provide more favorable tax incentives.

title_en: Are active ETFs turning into dark cards? Shareholders question 0050’s lagging performance! He is optimistic about the turnaround of optical communications
summary_en: The volatility of Taiwan's stock market intensified, and some investors used tens of millions of dollars in leverage to place large bets on the company's losses, arousing market attention. Analyst Lin Changxing reminded that if a single bet on high-priced stocks is locked up, the retracement may take many years. It is recommended to change your mind appropriately and shift capital allocation to leveraged ETFs with clean chips or targets with rebound potential. For active ETFs, it is recommended to observe the maximum retracement range and recovery ability, and pay attention to anti-fall stocks that are deployed in sync with foreign capital. Chao Ma Guale recommends investors to use 0050 as the core position and operate flexibly with active ETFs to balance asset risks and capture excess returns. In addition, when selecting high-dividend ETFs, be sure to clarify the source of dividend distribution to ensure that profits are pocketed. The investment market is changing rapidly. People should carefully assess risks and avoid blindly leveraging. Investment decisions still need to be made within their capabilities to ensure a healthy and sound asset allocation.

title_en: Taiwan’s richest man has been replaced! Chuanhu Lin Congji's net worth soared past 500 billion, edging out the giant Chen Taiming to take the throne
summary_en: According to the latest real-time rich list of "Forbes", the title of Taiwan's richest man has officially changed hands. Lin Congji, chairman of server slide manufacturer Chuanhu Technology, topped the list with a net worth of US$16.7 billion. Thanks to the strong demand for AI servers, Chuanhu's stock price has soared recently, becoming a rare millionaire stock in the history of Taiwanese stocks. Lin Congji's net worth surged by US$1.1 billion in a single day, surpassing Yageo Chairman Chen Taiming and Hon Hai founder Terry Gou. With its high-end slide rail technology and amazing profitability, Chuanhu's after-tax net profit in the first half of the year increased by 237% year-on-year, and its gross profit margin exceeded 87%. From a humble components manufacturer to a benchmark company on the Taiwan stock market, Lin Chongji’s legend of getting rich not only shocked the market, but also highlighted the indispensable key position of Taiwanese manufacturers in the AI ​​supply chain, making it the most talked-about topic in the Taiwan stock market recently.

title_en: A 71-year-old couple earned 250,000 a month and moved into the mountains to realize their dream. Five years later, they fell and discovered the horrifying truth.
summary_en: The 71-year-old Masashi couple sold their house five years ago to realize their dream and moved to Toten in the mountains to enjoy their retirement life. However, a heavy snowfall hampered their driving, making it difficult to buy groceries and traffic was paralyzed. According to a survey by Japan's Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, the number of "those who have difficulty buying food" in Japan has exceeded 9 million. Aging and shrinking transportation have become serious challenges. Although their pension can still support their lives, facing high expenses such as car maintenance and repairs, Zhengzhi and his wife finally chose to sell their house and return to the city, moving into a convenient apartment within walking distance of supermarkets and hospitals. This case highlights the need for elderly retired people to take long-term considerations into consideration when planning their residences, such as health changes and transportation convenience, to avoid falling into the dilemma of being isolated and helpless. Only pragmatic planning can ensure the safety and dignity of life in their later years.

title: 兆基集團吸金爆雷，拉「包租代管」陪葬…20萬戶社宅運作藏偏失！李同榮：背後有「致命三刀」
summary: 兆基屋管事件，引發社會對社會住宅包租代管制度的高度關注。房市趨勢專家李同榮認為，兆基事件大家焦點都放在公司治理，卻忽略這是長期社宅政策失靈的引信，政府在一昧追究業者責任的同時，卻忘了反省與重新檢視長期社宅與租賃政策所累積的結構性問題，政策的背後存在著「致命3刀」。 他指出，兆基事件最終涉及哪些法律責任，應由司法釐清；房東、房客是否實質受損，也應以後續事實判斷。但是，司法責任尚待釐清，不代表政策責任不必現在檢討。 李同榮說，政府不能每次出事就急著與個別企業切割，也不能因一家企業出事，就讓整個包租代管產業陪葬。
