Benefiting from the global AI application boom, demand for terminal replacements has emerged. Desktop products have performed well, with cumulative revenue increasing by 36.7% year-on-year. In addition, the commercial products and PC business grew strongly, and the non-computer business contributed 35.1%. Acer has successfully promoted its transformation into an all-round life technology group through its Little Golden Chicken Group layout, laying a strong foundation for peak season operations in the second half of the year.

title_en: When the stock market fluctuates, funds are transferred to the housing market? Real Estate Agent: Share-to-share transfer is available but only for certain ethnic groups
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market fluctuated violently in July. The index once hit its largest drop in history, and then saw its largest rise in history. The market is concerned about whether it will drive funds from the stock market to the real estate market. Real estate agents have observed that recently, some people with relatively strong assets have indeed transferred their funds into the real estate market after taking profits in the stock market. However, the overall impact is still mild, and there has not been a large-scale "stock-for-housing" boom. The number of transferred buildings in Liuzhou in July has been released, totaling about 20,500 buildings. It has grown for three consecutive months, with a monthly increase of 12% and an annual increase of 8.8%. It shows that after the central bank's mortgage loan measures were slightly relaxed, the housing market has shown signs of bottoming out. Chen Dingzhong, senior manager of the Taiwan Housing Trend Center, said in an interview with CTV News that the recent fluctuations in Taiwan's stock market have far exceeded those in the past. They may plunge thousands of points in a week and rebound quickly in a few days. If investors want to sell stocks and enter the housing market, they have to face the "T+2" time difference in stock delivery. Often, by the time the funds are in place, the stock market has rebounded sharply, so it is difficult for ordinary retail investors to change their asset allocation due to short-term fluctuations. Chen Dingzhong pointed out that those who have the ability to flexibly adjust assets between stocks and houses are mostly those with assets of more than 10 million yuan and large stock market holdings, especially buyers who want to exchange houses with a total price of about NT$30 million to NT$50 million. Under the recent stock market turbulence, it is indeed seen that some people choose to take profits and then move into the real estate market. He said: "(Original sound) In fact, this month, for products with a total price of about 30 million to 50 million yuan, corresponding to the relatively wealthy middle class with a net worth of about 10 million to 100 million yuan, the stock market has fluctuated.

title_en: Cash, time deposits, and bank deposits are the most dangerous in the long run! It is recommended to prepare cash requirements for six months to one year, and invest the remaining two
summary_en: Financial management is proactive. You need to understand your own financial situation and risk tolerance, and actively formulate spending plans and investment goals and strategies. The main task of financial planning is capital allocation, determining the proportion of funds allocated in risk-free assets and risky assets, and minimizing the tax burden within the legal scope. Risk-free assets include cash, time deposits, bank deposits and U.S. Treasury bills, and risky assets include risky fixed-income securities (i.e. bonds), stocks and real estate. Bonds include domestic and foreign long-term and short-term government bonds and corporate bonds, and stocks include stocks of domestic and foreign companies.

title_en: Win! Xie Jinhe's "2 key figures" slap the naysayers in the face: China is more dependent on Taiwan
summary_en: Xie Jinhe, chairman of Caixin Media, recently pointed out that Taiwan's economic growth rate in the first half of the year reached 13.72%, setting a new high in half a century and performing far better than China and South Korea. Xie Jinhe emphasized that data shows that Taiwan’s economy is strong, especially with its advantages in the semiconductor industry, while China is more dependent on Taiwan. As the export structure changes, Taiwan's exports to the United States have risen to 32%, while exports to China and Hong Kong have dropped significantly, indicating that Taiwan's industries are actively deploying the United States and the new southbound market. Faced with South Korea's trade deficit and geopolitical challenges, Xie Jinhe believes that the government should make good use of industrial bargaining chips, continue to optimize export layout, and refute the long-term negative remarks about Taiwan's economy, confirming that Taiwan still occupies a key and irreplaceable position in the global supply chain.

title_en: Not taking shortcuts? ByteDance founder: Open source model refuses distillation
summary_en: The AI ​​competition between China and the United States is heating up. Although last Friday (July 31) soared by 3,186 points, the highest in history, Taiwanese stocks continued to rise by 266 points on Monday (August 3) despite the heavy losses of Japanese and Korean stocks. This magazine interviewed industry heavyweights and people in the investment circle. They generally believe that this major correction is beneficial to Taiwan stocks. Although there is a lot of noise in the AI ​​market, it has not turned into a bubble. "The next stock selection strategy must focus on the future tense of looking at the long-term prospects and returning to the present tense of taking orders and making good profits." Investment experts suggest.

summary_en: Low-orbit satellites have entered a period of rapid deployment. Leveraging its leading position in microwave and millimeter-wave components, Sundaco has benefited from the SpaceX V3 satellite specification upgrade and Amazon's follow-up orders. Although revenue was affected by customer product revisions in the second quarter, net earnings per share still reached 4.47 yuan, and revenue is expected to recover in the third quarter. title_en: Attention shareholders! Sanshang Meibang will be delisted and suspended from trading on "this day", and there are still 252 large traders
summary_en: A major merger and acquisition in the financial sector has been finalized! The Financial Supervisory Commission has officially approved Yushan Financial Holdings' acquisition of Sanshang Life Insurance. The two parties are expected to complete the share conversion on September 1, at which time Sanshang Life will be officially delisted and renamed Yushan Life. According to the latest announcement, every common share of Sanshangshou was exchanged for 0.2596 shares of Yushan Gold. The last trading day of the stock is scheduled for August 19. After the completion of this merger, Sanshangshou will become a 100%-owned subsidiary of Yushan Gold. The assets of Yushan Financial Holding are expected to exceed 6.53 trillion yuan, making it the fifth largest listed financial holding company in China. Although Sanshang Life will enter history, officials emphasize that the protection rights of existing policyholders will be fully continued and will not be affected by the merger. Current CHEP data shows that there are still 252 large shareholders who hold more than 1,000 shares and need to pay attention to the follow-up share exchange schedule to ensure their own rights and interests.

title_en: Taiwan's famous restaurants/good food and beautiful scenery, "meal" is exquisite
summary_en: The catering industry relies on copying to make big money, but Wei Xingyi, CEO of Maye Catering Group, who has been in the industry for more than 30 years, likes to create new brands. Every time she makes a move, she creates a buzz. Among them, the Japanese no-menu restaurant "Feihua Luoyuan", which took 10 years to create on Taichung's Xinshe Mountain, is the most famous. The year after its opening, it was selected as a Michelin-selected restaurant. Chanel and DIOR both came here to hold VIP dinners. Wei Xingyi started her career as a bar girl at the age of 17 and was very mobile. She once worked three meals a day. After accumulating a fortune, she quickly spotted the trend and started her own business. She successively opened 12 types of catering such as French cuisine, teahouses, and barbecue restaurants in central Taiwan. After eliminating the weak and retaining the strong, she now owns 4 brands, with an annual revenue of more than 100 million yuan. The process of creating a new brand from "zero to one" is her motivation, as well as looking for the next opportunity.

title_en: Don't get confused! What’s the difference between house tax and land value tax and the self-occupancy regulations? Don’t think that having registered will give you discounts
summary_en: Don’t confuse the house tax and land price tax with owner-occupancy discounts! After the new housing tax 2.0 system came into effect, many people thought that as long as the house had a household registration and was not rented or operated, they would be able to enjoy both house tax and land value tax benefits for self-occupation. In fact, the two are different in terms of applicable conditions, household limit, area, application period and tax base date, and applications must be submitted separately and approved before the preferential tax rate can be applied.

title: 台電虧損擴大 外界關注電價恐漲
summary: 美伊戰爭開打後，能源價格疾速飆漲，中油四月、五月、八月調漲國內天然氣價格，使得天然氣發電占比將近五成的台電，承受燃料成本大增的經營壓力。根據最新財報，台電今年上半年虧損擴大至二五七億元，六月單月虧損高達一一三億元，費率較高的夏月電價，也無法避免六月的虧損擴大。

title_en: Taipower's losses expand, and outsiders are concerned that electricity prices may rise
summary_en: After the start of the U.S.-Iraq war, energy prices soared rapidly. PetroChina increased domestic natural gas prices in April, May, and August, putting Taipower, which accounts for nearly 50% of its power generation with natural gas, under operating pressure from increased fuel costs. According to the latest financial report, Taipower's losses expanded to NT$25.7 billion in the first half of this year, and its losses in June reached NT$11.3 billion. The higher summer electricity prices cannot avoid the expansion of losses in June.

title_en: Video/The white dolphin has not yet arrived at the Miaokou Night Market on Aisi Road, Keelung, and the night market is flooded. Store owners complain...the road is closed for drainage.
summary_en: Typhoon White Dolphin is approaching the waters of Beitai. Strong winds will blow in Keelung tonight, but the rain will not be heavy. The Tianliao River connecting Keelung Port will rise tonight due to high tides, causing seawater intrusion. Due to the blockage of the nearby drainage system, the Keelung Miaokou Night Market on Aisi Road has been flooded. The nearly 100-meter-long section is knee-deep in water and stalls have been removed. The city government has rushed to the scene to seal the road for drainage. The road is currently flooded and impassable.

title_en: White dolphins pass through the northern sea tomorrow, 79 voyages suspended
summary_en: After the China-Taiwan white dolphin turtle quickly swept through the waters northeast of Taiwan, it will pass through the north of Taiwan today and continue to move towards China. The Meteorological Administration continues to issue maritime typhoon warnings for the northern sea and northeastern sea, and maritime traffic is also affected.

title_en: White dolphins approaching! 8 schools in mountainous areas of Hsinchu County will suspend classes tomorrow and resume work as usual
summary_en: The Central Taiwan White Dolphin is gradually approaching the sea in northern Taiwan. According to the latest forecast from the Central Meteorological Administration, rainfall in the mountainous areas of Hsinchu County will reach the suspension level tomorrow on the 9th. The Hsinchu County Government announced in the evening that Xinguang Elementary School, Shilei Elementary School, Xiuluan Elementary School, and Yufeng Elementary School in the back mountains of Jianshi Township in Hsinchu County, as well as Wufeng Elementary School, Wufeng Elementary School, Taoshan Elementary School, and Huayuan Elementary School (including Zhulin Branch) in Wufeng Township. A total of 8 schools will suspend classes tomorrow and work normally.

summary_en: Cai Shufeng, director of the Department of Nursing and Health Care of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, said at the Senior Health Exhibition today that "every family deserves to have a home nurse." Therefore, the "Call Home Nurse" platform is being studied, hoping that home nurses can gradually become the health designers of every family in the community.

title_en: Hanguang entered the anti-landing stage, President Lai Qingde went to Zuoying to inspect the sea patrol ship
summary_en: The "Hankuang 42 actual military exercise" entered its fourth day today, and the combat process entered the "joint anti-landing and coastal strike" stage. President Lai Qingde also went to Zuoying Military Port today and boarded a coast guard ship to inspect the drill. The Coast Guard stated that the circulation outside Typhoon White Dolphin did not affect the drill. The coast guard ship has completed preparations and will next conduct "joint anti-blockade escort" and other real-force drills with the national army.

summary: 白海豚颱風還沒到，雨還沒有下，基隆廟口夜市愛四路等路段今晚卻淹水大，水深及膝，店面都泡水，商家怨聲載道。市府已封路緊急排水，市府說明淹水原因，因颱風外圍環流造成基隆港潮汐滿潮超過原中央氣象署預估滿潮位海平面逾1公尺，海水倒灌到市區造成淹水。

title_en: Photo/Big fish found in Keelung Miaokou night market flooded. The city government revealed the cause: typhoon and high tide seawater intrusion
summary_en: Typhoon White Dolphin has not yet arrived, and the rain has not yet fallen. Keelung Miaokou Night Market and other sections of Aisi Road are flooded tonight. The water is knee-deep. Stores are soaked in water, and merchants are complaining. The city government has closed roads for emergency drainage. The city government explained the cause of the flooding. Due to the typhoon's peripheral circulation, the high tide in Keelung Port exceeded the original predicted high tide level of the Central Weather Bureau by more than 1 meter, and seawater poured back into the urban area, causing flooding.

title_en: Sea water poured back into Keelung Miaokou Night Market and flooded. Tong Ziwei: Strengthen flood control, drainage and water control infrastructure
summary_en: Affected by the peripheral circulation and high tide of Typhoon White Dolphin, seawater from Keelung Port poured back into the city, and many sections such as Aisi Road in Keelung Miaokou Night Market were flooded. Democratic Progressive Party mayoral candidate Speaker Tong Ziwei rushed to the scene in the evening. He said that Keelung must invest more funds in the future to strengthen flood control, drainage and water control infrastructure.

title_en: The white dolphin moves! The speed is slightly faster. It is estimated that after the landfall tomorrow night, the coast guard will be lifted on Monday morning.
summary_en: The China-Taiwan White Dolphin has been approaching Taiwan at a turtle speed of about 10 kilometers per hour. The radius of the latest reported Category 7 storm has slightly narrowed to 250 kilometers, and its moving speed has also slightly accelerated to 16 kilometers. The Meteorological Administration predicts that the overall impact will end earlier. The center of the typhoon will have a chance to make landfall tomorrow night, and the coast guard will have a chance to be lifted next Monday morning.

title_en: Retired mother remits millions to help her grandson pay for school fees! Cold rejection by son Expert: Worry about accidentally falling into the trap of gift tax regulations
summary_en: A 69-year-old grandmother in Japan, who lives alone, reluctantly agreed to deposit 1 million yen to fund her eldest grandson's tuition. Unexpectedly, her son Ryosuke's attitude was cold after receiving the money, and he even asked, "Do you want to thank me for giving the money?" This made the grandmother feel chilled. Even though my son apologized and my grandson thanked me afterwards, it was hard to get rid of all the sadness. Experts point out that for the elderly, 1 million yen is equivalent to a gap in living expenses for several years, which puts heavy financial pressure. This incident triggered social discussions on family funding and emotional feedback. Experts also reminded that if educational gifts are not clearly planned, they may involve gift tax risks. Elders should carefully evaluate their own financial situation when making donations and communicate clearly with their families about the purpose to avoid good intentions turning sour and becoming the fuse of family conflicts.

title_en: A retired man gave his wife a 1.2 million-dollar watch but was met with a cold response. This sentence made him realize that his marriage of many years was full of blind spots.
summary_en: Koichi, a 65-year-old retired man in Japan, after receiving a 29 million yen pension, spent 1.2 million yen on a famous watch as a gift to thank his wife Emi for her 35 years of hard work. Unexpectedly, the wife responded coldly, "That's not what I want." She bluntly said that for many years, she has longed for her husband's company and sharing of housework more than valuables. This post-retirement marital conflict reveals the structural problem of many couples still not adjusting the division of family roles after retirement. After a deep introspection, Koichi began to take the initiative to share household chores and pay attention to planning a life together, which made his wife feel relieved. This case reminds the public that the key to happiness after retirement does not lie in expensive material rewards, but in listening to the true inner needs of the other half. Only through daily companionship and mutual understanding can we truly manage a long and happy retirement life.

title_en: The truth behind the excessive levels of benzene and pyrene in camellia oil is unknown. The Food and Drug Administration will visit the factory for counseling. Experts suggest that the raw materials should be investigated.
summary_en: Cases of cancer-causing camellia oil have broken out one after another in China. As of today, the number of oil factories in question has reached the seventh one. In this regard, the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare plans to hold two "exchange meetings" next week in Chiayi and Yunlin, where oil factories are concentrated, and will subsequently arrange for experts to join the competent authorities to go to Kucha Oil Factory for "in-factory counseling" one by one. However, the Food and Drug Administration has not yet explained the reason why tea oil benzene and pyrene exceeded the legal limit. Experts point out that there is no high-temperature refining in the production process of camellia oil, so the benzenepyrene may come from raw materials. It is recommended that in addition to conducting factory inspections, we should also continue to investigate the raw materials to find out the reasons.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 8th) The arbitration case between Yaohua Pharmaceutical and the Austrian pharmaceutical company AOP has obtained a partial arbitration judgment in the second stage. The arbitration tribunal determined that AOP should pay Yaohua Pharmaceutical’s outstanding payment and royalties of more than 17 million euros. It also ruled that Yaohua Pharmaceutical should refund approximately 31.6 million euros to AOP in a dispute over the drug purchase price. Yaohua Pharmaceutical stated that the current arbitration judgment has no significant impact on its financial business and will consider revoking the arbitration judgment.

title_en: The second-stage judgment on the arbitration case with AOP is released. Yaohua Pharmaceutical: No significant impact on finance and business
summary_en: The international arbitration case between Yaohua Pharmaceutical and the Austrian pharmaceutical company AOP has made new progress. Yaohua Pharmaceutical held a press conference on the 8th to announce that the International Court of Arbitration of the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) made a second-stage partial arbitration judgment on the 7th, finding that AOP should pay Yaohua Pharmaceutical more than 17 million euros in payment and royalties owed by Yaohua Pharmaceutical from 2019 to the first half of 2023. On the other hand, in response to the dispute over the drug purchase price, it was ruled that Yaohua Pharmaceutical should refund approximately 31.6 million euros. The company stated that its overall finance and business will not be significantly affected, and plans will be made to revoke the arbitration judgment in the future.

title: 南電Q2財報公布後　目標價調升
summary: ABF載板大廠南電近期表現亮眼，第2季財報營收達135.8億元，毛利率衝上24.8%，每股稅後盈餘3.5元。受惠於ABF與BT載板價格上漲及產能利用率提升，法人預估第3季營收將續增至161億元，獲利動能強勁。南電董事會更通過468億元資本支出，積極布局高階IC載板智慧工廠，強化長線競爭力。本土券商看好其毛利率擴張趨勢可望延續至2027年，重申買進評等並將目標價調升至1600元。雖然市場對其基本面深具信心，但投資人仍需留意T-glass材料供應與載板價格波動等潛在風險，進行投資決策時務必審慎評估。

title_en: After the release of China Southern Electric’s Q2 financial report, the target price was raised
summary_en: Nandian, a major ABF carrier board manufacturer, has performed well recently. Its second quarter financial report revenue reached 13.58 billion yuan, gross profit margin reached 24.8%, and after-tax earnings per share were 3.5 yuan. Benefiting from the rising prices of ABF and BT carrier boards and the improvement in production capacity utilization, the legal person estimates that revenue in the third quarter will continue to increase to 16.1 billion yuan, with strong profit momentum. The board of directors of Nanjing Electric Power Co., Ltd. also approved a capital expenditure of 46.8 billion yuan to actively deploy high-end IC substrate smart factories and strengthen long-term competitiveness. Local brokerages are optimistic that its gross profit margin expansion trend will continue until 2027, reiterated a buy rating and raised the target price to 1,600 yuan. Although the market has deep confidence in its fundamentals, investors still need to pay attention to potential risks such as T-glass material supply and carrier board price fluctuations, and must make careful assessments when making investment decisions.

title_en: Typhoon White Dolphin approaches, Taipower initiates preparations for typhoon prevention
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lu Yanci, Taipei, 8th) Typhoon White Dolphin continues to approach the northwest of Taiwan. Taipower said today that its Matsu District sales office has started preparations for typhoon prevention on the 6th, strengthening inspections of power supply equipment and completing preventive pruning of trees in advance. In response to possible power outages caused by typhoons, a cross-regional support mechanism will be quickly activated depending on wind and rain conditions to minimize the impact.

title_en: Crying faintly! Save 20 million in ETF and retire. 45-year-old man returns to the workplace half a year later due to "1 letter"
summary_en: Shota Nakamura, a 45-year-old Japanese man, chose to retire early after accumulating more than 100 million yen in assets through investments. He originally thought he could live a free life, but he encountered obstacles due to his "unemployed" status six months later. Whether your application for a top credit card is rejected, your rental renewal is questioned, or you even want to apply for a loan for investment, you are all declined by the bank due to a lack of "sustainable income." title: 比竹科還大！馬斯克喊蓋「地球最大」晶圓廠　專家揭3大隱憂
summary: 特斯拉（Tesla）與SpaceX兩大科技巨頭正式宣布，將合資於美國德州休士頓附近的格林斯郡（Grimes County）興建名為「Terafab」的超大型晶片工廠。第一期預計投入168億美元，號稱將成為地球上最大且最有價值的建築物。根據規劃，Terafab的製造空間超過1億平方英尺，約達929公頃，面積相當於36座大安森林公園或9座台積電Fab 18廠，規模甚至超越整座新竹科學園區。馬斯克團隊表示，全球現有晶圓廠產能僅能滿足其需求的2%，即使曾呼籲台積電、三星與美光加速擴產並承諾全數包下，經過5個月後，仍決定親自下場興建，未來製造的晶片將用於Optimus人形機器人、Cybercab自駕計程車與SpaceX太空資料中心。

title_en: Bigger than the Bamboo family! Musk calls for building "Earth's largest" wafer factory; experts reveal 3 major concerns
summary_en: Two major technology giants, Tesla and SpaceX, officially announced that they will jointly build a very large chip factory called "Terafab" in Grimes County, near Houston, Texas, USA. The first phase is expected to cost US$16.8 billion and is claimed to be the largest and most valuable building on earth. According to the plan, Terafab's manufacturing space exceeds 100 million square feet, covering approximately 929 hectares, an area equivalent to 36 Daan Forest Parks or 9 TSMC Fab 18 factories, and even larger than the entire Hsinchu Science Park. Musk's team stated that the world's existing wafer fab production capacity can only meet 2% of its needs. Even though it called on TSMC, Samsung and Micron to accelerate production expansion and promised to take over all of them, after five months, they still decided to end the construction themselves. The chips produced in the future will be used for Optimus humanoid robots, Cybercab self-driving taxis and SpaceX space data centers.

title_en: There are so many applications for life extension in old homes, can we increase the number? Land and Resources Department: Local quotas can be flexibly adjusted
summary_en: If the demand for local application for life extension subsidies for old homes exceeds original estimates, central resources are expected to be increased. The Department of Land and Resources of the Ministry of the Interior stated on the 8th that the number of cases originally reported by local governments is not the upper limit for applications and can be flexibly adjusted within the total subsidy limit approved by the central government based on actual case acceptance. The Department of Land and Resources will also continue to monitor the status of local case acceptance and funding implementation, and allocate additional resources or adjust needs in a timely manner.

title_en: After the intervention of the United States and Japan, the yen closed at 157.78 this week. The National Bank of China: Three key factors are needed to reverse the long-term downward trend.
summary_en: The yen experienced joint intervention by the United States and Japan, and yesterday's unexpected turn for the worse in the U.S. non-farm payrolls data, the yen closed at 157.78, almost the same as last week. However, the Bank of Japan still believes that it is not easy to reverse the long-term decline of the yen. In addition to official intervention, three key factors are needed: a clear shift in the Fed's monetary policy; the fall in oil prices eases imported inflationary pressure; and the Bank of Japan's interest rate hike path, extent, and terminal interest rates become clearer.

title_en: Lin Bingsheng, founder of Yonghe Soy Milk, passed away from esophageal cancer at the age of 70

title_en: Don’t be fooled by the sunshine on Father’s Day. Meteorological Administration: The White Dolphin Circulation will move in in the afternoon and will have the greatest impact on wind, rain and waves starting tonight.
summary_en: The Central Meteorological Administration continues to issue maritime typhoon warnings for Typhoon No. 13 White Dolphin. Wu Wanhua, deputy director of the Central Meteorological Administration, said that the center of the Central Meteorological Dolphin came to the sea about 450 kilometers northeast of Taipei at 11 a.m., moving westward at a speed of 12 kilometers per hour. It is getting closer this morning. It will be closest from the second half of today to tomorrow, and it will land in mainland China until next Monday. Tonight and tomorrow will be the most significant time of impact on Taiwan.

title_en: The cancer-causing camellia oil factory is the 7th in total. The Food and Drug Administration will go south next week to provide guidance to the industry and will hold at least 2 exchange meetings.
summary_en: Domestic incidents of tea oil benzene and pyrene exceeding the standard have continued to occur in China. On the 7th, Hanlin Trading Co., Ltd. notified the Taipei City Government of a batch of tea oil benzene and pyrene that exceeded the standard. The Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare pointed out that on the same day, the agency will move to the New Taipei City Government Health Bureau where Hanlin's factory is located for inspection. A total of 218 bottles of this batch of products have been received, and a total of 100 bottles have been received, and the rest have been removed from the shelves and sealed. Wei Renting, director of the Southern District Management Center of the Food and Drug Administration, said that this is the seventh tea oil factory in China with problems. The Office of Food Safety of the Executive Yuan will invite the Ministry of Agriculture to discuss and provide guidance with the Food and Drug Administration.

summary_en: There are more than 100,000 warning accounts in Taiwan, causing many people to innocently receive fraudulent funds, innocently being implicated, and having their accounts frozen. Some people proposed a "payee deposit consent mechanism" on the public platform. The Financial Supervisory Authority responded that the proposer had a good intention, but after comprehensive consideration, it will have an impact on the operation of our country's payment system, transaction convenience, and the efficiency of industrial and commercial economic activities. Whether it can effectively achieve the purpose of avoiding being listed as a warning account, and the risk that remitters may increase, it finally decided not to participate.

title_en: Wall Street is shocked by "large-scale hacker attack" and many victims have paid ransom
summary_en: Recently, hacker attacks have been reported on Wall Street, and many financial giants such as CME Group and Blackstone Group have been targeted. According to foreign media reports, hackers used "social engineering" techniques to tamper with caller ID and pretend to be corporate IT departments, induce employees to enter phishing websites and steal login credentials, successfully bypassing high-level security protection systems. The Google Threat Intelligence Team pointed out that such low-tech methods can obtain sensitive information for ransom, and unnamed companies have already paid the ransom. Although none of the named financial institutions responded, the incident has triggered a high degree of panic in the market, highlighting that the security awareness and identity verification mechanism of internal personnel are still the most vulnerable links in information security protection, and it is urgent to prevent social engineering attacks.

summary_en: The center of moderate Typhoon White Dolphin is currently in the sea east of Taipei, moving northwest and west. The Central Disaster Response Center held a meeting on the afternoon of the 8th to determine that it will pose a threat to the sea in northern Taiwan and the sea in northeastern Taiwan. According to the latest data from the Meteorological Administration, the intensity of Typhoon White Dolphin has weakened slightly in the past three hours. Deputy Commander He Jincang said that huge waves of more than 6 meters have appeared on the north coast, and there are threats of long waves along the northern, northeastern and Matsu coasts. Since it falls on the Father's Day holiday, the public should still be appealed through multiple channels to avoid going to mountainous areas for mountain climbing, wave watching and other outdoor activities.

title_en: Shou Songkou believes that the Ministry of Health and Welfare has decided not to remove 2 problematic oil products from the shelves. Lin Jingyi: The Ministry of Health and Welfare will take responsibility.
summary_en: The Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare announced an expert meeting on July 4. Xu Fu, Director of the Office of Food Safety of the Executive Yuan, attended. The outside world still questions the principle that products with less than 20% of carcinogenic oils do not need to be removed from the shelves. Is it authorized by the Executive Yuan? Xu Fu and Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang have so far refused to admit that they are the policy makers, leading to criticism from the central government that it is unwilling to take responsibility. Parliamentary Secretary of the Ministry of Health and Welfare Lin Jingyi relented for the first time today. Products containing more than 20% of carcinogenic oils need to be removed from the shelves. It was proposed by experts at the meeting. "We think the experts' suggestions are reasonable and have made a decision. The Ministry of Health and Welfare will shoulder this responsibility."

summary_en: The Chinese white dolphin continues to move towards the northern waters of Taiwan, posing a threat to New Taipei City. Mayor Hou Youyi presided over the work meeting of the Disaster Response Center this morning and pointed out that this afternoon to tomorrow afternoon will be the most severe period of the typhoon affecting New Taipei City. There will be strong gusts of magnitude 9 to 10 along the coast. Citizens are urged to be on strict alert and not go to the beach to fish or watch waves to avoid accidents.

title_en: Public banks are optimistic about new southbound lending, and development hotspots focus on Australia, India, Singapore and Malaysia
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lu Yanci, Taipei, 8th) Since the beginning of this year, the National Bank of China has had strong momentum in lending to new southbound countries, and the loan increase rate in the first half of the year was as high as 368%. title_en: Su Weiyuan: Guanghongke’s Q2 profit increased by 88% quarterly, entering the robot + AI server
summary_en: Forum Center/Comprehensive Report The recent market turbulence has left investors at a loss. Senior analyst Su Weiyuan pointed out in "Financial Sunday Party" that Guanghongke, a strong turnaround stock that suffered a loss for the whole year last year but made a profit of 3.38 yuan in one go in the first half of this year, had an EPS of 1 in the first quarter. .17 yuan, jumped to 2.21 yuan in the second quarter, with quarterly growth of 88.88%. In July, revenue increased by 108% year-on-year, with double year-on-year growth. At the same time, the three major themes of slot robots, drones, and servers are the dark horses with the most transparent financial reports and the most certain turnaround at this stage. Su Weiyuan said that Guanghongke’s core competitiveness lies in electronic control modules, as well as the three major themes of positioning robots, drones and servers. On the robot side, Guanghongke's electronic control module is equipped with a patented anti-collision design, which is used in robot batteries and brushless DC motors to effectively prevent the risk of collision and explosion. On the drone side, the high-efficiency electronic control module greatly extends the battery life and is deployed in low-altitude logistics, precision agriculture and disaster exploration. On the server side, it has launched a highly integrated programming-free cooling drive solution, which directly responds to the market needs of powerful groups such as Chuanhu. The three directions benefit simultaneously, and the breadth of themes is extremely rare. In addition, Guanghongke's cumulative revenue growth rate this year of 87.42% is higher than Xindai's 81.73%, but its stock price is only one-tenth of Xindai's, and its valuation is seriously undervalued. He emphasized that with transparent financial reports, established turnaround, and all three themes emerging, Guanghongke is the dark horse with the highest cost performance potential among the robot community at this stage. There are risks in stock market investment. Investors should evaluate carefully and never blindly chase high prices.

title_en: Chen Jianquan: Junxing-KY's revenue in July was the third highest in history, with orders booming and major players entering the market
summary_en: Forum Center/Comprehensive Report The robot industry is booming. Reducers and joint gears are the core components that account for the highest proportion of the total machine cost. They are also the entry point for Taiwanese manufacturers to have the most competitive advantage. Senior analyst Chen Jianquan pointed out in "Financial Sunday Party" that Junxing-KY, a core component supplier deeply involved in robot reducers and joint gears, saw revenue increase by 40% monthly and 36% annually in July. Chen Jianquan said that Junxing-KY's gear sales reached 180 million yuan last year, but in March this year, its orders in a single month reached 160 million yuan. The order visibility is extremely high, showing that the demand for robot joint gears is changing from quantitative to qualitative. He emphasized that gears and reducers are key components that account for the highest cost of a robot. Junxing-KY has long been deeply involved in this high-tech threshold field, and its cooperative relationships with KUKA of Germany and Yaskawa Electric of Japan have established its irreplaceable position in the global robot supply chain. In terms of chips, Chen Jianquan pointed out that the shareholding ratio of Qianzhang's large investors continued to rise. Chunjiang Water Warm Ducks knew that large investors had made arrangements in advance, which was highly similar to the chip structure of Shanghai Banking Corporation. Technically, Junxing-KY has broken through the downward pressure line, and the quarterly line is the strongest support. After reaching the quarterly line, the stock price will be difficult to turn back. Chen Jianquan suggested that everything below the quarterly line is a good opportunity for layout. He also emphasized that Junxing-KY's shareholder equity return rate of 16.39% is the highest among the group, and it is expected to challenge the profit this year to earn a share capital. There are risks in stock market investment. Investors should evaluate carefully and never blindly chase high prices.

title_en: Kaohsiung has achieved success in promoting industrial upgrading and financial innovation. The World Cities Summit Forum shares urban transformation experience
summary_en: Kaohsiung has actively promoted industrial upgrading and financial innovation in recent years. Driven by the rapid development of strategic industries such as semiconductors, AI, smart manufacturing, and net-zero technology, the industrial structure has continued to transform, and the demand for high-value financial services has grown simultaneously. In line with the central government's policy of promoting the Asian Asset Management Center, the Kaohsiung Zone has celebrated its first anniversary and has gradually established a development model for co-prosperity of finance and industry. The relevant results have also attracted attention from all walks of life. Luo Dasheng, deputy mayor of the Kaohsiung City Government, was invited to attend the "2026 Tianxia City Summit Forum" organized by "World Magazine" on the 7th. He gave a special presentation titled "Kaohsiung, creating an urban development model that resonates with industrial upgrading and financial services." He introduced the policy achievements of Kaohsiung's promotion of industrial upgrading, financial innovation and the Asian Asset Management Center, and demonstrated the specific results of urban transformation and the development of high-value service industries.

title_en: Formosa Plastics’ July revenue of 151.9 billion yuan increased by more than 30% year-on-year. South Asia benefited from the AI ​​trend and hit a 49-month high.
summary_en: [Reporter Xu Lizhen/Taipei Report] Formosa Plastics Sibao announced its July revenue. The four major companies' July revenue totaled NT$151.955 billion, a monthly increase of 14.7% and an annual increase of 31.5%. Assisted by the price and volume of petrochemicals and electronic materials, the revenue of the four companies in July increased both year-on-year and monthly. Especially in South Asia, which benefited from the AI ​​trend, the price and volume of electronic materials increased by 12.7% month-on-month and 44.5% year-on-year. July revenue hit a new high in nearly 49 months.

title_en: Typhoon White Dolphin approaches, Taipower initiates preparations for typhoon prevention
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lu Yanci, Taipei, 8th) Typhoon White Dolphin continues to approach the northwest of Taiwan. Taipower said today that its Matsu District sales office has started preparations for typhoon prevention on the 6th, strengthening inspections of power supply equipment and completing preventive pruning of trees in advance. In response to possible power outages caused by typhoons, a cross-regional support mechanism will be quickly activated depending on wind and rain conditions to minimize the impact.

title_en: Feijie's Q2 profit surges, H1 EPS is 5.93 yuan, AI software business H2 is estimated to double
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Reported by Reporter Wang Yihong] POS giant Feijie (6206) announced its second quarter financial report. Its single-quarter consolidated revenue was 1.882 billion yuan, an annual increase of 38%, with the largest contribution from the American market. After-tax net profit was 489 million yuan, an annual increase of 128%, and EPS was 3.42 yuan. Feijie's gross profit margin in the second quarter was 45.4%, maintaining a high level, with an annual increase of 1.54 percentage points. The operating profit margin increased by nearly 5 percentage points annually to 30.9%, and the quarterly increase also exceeded 2 percentage points. The pre-tax net profit margin increased by more than 12 percentage points annually, breaking the 30% mark for the first time at 31.6%. Despite component cost fluctuations and supply chain challenges, Feijie's operating profit in the first half of the year still set a new record, mainly due to the deepening of terminal market applications, the upgrade of AI software and field computing power, coupled with the continuous improvement of operating leverage efficiency, and the optimization of the overall profit structure. The cumulative gross profit of Feijie in the first half of the year was 1.543 billion yuan, an annual increase of 28%; operating profit reached 1.006 billion yuan, an annual increase of 37%; the net profit attributable to the parent company after tax was only 848 million yuan, an annual increase of 57%. The cumulative EPS in the first half of the year reached 5.93 yuan, earning more than half of the equity. Looking ahead to the market outlook, Feijie's order visibility in the third quarter is clear, and its overall purchase strength is significantly better than the same period last year. At the same time, the AI ​​visual recognition technology of its software subsidiaries Berry AI and Angible has entered the stage of large-scale commercialization and is expected to show multiple growth in the second half of the year. title_en: Yaohua Pharmaceutical AOP arbitration is released! Let the truth be told clearly once and for all. The second stage of arbitration will be to request revocation.
summary_en: There is the latest development in the arbitration case between Yaohua Pharmaceutical (6446) and AOP. On August 7, Yaohua Pharmaceutical received the second-stage partial arbitration judgment of the International Court of Arbitration of the International Chamber of Commerce (ICC). The arbitral tribunal determined that AOP should pay Yaohua Pharmaceutical’s outstanding payment and royalties from 2019 to the first half of 2023, totaling more than 17 million euros. Yaohua Pharmaceutical assesses that this result will have no significant impact on its finances and business, and will apply to revoke the arbitration judgment in accordance with the law. He also emphasized that AOP's claims that Yaohua Pharmaceuticals owes more than 100 million euros and has receivables of approximately 65 million euros are all unilateral calculations by AOP and are not part of the arbitration tribunal's ruling.

title: 英特爾靠川普不夠　業界揭「客戶不敢得罪台積電」關鍵

title_en: Intel’s reliance on Trump is not enough. The industry reveals the key to why “customers dare not offend TSMC”
summary_en: Intel has recently been actively seeking support from the Trump administration and has received billions of dollars in investment from Huida and SoftBank in an attempt to catch up in the foundry market. However, analysts and industry insiders pointed out that although Intel's 18A process has made progress, core data such as yield rate have not been made public, and there is a gap between Intel's technical level and TSMC. Considering that transferring orders from chip design companies requires huge costs and verification risks, and TSMC's production capacity is still in short supply, customers generally do not dare to offend TSMC easily. Experts suggest that Intel's more pragmatic strategy in the short term is to secure small-scale orders, or to undertake spillover demand after TSMC's production capacity is full. In the short term, it will be difficult to shake TSMC's absolute leading position in the world's advanced chip foundry field.

title_en: China expands global tax recovery, standardizes offshore trust tax rate at 20% for the first time, and backtracks overseas assets for 25 years
summary_en: The Chinese government is in urgent need of exploring new sources of revenue and has recently been actively expanding its global tax recovery campaign against wealthy individuals. China's Ministry of Finance has officially issued an announcement recently, clarifying for the first time the taxation method for residents' offshore trust income. Foreign media reported that China’s super-rich are busy finding lawyers and selling off some of their assets to collect cash to pay taxes.

title_en: 2.8 million students benefited! China Life has been providing student insurance for 10 consecutive years, and online insurance is open today
summary_en: Cathay Life has been operating the "National Student Group Insurance" since 2017 and has been operating the "National Student Group Insurance" for ten consecutive years. In the 115th academic year, the Ministry of Education continued to provide student group insurance protection and selected Cathay Life to provide services to 2.8 million high school and vocational students and kindergarten children. In response to this year's bidding schedule, it is expected that schools at all levels will be open to online insurance applications starting from August 17, 2026. The effective date of the first batch of insurance can still be retroactively dated from August 1, and the protection rights of students and young children will not be affected.

title_en: Who is the PCB Queen optimistic about? After the bloodbath of Xinxing, Jinju and Jinxiang Dian, they named "this stock was mistakenly killed" with a low price-to-earnings ratio.
summary_en: Taiwan stocks experienced a sharp pullback in July, with 60% of stocks including the printed circuit board (PCB) group rebounding one after another after their stock prices nearly halved. Liao Wanting, the general manager of Uni-President Investment Consulting with the title of "PCB Queen", analyzed the benchmark stocks such as Xinxing, Jinxiang Dian and Jinju. In particular, after Jinxiang Dian's stock price dropped to the range of 700 to 800 yuan, the price-to-earnings ratio has been very low. It is recommended that investors who bought at the high point do not need to pursue the amortization to the lowest point, but observe the signals released after the stock price bottoms out in August and September. This way, the layout will be relatively safe.

title_en: Super Optical Communications this week AAOI supplements the top three Taiwan stocks
summary_en: AAOI, a major U.S. optical communications company, announced its second-quarter financial results. Revenue increased by 86% year-on-year to a record high, and it successfully turned a loss into a profit. Although the third-quarter financial forecast was slightly lower than expected, causing stock price shocks, management emphasized that demand for 800G and 1.6T products is strong, and production capacity will be in short supply until mid-2027. As the demand for AI data centers explodes, AAOI is fully deploying high-margin transmission products to drive business opportunities in Taiwan's supply chain. Taiwanese manufacturers including Lianjun, Guangsheng and CSOT provide key packaging and components, benefiting from the North American data center arms race, and have a promising market outlook. Investors should note that although the industry prospects are optimistic, investment is still risky, and market fluctuations and changes in supply and demand need to be carefully evaluated.

title_en: 5 ways to avoid landmines for Father's Day gifts: Working dads most want to "receive cash"
summary_en: Today is Father's Day. Have you bought a Father's Day gift? According to the latest survey by yes123, the top five Father's Day gifts that working dads "least expect" to receive this year are, in order, tea making equipment, micro-plastic surgery services, ties, belts and shirts. In contrast, the gifts that dads most expect to receive are cash, domestic travel, department store gift certificates, overseas travel and smartphones. The survey shows that compared to traditional gifts, working dads prefer to receive gifts that can truly reduce the stress of life and increase the number of gifts.

summary_en: Financial Center/Li Wenzhen reported that the stock prices of high-priced Taiwanese stocks, which can easily reach millions of dollars, often discourage the petty bourgeoisie with limited funds, and even say that they "can't afford it." He pointed out that a high-priced stock can easily cost millions, and even he would not place an order to buy the entire stock at one time. title_en: The over-lending ratio of banks is only 1/4 of South Korea. Taiwan’s financial resilience is secure!
summary_en: The latest data from the Financial Supervisory Commission shows that as of the end of June this year, the total balance of domestic bank loans reached 47.8129 billion yuan, and the amount of overdue loans dropped to 67.338 billion yuan. The overall overdue loan ratio remained at a historical low of 0.14%, and the coverage ratio of bad debt allowances to overdue loans climbed to 939.51%. Compared with the over-lending ratio of Korean commercial banks that recently exceeded 0.5%, the over-lending ratio of Taiwan's banking industry is only about one-quarter of South Korea's, demonstrating strong financial resilience that ranks first in Asia.

title_en: What dad fears most is not getting sick! Global Life Insurance exposes family crisis and promotes it to build risk protection network
summary_en: Father's Day is approaching, and the atmosphere of gratitude is strong. Global Life recently proposed the concept of "Plan Be" risk planning, reminding fathers to shoulder the financial responsibility of the family while also proactively reviewing the gaps in family protection, including basic medical protection, major injuries and cancer treatment support, and long-term care preparations to build a safe foundation that can cope with future risks. summary_en: The Taipei City Health Bureau received an independent notification tonight from Hanlin Trading Co., Ltd. that the tea oil benzene and pyrene produced by it exceeded the standard. title_en: Public banks are optimistic about new southbound lending, and development hotspots focus on Australia, India, Singapore and Malaysia
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lu Yanci, Taipei, 8th) Since the beginning of this year, the National Bank of China has had strong momentum in lending to new southbound countries, and the loan increase rate in the first half of the year was as high as 368%. Public equity bank analysis shows that this wave of growth has a medium- to long-term structural foundation, and is particularly optimistic about markets such as Australia, Vietnam, Indonesia, Singapore, and Malaysia. However, it is still necessary to pay attention to challenges such as geopolitical uncertainty, differences in supervisory regulations in various countries, and competition with local banks.

title: 驗出陰性不等於沒病，醫生揭真相，多數人確診那天早就病了很久
summary:
同樣的症狀，同樣的檢體，為什麼有些病人懷疑感染，卻連續兩次檢驗為陰性，到了第三次檢驗才出現陽性？相反地，有些病人症狀緩解且檢驗陰性而被認定康復，出院後檢驗卻又變回陽性。病毒檢驗怎麼會一下子陰性，一下子又陽性？到底是病毒突變，還是檢驗出問題？

這個在2020年新冠肺炎大流行期間困擾醫界的問題，其實正是通往精準醫學路上最容易被忽略的一道關卡。被國內媒體譽為「醫界福爾摩斯」，元鼎診所院長曾嶔元在《精準醫學：早期預防癌症，破解基因迷思對症下藥》一書中指出，精準醫學強調要根據病人的生活型態、環境因素和基因差異，把疾病的診斷作更科學的區分。其中最重要的是基因上的差異，這包括基因結構上的差異，可比喻成電腦的硬體，以及表現上的差異，可比喻成電腦的軟體。

title_en: A negative test does not mean that you are not sick. Doctors reveal the truth. Most people have been sick for a long time on the day they were diagnosed.
summary_en:
With the same symptoms and the same test specimen, why do some patients test negative twice in a row when they suspect infection, and only show positive results on the third test? On the contrary, some patients were deemed recovered after their symptoms improved and their tests were negative, but their tests turned positive again after they were discharged. How could a virus test be negative all of a sudden and then positive again? Is it a virus mutation, or is there something wrong with the test?

This issue that has plagued the medical community during the 2020 COVID-19 pandemic is actually the most easily overlooked hurdle on the road to precision medicine. Hailed as the "Medical Sherlock Holmes" by the domestic media, Zeng Jinyuan, president of Yuanding Clinic, pointed out in the book "Precision Medicine: Early Prevention of Cancer, Solving Gene Myths and Prescribing the Right Medicine" that precision medicine emphasizes making more scientific distinctions in disease diagnosis based on the patient's lifestyle, environmental factors and genetic differences. The most important of these are genetic differences, which include differences in genetic structure, which can be compared to computer hardware, and differences in performance, which can be compared to computer software.

summary_en: The leading domestic leasing and hosting company "Shau Kee Group" has experienced a major financial crisis! Recently, it was reported that the capital chain of its related companies was broken and corporate bonds could not be paid, causing hundreds of investors to panic. After receiving the report and filing the case, the Investigation Bureau Beijing Station reported to the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office to direct the investigation. An in-depth investigation revealed that Li Jiancheng, the former chairman and founder of Zhaoji, was suspected of diverting company funds for investment, personal enjoyment, debt repayment, and the purchase of designer bags and luxury goods by his ex-wife, amounting to more than 700 million yuan. The prosecutor launched a search and interview today (8/7). summary_en: The Elderly Health Industry Expo opened yesterday (7th). summary_en: [Newtalk News] The latest employment data in the United States is unexpectedly shocking! The U.S. Department of Labor released its July non-farm employment report on the 7th. Instead of increasing as expected, non-farm employment dropped by 23,000 people, which was far worse than economists’ original forecast of an increase of 80,000 people. It also marked the first negative growth in the past five months. Weak employment data showed that the U.S. labor market has cooled significantly, and it also caused the market to sharply lower its expectations for an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve (Fed) in September. The four major U.S. stock indexes all closed in the red on Friday (7th), with the Nasdaq Index rising by 342.27 points. point, closing at 26,690.62 points, up 1.30%; the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose even more strongly by 308.10 points, closing at 12,356.79 points, or 2.56%, becoming the strongest performer among the four major indexes. Encouraged by the reduction in pressure to raise interest rates, technology and semiconductor groups are the most enthusiastic about buying. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 151.83 points to close at 54,036.93 points, an increase of 0.28%; the S&P 500 Index rose 47.68 points to close at 7,757.64 points, an increase of 0.62%, and set another historical closing high. In addition to weak non-farm payroll data reducing doubts about raising interest rates, bright earnings reports from U.S. companies also added bullish momentum to the market. According to Reuters statistics, as of Friday, 436 S&P 500 companies have released financial reports, and as many as 85.1% of them have profits that are better than market expectations, further boosting investors' risk appetite. The consolidated revenue was NT$399 million, an annual increase of 57% and a quarterly increase of 211%. summary_en: Real-Time Center/Comprehensive Report The latest U.S. employment data was unexpectedly weak, reducing market expectations for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates. U.S. stocks rose across the board on Friday (7th), with the S&P 500 closing at a record high and the three major indexes also recording their largest weekly gains since mid-April. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 151 points, or 0.28%, to close at 54,036 points; the S&P 500 Index rose 47 points, or 0.62%, to close at 7,757 points; the Nasdaq Index rose 342 points, or 1.30%, to close at 26,690 points. TSMC ADR rose $1 to close at $420 per share, an increase of 0.44%; Huida rose $5 to close at $223, an increase of 2.27%.

title_en: The increasing surplus with the United States hides two major hidden dangers! Scholars worry about Trump’s pressure and U.S. economy
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance released import and export statistics for July. Taiwan's trade surplus with the United States has increased. Scholars believe that exports are too concentrated in the United States. In addition to facing the reversal of the U.S. economy, Taiwan is at risk of being hit hardest. The biggest challenge is that Trump, with his changeable personality, may resort to various whimsical means to increase Taiwan's uncertainty. As for whether Trump will retaliate against Taiwan because of this, scholars believe that the United States is unlikely to adjust the tariffs it has set. However, in the short term, Trump may pressure Taiwan to increase purchases and open its market, and in the long term, other terms of investigation may arise.

title_en: Chaos again! Medical inflation: actual payments are not enough to compensate
summary_en: Medical inflation is serious, and people’s expenditure burden has increased significantly. Although the Financial Supervisory Commission launched "Original Claims" in July 2024 in order to put an end to the chaos of "using insurance policies to make money", hoping that medical insurance can return to the "damage compensation" principle, that is, the claims people receive from insurance companies cannot exceed their medical expenses. However, in the past two years, the advancement of medical technology has caused medical expenses to expand rapidly. Not to mention "damage compensation", now it is "insufficient compensation".

title_en: President Lai: The minimum wage will be raised to over NT$30,000. Please ask listed companies to also raise wages.
summary_en: President Lai Qingde attended the "2026 National Model Workers Celebration Dinner of the All-China Federation of Industrial and Occupational Trade Unions" on the evening of the 7th. He said that workers are the heroes behind Taiwan's economic progress. The government takes care of grassroots workers through salary increases, tax cuts, reducing childcare and education burdens, and allocating labor insurance funds. He hopes that the people will support the government, stand with the country, and allow the smooth advancement of national affairs.

title_en: Taiwan has entered a super-aged society and the participation of silver-haired workers has become a new issue
summary_en: Yang Panchi, president of the Health Policy Council, said yesterday (7th) that Taiwan has entered a super-aged society, but the labor force participation rate of the population over 65 years old is only about 10.2%. How to allow more people to maintain work and social participation, and convert health improvements into economic output is an important issue.

title_en: The insurance amount is small, the terms are old, and the actual insurance coverage is not enough
summary_en: In the past two years, has the medical inflation problem been so exaggerated that even if people have full-time insurance, they can’t make up for it? This is not an exaggeration. The cases will speak for themselves. There are two main reasons. One is the problem of insufficient quota, and the other problem is that many clauses in the old policy are out of date.

title: 美查產能過剩 台灣芒刺在背
summary: 台灣對美國出口持續強勁，但在美國調整貿易政策強化關稅工具之際，台灣也面臨新的貿易壓力。美國已完成對台灣強迫勞動議題的三○一條款調查，對部分台灣產品加徵百分之十關稅；另一方面，與半導體及科技產業高度相關的「結構性產能過剩」調查結果仍未公布，成為台美貿易重要觀察焦點。

title_en: US Cha's overcapacity is a thorn in Taiwan's back
summary_en: Taiwan's exports to the United States continue to be strong, but as the United States adjusts its trade policy and strengthens tariff tools, Taiwan is also facing new trade pressure. The United States has completed its Section 301 investigation into Taiwan's forced labor issues and imposed a 10% tariff on some Taiwanese products. On the other hand, the results of the "structural overcapacity" investigation that is highly related to the semiconductor and technology industries have not yet been released, making it an important focus of Taiwan-US trade observation.

title: 強彈千點！「18檔」收復失土台股ETF　股災後創波段新高
summary: 受美股反彈激勵，台股近期強勢回升，單日漲幅逾千點，帶動台股ETF表現亮眼。根據統計，共有18檔ETF率先收復7月股災失土並創下波段新高，其中高股息與主動式ETF表現最為強勁。主動凱基台灣（00407A）單週績效飆升達19.13%，居市場之冠，主動野村臺灣優選與中信小資高價30漲幅亦突破18%。法人分析，儘管大盤震盪，但透過靈活的選股策略與資金輪動，相關標的展現出強大的抗跌追漲能力。展望後市，分析師認為AI長線結構未變，台廠供應鏈動能依然穩健，建議投資人採取分散佈局策略，適度控管半導體產業集中度，並透過不配息ETF鎖定長期成長，以穩健心態應對市場波動，追求時間帶來的複利效益。

title_en: A thousand bullets! "18th Tier" Taiwan stock ETF regained lost ground and hit new highs after the stock market crash
summary_en: Inspired by the rebound in U.S. stocks, Taiwan stocks have rebounded strongly recently, with a single-day gain of more than 1,000 points, driving the performance of Taiwan stock ETFs. According to statistics, a total of 18 ETFs took the lead in recovering the losses from the July stock market crash and hitting new highs in the band, among which high-dividend and active ETFs performed the strongest. Active KGI Taiwan (00407A)'s single-week performance soared to 19.13%, ranking first in the market. Active Nomura Taiwan Select and CITIC Petty Bodies High Price 30 also exceeded 18%. According to legal analysis, despite the market fluctuations, through flexible stock selection strategies and capital rotation, the relevant targets have demonstrated a strong ability to resist declines and chase increases. Looking forward to the market outlook, analysts believe that the long-term structure of AI has not changed, and the supply chain momentum of Taiwanese manufacturers remains stable. It is recommended that investors adopt a diversified layout strategy, moderately control the concentration of the semiconductor industry, and lock in long-term growth through non-interest-bearing ETFs, respond to market fluctuations with a stable attitude, and pursue the compound interest benefits brought by time.

title_en: Tesla crashed into 9 cars and motorcycles at Guanghua Night Market in Kaohsiung, destroying the transformer box, injuring 3 people and causing a power outage to 600 households
summary_en: A man surnamed Guo drove a Tesla electric car near Guanghua Night Market in Kaohsiung City at about 7 o'clock tonight. The vehicle suddenly crashed due to a suspected mechanical failure and hit a roadside transformer box. It then hit a motorcycle and a Mercedes that were stopped at a red light in the same direction, and then hit a motorcycle and a bicycle on the roadside. Three riders were injured, one of whom was crushed by the transformer box. The front of the Tesla was seriously damaged. The accident also affected the night market and surrounding residents, causing power outages.

summary_en: Li Jiancheng, the former chairman of Zhaoji Estate Management, a leading domestic rental management company, was accused of using Zhao Ji Investment Company and Hermit Crab Management Consulting Company to issue corporate bonds without paying interest, and embezzled nearly 700 million yuan in investment funds, which were used to purchase dozens of boutique bags such as Hermès and Chanel, and eight luxury cars such as Mercedes-Benz. title_en: Yunlin dioxin mutton case, the forage was found to contain dioxin exceeding the standard, and 8 sheep were culled and all found to be unqualified
summary_en: The Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare recently carried out the 2015 Food Dioxin Sampling and Testing Project. It sampled mutton samples at the Yunlin County Meat Market and found that one sample did not meet the regulations for dioxin. It was traced and found to be a sheep raised by a breeder named Li. The Food and Drug Administration pointed out that it has jointly conducted an inter-ministerial investigation with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Environment and the local government. It was found that the soil and air dioxin content of the owner named Li were lower than the background value, but the dioxin content in the forage was slightly higher than the EU standard. The reason will continue to be investigated. The remaining 8 sheep on the farm were culled on July 27, and all of them failed to pass the inspection.

title_en: Employment is unexpectedly popular! All four major U.S. stock indexes closed in the red; the Nasdaq rose 342 points and the S&P 500 hit a new high
summary_en: The latest U.S. non-farm payrolls data was unexpectedly weak. The number of non-farm payrolls fell by 23,000 in July, and the previous month's data was significantly revised downwards. This phenomenon effectively alleviated the market's anxiety about the Federal Reserve (Fed) raising interest rates in September and encouraged U.S. stocks to rise across the board on Friday. The S&P 500 index closed at another record high, technology stocks rose strongly, the Nasdaq index rose 1.30%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index climbed 2.56%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed in the red at the same time. Market confidence rebounded due to the cooling employment data. Investors are paying close attention to the long-term impact of subsequent monetary policy trends on the stock market.

title_en: The white dolphins have slightly slowed down their speed. Storms and waves are strong over the weekend, and heavy rains are likely to fall in the mountainous areas north of central China.
summary_en: China-Taiwan white dolphins continue to approach Taiwan at turtle speed, and the latest coast guard coverage includes the northeastern waters. Although White Dolphin has weakened slightly, the radius of the Category 7 storm is still quite wide. The Meteorological Administration also predicts that White Dolphin will still affect Taiwan in the form of central Taiwan. title_en: Jinbao Chairman Xu Jieli: Sustainability is not a cost and is the key to the company’s growth in the next stage.
summary_en: Facing the global net-zero transformation and the industrial transformation driven by the AI ​​wave, the competition rules of the manufacturing industry are changing rapidly. Xu Jieli, chairman of Jinbao (2312) Group, attended the "2026 Taixin Shin Kong Net Zero Summit Forum" on the 7th and said that companies used to compare costs, quality and delivery, but now they need to simultaneously possess capabilities such as efficiency, low-carbon, governance, resilience and supply chain collaboration. summary_en: Winbond Electronics (2344)'s legal briefing was held on Thursday (8/6). The Q2 financial report and the outlook for the memory market have attracted attention from all walks of life. General manager Chen Peiming bluntly said: "(Supply and demand) will be tighter in 2027 than in 2026." Even if the average selling price of customized memory has doubled in Q2, it is expected that Q3 will still see considerable growth. In addition, Winbond also announced that it is preparing to start the expansion plan of Module B at its Kaohsiung plant. Chen Peiming pointed out that the current maximum production capacity of Module A is only 24,000 pieces, which is already full. Module B plans to start construction in January 2027, and hopes to start installation in Q1 2029, which will be carried out in two phases. The maximum production capacity of Module B is expected to reach 50,000 pieces. During the trading session on Wednesday, Huabang Electric once exceeded the fourth daily limit. On Thursday, the market focus was all on the company saying that it would stay on the sidelines. The stock price rose slightly by 2 yuan, or 1.18%, to close at 184.5 yuan. Some foreign investors estimate that Huabang Electric's EPS this year and next year will be 28.49 yuan and 60.03 yuan respectively. The reasonable stock price in the next 12 months should be 360 ​​yuan.

title: 工作第五年談到年薪500萬，他在科技外商16年身價逾億：只有履歷才能敲開高薪大門
summary: 高中努力唸書，看看自己分數可以拿幾分。努力考學測，拉高分數，選了科系，準備書面審查資料，說自己對某個科系是多麽有興趣。最後進大學，把課修完，畢業。即將要求職時，才想到要寫「履歷」。一般學生是怎麼寫履歷的呢？其實就是在人力銀行這類的求職網站上，把自己的學經歷按照時間填進去。如果有專案經驗就寫上去。接著，把準備好的履歷，一間一間的按下申請的按鈕。看哪一間公司回覆邀請面試，就去面試。面試時，不想開期望薪資，請對方先開。對方開了一個新鮮人的薪水，能接受就去，不能接受就上網抱怨薪水低，上論壇罵公司。矽谷的學生則不同。大家一定都看過那些「矽谷科技圈的工程師網紅」分享過，他們拿到多高的驚天年薪，或者是新聞也會報導哪些公司開出豐厚的高薪。連同現在加州也規定企業徵才，必須標出底薪的範圍。畢業生爭相爭奪高薪或申請給出高薪的大廠職缺。為爭取優秀的畢業生，新創公司也開出不輸高薪大廠的職缺。大家很有目標地調查薪水。好公司開出高薪來爭取優秀的學生，這些學生也看得到這些薪資資訊。

title_en: In his fifth year of work, he talked about an annual salary of 5 million. He has been a foreign technology businessman for 16 years and is worth more than 100 million: only resume can knock on the door to high salary.
summary_en: Study hard in high school and see what points you can get. I worked hard to take the academic test, improve my scores, choose a major, and prepare written review materials to express how interested I was in a certain major. Finally, enter college, complete the courses, and graduate. When I was about to apply for a job, I thought of writing a “resume.” How do ordinary students write resumes? In fact, on a job search website such as Job Bank, you fill in your academic experience according to time. If you have project experience, please write it down. Then, take your prepared resume and press the apply button one by one. See which company responds and invites you for an interview, and go for the interview. During the interview, if you don’t want to ask about salary expectations, ask the other party to ask first. The other party offers a salary for a fresher. If you can accept it, go for it. If you can't accept it, go online to complain about the low salary or go to forums to scold the company. Silicon Valley students are different. You must have seen those "Engineer Internet celebrities in the Silicon Valley technology circle" share how high their annual salaries are, or the news will also report which companies offer generous and high salaries. California now also stipulates that companies must indicate a minimum salary range when recruiting talents. Graduates are vying for high salaries or applying for jobs in large companies that offer high salaries. In order to attract outstanding graduates, start-up companies also open job vacancies that are comparable to high-paying large companies. Everyone investigates salaries very purposefully. Good companies offer high salaries to attract outstanding students, and these students can also see this salary information.

title_en: Confirming the receipt of the third reading address of the Legislative Yuan’s children’s account. The Government: Will take necessary actions to maintain constitutional order
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the "Taiwan Children's Growth and Future Account Ordinance" on the third reading on July 24, which stipulates that the government will open individual future accounts for children. This move is seen as a departure from the growth allowance proposed by President Lai Ching-te. The Executive Yuan confirmed that it received the third reading letter this afternoon; as for the next step, the Executive Yuan said that in response to the Legislative Yuan's actions that overstepped the boundaries of constitutional government and infringed on the Constitutional Yuan's constitutional power to propose policy guidelines and prepare budgets, the Executive Yuan will also take necessary constitutional actions to maintain constitutional order.

title_en: U.S. non-farm payrolls affect Taiwan stocks, gold price could hit US$5,000 next year
summary_en: Affected by the sharp correction of some technology stocks, memory and the lack of US non-farm employment data, Taiwan stocks opened higher and lower on the 7th. summary: 中央銀行持續執行信用管制、銀行房貸資金緊縮及整體經濟觀望氛圍影響下，上半年台中房市交易量出現明顯降溫，預售市場更顯低迷。另一方面，受全球資金行情、美伊衝突帶來的題材及AI科技股強勁領軍影響，台股高檔震盪。就在市場普遍認為高總價住宅買氣同步陷入低潮之際，最新實價登錄資料卻透露出不同訊號。

title_en: Funds flow back into luxury homes, Taichung has multiple over 100 million transactions in the first half of the year
summary_en: Affected by the central bank's continued enforcement of credit controls, the tightening of bank mortgage funds, and the overall economic wait-and-see atmosphere, Taichung's housing market transaction volume cooled significantly in the first half of the year, and the pre-sale market became even more sluggish. On the other hand, affected by the global capital market, themes brought about by the US-Iran conflict and the strong leadership of AI technology stocks, Taiwan stocks fluctuated at a high level. Just when the market generally believes that the purchasing sentiment of high-priced residential properties has reached a trough, the latest real-price registration data reveals different signals.

title_en: Retirement fund expands investment in global stocks
summary_en: Taiwan’s Civil Service Retirement Pension Fund, which has a scale of NT$1.57 trillion, plans to allocate more funds to third-party managers to increase the fund’s allocation in global stock markets. The fund also confirmed that it plans to outsource investment in global stocks, but the specific scale and investment strategy have not yet been finalized. The Pension Fund Management Bureau stated that the planning of foreign entrustment business is still under discussion, and the relevant types of quotas will be announced on the Bureau's website after the decision is made.

summary_en: Taichung Shuinan Economic and Trade Park welcomes a major development milestone! The "Shuinan Transfer Center", a complex transportation hub with a project cost of NT$4.68 billion, was grandly opened a few days ago, announcing that the region has officially entered a period of full realization of its functions. The transfer center plans a "seven turns and seven connections" transportation network, connecting seven types of transportation in one fell swoop, including national highway passenger transport, urban buses, MRT, railways, bicycles, taxis and airlines. It is like any transportation door. Observing the regional pre-sale market, the results of advanced deployment by major brand builders are gradually emerging.

title_en: Retirement pension fund diversifies risks, experts are optimistic about its success
summary_en: According to foreign reports, the domestic Civil Service Retirement Pension Fund, which has a scale of approximately US$49 billion (approximately NT$1.57 trillion), plans to expand its outsourcing operations, allocate more funds to third-party asset management institutions for management, and increase its allocation to global stock markets. Lu Renjie, chairman of South China Investment Consulting, said that under the promotion of the capital market, if it can expand its scale, improve global allocation and diversify risks, it can achieve perfect management of pensions and pursue stable returns, and he is "optimistic about its success".

title_en: "This semiconductor silicon wafer company" revenue in the first half of the year exceeded 40 billion! Green Energy shows off its power and earns 5 yuan per share
summary_en: Sino-American Silicon announced an eye-catching financial report. In the second quarter of 2024, consolidated revenue reached 21.12 billion yuan, a new high for the same period. In the first half of the year, cumulative revenue exceeded 40 billion yuan, and EPS reached 5.02 yuan. Benefiting from the explosion of global AI demand and energy transformation, the global wafer production capacity of the subsidiary is fully loaded, the revenue of the affiliated company Taitehua has increased by more than 262% year-on-year, and Hongjieke and Pengcheng Technology have also grown simultaneously. In terms of green energy layout, the total silicon power sales contract between China and the United States has exceeded 100 billion yuan, and it has entered the United States to build solar module production capacity. Relying on the dual engines of semiconductors and green electricity, Sino-American Silicon not only operates steadily, but also locks in cash flow through long-term contracts, continues to expand its industrial influence, and has become the focus of the Taiwan stock market.

title_en: U.S. polycrystalline silicon tariffs: Ministry of Economic Affairs: Limited impact on solar photovoltaic industry
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zeng Junting, Taipei, 7th) The United States announced an additional 15% tariff on polycrystalline silicon products, which will take effect on December 4, Eastern Time. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that Taiwan’s polysilicon and related products exported to the United States are mainly silicon wafers for semiconductors. Semiconductor companies can obtain tariff exemption quotas through the Taiwan-US investment cooperation mechanism to reduce the impact of new measures. As for the solar photovoltaic industry, due to its low proportion of exports to the United States, the overall impact is limited.

summary_en: Entering the typhoon season, what farmers fear most is not wind and rain, but sudden power outages. Taipower's Kinmen District Sales Office recently went to the Kinmen County Livestock Laboratory to conduct a publicity campaign on "Safety of Electrical Equipment in the Livestock Breeding Industry and Pre-Typhoon Maintenance of Electrical Equipment", reminding farmers to complete equipment inspections before the typhoon strikes, especially backup power supplies, ventilation equipment and power distribution systems. Once the power is interrupted and cannot be restored immediately, it may cause a large number of livestock deaths and inestimable losses.
