title_en: The pension fund has a hidden liability of 2.9 trillion yuan. The suspension of public education annuity has not yet been included in future debt.
summary_en: The government launched the pension reform for public servants in 2018, but the hidden liabilities of the pension fund for public servants continue to increase. According to the 2025 final account report of the pension fund, as of the end of 2025, the actuarial liabilities for the next 50 years will exceed 4.1 trillion yuan. Due to the outstanding investment performance of the pension fund in recent years, the amount that can be withdrawn has increased to 1.2 trillion yuan, but the hidden liabilities still exceed 2.9 trillion yuan.

title_en: The United States hits hard at mainland solar companies, targeting polysilicon and derivative products for taxation; United Recycling, Sino-U.S. Crystal will benefit
summary_en: Reuters quoted people familiar with the matter as reporting that the Trump administration, following its intention to ban the import of optical transceiver modules from China into the United States, has targeted Chinese solar companies as its latest target. It is preparing to impose rock-bottom prices on polysilicon and derivative products and impose new tariffs. It also plans to expand subsidies for U.S. manufacturing, thereby severely damaging Chinese companies.

title_en: Trump’s “guaranteed price policy” helps transfer orders
summary_en: The Trump administration has once again struck a blow against the solar red chain. The most eye-catching requirement is that imported polycrystalline silicon and its derived solar cells and modules from the United States must be subject to "minimum selling price" regulations and cannot blindly bargain for market share. The industry describes this as a "price guarantee policy." It will not only weaken the original price competition of mainland manufacturers, but also is expected to prompt American customers to increase their purchases of products from Taiwanese manufacturers.

summary_en: Good news is coming to the panel market. TrendForce released its latest quotation forecast yesterday (5th). After brand customers experienced adjustments at the end of the second quarter, they began to stock up for the peak season at the end of the year. IT panel prices are also stable. The industry believes that this will create a favorable environment for AUO and Innolux, and prepare to seize business opportunities during the peak season.

summary_en: Taiwan stocks rebounded strongly, driving leveraged ETFs to perform well. Qunyi Taiwan Weighted Positive 2 (00685L) and Cathay Pacific Taiwan Weighted Positive 2 (00663L) have benefited from the index's rise. They have strengthened simultaneously recently, and their trading volume has also increased significantly. They have become important tools for active investors to plan for the rebound of Taiwan stocks. However, leveraged ETFs have high volatility and are suitable for short-term operations. Investors must still pay attention to the risk of market shocks.

summary_en: BizLink-KY (3665) benefited from strong global demand for AI servers and high-performance computing (HPC), and its operating performance was outstanding. The legal person stated that as the proportion of high-gross-profit AI products increases, the company's gross profit margin and profit simultaneously reach new highs, and the industry expansion trend is clear.

title: 川普：美國通膨下滑、股市上漲，叫停加州電動車強制令並示好馬斯克
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，美國總統川普在拉斯維加斯發表談話時，強調美國通膨正在下滑，並稱讚股市持續上漲，藉此宣揚其政府的經濟政策成果。談到汽車政策時，川普提及叫停加州電動汽車強制令，並聲稱「我們都愛馬斯克」，公開向特斯拉執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)示好。川普政府一向反對以強制性規定推動電動汽車普及，主張由消費者自行選擇燃油車、油電混合車或純電動車。川普此次將取消相關規定與馬斯克並列談論，也凸顯雙方關係在歷經波折後再度受到市場關注。川普同時批評加拿大領導層「非常糟糕」，但未進一步說明所指事項。相關言論顯示，美加貿易及政治關係仍存在摩擦，而川普正以通膨降溫、股市走高與放寬監管，作為其經濟論述的主要支柱。

title_en: If the carcinogenic oil does not exceed 20%, does it need to be removed from the shelves? Food and Drug Administration releases minutes of expert meeting "E experts oppose against the wind"
summary_en: The Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare released the minutes of the July 4 meeting at around 8:00 pm today. At the meeting, the Ministry of Health and Welfare decided that products with less than 20% carcinogenic oil should not be removed from the shelves, which was controversial. According to the minutes of the meeting, when discussing the removal of doubtful products, a G expert first proposed that based on the detected concentration of 8.1 ppb benzene pyrene, 20% of the fat content of packaged food can be converted into a benzene pyrene concentration of less than 2 ppb. Theoretically, there is no risk. Subsequently, many experts agreed. Only E expert believed that the difference in intake was not taken into account, which may cause other disputes.

title: 伊朗首揭荷姆茲新方案，擬收貨值5%-7%過境費、美國反對

summary_en: Precision components factory Chifu Precision (6829) has received a wave of orders, and its business has continued to heat up this year. title: 富邦金首度與集團工會簽署團體協約，強化員工保障共創勞資雙贏
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】富邦金控(2881)昨（5）日與富邦金控集團工會正式簽署團體協約，由富邦金控副董事長曾銘宗與集團工會理事長吳曉文代表勞資雙方完成簽署。勞動部勞動關係司司長王厚偉、臺北市政府勞動局副局長梁蒼淇、全國金融業工會聯合總會理事長鍾馥吉及秘書長韓仕賢等貴賓共同見證，象徵富邦金控勞資關係邁向新的里程碑。富邦金控自2015年起，富邦金控轄下子公司陸續與工會簽訂團體協約，包括台北富邦銀行、富邦證券、富邦期貨、富邦產險及富邦人壽等，富邦金控是台灣擁有最多子公司簽署團體協約的金控公司。本次金控簽署團體協約，再次展現公司長期重視員工權益、深化勞資合作及落實企業永續發展的具體成果。富邦金控副董事長曾銘宗表示，穩定和諧的勞資關係是企業永續發展的重要基石。透過本次團體協約的簽訂，富邦金控將進一步以更制度化、具體化的方式，提升並保障員工福利，包括：將端午及中秋節金提高20%；同時，將員工持股信託納入協約內容，員工每月可依職等級距提撥2,000元至8,000元定額自提金，公司亦100%相對提撥同等金額至員工持股信託專戶，讓同仁能共享企業成長成果。未來，富邦金控將持續秉持「互信、尊重與合作」

title: 貿聯-KY 7月營收再衝新高，HPC、半導體挹注長期成長動能
summary: 【財訊快報／記者陳浩寧報導】貿聯-KY(3665)7月營收96.30億元，月增13.05%，年增59.59%，再創單月歷史新高，已連續兩個月刷新新高紀錄；累計1-7月營收537.41億元，較去年同期增加37.93%，亦為同期新高點。貿聯-KY表示，自最近一次法說會以來，整體客戶需求趨勢及中長期展望並無重大變化。每月營收表現仍可能受出貨時程、客戶驗證進度、產品轉換及正常營運波動等因素影響，而非反映基本需求的改變。展望後市，貿聯-KY提到，客戶互動及長期基礎建設投資趨勢仍具建設性，高效能運算（HPC）及半導體設備等長期成長動能，亦持續符合於法說會所說明之整體產業與業務發展方向。

title: 阮經天走過喪母之痛與4個月幽暗拍攝：真正能拯救自己的，永遠只有自己
summary: 台北初夏午後，陽光穿過窗，在地上留下斑駁長影。拍攝現場，阮經天幾乎沒有停下；音樂響起，他和攝影師確認視線、討論畫面，偶爾低頭沉思，下一秒又迅速切換情緒。每次快門落下前，他都像在等待某個瞬間自然發生。鏡頭前，他熟悉如何進入狀態；鏡頭外，少了銀幕上凌厲的爆發力，多了被時間淘洗過的沉靜。現場發生的一切，都是創作「拍照對我來講，跟演戲是一樣的。」阮經天說，事前會先準備，透過前置參與，預想自己如何進入狀況，「可是很多時候，表演還是要看當下的感受。真正開始拍攝後，我還是相信現場，因為所有當下發生的一切，都是創作的一部分。」他把每次相遇、每個人的反應都視為表演元素；無法預期的片刻，往往更接近真實。這份相信，也延伸到他20多年的演藝生涯。不少人覺得，演員走到某個階段，下一步就是當導演或轉往幕後，但他沒有急著設定答案。「導演要理解人的性格，也要懂音樂、美術、攝影、剪接、鏡頭，缺一不可。也許有一天我會想嘗試，但這是一門必須慢慢準備的功課。」對他來說，這不是能立刻完成的身分轉換。「我們從小常被問，以後想做什麼？大家很容易給出一個漂亮的答案。可是我覺得，人最重要的是對每一個當下誠實。」人生不一定要沿

title_en: Ethan Ruan went through the pain of losing his mother and 4 months of dark filming: The only one who can truly save himself is himself.
summary_en: On an early summer afternoon in Taipei, the sun shines through the window, leaving long mottled shadows on the ground. During the shooting scene, Ethan Ruan almost never stopped; as the music played, he and the photographer checked their sights, discussed the scene, occasionally lowered his head in contemplation, and then quickly switched emotions the next second. Every time before the shutter falls, he seems to be waiting for a moment to happen naturally. In front of the camera, he is familiar with how to get into the state; outside the camera, there is less explosive power on the screen and more calmness washed away by time. Everything that happens on set is a creation. "For me, taking pictures is the same as acting." Ethan Ruan said that he prepares in advance and anticipates how he will enter the situation through pre-production participation. "But many times, performance still depends on the feeling of the moment. After actually starting to shoot, I still believe in the scene, because everything that happens at the moment is part of the creation." He regards every encounter and everyone's reaction as elements of performance; unpredictable moments are often closer to reality. This belief also extends to his acting career of more than 20 years. Many people think that when an actor reaches a certain stage, the next step is to become a director or move behind the scenes, but he did not rush to set the answer. "A director must understand people's personalities, as well as music, art, photography, editing, and lenses. They are all indispensable. Maybe one day I will want to try it, but this is a task that must be prepared slowly." For him, this is not an identity change that can be completed immediately. "We are often asked when we are young, what do we want to do in the future? It is easy for everyone to give a beautiful answer. But I think the most important thing for people is to be honest about every moment." Life does not have to follow the same path.

title_en: I didn’t take it seriously after having acne. After many years of swelling and pain, I urgently sought medical treatment. The doctor drained the pus and removed it and the disease healed.
summary_en: A 63-year-old man discovered a small subcutaneous lump on his upper back many years ago. Although it gradually grew in size, it was neither painful nor itchy. Unexpectedly, it suddenly grew in size recently and was accompanied by redness, swelling, pain and a peculiar smell, so he sought medical attention. Huang Jiyi, a plastic surgeon at Keelung Hospital of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, said today that the patient was diagnosed with a powdery tumor complicated by inflammation and infection, and the patient was treated with incision and drainage of pus and antibiotics. After the acute infection was controlled, he underwent resection and recovered.

title_en: It’s so hot that I’m going to suffer from heatstroke! Doctors warn "4 common ways to cool down" may damage nerves, and some people may have heart attacks
summary_en: Reporter Wu Peijun: The summer heat can lead to heat stroke. Many people’s instinct is to apply ice and blow cold wind, but they ignore cases of frostbite on the skin, nerve damage, and even permanent scars. Xie Bingxian, attending physician at the Department of Neurosurgery, Yangming Jiaotong University Affiliated Hospital, shared four key reminders to properly cool down and avoid frostbite in summer! 1. Apply ice packs directly to the skin: Be careful of skin frostbite. Many people put ice packs directly on their skin after exercise or have a fever, thinking that the longer they are applied, the less swelling and fever they will reduce. As a result, the skin turns from red to white, and from white to purple, which is the process of frostbite! ▲Correct approach: "Be sure to wrap a towel or cloth outside the ice pack." Apply ice pack a layer apart before touching the skin. Apply ice for no more than 15 to 20 minutes at a time. After removing it, allow the skin to warm up for at least 20 minutes before repeating. Stop immediately if you feel numbness or loss of sensation in your skin - numbness is not a comfort, it is a warning that the nerves are already damaged. 2. Spray cold spray on the skin: Beware of contact frostbite and sports injuries. Commonly used cold sprays (such as ethyl chloride spray) can cause the temperature to drop to dozens of degrees below zero in an instant! If you do not keep an appropriate distance, your skin will easily suffer "instant frostbite". Epidermal cells will rupture and become necrotic, and the wound will be more serious than the original sports injury. ▲Correct approach: Spray at least 15 to 20 centimeters away from the skin, no more than 3 to 5 seconds each time, and never spray the same area repeatedly. 3. Long-term use of cooling patches, antipyretic patches, and cooling towels: Cooling devices can also damage the skin. Many people think that antipyretic patches, mint cooling patches, cooling ice towels, and cooling gel pads are "milder" and can be used for a long time.

title_en: Be careful if your myopia exceeds 600 degrees! Ophthalmologists warn about 4 dangerous habits that may damage the retina
summary_en: Reporter Wu Peijun If your myopia degree exceeds 600 degrees, ophthalmologists will often advise you on many daily precautions. In this regard, Dean Jingmin of the Department of Ophthalmology shares 4 daily risks that highly myopic people must pay attention to, so that you can understand why these behaviors may put your eyes in danger! Four major risks: Understand the invisible landmines of high myopia. Early prevention and protection of vision. 1. Prolonged exposure to the sun without wearing sunglasses: Ultraviolet rays accelerate macular degeneration. People with high myopia have longer eye axes, so the retina and macula are inherently more fragile than the average person. When you spend a long time in high-reflective environments such as the sun, snow, or the beach without any protection, ultraviolet rays will accelerate the degeneration of macular pigment cells and increase the risk of macular degeneration. This process is slow and silent, and by the time you notice blurred vision, irreversible damage has often been caused. It is recommended that people with high myopia wear anti-UV400 sunglasses when going out, especially between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m. when ultraviolet rays are strongest. Wear them whenever you can. 2. Rub your eyes: Small actions can lead to big disasters. You may not have thought that rubbing your eyes vigorously is extremely dangerous for people with high myopia! The moment you rub your eyes, you will exert direct mechanical pressure on the eyeballs, causing unnecessary pulling on the already thin retina. 3. Lower your head and slide your phone for a long time: the vitreous body pulls on the retina early. The vitreous body of highly myopic patients liquefies earlier than the average person and is more likely to collapse. When you lower your head for a long time and turn your eyes downward, the liquefied vitreous body will cause abnormal pulling on the lower part of the retina.

title_en: Don’t drink this kind of coffee in the morning! Cardiologist Reveals 5 Habits of Morning Sadness
summary_en: Reporter Li Zhengchun Many people pay attention to what to eat at night and what foods to avoid before going to bed, but they ignore the "morning habits" at the beginning of the day, which may actually affect cardiovascular health. Dr. Sanjay Bhojraj, a cardiologist and founder of the Laguna Institute of Functional Medicine, reminds that early morning is an important time for the human body to transition from a resting state to an active mode. At this time, cortisol rises, blood pressure gradually increases, and the heartbeat speeds up. The cardiovascular system is facing regulatory challenges throughout the day. Studies have found that cardiovascular events such as myocardial infarction and sudden death have a higher incidence within a few hours after waking up in the morning. Therefore, breakfast content, drinking habits, as well as mood and life rhythm after getting up deserve special attention. Don’t rush to drink “sweet coffee” in the morning, as blood sugar may fluctuate rapidly. Many people are accustomed to relying on coffee to wake them up in the morning, but Dr. Sanjay Bhojraj reminds that sugary coffee drinks may have hidden health risks. Some large flavored lattes may contain a lot of sugar. Drinking them on an empty stomach can easily cause blood sugar to rise rapidly and stimulate a large amount of insulin secretion. Although you feel better in a short period of time, you may feel tired and hungry again after your blood sugar drops rapidly, which will increase your metabolic burden in the long run. If you need to drink coffee, it is recommended to avoid too much syrup, cream and other additives. You can also replenish water first or have a protein-containing breakfast to reduce drastic changes in blood sugar. Breakfast pastries are convenient and delicious. title: 吃紅肉會短命？阿根廷人狂嗑牛肉，心血管死亡率竟比美國低
summary:
面對這些爭議，大規模研究提供了更細緻的見解。曾嶔元引述2019年發表的一項研究報告，該研究分析了超過603萬名受試者的數據，結果顯示，支持少吃紅肉可降低心血管死亡率的證據確定性非常低。此外，研究並未發現少吃紅肉對於乳癌、大腸直腸癌、食道癌、肝癌、卵巢癌、攝護腺癌和胃癌的死亡率有統計學上的顯著影響。

或許雞肉或魚類等瘦肉是更為健康的選擇，但這並不意味著你必須對紅肉避之唯恐不及。畢竟，你的健康狀態從來都不是由飲食中單一類型的食物所決定，而是受到整體飲食模式與生活習慣的綜合影響。

title_en: Will eating red meat shorten your life? Argentinians are crazy about beef, and their cardiovascular mortality rate is actually lower than that in the United States
summary_en:
In the face of these controversies, large-scale studies have provided more nuanced insights. Zeng Jinyuan cited a research report published in 2019, which analyzed data from more than 6.03 million subjects. The results showed that the certainty of evidence supporting that eating less red meat can reduce cardiovascular mortality is very low. In addition, the study did not find a statistically significant effect of eating less red meat on mortality from breast, colorectal, esophageal, liver, ovarian, prostate, and stomach cancers.

Maybe lean meats like chicken or fish are healthier options, but that doesn't mean you have to avoid red meat. After all, your health is never determined by a single type of food in your diet, but by the comprehensive impact of your overall eating pattern and lifestyle habits.

title_en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare released the minutes of the meeting on July 4. The Food Safety Office said in the meeting that the removal of the second tier from the shelves may affect the third and fourth tier products.
summary_en: More than a month after the China United Oils and Fats case broke out, the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare released the minutes of an expert meeting on July 4 in the evening. The meeting was controversial because it concluded that products using less than 20% of carcinogenic oils do not need to be removed from the shelves. According to the record, Xu Fu, director of the Executive Yuan’s Office of Food Safety, attended the meeting and expressed his opinions on the scope of product removals of concern. He suggested requiring second-tier product manufacturers to independently identify benzene and pyrene. If they do not meet the standards, they will be removed from the shelves for recycling. "If all second-tier processed products are required to be removed from the shelves, the third and fourth-tier products will also be implicated."

title_en: An insider was exposed in the procurement of Kucha cancer oil. Weijia International used fake certificates from small farmers in Taiwan to import inferior oil from mainland China. Two people were detained.
summary_en: Weijia International imported low-quality bitter tea seeds from mainland China and mixed them with Taiwanese bitter tea seeds, and then entrusted Yuanchun Oil Refining Factory to make black tea bitter tea oil for sale. The Taipei District Prosecutor's Office searched and interviewed seven people yesterday. The prosecutor found that Weijia International's purchasing staff Chen Zhongxiuhui was involved in collusion and matchmaking. Chen Yunong, the man behind the counterfeit oil, knew clearly that he was purchasing cheap tea seeds from the mainland, but he used fake photos of "Taiwanese small farmers" to claim to Yongfeng Yusheng that the origin was Taiwan, and then transferred the price difference. Prosecutors charged the two with conspiracy to commit suicide, and the court ruled in the evening that they were detained.

summary_en: Typhoon "White Dolphin" is approaching and may bring heavy rains. The Taipei City Government has deployed anti-typhoon preparations in advance. As of 11 a.m. today, the water level of Feicui Reservoir is 12.17 meters away from the full water level. Nearly 30% of the storage capacity is reserved. title_en: 0050: Do you want to sell it if the profit exceeds 12 million yuan? Guo Zherong reveals the starting point
summary_en: Guo Zherong, chief investment officer of Moore Investment Consulting, said that the Taiwan stock market showed an astonishing V-shaped reversal momentum. It rebounded sharply from the low point by nearly 5,000 points in just four trading days. The market sentiment changed like a sauna. Yesterday's drop made many people feel like they were going to the ICU. Today's surge made people want to go to KTV to party. Judging from the trend of the broader market, the worst situation for Taiwan stocks has passed. This year's goal will still be steadily moving towards 50,000 points, and there will be more opportunities to challenge the 100,000-point mark in the next four years. Last week, the Taiwan stock market fell below 40,000 points. I decisively spent 100 million yuan to buy 0050. At that time, many people were waiting to see the joke. When the stock price hit the limit, I made tens of millions of yuan, and everyone said it was awesome. As of today, 0050’s cumulative profit has officially exceeded 12 million yuan. Many people are concerned about whether I will take advantage of the high profits to exit the market? I can tell you clearly that we will not liquidate in the short term at present, and we will wait until at least 50,000 points or even 60,000 points before considering taking profits. Investors must establish a correct mentality. It is "a pity" not to buy at 43,000 points before, it is "poor" not to dare to buy when it reaches 47,000 points, and it is "pathetic" to wait until it reaches 50,000 points before chasing higher. 雙北捷運萬大線工程再邁進一步！台北市長蔣萬安昨（3日）與新北市長侯友宜一同搭乘萬大線測試列車，從LG08A莒光站前往LG07連城錦和站，見證主線動態測試成果。未來通車後，中正紀念堂站至中和高中站車程可望由40分鐘縮短至14分鐘，提升雙北通勤的便利性。
蔣萬安表示，萬大線是串聯雙北的重要捷運建設，路線將連接台北市中正區、萬華區，以及新北市永和區、中和區、土城區等生活圈，並可轉乘淡水信義線、松山新店線及環狀線，有助完善雙北捷運路網，朝30分鐘共同生活圈目標邁進。

summary_en: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell sharply in July, starting from a high of 14,655 points on June 22, and stopped falling all the way to 11,194 points on July 17. The band fell as much as 23.6%. Domestic semiconductor stocks also plummeted. Many investors are worried that semiconductor stocks will enter a bear market. However, the investment bank pointed out that after the four major U.S. cloud giants successively released their latest financial reports, AI The amount of capital expenditures continues to increase, indicating that the demand for AI is strong and the mid- to long-term growth trend remains unchanged. The overall sharp decline in semiconductor stocks in July can be regarded as a periodic high point correction bottom. It is recommended that investors focus on the mid- to long-term growth potential of AI and take advantage of the stock price fluctuations in August to deploy semiconductor-related ETFs or funds in batches to grasp the relative lows after the discount wave of stock prices and welcome the dream market of Taiwanese stocks in the fourth quarter.

title_en: Xiluo bids farewell to the "Fruit and Vegetable Floating River" and is expected to open a food waste treatment plant with a daily capacity of 15 tons
summary_en: Xiluo Town, Yunlin County, is an important vegetable producing area in China. However, whenever vegetable prices are low, vegetable waste is arbitrarily discarded in drainage ditches, forming a "fruit and vegetable drifting river", which has been criticized by the local government for many years. The central and Yunlin County governments have subsidized more than 13 million yuan to build a raw food waste treatment plant in Xiluo Town. It was opened today and can process up to 15 tons of raw food waste per day. In the initial stage, the raw food waste from households and schools will be treated first. If the capacity is sufficient in the future, it will also be evaluated to open farms and cooperatives to pay for use, so as to reduce the problem of food waste and agricultural waste from the source.

title: 《能源管理法》修正案初審通過 新增用電設備才須自設發電或儲能
summary: 立法院經濟委員會5日審查通過《能源管理法》修正草案，其中最受關注的用電大戶須自設發電及儲能設備條文已從善如流，將原「自用發電設備及儲能設備」改為「自用發電設備或儲能設備」，並將對象限於能源用戶新設或增設用電設備容量達規定容量者適用。

title_en: The amendment to the "Energy Management Law" passed the preliminary review. Only new electrical equipment must set up its own power generation or energy storage
summary_en: The Economic Committee of the Legislative Yuan reviewed and passed the draft amendment to the "Energy Management Law" on the 5th. Among them, the most concerned clause that large electricity consumers must install their own power generation and energy storage equipment has been improved. The original "self-use power generation equipment and energy storage equipment" was changed to "self-use power generation equipment or energy storage equipment", and it is only applicable to energy users who have newly built or added power equipment with a capacity of up to the specified capacity.

title_en: China Financial Report/Low-price inventory helps turn profit in the first half of the year. PVC market conditions are expected to improve in the middle of the third quarter
summary_en: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) major Huaxia (1305) announced its second quarter and first half financial results on the 4th. Net earnings per share (EPS) in the second quarter were 0.23 yuan, which was a profit compared with the previous quarter and the same period last year. Net profit after tax in the first half of the year was 12.36 million yuan, and net earnings per share (EPS) was 0.02 yuan, which was also a profit compared with the same period last year. Looking forward to the market outlook, China believes that with the arrival of India's peak season and the emergence of inventory replenishment needs, as well as many countries successively launching anti-dumping and countervailing investigations against imported PVC, the PVC market situation is expected to gradually improve in the middle of the third quarter.

title_en: Confidence among mid-sized companies plummets. US Taiwanese Business Optimism Index for the third quarter reveals supply chain and financial confidence have cooled.
summary_en: Global business data provider Dun & Bradstreet released the Taiwan Business Optimism Insights (BOI) survey report for the third quarter of 2026. The results showed that the business optimism index for this quarter was 107, a slight decrease of 0.8% from the previous quarter, but an increase of 4.5% from the same period last year (103). The revision of business confidence this quarter mainly reflects that sales, orders and hiring intentions have become more conservative, but the attitude of companies towards profits and investment is still relatively stable, indicating that the overall prosperity is a moderate adjustment rather than a comprehensive weakening.

title_en: <Taiwan stock market opens> surged more than 1,400 points, breaking through 44,000 to regain the quarterly line, with a 5-day rebound of more than 13%
summary_en: The U.S.-Iran talks showed signs of progress, coupled with the fall in international oil prices, the four major U.S. stock indexes closed in the red. The Dow Jones and S&P 500 indexes hit highs, and the index also surged by more than 6%, inspiring Taiwan stocks to surge by more than 1,400 points in early trading today, reaching an intraday high of 44,773.87 points. In addition to regaining 44,000 points, it also recovered its monthly and quarterly lines simultaneously, with an estimated trading volume of 1.35 trillion.

title: 8月5日盤前／美伊協議露曙光 道瓊與標普500創新高 台股叩關季線
summary:
昨日盤勢
美國7月ISM報佳激勵美股四大指數上漲，然台股周二盤中指數猶如雲霄飛車上沖下洗，終場指數小跌但仍守穩10日均線之上，成交量放大至一兆以上。盤面電子權值股遭遇賣壓表現相對弱勢，資金往中小型AI相關如矽晶圓、PCB、石英元件、記憶體等族群流入。另外光通訊傳出磷化銦基板缺貨，加上股價之前跌深，多檔個股亮燈漲停表現強勢。

title_en: Video/Loophole in Kucha Cancer Oil Revealed, Weijia International Conflicted with Mainland China to Make Substandard Oil, 2 People Claimed, and the Person in Charge Posted a Million Dollar Bail
summary_en: Weijia International Company imported low-quality bitter tea seeds from mainland China and mixed them with Taiwanese bitter tea seeds, and then entrusted Yuanchun Oil Refining Factory to make black tea bitter tea oil for sale. Yesterday, the Bureau of Investigation searched and interviewed 7 people and brought them to the case. After the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office resumed the interview, they believed that Chen Yunong, the middleman who brokered the fake oil production, and Chen Zhongxiuhui, a procurement officer from Vega International, were suspected of serious crimes and were in danger of destroying evidence. They were detained for violating the food safety law. Jason Tu, the person in charge of Vega, posted a bail of 1 million.

title: 亞洲科技股近期急挫，小摩駁基本面轉弱，估明年AI支出達1.49兆美元

title: 印度央行連四次按兵不動、政策立場中性，估2027財年GDP增長6.7%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】印度央行週三例會後宣布，將基準利率維持在5.25%不變，符合市場預期，貨幣政策立場續為中性，六名決策委員一致支持按兵不動。央行表示，經濟成長仍具韌性，但未來數季可能逐步放緩。這是印度央行連續第4次按兵不動，上一次調整利率是在2025年12月降息25個基點，其後連續四次會議都將附買回利率維持在5.25%。這次六名票委一致投票支持利率不變，並維持中性政策立場。印度央行預估，第二季國內生產毛額(GDP)年增6.4%，第三季加快至6.5%，第四季進一步升至6.8%；2027財年經濟成長率估為6.7%。不過，季風、聖嬰現象及全球貿易情勢仍為前景帶來不確定性。通膨方面，整體通膨已如預期小幅升至目標以上，主要受到燃料與食品價格推動。央行預計，整體通膨近期仍將上升，並在第三季觸頂，但第一季實際通膨低於原先預測，為政策保留觀察空間。印度央行指出，目前成本壓力向終端價格轉嫁的程度有限，物價壓力廣泛擴散的跡象仍然微弱，核心通膨也維持溫和。這使決策者得以在通膨短期上升之際保持中性立場，後續利率方向將取決於食品與能源價格、季風表現及經濟放緩幅度。

title: 年化衝12%！「他」刷新配息紀錄　7萬人受惠
summary: 8月台股ETF配息戰火引爆，首檔主動式ETF野村臺灣優選（00980A）公告最新配息，每股預估配發0.638元，單季配息率約3%，換算年化配息率高達12%，刷新成立以來紀錄。除息日訂於8月18日，投資人最晚須於8月17日前買進。近期台股受地緣政治與外資流動影響震盪劇烈，但受惠AI基礎建設需求，總經基本面仍穩健。主動式ETF透過經理人彈性調整持股水位，能適時獲利了結並轉進防禦型價值股，在市場波動中展現攻守韌性，成為追求穩定現金流的息收型投資人理想標的。

title: 南陽實業代理PORTER II逆勢成長，奪中型貨車銷售冠軍
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】三陽工業(2206)旗下南陽實業台灣總代理HYUNDAI汽車持續耕耘中型貨車，在2026年前7月台灣中型貨車市場衰退6.2%之際，HYUNDAI PORTER II以累計銷售2536台、年增5.9%的成績逆勢成長，勇奪同期中型貨車銷售冠軍，市占率近40%，接近每十台中型貨車就有四台為PORTER II。面對市場環境變動與營運成本挑戰，生財工具的可靠度、工作效率與資金運用彈性，成為自營商與中小企業經營者的重要課題。HYUNDAI汽車持續耕耘台灣中型貨車，也展現台灣頭家對HYUNDAI商用車產品實力與服務品質的肯定。以PORTER II累積的市場信任為基礎，HYUNDAI汽車本月進一步擴大商用車應援陣容，正式推出購車專案，並由兼顧商務運輸與多元生活需求的STARIA領銜，透過資金、配備與用車保障三大面向，協助頭家降低購車負擔，穩健拓展事業。HYUNDAI汽車表示，市場環境愈具挑戰，企業經營者愈需要兼顧工作效率、資金彈性與長期用車保障。HYUNDAI汽車希望透過具競爭力的產品、完整商用車陣容及實質購車方案，成為台灣百工百業可靠的事業夥伴。

title: 紐約時報財報出爐 數位轉型與訂閱成長受考驗
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導美國知名媒體紐約時報公司（New York Times Company）今日（週三）公布第二季財報，華爾街正密切關注這家百年大報在數位轉型浪潮中，能否透過訂閱制商業模式，成功抵禦產業下行趨勢。 根據《M.investing.com》報導，分析師預計紐約時報公司第二季每股盈餘（EPS，即公司每一股賺多少錢）為 0.66 美元，營收則上看 7.505 億美元。這將分別代表年增 13.66% 與 9.42% 的成長，顯示出相較於第一季的表現有所改善。在過去 60 天內，分析師對其 EPS 預期已小幅上調 0.5%，營收預期則大致持平。 第一季財報表現強勁，紐約時報公司當時繳出每股盈餘 0.61 美元的成績，遠超出市場預期的 0.47 美元近三成，營收 7.1224 億美元也超乎預期 1.69%。這股動能讓市場對其本季表現抱持樂觀態度。 目前紐約時報公司已建立超過 1,300 萬的訂閱用戶基礎，涵蓋新聞、遊戲、烹飪以及體育報（The Athletic）等多元產品線。投資人將特別檢視其各項服務的淨新增訂戶數，以評估多角化經營策略是否足以彌補核心新聞業務面臨的

summary: 光通訊概念股近期紅燈不斷，今日更是在波若威、聯亞、聯鈞、全新、穩懋等個股漲停之下，帶動整體族群持續上攻，相關概念股如華星光、上詮也都繳出8%以上的漲幅，表現相當亮眼。啟發投顧分析師白易弘表示，目前光通訊族群在美股財報利多推升下持續有好表現，目前漲停之下，持有者續抱即可，空手者不要輕易追高。

summary_en: Weijia International Company was suspected of importing low-quality bitter tea seeds from mainland China and passing them off as Taiwanese bitter tea seeds, and then entrusted Yuanchun Oil Refining Factory to manufacture black-heart bitter camellia oil. The investigation bureau's Beiji Station and Chiayi County Station divided 17 troops to search on the 4th. They interviewed Weijia manager Tu Jason and registration manager Jin Tianli. summary_en: Chairman Huang of Pingtung Yuan Tungsten Cobalt Resources Company was brutally murdered at his home in Taiyuan Village, Fangliao Township, Pingtung County on the 24th of last month. Pingtung police spent more than 10 days pursuing the investigation and arrested 34-year-old Lin, a retired employee, in Taichung on the 4th. After late-night interrogation, the Pingtung District Prosecutor's Office determined that Lin was involved in serious crimes such as robbery and murder. He was at risk of fleeing, annihilating evidence, and colluding with witnesses, and filed a ban on him in court.

title: 緯創法說後漲逾3%改寫新天價 分析師：收盤站穩200元有困難
summary: 電子代工大廠緯創（3231）昨（4）日召開2026年第二季法說會，受惠AI伺服器需求強勁，今年上半年營收、獲利同步刷新紀錄，並釋出下半年營運正向等訊息。今（5）日股價盤中睽違2個月再度叩關200元大關，最高一度來到202.5元、上漲3.85%，改寫歷史新高。資深證券分析師蔡明翰表示，緯創法說內容符合預期偏多，但未帶來超乎市場預期的驚喜，加上股價已提前反映利多，今日上漲也有大盤走強帶動，因此要在收盤站穩200元並不容易。

title: 富國銀行：AI投資開始傳導至實體經濟，看好工業股表現
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，富國銀行方面表示，科技巨頭掀起的人工智能(AI)投資熱潮正在「向下滲透到更廣泛的經濟領域」，並有機會推動工業股進一步上漲。富國銀行策略分析師Ohsung Kwon認為，持續擴張的數據中心建設將成為工業領域的重要利多。他在週二的一份報告中表示，生產用於建造數據中心的機器、設備和工具的資本品企業目前已成為「與AI關聯度最高」的領域之一，類似於近年來深受AI浪潮帶動的半導體行業。Kwon在接受採訪時表示，近幾個月來，資本財領域已成為與半導體行業相關性最高的領域。近幾個月來，投資者開始重新追捧所謂的「舊經濟」領域，推動標普500指數內部的領漲結構發生變化。今年以來，工業類股上漲20%，表現僅次於能源和信息技術。Kwon表示，估計數據中心整體擴張面臨的最大風險是政治層面的阻力，尤其是在中期選舉臨近之際。他所指的是將於11月舉行的美國國會選舉。

title: 110家A股公司披露半年報，基礎化工、電子、醫藥生物等行業表現搶眼
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述上海證券報的報導指稱，截至8月4日20時，已有110家A股上市公司披露了半年報。其中，68家公司上半年淨利潤實現年比值成長，14家實現扭虧為盈。行業需求的穩步回暖和主營業務的穩健成長，成為驅動上市公司業績向好的主要因素。從已披露半年報的公司來看，基礎化工、電子、醫藥生物、電力設備等多個領域淨利潤實現年比值成長的公司比重較高，凸顯了相關行業的高景氣。基礎化工類股景氣度尤為突出。截至目前，類股中已有16家公司披露半年報，其中13家實現淨利潤年比值成長。電力產業鏈整體經營表現亮眼，水電是表現最亮眼、業績確定性最高的領域。同時，醫藥生物類股，在已發布半年報的11家公司中，有8家實現成長。

title: 加元面臨多重不確定性 利率與油價壓抑匯價走勢
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導近期加元兌美元（USD/CAD）匯率波動加劇，美元兌加元在過去幾個交易日中升值近0.3%。外匯市場分析師指出，由於各國央行政策、債券市場表現以及中東地緣政治等因素交織影響，導致加元前景面臨多重不確定性，短期內可能呈現盤整走勢。 央行利率差異擴大 加元承壓 美國與加拿大之間的基準利率差異，是導致加元（CAD）近期走軟的主要原因之一。目前美國基準利率為3.75%，而加拿大則為2.25%。聯準會（Federal Reserve）在今年9月升息的機率高達56.9%，可能將基準利率推升至4.00%區間；相較之下，加拿大中央銀行（Bank of Canada）則暗示不會有突襲式轉向，市場預期其在9月會議上維持2.25%利率不變的機率高達80%。這意味著，美國央行未來幾個月的政策可能比加拿大更加鷹派，將使兩國利差進一步擴大，進而加劇加元的貶值壓力，並重新點燃市場對美元兌加元（USD/CAD）的買盤動能。 油價與地緣政治雙重衝擊 中東地緣政治的最新發展也對加元走勢產生影響。美國政府決定暫停軍事行動，並恢復在中東的談判，卡達等國家已宣布談判取得進展，此舉促使西德克薩

title: 金控最高！富邦金今宣布捐1億日圓賑災熊本 蔡明興：企業社會責任不分國界
summary: 金控最高金額！日本熊本爆發7.1強震，富邦金（2881）今（5）日宣布將捐贈 1億日圓協助災後救援、受災居民生活安置及地方重建工作。富邦金控董事長蔡明興表示，台灣與日本長期維持深厚情誼，而熊本與台灣亦交流密切，富邦秉持「人飢己飢、人溺己溺」及企業社會責任不分國界的信念，為台日之間長久以來相互扶持的情誼盡一份心力。

title: 摩根資產管理認為日銀升息過慢，建議回避日本國債
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，摩根資產管理表示，相對於全球債券基準指數，減持或回避日本國債可以增加超額收益。摩根資產管理全球綜合債券業務負責人Myles Bradshaw在一個電視節目中表示，日本央行在政策正常化和升息方面依然「行動過慢」，這意味著僅靠日圓干預不太可能改變該貨幣的基本面，也不太可能實質性地減緩其貶值步伐。Bradshaw表示，美國方面的干預規模相對較小。拋售歐元買入日圓是試圖壓低美元兌日圓匯率的一種相對不尋常的方式。日本央行可能加快升息步伐，這對投資者而言顯然是一個機會。市場目前消化每六個月升息一次，這似乎是一個很低的門檻。此外，Bradshaw對美國干預日圓的目的持懷疑態度。他表示，回想美國當年干預阿根廷披索的做法，那是一次非常政治化的行動。而此次干預同樣具有濃厚的政治色彩，可能與日本作為貿易協議一部分將進行的外商直接投資(FDI)談判密切相關。上週五，美國與日本聯手買入日圓以支撐該貨幣。美國總統川普表示，這是數十年來美日首次聯手買入日圓，是「一個友誼的信號」。

summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】國際油價連續兩個交易日急挫一成後，週三亞洲電子盤初小幅反彈。布蘭特10月期油最新升0.20美元或0.3%，報每桶79.56美元；紐約9月期油漲0.05美元或0.1%，報每桶75.82美元，兩者仍徘徊在三週低點附近。油價週一及週二連續重挫，布蘭特兩日累跌約11.9%，紐約期油同期下挫約10.5%。美國、伊朗及主要斡旋方相繼表示，恢復荷姆茲海峽通航的談判取得進展，促使市場快速削減地緣風險溢價。不過，目前各方尚未正式簽署協議，伊朗仍要求掌握駛入波斯灣船舶的航行管理權，美方則主張維持自由通行。荷姆茲海峽實際油輪流量依舊偏低，OPEC產量雖在7月回升，仍遠低於戰前水準，限制油價進一步下跌空間。高盛認為，在美伊協議正式落地或戰事再度大幅升級前，布蘭特期油可能於每桶80至90美元區間波動。短線油價方向將取決於荷姆茲海峽談判能否轉化為具體通航安排，以及中東原油出口與全球商業庫存的恢復速度。

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，統計數據顯示，今年上半年，在韓國售出的電動汽車中，有超過三分之一為中國製造。根據韓國汽車移動產業協會(KAMA)週二發佈的《2026年上半年國內汽車新註冊登記現狀分析報告》，今年1月至6月在韓國新登記的中國製造電動汽車為6.9513萬輛，年比值增長178.7%，在整體新登記的電動汽車中比重由去年同期的26.8%，向上攀升至35%。根據分析，中國製造電動汽車銷量大幅增長，主要得益於特斯拉中國上海超級工廠生產的ModelY、Model3進口量走高，加上比亞迪、極星等品牌加碼韓國市場佈局。中國產汽車在韓國進口車市場話語權顯著提升。上半年中國產汽車進口7.9444萬輛，年比增加127.8%，按生產地劃分的市場佔有率達41.2%，超越德國，首度位居首位，韓國汽車移動產業協會表示，中國產電動車大量湧入韓國市場有助於推動電動車普及、拓寬消費者選項，但或加大韓國本土車商經營壓力，激化產業鏈競爭。

summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】《上海證券報》報導，進入8月消費電子新品發布旺季，以蘋果新一代產品為核心的供應鏈正加速擴大人力與產能，富士康等主要代工廠密集招募員工，為後續產能爬升及新品出貨預作準備。與往年相比，今年旺季招募不僅集中於生產線作業人員，富士康等大型代工廠也持續增加工程師職缺，反映新品製程、設備調校及生產自動化對技術人才的需求同步升高。市場同時密切關注蘋果首款折疊螢幕手機的開發進度。隨著產品設計與供應鏈驗證逐步推進，折疊螢幕、精密結構件、鉸鏈及機身材料等關鍵零組件供應商，正進入研發攻關與產能建設的重要階段。藍思科技、精研科技等蘋果供應鏈業者已加快技術開發、擴充產線及準備量產交付。業界認為，若蘋果折疊手機按計畫推進，除可帶動代工需求，也可能推升高階螢幕、精密加工及新型材料等零組件的單機價值。

summary_en: Mainland China's Shenzhen Huaqiangbei Market announced the latest weekly DRAM quotation yesterday (4th), ending the relatively tepid trend in the past half year. The main specifications have increased across the board, with a single-week surge of about 10% to 14%, performing a "great resurrection" drama, a rare sharp rise this year, which will help Taiwan's DRAM-related market prospects such as Nanya, Winbond, ADATA, Transcend, Team Group, and Apacer.

title_en: Nanya's performance in July is excellent, one month is worth one year
summary_en: Nanya, a major DRAM manufacturer under the Formosa Plastics Group, announced yesterday (4) that its consolidated revenue in July exceeded the 40 billion yuan mark for the first time, reaching 43.868 billion yuan, setting a new monthly high for nine consecutive months, with a monthly increase of 49.26%, and a 7.2-fold increase over the same period last year; the consolidated revenue in the first seven months was 175.504 billion yuan, an annual increase of 660.87%.

summary_en: Huang Chongren, the founder of Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd., passed away suddenly on July 31. In an exclusive interview before his death, he mentioned that Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. would "operate steadily" in the future. Xie Zaiju, acting chairman of Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd., said yesterday (4th) that he would follow the direction set by Huang Chongren and that in the future, Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. would be more steady and conservative and would not be aggressive.

title_en: U.S. JOLTS job openings fell to 7.359 million in June, but hiring increased slightly
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that newly released data showed that the number of job vacancies in the United States fell back in June, but the number of job openings increased slightly, indicating that the overall demand for corporate manpower remained stable after entering the summer. Data released by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics on Tuesday showed that the number of job openings fell to 7.359 million in June from 7.537 million in May. The number of layoffs changed little. The decrease in job vacancies was mainly driven by lower recruitment demand in the healthcare, leisure and hotel industries, wholesale trade, and business services. Job vacancies increased in the transportation and warehousing industry. Federal government job openings rose to their highest level since late 2024. The report released on Tuesday reflects that the U.S. labor market is stable and layoffs are limited. Consumer spending remains resilient and continues to support corporate hiring plans, although some companies remain cautious in expanding their workforce. The increase in hiring was mainly driven by the health care and construction industries. Recruitment in the leisure and hotel industry fell for the third consecutive month to the lowest level since early 2025, undermining previous market expectations that the World Cup would drive demand for manpower. The report also shows that the number of job vacancies corresponding to each unemployed person has basically remained unchanged at 1:1. This indicator is an important reference that the Federal Reserve pays close attention to and uses to measure the balance between labor supply and demand. At the peak in 2022, this ratio reached 2:1. While the report showed little change in overall layoffs in June, layoffs increased in the professional and business services and entertainment and leisure industries. title: 沙烏地阿美：美伊戰爭令全球損失逾26億桶原油，庫存回補恐需18個月
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，沙烏地阿拉伯國營石油公司沙烏地阿美(Saudi Aramco)執行長納瑟爾(Amin Nasser)週二表示，自2月美國與以色列對伊朗開戰以來，全球市場已損失超過26億桶原油。儘管產油國採取緊急措施緩和衝擊，全球原油庫存仍快速下降，供應情勢持續吃緊。26億桶約相當於全球近一個月的正常原油產量，反映荷姆茲海峽關閉對能源供應造成的嚴重衝擊。納瑟爾警告，即使荷姆茲海峽立即恢復通航，按照每日回補210萬桶的平均速度計算，仍需長達18個月才能補回已消耗的庫存。供應中斷的範圍也有進一步擴大之虞。親伊朗的葉門胡塞武裝上月宣布封鎖沙烏地阿拉伯石油產業，並攻擊沙國兩座紅海港口的石油設施，使原本作為波斯灣替代出口通道的紅海航線承受更大壓力，也令海灣戰事擴展至第二條能源運輸戰線。納瑟爾證實，近期針對沙烏地阿美設施的襲擊確實造成部分生產中斷，但公司有信心迅速恢復營運。他強調，相關攻擊迄今未對沙烏地阿美的整體營運或財務狀況造成實質影響，不過在荷姆茲海峽與紅海航線同時受阻下，全球能源供應安全仍面臨高度不確定性。

title_en: Saudi Aramco: The U.S.-Iran war has cost the world more than 2.6 billion barrels of crude oil, and it may take 18 months to replenish inventories
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Chen Mengshuo] Foreign reports said that the global market has lost more than 2.6 billion barrels of crude oil since the United States and Israel launched a war against Iran in February, Amin Nasser, CEO of Saudi Arabia's state-owned oil company Saudi Aramco, said on Tuesday. Although oil-producing countries have taken emergency measures to mitigate the impact, global crude oil inventories are still declining rapidly and the supply situation continues to be tight. 2.6 billion barrels is approximately equivalent to the world’s normal crude oil production in the past month, reflecting the serious impact of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz on energy supply. Nasser warned that even if navigation in the Strait of Hormuz was restored immediately, it would still take up to 18 months to replenish the depleted stocks based on the average daily replenishment rate of 2.1 million barrels. The scope of supply disruptions is also likely to expand further. Last month, the pro-Iranian Yemeni Houthi armed forces announced a blockade of Saudi Arabia's oil industry and attacked oil facilities at two Saudi Red Sea ports. This put greater pressure on the Red Sea route, which was originally an alternative export channel to the Persian Gulf, and expanded the Gulf war to a second energy transportation front. Nasser confirmed that recent attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities had indeed caused some production disruptions, but the company was confident of quickly resuming operations. He emphasized that the relevant attacks have so far not had a substantial impact on Saudi Aramco’s overall operations or financial status. However, with the Strait of Hormuz and the Red Sea routes blocked at the same time, global energy supply security still faces a high degree of uncertainty.

title: 天兵蘋果？OpenAI公開對話紀錄揭2烏龍　諷洩密提告「草率又莫名其妙」
summary: 蘋果（Apple）向美國法院聲請初步禁制令，指控OpenAI與兩名前蘋果員工竊取商業機密。OpenAI短短幾小時就火速反擊，不僅全面否認指控，更罕見公開iMessage對話紀錄與電子郵件，反過來曝光蘋果兩大烏龍，包括離職員工權限管理漏洞，以及法律團隊姓氏傻傻分不清記錯信，且沉寂五個月突然轉頭代表蘋果提告。OpenAI直批，這起訴訟「草率、咄咄逼人，而且莫名其妙地針對個人」（careless, aggressive and oddly personal）。

title: OPEC 7月原油日產量增116萬桶至1,944萬桶，仍遠低於戰前水準
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電引述最新調查顯示，石油輸出國組織(OPEC)7月原油日產量較前月增加116萬桶，平均達1,944萬桶，增量幾乎全部來自伊拉克、科威特及沙烏地阿拉伯。儘管供應逐步修復，美伊戰事持續干擾波斯灣航運，OPEC整體產量仍遠低於戰前水準。伊拉克7月日產量增加46萬桶至230萬桶，增幅居成員國之首；受南部巴士拉港裝載量回升帶動，當月油輪運輸量月增37%。科威特日產量增加36萬桶至157萬桶，回升至衝突爆發以來最高月均水準；沙烏地阿拉伯則增加39萬桶至740萬桶，但與戰前產量相比仍有數百萬桶缺口。荷姆茲海峽可追蹤的油輪通行量已降至極低水準，部分出口商改以關閉船舶自動識別系統(AIS)，再於較安全海域進行船對船轉運，增加實際產量與出口數據的統計難度。另一方面，中東產油國通常在夏季增產並直接燃燒部分原油發電，以滿足空調使用帶來的用電高峰，因此7月產量增加不全然代表可供出口的原油同步上升。OPEC與盟國主要成員上週末同意再次小幅提高產量配額，完成對2023年減產措施的全面逆轉。然而，在中東大量產能仍處於停產、荷姆茲海峽通行受阻，以及胡塞武裝持續威脅沙國所倚賴的紅海替代航線下，新增配

title: 美伊荷姆茲臨時協議露曙光，卡達稱提案草案已在各方傳閱
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，美國與伊朗就恢復荷姆茲海峽通航達成臨時協議的可能性週二升高。主要斡旋方卡達表示，一份旨在緩和局勢的提案草案已在各方之間傳閱；美國國務卿魯比歐(Marco Rubio)及財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)也相繼釋出樂觀訊號，認為相關協議可能很快出爐。魯比歐表示，當前最迫切且最受關注的工作，就是就荷姆茲海峽問題達成協議，相關談判已取得進展，但仍未正式敲定。貝森特則稱，美方正與伊朗方面協商，最快可能在週二或週三達成重新開放海峽的安排；對於通行船隻是否需要繳費，他強調荷姆茲海峽應維持自由通行。伊朗外交部證實，德黑蘭正與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽問題進行談判，並已在技術及政治層面取得「積極進展」。雙方目前聚焦於確定船舶安全航道及建立必要的航運管理機制，阿曼與卡達則分別協調通航、安全保障及後續外交安排。不過，卡達、美國及伊朗均強調，目前尚未完成正式協議，仍有部分執行細節有待解決。川普日前暫緩原定對伊朗發動的大規模軍事打擊，並稱這是德黑蘭避免遭受進一步攻擊的「最後機會」；在美方主張航行自由、伊朗仍要求保留海峽管理權的情況下，臨時協議能否落地仍存在變數。

title: 伊朗在荷姆茲兩大核心議題鬆動，放棄雙向全控、首度考慮歐洲排雷
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，伊朗外交部週二表示，與阿曼就荷姆茲海峽恢復通航的談判已在技術及政治層面取得「積極進展」，重點是劃定船舶安全通行航道並建立必要的航運管理機制。知情人士透露，德黑蘭已不再堅持全面控制雙向航運，並首次考慮允許歐洲國家參與排雷。依照最新討論方案，所有駛入波斯灣的船舶仍由伊朗負責航行管理；駛離波斯灣的船舶則由阿曼辦理最終放行程序，伊朗僅保留監督權及必要時的干預能力。相較先前要求取消現行國際通航安排、由伊朗全面控制進出船舶，新方案被視為德黑蘭首次在航道管理權上作出實質讓步。在排雷問題上，伊朗正考慮允許英國、法國、比利時及荷蘭等具備成熟反水雷能力的歐洲國家參與行動。這些國家並未直接加入對伊朗的軍事攻擊，因而較可能被德黑蘭接受為技術性安全參與方；相關安排也可避免美軍重新進入荷姆茲海峽，並為國際航運提供第三方安全保證。不過，航道管理、排雷國家名單及安全保障機制仍未正式敲定。卡達與阿曼正分別協調各項技術問題，美國國務卿盧比奧表示談判已有進展，但尚未達成最終協議；財政部長貝森特則稱，協議最快可能在8月4日或5日出爐。伊朗雖在兩項核心爭議上展現妥協，但仍堅持掌握進入波斯灣方向的主

title: 昱厚生技氣喘新藥AD17002二期臨床收案提前達陣，預計明年初解盲
summary: 【財訊快報／記者何美如報導】昱厚生技(6709)4日宣布，旗下自主研發之氣喘新藥AD17002，用於治療中度至重度嗜酸性白血球型氣喘的二期人體臨床試驗，提前達到所有受試者入案的重大里程碑，下一步將持續追蹤病人投藥與安全性追蹤期間的療效反應，並規劃於明年初進行解盲之數據統計分析。昱厚生技表示，本次臨床試驗招募參與情況踴躍，歸因於固有中重度氣喘治療藥物的缺乏，以致許多氣喘患者在接受長期治療後常面臨療效降低的困境，同時也顯示出患者及市場對於新機轉氣喘藥物及療法的高度期待。AD17002是一項突破性的重組蛋白藥物，主要透過鼻噴劑進行局部給藥。在作用機制上，不同於傳統藥物直接癱瘓免疫系統或僅作氣道擴張等症狀治療，AD17002是運用積極的免疫調節來緩和過度的區域過敏發炎反應。其臨床訴求包含肺功能改善、降低類固醇的使用，避免惡化及延長進入氣喘重症期。此外，該藥物更具備高安全性，無明顯副作用及抗藥性。在全球市場潛力方面，氣喘治療領域具備極大的成長空間。根據國際知名研調機構Precedence Research的報告數據指出，全球氣喘治療市場規模在2024年已達282.8億美元，並預計在2034年將成

title: 國邑*旗下普元生技吸入裝置取TFDA許可，助攻L606全球布局
summary: 【財訊快報／記者何美如報導】甫納入國邑*(6875)集團的子公司普元生技傳出好消息，自主開發之智慧型呼吸引動吸入裝置（專案代碼：PN105），以自有品牌「邑普能」，取得衛生福利部食品藥物管理署（TFDA）第二等級醫療器材許可證。國邑*以「藥物劑型」為核心、普元生技以「精準給藥器械」為核心，雙方共同建構藥械合一雙平台，此次取證是普元生技納入國邑集團後的首項法規成果，代表雙平台由策略布局進入商業化階段。國邑*表示，「邑普能」已完成L606未來在台灣上市所需的器械準備，也為L606的全球商業化提供完整的產品方案，後續亦將配合L606全球市場推進時程，提前布局各主要市場醫材認證，完善全球商業化準備。在L606的全球市場上，「邑普能」將依不同市場模式發揮不同商業價值，針對亞洲尚未授權市場（如中國大陸、韓國），授權對象取得的不只是藥品，而是完整的藥械合一產品方案，可縮短上市準備時程，降低開發成本，提升授權價值與談判優勢。中東及土耳其市場則由Menagen擔任經銷夥伴，待L606取得當地上市許可後，國國邑*將直接供應藥品及「邑普能」，相關產品銷售將成為集團自有營收來源，建立授權收入以外的產品銷售模式

title: 美伊談判傳進展 道瓊、標普指數創高 記憶體股閃迪飆漲逾一成
summary: 商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導美國股市週二表現強勁，道瓊工業平均指數與標準普爾500指數雙雙創下歷史新高。這股漲勢主要受美國與伊朗之間談判進展的樂觀情緒，以及記憶體相關科技股如閃迪公司（SanDisk）股價飆升的帶動。 截至昨日收盤，道瓊工業平均指數上漲1.71%，報54,084.99點；標準普爾500指數上揚1.79%，報7,736.52點；納斯達克綜合指數則攀升2.59%至26,584.99點。在盤中（指股票市場交易進行時段）漲勢中，數據分析公司 Palantir 受惠於優於預期的第二季財報，股價大漲29.45%，該公司第二季營收年增93%達19.4億美元，調整後每股盈餘（EPS，即公司每一股賺多少錢）為41美分，皆超越市場預期。邁威爾科技（Marvell Technology）也因推出新的 AI 記憶體基礎架構產品線而上揚12.81%。 市場對美國與伊朗達成協議的期望提高，壓低了油價，進而提振了市場的風險偏好。美國財政部長 Scott Bessent 表示，美國與伊朗可能「明日」就能達成開放荷莫茲海峽的協議。荷莫茲海峽是連結波斯灣與阿曼灣的關鍵航運要道，其開放將有助於穩定原油供應。

title: 歐洲 Stoxx 600 指數創新高 企業獲利與科技股成漲勢主力
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜葉安庭／綜合外電報導歐洲股市週二（8月4日）表現強勁，泛歐股市基準 Stoxx Europe 600 指數收盤上漲 0.7%，達到 656.86 點的歷史新高。此波漲勢延續數月來的動能，並超越今年七月初創下的前次紀錄，主要由企業獲利表現亮眼以及科技股的強勢上揚所帶動。 盛寶銀行（Saxo Bank）投資策略師 Ruben Dalfovo 指出，歐股指數自上月底以來便持續挑戰歷史高點，過去數月也呈現連續成長，其中企業獲利增加是推升股市的主要原因之一。隨著歐洲財報季逐漸白熱化，投資人正仔細檢視各公司財報，以掌握區域經濟前景的線索。 個別企業表現方面，德國製藥與化工巨頭拜耳（Bayer）在公布意外成長 1.9% 的季度營業利潤後，股價上揚 2.4%。半導體產業是另一大亮點，整體科技類股上漲 2.8%。其中，貝思半導體（BE Semiconductor）在貝倫貝格銀行（Berenberg）將其股票評級調升至「買入」後，大漲 8.1%，該銀行認為近期市場疲軟創造了具吸引力的入場點。Soitec 股價勁揚 9.9%，愛思強（Aixtron）、艾司摩爾（ASML）及英飛凌（Infi

title: 美國6月貿易逆差收窄5.6%至733億美元，進口出現年初以來首降
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，由於進口出現年初以來首次下降且呈現普遍回落態勢，美國6月份貿易赤字有所收窄。美國商務部週二公佈的數據顯示，6月份商品和服務貿易逆差較前月收窄5.6%，至733億美元。當月，進口下降1.8%，出口下降0.9%。這份貿易數據為第二季畫上句號，也表明進出口貿易繼續拖累美國經濟成長。受關稅政策反覆調整、中東戰爭擾亂貿易，以及人工智能投資熱潮等因素影響，美國貿易數據近幾個月波動較大。儘管美國最高法院在第一季推翻了多項進口關稅措施，川普政府仍在尋求透過其他途徑對進口商品徵收關稅。受企業大舉投資人工智能的推動，2025年及今年初，美國電腦、電腦外圍設備及零組件進口大幅成長。不過，最新貿易報告顯示，6月電腦和半導體進口態勢有所放緩。包含上述產品在內的資本貨物進口則自去年9月以來首次下降。

title: 川普團隊釋伊朗協議訊號 美股三大指數飆漲、油價重挫
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導美國股市昨（4）日強勁上漲，主要指數飆升至歷史新高，油價則因中東地緣政治緊張局勢可望緩解而大跌。市場樂觀情緒源於美國財政部長史考特·貝森特（Scott Bessent）的發言，以及多家企業繳出優於預期的財報表現。 史考特·貝森特昨日接受媒體採訪時表示，美國與伊朗之間可能「今天或明天」就會達成協議，重啟荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）的通航。荷莫茲海峽是連接波斯灣與阿曼灣的狹窄水道，對全球石油運輸至關重要，近期因中東衝突而備受關注。貝森特的言論一出，隨即點燃市場對通膨壓力減輕的希望，國際油價應聲下跌。西德州原油價格從每桶80美元驟降約6%，至每桶75.80美元左右；布蘭特原油價格也下跌4.9%，至每桶79.64美元。 受此消息激勵，美國股市全面走高。道瓊工業平均指數（Dow Jones Industrial Average）終場飆漲逾900點，漲幅約1.7%至1.8%；標普500（S&P 500）也上漲約1.7%至1.8%，收盤首次站上7,700點，雙雙創下歷史新高。以科技股為主的那斯達克綜合指數（Nasdaq Composite）同樣

title: 長鑫科技手機記憶體晶片取得突破，縮小與三星電子等大廠差距

title: 檢調偵辦威加進口中國苦茶籽混充案 實際負責人凃傑生移送北檢複訊

title_en: Prosecution, investigation and investigation into the case of imported Chinese bitter tea seeds from Weijia. The actual person in charge, Tu Jason, was transferred to the Beijing Procuratorate for re-examination.
summary_en: Brands such as Yongfengyu independently tested Camellia oleifera oil and found that benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard, and reported it to the Food and Drug Administration. The Taipei District Prosecutor's Office filed a case and discovered that Weijia International Company was suspected of importing Camellia Seeds from mainland China. The outer packaging was marked with Taiwan Camellia Seeds, and the purity was 100% without additives. It was suspected of false labeling and fraud. Today, in conjunction with the Chiayi District Attorney's Office, they directed the investigation bureau's Northern Area Mobile Task Force to search for Weijia Company, Yuanchun Oil Factory, and Meishan Camellia Oil Production Cooperative. In the evening, the actual person in charge of Weijia Company, Jason Tu, was transferred to the North Prosecutor's Office for re-examination.

title: 西門子EDA：AI正重新定義半導體產業的設計模式
summary: 西門子 EDA 今（4）日在新竹舉辦年度 IC 設計技術論壇 Siemens EDA Forum 2026，聚焦 AI 原生（AI-Native）設計如何深度整合至整體電子設計流程與產品生命週期，打造未來晶片與系統。論壇匯聚多位西門子 EDA 全球技術專家，以及客戶與產業夥伴，共同探討 AI 結合數位雙生與 3DIC 等關鍵技術，協助台灣半導體產業因應當下設計、驗證與系統整合的新挑戰。

title_en: Siemens EDA: AI is redefining the design model of the semiconductor industry
summary_en: Siemens EDA held the annual IC design technology forum Siemens EDA Forum 2026 in Hsinchu today (4th), focusing on how AI-Native design can be deeply integrated into the overall electronic design process and product life cycle to create future chips and systems. The forum brought together many Siemens EDA global technical experts, as well as customers and industry partners, to discuss key technologies such as AI combined with digital twins and 3DIC to help Taiwan's semiconductor industry meet the current new challenges in design, verification and system integration.

summary: 達發科技（6526）今（4）日舉行法人說明會，公布2季合併營收62.9億元，季增15.3%、年增13.9%，創單季歷史新高。相較於營收創高，市場更關注的是達發正式宣示產品結構轉型進入收割階段，AI資料中心、高速光通訊及無線Edge AI成為未來成長三大引擎，其中光通訊業務今年營收預估將較去年成長超過四倍，2027年可望再較2026年成長三倍以上，成為公司未來最具爆發力的新事業。

title_en: Dafa Technology’s AI layout has entered the harvesting period, and optical communication revenue has more than quadrupled this year
summary_en: Dafa Technology (6526) held a corporate briefing today (4th) and announced consolidated revenue of 6.29 billion yuan in the second quarter, a quarterly increase of 15.3% and an annual increase of 13.9%, setting a record high in a single quarter. Compared with the high revenue, the market is more concerned about Dafa's official announcement that the product structure transformation has entered the harvest stage. AI data center, high-speed optical communication and wireless Edge AI will become the three major engines of future growth. Among them, the revenue of the optical communication business this year is expected to increase more than four times compared with last year. In 2027, it is expected to increase more than three times compared with 2026, becoming the company's most explosive new business in the future.

title_en: What to buy for labor funds 1/From balanced allocation to heavy investment in the AI ​​industry, this stock is firmly the largest holding
summary_en: The Labor Fund Utilization Bureau recently announced the top ten holdings of the new labor retirement fund in the first half of 2026. Observing that from 2020 to 2026, the stock selection strategy has gradually evolved from the original relatively balanced allocation of "electronics + finance + telecommunications" to an aggressive pattern of "concentrating on TSMC + betting heavily on the AI ​​hardware supply chain", showing that fund managers are complying with the global AI development craze in order to pursue performance.

title_en: The stock exchange and companies support football matches
summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange, Taiwan Futures Exchange, Taiwan Central Depository and Clearing House and Pou Chen International Group jointly sponsored 2 million yuan to support the development of sports in rural areas. This year, Pingtung County came to Yigao Central China, Majia Junior High School, and Donggang High School China. The 2026 "12th Taiwan Youth Football Tournament" organized by the Ministry of Education and the four schools of Changzhi Junior High School started from July 28 after five days and eight matches. The final results were announced on August 1. In the end, Donggang won the championship and Laiyi won the runner-up.

title_en: Dingji Q2 earned 2.94 yuan per share
summary_en: Thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) high-tech film factory Dingji (6585) announced its second quarter financial report yesterday (4th). The net profit after tax in a single quarter was 212 million yuan, a quarterly increase of 57.9% and an annual increase of 3,560%. The net profit per share was 2.94 yuan. Looking to the second half of the year, the company is optimistic that the momentum of medical product shipments will continue until the end of the year.

title: 台股擂台／「股市獲利王」何文高：美四大 CSP 業者連袂走揚 帶動台股偏多上漲
summary: 台股早盤從最低點42,900點僅僅用不到一小時的時間，就拉升千點至43,912點，是過去少見的走勢。從美股的角度來看，美國四大雲端資料中心微軟、亞馬遜、Google、Meta連袂上漲4%至6%左右，因此即使台積電最近有利空影響股價，但台股現階段將會持續偏多上漲，挑戰44,800點附近的壓力。
title_zh: 台股擂台／「股市獲利王」何文高：美四大 CSP 業者連袂走揚 帶動台股偏多上漲
summary_zh: 台股早盤從最低點42,900點僅僅用不到一小時的時間，就拉升千點至43,912點，是過去少見的走勢。從美股的角度來看，美國四大雲端資料中心微軟、亞馬遜、Google、Meta連袂上漲4%至6%左右，因此即使台積電最近有利空影響股價，但台股現階段將會持續偏多上漲，挑戰44,800點附近的壓力。
title_en: Taiwan Stocks Arena/"King of Stock Market Profitability" Ho Weng-ko: The four major U.S. CSP players rose in succession, driving the bullish bias in Taiwanese stocks.
summary_en: In early trading, the Taiwan stock market rose from a low of 42,900 points by a thousand points to 43,912 points in less than an hour, which was a rare trend in the past. From the perspective of U.S. stocks, the four major U.S. cloud data centers Microsoft, Amazon, Google, and Meta have all risen by about 4% to 6%. Therefore, even if TSMC has recently had a negative impact on its stock price, Taiwanese stocks will continue to rise on the bullish side at this stage, challenging the pressure near 44,800 points.

title_en: Cooperation between Taiwan and the United States’ collective insurance settlement institutions to strengthen the security and services of multiple entrustment delivery
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Pan Zhiyi, Taipei, 4th) Lin Binghui, chairman of the Taiwan Central Depository and Clearing House, said that the China Central Depository and Clearing House plans to deepen cooperation with the U.S. Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (DTCC) and directly obtain DTCC company action data. The purpose is not only to improve the operations of a single institution, but also to transform the settlement, delivery and data service capabilities of the U.S. market into infrastructure that can be used jointly by Taiwan's multiple trust market.

summary: 7月台股經歷歷史性震盪，單月重挫逾3000點，然散戶展現強大韌性，台股ETF受益人反而逆勢激增124萬人，總規模突破1854萬大關。數據顯示，投資人採取「越跌越買」策略，其中元大台灣50（0050）單月暴增逾32萬人居冠，高股息ETF與市值型產品同樣受到青睞。此外，積極型投資人則大舉佈局正二槓桿型ETF，意圖在反彈中放大獲利。專家分析，台股科技產業基本面未變，近期震盪屬健康回檔，提供存股族分批進場機會。不過，法人提醒槓桿型ETF風險較高，市場下跌時資產縮水幅度加倍，投資人務必審慎控管風險，切勿過度擴張信用，以應對後續市場波動。

title_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission revised the insurance industry’s financial reporting preparation standards to make the sources of profits and losses clearer
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 4th) The Financial Supervisory Commission said today that Taiwan will apply the expression and disclosure requirements in financial statements of International Financial Reporting Standards No. 18 (IFRS 18) in the 2028 fiscal year, and is planning to amend the "Insurance Industry Financial Reporting Standards" requirements to make financial report expression and disclosure more transparent. summary_en: As Typhoon White Dolphin approaches Japan, many property and casualty insurance companies have successively adjusted their overseas travel inconvenience insurance underwriting measures. title_en: Strengthening money laundering prevention, new domestic virtual currency transfer regulations will be implemented in October
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 4th) The Financial Supervisory Commission said today that it has revised the "Measures for Preventing Money Laundering and Combating Terrorism Financing by Enterprises or Personnel Providing Virtual Asset Services" to strengthen virtual currency money laundering prevention. If the virtual currency transfer amount exceeds the equivalent of New Taiwan Dollars 30,000 yuan. The transferee needs to fill in additional information of date of birth and residential address for verification. It is expected to be launched in two phases. It will be applicable to domestic VASP transfers in October this year, and will also be applicable to domestic VASP transfers to foreign VASPs before the end of next year.

title_en: The only one in the industry! KGI Life won the first "Insurance Special Contribution Award" in the company category of the "Insurance Trust, Hope and Love Award"
summary_en: KGI Life has won 12 awards in the "2026 Insurance Trust, Hope and Love Awards" for its outstanding professional services and innovative and sustainable actions, setting a new high in history! Among them, it has become the first life insurance company in Taiwan and the only life insurance company in the industry to receive the "Insurance Special Contribution Award" in the company category since the award was added in 2015. The award was personally awarded by Peng Jinlong, chairman of the Financial Supervisory Commission, recognizing KGI Life as a frontline worker in protecting Hualien's reconstruction. members developed Taiwan's first "Hualien Guangfu Township Assistance Volunteer Group Insurance" within 48 hours, which professionalized insurance as a solid backing for post-disaster support. It also set a model for the insurance industry and promoted the insurance industry to formulate a volunteer insurance operation mechanism, laying the foundation for future compliance.

title_en: To prevent the disconnection of social housing leasing and hosting services, the Ministry of the Interior: Will seek compensation from the businesses involved if necessary
summary_en: In response to external concerns about the operating conditions of the two companies "Shau Kee Housing Management" and "Hermit Crab Rental", the Ministry of Interior stated on the 4th that the social housing leasing and management services undertaken by the two companies are currently operating normally. The government will continue to monitor the case services and rent payment status, and fully protect the rights and interests of landlords and tenants. If the operator is unable to operate normally or services are interrupted, necessary legal measures will be taken in accordance with the law and compensation will be sought from the relevant operators.

title: 遠東商銀深化3W 財管服務 連四年獲保險信望愛雙獎肯定

title_en: Prosecution, investigation and investigation into the case of imported Chinese bitter tea seeds imported from Weijia. The person in charge was transferred to the Beijing Inspection Bureau for re-examination.
summary_en: Brands such as Yongfengyu independently tested Camellia oleifera oil and found that benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard, and reported it to the Food and Drug Administration. The Taipei District Prosecutor's Office filed a case and discovered that Weijia International Company was suspected of importing Camellia Seeds from mainland China. The outer packaging was marked with Taiwan Camellia Seeds, and the purity was 100% without additives. It was suspected of false labeling and fraud. Today, in conjunction with the Chiayi District Prosecutor's Office, the investigation bureau's northern area mobile work team was divided into No. 17 to search Weijia Company, Yuanchun Oil Factory, and Meishan Camellia Oil Production Cooperative. In the evening, Jin Tianli, the person in charge of the registration of Weijia Company, was transferred to the North Prosecutor's Office for further questioning.

title: 30歲眼睛就開始退化？醫師點名5大護眼營養素：葉黃素不是唯一選擇
summary: 洛桑加參表示，一些學者從營養角度切入，發現較高的維生素B9攝入量可能與降低青光眼風險有關，惟仍需後續研究進一步證實預防效果。B9其實就是葉酸，身邊有孕婦的應該都不陌生，它除了幫助胎兒健康成長，在造血、維護神經系統健康上都有功勞。菠菜、蘆筍、綠花椰菜和香菜，都能買來補充。香菜再度上榜，是因為它可以生食，營養不容易因烹調流失。真心不愛香菜也不打緊，記得炒菜時採用快炒的方式，可提高葉酸保留率。值得一提的是，預防青光眼，常保心情愉快也有幫助，主要原因跟壓力荷爾蒙皮質醇有關。適量適時出現的皮質醇有助我們應對緊急狀況，倘若緊急變成常態，皮質醇瘋起來，連視神經都不會放過。情緒越高昂，越生氣越激動，壓力荷爾蒙越是肆無忌憚，它才不管你會不會眼壓高。一把無名火上來，智慧無明，雙眼也無明，人真的有可能氣到兩眼昏花。算了算了，不如放寬心、看開點，好好看一眼這美麗的世界，才不負老天生給我們這雙美麗的眼。

title_en: Do your eyes start to degenerate at the age of 30? Doctors name 5 major eye-protecting nutrients: Lutein is not the only choice
summary_en: Luosang Jiacan said that from a nutritional perspective, some scholars have found that higher vitamin B9 intake may be related to reducing the risk of glaucoma, but follow-up research is still needed to further confirm the preventive effect. B9 is actually folic acid, which should be familiar to pregnant women. In addition to helping the healthy growth of the fetus, it also plays a role in hematopoiesis and maintaining the health of the nervous system. Spinach, asparagus, broccoli and cilantro can all be bought to supplement. Coriander is on the list again because it can be eaten raw and its nutrients are not easily lost through cooking. It doesn’t matter if you really don’t like coriander. Remember to use quick frying when cooking to increase the retention rate of folic acid. It is worth mentioning that to prevent glaucoma, it is also helpful to maintain a happy mood. The main reason is related to the stress hormone cortisol. Appropriate amounts of cortisol that appear at the right time can help us cope with emergencies. If emergencies become the norm, cortisol will go crazy and even the optic nerve will not be spared. The higher your mood, the more angry and excited you are, the more unscrupulous your stress hormones are, and they don't care whether you have high intraocular pressure. When an unknown fire comes up, the wisdom is ignorant, and the eyes are also ignorant, it is really possible for a person to become so angry that his eyesight goes blind. Forget it, let’s relax, open our eyes, and take a good look at this beautiful world, so that we can live up to the beautiful eyes God gave us.

summary_en: Jiexun (2643) held a press conference on the 4th. Benefiting from rising sea and air freight market demand and strong demand from AI customers, its profit jumped sharply in the second quarter. Net profit after tax in the single quarter reached 73.69 million yuan, an increase of more than 15 times year-on-year. Net profit after tax per share (EPS) was 2.11 yuan. title_en: Deaths from major occupational accidents fell by 21% in the second quarter, showing an overall downward trend
summary_en: The Ministry of Labor announced on the 4th the statistics on deaths from major occupational disasters in the entire industry for the second quarter of 2026. As of June 30, the number of deaths from major occupational disasters in the entire industry was 109, a decrease of 29 from 138 in the same period in 2025, a decrease of approximately 21%. The overall number of deaths from occupational disasters showed a downward trend in the first half of the year.

title: AI、先進製程與矽光子需求升溫 汎銓7月營收2.41億元締新猷
summary: AI晶片研發分析平台汎銓科技（6830）今日公告2026年7月合併營收達2.41億元，月增16.72％、年增26.15％，締造單月歷史新高。累計2026年1至7月合併營收達14.55億元，較去年同期成長21.18％，同步創下歷年同期新高。汎銓表示，7月營收創高，主要受惠AI晶片分析需求持續增加、先進製程材料分析案件穩健成長，加上國內外高階客戶委託案件持續擴大，展現公司整體營運隨著AI、高效能運算、先進製程及矽光子等市場需求而保持熱絡。

title_en: Demand for AI, advanced processes and silicon photonics is heating up. Fanquan’s July revenue is 241 million yuan, a new milestone
summary_en: Panquan Technology (6830), an AI chip R&D and analysis platform, announced today that its consolidated revenue in July 2026 reached 241 million yuan, a monthly increase of 16.72% and an annual increase of 26.15%, setting a single-month record high. The cumulative consolidated revenue from January to July 2026 reached 1.455 billion yuan, an increase of 21.18% over the same period last year, setting a new high for the same period in previous years. Fanquan stated that its revenue hit a high in July, mainly due to the continued increase in demand for AI chip analysis, the steady growth of advanced process material analysis cases, and the continued expansion of domestic and foreign high-end customer entrustment cases, showing that the company's overall operations remain hot with market demand for AI, high-performance computing, advanced processes, and silicon photonics.

title: 宏碁接手兆基真有譜？　施振榮淡定這樣說！
summary: 本週一開工，包租代管業者兆基傳出踩了投資大雷影響營運與管理層人事。身為第二大股東的宏碁則是以「媒體報導所涉投資及債務問題均屬個人行為，與兆基屋管無關。」進行回應，而今（4）日下午，宏碁創辦人施振榮出席活動也被問及此事，他回應說道：「兆基的公司治理應該到位，有把原來董事長、總經理所發生的問題進行一個隔離，未來兆基在新的董事長跟經營團隊帶領下可以再掌握（機會）。」

title_en: Zhang Zhongmou will serve as the honorary chairman of the funeral committee for former Power Semiconductor Chairman Huang Chongren
summary_en: Huang Chongren, founder of Powerchip Group and former chairman of Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., passed away recently. The company has decided to make space at its Taipei headquarters to set up a memorial venue for relatives and friends from all walks of life and friends who care about Chairman Huang to pay their last respects and say their final farewells. At present, work has begun to establish a funeral committee, and relevant work is still in progress. However, it has been confirmed that TSMC founder Zhang Zhongmou has agreed to serve as the honorary chairman of the funeral committee.

title_en: Will the liquidity of the new disposal stock system increase by 1.5 times? The stock exchange clarifies: Increase in matching frequency does not equal doubling of transactions
summary_en: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and the Securities Overseas Trading Center plan to shorten the stock disposal period from 10 business days to 5 business days, and shorten the manual matching time from every 5 minutes/20 minutes to every 2 minutes. In this regard, market reports are focusing on whether the new system can significantly increase market liquidity. The stock exchange clarified that the shortening of the matching interval provides investors with more intensive pricing opportunities, but the actual market trading volume still depends on the overall financial willingness and individual stock fundamentals, and cannot be directly equivalent to the exponential growth of liquidity.

title_en: The largest modern history academic event in China in recent years, scholars from 15 countries gathered at Academia Sinica
summary_en: From the entanglements and differences between the two sides of the Taiwan Strait, to how East Asia is included in the global historical context, the study of modern history is moving away from the traditional framework centered on a single country. Academia Sinica will hold a large-scale international academic symposium today (4th), which will last for three days. It will bring together scholars from 15 countries and more than 100 universities and research institutions around the world. It is expected to publish 208 academic papers. It is the largest international academic event on modern history in China in recent years.

title: 權值股休兵小兵齊衝鋒！華邦電領記憶體族群亮燈救火｜Yahoo財經掃描
summary:
台股洗三溫暖！今(4)日開低後一度翻紅，尾盤再遭權值股壓回，終場小跌25.75點、跌幅0.06%，收在43,360.66點，仍未能收復月線，成交金額放大至1兆376.31億元。台積電(2330)終場下跌50元、跌幅2.11%，收在2,320元，成為壓抑指數的最大來源。

 盤面呈現「權值休息、中小股接棒」格局，櫃買指數逆勢大漲3.35%，上市櫃多檔亮燈，多集中在中小型電子股。台達電(2308)走揚，大立光(3008)在蘋果新機備貨題材助攻下攻上漲停；記憶體族群則因報價回升與AI需求重燃買氣，華邦電(2344)、南亞科(2408)及力積電(6770)亮燈，旺宏(2337)也逼近漲停。國巨(2327)等被動元件股延續反彈，載板族群欣興(3037)受AI伺服器與高階ABF載板需求帶動大漲，南電(8046)、景碩(3189)齊亮燈，CPO、矽晶圓及設備族群也輪番表態，撐起台積電壓盤下的市場人氣。

亞股方面，日韓股市開高後漲勢收斂，三星電子與SK海力士續跌逾3%，壓抑韓股表現，不過終場韓國綜合指數反彈1.62%，日經指數上漲0.32%；其他市場漲跌互見，香港恆生指數下跌0.60%，上海綜合指數則上漲0.33%。

美國市場方面，美伊緊張局勢降溫，帶動國際油價與美債殖利率同步下滑，科技巨頭及AI概念股買氣回籠，美股四大指數全面走高，其中道瓊工業指數上漲1.32%、改寫歷史收盤新高，標普500指數上漲1.48%、逼近歷史高點。科技股方面，Meta大漲6.02%，亞馬遜延續強勢上漲4.58%，市值首度突破3兆美元；微軟勁揚4.93%、Alphabet上漲4.44%、輝達走高2.93%，蘋果則逆勢下跌1.78%。SpaceX在上市後首份財報公布前反彈5.68%，台積電ADR同步上漲0.46%。

title: 美國車貸平均月付破紀錄 2026年購車負擔恐持續攀升
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導美國汽車買家的每月車貸負擔持續寫下新高紀錄，無論是新車或中古車皆是如此。根據《Bankrate》報告指出，儘管預計2026年汽車貸款利率將略微下降，但這不足以抵銷保險費及維護成本等其他因素導致的整體擁車費用上漲。 購車成本與貸款趨勢 報告顯示，2026年第一季新車的平均每月車貸金額已達 770 美元，中古車則為 531 美元。值得注意的是，單筆新車貸款中，每月付款超過 1,000 美元的比例已佔 18.96%，而新車租賃方案中亦有 8.71% 超過此金額。這主要歸因於高昂的車價；截至 2026 年初，新車的平均貸款金額達到 43,925 美元，相較於 2025 年底的 42,582 美元有所增加。美國汽車貸款金額自 2022 年以來穩步上升，部分原因是車輛價格上漲以及 2025 年實施的關稅措施。 購車者為了負擔日漸高漲的車價，除了貸款金額變大外，也傾向拉長還款期限。儘管傳統上常見的貸款期限為 60 或 72 個月，但 84 個月（即七年）的期限正變得越來越普遍。然而，拉長貸款期限雖然能降低每月還款金額，卻會增加整體購車成本，並使車主更容易陷入「水

summary:
昨日盤勢

summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導美國地區性銀行 Capitol Federal Financial 近日公布其 2026 年第三季財報，表現亮眼。該公司不僅淨利息收入與淨利潤顯著成長，並已完成一項大規模的股票回購（庫藏股）計畫，此舉凸顯管理階層對股東回報的重視。 根據 Simply Wall St 的分析，Capitol Federal Financial 在該季實現了 5,348 萬美元的淨利息收入，淨利潤則達到 2,357 萬美元。報告指出，該公司的不良貸款沖銷（net charge-offs）僅為 14.8 萬美元，數額極低。Simply Wall St 表示，這些數據反映了 Capitol Federal Financial 的獲利成長主要來自核心銀行業務，而非一次性收入，並強調其穩健的經營策略與保守的信用品質。 值得注意的是，Capitol Federal Financial 已完成一項總計 7,284 萬美元的股票回購計畫，買回了 9,976,478 股自家股票，約佔總流通股數的 8%。股票回購（庫藏股，公司用自己的錢買回自家股票，通常會推升每股盈餘）通常被視為提振股

title: 美伊談判前景未明，荷姆茲單日僅六船通行、海灣航運持續低迷
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美伊和平談判進展仍不明朗，海灣兩大關鍵水道週一航運量變化不大。路透引述Kpler船舶最新追蹤數據顯示，曼德海峽當日共有20艘船舶通過；荷姆茲海峽則僅六艘，航運業者在船舶遇襲風險下仍保持高度謹慎。曼德海峽週一通行船舶包括12艘油輪及八艘散裝貨輪，總數與前一日相同，其中12艘駛離、八艘進入，多數船舶開啟自動識別系統(AIS)應答器。受葉門胡塞武裝威脅攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯航運影響，部分沙國籍超大型油輪已在亞丁灣改變航向，繞行非洲南部。荷姆茲海峽航運依然接近停滯，週一只有三艘油輪及三艘散裝貨輪通行，少於前一日的七艘。六艘船中有五艘進入、一艘駛離，全部使用伊朗指定航線；部分船舶可能關閉應答器航行，因此未被納入統計。美國總統川普表示，因美伊正在談判終止戰爭及處理荷姆茲海峽控制權問題，暫緩對伊朗發動新一輪攻擊；伊朗外交部發言人巴加埃(Esmail Baghaei)則否認雙方正在談判或已安排會面。兩國說法持續矛盾，加上船舶遇襲威脅未除，使航商不願迅速恢復通行，海灣能源及商品運輸短期內仍難回到戰前水準。

title: EZ Way遭質疑「民營公司拿個資」她揭官股內幕
summary: 財經中心／駱瑩倫報導近期「EZ Way易利委」APP引發討論，有民眾及網紅質疑，這款攸關跨境網購報關的工具，並非政府機關自行開發，而是由關貿網路股份有限公司負責建置、營運，甚至設有相關收費機制，因此質疑公部門與民營企業之間的關係。對此，關務署出面說明，關貿網路屬於受政府監管的通關網路業者，營運與個資管理均有法規依循，並非外界所想像的「政府把業務交給民間」。對此財經網紅胡采蘋感嘆，不公司化、不上市，那就是跟健保局一樣，每天都有虧損恐懼。

title_en: Uni-President Group's fitness business is out, BEING sport, fit and other nine locations will cease services in September
summary_en: Uni-President Group's beauty business operations have undergone major adjustments, and its fitness business has announced its withdrawal. Uni-President Jiajia, a subsidiary of Uni-President Super, announced yesterday (3rd) that the board of directors passed the operational adjustment plan of its BEING sport division. title_en: Foreign capital's net short position reached a new high of 90,000 contracts, pointing to the U.S. and Japan's intervention in the yen as the main reason for the unwinding of carry trades.
summary_en: Foreign investors were striving to be bullish on the Taiwan stock market yesterday (3rd). When the index rose by more than 200 points, they were oversold in spot prices. At the same time, net short orders in the Taiwan index futures also surged by more than 7,500 lots, and the overall open positions reached a record high of 90,038 lots. The industry, large investors, and legal persons are very worried about the subsequent movements of foreign capital. Among them, the focus is on the joint intervention of the United States and Japan in the yen, resulting in the unwinding of carry trades.

title: 中國強化晶片布圖設計保護，10/15起重大侵權可判懲罰性賠償
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，中國修訂積體電路布圖設計保護規定，提高註冊及原創性門檻，並允許法院對重大侵權行為判處懲罰性賠償，以加強保護本土半導體技術。新規已由中國國務院總理李強於7月23日簽署，預定10月15日生效。相關規定涵蓋晶片內部各項元件的具體排列與連接設計，即使企業本身不製造晶片，布圖仍可能包含大量工程投入，也是半導體研發的核心智慧財產。新措施並非出口管制，但反映北京日益重視中國企業開發的戰略技術。申請人未來必須證明申報內容源自真正的創作活動，提交原創性聲明，並清楚列明設計中的原創部分。監管部門可駁回明顯不符規定的申請，也將建立更明確的撤銷機制，以打擊抄襲他人設計、惡意搶先註冊及低品質申請。新規允許依權利人損失或侵權者所得計算賠償，嚴重案件可另加懲罰性賠償；同時明確布圖設計權可被授權、轉讓或作為融資抵押。隨美國持續限制中國取得先進晶片設計軟體及製造設備，北京正透過智慧財產制度，防止本土技術遭複製或由外國企業取得。

title: 記憶體荒擴大 MacBook Air 鬧缺貨 牽動台鏈出貨

title: 首爾豪宅價格今年料漲11%冠全球，李在明限三天檢討住宅供應措施

title_en: The price of graphics cards in mainland China has soared, and "one price per day" has spurred profits for ASUS, MSI, etc.
summary_en: Affected by the huge increase in memory prices, in less than a week since the end of July, the price of graphics cards in Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei Market, the world's largest electronic product wholesale and retail market, has increased by 30%. "One price per day" has emerged, and late purchases are more expensive. The increase has even spread to the second-hand market. As prices soared, the average unit price (ASP) of graphics card manufacturers such as Asus, MSI, and Gigabyte also surged, boosting profits.

title: 大摩估阿里雲營收增45%、目標價看180美元，阿里ADR週一大漲4.13%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】摩根士丹利(大摩)週一發表最新研究報告顯示，阿里雲可望成為中國雲端市場市占率增幅最大的業者，並持續擔任阿里巴巴股價的重要催化劑。該行將阿里巴巴列為產業首選，維持「加碼」評級及180美元目標價。摩根士丹利預估，阿里雲2027財年第一季營收將加速成長45%，反映人工智慧(AI)模型訓練、推理及企業雲端服務需求持續升溫，客戶增加AI相關支出將進一步推動業務規模擴張。隨著高附加價值AI服務占比提高及基礎設施利用率改善，摩根士丹利預計阿里雲利潤率將擴大至11%。若收入加速與利潤率改善同步實現，雲端業務對阿里巴巴整體獲利及估值的貢獻將明顯提高。阿里巴巴ADR(美股代碼BABA)週一收盤大漲5.05美元或4.13%，報127.30美元。摩根士丹利180美元目標價較最新收盤價高出約41.4%，加上阿里巴巴近期發布新AI模型，帶動市場重新評估其雲端成長與AI變現潛力。

title: 美銀警告，聯準會若未明確抗通膨方案，美債或再陷跌勢
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，美國銀行方面認為，如果聯準會不能更好地告訴大眾它將如何實現2%的通膨目標，美國國債的跌勢就會重新出現。美國銀行全球研究部美國利率策略主管Mark Cabana表示，上週三將殖利率推至近20年高點的長債拋售是一次「教科書式的通膨公信力衝擊」。當天，聯準會主席華許在記者會上未能向投資者解釋央行將如何抑制價格上漲。Cabana接受電視媒體採訪時表示，有堅定的決心實現2%的通膨是很好，但除非告訴我們要如何做到，否則我們是不會相信的，而且也騙不了債券，它會看穿。美國銀行全球研究經濟專家週一在研究報告中寫道，在上週記者會和債市反應之後，聯準會必須透過升息奪回話語權才能通過9月的考驗。Cabana表示，我們想看到方案，但目前還沒有，利率曲線的長端說明了這一點。

summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】國際油價週二亞洲電子盤小幅反彈，美伊外交解決方案仍充滿不確定性，中東原油供應風險重新獲得關注。布蘭特10月期油漲0.62美元或0.7%，每桶報84.39美元；紐約9月期油升0.61美元或0.7%，報80.95美元。布蘭特週一曾重挫7%至三週低點，紐約期油亦下跌逾5%至近一週最低，因美國總統川普暫緩對伊朗發動新攻擊，並聲稱雙方正就終止戰爭及荷姆茲海峽控制權進行談判。伊朗外交部發言人巴加埃(Esmail Baghaei)則否認與美國談判，並稱未安排任何會議。荷姆茲海峽仍是雙方爭議核心。華盛頓主張6月簽署的諒解備忘錄要求伊朗開放海峽，德黑蘭則稱文件明確保留伊方管轄權。巴克萊估計，截至7月31日止一週，通過海峽的原油及成品油日均淨出口量為420萬桶，高於前一週的320萬桶，但仍遠低於戰前水準。航運風險亦限制油價進一步下跌。六艘懸掛沙國旗幟的超大型油輪近日在亞丁灣改道非洲南部，另有兩艘沙國油輪穿越曼德海峽。英國海事貿易行動辦公室週二另接獲通報，一艘貨輪在阿曼海塞卜東北方約37公里處遭不明投射物擊中；荷姆茲與紅海雙重航運瓶頸，使油價仍保有地緣政治溢價。

title: 台灣將是全球AI產業的硬體巨人還是軟體侏儒？
summary: 中國大陸近期宣布開源Kimi K3，並接連推出DeepSeek V4等大型語言模型，在矽谷與華爾街引發強烈震撼。這不只是新模型的競爭，更象徵全球AI競爭已出現重大轉折：中國正由追隨者逐漸成為能以自己的技術路線、商業模式與價格體系參與制定全球AI規則的重要力量。對台灣而言，這既是難得的機遇，也是不可忽視的警訊。

title: 包租代管龍頭捲入財務危機 住都中心：設專案小組全面清查

title_en: The leading leasing and hosting company is involved in financial crisis. Residential Center: Set up a task force to conduct a comprehensive investigation
summary_en: Zhao Ji Investment and Hermit Crab Management Consultants, related companies of the leading leasing and hosting company Shau Kee Group, are in financial crisis. Due to the inability to pay interest on corporate bonds, more than a hundred investors have formed a self-help committee. This is also the first time that a large business has been involved in a financial crisis since the government promoted the lease management policy. The outside world is concerned about whether the tens of thousands of leases managed by Zhaoji can continue to operate, including paying rent to landlords and returning tenant deposits.

title: 00962  8月配息金額大增1倍創新高  　8/14最後買進日
summary: 台股AI投資狂潮與除權息旺季的雙重利多正式引爆！根據投信投顧最新公告，同時結合AI成長動能及息收優勢的台新臺灣AI優息動能ETF基金(00962）8月預計每單位配發0.16元，相較於上個月大幅增加一倍，以8/3收盤價14.42元計算，年化配息率達13.31%，配息金額及配息率皆刷新該成立以來的新高紀錄，00962預計8月17日除息，8月14日為最後買進日，9月4日領息。

title: 法興銀行估日本央行9月按兵不動，支撐日圓仍將靠匯市干預
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，法國興業銀行方面預計，日本央行將在9月按兵不動，認為日本當局將轉而依靠匯市干預來支撐日圓。法國興業銀行的這一觀點正值市場愈發猜測，日本和美國自1990年代以來首次聯手提振日圓的共識基礎是日本央行將加快升息步伐。法國興業銀行的利率策略分析師Stephen Spratt和Reo Sakida在報告中寫道，我們認為情況並非如此，因為從歷史上看，日本當局一直將匯市干預視為放緩日本央行貨幣政策收緊步伐的一種方式。這份報告預計，日本央行將於10月升息25個基點，並預計政策利率到2027年第四季將升至2%。貨幣市場目前計入日本央行到9月升息10個基點和到10月升息21個基點的預期。法國興業銀行的利率策略分析師在報告中寫道，如果美元/日圓在會議召開前逼近165，那麼9月升息是有可能的。

title: 微軟單日市值暴增4500億美元 創美股歷史紀錄 AI助攻雲端業務
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導美國科技巨擘微軟（Microsoft）於 7 月 30 日股價飆升 15.51%，使其市值在單一交易日內暴增約 4500 億美元。這創下美國企業史上最大的單日市值增長紀錄，也就是一家公司在單一交易日內市值增加的金額，將微軟的總市值推升至約 3.45 兆美元。這顯示市場高度肯定其人工智慧（AI）發展策略與雲端運算業務表現。 這次股價大漲，主要受到微軟最新公布的 2026 會計年度第四季財報激勵。報告顯示，微軟的 Azure 雲端服務業務成長加速，達到 30%，同時公司在 AI 基礎設施上的投資也開始展現獲利能力。微軟旗下的智慧雲端（Intelligent Cloud）部門，包含 Azure 及其他雲端運算服務，該季營收佔總銷售額的 41.5%，成長率高達 31.6%。相較之下，AWS 的成長率為 28.4%，而谷歌（Google）旗下的 Google Cloud 則達到 81.8%。 財報數據顯示，微軟第四季營收為 900.1 億美元，年增 17.7%，超出市場預期的 2.6%。稀釋後每股盈餘（EPS，即公司每一股賺多少錢）為 4.81 美元，較預期

title: 國內包租代管龍頭兆基集團相關公司爆發財務危機 大股東宏碁動向引發關注

title_en: A financial crisis broke out in related companies of Shau Kee Group, the leading domestic leasing and hosting company. The movements of major shareholder Acer attracted attention.
summary_en: A financial crisis broke out in companies related to the leading domestic leasing and hosting company, Shau Kee Group. The corporate bonds issued by "Zhao Ji Investment" and "Hermit Crab Management Consultants" under the name of former chairman Li Jiancheng showed a funding gap of tens of billions of yuan. Zhaoji is a venture invested by two listed companies, Acer and Nengli. Acer's shareholding was once as high as 20%. The outside world is concerned that it is involved in financial disputes, which may detonate landmines.

title: 焦點股：晟德推動旗下轉投資國際策略佈局不遺餘力，今年大有進展
summary: 【財訊快報／徐玉君】晟德(4123)近年持續積極推動旗下轉投資生技子公司之國際策略合作；近期更為放大投資綜效，由子公司順藥(6535)擴大與引正基因的戰略合作，雙方將強強聯手，結合引正基因頂尖的基因編輯平台，以及順藥在中樞神經系統(CNS)疾病領域的研發實力與臨床經驗，共同探索與開發中樞神經領域的創新療法。再者，與波蘭生物藥CDMO大廠Mabion S.A.正式簽署主服務框架協議，引導旗下永昕(4726)/建誼在抗體偶聯藥物(ADC)CDMO領域的戰略佈局，邁入實質合作階段，正式跨出歐洲布局第一步。長線而言，晟德對旗下轉投資公司的戰略布局將有更實質的營運績效可期待，為晟德集團潛在價值加分。股價今日開昨日高點，需守穩五日線並站上40.55元，始有機會往上繼續攻堅。

title: 台股開盤／台積電跌40元！台股跌近400點　生技、綠能逆勢撐盤
summary: 美股四大指數全面走揚，但台股今（4）日開盤未能延續國際股市強勢表現，在權王台積電開低40元拖累下，加權指數早盤下跌341.63點、報43,044.78點，跌幅0.79%；不過中小型股表現相對強勢，櫃買指數逆勢上漲3.79點至366.68點，漲幅1.04%，呈現「權值股休息、中小型股接棒」的盤勢格局。

title: 拄拐杖爬5樓、80歲靠子孫送飯...高雄50年老社區住戶：都更不是要房價漲、只要一台電梯｜好宅報報
summary: 每當傍晚，垃圾車音樂響起，高雄三民區民族社區總會出現熟悉的一幕。有人拄著拐杖走向垃圾車，有人提著垃圾袋，一步步走下五層樓，再扶著樓梯喘著氣回家。位於民族一路、九如一路附近的民族社區，約於民國65至67年間分批興建，屋齡已近50年，由4棟11樓、6棟7樓華廈及13棟五樓公寓組成，近2,000戶居民在此生活，是高雄規模最大的老舊住宅社區之一。隨著建物老化、高齡化加劇，都更成為居民最關心的議題。

title_en: Team Group's profits exploded, earning more than 5 shares in the first half of the year, surpassing previous annual performance
summary_en: Memory module manufacturer Team Group (4967) yesterday (3) announced its second-quarter profit of 2.412 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 5.14%, an annual increase of more than 218 times, and a net profit per share of 26.47 yuan, a single-quarter record; it made more than five shares in the first half of the year, with an after-tax net profit of 4.706 billion yuan, an annual increase of 48.5 times, and a net profit per share of 53.44 yuan, which has exceeded previous annual profits.

title: 東京匯市早盤美元指數自一個半月低點反彈，日圓力守干預部份漲幅
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】美日上週聯手進場買進日圓，令投機客不敢迅速重建空頭部位，日圓在東京匯市週二早盤守住大部分干預漲幅。日圓早盤微貶0.1%，報157.35兌1美元，雖低於週一觸及的三個月高位155.20，但仍遠離先前締造的40年低點；過去三個交易日一度累計升值5%。日本政府已證實，上週五與美國罕見採取聯合干預。景順日本全球市場策略師木下智夫(Tomo Kinoshita)表示，美日當局可能再度進場的疑慮，將限制日圓短期下跌空間，預期日圓年底前可望進一步升值；首相高市早苗(Sanae Takaichi)刺激政策造成的主要影響，可能已大致反映在匯價中。週一日圓突然急升，一度引發日本是否再度干預的猜測，但官方尚未確認。花旗估計，週一亞洲早盤美元兌日圓成交額約達270億美元，遠高於近期平均的19億美元。日圓兌歐元維持在逾八個月高位附近，報181.19；英鎊兌日圓則報211.60。美元指數自一個半月低位反彈至99.98，歐元報1.1511美元，英鎊小跌0.06%至1.3427美元。市場目前反映聯準會(Fed)年底前累計升息約35個基點，週五公布的7月非農就業報告將成為判斷緊縮時點的關鍵依據。

title: 跌逾五成後迎財報大考，SpaceX週一股價漲升5.68%，市場屏息等契機
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】SpaceX(美股代碼SPCX)週一股價上漲6.16美元或5.68%，收報114.53美元，成交額達76.16億美元，位居全美個股第14大。公司將於週二盤後公布上市以來首份季度財報，吸引資金提前回補。SpaceX於6月12日掛牌後一度受到市場熱烈追捧，但隨後股價快速反轉，迄今已連續四週下跌，較盤中歷史高點回落逾50%，市值蒸發超過5,000億美元，首批進場的散戶投資人承受沉重損失。市場人士將SpaceX掛牌後的表現，與Facebook於2012年首次公開上市後迅速跌破發行價相提並論。高估值、首批股票解禁壓力及市場重新檢視龐大資本支出，均使SpaceX由上市熱門股轉為高波動標的。週二財報將成為SpaceX上市後首項重大基本面檢驗，市場將關注火箭發射、星鏈業務營收、資本支出及自由現金流。特斯拉兩週前因成本攀升與自由現金流轉負而遭華爾街冷遇，使投資人對馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下企業的燒錢速度與資金需求格外敏感。

title: 都更第一關不是釘子戶！北市精華地1年整合成功的秘密：搞定98%聽不懂說明的住戶｜好宅報報
summary: 全台住宅存量約940萬戶，其中屋齡超過30年的老屋已接近六成，台北市更高達73.8%，居全台之冠。隨著建物老化，加上暴雨、地震等極端氣候衝擊，都市更新已成為許多老社區共同面臨的課題。然而，都更最難的從來不是拆房子，而是整合人心。從住戶共識、建商協調到行政程序，每一步都充滿挑戰，不少案件一走就是十多年。相較之下，台北市市民光復社區卻在短短一年內完成整合、準備送件，也成為這次專題探討都更成功關鍵的重要案例。

title_en: Market situation/AI industry growth trend remains unchanged
summary_en: Taiwan stocks rose 266 points to close at 43,386 points yesterday (3rd), showing a technical consolidation trend. Due to the recent sharp fluctuations in the global stock market, highly leveraged and excessively speculative funds have been forced out of the market, and the overheated market structure has been adjusted to allow chips to be allocated to stable long-term funds. The market performance has gradually shifted from being driven by liquidity to testing fundamentals.

This shows that the domestic auto market is gradually thawing, but also showing a considerable degree of resilience, and full-year growth is still expected.

title_en: The car manufacturer uses three arrows to press the accelerator
summary_en: New cars, gasoline-powered cars, and electric cars all hit the market, becoming the driving force behind the growth of the auto market in the second half of the year. As trade-in demand continues to support the market, automakers are accelerating the introduction of new vehicles, expanding their product portfolio of gasoline-electric vehicles, and actively attacking the electric vehicle market. Product strength has gradually replaced price wars and become the three key driving forces supporting the growth of the auto market in the second half of the year.

summary_en: The Ministry of Environment has planned the draft of the third phase of air pollution control plan. The national air pollution control will enter the deep water area. For the first time, major national policies such as energy transition, AI and high-tech industry development will be included in air pollution control. In the future, including six major industries including technology, energy, transportation, construction, catering, and agriculture, relevant pollutant control will be comprehensively tightened.

summary_en: Affected by the recent rise in international aviation fuel prices, the Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transport announced yesterday (3rd) that the passenger fuel surcharge for international routes of national airlines will be increased starting from August 9. Short-haul routes will be raised from US$27.5 to US$30 (approximately NT$970), and long-haul routes will be raised from US$71.5 to US$78 (approximately NT$2,520).
