title_en: The city government fined China United and Fumao Oil each another NT$3 million for failing to report abnormality in the oil purchased by Taiwan Sugar.
summary_en: In May this year, Taiwan Sugar purchased oil raw materials supplied by China United Manufacturing and Fumao Oil. On May 18, it was the first to discover that the raw materials contained benzenepyrene at 14.7 μg/kg, but it failed to notify the local Tainan City Government Health Bureau in accordance with the law. Only the upstream manufacturers Zoomlion and Fumao Oil were notified. Zoomlion and Fumao Oil did not notify the Taichung City Government immediately. After the city went to inspect today, in the evening they fined China United and Fumao Oil the maximum amount of NT$3 million each in accordance with the food safety law. The city government said it will never cover up any illegal behavior by manufacturers.

title_en: Unpaid leave increases, number of people exceeds 3,000
summary_en: The Ministry of Labor announced the latest implementation of overtime breaks (unpaid leave) yesterday (3rd). A total of 245 companies and 3,026 people implemented it, exceeding 3,000 again, an increase of 14 companies and 258 people compared with the previous period (mid-July). The Ministry of Labor stated that Taiwan has received a relatively preferential tax rate under the currently announced Section 301 tariff, and the development of the labor market can be viewed positively.

title: 網購族怕怕 關務署掛保證「EZ WAY符資安要求」
summary: 國人跨境網購習慣使用的實名認證App「EZ WAY易利委」，被質疑是由民營的關貿公司營運卻能取得民眾個資、收費不實。財政部關務署長彭英偉昨說，未強制民眾使用EZ WAY，且EZ WAY是依個資法及資安法規定所建置營運，符合資安要求。

title_en: Online shoppers are afraid, the Customs Department issued a guarantee that "EZ WAY complies with security requirements"
summary_en: The real-name authentication app "EZ WAY" that Chinese people habitually use for cross-border online shopping has been questioned as being operated by a private customs and trade company, but it can obtain people's personal information and charge false fees. Peng Yingwei, director of the Customs Administration of the Ministry of Finance, said yesterday that people are not forced to use EZ WAY, and EZ WAY is built and operated in accordance with the provisions of the Personal Information Law and the Information Security Law, and meets the information security requirements.

title_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission has stepped up its efforts to require banks to declare public wealth management working capital loans
summary_en: Credit expansion issues such as the "four loans under one roof" in Taiwan's stock market have attracted attention. It is understood that the Financial Supervisory Commission has recently revised bank reporting requirements and will require banks for the first time to fill in the figures of "financial working capital loans for investing in stocks and other financial products" in order to better understand the flow of funds borrowed from banks to the stock market. This is another new measure after the Financial Supervisory Commission set two supervisory red lines of "abnormal business growth" and "significant changes in risk indicators" and interviewed many banks to "drink coffee" to explain risk control.

summary: 台股近期震盪大，處置股流動性受到高度注目。證交所、櫃買中心昨天宣布修正注意股、處置股制度三大變革，包括處置期間縮短、撮合交易時間縮短、千金股列注意股價差放大，新制將於十日上路。其中，注意股價差放寬放大，被市場稱為「台積電條款」。

title_en: Taiwan’s new stock exchange system relaxes restrictions on stocks
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market has been volatile recently, and the liquidity of disposal stocks has received great attention. The stock exchange and the OTC Buying Center announced yesterday the revision of three major changes to the note stock and disposal stock systems, including shortening the disposal period, shortening the matching transaction time, and enlarging the stock price difference of the note stock list. The new system will be launched on the 10th. Among them, pay attention to the widening of the stock price difference, which is called the "TSMC clause" by the market.

summary: 經濟部推動「能源管理法」修法，要求契約容量達五MW以上的用電大戶，須於一定期限內設置一定容量以上的自用發電及儲能設備。協助產業界規畫興建自有儲能系統的業者說，工總的建議反映多數廠商對自建屋頂型電廠及儲能系統，因找不到興建土地或面臨保險業拒保，推展不順的困境，才會要求政府給予更多彈性配套。

title_en: Terms and Conditions for Large Electricity Consumers: Lack of Land and Denied Insurance, Hope for Supporting Plans
summary_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs is promoting the amendment of the "Energy Management Law", which requires large power consumers with a contract capacity of more than 5 MW to install self-use power generation and energy storage equipment with a certain capacity or more within a certain period of time. Industry players who assist the industry in planning and building their own energy storage systems said that the Federation of Industry and Commerce's recommendations reflect the fact that most manufacturers are facing difficulties in building self-built rooftop power plants and energy storage systems because they cannot find land for construction or face insurance rejections, which makes the implementation difficult, so they ask the government to provide more flexible supporting facilities.

title: 空汙管制加嚴 衝擊六產業
summary: 環境部規劃第三期空汙防制方案草案，國家空汙防制將進入深水區，首度將能源轉型、AI與高科技產業發展等國家重大政策納入空汙治理，未來包括科技、能源、運輸、建築、餐飲、農業等六大產業，相關汙染物管制都將全面加嚴。

title_en: Tightened air pollution control affects six industries
summary_en: The Ministry of Environment has planned the draft of the third phase of air pollution control plan. The national air pollution control will enter the deep water area. For the first time, major national policies such as energy transition, AI and high-tech industry development will be included in air pollution control. In the future, including six major industries including technology, energy, transportation, construction, catering, and agriculture, relevant pollutant control will be comprehensively tightened.

title: 能源管理法修法 工總籲：僅適用新廠、不溯及既往
summary: 經濟部擬修能源管理法，要求契約容量五ＭＷ以上的用電大戶須自設發電及儲能設備，工總表示，經濟部應與產業界充分溝通，排除經營實務窒礙難行的問題，以降低對產業發展與營運的衝擊。工總建議，新制僅適用於擴廠或新設投資案，並在設置自用發電或儲能設備外，納入其他替代方案，讓企業透過多元方式解決。

title_en: The Energy Management Law is revised and the Federation of Industry and Commerce calls for it to only apply to new plants and not retroactively.
summary_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs plans to amend the Energy Management Law, which requires large electricity consumers with a contract capacity of five MW or more to install their own power generation and energy storage equipment. The Federation of Industry and Commerce said that the Ministry of Economic Affairs should fully communicate with the industry to eliminate problems that hinder business practices to reduce the impact on industrial development and operations. The Federation of Industry and Commerce suggested that the new system only apply to factory expansion or new investment projects, and that in addition to setting up self-use power generation or energy storage equipment, other alternatives should be included to allow companies to solve the problem through multiple methods.

summary_en: The three major government pension funds have made huge profits following Taiwan stocks. In June, the labor fund, national security fund, and pension fund earned a total of 102.14 billion yuan, bringing the total profit in the first half of the year to 2.7 trillion yuan. Among them, the labor fund alone’s income in the first half of the year reached 2.20242 billion yuan, a new high.

summary_en: The Labor Fund Utilization Bureau announced the top ten holdings in the first half of the year yesterday (3rd). As it continues to be optimistic about the prospects of the AI ​​industry and believes that this is not a short-term phenomenon, but a trend with long-term development potential of about ten years, the Labor Fund’s investment in the first half of the year will still focus on electronic stocks.

summary_en: In the first half of the year, Taiwanese stocks frequently set new record highs. On June 26, the intraday price soared to a record high of 48,218 points. General investors also actively participated in the prosperity of Taiwanese stocks through Taiwanese stock ETFs and Taiwanese stock funds, forming a "fourth legal person" force to resist overselling by foreign investors. The total net subscription amount of Taiwanese stock-related products in the first half of the year reached 1.08 trillion yuan, also setting a new record.

title: 房市持續低迷！北市Q2預售屋推案腰斬、解約增3成

title_en: The housing market continues to slump! Q2 pre-sale housing sales in Beijing City were cut in half, while contract cancellations increased by 30%
summary_en: The Land Affairs Bureau of the Taipei City Government announced today (3rd) the quarterly report on pre-sale construction project information for the second quarter of 2026. There are only 20 pre-sale construction projects and 1,254 households, a quarterly decrease of 23.08% and a 44.73% respectively, and an annual decrease of 47.37% and 56.47%; in the statistics of pre-sale house cancellations, there were 47 cases in the second quarter, an increase of 11.9% and 30.56% respectively compared with the previous quarter and the same period last year. It shows that the wait-and-see atmosphere in the housing market continues. Not only do developers tend to be conservative in promoting projects, but home buyers also tend to be pessimistic about the housing market outlook.

title_en: To seize the frailty market of 90 million people worldwide, Taiwan’s new cell-based drug completes dual FDA and TFDA filings
summary_en: Frailty is not an inevitable consequence of aging, but a quantifiable and interventionable systemic functional decline, such as unexplained weight loss, weakened grip strength, slowed pace, and persistent fatigue. Frailty affects more than 90 million elderly people worldwide. Qiqi Biomedical, a regenerative medicine platform company, recently announced that its new frailty drug officially passed the FDA clinical trial application (IND) review by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration at the end of June this year, obtained international regulatory qualifications for frailty indications, and submitted an application to the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare.

title_en: Yageo, Jingmai, and Sino-American Jingliang Guo Zherong: If you can’t buy stocks that fall below 40,000 points, when should you get in?
summary_en: Observing the international market, the Korean stock market fell by about 5% today, mainly due to the normal technical retracement caused by the sharp rebound of 15% after the previous day's sharp decline. Investors need to pay close attention to the Korean stock market's previous low of 5,262 points in the future. This key position must not fall below. If the Korean stock market continues to weaken in the short term, it may have short-term implications for Taiwan stocks. Therefore, it is estimated that there is a higher chance of a rebound in the Taiwan stock market tomorrow. However, even if the market pulls back tomorrow, it will not fall below the 40,000-point mark again, and the chance of the OTC index bottoming out is extremely low. If there is a moderate pullback, investors should seize the opportunity to go long. Looking back at the performance of Taiwanese stocks, as I shared before, stocks that have fallen by more than 30% or even 50% in the band are expected to usher in a strong rebound. Sure enough, the group that had suffered from indiscriminate selling in the market before and fell into deep decline showed an extremely fierce rebound momentum today. Yageo, the leader in passive components, hit the daily limit just 5 minutes after the opening; the semiconductor packaging and testing and silicon wafer groups were not to be outdone. Jingma hit the daily limit 7 minutes after the opening. Mid-American Crystal also hit the daily limit strongly. Individual stocks that had previously overcorrected, such as Global Crystal and Phison, also simultaneously showed strong buying.

title: 想讓強勢老闆聽進建議？1,000多年前歷史人物示範：先給面子，再改變決定
summary:
有些老闆能力強、反應快，遇到問題也敢拍板，卻不容易接受部屬提出不同意見。面對這類重視效率、掌控感與權威的「力量型老闆」，光是把事情做好還不夠。你還必須知道，什麼時候該說、怎麼說，才能讓對方聽進建議，又不覺得自己的決策權受到挑戰。

一千多年前，武則天身邊的李昭德、魏元忠與狄仁傑，都有能力，也敢直言，命運卻大不相同。有人被貶黜，有人被逐出朝堂，只有狄仁傑始終得到她的信任。三人的差別，正好說明了與強勢主管相處時，專業之外更關鍵的一項能力：如何在堅持立場的同時，不讓溝通變成權力對抗。

作家吳淡如在《武則天攻略》中提到，武則天為何對李昭德、魏元忠都下重手，卻對狄仁傑始終信任，直到他咽下最後一口氣？當他逝世時，她甚至感嘆朝中空了，究竟是什麼原因？這三人有許多共通點，都是她一手提拔，品行剛正不阿，斷獄公道，且個性上皆嫉惡如仇。他們都曾心懷李唐，也曾進諫勸說武則天，只是她選擇聽或不聽。在我看來，個性的差異，最終決定了他們的命運。

title: 老闆換三輪、部門重整仍屹立不搖　這種同事為何最能活到最後？
summary: 你有沒有發現，公司裡活得最久的，往往不是最強的那個。有一種同事，你說不出他哪裡厲害，也想不起他得罪過誰。老闆換了三輪、部門砍掉重練兩次，他還在。被搶功，笑笑；被甩鍋，也笑笑。你私下覺得他沒骨氣，直到某天你才發現，當年拉你一把的人就是他，只是他從來沒說。所以，什麼樣的人能夠長保安康？這個問題，早在權力最凶險的朝堂上，就有人用一生作答。作家吳淡如在《武則天攻略》中提到兩個人：婁師德與蘇味道。後世有兩句成語，各與這二人相關：婁師德的「唾面自乾」，以及蘇味道的「模稜兩可」。婁師德（630—699）身材高大，情商也高，性情寬厚，即便有人冒犯於他，他仍能謙卑以對，求得原諒。成語「唾面自乾」便與他有關。他性情寬厚，也是有實際能力之人，進士出身，從軍能打勝仗，治理田賦也能使朝廷財政井然有序。在唐高宗與武則天時期，他皆是朝廷重臣。他能在官場平安無事，除了不得罪人之外，也與他長年在外掌管屯田與邊境防務，遠離朝中紛爭有關。

title: 生酮、低碳、地中海飲食誰減重最快？研究揭排名：短期與長期結果不同
summary:
為什麼有人餐餐節食卻越減越肥，有人天天吃飽照樣瘦下來？答案不在意志力，而在你是否掌握了那條流傳百年的減肥鐵律。「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，想減肥，不是靠喝瘦身茶或不吃晚餐，而是靠一個最基本的原則：熱量赤字。意思是：你每天吃進去的熱量要比你消耗的少。

減肥的第一原則：吃得比你消耗的少
曾嶔元表示，只要吃進去的卡路里比消耗掉的多，那麼剩下的必定會被累積起來。這個簡單的道理成為肥胖的物理模型：「卡路里進，卡路里出」（calories in, calories out）。這是美國醫師Hunt在1918年出版的書裡提到的觀念，至今已超過100年，深入大家的腦海。多年來，限制卡路里已經成為減肥的金科玉律。

當身體從食物獲得的能量不足，就會自動「啟用」脂肪倉庫，把體脂肪轉換成能量，體重自然就下降。不管你吃低碳、168、地中海、生酮、原型食物，最終都得靠熱量赤字來減重。

title_en: Who loses weight the fastest among ketogenic, low-carb, and Mediterranean diets? Study reveals rankings: Short-term and long-term results differ
summary_en:
Why do some people lose weight even more while dieting every meal, while some people still lose weight even if they eat well every day? The answer lies not in willpower, but in whether you have mastered the iron law of weight loss that has been around for centuries. "Medical Sherlock Holmes" Dr. Zeng Jinyuan points out in his new book "Precision Diet" that if you want to lose weight, you don't rely on drinking slimming tea or skipping dinner, but on one of the most basic principles: caloric deficit. Meaning: You eat fewer calories than you burn every day.

The first rule of weight loss: Eat less than you consume
Zeng Jinyuan said that as long as you eat more calories than you burn, the rest will definitely accumulate. This simple truth becomes the physical model of obesity: "calories in, calories out." This is a concept mentioned in a book published by American physician Hunt in 1918. It has been deeply rooted in everyone's minds for more than 100 years. Over the years, calorie restriction has become the golden rule for weight loss.

When the body obtains insufficient energy from food, it will automatically "activate" fat stores to convert body fat into energy, and weight will naturally decrease. No matter if you eat low-carb, 168, Mediterranean, ketogenic, or prototype food, you will ultimately have to rely on a caloric deficit to lose weight.

title_en: Osteoporosis doesn’t just affect the elderly! White, thin, and those who avoid sun exposure are high-risk groups. Doctors name 8 bone-protecting nutrients.
summary_en:
When most people talk about osteoporosis, what comes to mind is often the elderly with gray hair and limited mobility. However, with changes in lifestyle, bone loss is no longer exclusive to the elderly, but has quietly found another group of people. Ethnic groups that are fair and thin, diet for a long time, dare not bask in the sun, dare not exercise, and just want to "look thin" are becoming new high-risk targets.

If you take good care of your health early, you will avoid worries in old age. The concept of capital is actually like saving for retirement. You don’t start preparing for retirement. Rather, the earlier you accumulate, the more abundant you will have in the future. If you want to be healthy until old age, you must still be flexible and agile in running, jumping and squatting. Sunshine, exercise and nutritional supplements are indispensable, and are regarded as the golden triangle for preventing osteoporosis.

In his new book "Pure Mind and Wellness: 108 Tibetan Preventive Medicine Prescriptions for Mind, Body and Spirit to Avoid Sickness", a well-known expert in preventive medicine for body, mind and soul, Dr. Lobsang points out that instead of panicking about calcium supplements, it is better to take good care of the key nutrients needed for bones in your daily diet. The following eight major nutrients are the foundations that many people tend to overlook, but are crucial to bone health.

title_en: You don’t have to exercise every day for a week. Doctors reveal anti-aging exercise method: Leave 2 to 3 days for a good rest
summary_en: The most difficult feeling of fatigue often comes from negative emotions that cannot be let go. Even though you have worked very hard, you are still criticized by your customers or bosses. When you feel sad, you will not be able to find the energy to do even the things you are best at. Most people tend to only notice physical fatigue, but often ignore the internal wear and tear on the mental level. This hidden loss of energy is often more damaging than physical fatigue. It's like a secretly leaking water pipe, draining your vitality without even realizing it. The method to block depletion is simple and intuitive: the fewer negative thoughts the better, and there can never be too many positive thoughts. It is advisable to collect as many happy and interesting experiences as possible on a daily basis and build a happy database in your brain to meet emergencies. Sipping tea, reading good books, visiting beautiful countries, and making interesting friends are all good ways to expand your database.

title_en: Xinjin Financial Report/Earning 1.3 yuan per share in the second quarter, profit of 187 million yuan, a surge of 266%
summary_en: Xinjin (1582), a major precision mechanical parts manufacturer, held a board meeting today (3rd) to announce its financial report for the second quarter of 2026. The revenue share of low-orbit satellites (LEO) continued to increase in the second quarter compared with the same period last year. However, due to the conservative end demand of the overall industry and the adjustment of customer procurement schedules, the consolidated operating income in the second quarter was NT$2.006 billion, a quarterly decrease of 5.15% and an annual decrease of 6.87%. Affected by factors such as reduced revenue scale, rising product mix and raw material prices, the operating gross profit was NT$285 million, the gross profit margin was 14.19%, and the operating loss was NT$37 million. However, driven by non-industry income, the net profit after tax attributable to the parent company was NT$187 million, a quarterly increase of 266.9% and an annual increase of 54.58%. Calculated based on weighted average equity, after-tax earnings per share (EPS) in the second quarter of 2026 was NT$1.30, an increase from NT$0.84 in the same period last year.

title_en: Unexpected effects of the Kucha Oil food safety scandal: Zhongpu production and marketing class orders increased by 10% to 20%
summary_en: The scandal over Camellia oleifera oil exceeding the standard of benzene and pyrene continues to spread. Zhongpu Township in Chiayi County is an important Camellia oleifera production area. The 9th Class of the Camellia Camellia Production and Marketing Class of the Zhongpu Township Farmers Association has about 40 members and a planting area of ​​about 40 hectares. Class leader Zeng Ziyao said that after the incident, he was worried that consumers would have doubts about domestic camellia oil. Unexpectedly, class members' orders increased, with an initial estimate of about 10% to 20%. He believed that consumers began to pay more attention to the source of raw materials, and called on the government to clearly indicate the "origin of raw materials" in the future, not just the manufacturing location.

summary: 韓國和台灣股市今年以來成為亞洲漲幅表現數一數二的市場，不過韓股近期面臨技術性熊市，由於跌幅過大，單是7月，就觸發4次全場暫停交易的「熔斷機制」。台股是否要仿韓股實施熔斷？證交所今天(3日)表示，台股有10%漲跌幅限制及盤中瞬間價格穩定措施，足以提供冷卻效果並維護市場秩序。 韓國股市的熔斷機制有3階段，分別是跌幅達8%、15%與20%。當大盤指數比前一天收盤價下跌超過規定比例且持續一分鐘時就會觸發。 證交所3日宣布8月10日開始，處置股的相關新規定，包括個股關禁閉縮短為 5天，當沖加重者縮為7天，並改採每2分鐘撮合一次。媒體關注，未來是否比照美國、韓國股市導入「熔斷機制」？ 證交所發言人、副總杜惠娟表示，美國股市無漲跌幅限制，韓國股市漲跌幅限制高達30%，因此需要熔斷機制；而台股設10%漲跌幅限制，已有防範極端波動的基礎。另外，台股現行已有「盤中瞬間價格穩定措施」，當基準價超過 3.5% 時即會暫緩撮合 2 分鐘，同樣能達到冷卻市場情緒的效果。(編輯 : 廖奕婷)

title_en: Taiwan stock counterattack signal: Whether the New Taiwan dollar can turn from black to red in August will be the key
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market experienced violent fluctuations in July, falling all the way from the June high of 48,218 points to the July intraday low of 39,384 points, with a total loss of 8,834 points. Fortunately, it rebounded by more than 3,000 points on the last trading day of July, setting a record for the largest single-day point gain in history. The market also focused on whether the rebound could continue in August. However, market participants believe that the key to whether Taiwan stocks can truly bottom out and strengthen is whether foreign capital stops withdrawing and returns to the market. In August, the New Taiwan dollar exchange rate will also face an important test of whether the monthly trend can turn from black to red.

summary_en: The All-China Federation of Industry said on the 3rd that the Legislative Yuan is currently reviewing a draft amendment to the Energy Management Law. The new law intends to force large power consumers to set up power generation and energy storage facilities. Once passed, more than 400 semiconductor, optoelectronic, steel, petrochemical and AI data centers will be affected. The Federation of Industry and Commerce has made three major suggestions in this regard, calling for the scope of application to be broadened and alternatives to be included.

title_en: Can you catch up with a strong rebound after a sharp drop? 3 tips from experts to ensure safety
summary_en: After consecutive days of heavy losses, the Taiwan stock market rebounded by more than 3,000 points on Friday (7/31). However, a one-day surge does not mean that the V-turn has been established. summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述上海證券報的報導指稱，上週A股整體呈現震盪分化格局。經歷了7月的波動後，券商策略展望報告普遍認為，政策層面近期釋放出較為明確的穩成長信號，加上企業盈利修復與流動性適度寬裕的支撐，市場進一步下探空間有限，8月A股或將進入行情修復的有利時間窗口。中國銀河證券認為，從市場交易角度觀察，在本輪調整過程中，槓桿資金風險偏好明顯下降，兩融餘額持續回落，階段性槓桿資金降溫緩解了前期賽道的擁擠壓力。與此同時，中國銀河證券認為，場內股票型ETF逆勢出現資金淨流入，顯示資金在市場調整過程中逢低佈局，底部承接力量對指數形成支撐。中國銀行證券表示，短期來看，市場大機率將以震盪整理、結構再平衡為核心特徵，隨著AI賽道擁擠度回落、國內政策持續支撐、長線資金不斷入場，指數進一步下探的空間顯著收斂。

It is necessary to develop high value-added products using existing processes and equipment to build a body that can compete with the business cycle.

The General Accounting Office reported the preliminary plan to Executive Director Zhuo Rongtai last week. It will be reported to President Lai Ching-de this month and sent to the Executive Yuan for approval.

summary: 台股近期因個股大跌與處置機制導致「賣不掉」的爭議，引發網路熱烈討論。部分投資人主張應廢除10%漲跌幅限制，認為現行制度僵化，阻礙價格反映市場真實價值，導致投資人受困。然而，反對派則憂心台股量體較小，若取消限制，恐使中小型股淪為主力大戶炒作的工具，散戶將面臨更高流動性風險。市場正反意見激烈交鋒，焦點圍繞在漲跌幅限制與處置分盤制度對市場的影響。專家分析，如何在保障散戶權益與提升市場流動性之間取得平衡，成為台股交易制度改革的重要課題，後續政策走向備受投資市場高度關注。

summary_en: The global container shipping market has added to the uncertainty. The Panama Canal has recently reduced the scheduled traffic of some ships due to water level management and traffic scheduling. In addition, the unresolved crisis in the Middle East, congestion and ship shortages at major ports continue to disrupt the global supply chain, and transportation capacity is tightening again. Logistics industry players predict that spot freight rates on the North American route will rise another 10% to 15% this week, and quotations on the West and East routes will rise.

title: 蘇元和觀點》AI下半場 漲價故事說完了 終端願意買單嗎？

summary_en: Taiwan stocks have rebounded strongly after a sharp decline recently. title_en: Bessant said he would not rule out more joint Japanese yen intervention
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said that he would not hesitate to conduct more joint yen intervention. Bessent said in a post on X that the Ministry of Finance will continue to pay close attention to developments and maintain close communication with the Ministry of Finance and the Bank of Japan. We will not hesitate to engage in further joint interventions. Bessent said that the FIMA buyback mechanism is an important backup measure. We encourage its expansion in the coming months.

title_en: To curb the weakness of the yen, the United States and Japan are rumored to coordinate foreign exchange market measures
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that sources familiar with the situation revealed that Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama will announce as soon as Monday that Tokyo and Washington are coordinating measures in the foreign exchange market to curb the weakness of the yen. The announcement is still being developed but could be released as soon as Monday morning, said people familiar with the matter who asked not to be identified because the information has not yet been made public. Foreign news revealed earlier that Satsuki Katayama would confirm the joint action and reiterate that both parties are committed to responding to what they consider to be excessive depreciation of the yen. Foreign media previously quoted a source familiar with the matter as saying that the Japanese authorities bought yen and sold US dollars during New York trading hours last Friday.

title: 剛果民主共和國爆史上最大伊波拉疫情，累計確診3674例、死亡1621人
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情持續惡化。該國衛生部週六(8月1日)宣布，截至7月31日，本輪疫情累計通報3,674例確診病例，其中1,621人死亡，病例與死亡規模均處於極高水準，公共衛生與醫療體系承受沉重壓力。世界衛生組織(WHO)同日發布公告指出，本輪疫情已成為剛果民主共和國有紀錄以來規模最大的伊波拉疫情。按現有數據計算，病例死亡率約44.1%，反映伊波拉病毒疾病仍具有極高致命性，尤其在醫療資源不足、患者延誤就醫及接觸者追蹤困難的地區，死亡風險更為突出。伊波拉主要透過患者體液及受污染物品接觸傳播，疫情控制高度依賴快速診斷、患者隔離、接觸者追蹤、疫苗接種及安全埋葬措施。若病例持續增加，可能進一步壓縮當地醫療容量，並對跨境人員流動、航空運輸、礦業營運及區域供應鏈構成干擾。市場人士指出，剛果民主共和國是全球重要的鈷、銅等礦產供應國，疫情目前雖未必直接影響主要礦區生產，但若蔓延至交通樞紐或礦業省分，企業可能面臨人力短缺、物流延誤及防疫成本上升。後續需密切觀察病例是否外溢至鄰國，以及國際援助、疫苗與醫療物資能否及時到位。

title_en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has the largest Ebola epidemic in history, with a total of 3,674 confirmed cases and 1,621 deaths.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Chen Mengshuo] The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to worsen. The country's Ministry of Health announced on Saturday (August 1) that as of July 31, a total of 3,674 confirmed cases had been reported in this round of the epidemic, including 1,621 deaths. The scale of cases and deaths was at an extremely high level, and the public health and medical systems were under heavy pressure. The World Health Organization (WHO) issued an announcement on the same day stating that this epidemic has become the largest Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's history. Calculated based on existing data, the case fatality rate is approximately 44.1%, reflecting that Ebola virus disease is still extremely lethal. Especially in areas with insufficient medical resources, delayed patient treatment, and difficult contact tracing, the risk of death is more prominent. Ebola is mainly transmitted through contact with patient body fluids and contaminated items. Epidemic control highly relies on rapid diagnosis, patient isolation, contact tracing, vaccination and safe burial measures. If the number of cases continues to increase, it may further compress local medical capacity and disrupt cross-border movement of people, air transportation, mining operations and regional supply chains. Market participants pointed out that the Democratic Republic of the Congo is an important global supplier of cobalt, copper and other minerals. Although the epidemic may not directly affect production in major mining areas, if it spreads to transportation hubs or mining provinces, companies may face manpower shortages, logistics delays and rising epidemic prevention costs. It is necessary to closely observe whether cases have spilled over to neighboring countries and whether international aid, vaccines and medical supplies can be received in a timely manner.

summary_en: Picture/Schematic Shang Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports Trump Media & Technology Group transferred approximately US$165 million worth of Bitcoin to the cryptocurrency trading platform Crypto.com on August 2. The transfer involved 2,628 Bitcoins and was carried out in two transactions. Trump Media later stated that the Bitcoins were only transferred and not sold. According to reports, as of March 31, Trump Media had used approximately 4,260.73 Bitcoins as collateral for convertible notes. After the transfer was completed, the company's related wallets still held approximately 4,261 Bitcoins, estimated to be worth approximately US$268 million. The restrictions on these Bitcoins used as collateral will be lifted no later than May 29, 2028, when the note matures. Trump Media has previously maintained a cooperative relationship with Crypto.com in areas such as cryptocurrency index stock funds (ETFs) and shareholder reward tokens, although the company withdrew its applications for the Truth Social Bitcoin ETF and Bitcoin and Ethereum ETF in May. On the market front, Bitcoin has been under pressure recently. On July 31, the price of Bitcoin fell to $62,236, bringing the total market value to $1.26 trillion. title_en: KOSPI soared 17.91% last Friday, the strongest in history, with foreign investors buying 7.2 trillion won, setting a record
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] South Korea's stock market staged an epic rebound on July 31. South Korea's Seoul Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) surged 1,001.89 points, or 17.91%, to close at 6,595.45 points. Regardless of the number of points or the increase, it set the largest single-day record since statistics were collected in 1985. Foreign investors net purchased about 7.2 trillion won of KOSPI stocks that day, setting a new single-day record in history and becoming the main driver of the index's sharp rebound after falling sharply for three consecutive trading days. Citi analyst Jin-Wook Kim pointed out that the net monthly net selling of KOSPI stocks by foreign investors in July has narrowed to 9.8 trillion won, far lower than the 44.5 trillion won in May and 48.4 trillion won in June, indicating that the previous selling pressure caused by asset rebalancing and profit-taking is rapidly fading. Domestic pension funds and funds in South Korea also turned to a net purchase of 1 trillion won in July, reversing the net sales of 2.2 trillion won in May and 2.4 trillion won in June, which means that the capital side of the Korean stock market has gradually turned from an obvious headwind to a tailwind. South Korea's Financial Services Commission (FSC) has simultaneously raised the threshold for retail investors to participate in single stock leveraged ETFs since July 31. The minimum margin has been increased from the original 10 million won in stocks and cash to 30 million won, which can only be paid in cash. After the new regulations came into effect, the trading volume of major single-stock leveraged ETFs dropped to about half of the monthly average level, and the market value of related products also shrank significantly. title_en: South Korean stocks surged, with the MSCI Emerging Markets Index soaring 6.6% last Friday, the strongest single-day gain since 2008.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] A strong rebound in Asian technology stocks such as South Korea and Taiwan pushed the MSCI emerging market stock index up 6.6% last Friday (July 31), the best single-day performance since the 2008 global financial crisis, ending the violent sell-off triggered by artificial intelligence (AI) concept stocks earlier in the past week. The index's monthly decline in July narrowed to 3.3%, but it has not yet fully recovered the losses caused by the sharp decline in Korean stocks, Taiwanese stocks and memory stocks. Korean stocks are the biggest driver of this rebound in emerging markets. The Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) soared 17.91% on July 31, rewriting the largest single-day increase in history. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix both approached the 30% daily limit. Since South Korea occupies an important weight in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index, and the two major memory companies are the largest constituent stocks in the Korean stock market, related stocks have turned from sharp declines to skyrocketing gains, directly amplifying the rise of the overall emerging markets index. The driving force for the rebound mainly comes from short covering after extreme oversold conditions, accelerated liquidation of leveraged positions in South Korea, and earnings reports from Microsoft and Amazon that re-strengthened market confidence in the demand for AI. Technology stocks in Taiwan and Japan also rebounded simultaneously, driving Asia's emerging market indicators to their largest single-day gains in more than 17 years. The MSCI Emerging Markets Index is weighted by the free float market capitalization of large- and mid-cap stocks and covers 24 emerging markets. Therefore, when there are violent fluctuations in technology weighted markets such as South Korea and Taiwan, the rise and fall of the index will be significantly amplified. However, the single-day rise of 6.6% is still closer to a rebound from a deep decline, rather than a new one.

title: SpaceX傳嚴審供應鏈，禁用中國設備、限制中國人員
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述日經亞洲的報導指出，美國航太業者SpaceX據稱正採取措施確保其營運和供應鏈不受中國的影響。日經亞洲這篇引述多個消息來源的報導指稱，SpaceX已派人審計現有和潛在供應商。報導還指稱，SpaceX指示其全球供應鏈上的合作夥伴，不得在為其製造產品的設施安排或聘請中國公民，也不得使用中國公司製造的系統或設備。對於上述述消息，SpaceX未回應多次置評請求。

title_en: SpaceX is said to be strictly reviewing its supply chain, banning Chinese equipment and restricting Chinese personnel
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports quoted Nikkei Asia as saying that the US aerospace company SpaceX is reportedly taking measures to ensure that its operations and supply chain are not affected by China. The Nikkei Asia report, citing multiple sources, alleged that SpaceX has sent people to audit existing and potential suppliers. The report also alleged that SpaceX has instructed its partners in the global supply chain not to arrange or hire Chinese citizens in the facilities where it manufactures products, nor to use systems or equipment made by Chinese companies. SpaceX did not respond to multiple requests for comment on the above-mentioned news.

title: 韓國7月出口年增62.8%優於預期，AI晶片熱潮撐經濟，升息理由再增

title_en: South Korea's exports in July increased by 62.8% year-on-year, better than expected. The AI ​​chip boom supports the economy and there are more reasons to raise interest rates.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that investment in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure has driven demand for memory chips to continue to heat up. South Korea's exports in July increased by 62.8% year-on-year, higher than market expectations of 59%. Although it slowed down from the revised 70.9% in June, the largest growth rate in the past half century, it still maintained strong growth momentum. After adjusting for differences in working days, average daily exports increased by 69.6% year-on-year, indicating that the overall export slowdown was mainly affected by fewer working days, rather than a significant weakening of external demand. South Korea's imports in July increased by 26.5% year-on-year, lower than market expectations of 27.8% and slower than June's 30.1%. The single-month trade surplus reached US$30.3 billion, higher than analysts' forecast of US$29.487 billion. South Korea's exports exceeded US$100 billion for the first time in June, an annual increase of 70.9%, the largest increase since 1978. Export performance in July was once again better than expected, showing that the semiconductor boom is still the most important growth pillar of the South Korean economy. The strong exports mainly come from the expansion of AI servers and data centers, which boosts demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM), DRAM and other high-end chips. In the first 20 days of July, South Korea's semiconductor exports increased by 180.6% year-on-year, driving overall export growth by 52.3% during the same period; exports to China increased by 94.1%, and exports to the United States also increased by 39.6%, showing that the demand for AI supply chains benefiting Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix has not cooled down rapidly due to the recent plunge in global technology stocks. This data also provides more reasons for the Bank of Korea to further tighten monetary policy. The Bank of Korea has raised its policy interest rate to 2 in July

title_en: St. Louis Fed president leans in favor of raising interest rates, saying sell-off in U.S. debt has raised red flags for Fed's credibility in fighting inflation
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Chen Mengshuo] According to foreign reports, Alberto Musalem, president of the Federal Bank of St. Louis, said that the violent sell-off in U.S. government bonds in the past week has issued a warning to the credibility of the Federal Reserve (Fed) in maintaining price stability. He admitted frankly that he is inclined to support further interest rate increases, believing that if inflation continues to be higher than the 2% target, taking gradual tightening measures now may be less costly than being forced to raise interest rates significantly in the future. After the Federal Reserve concluded its two-day regular meeting on July 29, it voted 9 to 3 to maintain the federal funds rate target range at 3.50% to 3.75%. It remained unchanged for the fifth time in a row. However, long-term U.S. Treasuries subsequently suffered a massive sell-off. The 30-year U.S. bond yield once rose to 5.28%, the highest since 2007. The market simultaneously experienced a "reversal steepening" of falling short-term yields and sharp rise in long-term yields. This reflects that investors are not simply betting that the Fed will raise interest rates, but are increasing their compensation requirements for long-term inflation and policy credibility risks. Mussallem, who does not have the right to vote this year, said the signals from the bond market deserve high attention from policymakers, as rising long-term bond yields indicate investors are beginning to doubt the Fed's willingness to take sufficient measures to lower inflation. Tariffs, rising energy prices caused by the war in Iran, a boom in AI investment, and strong consumer demand are all likely to keep price pressures at a high level; if the Fed continues to wait, inflation expectations may gradually move upward, ultimately pushing up the costs of mortgages, corporate financing, and government debt. title: 印度央行引資措施吸金408億美元，力撐盧比並補強外匯緩衝

title_en: The Reserve Bank of India's investment attraction measures attracted US$40.8 billion, supporting the rupee and strengthening foreign exchange buffers
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that the Bank of India has launched a series of foreign exchange measures to attract overseas funds and stabilize the rupee. As of the end of July, it has introduced US$40.81 billion to supplement India’s foreign exchange liquidity and strengthen the central bank’s policy space to intervene in the foreign exchange market when the situation in the Middle East heats up and international oil prices fluctuate at high levels. The Reserve Bank of India launched preferential hedging and exchange arrangements in June to encourage state-owned enterprises, banks and overseas Indians to remit foreign currency funds into the country. Among them, banks absorbed US$36.7 billion in non-resident foreign currency deposits, accounting for nearly 90% of the overall inflow; in addition, the overseas commercial loan exchange mechanism introduced US$1.5 billion, and authorized banks' overseas foreign currency borrowings brought in US$2.57 billion. Non-resident foreign currency deposits can be exchanged with the central bank through a zero-cost hedging mechanism. The relevant window is open until the end of September, and other borrowing arrangements will continue until the end of the year. This wave of dollar inflows comes at a time when India is facing pressure from rising crude oil prices and depreciation of the rupee. India is highly dependent on energy imports, and rising oil prices typically increase demand for U.S. dollars and increase the burden on the current account. On July 24, the Bank of India reportedly sold about US$7 billion to support the rupee, which was one of the more powerful direct interventions in recent months. Central Bank Governor Sanjay Malhotra emphasized that the recent weakening of the rupee was mainly due to geopolitical conflicts, the appreciation of the US dollar, and general fluctuations in emerging markets, and was not a deterioration in India's economic fundamentals. The market still has expectations for the scale of subsequent inflows. The Economic Research Department of the State Bank of India estimates that non-resident foreign currency deposits may eventually increase to US$65 billion to US$70 billion.

title_en: Japan and the United States jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market after 15 years. The Japanese yen surged to 157 per dollar during the session.
summary_en: Picture/Schematic Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei Report: The monetary authorities of Japan and the United States jointly implemented coordinated exchange rate intervention of buying yen and selling US dollars in the New York foreign exchange market last Friday (July 31), aiming to correct the historical weakness of the yen. This is the first time the two countries have taken such joint action since the Great East Japan Earthquake in 2011. This intervention caused the yen exchange rate to strengthen rapidly, rising to 157.20 yen per dollar during the session, setting a new high in about two and a half months. On July 30, the day before the coordinated intervention by Japan and the United States, the Japanese government and the Bank of Japan conducted a separate foreign exchange intervention, with an estimated scale of 6 trillion to 7 trillion yen. This shows that market intervention actions have been carried out for two consecutive days. The U.S. Department of the Treasury also conducted a "rate check" on financial institutions on July 30 and issued a warning to the market by asking about exchange rate levels. Subsequently, on July 31, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York issued a rare advance notice of possible market intervention through a number of banks to prepare the market. According to local media reports, a note clearly marked "Buy Japanese Yen" was observed on the desk of U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet L. Yellen during a cabinet meeting, with an amount ranging from US$5 billion to US$10 billion (approximately 800 billion to 1.6 trillion yen), indicating that this intervention was carefully prepared. Actual foreign exchange transactions were allegedly conducted through Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley

title: 美債收益率攀升施壓 比特幣等加密貨幣市場現資金外流
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導近期美國公債收益率持續攀升，對全球金融市場帶來壓力，特別是比特幣等加密貨幣市場正因此面臨資金持續外流的挑戰。專家指出，脆弱的經濟狀況與美國聯準會（Federal Reserve）可能採取的進一步行動，皆對市場前景構成威脅，並可能全面性地影響加密貨幣資產的價格表現。 美國國債收益率，代表投資政府債券可獲得的報酬率，其上升通常意味著這些被視為較安全的資產變得更具吸引力，進而可能將資金從風險較高的投資中抽離。據《AMBCrypto》報導，這種趨勢已持續數週，導致投資者轉向低風險資產，並穩定地從比特幣等風險性資產中撤出資金。 加密貨幣分析師 Benjamin Cowen 指出，即便聯準會調降利率，也不會自動導致收益率下降。他以 2024 至 2025 年為例，當時聯準會將利率從 5.5% 降至 3.75%，但 30 年期公債收益率仍高於利率為 5.5% 時的水準。他預期，聯準會過早降息，將使長期債券市場承受更大壓力，若收益率維持在 5% 以上，最終將迫使聯準會升息，進而緊縮流向風險資產的資金。 聯準會升息會限制資金流動，因為借貸成本會提高，促使投資者選擇更穩定

title_en: Rising U.S. bond yields put pressure on cash outflows from Bitcoin and other cryptocurrency markets
summary_en: Picture/Schematic Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei Report: The recent rise in U.S. Treasury bond yields has put pressure on global financial markets. In particular, cryptocurrency markets such as Bitcoin are facing the challenge of continued capital outflows. Experts point out that fragile economic conditions and possible further actions by the Federal Reserve pose a threat to the market outlook and may comprehensively affect the price performance of cryptocurrency assets. Rising U.S. Treasury yields, which represent the rate of return you can earn from investing in government bonds, often mean these assets seen as safer are becoming more attractive, which can pull money away from riskier investments. According to AMBCrypto, this trend has continued for several weeks, causing investors to shift to low-risk assets and steadily withdraw funds from risky assets such as Bitcoin. Cryptocurrency analyst Benjamin Cowen pointed out that even if the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates, it will not automatically lead to a decrease in yields. He pointed to 2024-2025 as an example, when the Fed lowered interest rates from 5.5% to 3.75%, but the 30-year bond yield was still higher than when interest rates were 5.5%. He expects that the Fed will cut interest rates prematurely, which will put greater pressure on the long-term bond market. If yields remain above 5%, it will eventually force the Fed to raise interest rates, thereby tightening the flow of funds to risky assets. title_en: The Dallas Fed opposes no action, warning that delays in raising interest rates could solidify inflation and require heavy action in the future.
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Chen Mengshuo] According to foreign reports, Dallas Federal Bank President Lorie Logan said on Friday (July 31) that she opposed the Federal Reserve (Fed) keeping interest rates unchanged because the current degree of policy restraint is not enough to ensure that inflation continues to fall back to the 2% target. She warned that if the central bank does not take further action, inflation may remain above the target level for a long time, unless the economy encounters an unexpected shock. Mild tightening measures now can reduce the risk of being forced to raise interest rates significantly in the future. The Fed ended its two-day regular meeting on July 29, with 9 votes in favor and 3 votes against, maintaining the target range of the federal funds rate at 3.50% to 3.75% for the fifth consecutive time. Logan, along with Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack, both advocated a one-point increase in interest rates, becoming the first time since 2016 that three policymakers opposed the majority decision in the same direction, highlighting the apparent widening of differences among policymakers over inflation risks. Logan pointed out that it has been more than five years since inflation surged after the epidemic, and prices are still rising too fast. Every month when inflation rises above the target, it will further erode the purchasing power of American households and businesses. The common argument of the three opponents is that the U.S. economy and labor market are still resilient, but inflation has yet to return to 2%. If the policy continues to wait for energy prices, tariffs or other supply shocks to subside on their own, inflation expectations may gradually solidify, and the Fed will need to pay a higher economic price.

title: 華許考慮將Fed例會減至六次，恐打破45年慣例、放大政策空窗期風險

title: 歐盟擴大實施人工智慧法，聊天機器人須表明身分、深偽內容強制標示
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，歐盟執委會最新宣布，自週日(8月2日)起進一步擴大《人工智慧法》(AI Act)適用範圍，開始執行生成式與互動式人工智慧(AI)系統的透明度規定。聊天機器人等直接與民眾互動的系統，必須明確告知使用者正在與AI而非真人交流；經AI生成或修改的圖像、影音與聲音等深度偽造內容，也須以清楚方式加以標示。新規同時要求AI生成或修改的內容加入機器可讀標記，以便平台、監管機關及相關工具更容易辨識。涉及公共利益議題的AI生成或修改文字，也須揭露其人工生成性質。歐盟執委會表示，相關要求旨在降低AI被用於冒充真人、欺騙、操縱輿論及散播不實資訊的風險，但藝術、創作、諷刺及虛構作品可適用較有限的揭露方式。針對通用人工智慧模型(GPAI)，供應商須提交模型技術文件、提供下游開發者必要資訊，並遵守歐盟著作權規範；可能構成系統性風險的先進模型，還須進行風險評估、通報重大事故並強化網路安全，以防範模型失控、網路攻擊、有害操縱及侵犯基本權利等大規模危害。相關義務已自2025年8月起分階段適用，歐洲人工智慧辦公室自2026年8月2日起可進一步執行及裁罰。歐盟《人工智慧法》於2024年8月1日

title_en: Taiwan stock market pre-market/Amazon surges 15% to save U.S. stocks! The Taiwan Index fell 1,077 points in overnight trading and may have stopped rebounding today.
summary_en: The four major U.S. stock indexes closed in the red simultaneously on Friday (31st), with the Dow Jones Index rising 276.97 points, the Nasdaq Index rising 254.51 points, the S&P 500 Index rising 52.09 points, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rising slightly by 8.09 points. Although the financial reports of large technology stocks have boosted market sentiment, the Taiwan stock index fell 1,077 points in night trading. TSMC futures fell by 74 yuan after the market. With an increase in financing of 13.597 billion yuan, short-term chips have turned positive again. It is expected that Taiwan stocks will face profit-taking pressure at the opening of today (3rd day). The strong rebound after hitting the highest point in history may be significantly restrained today.

title_en: It will still be 36 degrees tomorrow! White dolphins are closest to Taiwan on this day. The latest prediction of "2 path divergences" is revealed
summary_en: Typhoon White Dolphin has weakened into a moderate typhoon, but the storm radius still remains at 320 kilometers. Liu Peiteng, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, said that White Dolphin will turn northwest and west towards the Ryukyu Islands, and then move to the sea in northern Taiwan after passing through. It is expected to be closest to Taiwan over the weekend. There may be heavy rain in some areas, but the path is still uncertain, and a northward trend cannot be ruled out. There will be less water vapor but there will still be rainfall.

summary_en: Chiayi Yuanchun Oil Refining Factory was involved in the incident involving tea oil, benzene and pyrene exceeding the standard. Today, it issued a clarification draft to further explain the sources of raw materials and OEM relationships for different products. Yuanchun stated that the tea seeds for the "Taiwan Camellia Oil" sold by International Functional Foods were indeed purchased from local farmers by Yuanchun; however, for the other three products of Yongfeng Yu Biotech's "Local Golden Flower Tea Oil", the tea seeds were provided by Weijia International, and Yuanchun was only responsible for processing and extracting the oil.

title_en: After 6 years, the Chaozhou International Packaging Factory will be opened in February next year. A one-stop cold chain for mango and pineapple exports
summary_en: Pingtung County is an important tropical fruit production base in Taiwan and the earliest producer of pineapples and mangoes in Taiwan. It took Pingtung County six years to build an international standard packaging and processing plant, and it will finally be put into operation in February next year. Vice President Xiao Meiqin visited Chaozhou International Packaging and Processing Plant today to learn about the one-stop operation process of goods collection, steaming and heat quarantine, grading packaging and cold chain logistics. County Mayor Zhou Chunmi said that in the future, the international competitiveness of Pingtung's high-quality agricultural products will be greatly enhanced through international standard equipment.

title_en: Taiwan Sugar knew that benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard but did not report it? Shi Chongliang made three points of clarification: The situation is different from that of Zhonglian and Nanqiao
summary_en: The case of Zoomlion Oil and Fat's carcinogenic oil has been spreading. The Taichung District Prosecutor's Office revealed that Taiwan Sugar reported that benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard in May, but only notified Zoomlion Oil and Fat to replace the product without notifying the competent authority. Kuomintang Legislator Chen Jinghui, People's Party Legislator Chen Zhaozi and others accused Taiwan Sugar of privately informing China United in May that the edible oil benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard. They believed that Taiwan Sugar discovered it earlier than Nanqiao, so Taiwan Sugar did not need to issue a penalty. They even believed that the real starting point of China United's carcinogenic oil case was Taiwan Sugar, which knew about it in May.

title_en: Dispelling the myth of high interest rates on ETFs! "Five Tips" of the Stock Exchange's Guidelines. If you get "him" wrong, you may become a leek.
summary_en: The craze in the Taiwan stock ETF market continues, and the stock exchange recently issued official guidelines to remind investors not to fall into the myth of high interest rates. Stabilization is a dividend adjustment mechanism rather than additional profits. The cover call strategy adopted by some ETFs can increase premium income, but may limit profit margins during a surge. Experts emphasize that the dividend rate is not equal to the real return, and investors should return to the "total return" evaluation to avoid earning dividends but losing the price difference. In addition, you should choose dividend or accumulation products according to your life stage, and make good use of the "Public Information Observatory" and "e Tianfu" platforms to check information such as ETF dividend structure and royalty ratio to ensure that investment decisions are rational and transparent, and to achieve the goal of steady long-term asset growth.

title_en: Financing maintenance rate closed, private version renamed and renewed
summary_en: In order to ensure that the Taiwan stock market does not exceed 40,000 points, the Financial Supervisory Commission and the stock exchange "covered" the financing maintenance rate of Taiwan stocks. In addition to requiring investment consultants to remove news on their own trial calculations of when financing will end, it also ordered brokers and Taiwan stock information platforms not to provide data on their own, and everything is subject to the announcement of the stock exchange. Some platforms that have not been targeted have recently changed their information to names such as "Financing Risk Value" to continue to update information. Brokerages have turned the light into darkness, willing to provide but denying the source.

summary_en: With the general election approaching at the end of the year, it has become the common goal of the Ministry of Finance and Economics to ensure that Taiwan's stock market does not fall. They even resort to "covering orders" and require that the financing maintenance rate can only be decided by the official. This approach is no different from asking short sellers to keep quiet. Instead of arguing about the authenticity of the data, the stock exchange no longer has to play word games and truthfully publish the financing and securities lending maintenance rates. Only by being open and transparent can we show credibility.

summary_en: An abandoned SpaceX rocket that has been drifting in space for more than a year is about to hit the moon! Hong Kong media "Hong Kong 01" reported that experts estimate that the upper debris of the rocket will fall into the Einstein crater area on the west side of the moon on Wednesday (5th). The impact speed will reach 8,700 kilometers per hour, which is equivalent to 7 times the speed of sound. The power generated is equivalent to the explosion of 3 tons of TNT explosives. It is expected to leave a crater 27 meters wide and 5 meters deep.

summary_en: Mr. T, a working worker in his 50s, locked in high-dividend stocks in the US and used the new NISA investment system to supplement his pension. Experts said the new NISA is different from the old rules, in the event of a corporate spin-off, the stock will be moved out of the tax-free framework, and the acquisition cost may be shown to be zero, resulting in aggravated subsequent tax burden. Financial expert Yukihiro Shimoda reminded that investors should not only focus on fees and interfaces when choosing brokers, but should also have an in-depth understanding of the account processing rules of the company's behavior. Many investors mistakenly believe that the rules of the old and new systems are consistent and neglect to verify. Investors are advised to confirm whether the brokerage regulations are in line with long-term asset allocation strategies, so as to avoid tax exemption benefits due to emergencies and affect the effectiveness of retirement planning.

summary_en: In response to external doubts that Taiwan Sugar was involved in the oil and fat exceedance incident with prior knowledge of China United, the Ministry of Economic Affairs issued a statement on the 2nd stating that the items purchased by Taiwan Sugar in May were crude collagen oil, not edible fats or edible oil products, nor "general oil" required by the "Food Safety Act". "The bid was submitted by Taiwan Sugar itself at the high standard in the contract; and when Taiwan Sugar took samples and learned that the benzene pyrene exceeded the standard, it immediately rejected it. This batch of oil products was in the factory of Zhonglian Oils and Fats in Taichung City from beginning to end. The reporting obligation was Zhonglian and had nothing to do with Taiwan Sugar."

title_en: Ministry of Economic Affairs: Obligations for notification of excessive raw materials and non-esophagus laws should not be unlimited
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 2nd) In response to some political figures’ doubts, Taiwan Sugar or the Ministry of Economic Affairs knew in advance that China Union Oil and Fats’ benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard, but did not notify the competent authorities. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated today that raw materials that exceed the standard are not the subject of notification under the Esophageal Law. Food safety issues require everyone to check, but the notification obligation should not be unlimited. If a restaurant goes to the wet market to buy vegetables, the purchasing personnel are required to report all vendors with rotten vegetable leaves to the competent authorities. "This is what the whistleblower wants to do, and it is not the obligation of the food industry."

summary_en: There’s going to be a double platform! title_en: It is an inevitable trend to regain weight after stopping the slimming injection. Doctor: You should do "two things" when losing weight to formulate a plan to stop taking the medicine.
summary_en: Overweight and obesity among Chinese people continue to increase, which may increase the risk of high blood pressure, cardiovascular disease and other diseases. More and more people in the country are using "slimming injections" to lose weight, but individual physiques are different, so special attention should be paid to the use of drugs. The Medical Society of Family Medicine held its 115th annual academic symposium today. Zhang Haoxiang, an attending physician at the Department of Family Medicine at National Taiwan University Hospital, said that "slimming injections" can reduce weight, waist circumference, cardiovascular disease and other risks, but there is an inevitable trend of regaining weight after stopping the medicine. Patients should fully discuss the timing of stopping the medicine with their doctors and pay attention to side effects at any time.

title_en: Tea oil was found to be inflamed with benzene and pyrene. Yuan Chun issued a statement again: not all raw materials are provided by our factory.
summary_en: The Food and Drug Administration announced that 8 batches and 4 brands of camellia oil were found to contain excessive levels of the first-level carcinogen benzene pyrene, and the products were all sourced from Chiayi County's "Yuanchun Oil Factory." Today (2), the Yuanchun Oil Factory issued another statement clarifying that except for products sold by international functional food companies, The "Taiwan Camellia Oil" sold is produced by Yuanchun, which purchases camellia seeds from farmers and is manufactured by other companies, including Yongfeng Yu Biotechnology, Weijia International, and Tingmao Agricultural Biotechnology. The raw materials for the bitter camellia seeds are provided by Weijia Company, and Yuanchun is only an OEM.

title: 抗憂鬱藥能停嗎？ 醫：「心情一好就停」恐提高復發風險
summary: 「醫師，我最近睡得比較好了，也沒那麼難過了，藥物是不是可以停了？」這是精神科門診最常見的問題之一。身心醫學診所主治醫師鄭佳益提醒，憂鬱症患者在症狀改善後，常誤以為已經痊癒，便自行停藥，但此時正是復發風險最高的階段，若過早停藥，不僅可能讓病情反覆，還可能因突然停藥出現身體不適。

title_en: Can antidepressants be stopped? Doctor: "Stop as soon as you feel good" may increase the risk of recurrence
summary_en: "Doctor, I've been sleeping better recently and I'm not that sad anymore. Can I stop taking the medication?" This is one of the most common questions asked in psychiatric outpatient clinics. Zheng Jiayi, the attending physician at the Mind-Body Medicine Clinic, reminded that after symptoms improve, patients with depression often mistakenly think they have recovered and stop taking medication on their own. However, this is the stage with the highest risk of recurrence. If the medication is stopped prematurely, not only may the condition relapse, but physical discomfort may occur due to sudden withdrawal of medication.

title_en: Pass 3 stress tests before buying a house to ensure you have sufficient funds
summary_en: With the adjustment of housing market policies and changes in the loan environment, the challenges faced by home buyers are not only whether the house price can be negotiated, but also include home appraisal, loan-to-value ratio, and the family's repayment ability in the next 20 to 30 years. 21st Century Real Estate stated that some buyers did not discover that the approved loan was not as expected until after bidding or signing, and they had to temporarily increase their own reserves. It is recommended that before buying a house, you should conduct three financial stress tests: "loan ratio, interest rate changes, and income reduction" to confirm that you can not only afford it, but also hold it for a long time.

title_en: The Private Equity Association merged with the Venture Capital Association. Qiu Decheng: The innovative capital system has entered a new stage.
summary_en: The Private Equity Investment Business Association of the Republic of China recently held a membership meeting, at which the merger with the Venture Capital Investment Business Association of the Republic of China was unanimously approved. Chiu Decheng, chairman of the Private Equity Association, said that venture capital and private equity are originally different stages in a complete long-term capital system. Venture capital mainly supports new start-up companies from technology research and development and product verification to growth, while private equity assists companies in expanding their scale, promoting mergers and acquisitions, industrial integration and international layout. The merger of the two associations is not only an organizational integration, but also means that Taiwan's innovation capital system will enter a new stage of development.

title_en: Taiwan stocks rose too fast and fell back. Looking forward to August. Legal person: chips control the market trend
summary_en: In July, the Taiwanese stock market went through a complete process of boom and bust. At the beginning of the month, the index was still around 47,000 points. The market's confidence in the AI ​​supply chain has hardly loosened. After entering the second half of the year, selling pressure emerged one after another. At the end of the month, there was a series of heavy losses. The weighted index barely stopped until it reached the half-year line. Yongfeng Investment Consulting believes that this wave of decline was not triggered by a sudden bad news, but by several pre-existing pressures overlapping at the same time. The most fundamental one is that this period has risen too fast and too much.

title_en: Taiwan stocks fluctuated by 8,011 points in July, setting a record, revealing 2 risks before opening
summary_en: Affected by concerns over the AI ​​bubble in U.S. stocks and linked to Korean stocks, Taiwan stocks have experienced a sharp correction recently, with the weighted index once plunging by more than 18%. Taiwan stocks staged an epic rebound on Friday, rising 3,186 points at the end, the largest single-day gain in history. TSMC rarely reached its daily limit to assist, and the index closed at 43,119 points. Legal person analysis shows that the recent financing balance has dropped sharply by more than 21%, and the chips have been effectively deleveraged, which has reduced the holding selling pressure and is conducive to stopping the decline and rebounding. Technically, although the market has regained its short-term moving average, the downward curve of the monthly line has created pressure, and it is expected that the short-term will face a volatile consolidation. In terms of investment strategy, it is recommended that investors control their operating positions and prioritize semiconductor and AI supply chain stocks with solid fundamentals. title_en: Lin Baohua’s point of view》Petit bourgeoisie investment is for living and working in peace and contentment. Do not sell houses and speculate in stocks.
summary_en: [Newtalk News] As ordinary petty bourgeoisie, we participate in stock investment in order to have a small and reliable income in addition to salary, so that we can live and work in peace and contentment. For example, I came from socialist China to capitalist Hong Kong in 1976, and I didn’t know how to operate stocks at all. The first goal at that time was to make money to buy a house, but looking at my salary, I couldn’t buy a house just by accumulating salary, because house prices rose faster than my salary. So I wanted to use my savings to buy construction stocks. If housing prices rise, construction stocks will also rise. So I started by buying a few bricks in construction stocks, then flooring, and so on. When I had enough money to pay the down payment, I started immediately because China and Britain had just signed the joint declaration at that time, property prices began to rise, and construction stock prices rose first. That was December 1986. On a weekend in mid-October 1987, the stock market became unstable due to the large number of computer-automated stop-loss and program sell orders. On Monday the 19th, the Dow Jones Index fell 22%. In order to avoid falling, Hong Kong closed the market for four days from the 19th to the 22nd. However, after the resumption of trading, not only did the decline not stop, but a total of 4 days of sell orders were sold on the same day. The Hong Kong Hang Seng Index fell by 1/3 that day. At that time, I had two accounts with different securities firms. One bank cut off my position, and the other bank I sold some and borrowed money to make up the money immediately. This was the only time in my life that I ever borrowed money from a friend. I am usually very cautious in managing my finances and must leave some room for improvement. I didn't sell out all the stocks at that time because I believed that there would be a rebound after such a decline, leaving some as a "seed". After this blow, I can no longer be surprised. title_en: A high-income man spent 25 million to become a charterer. The 30-year guarantee turned into a half-year delay.

title_en: Some people are JOMO when Korean stocks plummet, while others are sad when they soar. SK Choi Tae-won made 1 billion won in one night by buying at low prices.
summary_en: The South Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) experienced a roller coaster ride last week. When it plummeted for three days, stock investors cried out, but some also embraced the JOMO (Joy of Missing Out) mentality. title_en: Mude’s cash dividend for the first half of the year was RMB 1 per share
summary_en: AOI major manufacturer Mude (3563) announced its financial report. The net profit attributable to the parent company in the first half of the year was 626 million yuan, the net profit per share was 9.8 yuan, and the gross profit margin reached 60%. The overall profit performance was solid. The board of directors also decided to allocate a cash dividend of 1 yuan per share in the first half of this year, demonstrating stable profitability. Mude said that operations continued to grow in the first half of the year, benefiting from stable demand for high-end PCB applications, automatic optical inspection (AOI) equipment shipments maintaining a good level, and the gradual increase in the proportion of high-end products, driving overall revenue and profit performance. Affected by the high prices of key components such as IPC, CCD and memory in the supply chain market, Mude's gross profit margin has been slightly adjusted compared with the same period last year, and the selling prices of some products have been adjusted since June to reasonably reflect supply chain costs. Mu De pointed out that product technology and quality have been recognized by customers, and customers also accept the price adjustment plan. title_en: Biotechnology and medical treatment enter the capital market, and counter-buying centers act as promoters
summary_en: In order to help drive the innovation momentum of my country's biotech and medical industry and connect with the development of the capital market, the Overseas Purchase Center was invited to attend the "2026 China-Taiwan Biomedical Innovation and Deepening Platform Industry Acceleration Forum" and gave a special sharing on "How to help new biomedical innovations connect with the capital market." Lin Wanrong, the chief secretary of the OTC Buying Center, said that the biotech and medical industry is not only an important development industry for the government, but also one of the industries that the OTC Buying Center actively assists in entering the capital market. Biotech and medical stocks have also been among the top three industries in terms of number of companies listed on OTC IPOs for three consecutive years. The number of listed companies and emerging companies has reached 191 as of the end of June this year. It shows that the OTC Buying Center has been an important promoter of Taiwan's biotech and medical industry entering the capital market. title_en: The economic crisis behind the boom: AI craze boosts Taiwan's GDP, Trump's tariffs and "K-shaped economy" may become double bombs
summary_en: [Newtalk News] In recent years, the global artificial intelligence boom has boosted chip demand, driving Taiwan's economic growth to a rapid pace. According to statistics, Taiwan's GDP growth rate will reach 8.63% in 2025, soaring sharply to 13.69% in the first quarter of 2026, and remaining at a high level of 12.92% in the second quarter. Dexter Tiff Roberts, a senior fellow at the Atlantic Council think tank in Washington, said that because about 90% of the high-end chips required for the world's most advanced AI models are produced in Taiwan, this rapid growth trend is expected to continue with the support of strong demand in the United States and around the world. However, this wave of prosperity, led by the technology industry, has also sharply heated up the trade imbalance between Taiwan and the United States. According to Al Jazeera, U.S. imports from Taiwan totaled US$201 billion last year, almost double the US$116 billion in 2024. In May this year, Taiwan surpassed China and became the third largest source of imports to the United States. According to reports, the current trade surplus with the United States is approaching 200 billion US dollars, which may trigger U.S. President Donald Trump’s concern about tariffs on the trade deficit. In this regard, Reza Hasmath, an expert at the University of Alberta in Canada, bluntly said that this is an unbalanced relationship. However, senior analyst Zhou Daiyun pointed out that this surge is mainly due to the covering of short orders by foreign investors and a restorative rebound after a deep decline. title: 中聯問題油續燒…遭質疑事先知情未通報？台糖公司回應了

title_en: China United's oil problem continues to burn... Questioned about prior knowledge and failure to report? Taiwan Sugar Corporation responded
summary_en: In response to external doubts that Taiwan Sugar was involved in the incident of excessive oil and fat from China Federation of Industry and Information Technology, Taiwan Sugar stated on the 2nd that 32 pieces of Taiwan Sugar's raw materials or soybean salad oil products have been inspected since 2026, and all of them meet the inspection standards, and benzene pyrene (Bap) is lower than the standard 2ppb. Taiwan Sugar's oil products have absolutely no problems. In addition, when Taiwan Sugar Company purchased "raw materials" (non-edible fats and oils), it was found that they failed to pass the inspection, and the raw materials were not brought back or made into products. They are not the reporting obligors required by Article 7, Item 5 of the Food Safety and Hygiene Management Act, which is different from the situation of Nanqiao and other manufacturers.

title: 點亮半導體園區！台電高雄楠梓「雄積三、四線」完工送電 供電量翻倍
summary: 因應南部科學園區高雄第三園區（楠梓園區）半導體產業發展的電力需求，並強化高雄地區整體供電穩定性，台電自 2025 年推動興建「高雄～雄積三、四（高雄～高煉）輸電線路工程」，1日正式竣工送電。台電指出，楠梓園區目前用電需求量約 400MW（百萬瓦），工程完工後供電能力可提升至逾 1000MW，大幅強化園區供電品質。

title_en: Light up the semiconductor park! Taipower's "Xiongji Line 3 and 4" in Nanzi, Kaohsiung is completed and the power supply has doubled
summary_en: In response to the power demand for the development of the semiconductor industry in the Kaohsiung Third Park (Nanzi Park) of the Southern Science Park, and to strengthen the overall power supply stability in the Kaohsiung area, Taipower has promoted the construction of the "Kaohsiung ~ Hsiung Ji 3 and 4 (Kaohsiung ~ Gaolian) Transmission Line Project" in 2025, and the power transmission was officially completed on the 1st. Taipower pointed out that Nanzi Park’s current power demand is about 400MW (millions of watts). After the completion of the project, the power supply capacity can be increased to more than 1,000MW, which will greatly enhance the power supply quality of the park.

title_en: Opportunities for rebound emerge as optical communications plummets. This 800G gear has seen heavy volume, and investment stocks have increased on dips. "Revenue is at a high point, and stock prices are at a low level."
summary_en: As the conflict between the United States and Iran intensified again, and Trump continued to bomb Iran last week, oil prices, which had fallen, rebounded sharply, once exceeding $100. Rising oil prices have stimulated market concerns about inflation and increased the likelihood that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates, putting pressure on technology stocks. Therefore, the market entered a technical correction and consolidated near the quarter line. The stock prices of passive components and power components that were strong in the past have also almost halved. Even if Google issued a financial report that exceeded expectations, it was still picked on by the market, using increased capital expenditures and negative cash flow to continue to drive down the stock price. In fact, the fundamentals of AI have not weakened, but the market sentiment is very poor. Everyone is viewing all the good news with negative emotions, putting more pressure on the stock market.

title_en: Ministry of Economic Affairs: Obligations for notification of excessive raw materials and non-esophagus laws should not be unlimited
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 2nd) In response to some political figures’ doubts, Taiwan Sugar or the Ministry of Economic Affairs knew in advance that China Union Oil and Fats’ benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard, but did not notify the competent authorities. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated today that raw materials that exceed the standard are not the subject of notification under the Esophageal Law. Food safety issues require everyone to check, but the notification obligation should not be unlimited. If a restaurant goes to the wet market to buy vegetables, the purchasing personnel are required to report all vendors with rotten vegetable leaves to the competent authorities. "This is what the whistleblower wants to do, and it is not the obligation of the food industry."

title_en: Cover story/Gear king takes over Gus to lay out drone batteries Exclusive interview with Shen Guorong: Fighting for transformation with the expansion of production in Taiwan and the United States
summary_en: Shen Guorong, the president of Heda Group, who is known as the "King of Gears" in China, retired his daughter to the second line last year. Recently, he quickly bought the Xingai battery factory Gus Technology and entered the drone market in a big way. Shen Guorong revealed in an exclusive interview with this magazine a few days ago that Heda is preparing to expand production capacity in New York State in the United States to compete for drone business opportunities in Taiwan and the United States. "After the Ukraine-Russia war, the explosive growth of drones was triggered. Gus's lithium titanate batteries have the advantage of being lightweight and can extend the flight time of drones. They have been shipped to Vietnam's Switchblade drones. The group will use Gus to open the way and gradually enter the drone supply chain in Taiwan and the United States."

title_en: Rhine river water level creates low impact on transportation, Germany’s Q3 economic estimate is affected
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lin Shangying, special report from Berlin on the 1st) Germany continues to have little rain and high temperatures. The Cologne Observatory on the Rhine River measured a water level of 68 centimeters today, a record low. As the Rhine River carries a large amount of industrial raw materials and energy transportation in Germany, experts warn that low water levels have pushed up logistics costs. If the situation continues until the end of summer, it may reduce Germany's gross domestic product (GDP) in the third quarter by 0.1 to 0.2 percentage points.

title_en: Taiwan’s old restaurant/Famous shrimp and heirloom dish Kaohsiung Wufu Flat Food
summary_en:
Kaohsiung Wufu Bianshi originated in Kaohsiung. After moving to the north, it started from a small store in Kenan converted from a garage next to Yipin Building in Taipei East District. In the 1990s, it could be said to be a legend in the East District. The small shop, which is less than 20 square meters, has regular customers including former Vice President Xie Dongmin, Chairman of the People's First Party James Soong, Cathay Group Chairman Cai Chennan and other political and business celebrities. It is also the favorite of Hong Kong stars. At its peak, cash revenue was 100,000 yuan a day, and the highest record was that it hired 12 employees to provide food.

Few people know that Lin Jintai, the second generation who made the shop famous, was involved in a gang when he was young. When he was 27 years old, his parents took away the old shop that had been run in Kaohsiung for more than 20 years and accompanied him north to start over, making a name for himself by eating shrimp flat food. Nowadays, the store has been handed over to the third generation and is open in Dazhi and Neihu. What remains is not only the old-fashioned taste of attentiveness, but also the principles of life and business that the family has maintained for a long time.

The required bandwidth performance will be ten times that of horizontal expansion (Scale-out), injecting a boost into the optical communications market.

summary_en: Michael Hurlston, CEO of Lumentum, a major American optical communications company, warned at the RAISE Artificial Intelligence (AI) Summit in Paris that the bottleneck for the sustainable growth of AI infrastructure in the future lies in indium phosphide (InP). The shortage is expected to be worse than the current memory industry. The reason is that almost all components in the future AI infrastructure will use InP process lasers, and future market demand will increase several times.
