summary_en: Taiwan stocks will usher in a new wave of cash dividend frenzy in August. Although the Taiwanese stock market has been volatile in the short term, after the annual shareholders' meetings of listed companies were held at the end of June, many companies began to ex-dividend one after another and scheduled to start distributing cash dividends in August. title_en: The production location for export orders has shifted significantly. The proportion in Taiwan rose to 52.9% last year. The inland port fell below 30% for the first time.
summary_en: A major shift in global political and economic sectors. Statistics from the Ministry of Economic Affairs pointed out that thanks to rising demand for AI and cloud computing, IC manufacturing and server orders, which are mainly domestically produced, have grown significantly, pushing up the domestic production ratio of China's export orders to 52.9% in 2025; the production ratio in mainland China and Hong Kong dropped to 26.2%, falling below 30% for the first time. Both have written down the new situation in the past 16 years since statistics were collected.

title_en: Exports in July are estimated to be hot at 33 points in a row, with a value of approximately US$76 billion to US$78.8 billion, and an annual growth rate of 39%.
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance will announce export statistics for July 2026 on the 7th. The Ministry of Finance stated that the global economic and trade prospects are still affected by uncertain factors such as geopolitical conflicts and adjustments to U.S. tariff policies. However, as AI applications continue to expand, driving demand for computing power and related supply chains to rise, exports in July are expected to fall between US$76 billion and US$78.8 billion, an annual increase of about 34% to 39%. 33 consecutive months of positive growth are already a sure bet.

title_en: Taiwan Sugar: Refuse to accept Zoomlion’s crude oil that exceeds the standard in May, non-Food Safety Law notification person
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 2nd) The outside world has questioned Taiwan Sugar’s prior knowledge that Zoomlion Oil and Fat’s benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard. Taiwan Sugar stated today that when the company purchased soybean crude oil raw materials, it was found to be unqualified when submitted for inspection. Therefore, it refused to accept the raw materials, did not bring the raw materials back, and did not make products. According to the law, it is not a reporting obligor under the Food Safety and Hygiene Management Act. The situation is different from that of Nanqiao and other manufacturers. Taiwan Sugar has inspected 32 raw materials and soybean salad oil products this year, and the results are all in compliance with the standards. Taiwan Sugar's oil products are safe.

title: Fed新主席華許斷開前瞻指引  CPI、油價成美元美債新指南針
summary: 美國聯準會（Fed）在7月29日決議維持聯邦資金利率目標區間在3.5%至3.75%，但新任主席華許（Kevin Warsh）在會後的一番話，比利率決策更受矚目，不僅明確拒絕提供前瞻指引，並拋出「跟著球跑、而非跟著裁判跑」的說法，等同宣告Fed將不再替市場定調。台新金控首席外匯策略師陳有忠觀察，過去市場習慣等Fed給答案，如今華許把解讀權交還市場，投資人得自己緊盯CPI、油價與殖利率曲線，美元短線恐維持在100至102區間整理，10年期美債殖利率則將續探高點。

summary_en: The new solar photovoltaic system for building rooftops is officially launched today (1st). However, the Executive Yuan adjusted the policy on the eve of implementation and promoted the change in phases. The first wave will not include residential and shop buildings for the time being. title_en: Can the Dharma-repairing Star Chain be implemented? Are there still these issues that need to be resolved?
summary_en: In order to keep in line with the international low-orbit satellite trend, Taiwan has relaxed regulations and opened the door for SpaceX's Starlink to come to Taiwan to provide low-orbit satellite services. At the same time, it has given the National Communications Commission (NCC), the competent authority, great room for "accurate refutation." The industry supports international satellite companies coming to Taiwan, but how to balance issues such as national security, network security, communication resilience, supervision, and industrial development has become the biggest concern in the market.

title_en: Wei Zhejia: Recovery of mature manufacturing processes "Not at all" AI brings a lot of orders related to UMC
summary_en: On July 16, Wei Zhejia, chairman of TSMC (2330), said in France that he would be fully tight on mature processes. He bluntly said: "Not at all (not entirely)." He emphasized that the areas with real strong demand are AI-related power management ICs (PMICs) and sensors. General consumer electronics and other applications are not so good. This once caused the market to have doubts about the future of mature processes, especially industry representative manufacturers such as United Microelectronics (2303). However, judging from the latest outlook released by UMC, the company is catching up with the mature process boom brought by this wave of AI, and orders are booming.

title: 台灣老店／蝦拚揚名傳家味　高雄五福扁食

title_en: Taiwan’s old restaurant/Famous shrimp and heirloom dish Kaohsiung Wufu Flat Food
summary_en: Kaohsiung Wufu Bianshi started in Kaohsiung. After moving to the north, it started from a small store in Kenan converted from a garage next to Yipin Building in Taipei East District. In the 1990s, it could be said to be a legend in East District. The small shop, which is less than 20 square meters, has regular customers including former Vice President Xie Dongmin, Chairman of the People's First Party James Soong, Cathay Group Chairman Cai Chennan and other political and business celebrities. It is also the favorite of Hong Kong stars. At its peak, cash revenue was 100,000 yuan a day, and the highest record was that it hired 12 employees to provide food. Few people know that Lin Jintai, the second generation who made the shop famous, was involved in a gang when he was young. When he was 27 years old, his parents took down the old shop in Kaohsiung that had been run for more than 20 years and accompanied him north to start over, making a name for himself by eating shrimp flatbread. Nowadays, the store has been handed over to the third generation and is open in Dazhi and Neihu. What remains is not only the old-fashioned taste of attentiveness, but also the principles of life and business that the family has maintained for a long time.

Domestic banks believe that the bullish pattern of gold has not changed. In addition to being supported by geopolitical risks, central banks continue to increase their holdings of gold and diversify their US dollar asset allocation, which is also an important support for gold prices in the medium and long term. title: 大豆油、玉米油耐高溫？醫揭雙鍵愈多愈容易氧化
summary:
從鯨魚油到棉籽油的歷史演變，再到現代多樣化的植物油，曾嶔元回顧了油脂在工業與餐桌上的轉型。過去，飽和脂肪曾被妖魔化，反式脂肪則在食品工業的推波助瀾下悄然進入我們的飲食，帶來巨大的健康風險；然而隨著科學進步，我們現在明白，並非所有飽和脂肪都是「壞」的，例如乳製品中的奇數鏈飽和脂肪酸，甚至可能具有抗發炎益處。

在不飽和脂肪方面，普遍存在於種子油中的Omega-6雖然是必需的，卻很容易攝取過量，並可能與體內發炎反應增加有關；來自深海魚類的Omega-3（DHA和EPA）則以卓越的抗發炎與降低三酸甘油酯效果聞名，對大腦與心血管健康至關重要。曾嶔元提醒，膳食脂肪是生命不可或缺的一部分，唯有了解其背後的科學與歷史，才能擺脫過往的迷思，以更全面的視角，為自己與家人做出更好的「油」選擇，讓每一次烹飪都成為健康的實踐。

title_en: Are soybean oil and corn oil resistant to high temperatures? Doctors reveal that the more double bonds there are, the more likely they are to be oxidized
summary_en:
From the historical evolution of whale oil to cottonseed oil, to modern diversified vegetable oils, Zeng Jiyuan reviewed the transformation of oils and fats in industry and on the table. In the past, saturated fats were demonized, and trans fats, fueled by the food industry, crept into our diets, posing huge health risks. However, as science advances, we now understand that not all saturated fats are “bad,” and odd-chain saturated fats, such as those found in dairy products, may even have anti-inflammatory benefits.

In terms of unsaturated fats, Omega-6, which is commonly found in seed oils, although necessary, is easy to consume in excess and may be related to increased inflammation in the body; Omega-3 (DHA and EPA) from deep-sea fish are known for their excellent anti-inflammatory and triglyceride-lowering effects, which are crucial for brain and cardiovascular health. Zeng Jinyuan reminded that dietary fat is an indispensable part of life. Only by understanding the science and history behind it can we get rid of past myths and make better "oil" choices for ourselves and our families from a more comprehensive perspective, making every cooking session a healthy practice.

title: 致癌油案收押第4人！法院：中聯廠長知苯駢芘超標仍消極不通報

title_en: The fourth person detained in the carcinogenic oil case! Court: The director of Zhonglian knew that benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard but still remained passive and did not report it
summary_en: The Chung Lian carcinogenic oil scandal continues to spread. The Taichung District Prosecutor's Office arrested Chung Lian factory director Chen Mingrong for violating the food safety law. After the Taichung District Court posted a bail of NT$1 million, the prosecutor successfully protested. The Intermediate People's Court spoke out after reopening the detention court today. Chen Mingrong "knew that benzene and pyrene exceeded the legal limit and the food safety hazard increased, but he still took a passive approach and refused to report it." The defense continued to adjust responses as the evidence emerged, and now the ruling was changed that he should be detained without permission. He is the fourth defendant in this case to be detained.

title: 桃機接機引科技執法今上路 學者：硬體不足卻開罰 恐引民怨

title_en: Peach machine pick-up and use of technology to enforce laws are now on the road. Scholars: The hardware is insufficient but fines are issued, which may lead to public resentment.
summary_en: Starting today, Taoji will introduce technological law enforcement to combat chaos at airport pick-ups. Vehicles parked for more than 3 minutes will be fined 600 to 1,200 yuan. However, scholars have criticized that the airport pick-up supporting measures for Peach Blossom Airport are quite backward. If the hardware is not done well, it will be necessary to use technological law enforcement to improve the problem. I am afraid it will only cause public resentment.

summary_en: The Nuclear Energy Safety Commission held a "local briefing on the renewal of the operating license of the third nuclear power plant" in Hengchun today to respond to issues such as the seismic safety of the third nuclear power plant, nuclear waste disposal, local feedback funds, etc. Local citizen groups criticized the briefing, which was only announced two weeks ago.

title_en: During the window period between the Supervisory Committee and NCC, Zhuo Rongtai hopes to normalize the exercise of consent rights.
summary_en: Executive President Toh Wing-tai and Minister of Health and Welfare Shih Chung-liang attended the "Award Ceremony for Outstanding Personnel and Groups in Strengthening the Social Safety Net" in the afternoon. Interviews before the meeting stated that the terms of the Supervisory Committee and NCC members expired yesterday, and the two agencies will have a vacancy period without members serving from today. Executive President Tou Wing-tai said that personnel cases have been repeatedly rejected for "unreasonable reasons" before, and he hopes that the exercise of the right to consent will be normalized.

title_en: The bill for comprehensive health insurance subsidies for children aged 0 to 6 years old has been prioritized but has not been scheduled for review. Blue committee members are calling for it to be accelerated.
summary_en: In response to the juvenile national security crisis, the Kuomintang will promote the "Draft Amendment to Article 27 of the Child and Adolescent Welfare and Rights Protection Act", which advocates that the monthly health insurance premiums of approximately 826 yuan for children under 6 years old will be fully subsidized by the government, which will substantially reduce the burden on families with 1.05 million children. However, the case is still pending review by the Legislative Yuan Health and Environment Committee. Even KMT legislator Liao Weixiang has called for an expeditious review; the Kuomintang is open to the case, but needs to further evaluate budget allocation and fairness.

title: 汐止中正市場3億改建今上梁 侯友宜：拚年底完工啟用變現代化市場

title_en: Xizhi Zhongzheng Market has been renovated with RMB 300 million and is now in Liang. Hou Youyi: It will be completed by the end of the year and will be opened to modernize the market.
summary_en: The Zhongzheng Public Retail Market in Xizhi, New Taipei, which has a history of more than 50 years, will be renovated at a cost of 300 million yuan. During the dedication ceremony today, Mayor Hou Youyi prayed that the project would go smoothly and that it would be completed and opened by the end of this year. Hou Youyi said that the market reconstruction is not just about hardware renovation, but also about continuing the human touch of the traditional market, so that the new market has both modern functions and local characteristics, and it also needs to become an important base for residents' daily life.

title_en: The broken lever triggered the "panic limit"! Will Taiwan stocks rise or fall on Monday? Xie Jinhe: Look at these two stocks in the August stock market
summary_en: Global capital markets experienced turbulence in July, and the leverage adjustment brought about by the South Korean stock market caused the South Korean stock market to plunge by more than 34% in July, which also dragged down Taiwan stocks. In this regard, Xie Jinhe, chairman of Caixin Media, pointed out that the market is always born out of despair. The stock market rose sharply on July 31. title_en: Chiayi oil factory shut down due to food safety crisis involving Kucha oil. Chiayi inspection team quickly investigates the case to trace the source of the raw materials
summary_en: The domestic camellia oil food safety crisis continues to expand. A total of 8 cases of camellia oil have been found to contain the carcinogen "benzopyrene" exceeding the legal limit, and the products have been distributed to many manufacturers. The Chiayi County Yuanchun Oil Refining Factory has been ordered to suspend operations by the Chiayi County Health Bureau because it was found to be an OEM manufacturer of related problematic products. The Chiayi District Prosecutor's Office also quickly divided the case into investigations, commanding the Investigation Bureau and the police to conduct a comprehensive investigation. It also cooperated with the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare to clarify the source and flow of the tea seed raw materials and investigate whether any illegal activities were involved.

title_en: Zhonglian concealed carcinogenic oil...the news leaked and it was "forced" to be reported. The judge revealed: Taiwan Sugar had reported it in May
summary_en: The cancer-causing oil scandal spread, and the NT$1 million bail of the director of China United Company, Chen Mingrong, was revoked. The Taichung District Court reopened the detention court today. The judge revealed that Chen reported to Taiwan Sugar Company that the benzene and pyrene exceeded the legal limit in May. Later, Nanqiao also informed Chen that he knew that the food safety crisis was expanding but passively did not report it. It was not until the news leaked and the whistleblower took action that he "had to" report it. This is completely inconsistent with the Food and Drug Administration's initial statement that China United "reported proactively".

title: 國際機能苦茶油95度冷壓苯駢芘仍超標 江守山喊「不解」籲查原料產地

title_en: International Functional Tea Oil Cold-pressed Benzene Pyrene at 95 Degrees Still Exceeds the Standard. Jiang Shoushan Calls "Puzzled" and Calls for Investigation of the Origin of the Raw Materials
summary_en: Incidents of camellia oil exceeding the standard of benzene and pyrene occurred one after another. Among them, the tea oil produced by Weijia and International Function Company, which were assisted by Yuanchun Oil Refining Factory, also exceeded the standard. Among them, International Function independently reported to the New Taipei City Health Bureau. Jiang Shoushan, the founder of International Function and a nephrologist, said that the independent test in April did not detect it. The test in mid-July this year and the report was obtained on the 31st found that it exceeded the standard by 2.6 ppb. However, tea seeds are provided locally in Yunlin to Yuanchun OEM, and are manufactured by cold pressing at 95 degrees. I don’t know how benzene pyrene is produced.

title: 苦茶油風波延燒 源春製油聲明：去年12月至今年7月產品可退貨
summary: 針對苦茶油檢出苯駢芘含量超標事件，嘉義縣源春製油廠今天發聲明表示，近日威加國際股份有限公司委託代工永豐餘苦茶油，及國際機能食品股份有限公司委託生產之苦茶油產品，苯駢芘經檢驗含量超過法規標準，目前由主管機關介入調查，汙染原因及來源由衛生局持續釐清。

title_en: The controversy over camellia oil spreads. Yuanchun Oil Manufacturing declares: Products from December last year to July this year can be returned
summary_en: In response to the incident of tea oil found to contain excessive amounts of benzene and pyrene, Yuanchun Oil Factory in Chiayi County issued a statement today stating that the tea oil products produced by Weijia International Co., Ltd. and Yongfeng Yu Tea Oil, and International Functional Foods Co., Ltd., have been commissioned to produce tea oil products. The content of benzene and pyrene has been found to exceed regulatory standards. title_en: Camellia oil, benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard. The Ministry of Health and Welfare pointed the finger at mainland raw materials. Experts called for expanded inspections of Class 1 oils.
summary_en: A total of 8 domestic batches of camellia oil were found to exceed the standard for benzene and pyrene, and all of them came from a "Yuanchun Oil Refinery" in Chiayi. Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang said that it was "highly suspected" that the camellia seeds imported from mainland China produced carcinogens during the drying process, but at this stage, there is no consideration to expand the scope of the inspection to other oil products. Scholars have analyzed that in addition to benzene pyrene being easily produced at high temperatures, unrefined oil products may also contain benzene pyrene from raw materials. Experts suggest that the government should require businesses to provide raw material suppliers and target oil products made from "direct-fire roasted" raw materials to expand inspections.

title_en: The yen is hard to save...Three "holes" are causing capital outflows to continue
summary_en: The Japanese yen exchange rate has been depreciating since 2021, all the way from 100 yen to 160 yen per US dollar. Japan has intervened twice in the past, but the results have not been effective. Recently, it has even been reported that the United States and Japan have joined forces to prevent the depreciation of the yen. The market generally believes that the effect is limited. Experts believe that the Japanese government is currently facing three major structural problems: serious fiscal deficit, trade deficit, and capital outflow. If there is no improvement, the yen will remain weak in the long term.

title_en: The United States and Japan join forces to stop the depreciation and rebound. Is the Japanese yen’s sweet price gone? Expert: No need to rush
summary_en: There is still one month left in the summer vacation, and the peak season for Taiwanese people to travel to Japan is not over yet. The Japanese yen once devalued to 163 yen per US dollar a few days ago and then rebounded quickly, which also increased the cost of foreign currency exchange for Taiwanese people traveling to Japan. The Japanese yen cash exchanged by the Bank of Taiwan was shocked at 0.2086 yen per day, the worst price in five and a half months. Netizens regretted not exchanging it earlier. Experts said that the yen has rebounded in the short term due to official intervention, but the long-term trend is still weak. The yen still has a sweet price, so there is no need to rush to grab it.

title: 多吃植物油就一定健康嗎？Omega-6脂肪酸攝取過量，會發生什麼事？
summary:
2008年，加拿大科學家一項以小豬為對象的研究發現，當Omega-6脂肪酸占熱量攝取的1.2％時，有助於促進健康的大腦發展；然而，當攝取量增加到10.7％時，卻會損害神經發育。令人震驚的是，如今發展中國家的女性，其母乳中的平均亞油酸含量高達15～20％，甚至有研究指出某些比例更高達30％。這些高Omega-6脂肪酸比例的母乳，對於嬰兒的腦部發育影響不容小覷。

蜜蜂的生命模式也提供了另一個警示。雌性蜜蜂的兩種命運，壽命以年計的長壽蜂后，或壽命僅數週的短命工蜂，取決於牠們在蜂巢中第一週的食物。被餵食花粉的蜜蜂會成為短命工蜂，因為花粉含有高量Omega-6脂肪酸；而不被允許食用花粉、完全由工蜂口對口餵養的蜜蜂則會成為蜂后。分析顯示，長壽蜂后細胞膜中的Omega-6脂肪酸含量最低，而短命工蜂細胞中的Omega-6脂肪酸含量則顯著增加。

title_en: Is eating more vegetable oil necessarily healthy? What happens if you consume too much Omega-6 fatty acids?
summary_en:
In 2008, Canadian scientists conducted a study on piglets and found that when omega-6 fatty acids accounted for 1.2% of caloric intake, they helped promote healthy brain development; however, when the intake increased to 10.7%, it impaired neurological development. Shockingly, the average linoleic acid content in breast milk of women in developing countries is as high as 15 to 20%, and some studies even indicate that some proportions are as high as 30%. The impact of breast milk with a high proportion of Omega-6 fatty acids on the brain development of babies cannot be underestimated.

The life patterns of bees also provide another warning. The two fates of female bees, long-lived queens whose lives are measured in years, or short-lived workers who live only weeks, depend on what they eat during their first week in the hive. Bees that are fed pollen will become short-lived worker bees because pollen contains high amounts of Omega-6 fatty acids; bees that are not allowed to eat pollen and are fed exclusively mouth-to-mouth by worker bees will become queens. The analysis showed that the cell membranes of long-lived queen bees had the lowest levels of Omega-6 fatty acids, while the levels of Omega-6 fatty acids in the cells of short-lived worker bees were significantly increased.

summary: 日本近年盛行FIRE財務獨立、提前退休風潮，然而退休後的居住與生活安排成為重要課題。40歲男子直人存下7500萬日圓後裸辭移居鄉間，雖保留生活彈性，但鄉居挑戰仍存。另一對七旬夫妻則因鄉間生活缺乏醫療、購物機能，且年邁後依賴開車問題浮現，最終選擇回流都市。根據日本內閣府白皮書，高齡者換屋首重購物、醫療與交通便利性，顯示退休規劃需考量年齡增長後的生理變化，不僅是財務準備，更應評估環境是否適合長期養老，避免退休夢碎。

title_en: The retirement dream of the FIRE family is shattered! Although rural life is beautiful, it hides a fatal crisis. Experts remind the key conditions for retirement.
summary_en: In recent years, FIRE financial independence and early retirement have become popular in Japan. However, living and living arrangements after retirement have become important issues. A 40-year-old man saved 75 million yen and then resigned and moved to the countryside. Although he retains the flexibility of life, the challenges of living in the countryside still exist. Another couple in their 70s eventually chose to return to the city because of the lack of medical and shopping facilities in the countryside and their dependence on driving as they aged. According to the White Paper of the Japanese Cabinet Office, shopping, medical care and transportation convenience are the top priorities for elderly people when changing houses, which shows that retirement planning needs to take into account the physiological changes with age. It is not only financial preparation, but also an assessment of whether the environment is suitable for long-term retirement to avoid shattered retirement dreams.

title_en: Investment in semiconductor stocks has plummeted! Retired man accepted compensation of 600,000 yen and lamented that "this matter" is more important than profit
summary_en: Shoichi Fujimoto, a 68-year-old retired man in Japan, not only used his savings because his monthly pension was not enough to support his living expenses, but also invested 2 million yen in semiconductor stocks in order to turn around. Unexpectedly, the stock price plummeted, causing him to not only lose 600,000 yen on his account, but also fell into a state of physical and mental exhaustion due to excessively paying attention to the market trend. In the end, he chose to accept the loss to stop the bleeding, deeply understood the investment risks and psychological load, and decided to return to a stable index fund investment strategy. This case highlights that when retired people face inflationary pressure, if they lack investment knowledge and blindly pursue high-risk stocks, it may endanger the safety of their pensions. It reminds investors that they should prioritize a secure life and avoid excessive speculation.

title_en: The boss said, "It's hard to maintain a salary." He did this thing without telling his wife for 10 years.
summary_en: Facing a retirement crisis, a 67-year-old Japanese office worker, Mr. Yoshizawa, relied on rigorous investment strategies to successfully double his assets to 80 million yen. He adopted regular fixed-amount investment in index funds and insisted on not selling even in the face of the epidemic stock market crash, successfully catching up with global economic growth. After retirement, he boldly chose to claim the public annuity five years in advance. Through the strategy of "exchanging time for compound interest space", he made up for the shrinkage of the annuity caused by early withdrawal. However, experts warn that this type of high-return strategy is extremely risky and highly dependent on market trends after retirement, which may lead to double losses in the event of a stock market crash. Receiving an annuity early is irreversible. When planning for retirement, people must carefully evaluate their personal assets, health status and risk tolerance. They should not blindly copy a single case and seek professional advice to formulate the most robust financial allocation plan.

title_en: [Preview of August market trends] The Federal Reserve has not raised interest rates, but market interest rates have tightened first. Legal persons: Investment returns to corporate profits
summary_en: The Federal Reserve kept its policy interest rate unchanged this time, but three officials still advocated raising interest rates during the meeting, and the market once again discussed the direction of subsequent policy. "Juheng Buying Fund" said that bond yields and corporate financing costs have already taken the lead in rising, and financial conditions have actually tightened earlier than policy interest rates. In addition, in addition to energy price fluctuations, rents and wages have not accelerated simultaneously, which means that inflation has not yet spread to core service prices, and the overall inflation risk is still controllable. In the face of short-term policy noise, investment should still return to corporate profits and industry trends, and seize the long-term layout opportunities brought about by market corrections.

title: 政府與證交所為何加速改革零股交易？真正想解的是台股的什麼問題？
summary: 為了落實普惠金融並提升資本市場效率，臺灣證券交易所近期宣布盤中零股交易制度的改革，這也將迎來歷年來零股制度上最大幅度的優化革新。針對外界關注的交易時差與撮合速度問題，證交所董事長林修銘在立法院備詢時證實，盤中零股開盤時間將自現行的上午9時10分提前至9時（委託時間同步提前至8時30分），預計於2026年12月7日正式上路；而零股撮合間隔時間更規劃於2027年7月全面從現行的5秒大幅縮短至1秒。

title_en: Why are the government and stock exchanges accelerating the reform of odd lot trading? What problem does Taiwan stock market really want to solve?
summary_en: In order to implement inclusive finance and improve capital market efficiency, the Taiwan Stock Exchange recently announced the reform of the intraday odd-lot trading system, which will also usher in the largest optimization and innovation of the odd-lot system in recent years. In response to external concerns about the trading time difference and matching speed, Lin Xiuming, chairman of the stock exchange, confirmed during the Legislative Yuan's inquiry that the opening time of odd lots will be advanced from the current 9:10 am to 9:00 (the commission time will be simultaneously advanced to 8:30). It is expected to be officially launched on December 7, 2026; and the odd lot matching interval is planned to be significantly shortened from the current 5 seconds to 1 second in July 2027.

Cheng Zhenghua, former chief analyst of foreign-funded semiconductors and chief investment officer of Tengxu Company, said that the recent ups and downs in the intraday index are actually quite painful, but the four major reasons such as the Korean stock market, FOMC, CSP financial report and Situational Awareness liquidation can be regarded as all the bad news. The bad thing is: many people have been seriously injured in this wave, and it is not easy to directly turn V in the short term.

title_en: It’s so hard to be an investor! Foreign capital sells popular weight stocks this week. Is your holding also on the list?
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market closed at 43,119.75 points on the 31st, a surge of 3,186.45 points, the largest closing point in history. However, this week it fell 535.09 points, a weekly decrease of 1.23%. Foreign investors sold more than 82.454 billion yuan in a single week. Statistics on foreign investors buying and selling super stocks found that Macronix (2337) topped the list of stocks sold by foreign investors this week. Weight stocks such as Quanta (2382), TSMC (2330), and ASE Investment Holdings (3711) were also the targets of foreign investment. Taiwan stocks surged 1,677.11 points as soon as the market opened, opening at 41,610.41 points. The powerful TSMC led the charge, pushing the index higher. At midday, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. hit the daily limit of 2,425 yuan, rising 220 yuan. The highest intraday increase in history, the index also reached 43,214.36 points, an increase of 3,281.06 points, recovering 43,000 points, the largest historical increase in intraday trading. The market index closed at 43,119.75 points. The centralized market and the counter buying market totaled 1,752 rising stocks and 228 falling stocks. Among them, 221 stocks exceeded the upper limit and only 2 fell below the limit. title_en: Taiwan stocks’ weekly gainer is revealed! Luen One Optoelectronics soared by more than 30% to become the top, optical stocks became the biggest winners
summary_en: Although Taiwan stocks hit their largest single-day gain in history on the 31st, rising 3,186.45 points, they were still unable to reverse the weekly decline, falling 535.09 points or 1.23% for the whole week. Funds have obviously returned to small and medium-sized stocks, among which the optical group has performed the most brilliantly. Allianz Optoelectronics (3441) surged 30.64% in a single week to become the top gainer. Jialing (4976) and Advanced Optical (3362) simultaneously ranked among the top ten. AI vision, automotive lenses and robot themes became the focus of the market. title_en: Huang Chongren passes away. Gong Mingxin: Promoting the sale of the factory to Micron during his lifetime was an important contribution.
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zeng Yuting, Taipei, 1st) Economic Minister Gong Mingxin said today that the death of Huang Chongren, chairman of wafer foundry Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd., is a loss to Taiwan’s industry and the country. During Huang's lifetime, they had discussed the sale of the factory by Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. to Micron many times, believing it to be a decision that was "good for Power Semiconductor, good for Micron, and good for both Taiwan and the United States." It was also a major contribution to the global semiconductor industry.

title_en: <Hot Stock> Memory modules form a safe haven for funds. Transcendence rose 11% for the week
summary_en: Taiwan stocks were in a state of rage this week. After breaking through 40,000 points on Thursday, they soared by nearly 3,200 points on Friday, the largest gain in history. However, they still fell 535 points in a single week. Memory modules generally have outstanding profits in the first half of the year, coupled with low price-to-earnings ratios, becoming a safe haven when the market falls. Among them, Transcend (2451-TW) bucked the trend and rose sharply in a single week.

title_en: A fire broke out in a factory building on Industrial 3rd Road in Hsinchu. Xinquan clarified: It is not a company factory and has no impact so far.
summary_en: An explosion and fire broke out on Gongye 3rd Road, Hukou Township, Hsinchu County at about 11 a.m. today (1st). Flames and thick smoke continued to escape from the scene. The market was once rumored to be the factory of Xinquan (3264-TW), a major IC testing factory. The company clarified that this was a misinformation and that the company's factory buildings are currently not affected. It is understood that the factory where the fire broke out was the Huli Precision Industry Co., Ltd. next door.

summary_en: Financial Center/Yang Simin, Yan Kai Taipei reported that the world is accelerating the deployment of AI infrastructure, which has also driven a large amount of memory demand. title: 營養師親測連吃7天酪梨 身體「這一改變」超意外
summary: 「酪梨是超級食物」這句話，多數人都不陌生。它富含健康脂肪、膳食纖維與多種微量營養素，經常被營養師推薦作為日常飲食的一部分。但如果真的每天固定吃一份酪梨，身體會發生什麼實際變化？營養師Lauren Manaker親自進行了一項為期一週的飲食實驗，連續 7 天每天攝取一份酪梨，觀察對精力、消化與整體健康感受的影響。她分享，這次實測不只驗證了營養學理論，也讓她對這項食物的價值有了更深刻的體會。

title_en: A nutritionist personally tested eating avocados for 7 days and the "change" in the body was so surprising
summary_en: "Avocado is a superfood" is a saying familiar to most people. It is rich in healthy fats, dietary fiber and a variety of micronutrients, and is often recommended by nutritionists as part of a daily diet. But if you really eat a serving of avocado every day, what actual changes will happen to your body? Nutritionist Lauren Manaker personally conducted a week-long diet experiment, consuming one serving of avocado every day for seven consecutive days to observe the effects on energy, digestion, and overall health. She shared that this actual test not only verified the nutritional theory, but also gave her a deeper understanding of the value of this food.

summary_en: After hitting a record high of 48,218 points on June 23, the Taiwan stock market fell by nearly 8,000 points in just over a month, a loss of nearly 20%, and some small and medium-sized stocks have even halved. summary_en: On the 31st, the International Trade Bureau of the Ministry of Economic Affairs discovered that the "Article Recommendation Sharing" service provided by the Economic and Trade Information Network of the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Trade to recommend online articles to friends has been abused by unknown persons through automated programs, and falsely used the name of the Bureau to send emails with the subject matter of "eTag Parking Fee Unpaid Notification", "ETC Parking Record Service" and other parking payment-related emails. title_en: Taiwan stock market soared to its biggest point, the effect of four loans under one roof, five major financial events you must know this week
summary_en: After global stock markets fell wildly in July and then rebounded again, investors had a rough week. The market deleveraging and cleaning up the battlefield float continued. Fortunately, Taiwan stocks rose by 3,000 points on the last trading day of July, setting the highest point in history, filling half of the gap, and putting a big exclamation point on the crazy month of July. The central bank also named the "four loans under one roof" as a threat to financial stability. Once the market reverses, the chain impact cannot be ignored. The following are the five most important financial news worth reviewing this week: 1. Taiwan stocks were crazy in July Plunges and surges accounted for the biggest gains and losses. Taiwan stocks rebounded strongly on the 31st, benefiting from the cooling of the U.S. Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) deflator in June and Microsoft's better-than-expected financial report, which led to a rebound in semiconductor stocks, Japan and South Korea. The stock markets rose 4% and 17.9% respectively. Taiwanese stocks surged with momentum, soaring 3,186 points to close at 43,119 points, the largest gain in history. They recovered the 5-day and 10-day moving averages, and the trading volume shrank to 887.7 billion yuan. The Taiwanese stock market was like a stalled train in July. It set two records for the largest drop and the largest increase in history in one month. On 14 of the 22 trading days, the spread between the high and low of the market index exceeded 1,000 points, making it the craziest July market in history. The monthly line dropped 3,006 points, the third largest drop in history. Taiwan stocks created six major surprises on the 31st, including 1. The largest closing point increase of 3,186 points in the history of the centralized market and an intraday increase of 3,281 points; 2. The total market value of listed counters increased by 10.9 trillion yuan, the largest increase in history, rising to 150.3 trillion yuan; 3. TSMC (2330) closed the daily limit of 2,4 for the third time in history.

title_en: Will the United States and Japan join forces to intervene in the foreign exchange market? The yen rises above 158 again. This is what economists think
summary_en: The Japanese yen has fluctuated violently against the U.S. dollar in recent days. After widespread rumors in the market that Japanese officials intervened in the foreign exchange market on the 30th, the exchange rate once rose sharply from close to 164, breaking through the 158 level, and then fell back to around 160 the next day. However, on the 31st, foreign media once again photographed a to-do note written by U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent saying "Buy 5 billion to 10 billion yen." Coupled with market rumors that the U.S. Treasury Department notified major banks that they may take action, this triggered market speculation that the United States and Japan may coordinate intervention in the foreign exchange market, driving the yen to strengthen again, once rising to 157.29, and currently fluctuating between 157.5 and 157.6.

title_en: The death cross of Taiwan stocks is coming! Experts reveal the "critical 48 hours" and look at the four major stop signals at once
summary_en: The death cross of Taiwan stocks is coming! The Taipei stock market has just staged a historic counterattack. On the 31st, it soared by 3,186 points in a single day, setting a record. The powerful TSMC even exceeded the daily limit. Unexpectedly, the technical aspect faced a severe test of the "monthly line death cross". Faced with the Taiwan Index futures plunged more than 1,000 points in the night session, the market was panicking. Moore Securities Investment Consulting analyst Jiang Guozhong (Jiang Jiang) accurately pointed out that next Monday and Tuesday will be the "critical 48 hours" that determine life and death. If they can understand the rare "morning star turning point" and the stop signal, investors will have the opportunity to seize the opportunity of wealth redistribution amid the shock. (Reporter Tang Jiaxing)

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zeng Yuting, Taipei, 1st) Tea aroma is an important element in shaping the flavor characteristics of tea brands, but it is also the most difficult part to standardize. title: 飯、麵放涼再吃有差？醫揭抗性澱粉3大好處與正確吃法
summary:
對於熱愛白飯、麵條與馬鈴薯的人來說，「澱粉」兩個字常常伴隨罪惡感。但如果有一種澱粉，不僅不容易讓你發胖，還能餵養腸道益菌、提升胰島素敏感性，甚至可能降低大腸癌風險，你會不會重新愛上碳水化合物？「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，對於喜歡吃澱粉的人來說，一個聰明的解套方式，就是選擇抗性澱粉。

抗性澱粉的特別之處，在於它獨特的消化路徑。曾嶔元說明，一般澱粉會在小腸中被分解成糖類，但抗性澱粉能完整通過小腸，直到抵達大腸。在那裡，它不會被人體的消化酵素分解，而是成為結腸中數十億益生菌的「食物」。這個過程稱為發酵，也讓抗性澱粉成為一種天然的益生元。益生菌藉此大量繁殖，優化腸道菌群，進而提升消化與免疫功能。對於進行高強度訓練的人而言，健康的腸道更是恢復與表現的關鍵。

當腸道微生物分解抗性澱粉時，會產生一類稱為短鏈脂肪酸（縮寫為SCFAs）的代謝物，其中最重要的是丁酸鹽。這些SCFAs本身就具有調節新陳代謝與免疫力的潛力。更值得一提的是，抗性澱粉帶來的益處，並不需要像某些益生菌飲品那樣付出高昂的代價，卻能自然地支持腸道與整體健康。

title_en: Is it wrong to let the rice and noodles cool before eating? Doctors reveal the 3 major benefits of resistant starch and the correct way to eat it
summary_en:
For those who love rice, noodles and potatoes, the word "starch" is often associated with guilt. But if there was a starch that not only prevented you from gaining weight, but also fed good intestinal bacteria, improved insulin sensitivity, and might even reduce the risk of colorectal cancer, would you fall in love with carbohydrates again? "Medical Sherlock Holmes" Dr. Zeng Jinyuan points out in his new book "Precision Diet" that for people who like to eat starch, a smart way to solve the problem is to choose resistant starch.

What’s special about resistant starch is its unique digestion pathway. Zeng Jinyuan explained that starch is generally broken down into sugars in the small intestine, but resistant starch can pass through the small intestine completely until it reaches the large intestine. There, it is not broken down by the body's digestive enzymes, but becomes "food" for the billions of probiotic bacteria in the colon. This process, called fermentation, also makes resistant starch a natural prebiotic. Probiotics multiply in large quantities and optimize intestinal flora, thereby improving digestive and immune functions. For those who train intensively, a healthy gut is key to recovery and performance.

When gut microbes break down resistant starch, they produce a class of metabolites called short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), the most important of which is butyrate. These SCFAs themselves have the potential to regulate metabolism and immunity. What's more worth mentioning is that the benefits of resistant starch do not require the high cost of some probiotic drinks, but they can naturally support intestinal and overall health.

title: 加密資產平台 CatalX 破產 前執行長違反監管承諾遭罰
summary: 商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導加拿大加密資產交易平台 CatalX CTS Ltd.，因未經授權提款與客戶資產流失，已於 2024 年 1 月進入法院強制接管。該平台的前執行長，近期與加拿大亞伯達省的證券監管機構 Alberta Securities Commission（ASC）達成和解，承認違反預註冊承諾，並同意支付罰款且被禁止從事相關業務六年。 根據 ASC 的指控，CatalX CTS Ltd. 自 2019 年 2 月起至 2024 年 1 月間營運加密交易平台，並於 2023 年 3 月與證券監管機關簽署預註冊承諾（指加密貨幣平台在正式註冊前，向監管機關作出的法律承諾）。然而，ASC 發現該平台未妥善維護足以保護投資人資產的內部控制措施。公司紀錄顯示約有 1,400 萬美元的加密資產，但實際價值僅剩 15 萬美元。ASC 指出，此巨大差額主要源於未經授權的提款，以及將客戶的加密資產用於與客戶活動無關的用途。 CatalX CTS Ltd. 於 2023 年 11 月 24 日發現客戶資產流失，但延遲至同年 12 月 21 日才通報 ASC。該平台前執行長承認允許這些違規行為發生。

title_en: Cryptoasset platform CatalX goes bankrupt and former CEO is fined for violating regulatory commitments
summary_en: Business Media | Wu Chengyue/Taipei reported that CatalX CTS Ltd., a Canadian crypto-asset trading platform, entered compulsory receivership by the court in January 2024 due to unauthorized withdrawals and loss of customer assets. The former CEO of the platform recently reached a settlement with the Alberta Securities Commission (ASC), the securities regulator in the Canadian province of Alberta, admitting to violating pre-registration commitments and agreed to pay a fine and be banned from engaging in related business for six years. According to the ASC’s charges, CatalX CTS Ltd. operated a crypto trading platform from February 2019 to January 2024, and signed a pre-registration commitment with the securities regulatory authority in March 2023 (referring to the legal commitment made by the cryptocurrency platform to the regulatory authority before formal registration). However, the ASC found that the platform did not properly maintain internal controls adequate to protect investor assets. Company records show about $14 million in crypto assets, but the actual value is only $150,000. The ASC noted that this large discrepancy resulted primarily from unauthorized withdrawals and the use of customers’ crypto assets for purposes unrelated to the customer’s activities. CatalX CTS Ltd. discovered the loss of client assets on November 24, 2023, but delayed notifying the ASC until December 21 of the same year. The platform’s former CEO admitted allowing these breaches to occur.

title_en: Yageo soared to the daily limit of 502 yuan. Is there any way to save the top of the mountain? Death cross warning is coming, experts use "one trick" to reverse and double their profits
summary_en: Yageo, the leader in passive components, has recently been hunted by short sellers. Its stock price has plummeted by more than 60% from the high of 1,220 yuan in early July to as low as 456.5 yuan. Fortunately, there was a strong influx of buying orders on July 31, and the stock price went straight to the daily limit of 502 yuan, allowing investors who were stuck in high-end stocks to rekindle hopes of unwinding their arbitrage. Experts pointed out that Yageo is currently facing multiple moving average pressures technically, and it is difficult to have a vertical V-shaped reversal. Investors should adjust their strategies and switch to band operations. If three consecutive band operations go smoothly, the cumulative return rate can reach 120%, doubling profits.

title_en: Serving wealthy families for 19 years, a college admissions consultant reveals the key to entering prestigious schools: How do children spend "Ordinary Tuesdays"
summary_en: College counselors observe that getting into a prestigious school does not depend on a dazzling event or a perfect resume, but on how children spend their daily lives. Ordinary families can also start by cultivating curiosity, accumulating real work experience, exploring subjects early, practicing expressing life goals, and focusing on a few activities that they are truly passionate about, and gradually build maturity, responsibility and personal characteristics. Especially after the popularization of AI, it is easier to win the favor of admissions officers if you can tell real stories in your own language than to pile up gorgeous experiences.

title_en: A 50-year-old housewife "earned 82 million" by buying stocks, revealing why most people lose money
summary_en: A Japanese housewife and financial writer came into contact with the stock market in her 50s. Following a long-term holding strategy, she eventually accumulated 400 million yen (approximately NT$82.08 million) in assets. She pointed out in her books and interviews that she has seen many people invest without first understanding their own personalities and suitable methods, but instead blindly follow market news and impulsively sell stocks worth holding for a long time. She believes that sustainable investment methods should be gradually developed based on personality and advantages, rather than simply copying other people's practices.

title_en: Is lower cholesterol better? The 90-year-old man gave the opposite answer
summary_en: Text/Dr. Zeng Jiyuan If cholesterol can really cause artery blockage and then cause heart disease, then wouldn’t the liver, which produces most of the cholesterol, become the “number one murderer”? From an evolutionary perspective, if the liver produced cholesterol to cause heart disease, then humans would have become extinct over millions of years of evolution. So why has cholesterol become such a target in the media? Dr. Zeng Jiyuan, known as the "Medical Sherlock Holmes", points out in his new book "Precision Diet" that there is actually a tortuous history of science and media interfering with each other, and the cholesterol controversy can be traced back to scientific exploration in the early 20th century. The earliest suspicion came from rabbit experiments in 1907. By feeding rabbits a large amount of meat, eggs and milk, scientists found that they developed atherosclerosis, which is lipid deposition in the intima of arteries, leading to thickening of blood vessel walls and narrowing of the lumen, thereby affecting blood flow supply. Then in 1912, another group of scientists went further and discovered that simply feeding rabbits cholesterol also successfully reproduced atherosclerosis. This has led to the emergence of the "lipid hypothesis", which believes that cholesterol is the culprit of arteriosclerosis. However, rabbits are herbivores and are very sensitive to cholesterol uptake and cannot be directly extrapolated to humans. Zeng Jinyuan reminded that it is worth noting that these rabbit experiments did not produce similar results in dogs and rats. We now know this is because dogs and rats are highly efficient at converting cholesterol into bile acids for excretion. However, researchers at the time did not delve into the actual nature of these “failures.”

title_en: A gangster boy becomes an East District legend 1/The old Kaohsiung shop becomes a good boy for a gangster and goes north to rely on a bowl of flat food to become an East District legend
summary_en:
A bowl of flat food can change the life of a gangster. In the 1990s, Kaohsiung Wufu Bianshi opened in a converted garage of less than 20 square meters next to Yipin Building in Taipei East District. It once set a record of cash revenue of 100,000 yuan a day, and had 12 employees to pay for it non-stop. Regular customers include former Vice President Hsieh Tung-min, People's Party Chairman Soong, Cathay Pacific Group Chairman Tsai Chen-nam and other political and business celebrities. Hong Kong celebrities who come to Taiwan have even designated pilgrims.

But few people know that Lin Jintai, the second generation who turned his small shop into a legend in the East District, was involved in a gang when he was young. When he was 27 years old, his parents took down the old shop that had been run for more than 20 years in Kaohsiung and accompanied him north to start over. Only then did he change his life with a bowl of shrimp flatbread. Now Kaohsiung Wufu Bianshi has opened a new location and handed over the reins to the third generation, opening in Dazhi and Neihu. What remains is not only the old-fashioned taste of heart, but also the principles of life and business that the family has maintained for more than a decade.

title_en: A Gang Boy Becomes an East District Legend 2/Struggling to survive the first three years of starting a business. Cai Chennan’s advice made this restaurant popular for 20 years
summary_en: Having been in a gang, opened a casino, and participated in a karaoke fire, Lin Jintan said that he made money quickly in those years and lost it quickly, and he was tired of his time in the world. When he was 27 years old, his parents took away the old store that had been in business for 27 years in Kaohsiung and accompanied him to the north to start over. The three of them crowded into a small rented apartment and sold snacks in the East District during the day. After three years of hard work, they finally turned the humble shop into a famous store in the East District. This also includes a short story with guidance from an expert.

title_en: A gangster boy becomes a legend in the East District. Extra chapter/Wang Jinping is standing outside. The small box of a famous store is filled with political elders.
summary_en:
Lin Jintai, the second-generation owner of Wufu Bianshi in Kaohsiung, joined the Kaohsiung Yancheng Sandi Gang when he was young, and later joined the Qing Gang by chance. He speaks Taiwanese Mandarin. He stayed with Mr. Dai of the Youth Gang for three years and often ate at the same table with various generals. He said that everyone got along with each other very naturally. In that era, he never felt that others were inferior.

Later, he gave up Jianghu Road and went to Taipei to conquer the world. Along the way, he made the small restaurant famous. Many political and business celebrities were frequent visitors, especially the big figures of the Kuomintang. Former President Tsai Ing-wen was also a guest.

title: 非洲 SaaS 市場快速崛起 在地化解決方案成數位轉型關鍵

title_en: Prada 2026 Chinese Valentine’s Day visual interpretation of the pure essence of affection
summary_en: Prada officially released the 2026 Chinese Valentine's Day image advertisement, which is inspired by romantic connotations and deeply explores the true meaning of reunion, waiting and crossing the distance of time and space. The brand redefines "true connection" as the resonance of heart and consciousness, rather than just physical proximity. This time, actor Zhang Yifan and brand ambassador TransfOrm Project were specially invited to perform together. They created a poetic abstract experience that transcended language in the North Shore auditorium of the Chapel of Music built by architect Dong Gong and his team Vector Architects.

title_en: Preview of five major financial events on August 1
summary_en:
The Economic Daily has compiled five must-know financial events so that readers can quickly grasp the most important financial events every morning.

1. The strongest economy in half a century: Economic growth in the first half of the year was 13.72%
The General Accounting Office announced yesterday (31st) that the estimated economic growth rate for the second quarter reached 12.92%, setting a new high for the same period since 1988 and 39 years ago, and showing double-digit growth for three consecutive quarters...more

As the financial reports of Microsoft and Amazon cleared away the haze of chip stocks, the Northeast Asian stock market staged a "violent rebound" yesterday (31st). Japanese stocks soared nearly 2,500 points, and Korean stocks even soared 18%...more


3. The stocks of the four famous masters will reach 45K in August, and the expectation index has entered the stage of shock and bottoming.
After the turmoil in July, the Taiwan stock market is expected to enter a bottoming stage in August. The four major Taiwan stock market experts predict that the market index is expected to consolidate between 40,000 and 45,000 points...more


4. MediaTek targets AI ASIC and sets high standards. The first-generation product will be mass-produced in Q4.
Investment in AI infrastructure continues to heat up. MediaTek (2454) CEO Cai Lixing said at the press conference yesterday (31st) that the layout of AI ASIC is accelerating simultaneously, and the first generation AI accelerator ASIC is about to enter mass production...more


5. The four major cloud companies will invest 24 trillion this year, with Alphabet and Amazon leading the way.

title: 高額創投資金恐增新創詐欺風險 研究揭高壓環境黑幕
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜責任編輯／綜合外電報導一份來自英國倫敦帝國學院與法國里昂商學院的最新研究指出，新創公司一旦獲得高額創投資金（VC，一種投資於高成長潛力新創公司的資金模式），其發生詐欺行為的風險將顯著升高，遠高於未獲外部注資的同業。 這項研究分析了 2000 年至 2023 年間民事與刑事證券詐欺起訴案件，發現創投的「高速成長」文化與投資者期望，可能導致企業倫理底線遭到跨越。研究指出，當新創公司處於「過熱」市場且投資人監督不足時，更容易出現欺騙行為。特別是在快速且未受抑制的投資時期，獲得資金的新創公司詐欺傾向高出 19%。 研究揭示了導致創辦人偏離道德規範的心理與結構機制。一旦新創公司接受機構資金，便面臨嚴格的成長指標、使用者獲取目標和營收里程碑。這些目標往往需要透過「創意會計」或直接的欺騙手段才能達成。研究人員指出，創投模式催生了一種「特定的絕望感」，促使創辦人為了向投資者兌現高額回報承諾，傾向於誇大數字、扭曲合作關係或捏造客戶推薦證明。這種壓力下，有些投資者甚至明確建議創辦人「假裝成功直到真正成功」（fake it till you make it），這句話可能從勵志口號演變為

title: Bitget推美股期權盤前交易 加密用戶擁傳統金融新管道
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導全球領先的加密貨幣交易所 Bitget 旗下的 Bitget TradFi 平台，已於近日推出涵蓋 45 檔美股與 ETF 的盤前期權交易服務。這項新服務讓 Bitget 用戶能夠在美國股市開盤前，交易這些美股標的的期權（options trading），期權是一種金融衍生工具，賦予買方在特定時間以特定價格買賣標的資產的權利，但沒有義務。 根據 Bitget 的資訊，這次新增的盤前期權交易服務，支援包括 SPDR標準普爾500指數ETF（SPY）和 Invesco QQQ（QQQ）等熱門美股與 ETF。此舉不僅擴大了 Bitget TradFi 的服務範疇，更模糊了傳統金融與加密貨幣交易之間的界線。 Bitget TradFi 平台此前已提供現貨交易、永續合約（perps）、差價合約（CFDs）以及首次公開發行前（pre-IPO）的投資管道。此次將美股期權納入，意味著加密貨幣用戶現在有機會透過單一平台，接觸更多元化的傳統金融資產，為投資者帶來新的交易選擇。 【提醒您】 投資有賺有賠，本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議

title_en: Taiwan stocks soared by 3,186 points in a single day, a crazy month in July, with 14 trading days of over 1,000 points.
summary_en: Taiwan stocks rebounded in retaliation yesterday (31st), benefiting from the cooling of the U.S. Personal Consumption Expenditure (PCE) deflator in June and Microsoft's better-than-expected earnings report, which led to a rebound in semiconductor stocks. Japanese and Korean stock markets rose by 4% and 17.9% respectively. Taiwan stocks surged with momentum and ended up soaring 3,186 points to close at 43,119 points, the largest gain in history. They recovered the 5-day and 10-day moving averages, and trading volume shrank to 887.7 billion yuan.

title_en: Taiwan Mobile Network wins six championships
summary_en: With the popularization of 5G, the quality requirements of mobile networks have shifted from single-point speed measurement to full-time and all-scenario stability. Opensignal, an international mobile network analysis agency, announced the "Taiwan Mobile Network Experience Report" for the first half of 2026. Taiwan Mobile won six championships. summary_en: Creative (3443), a major IC design company, held a press conference yesterday (31st). title_en: Zhu Chengzhi: The Taiwan stock market is below 40,000 points, and TSMC’s sweet price is 2,180 yuan. AI stocks that have fallen deeply can be picked up.
summary_en: AI really rose too much in the first half of the year. Taiwan stocks soared continuously, rising by 7203 points in April, 5806 points in May, and 1393 points in June. After the monthly K-line was red for three consecutive times, the global stock market collapsed in July and the wind direction changed. On June 23, it hit a sky-high price of 48,218 points. On July 29, it fell below the "40,000 mark", with a minimum of 39,384 points, and a drop of more than 8,800 points. In this wave of Korean stocks, due to the launch of a large number of highly leveraged positive and negative ETFs in May, the surge triggered a major correction and a sharp decline. From June to July, the circuit breaker was 9 times, exceeding the "total of only 6 times in the previous 20 years." The Korean stock market fell 43.9% from the high point of June 19, falling below the half-year line and approaching the annual line. In the first half of the year, the Korean stock market and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index in the United States also more than doubled, but the more they rose, the more they fell. Foreign investors sold Taiwan stocks for 601.8 billion in June and sold another 758.2 billion in July. The decline of 18.3% of Taiwan stocks was smaller than that of Korean stocks. The main reason was the biggest decline in this wave from the high point: Samsung fell 46%, Hynix fell 54%, and TSMC only fell 13.6%! Therefore, the largest increase in Korean stocks in the first half of the year was twice that of Taiwan stocks. Now on 7/29, Taiwan stocks have risen by 38.2% this year, which is greater than 34.4% in Korean stocks! Will foreign investors’ crazy selling of TSMC change? TSMC increased again on 7/16 Hundreds of billions of US dollars were invested in the United States, totaling up to US$265 billion. Since then, foreign investors have increased their sales, with a total of 827,000 sold this year. It is estimated that foreign investors' withdrawals from TSMC are similar to the total sales of Taiwanese stocks this year, which exceeded 1.68 trillion. Last year, only 84,000 units were sold, and TSMC rose 44.2%. However, this year, TSMC has hit a record high since June 23.

summary: 晶碩（6491）昨（31）日公告上半年財報，在高階產品出貨成長帶動下，上半年合併營收40億元，年增24.2%；稅後純益10.17億元，年增26.6%，每股純益（EPS）13.13元，改寫歷年同期新高。單看第2季，EPS達7.08元，亦創歷年同期新高、單季歷史次高，僅次於2023年第4季，顯示獲利動能持續升溫。

title_en: Jingshuo’s first half EPS was 13.13 yuan
summary_en: Jingshuo (6491) announced its first-half financial report yesterday (31st). Driven by the growth in high-end product shipments, consolidated revenue in the first half of the year was 4 billion yuan, an annual increase of 24.2%; after-tax net income was 1.017 billion yuan, an annual increase of 26.6%, and net earnings per share (EPS) was 13.13 yuan, a record high for the same period in previous years. Looking at the second quarter alone, EPS reached 7.08 yuan, which was also a new high for the same period in previous years and the second highest in single-quarter history, second only to the fourth quarter of 2023, indicating that profit momentum continues to increase.

title_en: Hong Kang sells stake in mainland subsidiary
summary_en: Hongkang (3587), a major semiconductor materials analysis laboratory, held a major press conference yesterday (31st). The board of directors decided to sell 80% of the equity of the indirectly invested Chinese subsidiary Hongkang Technical Testing (Shanghai) to the investment team. The Shanghai subsidiary is worth approximately RMB 1.9 billion (approximately NT$9.09 billion), and the transaction was completed in cash. After the transaction is completed, the investment team will hold 80% of the shares of Hongkang Shanghai, while Hongkang Technology will retain 20% of the shares.

title_en: Guojinghua earned 0.42 yuan per share in June
summary_en: Guojinghua (4722) yesterday (31st) announced its self-imposed profit figures because its securities met the standards for publishing cautionary transaction information in the centralized trading market. Net profit after tax in June was 43 million yuan, an annual increase of 471%, and net profit per share (EPS) was 0.42 yuan. title: 購併大潤發後長出新物種　全聯靠大型店搶錢包也搶時間
summary: 過去，全聯門市多在市區，面積約200坪上下，200至400坪已算大店；相較之下，量販店則以市郊展店為主，面積約千坪起跳。但如今，包含進德店在內，全聯已有4間500坪以上的大型店。這樣的規模，既沒有到量販店等級，也不是一般人印象中的社區超市，而是巧妙的在這兩者之間，創造出一個新物種。為什麼他們要往這條路走？原因一，是4年前完成的大潤發購併案。事實上，目前這4間大型店，都是在此之後開出。蔡篤昌舉例，像是這一次在進德店中，導入的全家電、全酒窖模組，都是如今在大全聯中能看到的貨架規格。「大潤發時期，他們的酒就蠻厲害的，然後有很多的專業知識，抽取量販中元素過來，能讓全聯看起來比較豐富。」以往全聯也曾嘗試小店型「全聯mini輕超市」，但成效不佳。他坦言：「消費者還是要一站式購足，做得不大不小，反而坪效很差，所以我們把它捨棄了；反而是從標準的全聯到大一點的全聯，它的空間效益產值是好的。」

title_en: After the acquisition of RT-Mart, new species emerged. Quanlian relies on large stores to grab wallets and time.
summary_en: In the past, Quanlian stores were mostly located in urban areas, with an area of ​​about 200 square meters, and 200 to 400 square meters were considered large stores. In contrast, mass merchandisers were mainly suburban showrooms, with an area of ​​about 1,000 square meters. But now, including the Jinde store, there are four large stores in Quanlian with an area of ​​more than 500 square meters. This kind of scale is neither at the level of mass merchandisers nor the community supermarkets that most people think of. Instead, it cleverly creates a new species between the two. Why did they go this way? The first reason is the RT-Mart merger completed four years ago. In fact, the current four large stores were all opened after this. Cai Duchang gave an example. For example, this time in the Jinde store, the whole appliance and whole wine cellar modules introduced are the same shelf specifications that can be seen in Daquan Lianzhong today. "During the RT-Mart era, their wines were quite good, and they had a lot of professional knowledge. By extracting elements from mass sales, Quanlian looked richer." In the past, Quanlian also tried a small-store "Quanlian mini light supermarket", but the results were not good. He said frankly: "Consumers still want one-stop shopping. It is neither big nor small, but the square footage efficiency is very poor, so we abandoned it. Instead, we moved from the standard Quanlian to the larger Quanlian. Its space efficiency and output value are good."

title_en: A gangster boy becomes an East District legend 1/The old Kaohsiung shop becomes a good boy for a gangster and goes north to rely on a bowl of flat food to become an East District legend
summary_en: A bowl of flat food can change the life of a gangster. In the 1990s, Kaohsiung Wufu Bianshi opened in a converted garage of less than 20 square meters next to Yipin Building in Taipei East District. It once set a record of cash revenue of 100,000 yuan a day, and had 12 employees to pay for it non-stop. Regular customers include former Vice President Hsieh Tung-min, People's Party Chairman Soong, Cathay Pacific Group Chairman Tsai Chen-nam and other political and business celebrities. Hong Kong celebrities who come to Taiwan have even designated pilgrims. But few people know that Lin Jintai, the second generation who turned his small shop into a legend in the East District, was involved in a gang when he was young. When he was 27 years old, his parents took down the old shop that had been run in Kaohsiung for more than 20 years and accompanied him to the north to start over. Only then did he change his life with a bowl of shrimp flatbread. Now Kaohsiung Wufu Bianshi has opened a new location and handed over the reins to the third generation, opening in Dazhi and Neihu. What remains is not only the old-fashioned taste of heart, but also the principles of life and business that the family has maintained for more than a decade.

title_en: A Gang Boy Becomes an East District Legend 2/Struggling to survive the first three years of starting a business. Cai Chennan’s advice made this restaurant popular for 20 years
summary_en: Lin Jintan, who has been in a gang, opened a casino, and participated in a karaoke fire, said that he made money quickly in those years and lost it quickly, and he was tired of his time in the world. When he was 27 years old, his parents took away the old store that had been in business for 27 years in Kaohsiung and accompanied him to the north to start over. The three of them crowded into a small rented apartment and sold snacks in the East District during the day. After three years of hard work, they finally turned the humble shop into a famous store in the East District. This also includes a short story with guidance from an expert.

title_en: Traffic congestion tests the quality of living! Landmark road sections have become the focus of the move towards home buying for owner-occupiers, "near but not disturbing"
summary_en: As Taichung City's population continues to grow and the number of cars increases, traffic congestion has become the biggest concern affecting the quality of living. Market observation found that compared to areas with main roads and dense traffic, more and more owner-occupiers are turning their attention to residential streets that are adjacent to major construction and can moderately avoid through traffic, such as "Shishi North 2nd Road" in Phase 7, "Zhongke Road" in Shuinan Central Park Special Zone, and "Rongde Road" in Phase 14.

title: 四大房仲：房市緩步向上 7月交易量年增11.9%~18.6%

title_en: Four major real estate agents: The housing market is slowly rising, with transaction volume in July increasing by 11.9%~18.6% year-on-year
summary_en: The four major real estate brokerages, Yongqing, Zhushang, CITIC and Taiwan Real Estate, announced yesterday (31st) the transaction data of their agency stores in July. The transaction volume in July increased slightly by 1% to 6.7% or decreased by 3.5% compared with June, and increased by 11.9% to 18.6% compared with the same period last year. This shows that the housing market has escaped from the bottom of last year and is slowly recovering upwards. However, August and September coincide with the traditional lunar folk months, and the transaction volume in the third quarter may not increase significantly.

title: 力積電董事長黃崇仁辭世 傳奇人物屢屢絕處逢生
summary: 力積電董事長黃崇仁昨日在睡夢中辭世，消息傳出震撼國內半導體產業，他近40年來在半導體創業歷程驚濤駭浪，創立力晶半導體一度是台灣DRAM龍頭，但也經歷金融海嘯、背負1,200億元債務、股票下市。在產業冷眼中，他力挽狂瀾讓力晶起死回生，以力積電重返資本市場，成為產業傳奇人物。

title_en: Power Semiconductor Chairman Huang Chongren passed away. Legendary figures often survive from desperate situations.
summary_en: Power Semiconductor chairman Huang Chongren passed away in his sleep yesterday. The news shocked the domestic semiconductor industry. He had a turbulent entrepreneurial journey in the semiconductor industry for nearly 40 years. He founded Powerchip Semiconductor and was once the leader in DRAM in Taiwan. However, he also experienced the financial tsunami, was saddled with 120 billion yuan in debt, and his stock was delisted. In the cold eyes of the industry, he turned the tide and brought Powerchip back to life, returning to the capital market with Powerchip and becoming an industry legend.

title_en: Builders rebound... Rooftop photovoltaic policy turns around, Huan Tuan is dishonest
summary_en: The new rooftop photovoltaic system is now on the road. It was originally planned that as long as the building is more than 300 square meters, it will be mandatory to install solar panels on the roof, regardless of whether it is newly built, renovated or renovated. However, the construction industry has repeatedly expressed doubts in recent days. The Executive Yuan announced yesterday that it will be implemented in stages, and residential and shop buildings will be excluded in the first wave. The environmental group criticized that the consensus and preparations accumulated for three years were suddenly overturned, and the credibility of the government was completely lost. It also showed the swing of the energy policy of the ruling party.

title_en: The US dollar policy announced that the interest rate has jumped to 4.42%, and Taiwan Life Insurance has reached the highest level in the industry.
summary_en: The market expects that the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) will raise interest rates soon. The trend of U.S. long-term government bond yields continues to fluctuate at a high level. Domestic life insurance companies' U.S. dollar interest rate variable policies also reflect the market environment. They have raised policy announcement rates for three consecutive months to seize business opportunities. Currently, the highest announced interest rates for U.S. dollar policies generally fall within the range of 4.3% to 4.35%, with Taiwan Life temporarily taking the top spot at 4.42%.

title_en: Taiwan dollar surges 1.62 cents on heavy volume
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market surged by more than 3,000 points yesterday (31st), driving the inflow of foreign capital. The exchange rate of the New Taiwan dollar against the U.S. dollar counterattacked strongly at midday. Due to the massive inflow of foreign capital and late adjustment by the central bank, it finally closed at 32.292 yuan, the highest price of the day. It rose by 1.62 cents or 0.5% in a single day, setting the largest single-day increase in more than three and a half months. Trading volume increased to US$4.049 billion, and the weekly trend turned from black to red, ending five consecutive weeks of depreciation.

title_en: Huang Chongren passes away/reverses hundreds of billions of debts and returns to life Huang Chongren’s philosophy of never giving up
summary_en: The life of Huang Chongren, the founder of Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd., is full of legends and controversies. In 2012, Powerchip suffered a devastating blow due to the sharp freeze in the DRAM market. It was delisted with debts of 120 billion yuan. Many outsiders believed that the company would definitely fail. However, Huang Chongren relied on the life philosophy of "not giving up even if there is only a 1% chance" to transform into foundry, spent 8 years paying off hundreds of billions of debts, and led Power Semiconductor to return to the capital market. During his lifetime, he facilitated the sale of Tongluo Factory to Micron and initiated the fourth transformation, demonstrating his flexible and tenacious business survival skills.

summary_en: The Executive Yuan has made adjustments to the "rooftop photovoltaic" installation policy. Taking into account the concerns of grassroots implementation mechanisms and local governments, the Executive Yuan has decided to implement the rooftop photovoltaic policy in a "phased" manner, and the first wave will exclude residential and shop-type buildings. title_en: African swine fever breaks out in Finland, live pigs and pork products are banned from exporting to Taiwan
summary_en: The African Swine Fever Central Disaster Response Center said today that Finland's official website confirmed the first case of African swine fever (ASF). As the international African swine fever epidemic continues to increase, the response center appeals to Chinese people not to carry, mail or express pork products back to the country from countries where African swine fever occurs. Anyone who carries or mails illegally will be fined RMB 200,000 for the first time and RMB 1 million for the second and subsequent times. If the goods are imported illegally by express delivery or freight, the maximum penalty is a fixed-term imprisonment of not more than seven years, and a fine of not more than 3 million yuan may be imposed.

title: AI不是搶飯碗，而是替專業者升級！他用過500種生成式AI工具：先找出最痛問題
summary: Rick早年投入數位廣告與行銷科技，深刻感受到內容製作是行銷工作的瓶頸。過去一張廣告素材、一支宣傳影片，往往必須仰賴設計師、導演及後製團隊。生成式AI出現後，從創意發想、文字撰寫、圖片到影片素材，都能由行銷人員主導，內容生產的主導權也因此逐漸回到企業內部。這也成為他投入AI教學的重要轉折。非理工背景者過去學習程式，常因基礎不足而卻步。AI卻像一位不會不耐煩的老師，可以依照使用者的程度反覆解釋。Rick認為，AI打破的不只是技術門檻，更是一般人面對科技時的心理門檻。

title_en: AI is not grabbing jobs, but upgrading professionals! He has used 500 generative AI tools: find the most painful problem first
summary_en: Rick invested in digital advertising and marketing technology in his early years and deeply felt that content production was the bottleneck of marketing work. In the past, an advertising material or a promotional video often relied on designers, directors and post-production teams. After the emergence of generative AI, everything from creative ideas, text writing, pictures to video materials can be led by marketers, and the dominance of content production has gradually returned to the enterprise. This also became an important turning point for him to invest in AI teaching. People with non-science and engineering backgrounds were often deterred from learning programming due to insufficient foundation. AI is like a teacher who is not impatient and can explain repeatedly according to the user's level. Rick believes that AI breaks not only the technical threshold, but also the psychological threshold of ordinary people when facing technology.

title_en: After retirement, you will receive 20,000 pocket money every day for 40 years! Seeing the shocking amount of my wife’s savings, I sighed: I was cheated
summary_en: Toshio Ishikawa, a retired Japanese man, had an annual income of up to 9 million yen during his 40 years of work, but his wife has long restricted him from receiving only 20,000 yen in monthly allowance. It wasn't until the day of retirement that the wife revealed her family's bankbooks and investment accounts, which totaled 42 million yen in savings. It turned out that her wife used "no money" as an excuse to control finances, all to ensure a safe retirement life. Experts warn that this type of highly concentrated model of financial power is risky. If one party suffers from sudden dementia or an accident, assets may be frozen. It is recommended that couples review their assets, liabilities and pension allocation together at least annually, establish a transparent family asset list, avoid information asymmetry affecting retirement planning, ensure financial security and maintain good family communication, which are the key cornerstones of achieving a stable retirement life.

title_en: Taipower's losses widened to NT$11.3 billion in June; gas prices rose again in August, adding to cost pressure
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Xie Yixuan, Taipei, 31st) Taipower announced operating figures for June. The pre-tax loss in June was NT$11.3 billion, more than double the loss in May. Taipower explained that the increase in fuel expenses was due to PetroChina's increase in electricity gas prices in April and May and the increase in electricity consumption in summer months. In response to China National Petroleum Corporation's announcement to increase electricity gas prices in August, Taipower's latest estimate is that monthly fuel expenditure costs will increase to about 15 billion yuan.

title_en: Bragging about helping Xi Jinping import oil and the "ancestral Swiss trust", he defrauded 26.12 million...his fate was exposed
summary_en: A man surnamed Xiao claimed to be an oil tycoon. He falsely claimed that his grandfather had left a trust company in Switzerland with a capital of 500 billion euros and could trade oil. He also boasted that he was familiar with the top leaders on both sides of the Taiwan Strait. Not only was he designated by Chinese President Xi Jinping to import oil, but he was also helped by former President Tsai Ing-wen to deduct taxes. An investor mistakenly believed that he had a cross-border investment plan and invested more than 26.12 million yuan. Later, he was shocked to report that he had been deceived and called the police. The Shilin District Court found that the investment plan claimed by Xiao Nan was entirely fictitious and that he had altered bank transfer slips to serve as proof of funds. He was sentenced to four years and eight months in prison for the crime of altering private documents and confiscated 24.5 million yuan in criminal proceeds.

summary: 力積電今（31）日晚間重訊公告董事長黃崇仁因心肺衰竭辭世，享壽76歲。外界熟知黃崇仁是台灣半導體產業的重要推手，卻少有人知道，他畢生另一個最想完成的夢想，是投入癌症新藥研發。身兼智合精準醫學科技董事長的他，近年幾乎將所有心力投注於抗癌新藥，希望以自身醫學背景，為癌症患者找到新的治療方向。今年2月黃崇仁接受本刊專訪時形容，生醫工作是「使命」，只要能減輕病人的痛苦，「就是功德」。

title_en: Huang Chongren passed away/Doctor of Medicine returns to biomedicine. Huang Chongren’s last wish is to fight cancer and save people
summary_en: Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd. announced today (31st) evening that Chairman Huang Chongren passed away due to cardiopulmonary failure at the age of 76. The outside world is well aware that Huang Chongren is an important promoter of Taiwan's semiconductor industry, but few people know that another dream he most wants to fulfill in his life is to invest in the research and development of new cancer drugs. As the chairman of Zhihe Precision Medicine Technology, he has devoted almost all his energy to new anti-cancer drugs in recent years, hoping to use his medical background to find new treatment directions for cancer patients. In an exclusive interview with this magazine in February this year, Huang Chongren described biomedical work as a "mission" and as long as it can alleviate the pain of patients, "it is a merit."

title_en: Jiabang decided to implement treasury shares and expected to buy back 2,000 shares
summary_en: Jiabang (6284), a protective component and antenna company, announced on the 31st that its board of directors has decided to implement a treasury stock plan. It is expected to buy back 2,000 shares in the centralized market from August 3 to October 2, accounting for about 1.34% of the issued shares. The buy-back price range is set at 65 yuan to 77 yuan per share. The bought-back shares will be used to transfer employees to stimulate employee morale, enhance centripetal force and retain key talents.

summary_en: Amid long and short factors such as rising tensions in the Middle East and the liquidity of AI capital expenditures, foreign investors oversold Taiwanese stocks by more than 730 billion yuan in July, the second largest single month of overselling in history. At the same time, overselling for the whole year also reached 1.69 trillion yuan, temporarily the largest single year of overselling in history. As investors wait to see the next move of foreign capital, 10 stocks including Wistron (3231) and Asus, which oversold more than 10 billion in July, have become the focus of attention.

title_en: Advantech Financial Report/Profit in the second quarter of this year hit a record high, EPS reached 5.2 yuan
summary_en: Advantech (2395), a global leader in industrial IoT, held a board meeting on the 31st and announced its consolidated financial report for the second quarter and first half of 2026. Advantech's consolidated revenue in the second quarter of 2026 reached 26.126 billion yuan, an annual increase of 46% and a quarterly increase of 28%; the consolidated gross profit reached 9.845 billion yuan (gross profit margin 37.7%), the operating profit was 5.127 billion yuan (operating profit rate 19.6%), the consolidated after-tax net profit was 4.518 billion yuan, an annual increase of 127%, a quarterly increase of 36%; net earnings per share reached 5.2 yuan. Single-quarter revenue and profit both hit record highs. However, gross profit margin fell from the same period last year due to short-term price fluctuations of key raw materials.

title_en: AI is too strong! Taiwan's economic growth rate was revised upward to 12.92% in the second quarter, better than expected
summary_en: AI business opportunities continue to ignite, and Taiwan’s economy maintains rapid expansion. The General Accounting Office announced on the 31st that the economic growth rate in the second quarter of this year is estimated to be 12.92%.
