title_en: Qian Jing Your Family 1/When will you pick up diamonds after the stock market crash? Zheng Tingyi: Wait for 2 signals before taking action
summary_en: Taiwan stocks fell more than 3,500 points in just two trading days. Although they briefly rebounded on July 30, they still closed down 105.88 points, unable to hold the 40,000-point mark. The market has instantly turned from a price-chasing frenzy to a panicked escape. Faced with price limits and seemingly attractive discounts, what investors want to know most is whether they can enter the market now and grab a bargain? Billion dollar professor Zheng Tingyi said in the "Money Mirror Your Home" program that the rebound after a sharp decline does not mean the bottom. The real signal to stop the decline must simultaneously observe the long lower shadow line left by the index band volume and the NT dollar turning from depreciation to increase; before these two conditions are met, retaining cash is more important than guessing the low point.

title_en: Taishan's sale of FamilyMart shares exposed insider trading. Four directors were interviewed. Zhan Rendao and Liu Weilong each posted bail of NT$500,000.
summary_en: Taishan Enterprise, a major food manufacturer, suspected of a battle for management rights. In 2022, it decided to sell the equity of the "Golden Chicken Mother" FamilyMart convenience store. The four chairman Zhan Jingchao, Zhan Rendao, Zhan Renhua, and Zhan Yuelin, as well as the then director Liu Weilong, were banned. The trading of Taishan stocks during the trading period involved insider trading. The Taipei City Bureau of Investigation searched and interviewed 11 people and brought them to the case. After the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office reviewed the case, they ordered Zhan Rendao and Liu Weilong to post bail of NT$500,000 each in violation of the Securities and Exchange Act and were restricted from leaving the country.

title_en: Preview of five major financial events on July 31
summary_en:
The Economic Daily has compiled five must-know financial events so that readers can quickly grasp the most important financial events every morning.

1. The Fed’s hawk-like decision-making caused controversy. Three officials called for an interest rate increase, but interest rates remained unchanged.
The U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decided on the 29th to maintain the target range of the federal funds rate at 3.5%-3.75%...more


2. Taiwan stocks lost weight through financing and are brewing for a rebound. The Taiwan index futures once surged a thousand points in night trading, and market sentiment improved.
After Taiwan stocks plunged 3,595 points in two days, they staged a 1,751-point shock yesterday (30th), continuing to clear the final float. During the session, TSMC, the leading electronics weight stock, surged higher and once rebounded 1,116 points...more


3. Equity investment in mortgage loans may endanger financial stability. The minutes of the central bank’s Q2 Board of Supervisors pointed out three major problems with the “four loans under one roof”
The Central Bank released the summary of the proceedings of the second quarter joint meeting of governors and supervisors yesterday (30th). Several directors pointed out three major risks in "four loans under one roof"...more


4. ASE increased capital expenditure for the second time and simultaneously spent 12 billion to purchase AUO and Guaiguai factories.
ASE Investment Holdings (3711), the global leader in semiconductor packaging and testing, stated at a conference yesterday (30th) that AI has driven demand for advanced packaging and testing to continue to rise...more


5. The “eldest wife clause” of inheritance tax applies retrospectively. If you receive property two years before your death, you should pay the inheritance tax proportionally.
The Executive Yuan will finalize the amendments to the "Inheritance and Gift Tax Law" yesterday (30th), adding a new "eldest wife"

title_en: Deputy Minister of Finance Nguyen Thanh Hua saw the huge earthquake in the stock market and entered the market after the National Security Fund market was out of order.
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market has plummeted in recent days. Nguyen Ching-hua, executive secretary of the National Security Fund and Deputy Minister of Finance, said yesterday (30th) that the National Security Fund will enter the market only when major events lead to a collapse of confidence and market disorder and other special conditions. The stock market has fallen but also risen recently. The National Security Fund pays close attention to domestic and foreign political and economic situations, and will deal with it appropriately if there is any disorder.

summary_en: AUO turned a loss into a profit in the second quarter, with net profit attributable to the parent company reaching 1.343 billion yuan, and net profit after tax per share of 0.18 yuan, ending its first-quarter loss. Revenue was 70.891 billion yuan, with a gross profit margin of 13.05%. Both operating profit margin and after-tax net profit margin improved significantly compared with the first quarter.

summary_en: Taiwan Mobile held the launch press conference of the 10th "Solar for Good" yesterday (30th), focusing on Changhua's Solar for Good. The fund-raising target is NT$5.2 million. It is expected to generate about NT$8 million in green electricity income in the next 20 years, and the fundraising benefit will be amplified by 1.54 times. title: 花旗估日圓將走弱，稱植田和男無法比預期更鷹
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，花旗集團認為日圓有走弱空間，因為日本央行行長植田和男不太可能發出比市場預期更為鷹派的信號。花旗分析師Daniel Tobon、Osamu Takashima和Brian Levine在報告中寫道，我們做多1個月期美元/日圓160.50/162看漲期權價差。花旗這些分析師表示，週四美元/日圓急跌與之前干預期間出現的走勢一致。然而，我們認為植田行長週五稍晚在日本央行會議上無法給出「超鷹」預期，從而引發失望。花旗分析師還表示，我們認為美元/日圓週五晚間有反彈的空間，之後還有機會上升。

Only Microsoft's "free cash flow" indicator has been recognized by the market. The sharp decline in cash flow of Google and Meta has raised market doubts about whether AI investments can be realized. Coupled with the transfer of capital chips in the stock market, server foundries such as Hon Hai, Quanta and Wistron were "indiscriminately sold" yesterday (30th), and all fell by more than 3%. Quanta was even beaten to the limit.

summary_en: The volatility of Taiwan's stock market has intensified recently, and bad news can easily be magnified and interpreted. Even if there is positive news, investors can easily regard it as "all profits are gone." From a short-term perspective, Taiwan stocks are currently under greater pressure due to chip pressure. However, the current fundamentals are solid, and market estimates for Taiwanese corporate profits have been revised upward from 28% year-on-year to over 30%.

As chips changed hands benignly, stocks such as United Microelectronics (2303) and Nanya rebounded on the strength of the volume, and bullish statements began to appear. Legal persons expect that the market situation will still take time to sort out. It is recommended to avoid excessive leverage and only try to rebound.

summary_en: Foreign investors Goldman Sachs and Citi Securities simultaneously issued the latest stock reports on Yageo* (2327), and unanimously lowered their target prices. Goldman Sachs lowered the target price from 1,490 yuan to 1,280 yuan, and Citigroup lowered it from 1,500 yuan to 1,450 yuan. Based on the views of the two foreign investors, this modest revision of the target price mainly reflects the compression of the price-to-earnings ratio caused by industrial deleveraging, rather than changes in Yageo's profits, so they both still maintain a "buy" rating.

The stock price listed on the Shenzhen Exchange even closed down by more than 9%. Zhongji InnoLight led the decline, and the stock prices of Taiwan's optical communications manufacturers Boruowei (3163) and China Star Optoelectronics simultaneously weakened.

Chairman Lin Yu-chang revealed a new strategic goal: "Bring Taiwan back to the global optoelectronics battlefield."

The goal is to complete the review within 30 days and notify the review results within five days. The first phase of "cooperating countries" is mainly the United States, and prevents illegal goods from being "laundered of origin" through transshipment to third countries.

summary_en: The "K-shaped economy" issue of uneven industrial development has attracted much attention. The Finance Committee of the Legislative Yuan held a public hearing on "K-shaped economic issues" yesterday (30th). Many suggestions during the meeting focused on tax reform. Kuomintang legislator Lai Shibao advocated that the Ministry of Finance should consider imposing a 5% rich tax on high-asset groups. Other scholars believe that the abundant tax revenue should be used to assist industrial transformation and increase labor wages.

title_en: Ministry of Economic Affairs’ “Double Plus” Initiative encourages sharing of economic fruits
summary_en: Faced with the intensification of the K-shaped economy and the uneven distribution of the fruits of growth, the Finance Committee of the Legislative Yuan held a public hearing on "K-shaped economic issues" yesterday (30th). The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated that through the two major measures of "increase in credit insurance for salary increases" and "tax deduction for salary increases", companies are encouraged to share the fruits of the economy and reflect operating results in employee salaries.

title: 老了醫療誰來顧 對策篇／健保拚永續 必須多管齊下
summary: 邁入超高齡社會，看病的人變多，繳健保費的人變少，以前是100個人繳錢，養100個人的看病支出，現在是50人養200人，加上醫療通膨，健保費再怎麼漲，也跟不上醫療支出的增加。為了強化國人的醫療保障安全網，提高第一層健保保費、找尋新財源及設立第二層健保補位險，得多管齊下。

title_en: Who will take care of medical care in old age? Countermeasures/Multi-pronged approach is necessary to ensure sustainability of health insurance
summary_en: As we enter a super-aged society, more people see doctors and fewer people pay health insurance premiums. In the past, 100 people paid to support 100 people, but now it is 50 people to support 200 people. With medical inflation, no matter how much health insurance premiums rise, they cannot keep up with the increase in medical expenditures. In order to strengthen the medical security safety net for Chinese people, a multi-pronged approach is required to increase the first-tier health insurance premiums, find new sources of income, and establish second-tier health insurance supplementary insurance.

title: 老了醫療誰來顧 對策篇／化解理賠爭議 醫保坐下來談

title_en: Who will take care of medical care in old age? Countermeasures/Resolving claims disputes: Let’s sit down and talk about medical insurance
summary_en: The gap between medical judgment and insurance claims is getting wider and wider. In addition to the need for insurance companies to keep pace with the times and launch new types of insurance policies to respond, for disputes such as the conversion of inpatient surgeries to outpatient surgeries and the identification of medical necessity, it is even more necessary for the government to cooperate across departments and committees to find consistent standards, reduce mutual distrust, and reduce disputes.

title_en: Microsoft's earnings report sparked a rebound in chip stocks, and the three major U.S. stock indexes closed strongly higher on Thursday
summary_en: Business Media | Fang Chengye/Comprehensive foreign news reports The U.S. stock market generally closed higher on Thursday (July 30), mainly driven by Microsoft's (Microsoft) impressive financial report, with technology stocks and semiconductor stocks rebounding strongly. Investors viewed the Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates unchanged, but on the other hand, the market's doubts about the effectiveness of artificial intelligence (AI) spending caused Meta Platforms' stock price to plummet. Microsoft's financial report inspired semiconductor stocks to rise. After Microsoft announced earnings that exceeded expectations, its stock price soared more than 15%, setting its best single-day performance since October 2008 and driving its market value to surge by US$450 billion in a single day on Wall Street. The company's cloud business revenue grew by 43%, the fastest growth rate since 2022, and its capital expenditure guidance was in line with expectations, effectively alleviating market concerns about the failure of AI investments to bring returns. As of closing, Microsoft's stock price rose 13.83%. Encouraged by this, semiconductor stocks got rid of the previous day's decline and rebounded strongly across the board. The PHLX Semiconductor Index surged 8.2%. Among them, Micron Technology soared 18% to 18.4%, SanDisk soared 26%, Lam Research rose 19%, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) rose 13%, and Intel also climbed 11.3% to 13%. The CEO of Qualcomm even pointed out on the earnings call that rising memory chip prices are "very important."

title: 美日長債殖利率雙雙大漲，SMBC日興：日本當局疑順勢干預匯市
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，SMBC日興證券方面表示，日本疑似干預匯市，可能是受到日本和美國長期及超長期國債殖利率均大幅上升的推動。SMBC日興證券高級外匯及利率策略分析師Rinto Maruyama表示，在日本央行公佈政策決定前干預，可能是為了出其不意，最大限度放大干預效果。這與4月更透明、容易識別的干預形成對比。日本財務省近期多項高層人事任命，可能有助於鞏固政府的干預機制和決策流程。如果日圓在日本央行會議後再度走弱，才可能出現新一輪干預。Maruyama表示，如果市場將日本央行會後的表態解讀為鴿派，美元/日圓再度面臨上升壓力，屆時可能為當局再次入市干預提供機會。

title_en: Long-term bond yields in the United States and Japan both surged, SMBC Nikko: Japanese authorities suspected of taking advantage of the trend to intervene in the currency market
summary_en: [Financial News Express/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that SMBC Nikko Securities stated that Japan’s suspected intervention in the foreign exchange market may be driven by the sharp increase in long-term and ultra-long-term government bond yields in Japan and the United States. Rinto Maruyama, senior foreign exchange and interest rate strategist at SMBC Nikko Securities, said that the intervention before the Bank of Japan announced its policy decision may be to surprise and maximize the effect of the intervention. This contrasts with April's more transparent and easily identifiable intervention. Japan's Ministry of Finance has recently made a number of high-level personnel appointments, which may help consolidate the government's intervention mechanism and decision-making process. If the yen weakens again after the Bank of Japan meeting, a new round of intervention may occur. Maruyama said that if the market interprets the Bank of Japan's post-meeting statement as dovish, the dollar/yen will once again face upward pressure, which may provide opportunities for the authorities to intervene in the market again.

title: GoDaddy 縮減全年營收財測 AI 工具採用緩慢影響客群
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜何映辰／台北報導全球知名網域註冊商 GoDaddy 於週四（30日）發布財報，下修了年度營收預測，主因是人工智慧（AI）工具採用速度較慢，以及新客戶獲取不如預期。儘管如此，GoDaddy 第二季營收大致符合分析師預估。 根據財報顯示，GoDaddy 預期全年營收將介於 52.15 億至 52.55 億美元之間。此一預測值略低於先前公布的 51.95 億至 52.75 億美元區間，反映了市場環境的變化。 在第二季營收方面，GoDaddy 錄得 12.98 億美元，略高於分析師預期的 12.95 億美元。對於第三季，該公司預計營收落在 13.2 億至 13.4 億美元，與市場預期相符。 GoDaddy 執行長阿曼·巴塔尼（Aman Bhutani）表示，公司正透過以去年推出的 Airo.ai 平台為核心，推動一項全公司範圍的 AI 轉型，目標是建立一個「代理式作業系統」，幫助客戶提升效率。然而，AI 工具的普及速度與新客戶的成長趨緩，是此次調整財測的關鍵因素。

title_en: GoDaddy scales back full-year revenue forecast, slow adoption of AI tool affecting customer base
summary_en: Picture/Schematic Business Media｜He Yingchen/Taipei report GoDaddy, a world-renowned domain registrar, released its financial report on Thursday (30th) and revised down its annual revenue forecast. The main reason is the slow adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and the lower-than-expected acquisition of new customers. Still, GoDaddy's second-quarter revenue was broadly in line with analysts' estimates. According to the financial report, GoDaddy expects full-year revenue to be between $5.215 billion and $5.255 billion. This forecast is slightly lower than the previously announced range of $5.195 billion to $5.275 billion, reflecting changes in market conditions. In terms of second-quarter revenue, GoDaddy recorded $1.298 billion, slightly above analysts' expectations of $1.295 billion. For the third quarter, the company expects revenue to fall between $1.32 billion and $1.34 billion, in line with market expectations. GoDaddy CEO Aman Bhutani said that the company is promoting a company-wide AI transformation with the Airo.ai platform launched last year as the core, with the goal of establishing an "agent-based operating system" to help customers improve efficiency. However, the slowdown in the popularity of AI tools and the slowdown in the growth of new customers are key factors in this adjustment to the financial forecast.

title: 延伸年齡層三期臨床結果正面，高端EV71疫苗適應年齡擬擴至未滿10歲
summary: 【財訊快報／記者何美如報導】高端疫苗(6547)30日宣布，已正式向台灣食品藥物管理署（TFDA）提交腸病毒71型（EV-A71）疫苗之適應症年齡變更申請，此向申請是基於正面之延伸年齡層的三期臨床試驗結果，擬將現行適應症「2個月大至未滿6歲」，進一步擴增至「2個月大至未滿10歲」之兒童群體。總經理李思賢表示，腸病毒重症與死亡年齡，並不限於6歲以下，在1998年、2019年的疫情重症或死亡病例，都出現8歲孩童。因此讓這支疫苗的保護力涵蓋更大年齡層、一直是我們開發疫苗的終極目標。本次的年齡延伸臨床試驗結果正面，促成今日藥證適應症變更申請的正式提出。我們由衷希望此項變更申請能順利通過，讓腸病毒71型疫苗的保護傘，由滿2個月大嬰幼兒擴及未滿10歲學童，保護更多小朋友，是我們一直以來的使命。腸病毒71型長期以來是引發台灣及亞洲地區重症手足口病及神經系統併發症的主要元兇。高端所生產的腸病毒71型疫苗在先前臨床研究中已證實具備高達100%的保護力。 總經理李思賢說，雖然腸病毒71型傳統上以6歲以下的幼童為高風險族群，但臨床數據與防疫實務顯示，超過6歲以上的學齡兒童，依然有感染並導致重症或死亡的風險。

title_en: Phase III clinical results for extended age groups are positive, and the applicable age of high-end EV71 vaccine is planned to be expanded to under 10 years old
summary_en: [Financial News/Reported by reporter He Meiru] High-end Vaccine (6547) announced on the 30th that it has officially submitted an application for age change of indications for enterovirus 71 (EV-A71) vaccine to the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA). This application is based on the positive results of the Phase III clinical trial of extending the age group. It plans to further expand the current indication "2 months old to under 6 years old" to children "2 months old to under 10 years old". General Manager Li Sixian said that the age of severe enterovirus disease and death is not limited to children under 6 years old. In the 1998 and 2019 epidemic cases, severe cases or death cases occurred in children as young as 8 years old. Therefore, making the protection of this vaccine cover a wider age group has always been our ultimate goal in vaccine development. The positive results of this age-extension clinical trial have prompted today's formal filing of an application for change of drug indications. We sincerely hope that this change application can be successfully approved, so that the protective umbrella of enterovirus 71 vaccine can be expanded from infants and young children over 2 months old to school children under 10 years old. It has always been our mission to protect more children. Enterovirus 71 has long been the main culprit causing severe hand, foot and mouth disease and neurological complications in Taiwan and Asia. The enterovirus 71 vaccine produced by High-End has been proven to have up to 100% protection in previous clinical studies. General Manager Li Sixian said that although enterovirus 71 has traditionally been a high-risk group for children under 6 years old, clinical data and epidemic prevention practices show that school-age children over 6 years old are still at risk of infection and leading to severe illness or death.

title: 台灣大「種福電」10年建10座公益電廠，綠能收益估破億元
summary: 【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】台灣大哥大(3045)昨(30)日舉行第十屆「種福電 Solar for Good」啟動記者會，本屆聚焦彰化伯立歐家園，募資目標520萬元，預估未來20年創造約800萬元綠電收益，募資效益放大1.54倍。台灣大率先捐出250萬元，並串聯21家企業夥伴與社會大眾共同投入，邀請全民一起完成募資目標。「種福電」推動至今十屆，包含伯立歐家園在內共推動10座公益電廠，以各案20年營運期估算，預計可為10家社福團體創造逾1億元綠能收益、發電1,880萬度、減碳9,534公噸，改變善款一次用罄的傳統公益模式——募得款項投入太陽能發電設備，售電收益於20年營運期間持續回流社福機構，支應照護人力與日常營運。台灣大哥大總經理暨台灣大基金會執行長林之晨表示，公益組織經營最難的，不是一次性的募得善款，而是十年、二十年，種福電的做法是把一次性的善款，轉化為資產，為公益組織產生二十年的穩定收入；這次為伯立歐家園募集的520萬元，將會轉化為太陽能電廠，未來20年會持續發電、轉化為每年約40萬元、全程共800萬元的穩定收益，讓家園每個月的照顧人力和開銷，多了一份風雨無阻的支撐。本屆共21家

title_en: Taiwan's "Zhongfu Power" will build 10 public welfare power plants in 10 years, and the revenue from green energy is estimated to exceed 100 million yuan
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter Liu Juquan] Taiwan Mobile (3045) held the 10th "Solar for Good" launch press conference yesterday (30th). This year's press conference focused on Changhua's Solar for Good, with a fundraising target of NT$5.2 million. It is estimated that it will create about NT$8 million in green electricity income in the next 20 years, and the fundraising benefit will be amplified by 1.54 times. Taiwan University took the lead in donating 2.5 million yuan, and connected 21 corporate partners and the public to invest together, inviting everyone to work together to complete the fundraising goal. The "Growing Welfare Power Project" has been launched for the tenth time so far. A total of 10 public welfare power plants have been promoted, including Birrio Homes. Based on the 20-year operation period of each project, it is expected to generate more than 100 million yuan in green energy revenue for 10 social welfare groups and generate 18.8 million kilowatt-hours of electricity. , reducing carbon emissions by 9,534 metric tons, changing the traditional public welfare model in which donations are used up all at once - the funds raised are invested in solar power generation equipment, and the proceeds from electricity sales continue to flow back to social welfare organizations during the 20-year operation period to support care manpower and daily operations. Lin Zhichen, general manager of Taiwan Mobile and CEO of Taiwan Mobile Foundation, said that the most difficult thing about running a public welfare organization is not to raise funds in one go, but in ten or twenty years. Zhongfudian’s approach is to convert one-time donations into assets to generate stable income for public welfare organizations for twenty years; The 5.2 million yuan raised this time for the Borreau Home will be converted into a solar power plant, which will continue to generate electricity in the next 20 years, turning into a stable income of about 400,000 yuan per year and a total of 8 million yuan, giving the home an extra support for the monthly care manpower and expenses. title: 錢鏡你家1／股災後何時撿鑽石？　鄭廳宜：等2訊號再出手
summary: 台股短短兩個交易日重挫逾3,500點，7/30雖短暫彈升，但最後仍收跌105.88點，守不住4萬點關卡。市場從追價狂熱瞬間轉為恐慌逃命，面對遍地跌停與看似誘人的折扣價，投資人最想知道的是現在究竟能不能進場撿便宜？億元教授鄭廳宜在《錢鏡你家》節目中表示，急跌後的反彈不等於落底，真正的止跌訊號，必須同時觀察指數帶量留下長下影線，以及新台幣由貶轉升；在此2條件尚未到齊前，保留現金比猜低點更重要。

title: 原物料居高不下及美元走強，華新8月316調漲每公噸2000元，其餘平盤
summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】華新(1605)公布8月不銹鋼盤價，受到印尼政府定調今年度鎳礦開採配額維持2.6億噸，較去年縮減30%影響，致使鎳生鐵價格居高不下，除316調漲每公噸2000元外，其餘維持平盤。華新指出，印尼政府定調今年度鎳礦開採配額維持2.6億噸，較去年縮減30%影響，致使鎳生鐵價格居高不下，加上美伊戰爭再起，原物料、銅價及鉬價皆維持高檔。另外，市場預期聯準會轉向升息趨勢，避險情緒增加及美元走強，導致鋼廠生產成本大幅攀升，惟考量客戶整體接單競爭力，在綜合評估後，針對2026年8月盤元產品價格調整，316調漲每公斤2元，304維持平盤，至於200系、400系為平盤。

summary_en: Taiwan stocks have experienced deleveraging and stop-loss selling pressure, and have continued their recent corrections. Experts pointed out that in the short term, it is advisable to operate conservatively and prudently. Yushan Gold (2884), Airline Shuangxiong and other "double long operation stocks" that have both overbuying by foreign investors and covering short positions by borrowing bonds have chip advantages and indicator significance. They are expected to lead the rise and resist the fall in the future market, acting as a beacon for the bulls.

title: 年薪170萬如何談到250萬？換工作別再寫「依公司規定」　談薪先算四年總包
summary: 許多上班族換工作談薪水時，總覺得開高價很不好意思，深怕被當成貪心或難相處，最後只能在履歷寫上「依公司規定」。結果錄取後才發現，自己的薪水連後進的新人都不如，永遠被通膨追著跑。在我們正式進入薪資談判的攻防步驟之前，我們必須先認識這個賽局裡最常見的對手策略，以及調整好自己的應戰心態。因為在核薪的過程中，大家談薪水都怕被「low-ball」，這是一個英語用詞，劍橋英語字典的解釋是「將某事物的價格或水準，不合理（或不公平）的壓低。」很多人看到對方開出一個低於自己心中的價格，低於自己在網路上查到的數字，就會覺得自己被「low-ball」（低估）了。一般來說，談薪水沒有優勢（自己本來薪水偏低）的朋友，會希望對方「先開出標準包」（Standard Package）薪資，也就是依照職級的既定預算來核薪，而不是因為我們前職薪水偏低，而故意壓低薪水省預算，所以，對於急需「脫 離低薪循環」的朋友來說，直接瞄準大廠的標準包，是實現薪資跳躍最好的策略。

title_en: How can an annual salary of 1.7 million be reduced to 2.5 million? When changing jobs, don’t write “according to company regulations”. When negotiating salary, first calculate the four-year general contract.
summary_en: When negotiating salary when changing jobs, many office workers always feel embarrassed to offer high prices and are afraid of being seen as greedy or difficult to get along with. In the end, they can only write "according to company regulations" on their resumes. After being admitted, I discovered that my salary was not even as good as that of junior newcomers, and I was always being chased by inflation. Before we officially enter the offensive and defensive steps of salary negotiation, we must first understand the most common opponent strategies in this game and adjust our own mentality to fight. Because during the salary verification process, everyone is afraid of being "low-balled" when talking about salary. This is an English term. The Cambridge English Dictionary explains it as "unreasonably (or unfairly) lowering the price or level of something." Many people feel that they have been "low-balled" (underestimated) when they see the other party offering a price that is lower than what they think or the number they found on the Internet. Generally speaking, friends who have no advantage in negotiating salary (their own salary is low) will hope that the other party will "offer a standard package" salary first, that is, the salary will be calculated according to the established budget of the rank, rather than deliberately lowering the salary to save the budget because our previous salary was low. Therefore, for friends who urgently need to "break out of the low-salary cycle", directly targeting the standard package of a large company is the best strategy to achieve a salary jump.

title: 拍照不修圖就不敢見人？心理師揭「容貌焦慮」12項警訊
summary:
拍完照之後，你一定要先修圖，才敢把照片傳給別人嗎？如果沒有濾鏡、沒有美肌、沒有調整臉型和身材，就會覺得那不是自己，甚至不想讓人看見，這究竟只是愛美，還是焦慮早已悄悄上身？在《從裝扮洞察人心》中，林萃芬從修圖行為切入，指出愈來愈多人以為自己是在經營形象，實際上，卻可能正一步步掉進「容貌焦慮」而不自知。

身邊很多朋友拍完照後，都會說：「回去修好圖後，再把『美照』傳給你。」而我們也常常期待，朋友究竟會如何加工照片，讓容貌美上加美。林萃芬指出，修圖其實是一種「印象管理」的行為，盡可能將照片修成自己想要呈現的形象，像是把眼睛加大一點、身材變瘦一點、皮膚變好一點、臉型變小一點，一方面試圖給別人留下美好的印象，提高別人對自己的評價，另一方面，也是依照社會審美的標準來修飾自己，期待能夠贏得別人的正向回饋。

但若太過在意別人眼中的自我外貌，就很容易過度焦慮，無法忍受自己的「不完美」被看見，太過執著於修圖，沒有修過的照片就無法見人。長期下來，不只可能影響心理健康，若只對修過圖的照片有自信，慢慢地也會變得不敢以真面目示人，自信心反而因此大幅降低，甚至變得更加沒自信。

title_en: Are you afraid to meet people if you take photos without retouching them? Psychologists reveal 12 warning signs of "appearance anxiety"
summary_en:
After taking a photo, do you have to retouch it before you dare to share it with others? If there are no filters, no skin beautification, no face and body adjustments, you will feel that it is not you, and you don’t even want others to see you. Is this just a love of beauty, or is anxiety creeping in? In "Insight into People's Hearts through Dressing Up", Lin Cuifen starts from the behavior of retouching and points out that more and more people think that they are managing their image, but in fact, they may be falling into "appearance anxiety" step by step without knowing it.

After many friends around us take photos, they will say, "After I go back and fix the pictures, I will send you the "beautiful photos"." And we often look forward to seeing how our friends will process the photos to make their appearance even more beautiful. Lin Cuifen pointed out that photo retouching is actually a kind of "impression management" behavior. Try to retouch the photo to the image you want to present, such as making the eyes bigger, the body slimmer, the skin better, and the face smaller. On the one hand, you try to leave a good impression on others and improve others' evaluation of yourself. On the other hand, you also modify yourself according to social aesthetic standards, hoping to win positive feedback from others.

But if you care too much about your appearance in the eyes of others, you will easily become overly anxious and unable to bear your "imperfections" being seen. You will be too obsessed with retouching photos, and you will not be able to see people without retouching your photos. In the long run, not only may it affect your mental health, but if you are only confident in photos that have been edited, you will gradually become afraid to show your true colors to others. As a result, your self-confidence will be greatly reduced, and you will even become less confident.

title: 家裡常吵架可能和顏色有關？心理師提醒：這顏色別用太多
summary: 有些人一走進房間就渾身是戲，有些人卻總是安靜地待在角落，你有沒有想過，光看一個人最愛的顏色，就能猜出他是哪一種？甚至連家裡老是莫名起衝突，都可能跟顏色脫不了關係。專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從裝扮洞察人心》中指出，色彩可說是大自然的「溝通語言」，透過色彩的轉變，造物主告訴我們現在是什麼季節，姹紫嫣紅、百花盛開意味春天來臨，蒼鬱碧綠象徵夏天，飽滿的金橘色捎來秋天的訊息，白雪皚皚宣告冬天覆蓋大地。顏色還能提示人們果實是否成熟可食，我們的腦中彷彿有張「食物顏色對照表」，食物的顏色不對也會影響味覺，令人無法下嚥。大自然也藉由顏色讓我們知曉處於哪種地理環境，如綠色的山林、藍色的海洋，以便身體事前做好準備和調整。正因為色彩具有溝通的功能，每種色彩都有其象徵意義。看見紅色，會讓人直覺聯想到血液、心臟、夕陽、火燄、喜帖，這些事物又會引發危險、熱情、喜慶、爆發的感受。與色彩特質相似，熱愛紅色的人多半精力充沛、個性活潑、喜歡講話，期待被周遭親友看到自己的表現，有時卻因太過渴望「能見度」，讓別人飽受挑戰的威脅。這就是「色彩的象徵作用」，從對方喜歡的顏色，多少可以推測出他的人格特質。

title_en: Maybe the frequent quarrels at home are related to color? Psychologists remind: Don’t use too much of this color
summary_en: Some people get all excited when they walk into a room, while others always stay quietly in the corner. Have you ever thought that you can guess a person's favorite color just by looking at it? Even if there are always inexplicable conflicts at home, it may be related to color. Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insight into the Heart through Dressing Up" that color can be said to be the "communication language" of nature. Through the change of color, the Creator tells us what season it is now. Colorful purples and flowers in bloom signify the arrival of spring, lush green symbolizes summer, rich golden oranges bring the message of autumn, and white snow announces that winter is covering the earth. Color can also remind people whether the fruit is ripe and edible. We seem to have a "food color comparison chart" in our minds. The wrong color of food can also affect the taste and make it difficult to swallow. Nature also uses colors to let us know what geographical environment we are in, such as green mountains and blue oceans, so that the body can prepare and adjust in advance. Because color has the function of communication, each color has its own symbolic meaning. Seeing red makes people intuitively think of blood, heart, sunset, flames, and wedding invitations. These things can also trigger feelings of danger, enthusiasm, joy, and explosion. Similar to color traits, people who love red are mostly energetic, lively, and like to talk. They look forward to being seen by their relatives and friends around them, but sometimes they are too eager for "visibility" and threaten others with challenges. This is the "symbolic effect of color." From the color the other person likes, you can infer his or her personality traits.

title: 遺贈稅修正！遺產稅贈與稅分期30萬門檻取消，死亡前2年贈與「擬制遺產」額度可扣更多、受贈人依比例負擔
summary: 行政院長卓榮泰周四（7/30）院會上，拍板通過有「大老婆條款」之稱的《遺產及贈與稅法》（遺贈稅）修正草案。 修法草案明定，被繼承人死亡前2年贈與特定親屬（包含其配偶、各順序繼承人及其配偶）的財產（擬制遺產），受贈人須按比例成為納稅義務人，且負擔上限以其受贈財產價值為限，避免單一繼承人獨自承受全部稅務負擔。 此外修正也刪除原本遺贈稅應納稅額在30萬元以上，才能申請分期繳納的限制規定，未來不論稅額多寡，只要現金繳納有困難，均可申請分期繳納。

title: 女明星15年整型25次仍不滿意　割9次雙眼皮、隆鼻4次
summary:
專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從裝扮洞察人心》中指出，心理學形容這種狀況為「身體臆形症」（Body Dysmorphic Disorder），他們會執著於自己身體外觀的瑕疵或缺陷，但是在別人眼中卻無法察覺有什麼瑕疵。此外，他們對外表的擔心，也會讓他們做出一些重複性的行為，像是反覆照鏡子檢查、再三尋求保證，同時也會不斷跟別人比較自己的外貌。

舉例來說，有的人覺得自己的臉型歪歪的，為了遮蓋缺點，從來不在外人面前脫下口罩，幾乎沒有朋友看過他的真面目，凡是遇到要脫口罩的場合就緊張不安。也有人認為自己牙齒咬合不正會影響講話，人際互動時能不開口就不開口，從來不跟朋友出去吃飯，也不會跟朋友去旅行。

為了改變這樣的社交困境，他們往往會走上整型之路，試圖讓自己改頭換面。林萃芬指出，通常「整型上癮」的人並非身體真有什麼問題，而是極端在乎「想像中」的外表缺陷，或許在別人眼裡他們既正常又美麗，可是他們卻對自己的長相困擾不已，甚至苦惱到必須進行身體改造工程，並且怎麼修改都不滿意。

title_en: Female star has had 25 plastic surgeries in 15 years and is still not satisfied with it, including 9 double eyelid surgeries and 4 rhinoplasties.
summary_en:
Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insights into the Human Heart through Dressing Up" that psychology describes this condition as "Body Dysmorphic Disorder". They will be obsessed with the flaws or defects in their own body appearance, but they are unable to detect any flaws in the eyes of others. In addition, their worries about appearance will also cause them to engage in repetitive behaviors, such as repeatedly checking themselves in the mirror, seeking reassurance, and constantly comparing their appearance with others.

For example, some people feel that their face shape is crooked, and in order to cover their shortcomings, they never take off their masks in front of outsiders. Almost no friends have seen their true face, and they feel nervous whenever they are required to take off their masks. Some people think that the malocclusion of their teeth will affect their speech. They don't speak when they can't speak during interpersonal interactions. They never go out to eat with friends or travel with them.

In order to change this social dilemma, they often embark on the road of plastic surgery, trying to change themselves. Lin Cuifen pointed out that usually people who are addicted to plastic surgery do not have any real physical problems, but are extremely concerned about "imaginary" appearance defects. They may be normal and beautiful in the eyes of others, but they are troubled by their appearance, and are even distressed to the point of having to undergo body modification projects, and they are not satisfied no matter how they modify it.

summary: 全球科技股殺聲連連，不過封測龍頭日月光投控30日舉行法說會，釋出客戶強勁需求的訊號，先進封測營收目標上修至超過35億美元，並斥資120億元買下友達高雄路竹廠、乖乖中壢廠；和碩董事長童子賢出席活動時也提到，長期來看AI絕對不會泡沫，且台灣供應鏈已從晶片延伸至零組件，逐步形成護國群山，進一步深化應用將帶來健全的發展動能。

title: 台積熊本停工 周營收曝險1400萬美元
summary: 日本熊本縣於7月28日發生規模7.1強震，台積電位於熊本縣菊陽町的JASM晶圓廠測得震度5強，其中熊本二廠建廠工地29日復工，熊本一廠則積極復歸校正；市場高度關注災後復工狀況，研調機構DIGITIMES分析，由於JASM廠目前仍處於產能爬坡階段，實際月產能約2萬片，初步估算對台積電今年第3季營收影響僅約0.03％，對整體營收衝擊有限，不過地震引發的設備校正與後續餘震發展，將是產能能否順利全面恢復的最大變數。

title: 當菲爾茲獎照進清華園
summary: 今年7月，國際數學家大會在美國費城舉行，王虹與鄧煜同時獲頒菲爾茲獎，創下華人數學界 Important 的歷史紀錄。幾乎同一時間，諾貝爾化學獎得主 Omar Yaghi 正式加盟北京清華大學，投入材料科學與人工智慧的交叉研究。這兩項事件不僅是個人學術巔峰，更宣告全球科技博弈已跨越晶片代工與算力補貼的工程階段，進入「知識生產體系」的源頭對決。競逐焦點早已跨越單純的設備產能與應用開發，全面延伸至基礎科學、頂尖人才與知識體系的底層重塑。

title: Fed按兵不動 9月升息機率破5成
summary: 美國聯準會（Fed）29日宣布維持利率不變，但決策過程有3名官員投票支持升息，這凸顯面對連續5年高於目標的通膨率，Fed內部要求採取行動的壓力更勝以往。市場預估，9月升息的機率升高至57.4％。

title: 帳冊造假逃漏稅逾10億元 冠軍建材董娘遭判4年6月
summary: 知名磁磚公司「冠軍建材」副董事長王桂鳳涉嫌以9家人頭公司，隱蔽關係人交易且未在財報中揭露，且為逃漏稅造假12年的帳冊，逃漏個人綜合所得稅及旗下經銷商營業稅金額高達逾10億元，新北地院依違反《證券交易法》判處應執行4年6月徒刑，其中4年不得易科罰金，另併科罰金2000萬元。王桂鳳丈夫、曾任國民黨代理黨主席的董事長林榮德則因知情未報處2年徒刑，緩刑5年並應支付公庫2000萬元。可上訴。

title: 拿少繳多法官認不公 釋憲促修法
summary: 陳姓富商生前將3億元股票贈與妻子，但他死後妻子跟子女都拋棄繼承，只有非婚生女獨自繼承且要繳高額的5700萬元遺產稅，形成「拿得少，繳得多」的極度不公，提訴訟後，承審法官認為不公平聲請釋憲，民國113年憲法法庭認定《遺產及贈與稅法》欠缺明確規範，不符《憲法》保障平等權及財產權的意旨，判決部分違憲，要求2年內修法，這也促成了這次遺贈稅法修法。

title: 大老婆條款 防堵拋棄繼承漏洞
summary: 行政院會30日拍板《遺產及贈與稅法》修法草案，送立法院審議。新增「大老婆條款」，明定被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與配偶、各順序繼承人及其配偶的財產，應依受贈財產占遺產總額比例分擔遺產稅，以防堵藉由生前贈與規避遺產稅；配偶先拿到的財產，計算夫妻財產分配時也要計入，不能主張扣除。未來遺贈稅即使低於30萬元，也能申請分期給付。

title: 通膨疑慮 央行理事拋升息主張

summary_en:
So, how to minimize these distress and discomfort? In addition to adjusting lifestyle factors such as diet, nutrition, exercise, stress relief and sleep, are there any other effective methods? Many professional organizations and medical groups in the world that focus on the field of female menopause and menopause often review the latest medical research, integrate the suggestions of experts and scholars to form a consensus, formulate clinical treatment guidelines, and continuously update them with new research results. According to numerous medical literature, recommended guidelines, and the official statement revised in 2022 by the North American Menopause Society (NAMS), it is unanimously agreed that: for menopausal vasomotor symptoms and genitourinary tract-related symptoms, the most effective treatment method at present is hormone replacement therapy. The statement also noted that hormone replacement therapy not only effectively treats these symptoms but also prevents bone loss and fractures.

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has also approved hormone replacement therapy for the following situations: 1. As the treatment of choice for moderate to severe vasomotor symptoms of menopause; 2. To prevent postmenopausal osteoporosis; 3. title: 強制住院改由法院裁定 精神衛生法新制8月1日上路
summary: 「精神衛生法」重大修法即將正式上路，衛福部次長莊人祥表示，8月1日起，精神疾病嚴重病人的強制住院制度，將告別沿用多年的行政審查模式，改由法院裁定，並採「法官保留」原則，引進精神科醫師與病人權益代表共同參與的「專家參審」制度，期望在保障公共安全與醫療需求的同時，更進一步落實精神病人的人權保障。

title_en: Compulsory hospitalization will be decided by the court and the new mental health law will go into effect on August 1
summary_en: Major amendments to the Mental Health Law are about to be officially launched. Zhuang Renxiang, deputy minister of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, said that starting from August 1, the compulsory hospitalization system for patients with severe mental illness will bid farewell to the administrative review model that has been used for many years and will be decided by the courts. The principle of "judge reservation" will be adopted and the "expert participation" system will be introduced with the participation of psychiatrists and patient rights representatives. It is hoped that while ensuring public safety and medical needs, the human rights protection of mental patients will be further implemented.

title_en: Announcement on the postponement of Wengao rezoning to the end of the year Hou Youyi: The schedule of the Second Sports Center remains unchanged
summary_en: The New Taipei City Council is holding a municipal general inquiry today. New Taipei City Councilor Weng Zhenzhou pointed out that Xinzhuangwen Plateau is expected to announce a rezoning plan early this year and accept voluntary relocation before the middle of the year. However, the current schedule has been significantly delayed. Many people have already moved out of their homes, closed stores or moved their vehicles, and continue to suffer rent and business losses. He asked the city government to speed up the progress and confirmed that the Xinzhuang Second National Sports Center can still be completed in 2030 as scheduled.

title_en: Yongfeng Yuku Camellia Oil is reported to have exceeded the standard of benzene and pyrene. Chiayi County Health Bureau traces the flow of more than 2,000 kilograms to Yunlin
summary_en: Yongfeng Yu Biotechnology Co., Ltd. reported that Camellia Oil benzene and pyrene exceeded the standard. The Chiayi County Health Bureau received a notice from the Food and Drug Administration last night that the batch of Camellia Oil was produced by a Chiayi County OEM and exceeded the food safety and hygiene standards. The food safety response mechanism was activated that night, and the Food and Drug Administration went to the OEM to inspect, supervise the industry to check the flow of products, implement removal from shelves and related control measures, and prevent the continued circulation of problematic products.

title_en: The number of prostate cancer cases increases by 9,000 every year. Shi Chongliang: Propose a publicly funded screening program by the end of this year and hope to launch it next year
summary_en: Prostate cancer is the third most common cancer in men and the fifth most common cancer in mortality. There are about 9,000 new cases every year. Legislator Liao Weixiang said at the Legislative Yuan today that he had advocated publicly funded prostate cancer screening in the past and hoped that it could be passed as a gift to all men before Father's Day on August 8 this year. Minister of Health and Welfare Shi Chongliang said that it is currently under planning and needs to be budgeted, and he hopes to promote the implementation of prostate cancer into publicly funded screening next year.

title: 電子煙披時尚外衣誘少年 屏東縣衛生局：賣菸給未滿20歲最高罰25萬
summary: 近年菸商常以「減害」或「時尚」等方式包裝電子煙、加熱菸等新興菸品吸引青少年，成為菸害防制隱憂。屏東縣政府衛生局提醒，根據菸害防制法規定，全面禁電子煙等類菸品製造、輸入、販賣、供應、展示、廣告及使用。任何人不得販售、供應或提供菸品給未滿20歲青少年。呼籲商家落實「疑似未滿20歲者，先查驗證件」之責任，違者依法最高可處25萬元罰鍰。

title_en: E-cigarettes are used to lure teenagers in fashionable clothes. Pingtung County Health Bureau: Selling cigarettes to under 20 years old can be fined up to 250,000 yuan.
summary_en: In recent years, cigarette dealers have often packaged emerging tobacco products such as e-cigarettes and heated cigarettes in "harm reduction" or "fashionable" ways to attract young people, which has become a hidden concern in tobacco harm prevention. The Pingtung County Government Health Bureau reminds that in accordance with the Tobacco Harm Prevention Law, the manufacture, import, sale, supply, display, advertising and use of e-cigarettes and other tobacco products are completely prohibited. No one is allowed to sell, supply or provide cigarettes to young people under the age of 20. Merchants are called on to fulfill their responsibility of "checking identification documents of those suspected to be under 20 years old". Violators may be fined up to NT$250,000 in accordance with the law.

title_en: Tainan strengthens food safety control Huang Weizheyun establishes benzene and pyrene inspection capabilities and expands oil product sampling
summary_en: Zoomlion Oil and Fat's excessive benzene and pyrene caused concern from all walks of life on the safety of edible oils. Tainan City Councilors asked the city government to increase the inspection capacity and establish an independent laboratory to test benzene and pyrene. The Health Bureau initially estimated that more than 10 million yuan would be invested in the equipment construction, and the annual maintenance fee would be about 300 yuan. Ten thousand yuan, the Health Bureau stated that the first line of defense is still independent management by the industry. The city government will strengthen the inspection of large oil product manufacturers, expand oil product sampling projects, and establish a food flow tracking and drill mechanism; Mayor Huang Weizhe promised to establish the ability to test benzopyrene equipment.

Liang Wenjie, deputy chairman and spokesperson of the Mainland Affairs Council, responded on the 30th that the Mainland Affairs Council roughly knew the situation in early July, but the family members did not complain to the SEF or the Mainland Affairs Council. However, the Mainland Affairs Council will continue to pay attention to the case and respect the wishes of the family members and will not disclose to the outside the matters or personal privacy that the family members do not want to disclose. Regarding Xie Longjie's suspicion that the Mainland Affairs Council had "covered the cards", Liang Wenjie said that this was inconsistent with the facts.

title_en: The Fed remains on hold; investment credit: short-term negative news superimposes, AI development trend remains unchanged
summary_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve held an FOMC meeting on the 29th. Chairman Washer's neutral-to-dovish remarks combined with the differences in the attitudes of internal officials made investors question the Fed's determination to suppress inflation. All three major U.S. stock indexes ended up falling by more than 1%; the U.S. 10-year Treasury bond yield once jumped to 4.69%. This time, voices of disagreement within the FOMC have increased, coupled with the continued upward pressure on inflation, the market expects the possibility of the Federal Reserve raising interest rates before the end of the year. KGI believes that raising interest rates will indeed bring fluctuations to the financial market, but it will not significantly affect the upward trend of the stock market.

title: AI履歷像複製貼上！ 求職者海量投 HR狂刪檔：全都長一樣
summary: AI不只改變工作模式，也正在重塑企業徵才與求職流程。愈來愈多求職者利用AI工具大量投遞履歷，企業則因申請量暴增而轉向AI協助篩選，形成雙方都依賴自動化的現象。招聘軟體平台Greenhouse執行長Daniel Chait將此形容為「AI末日循環（AI doom loop）」，直言當求職與招聘都交由AI處理，最終反而讓整個徵才系統變得更沒有效率。

title_en: To combat China’s low-price dumping, scholars suggest canceling the tax exemption for small-value parcels. Ministry of Finance: Careful consideration
summary_en: Thanks to AI, Taiwan's economic growth has been record-breaking in recent years, but the performance of traditional industries other than AI has been weak. Scholars suggested at a Legislative Yuan public hearing today that the government should help traditional industries fight China's low-price dumping, cancel tax exemptions for small packages, and help traditional industries enter the international non-red supply chain. In response, Deputy Finance Minister Ruan Qinghua responded that the United States has recently canceled the European Union due to some sequelae. Whether Taiwan should follow suit will pay attention to the practices of international countries and carefully consider it.

summary_en: The AI ​​wave not only drives the demand for chips, but also begins to promote the rapid growth of the semiconductor smart logistics market. Chen Songlin, senior manager of the Intelligent Handling Division of China Optoelectronics Intelligent Robot Company, a subsidiary of China Optoelectronics, said today that the company has actively deployed intelligent mobile vehicles (AMRs) and intelligent forklifts in recent years, and has entered the automated chemical warehousing system of domestic wafer factories, advanced packaging plants and semiconductor supply chains. The applications cover chemical warehousing, inter-production line transportation and third-party logistics. Thanks to the continued expansion of semiconductor production driven by AI, the current demand for smart logistics has increased by about 30% compared with the same period last year, and the visibility of project orders has been extended to three years later.

title_en: After the inheritance tax law is revised, Zicheng calls on family businesses to first take stock of the five key inheritance points
summary_en: On the 30th, the Executive Yuan passed a draft amendment to some provisions of the "Inheritance and Gift Tax Act" to adjust the taxation mechanism for property donated to specific relatives (fictitious inheritance) within two years before death. Zicheng pointed out that although this revision of the law did not increase the inheritance tax rate, nor did it change the principle that the proposed inheritance must be included in the total amount of inheritance for taxation, the readjustment of the tax burden objects will affect the inheritance of family business equity and the wealth inheritance planning of high-asset families. It is recommended to take stock of the five major inheritance priorities as soon as possible.

title: 導入 AI 卻看不到成效？資誠點出台灣企業三大痛點
summary: AI導入不再只是追求省人力、降成本，更重要的是能否真正帶動營收成長、提升獲利。資誠創新諮詢公司（PwC Taiwan）表示，不少企業雖已開始導入AI，但仍面臨投資效益難以量化、應用分散、跨部門協作不足等問題，AI轉型也正從概念驗證（PoC）邁向規模化落地（Scale-up）的關鍵階段。
title_zh: 導入 AI 卻看不到成效？資誠點出台灣企業三大痛點

title_en: Importing AI but not seeing results? Zicheng points out three major pain points for Taiwanese companies
summary_en: The introduction of AI is no longer just about saving manpower and reducing costs, but more importantly, whether it can truly drive revenue growth and improve profits. PwC Taiwan said that although many companies have begun to introduce AI, they still face problems such as difficulty in quantifying investment benefits, scattered applications, and insufficient cross-department collaboration. AI transformation is also moving from proof of concept (PoC) to a critical stage of scale-up.

title_en: The new high-speed rail car officially leaves the factory. Shi Zhe announced that it will be officially put into operation on July 1 next year.
summary_en: Taiwan's new high-speed rail train was officially unveiled today (30th). Chairman Shi Zhe pointed out that after the first train officially leaves the factory today, it will be shipped from Kasado Port and is expected to arrive at Kaohsiung Port, Taiwan, on August 15. A series of static and dynamic tests will immediately begin. If all goes well, it will be officially launched on July 1, 2027. Taiwan High Speed ​​Rail and the Hitachi-Toshiba Alliance held the "Taiwan High Speed ​​Rail New Generation Train N700ST Factory Delivery Ceremony" at the Hitachi Kasado Factory in Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan today. Transportation Minister Chen Shikai also went to Japan to participate with the convening committee of the Legislative Yuan Transportation Committee.

title_en: Big wife terms finalized! The Political Yuan passed the amendment to the inheritance tax law, and the property donated in the two years before death will be taxed on a proportional basis.
summary_en: The Ministry of Finance has prepared a draft amendment to some provisions of the "Inheritance and Gift Tax Law", which was approved by the Executive Yuan on the 30th. Known as the "eldest wife clause" in the outside world, the provisions stipulate that for property donated to specific relatives two years before death, the recipients should bear a certain amount of inheritance tax based on the proportion of the donated property to the total estate.

summary_en: Traveling to Japan and South Korea with Chinese people has become a daily consumption routine. Since the beginning of this year, operators including Throne (2751), Tsukama (7723), Xiangjiguang (7418), and Catering have accelerated their distribution of Japanese and Korean brands. Brands ranging from eel rice, roasted birds, Korean hot pots to roasted pork have been launched one after another. Many of the new brands are expected to open in the second half of the year, reflecting the industry's focus on the tourism experience to drive brand awareness, hoping to convert overseas popularity into domestic consumption power, and seize business opportunities among young people and department stores.

title_en: Global Crystal suffered a huge loss of 8.27 yuan in June, and the stock price jumped directly to the limit, causing all silicon wafers to collapse.
summary_en: Global Crystal (6488) announced on the 29th that its net loss per share in June reached 8.27 yuan. The share price of its German holding Siltronic fell by more than 20% at the end of June from the previous month, giving up part of the previously recognized evaluation benefits, thus affecting the pre-tax profit and loss and net income per share performance in June. Global Crystal stated that the industry's profits have grown steadily, emphasizing that the above-mentioned evaluation losses have nothing to do with cash flow and will not affect the industry's operating conditions. However, Global Crystal's stock price still jumped to a limit of 778 yuan on the 30th. Other silicon wafer groups such as Hejing Crystal (6182) and Taiwan Sembcorp (3532) also fell to their limit. Sino-American Crystal (5483) fell more than 7% during the session.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zeng Renkai, Taipei, 30th) The U.S. Federal Reserve decided to keep interest rates on hold, but three officials voted against it and advocated raising interest rates. This was interpreted by the market as the rise of hawks, and all four major U.S. stock indexes closed in the black. Taiwan stocks fell 3,595.01 points in the past two trading days. title: 小資男滾房術1／重大建設還沒蓋就先買　他靠都計圖卡位店面3年增值25％
summary: 陳冠允27歲時掏出僅有的20萬元積蓄，再向家人借20萬元，在桃園平鎮買下人生第一間房子，滾房至今，他坐擁1店3宅、市值達9,000萬元。許多人買房靠感覺，但他靠的是一張都市計畫圖。3年前小檜溪重劃區仍是荒地，他從都計圖嗅到麥當勞、星巴克確定進駐，以2,800萬元買進預售店面，如今增值達3,500萬元，「投資要早一步嗅到人潮在哪裡。」他說。

title_en: Petty bourgeoisie man's house rolling technique 1/Buy a major building before it is built. He relies on the city's plan to increase the value of the store by 25% in 3 years.
summary_en: When Chen Guanyun was 27 years old, he took out his only 200,000 yuan in savings and borrowed another 200,000 yuan from his family to buy his first house in Pingzhen, Taoyuan. Since then, he has owned a shop and three houses with a market value of 90 million yuan. Many people rely on their feelings when buying a house, but he relied on a city plan. Three years ago, the rezoning area of ​​Little Huixi was still a wasteland. He sensed from the city plan that McDonald's and Starbucks were determined to move in, and bought a pre-sale store for 28 million yuan. Now the value has increased to 35 million yuan. "Investing requires you to smell where the crowds are early," he said.

title_en: The petty bourgeoisie man’s house-moving technique 2/Monthly rent of 24,000 is actually more profitable than 28,000. Real estate experts reveal the most expensive cost of short-term renting
summary_en: When Chen Guanyun was 27 years old, he had a monthly salary of 42,000 yuan. With 200,000 yuan of self-prepared funds and a loan of 200,000 yuan from his family, he bought his first Pingzhen house with a total price of 2.4 million yuan to collect rent. The higher the rent, the better, but if you have to bear the risk of vacant rent, can you really make more money?" Chen Guanyun kept the market price and reduced the vacant lease period. "The more people come to ask for rent, I can filter out more stable and good tenants." He said.

title_en: Petty bourgeoisie man's house-moving skills 3/200,000 yuan, he moved out of a shop and three houses. He looks at 50 houses every week: When buying a house, think about who will take over it.
summary_en: In order to pursue a low total price or a high return on investment, new investors often choose remote peripheral areas, but fall into the "liquidity trap". They seem cheap but are not easy to rent or sell, and their funds are stuck. Real estate expert Chen Guanyun believes that real estate investment should not only look at the return on investment rate, but should target core business districts with a concentrated population and stable rental and purchase demand. And he looks at at least 50 houses every week. "When buying a house, you must think about who will rent with you? Who will buy with you?" Chen Guanyun mastered liquidity, switching from second-hand houses to pre-sale houses, and then bought storefronts. With one store and three houses, the market value of real estate has accumulated to 90 million yuan.

title: 華爾街力挺加密永續合約 美國監管立場現轉機

title: 加密貨幣基金經理逃稅判囚三年 須賠償逾 340 萬美元
summary: 商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導一名加密貨幣對沖基金經理人因逃稅，昨日在美國德州被判處三年徒刑，並須支付約 340 萬美元（約新台幣 1.1 億元）的賠償金。 這名基金經理人於 2020 年至 2022 年間，透過管理 Translunar Crypto LP 基金賺取至少 700 萬美元的收入，卻未向美國稅務機關申報任何所得。為了規避美國稅務責任，該經理人於 2022 年 3 月放棄美國公民身份，並遷居至避稅天堂開曼群島。 他向美國國家稅務局（IRS）提交了一份虛假聲明，謊報淨資產僅 2.5 萬美元，實際卻逾 200 萬美元。此外，他還宣稱已遵守美國過去五年的納稅義務，但此說法亦不實。當局進一步指控，該基金經理人於 2023 年出售科羅拉多州的一處房產，同樣未申報所得。 今年稍早，這名基金經理人已對一項逃稅罪名認罪。除 37 個月的監禁外，他還將面臨三年監管釋放，並被勒令支付約 340 萬美元的賠償金。此案再次突顯加密貨幣領域的稅務合規重要性，提醒投資者應留意相關法規。 【提醒您】 加密資產價格波動劇烈，本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議

summary: 【財訊快報／記者戴海茜報導】倉和(6538)受惠全球太陽能供應鏈正逐步朝中國以外地區擴產，倉和除已供貨韓系太陽能製造業者外，也切入美國本土客戶供應鏈，市場聚焦非中國太陽能供應鏈以及營收走高題材下，今天股價盤中大漲一度攻頂。倉和自結6月營收為1.36億元，月增12.21%，年增46.5%；累計上半年營收為6.97億元，年減14.73%，年減幅度逐漸收斂。倉和為太陽能精密網版製造與網印耗材買賣的台灣龍頭廠商，受惠於非中供應鏈重組、美國與印度等市場推動在地太陽能製造，以及高精密網版在次世代電池與高階印刷應用上的需求提升。倉和第一季中國與非中國市場營收占比已接近5比5，預期今年下半年非中國市場占比可望正式超越中國市場，營運上也有機會優於上半年。倉和持續發展非編織網版與次世代產品，將技術基礎延伸至智慧穿戴裝置與柔性RF模組等方向。

title: 紐約聯準銀行：美國高評級公司債市場運作失能達近三年高點
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜方承業／綜合外電報導根據《Crypto Briefing》報導，紐約聯邦儲備銀行（New York Federal Reserve）發布的報告指出，美國高評級公司債市場的運作失能狀況已升至近三年來最高點。這項數據來自紐約聯準銀行於 2022 年 6 月推出的「公司債市場壓力指數」（Corporate Bond Market Distress Index, CMDI），該指數旨在評估投資級信用債市場的運作健康狀況。 報告顯示，在今年 7 月份，CMDI 的投資級子指數飆升至 2023 年 11 月以來的最高水準。當該指數攀升時，通常意味著市場交易成本更高、流動性（資產轉換為現金的速度與難易度）降低，以及價格發現過程變得混亂，即買賣雙方難以確定合理的交易價格。歷史經驗表明，核心固定收益市場的失能往往預示著市場風險情緒將出現更廣泛的轉變。 分析指出，當機構投資者在最安全的資產類別（例如投資級債券）中面臨流動性困境時，他們通常會傾向於減少市場曝險並囤積現金。此外，晚近 7 月份固定收益市場的普遍波動，也可能間接影響穩定幣生態系統。因為許多主要穩定幣發行商，其儲備資產中包含

title_en: Multiple killings and multiple selling pressure emerge, Taiwan stock market national team urgently rescues
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market was under heavy selling pressure yesterday (29th), and the index opened lower. It once plunged more than 2,200 points and fell below 40,000 points to 39,384 points. Under the confident words of Finance Minister Zhuang Cuiyun, the national team's protective silver bullet came into the market to boost the market, and short-term buying appeared. summary_en: U.S. President Trump has banned the import of new robots and inverters produced in mainland China on the grounds of national security. title: 美國中西部降雨預期壓抑，CBOT黃豆期約週三挫2.23%、玉米跌1.82%
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】芝加哥期貨交易所(CBOT)黃豆與玉米期約週三同步收低，因天氣預報顯示美國中西部種植區本週後段可望迎來降雨，有利正進入關鍵生長階段的作物；小麥則在黑海出口受阻與全球供應充裕兩股力量拉鋸下小幅下跌。交投最活躍黃豆期約收跌27.25美分或2.23%，報每英斗11.9275美元；玉米期約跌8.75美分或1.82%，收報每英斗4.7175美元。Hightower Report分析師普萊斯(Randy Place)表示，黃豆正進入結莢階段，本週預測降雨正是作物目前所需，因而削弱市場的天氣風險溢價。交投最活躍小麥期約跌1.75美分或0.26%，收報每英斗6.6075美元。俄羅斯與烏克蘭持續攻擊黑海地區船舶及港口基礎設施，三座俄羅斯主要穀物碼頭因航運風險升高限制卡車送貨，一度為小麥價格提供支撐。此外，俄羅斯亞速海穀物出口樞紐塔甘羅格(Taganrog)遭飛彈攻擊，進一步凸顯區內供應鏈風險。不過，全球小麥供應仍然充裕，加上主要產區收割接近尾聲，抵消黑海供應疑慮，令小麥期約最終無力翻紅。

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，紫金黃金(Zijin Gold International Co)收購加拿大Allied Gold Corp的交易正式告吹。紫金黃金這家中國礦業公司將不再推動收購，而是改為向這家專注於非洲金礦開發的黃金生產商投資約2.95億美元。兩家公司週三分別發布聲明指稱，紫金黃金和Allied Gold已終止這筆交易，雙方認為，在7月29日截止日期前，「沒有合理可能性」滿足完成這筆交易所需的全部交割條件。這筆交易規模達55億加幣(39億美元)。雖然收購已獲得加拿大批准，但尚未取得中國方面的審批。此次交易未能成功，意味著原本將成為中國投資者收購加拿大礦業公司的最大交易之一的計畫最終未能成行。此前，在地緣政治緊張局勢加劇、金屬市場波動以及中國對企業境外投資審查趨嚴等不利因素影響下，這筆收購的截止期限已延長過一次。根據新的協議，紫金黃金將以每股32.55加幣的價格認購Allied Gold 1,280萬股股份，較週二收盤價溢價10%。兩家公司表示，交易完成後，紫金黃金將持有Allied Gold約9.2%的已發行普通股。

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電引述英國金融時報的報導指稱，英國央行正在評估在倫敦營運的投資銀行對亞洲股票的風險部位，以降低與少數人工智能相關公司有關的集中度風險。英國金融時報週三引述知情人士的消息指稱，監管機構正在評估銀行如何透過英國業務，為對沖基金及其他機構的亞洲投資提供融資。受人工智能熱潮推動，少數亞洲公司吸引了大量對沖基金資金流入，其中包括韓國的SK海力士和台灣的台積電。報導引述知情人士的消息指稱，對部分銀行而言，亞洲地區對這類融資業務的收入貢獻可能超過歐洲。對於上消息，英國央行不予置評。

title_en: The manufacturing industry has not reaped the benefits of AI, and business opportunities are still concentrated in specific industries.
summary_en: AI and semiconductors have supported Taiwan's economic growth. However, according to the latest survey by the China Economic and Technological Research Institute, less than 20% of the manufacturing industry has entered the semiconductor supply chain, while non-manufacturing industries mainly take on business opportunities through logistics, engineering and professional services. This shows that AI dividends have not yet spilled over to other industries and are still concentrated in specific supply chains. There is still some distance to form a comprehensive industrial boom cycle.

title: 國發會：全球經濟有三隱憂
summary: 台灣經濟受惠AI浪潮，出口、生產與投資動能持續升溫，但全球景氣前景仍有不少暗礁。國發會最新「當前經濟情勢」分析指出，儘管AI、高效能運算及雲端基礎建設需求持續攀升，全球經濟仍面臨中東衝突、貿易政策不確定性及金融市場波動等三大隱憂，後續發展須密切關注。

title_en: National Development Council: There are three hidden worries about the global economy
summary_en: Taiwan's economy has benefited from the AI ​​wave, and its exports, production and investment momentum have continued to increase. However, there are still many hidden dangers in the global economic outlook. The National Development Council's latest "Current Economic Situation" analysis points out that although the demand for AI, high-performance computing and cloud infrastructure continues to rise, the global economy still faces three major hidden worries, including conflict in the Middle East, trade policy uncertainty and financial market fluctuations, and subsequent developments must be paid close attention to.

title_en: Qualcomm's Q3 profit is in line with expectations, Q4 outlook is conservative, and stock price fell more than 4% on Wednesday
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that Qualcomm Inc, the world's largest smartphone processor manufacturer, released its third-quarter financial report. The results showed that the profit per share for the quarter was in line with expectations. However, the company's profit outlook for the fourth quarter of the year was relatively conservative compared with analysts' opinions, indicating that component shortages and rising costs are impacting its major markets. In regular trading on Wednesday, Qualcomm (QCOM US) shares fell 4.42% to US$155.68. In later after-hours trading, the stock price fell further by 4.67%. According to the financial report, in the third quarter of the year ended June 28, earnings per share after excluding some items were $2.21. Revenue fell 4% in the quarter to about $9.95 billion. Analysts had expected earnings of $2.21 per share and revenue of $9.62 billion. Qualcomm's mobile phone-related business revenue in the third quarter of the year was US$5.1 billion. Networked equipment business revenue was US$1.83 billion, and the automotive electronics business contributed US$1.59 billion. At the same time, Qualcomm said that the growth rate of non-mobile phone business revenue will accelerate from 24% to 60% in fiscal year 2027. In addition, Qualcomm said in a statement on Wednesday that in the fourth quarter of the year ending in September, earnings per share after excluding some items are expected to be $2.05 to $2.25. Even if it reaches the upper end of the range, it would be below analysts' average forecast. Revenue is expected to be $9.7 billion to $10.5 billion, compared with analysts' average estimate of $9.95 billion. The downturn in the smartphone market has had a greater impact on Qualcomm than expected. Qualcomm Aspects

title_en: The short-term ceasefire between the United States and Iran breaks, Trump threatens to "fight hard", and the United States and Saudi Arabia jointly launch air strikes on Iraq
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that U.S. President Donald Trump said on Wednesday that the United States would retaliate forcefully against Iran after Iran once again attacked U.S. troops in Jordan, meaning that the brief cessation of mutual attacks between the United States and Iran since the weekend has officially broken down, and the war in the Middle East has escalated again. In a phone interview with Fox News, Trump said that the United States would "hit Iran hard" and Iran would suffer a heavy blow, but at the same time claimed that it would continue to participate in negotiations. Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claimed that it had launched multiple ballistic missiles at a US air force base and military center in Jordan in response to US military operations; the US military said it intercepted multiple incoming missiles. Iranian state-run media also stated that the United States attacked a location in Iran's West Asian province of Zerbaijan, indicating that the military operations between the two sides have quickly shifted from a brief ceasefire to direct exchange of fire. The United States and Saudi Arabia also jointly launched air strikes against armed groups supported by Tehran in Iraq. This was the first time that Saudi Arabia publicly participated in the US military's attack on an Iranian ally. The "Popular Mobilization Forces" of Iraq's Shia militia alliance said that the air strike killed at least 20 members; Iranian semi-official media said that another four members of the Revolutionary Guards were killed in an attack near Karbala. Before the U.S. and Saudi Arabia took action, Saudi Arabia stated that it had continuously intercepted drones launched by Iraqi armed groups and targeted its oil facilities. The standoff in the Strait of Hormuz has also continued to worsen, and Iran has rejected Oman’s regional joint management plan. The Revolutionary Guards Navy claimed on Wednesday that it had attacked and forced three oil tankers to stop traveling on "unsafe and illegal routes".

title: 再融資與購屋貸款需求減弱，美國最新一週MBA貸款申請指數下跌6.4%
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，最新一週衡量美國抵押貸款申請的指標下跌，未能延續此前一週上揚升勢，因再融資與購屋貸款需求下滑。美國抵押貸款銀行協會(MBA, Mortgage Bankers Association)公佈的數據顯示，衡量截至7月24日止當週再融資與購屋抵押貸款需求的MBA貸款申請指數較前一週下跌6.4%，報247.2點。根據MBA數據，上週再融資抵押貸款申請分項指數下滑9.9%，報723.1點；購屋抵押貸款申請分項指數則是下跌3.6%，報159.8點。上週30年期固定抵押貸款利率由前一週6.69%，向上升至6.76%的水準。15年期固定抵押貸款平均利率則是由前一週的6.04%，向上升至6.15%的水準。上週再融資貸款申請占總申請的比例為39.5%，前一週為41.2%。MBA自1990年以來按週進行該項調查，調查涵蓋了美國逾75%的零售住宅抵押貸款申請。

title_en: Demand for refinancing and home purchase loans weakened, and the U.S. MBA loan application index fell 6.4% in the latest week
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that newly released data showed that an indicator measuring U.S. mortgage loan applications fell in the latest week, failing to extend the upward trend from the previous week due to a decline in demand for refinancing and home purchase loans. Data released by the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) showed that the MBA loan application index, which measures demand for refinancing and home purchase mortgages in the week ending July 24, fell 6.4% from the previous week to 247.2 points. According to MBA data, the refinancing mortgage application sub-index fell 9.9% last week to 723.1 points; the home purchase mortgage application sub-index fell 3.6% to 159.8 points. The 30-year fixed mortgage rate rose to 6.76% last week from 6.69% the previous week. The average interest rate for 15-year fixed mortgages rose to 6.15% from 6.04% the previous week. Refinancing loan applications accounted for 39.5% of total applications last week, compared with 41.2% the previous week. MBA has conducted the survey on a weekly basis since 1990 and covers more than 75% of retail residential mortgage applications in the United States.

title: 美國保障供應鏈安全，撥款8.74億美元助七家企業研發晶片
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，美國商務部在一份聲明中表示，將與七家公司簽署意向書，依據《晶片與科學法案》提供8.74億美元的聯邦激勵資金。作為提供資金的交換，美國政府將持有每家公司少數、非控股股權。這筆資金將用於支持美國國內相關技術，以「大幅提升全球最快電腦的性能」，保障本土供應鏈安全，並鞏固美國在電腦產業供應鏈中的領先地位。格羅方德(GlobalFoundries)將獲得最高3億美元資金，Kepler最高獲得2.45億美元，Multibeam Corporation最高獲得1.4億美元，Extropic最高獲得7,500萬美元。其他獲得支持的公司包括Thintronics、OBSIDIA Semiconductors和Aeluma。

title_en: The United States ensures supply chain security and allocates US$874 million to help seven companies develop chips
summary_en: [Financial News/Liu Minfu] Foreign reports pointed out that the U.S. Department of Commerce said in a statement that it would sign letters of intent with seven companies to provide $874 million in federal incentive funds under the Chip and Science Act. In exchange for providing the funds, the U.S. government will take a minority, non-controlling stake in each company. The funds will be used to support related domestic technologies in the United States to "significantly improve the performance of the world's fastest computers," ensure the security of the local supply chain, and consolidate the United States' leading position in the computer industry supply chain. GlobalFoundries will receive up to $300 million, Kepler will receive up to $245 million, Multibeam Corporation will receive up to $140 million, and Extropic will receive up to $75 million. Other companies receiving support include Thintronics, OBSIDIA Semiconductors and Aeluma.

title_en: Ancheng Biotechnology AC-203 delivered a keynote speech at the U.S. DCC Annual Meeting, and international pharmaceutical companies actively promoted authorization negotiations.
summary_en: [Financial News/Reporter He Meiru] AC Biotechnology (6610) announced that its new drug candidate AC-203 for the treatment of epidermolysis bullosa simplex (EBS) will publish the latest progress of the global pivotal EBShield phase II/III clinical trial at the 2026 DEBRA Care Conference (DCC). As global clinical development enters the final stage, Ancheng Biotechnology has simultaneously promoted AC-203 regulatory application preparation, global commercial authorization and pre-market market layout, making steady progress towards the goal of commercialization. The DEBRA Care Conference is held every two years by DEBRA of America, an organization for patients with EB. It is the most representative international exchange platform in the global EB field. This conference attracted more than 800 patients, dermatologists, research institutions, representatives of international pharmaceutical companies and biotech companies to participate, including Abeona Therapeutics, Krystal Biotech, Chiesi and LEO Pharma and other important global companies in the EB field attended the exchange. This year, Ancheng Biotechnology once again participated in DCC and set up a display booth to conduct in-depth exchanges with patients, medical experts, international opinion leaders (KOLs) and potential partners, and continue to enhance the visibility of AC-203 in the global EB community and medical community. From the Department of Dermatology, Stanford University School of Medicine, USA

title_en: The Fed is on hold and the selling pressure on AI stocks has not stopped! U.S. stocks plummet, TSMC ADR drops 4.48%
summary_en: After the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) decided to keep interest rates unchanged, Wall Street's major stock indexes closed sharply lower on Wednesday (29th). Before technology giants such as Microsoft and Meta released their latest quarterly reports, artificial intelligence (AI) stocks continued to experience selling pressure. title: 鳳凰攜手漢莎航空推動永續航空燃料，落實ESG永續旅遊

summary: 美國總統川普以國家安全為由，禁止中國大陸產製的新型機器人、逆變器進口，業界人士指出，美國太陽能逆變器市場規模每年高達上千億元，陸系產品銷美受阻，台灣業者將迎來轉單商機。其中，旭隼、全漢逆變器營收占比相對高，可望成為大贏家，台達電、亞力也沾光。

title: 聯電：AI需求未見放緩跡象 預期Q3晶圓出貨高個位數成長
summary: 晶圓代工大廠聯電昨（29）日召開法說會，釋出對下半年營運樂觀的展望，預估本季晶圓出貨量將較第2季成長高個位數百分比，產能利用率可望突破90%，毛利率維持30%中位數水準；強調目前40奈米及FinFET等製程需求依舊強勁，尚未看到AI需求放緩跡象。

title: ODM廠募資...一波波
summary: 代工廠廣達宣布發行22億美元海外存託憑證（GDR），確保採購零組件及建廠資金。看好AI與美國製造的趨勢，近期ODM紛紛啟動募資。今年鴻海領跑，完成360億元的永續連結聯貸案；緯穎今年在股東會也通過新籌資方案，後續有機會募得超過700億元資金。

title: 中東戰火再起推升國際油價　布倫特站上每桶90美元
summary: （中央社紐約29日綜合外電報導）美國與伊朗的軍事衝突先前似乎轉向外交途徑解決，如今又恢復戰火，引起市場擔憂原油供應中斷，使國際油價今天反彈飆漲。

title_en: Renewed war in the Middle East pushes up international oil prices; Brent reaches US$90 per barrel
summary_en: (Central News Agency, New York, Comprehensive Foreign News Report on the 29th) The military conflict between the United States and Iran, which previously seemed to turn to diplomatic solutions, has now resumed fighting, causing market concerns about crude oil supply interruptions, causing international oil prices to rebound and surge today.

title: 銀行打詐 警示帳戶糾紛暴增
summary: 銀行加強打詐，導致「違反自動化服務規範爭議」成為銀行業金融消費爭議首位，光是今年第一季就有二四三件，超越過去「信用卡消費爭議」長期居首位的情形。而所謂的「違反自動化服務規範爭議」，可能的情形包括遭列警示帳戶，使得自動扣繳存匯款失敗，而進行申訴。

title_en: Bank fraud warning: account disputes surge
summary_en: Banks have intensified their efforts to combat fraud, causing "disputes over violation of automated service standards" to top the list of financial consumer disputes in the banking industry. In the first quarter of this year alone, there were 243 cases, surpassing the long-term ranking of "credit card consumer disputes" in the past. As for the so-called "disputes over violations of automated service standards", possible situations include an account being listed as a warning, causing the automatic withholding of deposits and remittances to fail, and filing an appeal.

title: 台股重災區 主動式ETF慘摔
summary: 台股連日下跌，主動式ＥＴＦ（指數股票型基金）迎來嚴酷的一日壓力測試。加權指數昨單日又重挫超過一千五百點，盤中一度跌破四萬點大關，跌幅百分之三點七六；值得注意的是，近一年被市場追捧的台股主動式ＥＴＦ，廿一檔中有廿檔同步重摔，單日平均跌幅將近六個百分點，成為昨日股市重災區。

title_en: Taiwan stock market hit hardest, active ETFs plummet
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have been falling for days, and active ETFs (index stock funds) are facing a harsh one-day stress test. The weighted index fell again by more than 1,500 points in a single day yesterday, once falling below the 40,000-point mark during the session, with a drop of 3.76%. It is worth noting that 20 of the 21 stocks of Taiwan stock active ETFs that have been sought after by the market in the past year fell simultaneously, with an average single-day drop of nearly 6 percentage points, becoming the hardest hit area for yesterday's stock market.

title: 觀察站／失速下跌…台股帳面縮水 一堂昂貴求生課
summary: 台股七月呈現史上罕見急跌行情，單月累積跌點超過六千點，創下最大單月跌點紀錄，更在短短一個月內四度單日重挫逾千點，市場幾乎是以搭電梯速度下滑，投資人情緒從年初的樂觀迅速轉為恐慌。

title_en: Observation Station/Stalling decline...Taiwan stocks’ book balance has shrunk, an expensive survival lesson
summary_en: Taiwan's stock market experienced a rare sharp decline in history in July, with a cumulative drop of more than 6,000 points in a single month, setting a record for the largest monthly drop. In just one month, it fell more than 1,000 points in a single day four times. The market fell almost at an elevator speed, and investor sentiment quickly turned from optimism at the beginning of the year to panic.

title: 台韓重災！亞股大逃殺 追繳令狂發
summary: 亞洲股市昨天再現「大逃殺」，台灣、南韓成為重災區。南韓KOSPI指數盤中再度觸發熔斷，終場重挫百分之六；台股盤中一度跌破四萬點，終場跌勢雖稍微收斂，仍大跌一五六四點，收在四萬零三九點，寫下史上第七大跌點，成交值一點○八兆元。

title_en: Severe disaster in Taiwan and South Korea! Asian stocks battle royale, demand orders issued wildly
summary_en: Asian stock markets experienced a "Battle Royale" yesterday, with Taiwan and South Korea becoming the hardest hit areas. South Korea's KOSPI index triggered a circuit breaker again during the session and ended up plunging 6%; Taiwan's stock market once fell below 40,000 points during the session. Although the decline converged slightly at the end, it still fell 1,564 points to close at 40,039 points, marking the seventh largest drop in history, with a transaction value of 1.08 trillion yuan.

title: 晶片股走弱韓股崩跌 散戶恐慌逃命
summary: 晶片股走弱不只拖累台股，南韓股市也無法倖免於難。南韓散戶投資人爭相拋售持股，韓股KOSPI指數昨盤中一度崩跌近百分之十三，儘管跌幅收斂，終場仍大跌近百分之六。而韓股的槓桿型ＥＴＦ（指數股票型基金）去化成為韓股暴跌的核心，南韓財長具潤哲昨也為政府當初未經審慎考量便允許推出個股槓桿型ＥＴＦ致歉。

title_en: Chip stocks weaken, Korean stocks collapse, retail investors panic and run for their lives
summary_en: The weakening of chip stocks not only dragged down the Taiwan stock market, but the South Korean stock market was not immune to the disaster. South Korean retail investors rushed to sell their holdings. The Korean KOSPI index collapsed by nearly 13% yesterday. Although the decline converged, it still fell by nearly 6% at the end. The depletion of leveraged ETFs (index stock funds) in the Korean stock market has become the core of the Korean stock market's plunge. South Korean Finance Minister Koo Yoon-cheol also apologized yesterday for the government's decision to allow the launch of individual stock leveraged ETFs without careful consideration.

summary: 「我畢業了，不是財富自由，是被券商退學」、「我開了融資、交出了靈魂，在永無止盡的追繳令中，陷入瘋狂」，最近幾日，網路投資社群常見貼出融資追繳簡訊或股票帳戶截圖的發文，看著總損益出現負數，樓下有安慰的也有嘲諷的，苦主則貼出畢業文勸世，奉勸大家不要融資。

title_en: Taiwan stocks raise blood and tears, the sufferer posts graduation essay to persuade the world
summary_en: "I graduated, not to have freedom of wealth, but to be dropped out of school by a brokerage firm." "I opened financing, surrendered my soul, and fell into madness amid the never-ending demand for debt." In recent days, it is common in online investment communities to post financing demand text messages or screenshots of stock accounts. Seeing the negative total profit and loss, there are those who comfort and ridicule downstairs. The victims posted graduation essays to persuade the world and advise everyone not to raise funds.

title: AI撐台灣景氣 國發會：全球經濟3隱憂
summary: 台灣經濟受惠ＡＩ浪潮，出口、生產與投資動能持續升溫，但全球景氣前方仍有不少暗礁。國發會最新「當前經濟情勢」分析指出，儘管ＡＩ、高效能運算及雲端基礎建設需求持續攀升，全球經濟仍面臨中東衝突、貿易政策不確定性及金融市場波動等三大隱憂，後續發展須密切關注。

title_en: AI supports Taiwan’s prosperity National Development Council: 3 hidden worries about the global economy
summary_en: Taiwan's economy has benefited from the AI ​​wave, and its exports, production and investment momentum have continued to heat up. However, there are still many hidden dangers ahead of the global boom. The National Development Council's latest "Current Economic Situation" analysis points out that although the demand for AI, high-performance computing and cloud infrastructure continues to rise, the global economy still faces three major hidden worries, including conflict in the Middle East, trade policy uncertainty and financial market fluctuations, and subsequent developments must be paid close attention to.

title: AI商機不均 僅2成製造業切入半導體鏈
summary: ＡＩ與半導體持續撐起台灣經濟成長，但這股紅利尚未全面流入其他產業。中經院最新調查顯示，製造業僅不到兩成切入半導體供應鏈，非製造業主要透過物流、工程及專業服務承接商機，顯示外溢效益仍集中在特定供應鏈與服務節點，距離形成全面性的產業景氣循環仍有一段距離。

title_en: AI business opportunities are uneven. Only 20% of the manufacturing industry has entered the semiconductor chain.
summary_en: AI and semiconductors continue to support Taiwan's economic growth, but this dividend has not yet fully flowed into other industries. The latest survey by the China Economic Academy shows that less than 20% of the manufacturing industry has entered the semiconductor supply chain. Non-manufacturing industries mainly take on business opportunities through logistics, engineering and professional services. This shows that spillover benefits are still concentrated in specific supply chains and service nodes, and there is still some distance to go before forming a comprehensive industrial boom cycle.

title: 超商衝刺自助化 減少工作負擔
summary: 缺工成為流通業的新常態，迫使業者由「勞力密集」走向「科技密集」，而ＡＩ、自助化就成為打造「少人化」流通模式的最大武器，其中自助化更是發展最快的重點。統一超7-ELEVEN表示，內部統計，前三大門市使用頻次最高省力化作業分別為自助微波、自助結帳、自助取貨，三大省力服務一年可減少工時近兩百萬小時。

title_en: Supermarkets sprint towards self-service to reduce work burden
summary_en: The shortage of workers has become the new normal in the circulation industry, forcing operators to move from "labor-intensive" to "technology-intensive". AI and self-service have become the biggest weapons to create a "less-staffed" circulation model, with self-service being the fastest-growing focus. Uni-President Super 7-ELEVEN stated that internal statistics show that the top three most frequently used labor-saving operations in its stores are self-service microwaves, self-service checkout, and self-service pickup. These three labor-saving services can reduce nearly two million hours of work per year.

title: 缺工時代 零售業轉型打 「效率戰」
summary: 在少子化、高齡化的壓力下，台灣進入大缺工時代，過去流通業競爭的是展店速度、坪效與價格，現今人力成最稀缺資源，卻也逼出台灣流通業新競爭力，迫使零售、餐飲、物流重新設計營運模式，誰能用更少的人經營更多生意，誰就有競爭優勢。

title_en: In the era of labor shortage, the retail industry transforms and fights the "efficiency war"
summary_en: Under the pressure of a declining birthrate and an aging population, Taiwan has entered an era of great labor shortage. In the past, the distribution industry competed on store opening speed, square footage and price. Nowadays, manpower has become the scarcest resource, but it has also forced Taiwan's distribution industry to have new competitiveness, forcing retail, catering, and logistics to redesign their operating models. Whoever can run more business with fewer people will have a competitive advantage.

title: 中彰30分鐘生活圈成形 彰化房市「蛋白區」順勢崛起吸引在地建商卡位
summary: 彰化縣房市正迎來前所未有的結構性轉變。過去，彰化面臨人口外流與台中房價擠壓挑戰，如今隨著重大交通建設與都市計畫雙效推進，房市也從「人口外流」走向「承接外溢」，其中交通條件改善、房價相對親民的花壇、和美等二線鄉鎮，也成為在地建商如格睿建設等積極布局的新戰場。

title_en: The 30-minute living circle in Zhongzhang takes shape, and the "Protein District" of Changhua's real estate market rises to attract local developers.
summary_en: The real estate market in Changhua County is undergoing unprecedented structural changes. In the past, Changhua faced the challenges of population outflow and the squeeze on housing prices in Taichung. Now, with the dual-efficiency advancement of major transportation construction and urban planning, the housing market has also shifted from "population outflow" to "acceptance of spillover." Among them, second-tier towns such as Huatan and Hemei, where traffic conditions have improved and housing prices are relatively affordable, have also become new battlefields for local developers such as Green Construction.

title_en: Taiwan stock market pre-market/Fed freezes for five consecutive times, hawks rise! Taiwan Index fell 683 points in night trading and once again faced a battle to defend 40,000 points
summary_en: U.S. stocks plunged in late trading on Wednesday (29th), with the Dow Jones Index plummeting 1,153 points and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunging 5.33%. Although the Federal Reserve announced that it would keep interest rates unchanged for the fifth time in a row, its decision statement was unexpectedly hawkish. In addition, the situation in the Middle East heated up again and pushed up oil prices, which impacted market confidence. After the Taiwan stock market plunged 1,564 points yesterday, the Taiwan stock index futures fell another 683 points in overnight trading. TSMC futures fell by 31 yuan after the market closed, and financing decreased by another 38.5 billion yuan. Under the continued negative influence from the international market, Taiwan stocks may continue to be weak at the opening today (30th), and the market will once again face a battle to defend 40,000 points.
