title_en: Fed rates have been frozen for the fifth consecutive time, but hawks are on the rise. Dow Jones plummeted by 1,153 points, and the Federal Reserve plummeted by more than 5%.
summary_en: The war between the United States and Iran has intensified, pushing up international oil prices and further exacerbating inflationary pressures. The U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) once again kept interest rates unchanged at its policy meeting today, keeping interest rates unchanged for the fifth time in a row. However, it was rare that three policymakers advocated raising interest rates. In addition, Chairman Bush reiterated his stance of lowering inflation, and long-term U.S. bond yields surged. In addition, the resurgence of war in the Middle East also led to a sharp rise in oil prices. The Dow Jones plunged 1,153 points, the Nasdaq Index and the S&P 500 Index both fell by more than 1.5%. Feiban, which is closely linked to the Taiwan stock market, fell by more than 5%. TSMC ADR closed down 4.50%. Taiwan Index futures fell 683 points, or 1.69%, to close at 39,645 points in overnight trading.

title_en: Seems healthy but high risk! Doctor: Two behaviors are accelerating the occurrence of cancer
summary_en: You drink a cup of hot tea every morning to warm your stomach and have a drink after get off work to relax. Are these seemingly harmless habits actually accelerating the occurrence of cancer? Research shows that when "drinking scalding hot tea" is combined with "more than 15 grams of alcohol per day", the risk of developing esophageal cancer is five times higher than that of others. The real scary thing is not cancer, but that we continue to repeat seemingly healthy but high-risk behaviors without knowing it. Hailed as the "Medical Sherlock Holmes" by the domestic media, Zeng Jinyuan, director of Yuanding Clinic, pointed out in the book "Precision Medicine: Preventing Cancer Early, Solving Gene Myths and Prescribing the Right Medicine": "Rather than comprehensively preventing cancer, it is better to target high-risk factors and targeted prevention is the most effective way." He divided cancer prevention into two categories: "targeted prevention" and "cliché prevention."

title_en: Keigo Higashino passed away from colorectal cancer! Doctors remind "these" lifestyle habits are quietly developing cancer

The cause of death was colorectal cancer. Higashino, who has a large number of book fans in Japan and abroad, has been in the industry for nearly 40 years and has written many best-selling works, including "The Devotion of Suspect X" and "White Night Walk", which won the "Naoki Prize". The total sales in Japan have exceeded 100 million copies in 2023. The real scary thing is not cancer, but that we continue to repeat seemingly healthy but high-risk behaviors without knowing it. Most cancers are caused by multiple mutations, and specific environmental factors are often the tipping point. title_en: The Food and Drug Administration released a 34-page investigation report on the Zhonglian case. TAT, Changhui, and Taiwan Sugar all passed the test
summary_en: On the 29th day of the outbreak of the Zhonglian oil and fat case, the full text of the 34-page public investigation report of the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare was published on the official website for public viewing. The latest inspection results were simultaneously announced. In addition to Zhonglian, the other three large domestic edible oil and fat manufacturers, including Tatongyi, Changhui, and Taiwan Sugar, tested a total of 30 oil samples from January to July this year. All of them met the standards, and the benzopyrene was less than 2 ppb. Wang Deyuan, deputy director of the Food and Drug Administration, said that except for Taiwan Sugar, the other three manufacturers all use a mixture of Brazilian and American soybeans. "It can be seen that the source risk can be eliminated in the back-end process."

title_en: Concern over the Zoomlion Oil and Fats case, Nanqiao Li Kanwen calls for the implementation of food cloud traceability
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 29th) Li Kanwen, president of Nanqiao, said that the government should implement the existing food cloud and traceability and tracking system to ensure that the upstream and downstream batch numbers of the food supply chain are connected in series. When a food safety incident occurs, the flow of problematic products can be accurately traced; at the same time, industry reporting procedures, responsibilities and guarantees should be clarified to avoid impacting mutual trust in the domestic supply chain.

summary_en: A magnitude 7 earthquake occurred in Kumamoto, Japan on the 28th. Subsequently, there were a number of large-scale aftershocks. title_en: TSMC: Kumamoto factory needs adjustments and corrections, support has been deployed to comprehensively review the impact of the earthquake
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zhang Jianzhong, Hsinchu, 29th) A strong earthquake occurred in Kumamoto, Japan on the 28th. Wafer foundry TSMC said today that due to the large magnitude of the earthquake, the Kumamoto JASM wafer factory is expected to take some time to adjust and correct. TSMC has deployed resources to support JASM. The supply of raw materials is currently intact. As for the JASM factory construction site, it has not been affected. Construction has resumed today after confirming safety. In addition, we are also comprehensively reviewing the impact of the earthquake and maintaining close communication with customers.

title_en: The automobile market is cautious and not optimistic, the era of meager profits is coming
summary_en: As Wu Ruihong, co-CEO of Baojia, said, the automobile market in the second half of this year is cautious and not optimistic. In order to seize the market, various car manufacturers are bound to launch products that meet market demand. Product settings vary from manufacturer to manufacturer, but competitive prices are a common trend. Starting from July, Yuri Motors' X-Trail facelift has reduced prices and added equipment, with a value of RMB 170,000. Including trade-in subsidies, the entry price has dropped to RMB 899,000. After the SUV war started, including PEUGEOT and MAZDA, both PEUGEOT and MAZDA offered great discounts on domestic prices for imported cars, which also announced that the era of meager profits in the automobile market has arrived.

title: 獨家／不同品牌、同一套路 多家電商平台會員收到詐騙郵件 引發資安疑慮
summary: 有網購習慣的消費者注意了！近日不少民眾在Threads上討論自己收到詐騙E-mail，這些E-mail大多以「重複訂購」、「定期扣款」、「訂單異常」名義寄出，民眾剛開始以為是訂單出問題，沒想到卻是詐騙訊息。比較特別的是，這次詐騙集團盯上的不只是單一電子商務平台，範圍涵蓋服飾品牌CACO、寵物品牌寵物公園App、點數回饋平台Ocard，連消費者都大喊，「如果不是自己真的買過，很難相信這是詐騙」。

summary_zh: 有網購習慣的消費者注意了！近日不少民眾在Threads上討論自己收到詐騙E-mail，這些E-mail大多以「重複訂購」、「定期扣款」、「訂單異常」名義寄出，民眾剛開始以為是訂單出問題，沒想到卻是詐騙訊息。比較特別的是，這次詐騙集團盯上的不只是單一電子商務平台，範圍涵蓋服飾品牌CACO、寵物品牌寵物公園App、點數回饋平台Ocard，連消費者都大喊，「如果不是自己真的買過，很難相信這是詐騙」。
title_en: Exclusive/different brands, the same routine. Members of multiple e-commerce platforms received fraudulent emails, raising security concerns.
summary_en: Consumers with online shopping habits, take note! Recently, many people have discussed on Threads that they have received fraudulent emails. Most of these emails were sent in the name of "duplicate ordering", "regular deduction", and "order abnormality". At first, people thought that there was a problem with the order, but they did not expect that it was a scam message. What’s special is that this time the fraud group is targeting not just a single e-commerce platform, but also the clothing brand CACO, the pet brand Pet Park App, and the points rewards platform Ocard. Even consumers shouted, “If you haven’t actually bought it yourself, it’s hard to believe that this is a scam.”

title_en: People bring back slimming injections from overseas, "fake for personal use, but really for sale". Doctors: If the cold chain is destroyed, all the curative effects may be lost.
summary_en: There is a lot of confusion about slimming injections for weight loss, and many people go abroad to buy them. Because the overseas prices are 30% to 40% off in Taiwan, there is an illegal chaos of "fake for personal use, real sales". In order to prevent chaos, the Food and Drug Administration continues to cooperate with the Customs Administration to strengthen border control, and plans to bring such drugs into the country in the future. You must actively declare to the customs, otherwise all will be confiscated, and you will have to pay high penalties. Doctors pointed out that slimming injections require cold chain transportation, and purchasing drugs from unknown sources may lead to ineffective weight loss.

summary_en: Typhoon White Dolphin will be upgraded to a severe typhoon today, and the storm radius will continue to expand. Li Mengxuan, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, said that White Dolphin is expected to head towards the South China Sea next week. Rainfall will slow down in the next week, and the high temperature will reach 36 degrees. However, local thundershowers still need to be watched in the western and eastern half of the mountainous areas tomorrow and the next two days in the afternoon.

title_en: Chanel's top jewelry "Signes & Symboles" debuts on the stage, four classic symbols are dreamily intertwined
summary_en: CHANEL's 2026 top jewelry series "Signes & Symboles" will be exhibited in Taiwan for the first time after being exposed for the first time in South France earlier. It was specially chosen to be displayed in New Taipei City's Back and forth Elephant Arts and Culture Space. The quiet and leisure space atmosphere echoes the location of the first exhibition, la Pausa, which was the holiday villa where Gabrielle Chanel received artist friends such as Picasso and Dali in her early years. There are a total of 85 pieces in the series, which demonstrate the powerful tension of contemporary jewelry art through profound interpretations of the brand's four core symbols - the sun, stars, camellias and lions.

title_en: On the eve of high-speed rail N700ST leaving the factory, Taiwan High-Speed ​​Rail donated 20 million yen to aid Kumamoto’s post-disaster reconstruction
summary_en: Taiwan's new generation high-speed train N700ST will be officially shipped from the Hitachi Kasado Factory in Yamaguchi Prefecture, Japan on the 30th. Taiwan High Speed ​​Rail Corporation held a thank-you party in Fukuoka, Japan, on the evening of the 29th. It was originally to express gratitude to Taiwanese and Japanese dignitaries from all walks of life who participated in the new car delivery ceremony. However, due to the recent 7.1 magnitude earthquake in Kumamoto, the party also added an atmosphere of care for the disaster-stricken areas. Transportation Minister Chen Shikai announced that he would donate one month's salary to disaster relief, and Taiwan High Speed ​​Rail Chairman Shi Zhe announced that the company would donate 20 million yen (approximately NT$4 million) to assist in post-disaster reconstruction.

title_en: Direct sales to reduce fever? In 2025, the turnover of multi-level marketing businesses will fall below 100 billion yuan, the first time in the past five years
summary_en: The Fair Trade Commission today released the results of a survey on the operation and development of my country's multi-level pyramid schemes in 2025, pointing out that the total turnover of multi-level pyramid schemes will exceed the 100 billion yuan mark every year starting from 2021. The turnover in 2025 will be 98.6 billion yuan, which is the first time in the past five years that it has not reached 100 billion yuan. The Fair Association analyzed that it should be related to the intensified competition of similar products in MLM business and the decrease in the number of MLM dealers. title_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission today issued new guidelines for financial rewards. Peng Jinlong emphasized the importance of "trust in finance"
summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission today released new guidelines for financial feedback, and hosted a forum hosted by the China Federation of Finance and Finance and the Financial Research and Training Institute. Almost all the Financial Supervisory Commission chairman Peng Jinlong, the chairman of 13 domestic financial holding companies and the chairman of each financial association attended. title: 日本推成長投資指南 經濟利潤EP望成企業評價新焦點
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導日本經濟產業省於 2026 年 7 月 21 日發布了全新的「成長投資指南」，旨在引導企業提升價值創造。該指南明確指出，除了傳統的股本回報率（ROE）之外，企業應將「經濟利潤」（EP）視為評估企業價值創造的重要指標。 這項新指南延續了 2014 年「Ito Report」的倡議，並與日本金融廳及東京證券交易所修訂的 Corporate Governance Code 協調一致。「Ito Report」過去著重於資本成本意識經營，強調股本回報率、與投資者的建設性對話以及高品質的資訊揭露。在這些改革的推動下，日本企業的資本效率已顯著提升，股本回報率從 2010 年代初期的約 5% 普遍成長至近期超過 9%。 然而，過度側重股本回報率可能導致企業透過減少股東權益（如發放股息或實施庫藏股）來提高比率，這不一定能有效促進成長投資。經濟產業省此次引入經濟利潤（EP），正為了解決此一課題。經濟利潤的計算方式為：稅後淨營業利潤（NOPAT）減去投入資本（Invested Capital）乘以加權平均資本成本（WACC），也就是投入資本回報率（ROIC）減去加權平均資本

title_en: Technology financial reports trigger short-term capital profit-taking, UMC, Delta Electronics and MediaTek are holding legal talks one after another
summary_en: The global AI race continues to heat up, with the market focus this week focusing on the U.S. Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate decision and the financial reports of U.S. technology giants. Affected by the wait-and-see atmosphere, Taiwan stocks have corrected for several days this week. Cathay Investment Bank said that compared with the short-term trend, the market is paying more attention to whether the expansion of investment by global technology companies will bring a new wave of growth opportunities. Recently, TSMC (2330) and Micron have successively raised their capital expenditures, and advanced packaging, memory and mature process manufacturers have started to expand production. This shows that AI investment has gradually extended from chip design and server manufacturing to factory construction, advanced packaging and infrastructure. It has also continued to benefit technology companies with leading positions in various industries.

title: 瘋股也要顧心理 別讓健康負債
summary: 近期台股受到高度關注，從個股、當沖到ETF，都成為民眾熱烈討論的話題。桃醫精神部主任蘇柏文二十九日表示，投資原本是為了增加生活安全感，倘若最後讓人每天緊盯盤勢、害怕虧損、無法入睡，甚至影響工作與家庭，這時候就需要重新檢視目前投資方式。全民瘋股也要顧心理，別讓投資賠上健康。臨床上，曾有民眾頻繁當沖累積近千萬元損失，仍不甘心停手，希望靠下一次交易翻本，最後需要家人出面協助。當事人坦言，自己無法控制想繼續當沖的衝動。進一步了解後發現，他的判斷主要仰賴前一日外資買賣超資訊及網路明牌，缺乏完整分析與風險評估，背後隱含藉由賺錢獲得家人肯定與重視心理需求。蘇柏文指出，當獲利被視為能力與自我價值證明，虧損就容易被感受為失敗，進而出現「越賠越想翻本、越想翻本越承擔更高風險」的惡性循環，甚至 ...

title_en: Taiwan stock market continued to fall by 2,000 points, and stocks in the hardest-hit area fell by the 15th limit, with 19 companies falling off the list in one month, leaving 37 companies
summary_en: Taiwan stocks experienced strong selling pressure today (29th), with the intraday volume falling by more than 2,000 points. Not only were the value stocks in collapse, but also the gold stocks were rumbling, with up to 15 stocks hitting the limit. title_en: Gold prices fall to near one-week low! Testing the $4,000 level, experts say
summary_en: International gold prices continue to weaken. On the 29th, spot gold once fell to US$4,010.42 per ounce, hitting a new low in the past week. As of noon Taipei time, it was trading at US$4,023.9 ​​per ounce, just one step away from the integer mark of US$4,000. The market is focused on the U.S. Federal Reserve's (Fed) interest rate decision. Gold continues to be under short-term pressure as the U.S. dollar strengthens, U.S. bond yields rise, and the situation in the Middle East pushes up oil prices and intensifies concerns about inflation.

title_en: AI computing power shows its power! SK Hynix’s operating profit surged 5.57 times to hit a record, slapping the AI ​​bubble theory in the face
summary_en: The wave of global AI infrastructure construction continues to heat up. SK hynix, the leader in AI memory, announced its financial report for the second quarter of 2026, setting another record high with outstanding operating performance. Single-quarter revenue reached 79.32 trillion won, an annual increase of 29%; net profit was 93.92 trillion won, an annual increase of 361%, both setting new single-quarter highs. Operating profit climbed to 60.54 trillion won, an annual increase of 557.2%. The operating profit rate reached a historical high of 76%, driving the cumulative revenue in the first half of the year to exceed 100 trillion won for the first time.

title_en: The fourth phase of Daxun’s factory will be completed by the end of the year, and construction of the fifth phase will continue.
summary_en: In response to the explosive demand for high-density computing power in AI and the global competition to invest in the construction of ultra-large-scale data centers, Ablecom Technology Inc., a provider of professional chassis and high-end cooling solutions, is actively preparing production capacity for customers. It is initially expected that the production capacity of next-generation high-density computing server racks will increase by more than 1,000 units per month. Among them, Daxun Taoyuan Bade Phase 4 new factory has completed the main structure of the building. Next, the project progress will be accelerated and the target of completion by the end of the year will be achieved. At the same time, the fifth phase factory construction will also start within this year, which will be able to provide production capacity services to more customers.

title_en: AI changes face and copies voice into a powerful fraud weapon 104 senior grade fraud prevention practical course
summary_en: The continuous development of AI technology has also made fraud methods more fake and real. "104 Senior", a brand of 104 Human Bank, pointed out that fraud losses in Taiwan reached NT$4.7 billion in June. title_en: Cathay Investment Consulting: Even if market volatility expands, technology giants and financial stocks will still be the two main investment pillars of U.S. stocks
summary_en: U.S. stocks have recently been affected by factors such as concerns about high technology valuations, inflation trends, Federal Reserve (Fed) policies and geopolitical events, and market volatility has increased. However, Cathay Investment Consulting emphasized that the long-term bullish pattern of U.S. stocks has not changed. The most critical reason is that corporate fundamentals are still strong, and technology giants and financial stocks are still the two main investment pillars of U.S. stocks.

title_en: Taiwan stocks have plummeted in recent days, will Guoan Fund enter the market? The finance minister said this
summary_en: The stock market has plummeted for days and missed 40,000 points today. The outside world is concerned about whether the National Security Fund will enter the market. Finance Minister Zhuang Cuiyun said on the 29th that there are many factors for the stock market decline. Looking at other countries, such as the United States, Japan and South Korea, stocks have fallen in recent days, but Taiwan’s economy is good and the prosperity signal is also red, which will help stabilize Taiwan’s stock market. The staff of the National Security Fund will continue to pay attention to the international situation and stock market trends, and handle it in accordance with regulations.

title_en: Taiwan stock market once again collapsed by more than 1,000 points and fell to 4.1K! TSMC and MediaTek lead the decline, Hon Hai Holdings resists shortfalls
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market opened 111.88 points lower on the 29th and closed at 41,491.48 points. Subsequently, the selling pressure on weight stocks such as TSMC (2330), MediaTek (2454), Nanya (2408), and ASE Investment Holdings (3711) came out simultaneously, and the market fell. It quickly expanded to more than 1,000 points, breaking the 41,000-point integer level; although Hon Hai (2317), Quanta (2382), Asus (2357), Realtek (2379) and Cathay Gold (2882) tried to support the market, it was still difficult to resist the bears' offensive. On the market, active unified upgrade 50 (00403A), Innolux (3481) and Qunyi Taiwan Weighted Positive 2 (00685L) were the most actively traded.

title_en: China’s Semiconductor Chasers/Asia’s Largest IPO Debuts, Changxin’s Listed Market Value Soars, Challenges the Top Three in Memory
summary_en: Foreword: China's memory factory Changxin Technology (Changxin Storage) is coming in force. It previously completed Asia's largest initial public offering (IPO) this year and became one of China's most valuable listed companies. It was officially listed on the Shanghai Innovation and Technology Board on the 27th. Changxin's share price soared by about 470% on its first trading day, which also impacted South Korea's Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's share prices, which fell by more than 10% on the 28th. Taiwan's memory group also weakened simultaneously. The huge movement has attracted market attention. Now that it has the support of the Chinese government and the support of the capital market, whether Changxin will rewrite the global DRAM competition pattern that has been dominated by Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron for many years in the future.

summary_en: Changxin Technology (Changxin Memory), a major Chinese memory manufacturer, completed a large-scale IPO, and soon after it was reported that domestic immersion deep ultraviolet (DUV) exposure machines have begun mass production. title_en: Heda rushes to attack drones/Gear King expands its UAV factory in Taiwan and the United States, and Heda Group takes over Ges to fight for transformation
summary_en: Shen Guorong, the president of Heda Group, who is known as the "King of Gears" in the country, took over his daughter last year and took a back seat. Recently, he quickly bought the Xingai battery factory Gus Technology and entered the drone market in a big way. Shen Guorong revealed in an exclusive interview with this magazine a few days ago that Heda is preparing to expand production capacity in New York State in the United States to compete for drone business opportunities in Taiwan and the United States. title_en: Heda Attack Drone 2/Learn from TSMC before going to the United States to expand the factory. Shen Guorong: Send engineers to the meeting for one-on-one teaching
summary_en: Heda Group went to the United States to expand production. President Shen Guorong revealed to this magazine that he had served as the chairman of the Science Park Industry Association for two terms. He often met with TSMC supervisors and engineers to chat and have meals. He learned that TSMC had many problems in the beginning of its expansion in the United States. One of the main reasons why it was able to overcome the difficulties was that it sent 2,000 engineers to the local area every month for one-on-one teaching. In the future, Heda will also learn from TSMC's experience and send people to teach in the United States.

title_en: Will free e-books ruin the book market? The Ministry of Culture promotes e-book counting for three years. Report reveals: it can be used as a marketing tool
summary_en: Three years ago, the Ministry of Culture promoted e-book lending in public libraries. Readers can borrow books and magazines online from the comfort of their homes, without having to wait for the previous person to return the e-book like in traditional libraries. Convenient digital reading methods also make publishers worry about affecting people's willingness to buy physical books and e-books and impacting the book market. The e-book reading survey report "114 Years of Digital Reading Data Analysis" commissioned by the Taiwan Academy of Economics and commissioned by the Ministry of Culture has been released, showing that this new form of digital reading has limited overlap with readers of physical books, and can also become a marketing tool for publishers to cultivate IP.

title_en: Chunghwa Post’s procurement fraud case broke out, 8 people were interviewed during the anti-corruption investigation, and 4 officials and businessmen missed the overnight interrogation
summary_en: The Independent Commission Against Corruption received a report alleging that when the Chunghwa Post Office in Taipei was handling an office renovation procurement case, the internal section chief of the Labor and Safety Department was suspected of colluding with the manufacturer, splitting the tender with a bid price of more than one million yuan into smaller bids of less than 100,000 yuan, and escorting Lihai Construction to contract the bid without the need for public bidding. The investigators searched and interviewed 8 people today and arrived at the case. Four officials and businessmen were transferred to the Taipei District Prosecutor's Office in the early morning. The whole case was investigated for violation of the Government Procurement Act.

title_en: In the third reading of the Legislative Yuan, special divisions between brothers and sisters in civil law have been deleted. Ministry of Justice: Succession order and succession divisions remain unchanged.
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the relevant amendments to the Civil Code on the third reading yesterday (28th), deleting the special points reserved for brothers and sisters, closer to the freedom of testament, and stipulating that the revised law will take effect six months after its promulgation. The Ministry of Justice reminds that the order of succession and inheritance of siblings remain unchanged. If there is no prior planning through a will, brothers and sisters can still participate in the distribution of the estate in accordance with the law.

title: 美元兌加幣觸及關鍵阻力區 市場緊盯加幣潛在反彈
summary: 圖／示意圖商傳媒｜吳承岳／台北報導根據《Forex.com》報導，美元兌加幣（USD/CAD）匯率目前正因盤整模式而受到關注，可能出現技術性突破。該貨幣對目前交投於關鍵阻力位附近，若此位置被突破，美元兌加幣可能會進一步上漲，意味著加幣相對美元走弱。 技術指標分析顯示，美元兌加幣正在積累動能，可能向上發展。若成功突破關鍵阻力區，預計將引發更多買盤，推升美元兌加幣匯率。反之，若未能突破此阻力位，則可能導致匯率反轉，加幣兌美元有望走強。 目前市場參與者正密切關注美元兌加幣在 1.3500 至 1.3550 區間的表現。外匯交易者應持續監控此關鍵水平，以確認是看漲突破還是看跌反轉的趨勢。 值得注意的是，提供此市場分析的 Forex.com，其營運公司 StoneX Financial Pte. Ltd.（SFP）受到新加坡金融管理局（Monetary Authority of Singapore）的監管，並持有資本市場服務執照。SFP 也是 StoneX集團（StoneX Group Inc.）旗下的全資子公司。 【提醒您】 槓桿商品潛在虧損可能大於本金，本文僅供參考，不構成投資建議

title: Barclays稅前獲利增17% 成本擔憂壓垮股價挫5%

title: 寒武紀擬推500萬股限制性股票激勵計畫，授予價格每股750元人民幣
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，中國人工智慧晶片設計公司寒武紀計畫推出500萬股限制性股票激勵計畫。交易所公告顯示，寒武紀發布2026年限制性股票激勵計畫草案，擬授予500萬股第二類限制性股票，占公司總股本的0.80%，授予價格為每股750元人民幣。寒武紀擬首次授予400萬股第二類限制性股票，向945名激勵對象授予，占公司員工總數的85.37%。公司業績考核目標包括2026年營業收入不低於135億元人民幣，2026年至2027年累計營業收入不低於405億元人民幣，2026年至2028年累計營業收入不低於1,000億元人民幣。

title: 鎖定財富傳承！統一投信董永寬進軍「投信3.0」　把中小企業當成寶！
summary: 統一投信總經理董永寬宣布正式邁入「投信3.0」時代，策略重心從傳統公募基金與ETF轉向高階資產管理。統一投信將以家族辦公室為核心，鎖定台灣眾多中小企業主，提供包含財富傳承、稅務優化及企業顧問等一條龍專業服務。董永寬強調，憑藉深耕市場三十年的強大投研團隊底氣，結合外部法律與會計專業網絡，統一投信將能為金字塔頂端客戶提供差異化的資產配置方案。目前公司已擴編專責團隊，積極搶攻高資產族群市場，展現深化經營精品級理財服務的強烈企圖心，成為資產管理領域的新藍海指標。

title_en: Who will take care of medical care when we are old? Issues/Medical safety net lights up red light
summary_en: Advances in technology have led to the rise of one-day surgeries, but may threaten the failure of traditional medical insurance. Faced with the impact of aging and declining birthrates, Taiwan urgently needs to build a more solid medical safety net. This is the original intention of our special topic.

title: 快訊／國安基金再次進場？財政部表態了
summary: 全球股市近期震盪劇烈，台股連帶受到電子與半導體股走弱影響，盤勢波動加劇。對此，財政部長莊翠雲於立法院答詢時強調，儘管國際因素干擾全球金融市場，但台灣實體經濟表現亮眼，景氣燈號更亮出代表熱絡的紅燈，穩固的基本面將成為台股支撐力道。針對國安基金是否進場護盤，莊翠雲表示，幕僚團隊將持續密切監控國際情勢與台股動態，並觀察金管會穩定市場措施成效。國安基金將嚴格依照條例規範，視市場實際狀況進行評估，若有必要，將召開委員會決議是否進場，以維護台股金融市場穩定與投資人信心。

title_en: Who will take care of medical care in old age? Questions/Increase in health insurance premiums, 70% of the people support it
summary_en: 75% of the financial resources of health insurance come from general premiums, 9% are supplementary premiums of second-generation health insurance, and 16% are government budget injections. Among general premiums, 60% of the health premiums for employed workers are borne by employers, 30% by employees, and 10% by the government. There is a common myth in the outside world that health insurance premiums are difficult to increase because "people" are unwilling to pay more. Is this true?

title_en: Who will take care of medical care in old age? Issues/"Elderly" groups with medical conditions find it more difficult to obtain insurance
summary_en: Commercial medical insurance has not kept pace with the advancement of medical technology, resulting in a gap between insurance policies and medical on-site services. Not only have claims disputes increased, insurance companies' medical insurance loss ratios have worsened, and it has become increasingly difficult for the elderly and sick groups who really need medical protection to purchase commercial insurance coverage.

title: 福特電動車事業虧損擴大 Q2淨損13億美元仍上修財測
summary: 圖／本報資料庫商傳媒｜責任編輯／綜合外電報導福特汽車（Ford）週二公布的第二季財報顯示，由於電動車業務產生鉅額費用，導致公司出現高達 13 億美元的淨虧損。然而，儘管面臨電動車轉型挑戰，福特仍再次上調全年業績展望，展現對未來營運的信心。 這項 13 億美元的第二季淨虧損，主要歸因於電動車部門相關的成本支出。這凸顯出傳統汽車巨頭在全面轉向電動化的過程中，所面臨的巨大投資壓力與挑戰。 儘管如此，福特汽車對全年財報仍抱持樂觀態度，再次上調了年度業績指引。這顯示公司預期其他業務板塊的表現將能彌補電動車部門的虧損，並支持整體營收成長。 在福特積極推動電動車轉型的同時，市場上也出現像由亞馬遜（Amazon）創辦人貝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）支持的新創公司 Slate。該公司推出售價 26,400 美元的電動車產品，並以直接銷售模式，鎖定追求實惠與自主改裝的買家。這類創新商業模式與平價產品，也為福特等傳統汽車製造商的電動車策略，帶來了新的市場競爭與挑戰。

title: 美國5月份FHFA房價指數月增0.3%，表現優於預期
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，美國5月份房價月比值呈現上揚局面，表現優於預期。美國聯邦住屋融資局(Federal Housing Finance Agency, 簡稱FHFA)發布的數據顯示，美國5月份FHFA房價指數月比值上揚0.3%。9位受訪經濟專家的預估中值為上揚0.1%，預估區間介於持平至上揚0.3%。前月數據為月減0.1%。與去年同期相較，5月份FHFA房價指數上揚了有2.2%。根據FHFA公佈的這份數據顯示，從年比值來看，5月份美國九個地區房價中僅太平洋地區一處下跌，其餘八個地區上揚。從月比值來看，5月份美國九個地區有七個地區房價上揚、兩個地區下滑。在房價上漲的地區中，東南部中區漲幅為1.4%，漲勢最為亮眼，其餘六個地區的住宅價格漲幅介於1.1%至0.1%。而在下滑的地區中，太平洋地區房價下跌0.6%，降幅最為醒目，東北部中區跌幅為0.2%。FHFA房價指數是基於房地美和房利美發放的抵押貸款，計算的美國單戶房屋價格指數，不提供具體的房屋售價。

summary_en: Yang Qin (2755) continues to develop its store openings and membership economy. Chairman Zhuo Jinglun said yesterday (28th) that the number of Maiwei Deng stores in Taiwan will challenge 1,100 this year, and will move towards 2,000 stores in the long term. summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，新出爐的數據顯示，7月份聯準會里奇蒙分行轄下的製造業活動呈現擴張態勢，但表現略遜於經濟專家預期。聯準會里奇蒙分行公佈的7月份製造業指數由前月的「4」，向上升至「5」的水準，表現遜於預期。此前7位受訪經濟專家的預估中值為「6」，預估區間介於「2」至「8」。該指數若高於0意味著產業活動呈現擴張，低於0則是說明產業呈現萎縮局面。這份報告顯示，7月份出貨分項指數由前月「4」，向上升至「8」的水準。此外，新訂單分項指數則是由前月的「8」，向下降至「5」的水準。產能利用分項指數則是由前月的「-1」，向上攀升至「2」的水準。積壓訂單指數由前月的「3」，向上升至「4」的水準；製成品庫存指數維持在前月「9」的水準。里奇蒙分行管轄區包括哥倫比亞特區、馬里蘭、維吉尼亞等地區，對於美國整體GDP的貢獻度為9.1%。

Quanta announced yesterday (28th) that it purchased AUO's Taoyuan factory for 19.7 billion yuan; Wistron acquired new real estate in California and invested US$121 million (approximately NT$3.922 billion); Inventec will build new factories in Taoyuan and Thailand, and purchase additional factories in Texas, the United States, with a total investment of 18.131 billion yuan.

summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，Digital Currency Group旗下加密貨幣交易所Luno正啟動重組，將在全球各地裁減約20%的員工。Luno首席執行長James Lanigan表示，此次重組將推動公司擴大企業客戶的業務，同時根據當前市場環境進一步削減成本。不過，他拒絕透露此次裁員涉及的具體人數。今年以來，比特幣、以太幣、Solana等加密貨幣價格持續下跌，進一步加劇了零售加密貨幣交易市場的波動。Lanigan表示，過去一年，Luno在自動化和營運效率提升方面進行了大量投資，並持續整合和開發相關工具，而這些工具正在迅速改變公司高效運營所需的資源配置模式。因此，建立一個更加精簡、更加適應當前發展需要的組織架構，既有必要，也十分合適。此次重組還將使Luno這家總部位於倫敦、起源於南非、並在亞洲開展業務的加密貨幣交易所，能夠進一步拓展機構投資者業務，加強核心基礎設施和合規體系建設，並加大對零售客戶產品的投入。

title: 伊朗開出三條件重開荷姆茲，要求改道、廢TSS並獨攬排雷
summary: 【財訊快報／陳孟朔】路透報導，伊朗已向阿曼提出荷姆茲海峽臨時通航方案，要求所有進入波斯灣的船舶以及部分駛離波斯灣的船舶改經伊朗領海，以擴大德黑蘭對這條全球能源動脈的實際控制。伊朗同時拒絕阿曼提出的雙向航道「平均分配」方案，並警告若伊方條件不獲接受，荷姆茲海峽將繼續維持關閉狀態。伊朗外交部副部長加里巴巴迪(Kazem Gharibabadi)表示，德黑蘭已不再承認國際海事組織(IMO)於1968年批准的交通分離制(TSS)。原有TSS將進出船舶分流，大部分航線位於阿曼水域；伊朗認為，這項安排在美國與以色列今年2月攻擊伊朗後，已無法保障其國家安全，因此要求在未來雙向航線中都取得更大的管控權。除改劃航道外，伊朗也要求獨攬海峽排雷工作，不允許美國、法國或其他第三國介入，即使相關國家受到阿曼邀請也不例外。目前原有國際航道仍因水雷威脅而無法正常使用，船舶主要依靠伊朗與阿曼各自劃設的替代航線通行。伊朗的提案目前仍處於談判階段，尚未成為正式通航制度，因此不能解讀為荷姆茲海峽即將全面恢復正常航運。這項方案顯示，德黑蘭爭取的已不只是向船舶收取服務費，而是要在航線規劃、船舶監管及海上安全等領域取得制度性主導

title_en: Iran offers three conditions to reopen Homuz, requiring diversion, abolition of TSS and monopoly on demining
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] Reuters reported that Iran has proposed to Oman a temporary navigation plan for the Strait of Hormuz, requiring all ships entering the Persian Gulf and some ships leaving the Persian Gulf to divert through Iranian territorial waters to expand Tehran's actual control over this global energy artery. Iran also rejected Oman's proposal for an "equal allocation" of two-way shipping lanes and warned that the Strait of Hormuz would remain closed if Iran's conditions were not accepted. Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Tehran no longer recognizes the Traffic Separation System (TSS) approved by the International Maritime Organization (IMO) in 1968. The original TSS will divert incoming and outgoing ships, with most routes located in Omani waters. Iran believes that this arrangement can no longer protect its national security after the United States and Israel attacked Iran in February this year, and therefore requires greater control over both directions in the future. In addition to changing the waterway, Iran also demands to monopolize the demining work in the strait and not allow the United States, France or other third countries to intervene, even if the relevant countries are invited by Oman. At present, the original international waterways are still unable to be used normally due to the threat of mines, and ships mainly rely on alternative routes established by Iran and Oman. Iran's proposal is still in the negotiation stage and has not yet become a formal navigation system, so it cannot be interpreted as an imminent return to normal shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. This plan shows that Tehran is no longer just striving to collect service fees from ships, but also to obtain institutional leadership in areas such as route planning, ship supervision and maritime safety.

title_en: How does the deletion of special points for siblings affect different family types? The lawyer reminded me that this matter is very important
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the third reading to amend some provisions of the Civil Code to delete special points for brothers and sisters, which will come into effect six months after the presidential announcement. Liu Weide, chairman of the Taiwan Probate Association, reminded that after this revision of the law, singles and inmates are the two major groups that have the greatest impact. He specifically reminded that after the amendment of the Civil Code, the necessity of making a will has not diminished but increased. If there is no will, the successor branches of brothers and sisters will be far more than the inheritance branches.

title: 法說會前夕，聯電ADR週二收挫9.01%連四黑，五週內急瀉40%

title_en: On the eve of the meeting, UMC ADR fell 9.01% on Tuesday for four consecutive black days, plummeting 40% in five weeks.
summary_en: [Financial News/Chen Mengshuo] United Microelectronics (2303) ADR (US stock code UMC), a major wafer foundry that focuses on mature processes, continued its heavy losses on Tuesday, falling as much as 15.6% during the session. The daily low was US$16.11. Although the decline in late trading was obviously restrained, it still fell sharply by US$1.72 or 9.01% at the end, marking the fourth consecutive black day and closing at US$17.36, the lowest in more than two months since May 14. Trading volume on the day increased to approximately 26.47 million shares, significantly higher than the recent average, indicating a fierce battle between panic selling pressure and low-priced buying. If the latest closing price is calculated based on the historical high of US$28.96 created on June 25, UMC ADR has plummeted by US$11.60 or 40.1% in less than five weeks. The short-term retracement speed and magnitude far exceed that of most foundry peers. Joint stock prices have also sharply corrected recently, causing the market to speculate that in addition to the cooling of global semiconductor stocks, whether there are still potential negative effects such as orders, quotations or profit outlooks have not yet been fully reflected. Market participants pointed out that the company has yet to see major negative news released to explain such a sharp decline. The recent selling pressure may also come from the valuation revision of semiconductor stocks, price competition in mature processes, the expansion of China's foundry capacity, and concentrated profit-taking after previous excessive increases. When the stock price falls below key technical support, program trading, financing reduction and foreign capital adjustment may also mutually amplify the decline. UMC will announce its second-quarter financial results and hold a press conference on Wednesday. The market focus will focus on capacity utilization, gross profit margin, 22- and 28-nanometer process demand, and mature process reports.

title: 衛星圖像顯示亞馬遜巴林數據中心受損，伊朗宣稱實施飛彈襲擊
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，衛星圖像顯示亞馬遜(Amazon.com Inc)位於巴林的兩個數據中心遭到了損壞，這就印證了伊朗上週的說法，即其用飛彈襲擊了這些設施。伊斯蘭革命衛隊通過官方通訊社塔斯尼姆發布了高分辨率衛星圖像，顯示位於Zallaq和Askar這兩個城鎮的數據中心嚴重受損，並聲稱它們成為打擊目標是因為亞馬遜支持美國軍事行動。根據外電所見，來自歐洲航天局「哨兵-2」星座的低分辨率圖像也顯示，這兩處設施均受損。具有地理空間知識背景的金融媒體經濟研究資深地緣經濟分析師Adam Farrar表示，從哨兵-2圖像上可見兩處設施雙雙受損的證據，但無法據此判斷損壞程度。表觀襲擊時間以及受損區域的位置與伊朗新聞機構發布的圖片基本一致。對於上述消息，亞馬遜拒絕置評。巴林國家通信中心未回應置評請求。美國五角大樓和美國中央司令部均拒絕置評。週二常規盤，亞馬遜(AMZN US)股價下跌0.23%，報230.86美元。

title: 中國半導體追兵／亞洲最大IPO登場　長鑫掛牌市值狂飆、挑戰記憶體三強

title: 青安3.0上路到數計時 排富條款再加碼
summary: 青安3.0上路倒數計時，即將在本周五正式上路。財政部已將青安3.0的新規定和執行細節，正式發文給各八大行庫，其中在「排富」方面，除了個人所得收入以200萬元為限之外，房屋總價的「三級制」，財政部已明確要求行庫，以「成交總價和銀行鑑價」孰高來認計，同時有別於青安2.0對於一次買二戶的，亦即「買雙拼」還有通融其中一戶的空間，到了青安3.0，則是一次買二戶的連其中一戶都不能適用青安優惠專案。

title_en: Qing'an 3.0 is about to hit the road, and the terms of wealth qualifiers will be tightened
summary_en: The countdown to the launch of Qing'an 3.0 will be officially launched this Friday. The Ministry of Finance has officially issued the new regulations and implementation details of Qing'an 3.0 to each of the eight major banks. In terms of "wealth exclusion", in addition to the personal income limit of 2 million yuan, the Ministry of Finance has clearly required banks to use the "three-tier system" for the total housing price. Different from Qing'an 2.0, for those who buy two houses at a time, that is, "buy two houses" there is still room to accommodate one of the houses. In Qing'an 3.0, those who buy two houses at a time cannot even apply to the Qing'an preferential project.

title: 糖尿病截肢悲劇，近7成禍首竟是「穿錯鞋」？醫揭傷口治療的最大盲點
summary: 腳上一個不起眼的小傷口，最後竟然要截肢？這是許多糖尿病患者和家屬最深的恐懼。但你可能不知道，根據日本東京女子大學的調查，糖尿病足病變的直接原因，第一名不是血糖失控，也不是燙傷，而是鞋子的問題，比例高達百分之六十九足踝專科名醫朱家宏醫師在他的著作《自己的腳痛自己救》中提到，不可否認，「截肢」確實是糖尿病足的終極治療，但是「早期治療」及「對糖尿病足建立正確的認識」，絕對可以挽救糖尿病患者免於截肢的下場，並增進生活品質。

title_en: Nearly 70% of diabetic amputation tragedies are caused by "wearing the wrong shoes"? Doctors reveal the biggest blind spot in wound treatment
summary_en: An inconspicuous small wound on the foot ended up requiring amputation? This is the deepest fear of many people with diabetes and their families. But you may not know that according to a survey by Tokyo Women's University in Japan, the number one direct cause of diabetic foot disease is not loss of blood sugar or burns, but shoe problems, accounting for as high as 69%. Dr. Zhu Jiahong, a famous foot and ankle specialist, mentioned in his book "Save Your Own Foot Pain" that it is undeniable that "amputation" is indeed the ultimate treatment for diabetic foot, but "early treatment" and "establishing a correct understanding of diabetic foot" can definitely save diabetic patients from amputation and improve their quality of life.

title: 膝蓋痛怎麼辦？醫戳破30年迷思：軟骨不是老化是被磨壞，找對原因還能再生
summary:
文／呂紹睿醫師

膝蓋痛、緊繃、腫脹、走路卡卡，看了醫生卻只得到一句「退化了，只能拖」？如果你也被這樣告知過，先別急著認命。有一位骨科醫師，花了30年時間證明這句話是錯的。被譽為「全台最難掛號」的骨科名醫呂紹睿，在他的著作《自己的膝蓋自己救：退化性膝關節炎的真相【暢銷增訂版】》中，回顧了這段近乎孤獨的追尋。故事要從1995年說起，當時他在一位農婦退化的膝關節內，意外瞥見一個隱藏的病灶，就是這驚鴻一瞥，讓他下定決心要找出「退化性膝關節炎」的真相。他形容，這個真相像夜空中一顆晦暗的天體，一直都在，靜靜等待有緣人發現，而他從此踏上一條人跡罕至的漫漫長路。

轉折點出現在1999年初春。剛結束瑞士伯恩大學附設醫院2週的觀摩學習，他坐在開往德國科布倫茲的火車上，望著窗外野花盛開的原野，研究主題一個接一個湧上腦海。他當場寫下16個題目，還畫了「內側摩擦現象」的致病機轉草圖。多年後翻出那疊斑駁泛黃的稿紙，他說，就像投進湖心的石子，激起一段又一段回憶。

這個在火車上誕生的大膽假說，一驗證就是25年。歷經5年的嚴格審查與漫長等待，2023年5月，支持他30年前提出致病機轉的最後一篇、也是最關鍵的一篇論

title_en: What to do if you have knee pain? Doctors debunk a 30-year-old myth: Cartilage is not aging but worn out, and it can regenerate if the cause is found
summary_en:
Text/Dr. Lu Shaorui

Your knees are painful, tight, swollen, and you have difficulty walking. When you go to the doctor, you only get the answer: "It has deteriorated and can only be delayed." If you've been told this, don't accept your fate just yet. There is an orthopedic surgeon who spent 30 years proving this statement wrong. Lu Shaorui, a famous orthopedic doctor known as "the most difficult to register in Taiwan", reviewed this almost lonely pursuit in his book "Save Your Own Knees: The Truth about Degenerative Knee Arthritis [Best-Selling Updated Edition]". The story begins in 1995, when he accidentally caught a glimpse of a hidden lesion in the degenerated knee joint of a peasant woman. It was this startling glimpse that made him determined to find out the truth about "degenerative knee arthritis." He described the truth as being like a dark celestial body in the night sky, always there, quietly waiting for someone destined to discover it, and from then on he embarked on a long road less traveled by.

The turning point came in the early spring of 1999. He had just finished a two-week study tour at the University Hospital of Bern in Switzerland. He was sitting on a train bound for Koblenz, Germany, looking out the window at the fields of blooming wildflowers, and research topics came to his mind one after another. He wrote down 16 questions on the spot and drew a sketch of the pathogenesis of the "internal friction phenomenon." Years later, when he dug out the pile of mottled and yellowed manuscript paper, he said, it was like pebbles thrown into the middle of a lake, arousing memories one after another.

This bold hypothesis born on a train took 25 years to be verified. After five years of rigorous review and long wait, in May 2023, the last and most critical paper supporting his proposed pathogenic mechanism 30 years ago was published.

title_en: Why are you angry about your child's mistakes? Experts say this
summary_en: The child called me cringingly with an empty milk bottle in his hand. "Mom! Milk... I'm sorry." I saw milk dripping down from the bottom of the table. Parents with children must have experienced this situation. You can replace "milk" with water, rice, cookies, or various games. "If it falls over, just wipe it up. Mommy will help you, and let's go get a rag and wipe it together." As a parent, I still have many shortcomings, but in the past seven years of growing up with my children, I have a very insistent principle - "Don't blame or blame children when they make mistakes." "You don't have to feel sorry, let's put the milk in the middle of the table next time." It is inevitable for children to make mistakes often. For example, when eating, rice grains fall everywhere, and it is common for things to fall on the floor.

title: 老年科醫師：避開10種對長壽有害的習慣
summary: 「身為老年科醫師，我很難過看到愈來愈多人活到存款不夠花。」許多九十多歲病人告訴她，從來沒想到自己會活這麼久，也沒想到退休後還必須再養自己30年。惠特森說，這是真實存在的問題。「我很擔心一些正值中年的人。他們預期自己65歲退休，卻沒有真正考慮到，假如退休後還能健康生活30年，生活費要從哪裡來。」她說，「很多人想像自己退休後可以旅行、享受富裕生活，因為他們做出了所有正確的健康選擇，也能保持健康，這當然很好。」「但在中年時期，就開始思考人生下一階段的資金流向，同樣非常重要。」

title_en: Geriatrician: Avoid 10 Habits That Are Harmful to Longevity
summary_en: "As a geriatrician, I am sad to see more and more people living until their savings are out of pocket." Many patients in their 90s told her that they never thought they would live so long, nor that they would have to support themselves for another 30 years after retirement. Whitson said this is a real problem. "I'm very worried about some people in middle age. They expect to retire at 65, but they haven't really considered where their living expenses will come from if they can live healthy for 30 years after retirement." She said, "Many people imagine that they can travel and enjoy a wealthy life after retirement because they have made all the right health choices and can stay healthy, which is of course good." "But in middle age, it is also very important to start thinking about the flow of money in the next stage of life."

title: 別再做仰臥起坐了！健身教練：這個動作練核心更好
summary: 練核心不是只能靠仰臥起坐。美國健身教練荷普斯（Sam Hopes）告訴你為什麼改練「棒式膝碰胸」更有幫助。編譯 樂羽嘉很多人練核心都會做仰臥起坐和俄羅斯轉體，因為大家普遍認為這些動作可以鍛鍊腹肌和腹斜肌。如果體脂率夠低，這些肌群確實能幫你練出比未來還清晰、起伏分明的腹部線條。但荷普斯指出，很多人在練這兩種動作時都會下背痛，原因可能包括核心沒有正確出力、姿勢不良、有舊傷，或個人的身體結構與力學差異。換句話說，這些動作並不適合所有人。若你正在尋找一些對脊椎較友善、衝擊較低的優質運動，荷普斯建議把重點放在全面強化核心，尤其是負責穩定身體的深層核心肌群，並選擇不容易刺激或加重背部不適的姿勢。荷普斯提醒，若你現在有疼痛、傷勢或任何健康問題，開始新的運動計畫前務必先諮詢醫療專業人士。棒式膝碰胸是什麼樣的動作？棒式膝碰胸（Plank knee tuck，或稱棒式屈膝、棒式收膝）有點像登山者式，不同之處在於你不用讓膝蓋反覆向前、向後移動，而是要將收膝姿勢固定住。這個動作的重點，是盡可能啟動更多肌肉，幫助身體對抗重力並抵抗旋轉。你需要把膝蓋抬高、向前拉近胸口，同時雙手用力推地

title_en: Stop doing sit-ups! Fitness coach: This action is better for core training
summary_en: Core training is not just about sit-ups. American fitness coach Sam Hopes tells you why it is more helpful to practice "stick knee-to-chest" instead. Compilation Le Yujia Many people do sit-ups and Russian twists when practicing their core, because it is generally believed that these movements can strengthen the abdominal muscles and oblique muscles. If your body fat rate is low enough, these muscle groups can indeed help you develop a clearer, more undulating abdominal line than you will have in the future. But Hopes pointed out that many people experience lower back pain when practicing these two movements. The reasons may include incorrect core exertion, poor posture, old injuries, or personal differences in body structure and mechanics. In other words, these moves aren't for everyone. If you're looking for some quality exercise that's gentle on your spine and low-impact, Hopes recommends focusing on overall core strengthening, especially the deep core muscles responsible for stabilizing the body, and choosing positions that won't easily irritate or aggravate back discomfort. Hopes reminds that if you currently have pain, injury or any health problem, be sure to consult a medical professional before starting a new exercise program. What is the movement of stick knee to chest? Plank knee tuck (Plank knee tuck, also known as Plank knee tuck, Plank knee tuck) is a bit like mountain climber's pose, except that instead of moving your knees forward and backward repeatedly, you have to fix the knee tuck position. The focus of this movement is to activate as many muscles as possible to help the body fight gravity and resist rotation. You need to raise your knees and pull them forward toward your chest while pushing hard on the ground with your hands

title_en: Taiwan stocks retracement and leverage crisis explodes! 929 "Financing Emergency List" Popular Group Stocks Exposed
summary_en: Taiwan stocks have corrected sharply from their highs recently. As market bulls seek support, the pressure on individual stocks to raise funds and cut off their stocks has fully erupted. title: 總是太體貼、太能忍？研究發現這些「好人特質」可能正傷害你的身體
summary: 善良、體貼、總是替別人著想，不一定只是一種個性，也可能成為健康的代價。《正常的迷思》整理多項研究發現，長期壓抑情緒、習慣隱忍與過度付出，可能影響免疫系統運作，並增加多種疾病風險。那些未曾表達的情緒，不一定會消失，而是可能持續留存在身體裡。作者： 嘉柏‧麥特, 丹尼爾・麥特1982 年，一項德國研究在倫敦舉行的第四屆國際癌症預防與檢測研討會上發表。研究發現，某些人格特質與乳癌之間存在密切關聯。參與者為五十六位因乳房腫塊而住院接受切片檢查的女性，研究團隊藉由評估她們是否具有情緒壓抑、合理化傾向、利他行為、迴避衝突，以及如卡洛琳所展現的過度自主、自我依賴等特質，推測其罹患乳癌或良性囊腫的可能性。最終，僅依據訪談結果，無論是進行訪談的評估者，或是從未接觸受試者的「盲評」人員，均能在癌症個案中達到高達 94% 的預測準確率，良性腫瘤個案的預測準確率亦達約 70%。此外，英國倫敦國王學院醫院的一項研究亦指出，相較於同期接受切片檢查但腫瘤為良性的對照組，乳房腫塊為惡性的女性展現出「極度壓抑憤怒及其他情緒」的比例明顯偏高。2000 年，《癌症護理》（Cancer Nursing）期刊調查

title_en: Are you always too considerate and tolerant? Study finds these "good guy traits" may be harming your body
summary_en: Being kind, considerate, and always thinking of others is not necessarily just a personality, it may also be the price of health. "The Myth of Normality" compiled a number of studies and found that long-term suppression of emotions, the habit of forbearance and excessive efforts may affect the operation of the immune system and increase the risk of various diseases. Those unexpressed emotions may not disappear but may remain in the body. Author: Gabor Matt, Daniel Matt In 1982, a German study was published at the Fourth International Symposium on Cancer Prevention and Detection in London. Research has found a strong link between certain personality traits and breast cancer. The participants were fifty-six women who were hospitalized for biopsy due to breast lumps. The research team speculated on the possibility of developing breast cancer or benign cysts by assessing whether they had emotional suppression, rationalization tendencies, altruistic behavior, conflict avoidance, and, like Caroline, excessive autonomy and self-reliance. In the end, based only on the interview results, both the evaluators who conducted the interviews and the "blind evaluators" who had never come into contact with the subjects were able to achieve a prediction accuracy of up to 94% in cancer cases, and the prediction accuracy in benign tumor cases was also about 70%. In addition, a study by King's College Hospital in London, UK, also pointed out that compared with a control group who underwent biopsies but had benign tumors during the same period, women with malignant breast lumps showed a significantly higher proportion of "extremely suppressed anger and other emotions." 2000, Cancer Nursing journal survey

title: 別急著稱讚孩子「懂事」：那些過度乖巧的背後，可能藏著害怕失去愛
summary: 孩子太懂事，真的是好事嗎？每個父母都希望孩子乖巧聽話，但真正值得思考的是：孩子是因為理解對錯而選擇懂事，還是因為害怕失去愛，而學會壓抑自己的情緒與需求？《正常的迷思》指出，當「乖巧」成為維繫關係的方式，那些被稱讚的特質，也可能一路影響孩子的人際關係、自我價值，甚至身心健康。作者： 嘉柏‧麥特, 丹尼爾・麥特孩童往往從小就接收到這樣的訊息：自己的某些面向是可被接受的，另一些則不然。若這種二分觀念被內化，必然會導致自我感的分裂。當大人惱怒地說出「乖孩子不會亂吼尖叫」，無意間傳遞出一個強而有力的威脅訊息：「生氣的小孩不值得被愛。」於是，當個「乖孩子」也就是壓抑憤怒、努力爭取父母認同，就可能成為孩子的生存策略。又或者，孩子會把「我要表現完美才配得上愛」的信念內化，走向完美主義，緊緊抓住某種被期待的角色認同，同時與自己那個更脆弱的面向切割。其實，孩子內心那份脆弱的自我，需要的是一種允許：允許他們可以失敗，甚至只是平凡，卻依然值得被愛與接納。雖然依附與本真這兩種需求都至關重要，但在生命的早期階段，依附無疑占了優先地位。因此，當這兩種需求在孩子的生命中產生衝突時，結果其實並不難預測。

title_en: Don’t rush to praise your children for being “sensible”: Behind those overly well-behaved people may be a fear of losing love.
summary_en: Is it really a good thing that children are too sensible? Every parent wants their children to be well-behaved and obedient, but what is really worth thinking about is: Do children choose to be sensible because they understand right and wrong, or do they learn to suppress their emotions and needs because they are afraid of losing love? "The Myth of Normality" points out that when "being well-behaved" becomes a way to maintain relationships, those qualities that are praised may also affect children's interpersonal relationships, self-worth, and even physical and mental health. Author: Gabor Matt, Daniel Matt Children often receive the message from an early age that some aspects of themselves are acceptable and others are not. If this dichotomous concept is internalized, it will inevitably lead to a split in the sense of self. When adults angrily say, "Good children don't yell and scream," they unintentionally send a powerful and threatening message: "An angry child is not worthy of love." Therefore, being a "good boy" means suppressing anger and striving to win the approval of parents, which may become a child's survival strategy. Or, the child will internalize the belief that "I have to be perfect to deserve love" and move toward perfectionism, clinging to a certain expected role identity while cutting off the more vulnerable side of himself. In fact, the fragile self in children needs a kind of permission: permission that they can fail, or even be ordinary, but still deserve to be loved and accepted. Although both attachment and authenticity needs are crucial, attachment undoubtedly takes precedence in the early stages of life. So when these two needs come into conflict in a child's life, the outcome is actually not that difficult to predict.

title_en: Are toxic marriages and jobs more harmful to health than being single and unemployed? Mind-body doctors redefine health for 40 years
summary_en: Editor's Note: The author, a Canadian physician known as the "Pioneer of Trauma Healing," created the original "Compassionate Inquiry (CI)" method to accurately analyze the subconscious dynamics and trauma paths behind the disease. More than 80 countries around the world have put it into clinical application. Combining four decades of clinical observation, neuroscientific research, and personal experience, he reveals a startling observation: the "normal" we take for granted is actually the result of a collective trauma. Many values ​​that are regarded as civilizational progress are eating away at our physical and mental health. In his works, overwork, depression, immune disorders, and unknown chronic symptoms are not single events, but a long-term accumulation of suppressed trauma, emotions, and needs. Author: Gabor Matt, Daniel Matt Do marriage, work and relationships really affect your health? The answer is yes, and the impact may be deeper than imagined. Gabor, author of "The Myth of Normality" and an authority on mind-body medicine. Matt pointed out that an unhappy marriage may be more harmful to the body than being single, and a bad job may even damage mental health more than unemployment. Parents' stress and emotions may also affect children's stress response and even increase the risk of asthma. He redefined health and pointed out that what truly affects the body and mind is not just personal living habits, but also the family, workplace and social environment in which we live. title_en: Why is pancreatic cancer so late when it is discovered? Doctors reveal 4 major warning signs missed by traditional health examinations

World experts predict that pancreatic cancer will become the second leading cause of cancer death in the world by 2035! From passive waiting to active management, the risk of pancreatic cancer is no longer just fate! Many patients have flown from as far away as the United States, the United Kingdom, Japan, and Singapore for help. She and the National Taiwan University team integrated more than 25 years of solid clinical data and unveiled the "zero-stage interception" defense map to the public for the first time. In the past, the tariffs for Taiwanese products exported to the United States were always higher than those of Japan and South Korea, putting them at a disadvantage in price competition. title_en: Is the 2,030-point plunge in Taiwan stocks just the beginning of deleveraging? Guo Zherong warned that 41,250 points may trigger a wave of financing cuts
summary_en: Guo Zherong, chief investment officer of Moore Investment Consulting, said that today the Taiwan stock market crashed 2,030 points in a single day, the third largest drop in history, and fell below the 42,000 mark. This wave of historical declines has made many investors feel extremely panicked. But I must remind everyone that falling below 42,000 may be just the beginning of market deleveraging. As the market collapses, brokerages have issued reminders of financing call orders, clearly stating that if the market point is revised down by about 400 points, to approximately 41,250 points, a large number of financing calls and beheadings will be triggered. This wave of selling is not unique to Taiwan. South Korea has also been deleveraging the stock market recently. The Korea Financial Supervisory Commission has raised margin requirements for positive 2-leverage ETFs such as Samsung and SK Hynix. The deadline is July 31. Some investors are unable to pay the margin, which in turn triggers a wave of beheadings. The Taiwan market is also currently undergoing this "positive 2 operation" to cleanse high-leverage and financing positions. This is like having "orthognathic surgery". You can only eat liquid food for a period of time after the surgery, and the process is very painful. The same is true for investing. If you buy in the wrong way and use excessive leverage to borrow money, you will be very miserable now. From a technical perspective, the market has successively fallen below the quarter line and the neckline of 42,000. The current line pattern shows a weak pattern with lower and lower highs and lower and lower bottoms. In the short term, no substantial support point can be found on the technical line pattern. If international stock markets continue to decline, Taiwan stocks may even drop further to around 40,000 points. When many people see the bottom, they start to panic. Is this an AI bubble? We might as well

title_en: The risks of "Four Loans under One roof" are controllable! Financial Supervisory Commission: China National Bank has an extremely low proportion of multi-loan customers and plans to promote cross-industry joint defense
summary_en: The outside world continues to pay attention to the phenomenon of "four loans under the same roof" of housing loans, car loans, credit and stock financing caused by the boom in Taiwan's stock market, which may lead to a credit risk crisis. The Financial Supervisory Commission said today (28th) that after consulting some banks, the proportion of customers holding two or more multiple loans at the same time is "extremely low", accounting for only a low single-digit percentage.

title_en: If the tariff on passenger cars is reduced to zero, the worst-case scenario is that tax losses will exceed 60.1 billion yuan and the livelihoods of more than 80,000 people will be at risk.
summary_en: With the outside world concerned about zero tariffs on imported passenger cars, the Ministry of Finance report pointed out that according to the tax expenditure assessment report proposed by the Ministry of Economic Affairs in the past, whether analyzed in two scenarios, optimistic or pessimistic, the net tax loss is about 52.3 billion yuan to 60.1 billion yuan, and it will also affect the output value of about 84.774 billion yuan and the livelihood of 82,600 related employees.

title_en: Qing'an 3.0 loan terms are released, and clear penalties for violations are exposed
summary_en: The Executive Yuan has recently approved the Ministry of Finance’s Young People’s Home Purchase Preferential Loan (hereinafter referred to as Qing’an Loan) 3.0 plan, which will be implemented from August 1. Loan objects and qualification conditions include interest subsidy renewal, the maximum loan limit for married families is 10 million yuan for general objects, the maximum limit for newlywed families is increased to 12 million yuan, and the maximum limit for families with minor children is 15 million yuan, and the new age, income and total house price and other loan application qualification conditions are added. The one-time loan limit will be continued and cross-department data verification will continue to handle cases that fail to meet the requirements to truly assist families who do not own their own homes to buy a house and settle down.

title: 超市壽司引爆家庭衝突！日本高齡夫妻養老金見底　遭孝子兒痛心怒嗆
summary: 日本高齡化社會問題加劇，一對七旬夫婦因退休金不足，長期仰賴長子資助，卻因一盒壽司引爆家庭財務衝突，兒子崩潰怒吼「別拖累我」，揭示了夾心世代沉重的經濟壓力。專家指出，日本高齡夫婦普遍面臨每月收支短缺的困境，若持續依賴子女援助，恐將引發嚴重的家庭財務危機。理財專家小川洋平建議，民眾應及早進行收支視覺化管理，並善用政府扶助資源及退休金延後請領制度，才能有效緩解高齡經濟壓力，避免下一代陷入財務崩潰的惡性循環，為退休生活做好完善規劃。

title: 韓國爆新金融危機？散戶少年股神慘賠變街友　地下錢莊暴利5000%
summary: 韓股今年累計爆發高達8次熔斷，引爆極度嚴重的斷頭潮與金融危機。節目《新聞線》主持人呂惠敏指出，韓國股市的激烈波動甚至影響到全世界。財經專家邱敏寬對此進一步深入解析，指出韓國證監單位已出面示警，由於韓國人投資風格極度熱衷槓桿與高額博弈，且商品保證金門檻極低，導致每次股市發生熔斷，估計都有15%至18%的散戶遭到強制平倉斷頭。為了遏止失控的投機風潮，韓國官方決定自7月31日起將ETF保證金一口氣提高兩倍，大幅拉高交易門檻，預期將引發大規模的資金離場潮。

title_en: Strong earthquake hits TSMC's Kumamoto factory. Legal person: Must observe whether the raw material supply chain is delayed
summary_en: TSMC's joint venture JASM plant in Kumamoto suffered a strong earthquake of magnitude 7.1. People familiar with factory operations said that although TSMC's plant machines had been equipped with anti-seismic equipment in advance, the intensity of the earthquake was extremely high and there were constant aftershocks. It is inevitable that wafers will be broken during the fab process and in the storage area. This will also test the adaptability of TSMC's overseas factories. However, since the Kumamoto Plant 1 has already mass-produced products such as automotive and image sensors using mature processes, and the proportion of its production capacity is low, TSMC should not be greatly affected.

title: 無人機條例出經委會　軍工股這2檔必收
summary: 立法院針對無人機條例展開聯席審查，雖朝野對預算規模與技術細節仍有歧見，導致14個版本均保留送出協商，但跨黨派已達成建立非紅供應鏈與強化資安的共識。法人指出，此舉確立了本土無人機產業長線發展基調。儘管短期預算審查進度可能影響軍工股走勢，但隨著軍用無人機標案落實，預期自2027年起將實質挹注相關廠商如長榮航太、雷虎的營運成長。投資人應密切關注政策推進進度與標案細節，並留意軍工族群在預算審核期間的短線股價波動風險，審慎評估投資布局。

summary: 交通部長陳世凱日前至財團法人車輛安全審驗中心（車安中心）及財團法人車輛研究測試中心（車輛中心）視導。陳世凱此行實地觀摩「TNCAP行人頭部衝擊」與「側方立柱撞擊」等試驗，了解我國車輛安全審驗、評等及檢測量能。陳部長高度肯定團隊的專業表現，並期許未來持續深化車輛安全管理，攜手打造更安全的道路交通環境，守護全民行車安全。

title_en: Chen Shikai Vision Vehicle Safety Center affirms TNCAP’s achievements and creates an open and transparent car purchase safety rating
summary_en: Minister of Transportation Chen Shikai recently visited the Vehicle Safety Inspection Center (Vehicle Safety Center) and the Vehicle Research and Testing Center (Vehicle Center). During this trip, Chen Shikai observed on-site tests such as the "TNCAP Pedestrian Head Impact" and "Side Pillar Impact" tests to learn about my country's vehicle safety inspection, rating and testing capabilities. Minister Chen highly recognized the professional performance of the team and looked forward to continuing to deepen vehicle safety management in the future, working together to create a safer road traffic environment and protect the driving safety of all people.

title: 快訊／熊本強震　台積電最新回應：員工安全無虞！部分建廠工程已暫停
summary: 日本熊本縣28日下午4點27分左右發生7級強震，最大震度7.1，深度僅10公里。台積電熊本廠所在的菊陽町，震度達5+。台積電晚間9時許發出聲明指出，JASM子公司所有員工安全無虞，且已完成JASM廠區建築震後損害檢查。各項細部檢查與詳細影響評估作業持續進行中。至於新廠的部分建廠工程因安全考量目前暫停中。

title_en: It’s no good to pretend to be cute or cool! Job Bank reveals resume photos of top ten NGs
summary_en: The labor market is shrouded in the shadow of labor shortage, and the conditions for companies to recruit talents are gradually relaxing. Yes123 job search website's latest "Company Evaluation Internet Generation Job Seeker Survey" released on the 28th pointed out that on average, companies have to interview about 18.1 fresh people before they can find a suitable talent. Although the admission rate does not seem to be high, 55.2% of the companies admitted that due to the lack of jobs during this year's graduation season, the admission standards were "revised and relaxed", which was higher than the 53.8% in last year's survey.

title_en: Health Coin is planned to go on the road in September. The National Health Administration reveals the awards: it can be exchanged for chicken breasts and tea eggs from 4 major supermarkets.
summary_en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare plans to launch the "Health Coin" in September this year, including the first phase of adult health examinations, publicly funded cancer screenings, three major vaccinations, and lifestyle assessments, with a total of four major projects. Shen Jingfen, director of the National Health Service of the Ministry of Health and Welfare, revealed today that health coins can be exchanged for prizes, mainly "healthy food" from supermarkets. Currently, all four major supermarkets will join. The redeemable products include mineral water, chicken breasts, tea eggs, etc., food that meets the health concept, and all items must be reviewed by the National Health Service.

title: 中研院揭大腦演化之謎！研究成果登國際權威期刊
summary: 高度複雜的人類大腦如何演化而來，一直是演化生物學的重要謎題。中研院細胞與個體生物學研究所研究員游智凱帶領的團隊，首度建構文昌魚大腦的「3D空間細胞類型圖譜」，發現負責人類思考、記憶與決策等高階認知功能的大腦皮質，並非共同祖先脊索動物原有的構造，而是在脊椎動物演化過程中逐步形成，為理解人類大腦的起源提供重要線索。研究成果於2026年7月發布於國際期刊《科學進展》(Science Advances)。

title_en: Academia Sinica reveals the mystery of brain evolution! Research results published in authoritative international journals
summary_en: How the highly complex human brain evolved has always been an important mystery in evolutionary biology. A team led by You Zhikai, a researcher at the Institute of Cell and Individual Biology of Academia Sinica, constructed a "3D spatial cell type map" of the amphioxus brain for the first time and found that the cerebral cortex, which is responsible for high-order cognitive functions such as human thinking, memory and decision-making, is not the original structure of the common ancestor chordates, but was gradually formed during the evolution of vertebrates, providing important clues for understanding the origin of the human brain. The research results will be published in the international journal "Science Advances" in July 2026.

title: 史上第三慘！台股急殺2030點滿地傷 國巨單月股價「腰斬」聯發科、台達電摔跌停｜Yahoo財經掃描
summary:
台股上演大跳水！今日開低走低，終場暴跌2,030.83點，寫下史上第三大收盤跌點，跌幅4.65%，收41,603.36點，不僅失守42,000點，也創近兩個月低點，成交金額8,110.51億元；台積電(2330)下跌70元或2.98%，收2,280元。盤面電子、傳產與金融全面承壓，聯發科(2454)、台達電(2308)、聯電(2303)、國巨*(2327)、華邦電(2344)及南亞科(2408)等權值與記憶體股均跌停。盤面上僅少數個股逆勢突圍，其中隆銘綠能(3018)、光鼎(6226)亮燈漲停等更成為市場焦點；光學與航空股也有零星買盤，聯一光(3441)逆勢大漲逾9%，東典光電(6588)、台灣虎航(6757)及華航(2610)上漲，長榮航(2618)也收紅，成為今天弱勢盤面的少數亮點。

亞股今日跌多漲少，半導體賣壓從美股一路燒向亞洲。韓股在SK海力士與三星電子領跌下重挫10.84%，盤中再度觸發熔斷；日本記憶體龍頭鎧俠重挫18.33%，拖累日經指數下跌3.95%；上證指數也收低1.16%，僅港股逆勢上漲0.41%。 


科技股方面，輝達傳出可能為OpenAI資料中心計畫提供最高2,500億美元擔保，引發財務負擔疑慮，股價重挫4.99%至196.51美元、跌破200美元，也讓出全球市值第二寶座，由蘋果超車奪下全球市值王寶座。中國記憶體晶片商長鑫存儲於上海掛牌首日較發行價暴漲逾4.6倍，登上A股市值龍頭，加上中國傳出已能製造本土深紫外光微影設備，競爭及產能擴張疑慮重創全球晶片股；艾司摩爾ADR下跌5.80%，超微下挫5.17%，美光下跌2.25%，SanDisk更重摔11.02%，台積電ADR也收低1.07%。相較之下，微軟上漲1.90%、蘋果走高1.20%，為大型科技股提供部分支撐。

title: 九州發生規模7.1強震，台積電熊本廠區人員依應變程序疏散與清點中
summary: 【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】日本九州發生規模7.1強震，台積電(2330)有廠區位於熊本，公司今日證實，有依緊急應變程序進行人員室內及室外疏散，也正清點中。台積電官方表示，今（28）日日本時間16時許，日本熊本發生地震，台積電位於日本熊本的JASM廠區達疏散標準，以人員安全為第一優先，依緊急應變程序進行人員室內及室外疏散與清點中。台積電旗下熊本JASM，股東包括Sony、電裝（Denso）及豐田汽車（Toyota），廠區位於熊本縣菊陽町，目前一廠已經量產，主要以22/28奈米以及12/16奈米，生產車用、工業、消費電子與CMOS影像感測器等晶片為主，月產能為五萬片。鄰近的二廠，規劃直接導入3奈米，目前建置中。

title_en: Huida’s insider is revealed/cases of AI server theft are on the rise. Huida’s manager was involved in illegally obtaining B300 chips and was impounded
summary_en: Under the AI ​​wave, China’s penetration of Taiwan has extended from the military to the chip field. The Keelung District Prosecutor's Office investigated the smuggling of Supermicro AI servers equipped with Huida's high-end chips into China. It was shockingly discovered that there was an insider inside Huida, the global AI server overlord. Zhang Denglong, the company's senior business manager, was suspected of colluding with Supermicro's business manager Wang Xiang who was in custody. Yi and other defendants issued certificates to allow servers loaded with B300 chips to eventually flow into China. Prosecutors secretly searched and interviewed Zhang Denglong last Friday. After the interrogation, they applied to the court for a detention ban and were granted. Seven defendants have been detained in the case, and the case continues to escalate.

title_en: Huida’s inner ghost revealed 1/Smuggled drugs and was sentenced to death for stealing chips and sentenced to 5 years. The gang abandoned drugs and switched to selling AI chips to make tens of billions.
summary_en: The Keelung District Prosecutor’s Office investigated the Huida chip smuggling case and uncovered the mole! Huida manager Zhang Denglong was detained. According to this magazine's investigation, the United States has an "Export Control Reform Act" for AI, biotechnology and semiconductors, which strictly restricts the export of high-end products. If you smuggle related chips in the United States, you can be sentenced to up to 20 years in prison. Taiwan has no corresponding special laws. The most severe smuggling of chips can only be based on breach of trust or forged documents. The crime of writing is punishable by a prison sentence of up to five years. Compared with drug trafficking, which can be punished by death, the legal risks of smuggling chips are significantly lower. The Taiwanese gangsters who were originally engaged in drug trafficking began to transform, set up technology companies, and invested in high-reward and low-risk chip smuggling. The total illegal amount in the case reached tens of billions of dollars.

summary_en: Taiwan and the United States jointly investigated the case of Huida chip smuggling into China and made a major breakthrough recently! The task force cracked the cellphones of six defendants, including Supermicro business managers Wang Xiangyi and You, who were detained and banned. After restoring conversation records and comparing relevant documents, they found that the key to China's ability to break through U.S. President Trump's chip ban and obtain a large number of Huida's high-end chips was the cooperation of insiders within Huida.

title_en: The ghost inside Huida appears 3/The smuggling of chips is very deep. Both TSMC and Huida are rumored to be a coincidence in their silence and death.
summary_en: In addition to the Huida chip smuggling case, China has also extended its claws to TSMC, the "sacred mountain that protects the country", and is eager to get its hands on its confidential technology. Former TSMC deputy manager Chen Zhijian and Hong Kong businessman Ding Xiaohu planned to set up a semiconductor materials analysis company in China to poach Taiwanese talents. Chen Zhijian used his position to steal 21 national core key technologies and business secrets from TSMC and planned to hand them over to China. Fortunately, TSMC discovered and urgently recovered the stolen goods. In response, the High People's Procuratorate prosecuted Chen Zhijian in accordance with the National Security Law and the Trade Secrets Law on July 20. title: 買家補庫存，中國7月液化天然氣進口量料連三升
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，隨著買家補充低於平均水準的庫存，並為盛夏高溫期間空調制冷需求上升做準備，中國7月份液化天然氣(LNG)進口量年比值有機會連續第三個月成長。根據大宗商品數據分析機構Kpler的船舶追蹤數據，7月LNG到貨量預計約為560萬噸，年比值成長3.5%。此前6月進口量已成長8.3%。這種持續回升可能加劇亞洲買家之間對現貨資源的競爭。其他亞洲進口國目前正積極尋找替代貨源，以彌補卡達供應中斷帶來的缺口。美國和伊朗的衝突已嚴重影響波斯灣地區天然氣出口，而該地區通常占中國LNG進口量約三分之一。儘管敵對行動的暫停舒緩了市場對更大規模供應衝擊的擔憂，但區域內強勁採購需求仍可能為價格提供支撐。Kpler液化天然氣分析師Go Katayama表示，預計中國LNG儲罐在7月和8月的充裝率預計將維持在約47%，9月小幅升至48%。Katayama指出，庫存水準仍低於過去五年的季節性平均值和去年同期值，為沿海地區進一步補充庫存留出了空間，同時也將繼續對亞洲即期LNG價格形成支撐。

title: AI基建需求續旺，香港6月份出口飆升53.4%創逾40年最大增幅
summary: 【財訊快報／劉敏夫】外電報導指出，數據顯示，受全球人工智能熱潮帶來的強勁需求推動，香港6月份出口創下四十多年來最大增幅，並達到歷史最高水準。香港政府統計處週一稍晚公佈的數據顯示，香港6月份出口年比值飆升53.4%，創1984年以來最大增幅。當月出口額由此增至6,411億港幣(818億美元)的紀錄最高水準。這一增幅超過了受訪經濟專家預估中值的43.8%，也超過了5月份40.8%的增幅。香港特區政府數據顯示，6月出口激增的驅動力主要來自全球AI基礎設施建設推動的電子產品需求成長，其中電機及零組件、數據處理設備和電信設備的出口成長最為顯著。香港政府發言人在聲明中表示，展望未來，全球對人工智能相關電子產品的蓬勃需求應繼續為香港商品貿易表現帶來支持。然而，近期中東地緣政治緊張局勢再度升溫，值得注意。香港的貿易幾乎全都是轉口貿易。這座城市自己很少生產AI硬體，但已成為高科技產品進出中國的重要通道，以及欣欣向榮的亞洲AI貿易的一個關鍵點。香港6月對新加坡的出口成長了83%，對台灣的出口成長了80%，對中國內地的出口成長了59%。其對美國的出口成長了114%。

title_en: Lianzheng Center provides financial leverage information to securities companies, and two major premises for the new system are proposed
summary_en: In order to solve the problem of "cross-industry stacking" of people's stock-buying leverage but there is a blind spot in information disclosure, people familiar with the matter revealed that the Financial Supervisory Commission recently invited the stock exchange, the Liangzheng Center, the Bank Association and the Securities Dealers Association to hold a meeting to discuss the content of the public's financing leverage information exchange in the banking and securities dealer systems. Currently, it is most likely The breakthrough will be to allow securities companies to provide the total amount of loans of the borrower in the entire banking system through the Lianzheng Center under the condition of de-identification. That is to say, the total amount of data will be provided, without providing individual bank transaction details, as a prerequisite for the Lianzheng Center to provide public leverage information to securities companies.

title: 太陽誘電擬於9/1起再度調漲MLCC，稱漲價後仍無法保證交期
summary: 【財訊快報／記者陳浩寧報導】日本MLCC大廠太陽誘電(Taiyo Yuden)繼宣布調漲包括MLCC、電感及鋁電等產品後，昨日再傳出，將於9月1日起再針對MLCC調漲價格，然太陽誘電也強調，調漲價格後仍無法保證交期符合要求。太陽誘電指出，面對近來原材料及材料成本持續大幅上漲，公司至今已盡最大努力推動成本削減，但目前成本上升的幅度已達僅憑公司自身努力無法吸收的程度。上個月曾提出一次價格調整請求，但截至目前仍無法完全吸收成本，因此再次提出價格調整申請。自2026年9月1日起，以公司出貨產品為準，將再次調整產品價格。此外，在供貨方面，太陽誘電強調，目前整個產業仍無法完全滿足需求，持續存在無法依照交期供貨的情況。即使此次價格調整後，公司仍無法保證能完全依照原訂交期交貨，但將盡最大努力協調並改善供貨狀況。

summary: 台股今（28）日猶如黑色星期二，開盤即遭遇血洗，在台積電領跌下，指數如自由落體般一度暴跌逾1,800點，失守42,000點大關，市場恐慌情緒飆升，電子、半導體及AI概念股成為殺盤重心，這不僅是半導體地緣風險的單一衝擊，更疊加中東局勢、油價與利率前景疑慮，以及本週全球「超級央行週」與科技巨頭財報揭曉的高度不安，台股老先覺杜金龍建議，有錢可分批買，沒錢也不要恐慌停損，等待回彈再調節持股。

title_en: It's not a false alarm! This is actually a precursor to a stroke! Five indicators tell you risks
summary_en: Text/Physician Bai Yingyu (first published on March 11, 2025) "Abba, why don't you sit properly?" After hope Lian came back from going to the toilet, she found that her father seemed to be sitting crookedly. "@#$%^!@$^%" Dad's response was a little difficult to understand. "Abba, what are you talking about?" Xi Lian asked nervously, "What's wrong with you?" Dad pointed to his right leg, rubbed it a few times, took a breath and said slowly: "Num... numb... numb..." Xi Lian rubbed his father's leg, massaged it a few times, and asked, "Did you sit for too long? Do you want to get up and walk?" Mrs. Lian asked, "Dad's legs are numb and his speech is unclear. Could it be a mini-stroke? Dad also has high blood pressure and diabetes. Do I need to go to the hospital?" Transient cerebral ischemia causes a "mini-stroke." What we often call "stroke" means that the blood supply to the brain is blocked, causing the brain to become incapacitated without oxygen. The common colloquial term "mini-stroke" stands for transient ischemic attack (TIA). In fact, the principle is the same as a stroke. The blood supply to the brain is blocked. However, the symptoms do not last long. Within 24 hours, the blood circulation in the brain recovers on its own. Because the symptoms of transient ischemic attack (TIA) come and go quickly, sometimes patients and their families do not realize that this is a problem and do not feel that there is immediate danger. However, many patients don’t know that they may not be so lucky next time. Patients with minor strokes had more strokes within the past three months.

title_en: The Ministry of Health and Welfare announces the results of an independent investigation into the poisonous oil incident, and White House officials shirk responsibility: they only review the industry and not themselves
summary_en: The Zoomlion poisonous oil incident has been spreading for nearly a month, and the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare released an investigation report today. Chen Qinglong, the chief convener of the People's Party Legislative Yuan Caucus, said that it only reviews the industry and does not review itself. Is the Food and Drug Administration of the Ministry of Health and Welfare using this to shirk its responsibility? People's Party legislator Chen Zhaozi also questioned that the poisonous oil has long been swallowed by the people. As long as manufacturers are self-disciplined in everything, then why do we need the government?

title: 鄉親頻勸進！曾掌竹北8年 前市長何淦銘評估再戰竹北
summary: 竹北市長選舉牽動新竹縣長選情，曾任2屆竹北市長的無黨籍何淦銘近日鬆口考慮回鍋。他表示，近期不少地方人士及鄉親勸進，目前正審慎評估；若正式參選，憑藉8年執政資歷及基層實力，將為藍白綠競逐再添變數。

title_en: Folks urge us to come in! Having been in charge of Zhubei for 8 years, former mayor He Ganming evaluates the future of Zhubei
summary_en: The Zhubei mayoral election has affected the Hsinchu county mayoral election. He Ganming, an independent who served two terms as Zhubei mayor, recently relented and considered returning to the job. He said that many local people and villagers have recently persuaded him to join, and he is currently carefully evaluating it. If he formally runs for the election, with his eight years of experience in power and grassroots strength, it will add another variable to the blue, white and green competition.

title_en: Non-educational director Changhua County Education Director will be replaced by Administrative Director Wu Lanmei
summary_en: The secondment period of Cai Jintian, director of the Education Department of the Changhua County Government, has expired, and the county government has approved that Wu Lanmei, director of the administrative department, will take over as the director of education. Since Wu Lanmei is not from the education field, it is quite surprising that she can qualify. Especially since education issues are complicated, it will be difficult to take over. However, people in the education field believe that she may be able to break away from the stereotypes of the education field and be able to make a difference.

title_en: It is reported on the Internet that China Union borrows beans through back-end relations. The Ministry of Economic Affairs clarifies: Stable supply of raw materials and coordinated turnover
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Xie Yixuan, Taipei, 27th) A video posted online showed that China United Chairman Cai Qingsong mentioned that he had borrowed 8,000 tons of soybeans from Taiwan Sugar, and was insinuated that "there is someone in the DPRK." The Ministry of Economic Affairs clarified tonight that this incident was due to the impact of the epidemic in 2021. There was a shortage of soybeans and other feed grains on the market. The turnover was coordinated to stabilize supply. The industry has returned all of them. This is a measure to stabilize raw materials and has nothing to do with the backend.

title_en: Taiwan’s public blue carbon restoration project results turn abandoned fish ponds into carbon sink wetlands
summary_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045) responded to the "International Day for the Protection of Mangrove Ecosystems" on July 26 and released the scientific experimental results of the "Taiwan Big Blue Carbon Mangrove Restoration Project" for the first time on the 27th. The 2.7-hectare mangrove restoration site located in Taijiang National Park in Tainan City has transformed from a carbon emission (source) to a carbon storage (sink) system after long-term monitoring. The soil organic carbon increased by 32% compared with the baseline before mangrove planting. The ratio of organic carbon that is not easily decomposed also increased simultaneously, indicating that after carbon enters the sediment, it gradually forms a stable storage state.

title: 愛吃飯又怕胖？醫揭這種澱粉不只不長肉，還能幫你燃脂防癌
summary:
文／曾嶔元醫師

對於熱愛白飯、麵條與馬鈴薯的人來說，「澱粉」兩個字常常伴隨罪惡感。但如果有一種澱粉，不僅不容易讓你發胖，還能餵養腸道益菌、提升胰島素敏感性，甚至可能降低大腸癌風險，你會不會重新愛上碳水化合物？「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，對於喜歡吃澱粉的人來說，一個聰明的解套方式，就是選擇抗性澱粉。

抗性澱粉的特別之處，在於它獨特的消化路徑。曾嶔元說明，一般澱粉會在小腸中被分解成糖類，但抗性澱粉能完整通過小腸，直到抵達大腸。在那裡，它不會被人體的消化酵素分解，而是成為結腸中數十億益生菌的「食物」。這個過程稱為發酵，也讓抗性澱粉成為一種天然的益生元。益生菌藉此大量繁殖，優化腸道菌群，進而提升消化與免疫功能。對於進行高強度訓練的人而言，健康的腸道更是恢復與表現的關鍵。

當腸道微生物分解抗性澱粉時，會產生一類稱為短鏈脂肪酸（縮寫為SCFAs）的代謝物，其中最重要的是丁酸鹽。這些SCFAs本身就具有調節新陳代謝與免疫力的潛力。更值得一提的是，抗性澱粉帶來的益處，並不需要像某些益生菌飲品那樣付出高昂的代價，卻能自然地支持腸道與整體健康。

多重效益：從腸道健康到血糖
