title_en: Love to eat but afraid of getting fat? Doctors reveal that this kind of starch not only doesn’t make you gain weight, it can also help you burn fat and prevent cancer.
summary_en:
Text/Dr. Zeng Yiyuan

For those who love rice, noodles and potatoes, the word "starch" is often associated with a sense of guilt. But if there was a starch that not only prevented you from gaining weight, but also fed good intestinal bacteria, improved insulin sensitivity, and might even reduce the risk of colorectal cancer, would you fall in love with carbohydrates again? "Medical Sherlock Holmes" Dr. Zeng Jinyuan points out in his new book "Precision Diet" that for people who like to eat starch, a smart way to solve the problem is to choose resistant starch.

What’s special about resistant starch is its unique digestion pathway. Zeng Jinyuan explained that starch is generally broken down into sugars in the small intestine, but resistant starch can pass through the small intestine completely until it reaches the large intestine. There, it is not broken down by the body's digestive enzymes, but becomes "food" for the billions of probiotic bacteria in the colon. This process, called fermentation, also makes resistant starch a natural prebiotic. Probiotics multiply in large quantities and optimize intestinal flora, thereby improving digestive and immune functions. For those who train intensively, a healthy gut is key to recovery and performance.

When gut microbes break down resistant starch, they produce a class of metabolites called short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), the most important of which is butyrate. These SCFAs themselves have the potential to regulate metabolism and immunity. What's more worth mentioning is that the benefits of resistant starch do not require the high cost of some probiotic drinks, but they can naturally support intestinal and overall health.

Multiple benefits: from gut health to blood sugar

title_en: Market rumors say that the terms of the party, government and military will be relaxed, and Taiwan is likely to buy Kaibao. Kaibao said: "We have to ask the buyer."
summary_en: Kaibo Broadband, a fiber optic Internet service provider under Kaibo, launched the "Kaibao New Speed ​​Generation 10G" service on the 27th and joined hands with Taiwan Broadband (3045) to promote value-added audio and video services related to broadband networks. The market is paying attention to the amendments to some provisions of the Cable Broadcasting and Television Law that have relaxed the "party, government, and military provisions" to an upper limit of 1%. Taiwan is expected to legally acquire Kaibo in the future. Lu Ronghui, chairman of Kaibo Broadband, said that he welcomes the loosening of laws and the opening of relevant policies, which will definitely help capital flow into the industry. He also hopes that AI or content manufacturers can join in to promote win-win development of Taiwan's overall digital infrastructure and the consumer side.

title: 少吃豬油、奶油就更健康？一場颶風意外推翻飲食迷思
summary:
文／曾嶔元醫師


豬油、牛油、奶油，今天多數人聞之色變。但如果飽和脂肪真的是心血管殺手，為什麼吃得最油的那幾個民族，反而沒有現代文明病？被譽為「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，在現代文明病出現之前，人類數千年來賴以為生的食用油，像是豬油、牛油、羊油、奶油和棕櫚油，都是以飽和脂肪為主。許多原始部落的飲食中，飽和脂肪的比例也很高。南太平洋的托克勞人飲食中60％是飽和脂肪，肯亞倫迪爾人的飲食63％是飽和脂肪，非洲馬賽人的飲食66％是飽和脂肪，北美洲北部因紐特人的飲食中75％是飽和脂肪。

一場颶風，意外促成人類飲食的天然實驗
這些部落的飲食中含有這麼多飽和脂肪，會比較不健康嗎？答案可能出乎意料。1966年，一場颶風迫使托克勞人移民到紐西蘭。後來的「托克勞島民移民研究」發現，移民到紐西蘭後，托克勞人的飲食中飽和脂肪攝取量減少，碳水化合物和糖的攝取量增加。然而，與留在托克勞的居民相比，紐西蘭移民的血清總膽固醇、低密度脂蛋白膽固醇和三酸甘油酯濃度普遍較高，而高密度脂蛋白膽固醇濃度較低。這意味著，移民到紐西蘭後，托克勞人吃得比較不油了，但心血管疾病的風險卻反而增加了。

title_en: Is it healthier to eat less lard and butter? A hurricane unexpectedly overturns diet myths
summary_en:
Text/Dr. Zeng Yiyuan


Lard, butter, butter, most people today are disgusted by the smell. But if saturated fat is really a cardiovascular killer, why do the nations that eat the most fat not have the diseases of modern civilization? Dr. Zeng Jiyuan, known as "Medical Sherlock Holmes", points out in his new book "Precision Diet" that before the emergence of modern civilization diseases, the edible oils that humans have relied on for thousands of years, such as lard, beef tallow, mutton fat, butter and palm oil, were mainly saturated fats. The diets of many primitive tribes also contained high proportions of saturated fat. The diet of the Tokelauans in the South Pacific is 60% saturated fat, the diet of the Arendil people of Kenya is 63% saturated fat, the diet of the Maasai people of Africa is 66% saturated fat, and the diet of the Inuit people of northern North America is 75% saturated fat.

A hurricane unexpectedly prompted a natural experiment in human diet
Could it be that the diets of these tribes contained so much saturated fat that they were unhealthy? The answer may be surprising. In 1966, a hurricane forced Tokelauans to immigrate to New Zealand. Later, the "Tokelau Islander Immigration Study" found that after immigrating to New Zealand, Tokelauans' dietary intake of saturated fat decreased and their intake of carbohydrates and sugar increased. However, New Zealand immigrants generally had higher serum total cholesterol, low-density lipoprotein cholesterol, and triglyceride concentrations and lower high-density lipoprotein cholesterol concentrations than residents who remained in Tokelau. This means that after immigrating to New Zealand, Tokelauans eat less fat, but their risk of cardiovascular disease increases.

title: 說真話的人為何最先出局？看透職場潛規則：會忍的人才能活到最後
summary:
蘇味道（648—705）是蘇東坡一家的遠祖，進士出身，文章寫得好，數度官至宰相。他的生存哲學是圓滑處世，在官場上不樹敵、不逞強，凡事皆依中庸之道。他曾言：「凡事不宜過於鮮明，過於決絕則易遭譴責，模糊地遊走於兩端之間即可。」眾人以「蘇模稜」相稱，這便是「模稜兩可」一詞的由來。

貶貶升升，乃武則天時代的官場常態，大臣官位變動之快，猶如年號更替。蘇味道也幾度因小事遭貶，又數次被召回為相。他從未被牽連於謀反案，這與他在武則天晚年與張氏兄弟建立良好關係，以及善於借祥瑞事件撰文取悅武則天有關。兩相對比，一個宰相訓練自己到「毫無脾氣」，另一個宰相則始終「不表態」，可見當時官場之凶險，想好好活，最佳策略即為「明哲保身」，或逢迎聖意。

當說真話成為一種危險，政治還能清明嗎？女皇武則天登基後的十五年間，朝臣無不在酷吏政治的風暴之中苟延殘喘。武則天對於「酷吏遊戲」樂此不疲。這些酷吏既是獵犬，也是替罪羔羊，他們的權勢與生殺大權，都操控在武則天手中。她當女皇後性情變得更為反覆，愛之欲其生，恨之則欲其死，恩寵與滅族只在一念之間。

title_en: Why are the people who tell the truth the first to be eliminated? See through the unspoken rules of the workplace: only those who can endure will survive to the end
summary_en:
Su Weiwei (648-705) was the distant ancestor of Su Dongpo's family. He was a Jinshi scholar. He was good at writing articles and was promoted to prime minister several times. His philosophy of life is to behave tactfully, not to make enemies in the officialdom, not to be aggressive, and to follow the golden mean in everything. He once said: "Everything should not be too clear. If it is too decisive, it will be easily criticized. Just wander vaguely between the two extremes." Everyone calls him "Su ambiguous", which is the origin of the word "ambiguous".

Demotion, demotion and promotion were the norm in the officialdom during Wu Zetian's era. The official positions of ministers changed as fast as the change of reign titles. Su Weiwei was demoted several times for trivial matters, and was recalled as prime minister several times. He has never been implicated in a rebellion case, which is related to the fact that he established a good relationship with the Zhang brothers in Wu Zetian's later years and was good at writing articles to please Wu Zetian through auspicious events. Comparing the two, one prime minister trained himself to "have no temper", while the other prime minister never expressed his stance. This shows that the officialdom at that time was dangerous. If you want to live a good life, the best strategy is to "preserve yourself wisely" or to cater to the holy will.

When telling the truth becomes a danger, can politics still be clear? In the fifteen years after Empress Wu Zetian ascended the throne, all court officials were struggling to survive in the storm of cruel politics. Wu Zetian never tired of the "cool official game". These cruel officials were both hunting dogs and scapegoats. Their power and power of life and death were all controlled by Wu Zetian. As a queen, her temperament became even more capricious. She wanted to live if she loved her, and wanted to die if she hated her. Favor and annihilation were just a matter of thoughts.

title: 什麼都不爭，為何仍被當成敵人？權力組織最殘酷的生存困局
summary:
一個人在組織裡已經退到不能再退，從不爭功、不表態，也不違逆上位者，為什麼仍然無法換來安全？因為在高度猜忌的權力場裡，你是否忠誠，有時並不重要。只要你的身分足以構成威脅，沉默會被視為隱忍，退讓也可能被解讀成等待時機。更殘酷的是，上位者甚至不必親自動手，只要默許身邊的人逼供、誣告與清算，就足以將一個人推到絕境。一千三百多年前，武則天與兒子李旦之間，便上演過這樣一場無法自證的生存困局。作家吳淡如在《武則天攻略》中寫下這段母子相疑、酷吏環伺的宮廷往事。

李旦一定時常在心中低語：「母親啊，我真的是妳親生的嗎？我到底犯了什麼錯？只因為我姓李，就註定有原罪嗎？我要怎麼做，妳才會滿意？要怎麼做，我對妳才不是威脅……為什麼妳要對我步步相逼？我什麼都可以讓給妳啊。」這些話，他只能無聲地吶喊，卻不敢洩露半分情緒。

title_en: If we don’t fight for anything, why are we still treated as enemies? The most cruel survival dilemma of power organizations
summary_en:
If a person has retreated to the point of no return in the organization and never seeks credit, expresses his position, or disobeys his superiors, why can't he still be able to gain safety? Because in a highly suspicious power field, sometimes it doesn't matter whether you are loyal or not. As long as your identity is enough to pose a threat, silence will be seen as forbearance, and giving in may also be interpreted as waiting for an opportunity. What's even more cruel is that the superiors don't even have to do it themselves. They only need to acquiesce to the people around them to force confessions, false accusations and liquidation, which is enough to push a person to a desperate situation. More than 1,300 years ago, Wu Zetian and his son Li Dan had such an impossible survival dilemma. The writer Wu Danru wrote about this palace past where mother and son were suspicious and surrounded by cruel officials in "Wu Zetian Strategy".

Li Dan must always be whispering in his heart: "Mother, am I really your biological child? What mistake have I made? Just because my surname is Li, am I destined to be guilty of original sin? What should I do to satisfy you? What should I do so that I am not a threat to you... Why do you keep pushing me step by step? I can give you anything." He could only shout these words silently, but he did not dare to reveal any emotion.

title_en: How is the general trend created? The 2026 nine-in-one election will be held on November 28. Historically, she has already used auspiciousness to convince the world that she will win.

Modern campaigns use huge crowds to tell voters that "everyone supports me"; Wu Zetian used auspiciousness to declare to the world that "even God has chosen me." The 2026 nine-in-one election will be held on November 28. The battle for each campaign is not only the number of people present, but also who can first write "the general trend is decided" into the hearts of voters. Wu Zetian faced an even more difficult situation. She had to convince an era that had never accepted a woman as emperor, believing that her ascension to the throne was not a usurpation, but a destiny. Before she was twelve years old, she worked as an official with her father, living among the people. She knew very well how people look for faith in a changing world to stabilize their body and mind. "Fate" is the easiest faith to manipulate. She has read extensively in history books and understands how emperors in the past dynasties stabilized their political power in response to natural disasters. Ministers often used this information to advise monarchs to reflect on themselves. She knew that as long as she could skillfully control her "Destiny", she would be able to reach her ideal position and get twice the result with half the effort. As a result, she began to frequently use auspiciousness to weave her way to the highest power.

title_en: The construction of the third section of National Highway 7 has been delayed one after another, and the opening time of the main line has been extended to 2032.
summary_en: National Highway 7 has been delayed for many years. Construction was originally expected to start in the first half of this year. However, three important civil construction bids in Kaohsiung's Xiaogang, Linhai and Fengliao areas have failed one after another. Local authorities are worried that construction will not start smoothly this year and will not be completed and opened to traffic in 2030. The High Power Bureau stated that it is still working towards the goal of winning the bid and starting construction before the end of this year. After rolling review, the main line (excluding interchanges) is targeted for opening to traffic in 2032.

summary_en: Typhoon White Dolphin formed at 2 pm this afternoon and has a high chance of developing into a moderate or severe typhoon. Zheng Jieren, a forecaster from the Central Meteorological Administration, said that White Dolphin is far away from Taiwan and will not cause any impact. However, Taiwan is currently at the junction of high and low pressure zones with a lot of moisture. Watch out for brief thundershowers in Taitung tomorrow and the next two days. There are also local brief thundershowers in the western half and Yihua Mountain area in the afternoon.

title_en: The stock market is booming. High-asset funds are quietly returning to branded luxury homes. There are many high-price transactions in Taichung’s luxury housing market.
summary_en: The stock market is hot and the real estate market is cold, but the Taichung real estate market has recently reported that high-net-worth funds are quietly returning to branded luxury homes. According to the latest real-price registration data, from January to June this year, a total of 78 transactions were completed in Taichung's high-priced residential market (more than 40 million yuan), with an average of 13 transactions per month, while there were 38 transactions for houses above 100 square meters (excluding parking spaces). This shows that high-net-worth groups have not completely withdrawn from the market, but continue to allocate assets during the economic consolidation period.

summary_en: The whole of Taiwan was hit by factors such as the crackdown on housing, and the purchase of gas dropped sharply in the first half of the year. According to statistics from the Ministry of Interior, only 124,619 houses were transferred for sale and purchase in Taiwan in the first half of the year, the lowest in the same period since 2017, according to statistics from the Ministry of Interior. Lai Chi-sung, public relations assistant at the Family Planning Research Institute, analyzed that the central bank's seventh wave of credit control effects continue to ferment, coupled with the impact of bank-end loan restrictions, which has greatly affected the willingness of home buyers to enter the market.

title_en: To fix the misalignment of cross-industry leverage information, the Financial Supervisory Authority will first fix the loopholes in these two areas.
summary_en: In order to prevent people from increasing the risk of "cross-industry stacking" of leverage for investing in stocks, the Financial Supervisory Authority will take steps to solve the problem of "cross-industry stacking" of people's leverage but the inability to communicate information across financial industries. According to people familiar with the matter, the fastest measure to be adopted at this stage will be for people to use unrestricted access to securities companies in the future. To purchase stocks using financing methods such as borrowing money, you must present your personal loan record shown on the Lianzheng Center before the securities firm can approve it. As for whether it will be further extended to the public to conduct margin trading securities business at securities firms, they must present the Lianzheng Center information before they can be released. This is yet to be determined by further internal discussions within the Financial Supervisory Committee.

title_en: The competition for production expansion among the three contact lenses companies has begun. Jingshuo, Shiyang, and Wangfal are launching new production capacities in succession.
summary_en: The global market penetration rate of Taiwan's contact lens manufacturers continues to increase, and the pace of production expansion is accelerating. With the increase in shipments of high-end products such as silicone hydrogel, contact lens manufacturers Jingshuo (6491), Shiyang (6782) and Wangfal (4771) have fully expanded their production capacity. Jingshuo's monthly production capacity will increase from 105 million pieces to 118 million pieces this year, an annual increase of 12%; due to strong order demand, Shiyang has advanced the expansion schedule of its Malaysian factory by one quarter, and its monthly production capacity will reach 63 million pieces in the fourth quarter; Wangfu It is expected to increase global monthly production capacity from 59.05 million pieces to nearly 81 million pieces by the first quarter of next year, an increase of more than 37%. title_en: Gigabyte Group's industrial computer factory Gichen now logs in to open counters
summary_en: Jichen (7939), an industrial computer company owned by Gigabyte (2376), listed on the stock market on the 27th, with an opening price of 250 yuan and once as high as 336 yuan. Jichen was established in December 2017. It is mainly engaged in the research and development and sales of industrial computer-related products. Its products cover industrial-grade motherboards, embedded systems, and Edge AI. Box, modules and packages are applied in vertical markets such as hospitality, retail, POS, factory automation, medical, and edge computing. In 2025, benefiting from the increased volume of existing projects and the introduction of new projects, annual revenue will reach NT$1.862 billion, net profit after tax will reach NT$158 million, and earnings per share will be NT$9.69. The compound annual growth rate (CAGR) in the past five years has reached 23.4%, demonstrating strong operational explosiveness.

title_en: SCFI International Freight Index fell three times in a row, legal persons maintain neutral view on shipping stocks
summary_en: The SCFI index, which reflects the freight rate trends in the international shipping market, was 3,062.95 points as of last week, down 0.56% on the week. Among them, the US East Line fell 1.08%, the US West Line fell 3.25%, and the European Line fell 1.87%. Analysts pointed out that the SCFI index fell for the third consecutive week, and the decline has narrowed. However, considering that the momentum for freight rates to continue to rise is limited, the view on shipping stocks remains neutral for the time being.

summary: 高額美元保單爭議爆發後，許多人才發現，保單上寫著數百萬美元的保額，並不代表隨時都能領回。利變美元保單依設計不同，可分為還本型、增額型，不同商品累積財富的方式完全不同。若將「身故保額」誤認為「解約價值」，就容易誤解商品本質，也成為保戶與保險公司之間的爭執來源。

title_en: Controversy arose over the tens of billions of idols 1/Mistakenly believed that they could receive US$2 million back in 6 years; an elderly couple took out a mortgage and mistakenly bought an insurance policy
summary_en: Originally I wanted to buy an investment policy, but in the end I signed a high-dollar life insurance policy and even took on a mortgage of tens of millions of dollars. An elderly couple in Taichung recently came forward to complain, saying that bank accountants promoted insurance policies with claims such as "tax savings, capital preservation, and repayment of principal after 6 years." It was later discovered that the high benefits of the policy could only be collected after death, triggering discussions about the policy sales process and the obligation to explain it. The bank denied that there was any induced sales and stated that the solicitation procedures were handled in accordance with the law. Both parties insisted on their own opinions, which also made the interest-variable dollar policy once again become the focus of the market.

title_en: Taiwan stocks fluctuate 2/Taiwan stocks still lack the "second foot" Li Shufang: Hold on to this line of defense and reach 50,000 points by the end of the year
summary_en: The world's major stock markets are facing correction trends and the volatile market in the third quarter. Senior analyst Li Shufang believes that the biggest problem at this stage is not the fundamentals, but the messy financing chip structure. Investors must be mentally prepared to face a period of bottoming out. She pointed out that the Taiwan stock market is currently showing the prototype of the "first foot", and we should pay close attention to whether the "second foot" is completed. As long as the key defense line of 39,967 points is not lost and the bullish structure is still there, there will be an opportunity to challenge the previous high by the end of the year and move towards the 50,000-point mark.

summary_en: Hang Lung Hong, a fine daily necessities agent with a 66-year history in Taiwan, owns 27 well-known international lifestyle and home appliance brands such as Dyson and Coway, with annual revenue exceeding NT$10 billion. It still insists on not being listed on the market. Faced with the frequent competition among Chinese brands overseas in recent years, how does Chen Zhenghong, the second-generation director of Hang Lung Bank in charge of trading, respond? Hang Lung Bank’s director Chen Zhenghong became famous for his agency for "Hermès Dyson in the vacuum cleaner industry" and entered the Taiwan market. Among them, TSMC was sold for more than 1.62 trillion yuan in the first batch, exceeding the total amount sold by foreign investors. Some large institutions believe that foreign capital's overselling of TSMC should not be a matter of fundamentals, but a limitation of the value of the stock held.

title: 半導體用電 四年後吃掉24% 2035年將增至千億度...占比提升到30%
summary: 半導體產業持續擴張。台電近期評估，國內晶圓製造、高頻寬記憶體（HBM）及先進封裝測試持續擴產帶動，估計今年半導體產業用電量約520億度，2030年將成長至800億度，占全台用電占比由今年的17.71%提升至2030年24.34%，幾乎等於全國每四度用電中，就有一度貢獻給半導體。

title_en: Semiconductor electricity consumption will consume 24% in four years and will increase to 100 billion degrees in 2035...the proportion will increase to 30%
summary_en: The semiconductor industry continues to expand. Taipower recently assessed that, driven by the continued expansion of domestic wafer manufacturing, high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and advanced packaging and testing, the semiconductor industry is estimated to consume about 52 billion kilowatt-hours of electricity this year and will grow to 80 billion kilowatt-hours in 2030, accounting for 24.34% of Taiwan's total electricity consumption from 17.71% this year. This is equivalent to almost one out of every four kilowatt-hours of electricity consumed in the country being contributed to semiconductors.

summary_en: In the AI ​​era, in addition to the rapid growth of electricity consumption in the semiconductor industry, the AI ​​Data Center (AIDC) is another focus. The Ministry of Economic Affairs recently announced that it has "conditionally" relaxed restrictions on the application for the establishment of AIDCs above 5MW (thousand miles) north of Taoyuan, which must be near Tai Tam Power Plant and Concorde Power Plant. It is understood that the installation range is about 2 kilometers near the power plant, and will be discussed with local governments in the future.

summary: 全球鋼鐵市場進到第3季展開修正，近期浮現「原料止穩、鋼價止跌、需求轉型、成本有撐」四大築底訊號，第4季景氣逐步回升的可能性大增，中鋼、新光鋼等鋼鐵族群均樂見鋼市正向發展。

title_en: Four major bottom-building signals in the steel market emerge, and the market outlook for Sinosteel, Xinguang Steel, etc. is not bleak
summary_en: The global steel market has entered the third quarter and has begun to correct. Recently, four major bottoming signals have emerged: "raw materials have stabilized, steel prices have stopped falling, demand has transformed, and costs have been supported." The possibility of a gradual recovery in the fourth quarter has greatly increased. Steel groups such as Sinosteel and Shin Kong Steel are happy to see the positive development of the steel market.

title_en: AI infrastructure and new energy act as the growth engine of the steel city
summary_en: The global steel industry is facing a restructuring of demand structure. As mainland China's real estate continues to adjust, the demand for construction steel that has supported the growth of the steel market for many years has gradually cooled down. However, the rapid rise of high-end manufacturing such as AI data centers, power infrastructure, new energy, and automobiles is taking over as a new growth engine for the steel market.

title: 旅遊市場持續升溫與中東情勢影響 航空三雄掀歐洲擴點大戰
summary: 國人赴歐旅遊熱度持續升溫，加上中東情勢牽動全球轉機市場，航空三雄全面啟動歐洲增班計畫。隨著星宇航空8月1日正式開航首條歐洲航線，華航持續加密熱門航線，長榮航空穩居國籍航空歐洲班次之冠，三家航空公司同步增班、擴點，下半年可望掀起近年最大規模的歐洲航網擴張戰。

title_en: The tourism market continues to heat up and the situation in the Middle East is affecting the aviation industry.
summary_en: The popularity of Chinese people traveling to Europe continues to increase, and the situation in the Middle East has affected the global transfer market. The three aviation giants have fully launched plans to increase flights to Europe. As StarLux Airlines officially launched its first European route on August 1, China Airlines continues to increase its number of popular routes, and EVA Air ranks first in European flights among domestic airlines. The three airlines are simultaneously adding flights and expanding points. The second half of the year is expected to set off the largest European network expansion war in recent years.

summary_en: The international oil prices are rising, and the industry is worried that it will also increase the operating costs of the aviation industry. However, the legal person believes that even if fuel costs increase, there will be strong support for the profits of China Airlines, EVA Air and Xingyu in the second half of the year, including the continued AI in air cargo, high freight rates driven by high-tech cargo sources, and high passenger load factors, which will become the most important support for operations.

Bulls are expected to launch another offensive from U.S. technology financial reporting concept stocks.

summary_en: The three current members of the National Communications Commission (NCC) (including acting chairman Chen Chongshu, etc.) will be in office until July 31 this year. Although the Executive Yuan urgently proposed a list of seven nominees on the 24th, the Transportation Committee has not yet scheduled a review time. If it fails to pass on the 31st, the NCC will have a vacancy period for the first time since August.

title: 輝達買暗光纖有何盤算？從電信、擴大地盤來看有啥影響
summary: 「傳輸」是AI算力的瓶頸，全球指標廠商都在解決「傳輸」問題，小自伺服器內的CPO到跨國、跨區、跨海的IOWN全光網路，都是要用「光」來解決傳輸問題，市場盛傳輝達大規模收購美國「暗光纖（Dark Fiber）」，透過掌握實體光纖網路，更透露輝達從晶片軍火商，跨向AI基礎建設與網路整合的野心。

title_en: What is Huida’s plan to buy dark optical fiber? What is the impact from the perspective of telecommunications and expanding territory?
summary_en: "Transmission" is the bottleneck of AI computing power. Global indicator manufacturers are solving the "transmission" problem. From CPOs in small servers to cross-border, cross-regional, and cross-sea IOWN all-optical networks, they all need to use "light" to solve transmission problems. It is widely rumored in the market that Huida has acquired "Dark Fiber" in the United States on a large scale. By mastering the physical optical fiber network, it also revealed Huida's ambition to move from a chip arms dealer to AI infrastructure and network integration.

title: 50多年前馬路拓寬遷成大保存 府城小西門暫以這形式「重現」
summary: 台南建城逾300年，多數城門因都市發展陸續拆除，其中小西門於1970年因西門路拓寬遷移至成功大學光復校區保存。地方文史團體多年倡議「小西門回家」，希望重返原址附近，恢復府城歷史地景；不過，市府考量文化資產保存、結構安全及工程技術等因素，現階段不規畫搬遷，將先在公園打造小西門城門意向特色遊戲區，讓小西門重新走入市民生活。

title_en: More than 50 years ago, the road was widened and moved into a large preservation area. The small west gate of Fucheng is temporarily "reproduced" in this form.
summary_en: Tainan has been a city for more than 300 years. Most of the city gates have been demolished due to urban development. Among them, the Xiaoximen was moved to the Guangfu Campus of National Cheng Kung University in 1970 due to the widening of Ximen Road for preservation. Local cultural and historical groups have been advocating "Xiao Ximen Returns Home" for many years, hoping to return to the vicinity of the original site and restore the historical scenery of the city. However, considering factors such as cultural asset preservation, structural safety, and engineering technology, the city government does not plan to relocate at this stage. It will first build a special game area with Xiao Ximen City Gate in the park to allow Xiao Ximen to re-enter citizens' lives.

title: 台灣去年因精神相關疾病就診逾170萬人 衛福部：疾病汙名化是最大挑戰

title_en: Last year, more than 1.7 million people were treated for mental illness in Taiwan. Ministry of Health and Welfare: Disease stigma is the biggest challenge
summary_en: According to statistics from the National Health Insurance Administration, 1.702 million people sought medical treatment for mental-related diseases in 2014. Among the nearly 200,000 patients with chronic mental illness major illness cards, about 97,000 suffered from schizophrenia. Is Taiwan’s psychiatric community care network complete? The Department of Mental Health of the Ministry of Health and Welfare stated that the core direction of the Ministry of Health and Welfare’s promotion of mental care is to establish a continuous care system from hospital to community, so that patients can receive appropriate and uninterrupted care at different stages.

title: 雙溪發生規模5.6地震原因曝光 同地區去年才發生規模7地震
summary: 新北市雙溪區今晚8時36分發生規模5.6地震，地震深度95.7公里，各地最大震度3級。地震測報中心技正郭冠宏表示，本起地震發生主因與菲律賓海板塊與歐亞大陸板塊隱沒有關，且該地區近年發生2起規模6以上地震，包含2025年12月27月東部海域規模7地震、2026年5月1日東部海域規模6.1地震。

title_en: The cause of the magnitude 5.6 earthquake in Shuangxi was revealed. The same area only experienced a magnitude 7 earthquake last year.
summary_en: An earthquake with a magnitude of 5.6 occurred in Shuangxi District, New Taipei City at 8:36 tonight. The depth of the earthquake was 95.7 kilometers. The maximum magnitude of the earthquake was 3. Guo Guanhong, technical director of the Earthquake Forecasting and Forecasting Center, said that the main cause of this earthquake is related to the connection between the Philippine Sea Plate and the Eurasian Continental Plate, and that there have been two earthquakes of magnitude 6 or above in the area in recent years, including a magnitude 7 earthquake in the eastern sea area on December 27, 2025, and a magnitude 6.1 earthquake in the eastern sea area on May 1, 2026.

The inspection of the entire line was completed at 8:54 p.m., and normal operations were resumed across the line.

title_en: Outsiders question whether the high-speed rail extension to Yilan will be able to relieve snow tunnel congestion. The Railway Bureau clarifies: it should be assessed based on regional development and transportation resilience.
summary_en: The environmental group questioned that the cost of the high-speed rail extension project to Yilan may increase to 600 billion, and it will not be able to relieve congestion in the snow tunnel and crowd out the Taiwan Railway and passenger traffic. The Railway Administration clarified that the high-speed rail extension to Yilan will be carefully evaluated from the perspective of the national railway network, eastern external transportation, balanced regional development and land transportation resilience, and is not just for the purpose of solving traffic congestion.

title_en: Imported white radish was found to contain excessive pesticides. The Food and Drug Administration initiated traceability: violators may be fined up to NT$200 million.
summary_en: The New Taipei Fruit and Vegetable Transportation Company recently inspected a batch of imported white radishes, and found pesticide residues exceeding my country's allowable standards. The Food and Drug Administration stated that it has requested the Health Bureau of the New Taipei City Government to immediately launch an investigation and trace the source to clarify the flow of products and the identity of the importer. Subsequent actions will be taken in accordance with the food safety law. If import violations are confirmed, feedback will be given to the border inspection mechanism to increase the intensity of follow-up inspections.

title_en: Eslite has withdrawn from Dajiang and Tongling stores one after another. Taoyuan people are crying: Isn’t the urban area worthy of Eslite?
summary_en: After Eslite Bookstore took over the Taoyuan Dajiang store, the Taoyuan Tongling store will also be open until September 14 due to the expiration of the lease. It will move to Qingpu in the future. It is expected to launch a nearly 5,000 square meter new independent store in front of the Qingpu high-speed rail Taoyuan Station by the end of 2028. As soon as the news came out, many Taoyuan people discussed on the community, "Why should Eslite, like IKEA, abandon Taoyuan District, which has a population of 470,000, and choose Qingpu, which has a population of only 50,000. Isn't Taoyuan City worthy of having an Eslite?"

title_en: Nomura: AI semiconductor still benefits from component shortages, price increases and profit revisions. Optimistic about seven Taiwanese stocks
summary_en: Nomura Securities released an "AI Semiconductor" industry report stating that AI concept stocks have been in consolidation recently, but component shortages, price increases and profit revisions will still be the next wave of catalysts. The main risk still lies in the capital expenditure outlook of cloud companies. In the Taiwanese supply chain, Nomura is optimistic about seven stocks, namely TSMC (2330), ASE Investment Holdings (3711), KYEC Electronics (2449), Hongjin (7769), Maximo (2360), Wangsi (6223) and Yingwei (6515), all of which have given a "buy" rating.

title: 半導體快速擴張吃電！估2035年台灣每發三度電 1/3將貢獻給半導體

title_en: The rapid expansion of semiconductors consumes electricity! It is estimated that in 2035, 1/3 of every three kilowatt hours of electricity generated in Taiwan will be contributed to semiconductors
summary_en: Taiwan's semiconductor industry continues to expand. According to Taipower's recent assessment, driven by the continued expansion of domestic wafer manufacturing, high-bandwidth memory (HBM), and advanced packaging and testing, the semiconductor industry's electricity consumption is estimated to be approximately 52 billion kilowatt-hours in 2026, and will grow to 80 billion kilowatt-hours, increasing to 110 billion kilowatt-hours in 2035, accounting for 17.71% of Taiwan's electricity consumption in 2026 to 24.34% in 2030. One of the four kilowatt-hours of electricity consumption in the country is contributed to semiconductors.

title_en: How important is oil to Taiwanese people? China Research Institute scholar He Meixiang talks about the China United Oil incident: Don’t just shout food safety slogans
summary_en: The incident involving Zoomlion Oil's soybean salad oil containing excessive amounts of benzene and pyrene triggered a food safety crisis across Taiwan. People dressed in white walked onto Ketagalan Avenue last night to express their concerns about food safety. He Meixiang, a former researcher at Academia Sinica, believes that if social discussions stop at emotional catharsis, it will be difficult to truly improve Taiwan's food safety. The focus should be returned to scientific evidence and system reform, and a comprehensive review from raw materials, manufacturing processes to monitoring mechanisms can reduce the risk of similar incidents happening again in the future.

title_en: Patient complains about waiting 13 hours for surgery, triggering online controversy. Doctors analyze hospital's surgery scheduling system
summary_en: Recently, a medical controversy went viral on the Internet. A patient pointed out that she fasted for 29 hours and fasted for 13 hours in the ward to wait for the operation, but she still couldn't wait for the operation. She criticized, "The attending doctor had a big meal out? Shouldn't he be in the operating room at this time?" He even made the doctor and the hospital public. In response to this, the doctor who was named also left a message in person to respond. Initially, it was based on the fact that this patient was an old patient that I had taken care of for many years. Unexpectedly, what came in the end was a series of statements that were inconsistent with the facts, sparking discussion again.

summary_en: The Central Meteorological Administration issued a special heavy rain warning at 14:50 p.m., pointing out that the cloud system in the south moves northward and convection develops in the afternoon, which is likely to cause short-term heavy rainfall. Heavy rain has already occurred in Taitung County. Today (26), there is a chance of local heavy rain in Nantou, Taitung, Changhua to Tainan, the Hengchun Peninsula and the Gaoping Mountains. Please pay attention to lightning strikes and strong gusts. In mountainous areas, beware of collapses, rockfalls and surging streams, and in low-lying areas, beware of flooding.

title_en: Yunlin mutton exploded for the first time, dioxin exceeded the standard. The National Prevention and Prosecution Service: Starting from tomorrow, handwriting comparison of health declaration forms will be strengthened.
summary_en: The first case of mutton dioxin exceeding the standard broke out in Yunlin County. The owner surnamed Li was suspected of sending sheep for slaughter under the name of "Yunnong Ranch". After investigation, the prosecutor ordered him to post a bail of 30,000 yuan. The Animal and Plant Inspection and Quarantine Service of the Ministry of Agriculture said that starting tomorrow, local meat markets and slaughterhouses will be required to strengthen comparisons of the handwriting and systems of the independent health declarations of ranches to prevent similar fraudulent use from happening again.

title_en: Routine surgeries are always postponed again and again. The medical community: This phenomenon has been going on for 1 or 2 years. The shortage of anesthesia nurses is the key
summary_en: Recently, a medical controversy went viral on the Internet. A patient pointed out that she fasted for 29 hours and fasted for 13 hours in the ward while waiting for surgery, but she still couldn't wait for the surgery. Wei Guozhen, deputy director of New Taipei City Tucheng Hospital, said that he is not the doctor involved, but non-urgent surgeries have been postponed for one or two years. The main reason is the shortage of anesthesia nurses. This phenomenon will continue, and the public should be mentally prepared. Huang Jianpei, secretary-general of the Society of Obstetrics and Gynecology, said that there are many reasons for patient delays in surgery, and doctors and patients should take a step back to reduce mutual discomfort.

title_en: Having a stroke in the summer is no coincidence! Doctors teach 6 prevention tips: replenish water, measure blood pressure, don’t wait until you are thirsty to drink water
summary_en: Don’t think that stroke is a winter-only disease. During the high temperatures in summer, the number of stroke patients sent to the hospital for heat stroke, dehydration, and blood pressure fluctuations increases significantly. Zhou Zonghan, a Chinese medicine practitioner at Chu Ming Tang Traditional Chinese Medicine Clinic, said that hot weather causes the body to lose water and the blood becomes thicker, and blood pressure is prone to violent fluctuations. If you already have high blood pressure, diabetes, hyperlipidemia or cerebrovascular disease, it may increase the risk of stroke.

summary_en: In response to recent remarks by some people who claimed that the high-speed rail extension project to Yilan may expand to 600 billion yuan, fail to relieve congestion in snow tunnels, crowd out Taiwan Railways and passenger transportation, and question the policy positioning and packaging methods, Chen Huijun, deputy director of the Railway Bureau of the Ministry of Transport, clarified that there is a considerable gap between the relevant statements and the positioning, policy objectives, evaluation basis and actual content of this plan. It is not just a policy purpose to solve a single traffic congestion problem. Chen called on major national construction projects to return to facts and professionalism with macro thinking to build a development foundation for the next generation.

In response, the latest news on Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain, which is familiar with the Japanese market, directly pointed out that it is false news. The relevant Japanese factories have not stopped production, and the supply chain is not expected to be affected.

title_en: Cover story/Insurance center’s claim for RMB 700 million was reversed to almost no compensation; Phison low-key laid out NASA’s moon project
summary_en: Phison Electronics, a large memory manufacturer, rode on the AI wave and became a leading indicator stock among ethnic groups. However, the civil lawsuit stemming from the fake accounting scandal 10 years ago has not yet ended. The Insurance Center represented 97 investors in that year and sought compensation of 697 million from Phison. Yuan, but a dramatic turn occurred during the recent hearing of the High Court. The insurance center re-proposed the calculation of actual damages. Only five investors were left with actual losses recognized, and the total amount was only 1.21 million yuan. The difference from the amount of compensation was more than 500 times, and it was almost non-compensable. As the legal battles and defenses continue, this magazine’s investigation shows that Phison has quietly penetrated into the supply chain of the United States Space Agency (NASA) in recent years. Storage technology has been successively used in projects such as Mars exploration, the International Space Station and the Lunar Data Center. It has become one of the few Taiwanese companies to enter the field of space data storage. The market focus is expected to return to its technical strength and global layout.

summary_en: The Taiwan stock market has become more volatile recently, with a washout of thousands of points happening almost every week. Retail investors holding stocks are frightened. However, the violent fluctuations are an opportunity for stock depositors to deploy market capitalization ETFs in batches. Investment guru Hai Lao Niu teaches Zhan that the strategy of long-term market capitalization ETFs is to keep deducting fixed quotas on a regular basis, and then adding more in a single transaction after a sharp drop of a thousand points. The Ministry of Economic Affairs stated yesterday (25th) that Taiwan's new tax rate applies to a 10% non-superimposed MFN (Most Favored Nation) tax rate. Its main competitors, Japan and South Korea, apply a 12.5% ​​non-superimposed MFN tax rate. Mainland China, Vietnam, Thailand, etc. apply a 12.5% ​​superimposed MFN tax rate. All are higher than the applicable tax rates in my country. This will help industries such as machine tools and machinery to switch from defense to offense and continue to expand the US market.

The 2026 OCP Asia Pacific Summit will take the stage, focusing on shaping the future of AI from openness. TSMC, Hon Hai, Quanta, Werder, Wistron, Wiwing, Intelligent Power, Inventec, Delta and other major AI manufacturers will participate, showcasing the key strengths of open computing and AI data centers.

title: AI 連續運算架構 躍新商機
summary: AI下一波浪潮將是推理，「計算」更加貼近終端用戶，不僅需要超大型AIDC，更需要關注邊緣運算及分散式AIDC，OCP近期攜手IOWN，聯合倡議「AI連續運算」（AI Computing Continuum），打造具擴充性及節能的AI基礎設施，成為台灣廠商新商機。

title_en: AI continuous computing architecture creates new business opportunities
summary_en: The next wave of AI will be inference, and "computing" will be closer to end users. It not only requires ultra-large AIDC, but also needs to pay attention to edge computing and distributed AIDC. OCP recently joined hands with IOWN to jointly initiate the "AI Computing Continuum" to create a scalable and energy-saving AI infrastructure, which has become a new business opportunity for Taiwanese manufacturers.

summary_en: The carcinogenic oil storm continues to spread, triggering a strong panic about food safety among the people. The Kuomintang held a "I am a human being, I am an anti-drug platform" rally on Ketagalan Avenue today. Earlier, at 6:35 pm, more than 80,000 people shouted at the scene. Mr. Zhang, a member of the public, was very emotional during the interview and said that "oil" ranks third among daily necessities in terms of firewood, rice, oil, salt, soy sauce, vinegar and tea. Nowadays, food safety issues have spread. The food safety law is the responsibility of the central government, but Executive President Zhuo Rongtai has passed the responsibility to local governments and asked to step down.

summary_en: The Zoomlion cancer-causing oil scandal spread. The Taichung District Prosecutor's Office launched the third wave of searches yesterday and found that Shen Yijun and Cai Guoliang, the former and current general managers of Taishan Company, were suspected of being afraid of losses and other motives. They knew in advance that upstream Zoomlion oil products were outsourced and allowed them to continue processing and selling them. They were detained in accordance with the food safety law. The Taichung District Court opened a detention court at noon. The defender and prosecutor defended for 8 hours. The Intermediate People's Court ruled that Shen and Cai were both detained.

title_en: Kaidao Anti-Poison Oil... stallholders are forced to change oil and bear the cost. People are worried that "poisons come in through the mouth" and the government will not solve it.
summary_en: As the cancer-causing oil storm spreads, the Kuomintang launched the "I am a human being, I am an anti-drug platform" rally in Kaidao this evening, calling on people to take to the streets to roar against the DPP government. As of 6:30 p.m., the organizer announced that 80,000 people had gathered at the rally. Many people came to the scene voluntarily, criticizing that the oil they eat every day contains carcinogens, and the government's control has seriously gone wrong, demanding accountability and rebuilding mechanisms. Some retail market vendors said that the market was forced to replace all oils with lard and chicken fat, and the cost increased significantly, but sacrifices must be made to protect people's health.

Most flights to and from Hong Kong and Macau will be canceled in the first half of tomorrow, and some flights will be postponed.

title: 中年變胖不只身材走樣？腰間那圈游泳圈，正悄悄拉高你的血糖
summary: 許多女性在進入更年期或停經後，發現體重悄悄增加、腰圍變粗，體脂肪還特別愛往腹部集中，形成中央型肥胖。多數人第一時間想到的，是外表美觀上的困擾。但真正該擔心的，其實藏在看不見的地方。鴻馨診所院長吳佳鴻醫師出版的《別怕荷爾蒙，妳抗衰防病的關鍵》指出，許多研究都證實，腹部脂肪的堆積會增加代謝及心血管疾病的風險，例如糖尿病、高血壓、高血脂、心臟病、腦中風，甚至連乳癌在內的癌症和失智症風險也隨之上升。因此當女性面臨更年期的體重增加、腰圍變粗時，千萬不要單純認為這只是美觀問題，因為更重要的潛在風險，是對健康造成的長期危害。而這些危害之一，就是糖尿病。

title_en: Gaining weight in middle age is not just about losing shape? The swimming ring around your waist is quietly raising your blood sugar
summary_en: After entering menopause or menopause, many women find that their weight has gradually increased, their waist circumference has become thicker, and body fat tends to concentrate in the abdomen, forming central obesity. The first thing that comes to mind for most people is the problem of appearance. But what you should really worry about is actually hidden in invisible places. "Don't be afraid of hormones, the key to anti-aging and disease prevention" published by Dr. Wu Jiahong, director of Hongxin Clinic, pointed out that many studies have confirmed that the accumulation of abdominal fat will increase the risk of metabolic and cardiovascular diseases, such as diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidemia, heart disease, stroke, and even the risk of cancers including breast cancer and dementia. Therefore, when women face menopausal weight gain and thicker waistlines, they must not simply think that this is just a cosmetic problem, because the more important potential risk is long-term harm to health. One of these hazards is diabetes.

title: 舞台上光芒萬丈，深夜卻輾轉難眠：為什麼泰勒絲的歌單，藏著你我都有的焦慮？
summary:
剛認識一個人的時候，如果想找個「安全話題」開啟關係，最輕鬆的方式之一就是問問對方：平常都做些什麼休閒活動？相信不少人的答案都是：「我喜歡聽音樂。」但你以為聽音樂只是打發時間？那就太小看音樂的力量了。專業諮商心理師林萃芬在其著作《從肢體洞察人心》中指出，音樂會反映出聽者「當時的情緒」與「深層的情感」。在《感官之旅》這本書中，作者黛安．艾克曼也曾研究過音樂與情緒之間的關係，她認為音樂就如感情一般，有波濤洶湧的時刻，也有平靜的時刻，會狂暴，也會安靜，它就像我們的情緒，能象徵、反映，也能傳達。

因此，下次聽到有人跟你說「我喜歡聽音樂」時，不妨進一步探索：對方喜歡聽什麼類型的音樂？最愛聽誰的歌？從喜歡聽的音樂中，往往可以了解自己和對方當時的感情狀態。例如：熱戀中的人喜歡聽的歌，會和失戀中的人不一樣；沮喪時，會對帶點憂傷的音樂特別有感覺；興高采烈時，又偏愛聽讓人想要跳舞的音樂。此外，「人格特質」與「音樂風格」也會有些搭配性。若想了解一個人的內在情感，不妨跟著對方聆聽：最常聽什麼音樂？對什麼音樂最有感覺？雙方也比較容易找到共鳴點。

title_en: The stage is shining brightly, but late at night, I can’t sleep: Why does Taylor Swift’s playlist hide the anxiety that you and I both have?
summary_en:
When you first meet someone, if you want to find a "safe topic" to start a relationship, one of the easiest ways is to ask the other person: What leisure activities do they usually do? I believe the answer for many people is: "I like listening to music." But do you think listening to music is just to pass the time? That would be to underestimate the power of music. Professional counseling psychologist Lin Cuifen pointed out in her book "Insight into the Human Heart from the Body" that music reflects the listener's "emotions at the time" and "deep emotions." In the book "Journey of the Senses", the author Diane. Ekman has also studied the relationship between music and emotions. She believes that music is like emotions. It has rough moments and calm moments, it can be violent and it can be quiet. It is like our emotions, it can symbolize, reflect, and convey.

Therefore, next time you hear someone tell you "I like listening to music," you might as well explore further: What type of music does the person like to listen to? Whose songs do you like to listen to the most? From the music you like to listen to, you can often understand the emotional state of yourself and the other person at that time. For example: people who are passionately in love will like to listen to different songs than those who are out of love; when they are depressed, they will have a special feeling for music with a bit of sadness; when they are in high spirits, they prefer to listen to music that makes people want to dance. In addition, "personality traits" and "music style" will also have some matching. If you want to understand someone's inner emotions, you might as well listen along with them: What music do you listen to most? What music do you feel most passionate about? It is also easier for both parties to find common ground.

title_en: India's manufacturing growth rate of 4.15% exceeds the global average! Supply chain reorganization promotes the next world manufacturing center
summary_en: Global supply chain reorganization continues to accelerate, and India's manufacturing industry is facing unprecedented growth opportunities. According to the latest research by the Association of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (ASSOCHAM), India's manufacturing industry will record double-digit growth in the fiscal year 2025-2026. Taking India's manufacturing industry from 2022 to 2025 as an example, the average growth rate will reach 4.15%, which is not only higher than the global average of 2.19%, but also significantly higher than before the epidemic. It shows that India's manufacturing competitiveness has undergone a structural upgrade and is rapidly emerging as a new generation of global manufacturing center. "Full text..."

title_en: OTT TV moves from on-demand to real-time content channels. Taiwan’s largest MyVideo TV launches 37 TV channels
summary_en: In the past, the most attractive viewing mode of OTT TV streaming video was anytime, anywhere, on-demand. Now the competition among streaming video platforms has shifted from "film library size" to "real-time content". Taiwan Mobile (3045) said that after MyVideo launched live sports events in March this year, the number of live viewers jumped sixfold and paying members increased by nearly 20% in several years. "MyVideo TV" will be launched on August 1, with the first wave of 37 TV channels.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter He Xiuling, Taipei, 25th) Shin Kong Mitsukoshi officially took over the Taipei Station Mall today. The director of Shin Kong Mitsukoshi said that after the mall closed at 3 pm yesterday, more than 300 manpower was invested, and it took more than ten hours to complete a comprehensive check-in and safety inspection of the mall. Taiwan Railway said that most counters have resumed operations, but a small number of counters have old equipment and have not fully passed safety inspections, and will resume operations after completing improvements.

Its main competitors, Japan and South Korea, apply a 12.5% ​​non-superimposed MFN tax rate. title: 曾押寶墨西哥，緯創為何急轉赴美設廠？林憲銘首揭美國設廠祕辛
summary: 其實，若把時間倒轉到去（2025）年1月，當時，川普重回白宮、開始醞釀貿易戰，而包括緯創在內的電子五哥，在北美洲僅在墨西哥有工廠。有一次，林憲銘被商周詢問是否考慮赴美建廠，他曾嚴肅表示，這是一個需要「審慎思考」的布局。而今，18個月過去，緯創第一座美國工廠開幕，而它的競爭對手鴻海、英業達、和碩、廣達的美國新廠，也將陸續開幕。究竟是什麼原因，讓電子五哥們從一開始的觀望、到爭先恐後進軍「美國製造」？林憲銘首度對此釋疑。他說，第一個原因，是資源配置，以緯創去年與今年的生產量、營業額，動輒1倍的成長速度，「我們要在台灣拿更多的土地跟電，確實有困難，因此就想說，既然我們是全球公司，工廠就要有全球足跡。」

title_en: Once betting on Mexico, why did Wistron suddenly switch to the United States to set up a factory? Lin Xianming reveals the secret of setting up a factory in the United States for the first time
summary_en: In fact, if we turn the time back to January 2025, when Trump returned to the White House and began to brew a trade war, the top five electronics companies in North America, including Wistron, only had factories in Mexico. Once, Lin Xianming was asked by Shang Zhou whether he would consider building a factory in the United States. He seriously stated that this was a layout that required "careful thinking." Now, 18 months later, Wistron's first U.S. factory has opened, and its competitors Hon Hai, Inventec, Pegatron, and Quanta's new U.S. factories will also open one after another. What is the reason that caused the five electronics buddies to go from waiting and watching at the beginning to rushing to enter "Made in the United States"? Lin Xianming clarified this for the first time. He said that the first reason is resource allocation. With Wistron's production volume and turnover last year and this year, the growth rate is almost doubled. "It is indeed difficult for us to acquire more land and electricity in Taiwan, so we want to say that since we are a global company, our factories must have a global footprint."

title: 一場科技業「笑裡藏刀」職場悲劇：看清「笑面虎」真面目，察覺四種人格特質
summary: 科技業曾發生過一起震驚社會的「笑裡藏刀」職場悲劇，受害者是一位擁有專業職能的技術長，施暴者則是親自延攬他至公司的董事長。最初幾年兩人關係良好，然而隨著公司規模擴大，遇到客訴危機與新產品的研發瓶頸，雙方管理理念的分歧逐漸浮現。技術長認為產品的技術品質與長期穩定性才是公司核心，但董事長更關心市場策略，時常以「外行領導內行」的方式干涉技術決策，技術長在專案推動上屢屢受挫，還在高層會議上常被當眾數落，感覺自己被羞辱、被霸凌，離職的念頭越來越強烈。最終，技術長決定離職，離職前一天，他在社群媒體上發表感言，寫下他在公司內部的掙扎與困難，點出管理層面的問題。離職當天，董事長特地安排了最後一次會面，在會議中感謝技術長的貢獻，並再度請他刪除這篇離職文章，技術長僅說「我再想想」，沒有明確答應。

title_en: A workplace tragedy in the technology industry where "a smile hides a knife": see clearly the true face of the "smiling tiger" and detect four personality traits
summary_en: There has been a workplace tragedy in the technology industry that shocked society. The victim was a technical chief with a professional function, and the perpetrator was the chairman of the company who personally recruited him to the company. In the first few years, the two had a good relationship. However, as the company expanded and encountered customer complaint crises and new product development bottlenecks, differences in the management philosophies of the two parties gradually emerged. The chief technology officer believes that the technical quality and long-term stability of the product are the core of the company, but the chairman is more concerned about market strategies and often interferes in technical decisions in a "layman leads an expert" manner. The chief technology officer has been repeatedly frustrated in project promotion and is often scolded in public at high-level meetings. He feels humiliated and bullied, and the idea of ​​​​resigning is getting stronger and stronger. In the end, the chief technology officer decided to resign. The day before his resignation, he posted a speech on social media, writing about his struggles and difficulties within the company, and pointing out management-level problems. On the day of his resignation, the chairman specially arranged a last meeting. During the meeting, he thanked the technical chief for his contribution and once again asked him to delete the resignation article. The chief technical officer only said "I will think about it again" without explicitly agreeing.

summary_en: Typhoon Bavi hit Taiwan a few days ago, causing power outages to more than 240,000 households across the country. Taipower mobilized more than 16,000 people for emergency repairs. In addition to the threat of natural disasters, Northern Taiwan Electric Power is actually entering a new power outage crisis. This publication’s investigation revealed that the most important heart of Taipower’s Northeast Power Grid, which supplies New Taipei and Yilan, is the Heping Power Plant in Hualien, a subsidiary of TCC. The contract with Taipower will expire in the middle of next year, but it has not been renewed yet. "In the past, the contract renewal was completed a year ago. If the two parties failed to renew the contract, about 4.8 million people in Yilan and New Taipei may be plunged into a new wave of power outage crisis." A person familiar with the matter said.

title_en: Wang Dawei was involved in loan sharking fraud, and the mastermind and business manager were detained and banned from public viewing
summary_en: Kaohsiung's "Wangdao International Financial Consulting" company falsely claimed that it could apply for low-interest loans from banks on its behalf. Many people mistakenly believed that it was a company affiliated with Wangdao Bank. After applying, they found out that they were charged a high 20% "consultancy fee". A disguised form of loan sharking, with nearly 100 million yuan in illegal funds. The prosecutor searched and arrested 20 people. After the trial, they found that they were involved in extinguishing evidence. They banned the mastermind Lin Yucun, business managers Zheng Rujun, Zhong Wenhao, and Lin Lirong from meeting. The court ruled in the evening that they should be detained.

summary_en: The organic tea oil produced by Lianjing Green Technology Co., Ltd. was detected to be benzene and pyrene. Cotton Field Vitality Garden mainly sells it to its members and general consumers. The Beijing Municipal Health Bureau said today that it has asked businesses to proactively notify consumers to handle returns and exchanges to safeguard consumer rights.

title_en: After the live ammunition firing, the Communist Army launched the "Joint Combat Readiness Patrol" again, and 19 planes went to sea to disrupt Taiwan.
summary_en: The Ministry of National Defense stated in the evening that since 16:26 pm, it has successively detected 19 sorties of the Chinese Communist Party's J-10, J-16, H-6, KJ-500 and other main and auxiliary fighter aircraft going to sea. Among them, 12 sorties crossed the center line and its extension line and entered the northern, central and southwestern airspace of China. They cooperated with the Communist Party ships and harassed the air and sea areas around China under the guise of "joint combat readiness patrol".

title_en: Hongxia flights were disrupted, 22 Taoyuan aircraft were diverted, Songji and Kaohsiung airports were full, and ground operation time may be extended.
summary_en: Typhoon Hongxia only swept through the southern waters of Taiwan, but it has already caused chaos in flights at Taoyuan Airport and Kaohsiung Airport. Gusty winds blew up in Taoji at night, causing 22 flights to be diverted to other airports. Songji, Taichung and Kaohsiung airports were once full and refused to accept any more, so the flights had to be diverted to Hong Kong and Macau. The three airports in the western region have absorbed many transfer flights, so the ground operations can be tight, and passengers can only wait in the carousel area.

summary_en: The Meteorological Administration continues to issue maritime typhoon warnings for Typhoon Hongxia. The impact of the typhoon will be most obvious until the first half of Saturday. The storm radius continues to act, and strong gusts of level 10 have occurred in Hengchun Peninsula and Taoyuan Guanyin. The rainfall hot spots are concentrated in Taitung, Hengchun Peninsula and Orchid Island.

title_en: Shareholders of Zoomlion 3 apologized and announced reforms to remove all oil products produced from April to June.
summary_en: The food safety scandal of Zoomlion Oil has been spreading for nearly a month. The chairman of Taishan, Fushou and Fumao Oil announced for the first time yesterday (24th) that they jointly explained and apologized, announcing that they would promote the reform of the board of directors and corporate governance of Zoomlion Oil, and advocated that Zoomlion Oil should not resume work until food safety concerns are resolved and reviewed by the competent authorities. The oil products produced from April to June will also be completely removed from the shelves and will not be resumed.

title_en: Happy corporate birthday/Baoling Fujin from hospital to family
summary_en: Baoling Fujin Biotech, a well-known domestic pharmaceutical company, celebrated its 50th birthday in January this year. Founder and general manager Jiang Zongming, who is over 80 years old this year, said that he works at the company every day, 365 days a year, except during the Spring Festival. He and other members of the "Banyou Group" who graduated from the Department of Peking Medicine, have pulled Baoling Fujin from a small pharmaceutical factory for half a century to build one of the few listed companies in Taiwan that spans new drug research and development, in vitro diagnostics, and innovative medical aesthetics.

summary_en: When it comes to the shareholders of Baoling Fujin Biotech, the most talked-about story is the story of "nine heroes in one class" of Banyou Group. In 1974, nine seniors and juniors from the Department of Medicine at Peking University jointly formed Banyou Company. It has developed for more than 50 years. title_en: U.S. Section 301 Investigation: Political Yuan: This time the treatment is more advantageous
summary_en: In response to the "forced labor" determination under Section 301, the U.S. Trade Representative's Office has implemented a "10% non-superimposed Most Favored Nation (MFN) tariff" on Taiwan and has an exemption list for Taiwan. Vice President of the Executive Yuan Cheng Li-jun said yesterday (24th) that the United States affirmed Taiwan's commitment to the import policy of forced labor goods in the "Taiwan-US Reciprocal Trade Agreement (ART)". Compared with the previous "10% additional MFN" temporary tariff in Article 122, Taiwan's treatment this time is more advantageous.

title_en: Happy corporate birthday/Baoling Fujin develops multi-functional reagents, a new tool for preventive medicine
summary_en: Jiang Zongming, general manager of Baoling Fujin, said that in the 50 years since the company was founded, its development orientation has shifted from extending human lifespan to focusing on improving the quality of life. The way to prolong life is to use drugs to treat internal diseases of the human body. To improve the quality of life, we start from the outside. We use medical beauty products to improve the quality of the human body's appearance. In recent years, we have developed into the field of preventive medicine through testing reagents, creating a new situation for the next 50 years.

title_en: 1.14 million yuan for 18-year-olds. The third reading of children’s future accounts predicts that 216.2 billion yuan will be spent in the first year.
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the blue-and-white version of the "Taiwan Children's Growth and Future Account Ordinance" in the third reading yesterday (24th). It stipulates that the central government will allocate a budget to open a future account for children. An initial fund of 60,000 yuan will be allocated when the child is born, and then a subsidy of 60,000 yuan will be allocated and paid every year. It is estimated that the child will receive 1.14 million yuan from birth to 18 years old.

summary_en: The expansion of the war between the United States and Iran, rising inflationary concerns, and renewed doubts about the realization of AI have impacted Taiwan's stock market, which opened lower yesterday (24th). title: 青安3.0婚育加碼「離婚怎麼辦」？財長：婚姻關係消滅或監護權變動就停補
summary:
青安3.0將於8月1日正式上路，新增新婚及育兒加碼優惠。不過，若貸款人在6年利息補貼期間內離婚，或子女監護權異動，利息補貼是否受影響，引起關注。對此，財政部長莊翠雲昨（22日）於立院備詢表示，離婚後，新婚加碼200萬元貸款額度的利息補貼將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止；若屋主未取得未成年子女監護權，育兒加碼500萬元額度的利息補貼也將停止。
立法院財政委員會22日審查相關議題，民進黨立委李坤城指出，青安3.0將新婚夫妻最高貸款額度提高至1200萬元，若有未成年子女（含持有媽媽手冊的懷孕婦女），最高可貸1500萬元，「離婚後利息補貼如何認定？」

莊翠雲表示，離婚後，新婚加碼200萬元貸款額度的利息補貼將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止；若屋主未取得未成年子女監護權，育兒加碼500萬元額度的利息補貼也停止。圖／國會頻道
對此，莊翠雲回應，若夫妻沒有子女，在6年利息補貼期間內離婚，原本因新婚增加的200萬元額度，將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止利息補貼。不過，未持有房屋的一方，若未來仍符合資格且未曾使用過新青安貸款，不論維持單身或再婚，仍可重新申請最高1000萬元的青安貸款。
title_zh: 青安3.0婚育加碼「離婚怎麼辦」？財長：婚姻關係消滅或監護權變動就停補
summary_zh:
青安3.0將於8月1日正式上路，新增新婚及育兒加碼優惠。不過，若貸款人在6年利息補貼期間內離婚，或子女監護權異動，利息補貼是否受影響，引起關注。對此，財政部長莊翠雲昨（22日）於立院備詢表示，離婚後，新婚加碼200萬元貸款額度的利息補貼將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止；若屋主未取得未成年子女監護權，育兒加碼500萬元額度的利息補貼也將停止。
立法院財政委員會22日審查相關議題，民進黨立委李坤城指出，青安3.0將新婚夫妻最高貸款額度提高至1200萬元，若有未成年子女（含持有媽媽手冊的懷孕婦女），最高可貸1500萬元，「離婚後利息補貼如何認定？」

莊翠雲表示，離婚後，新婚加碼200萬元貸款額度的利息補貼將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止；若屋主未取得未成年子女監護權，育兒加碼500萬元額度的利息補貼也停止。圖／國會頻道
對此，莊翠雲回應，若夫妻沒有子女，在6年利息補貼期間內離婚，原本因新婚增加的200萬元額度，將自婚姻關係消滅日起停止利息補貼。不過，未持有房屋的一方，若未來仍符合資格且未曾使用過新青安貸款，不論維持單身或再婚，仍可重新申請最高1000萬元的青安貸款。
title_en: Qing'an 3.0 focuses on marriage and childbearing: "What to do if you get divorced"? Finance Minister: Compensation will be suspended if the marriage relationship is terminated or the custody rights are changed.
summary_en:
Qing'an 3.0 will be officially launched on August 1st, with newly added discounts for newlyweds and childcare. However, if the borrower divorces or changes child custody during the six-year interest subsidy period, whether the interest subsidy will be affected has caused concern. In this regard, Finance Minister Zhuang Cuiyun stated at the Legislative Yuan yesterday (22nd) that after divorce, the interest subsidy for the newlywed loan limit of 2 million yuan will cease from the date of the termination of the marriage; if the homeowner has not obtained custody of the minor children, the interest subsidy for the childcare loan limit of 5 million yuan will also stop.
The Finance Committee of the Legislative Yuan reviewed relevant issues on the 22nd. DPP legislator Li Kuncheng pointed out that Qing'an 3.0 will increase the maximum loan limit for newlyweds to 12 million yuan. If there are minor children (including pregnant women with mother's handbooks), the maximum loan amount can be 15 million yuan. "How to determine the interest subsidy after divorce?"

Zhuang Cuiyun said that after divorce, the interest subsidy for the additional loan amount of 2 million yuan for newlyweds will stop from the date of the termination of the marriage; if the homeowner has not obtained custody of the minor children, the interest subsidy for the additional 5 million yuan for childcare will also stop. Picture/Congress Channel
In response, Zhuang Cuiyun responded that if the couple has no children and divorces within the six-year interest subsidy period, the interest subsidy of the 2 million yuan that was originally increased due to the new marriage will cease from the date of the termination of the marriage relationship. However, if the party who does not own a house is still eligible in the future and has never used a new Qingan loan, regardless of whether he remains single or remarries, he can still reapply for a Qingan loan of up to 10 million yuan.

title_en: EPS ranges from 12 to 17 yuan. It breaks away from the traditional positioning of plastics stocks, AI electronic materials increase in volume, and the value revaluation market starts?
summary_en: Looking forward to the market outlook, demand for AI servers, high-speed computing, advanced packaging and high-frequency and high-speed materials will continue to grow. Nanya's high-end electronic materials product line is expected to gradually increase its volume, driving continued improvement in gross profit margin and profitability. The legal person predicts that EPS is expected to exceed 12 yuan in 2026 and further challenge 17 yuan in 2027. Electronics-related businesses may account for nearly 97% of the overall profit. The company's operational focus has shifted from traditional plasticizing to electronic materials. Overall, Nanya is no longer just a cyclical stock, but a new generation technology materials company that combines the advantages of AI electronic materials, advanced packaging supply chain and reinvestment twin engines. title_en: The benefits of transformation emerged. Its profit in May increased by more than 8 times year-on-year, and three major new materials took over.
summary_en: In the first quarter of 2026, Taihong (8039)'s revenue was 2.415 billion yuan, an annual increase of 8.46%. The growth rate was not eye-catching, but its operating profit increased by about 78%, and its net profit after tax nearly doubled, with earnings per share of 0.65 yuan. The main reason is that the company proactively reduced low-margin orders and raised product selling prices to reflect copper prices and other raw material costs. After one year of adjustments, the Thai factory has caught up with the Taiwanese factory in yield rate and production efficiency. Therefore, the gross profit margin in the first quarter reached 22.03% and the operating profit margin was 6.06%, indicating that the improvement in product mix has begun to be reflected in profits. Second-quarter revenue was 2.696 billion yuan, a quarterly increase of 11.62%, but an annual decrease of 2.4%. The main reason is that the demand for consumer electronics is flat, but it has gradually entered the peak season. The net profit after tax in May was 69.45 million yuan, an annual increase of more than 8 times, and the earnings per share was 0.26 yuan, which is equivalent to earning 40% of the profit in the first quarter in a single month. This once again proves that the company is not relying on revenue, but on high-margin products to increase profits.

title_en: Zhu Chengzhi: Will the listing of Kimi K3 affect AI stocks? How are Taiwan stocks doing in August?
summary_en: The Korean stock Kospi index fell by a maximum of 31% this week. Highly leveraged ETFs placed heavy bets on the second leading Korean semiconductor stocks. 460,000 investors were cut off. Foreign investors cut leeks and retail investors wailed. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix account for 53-60% of the weight of the index, and TSMC accounts for 43.5% of the Taiwan stock market. The reason why the Taiwan stock index fell less is because foreign investors sold 84,000 TSMC shares last year. However, as of July 22 this year, TSMC will bear the burden. Foreign investors sold more than 784,000 shares, and it can still hold on to the quarterly support. The lowest is only 2,290 yuan. It is relatively resistant to decline and has risen 10% more than last year. Therefore, it is estimated that it will be relatively resistant to rising prices in the future. Therefore, buying TSMC’s performance is not as good as buying its surrounding beneficiary stocks. In the past, the world did not pay attention to the Korean stock market. Now, this US$4 trillion stock market has become an early indicator of market risk appetite, and it is also the target of Trump's big investment and establishment of factories in the United States. Since the launch of the single-stock leveraged ETF on May 27, Korean retail investors have net purchased approximately 14 trillion won (approximately US$9.5 billion), which is much higher than that of foreign investors. Hynix dropped 44% from a sky-high price of 2.987 million won on June 25 and fell below the quarterly line to a low of 1.678 million won on July 14. Hynix Double Leverage ETF has fallen by 70% since its high point in June, so Korean retail investors were seriously injured. Korean stocks fell sharply eight times from June to July this year, and foreign investors oversold Taiwanese and Korean stocks for four consecutive weeks. Since the beginning of this year, foreign investors have only bought US$2.14 billion over Thailand’s emerging Asian stocks, sold more than US$103 billion into Korean stocks, followed by US$38.9 billion over Taiwanese stocks.

title_en: 18-year-olds who read the third reading of Future Account can receive 1.14 million yuan. Blue and White: Let children’s dreams come true and parents can raise their children with peace of mind.
summary_en: The Legislative Yuan passed the "Taiwan Children's Growth and Future Account Ordinance" jointly proposed by the Kuomintang Legislative Yuan Caucus and the People's Party on the third reading today. The two parties held a press conference after the meeting to explain the content of the bill. They pointed out that the bill uses a "dual-track system" of childcare subsidies and account subsidies, so that children can accumulate at least 1.14 million yuan after they reach the age of 18, which can be used as the first pot of gold in life; so that children's dreams can come true and parents can care for them with peace of mind.

title_en: Where will CNR Shopping Mall go after Shin Kong takes over? Expert: Operate with a department store mentality, not a food court
summary_en: The CNR Mall has officially changed hands, and Shin Kong has signed a short-term contract with 90% of the counters for a minimum of three months. It is expected to submit a complete renovation plan to the Taiwan Railway Company for review by the end of August, and all renovations will be completed by the end of 2028 at the earliest. But how will the blueprint for the future CNR shopping mall be drawn up? Experts put forward suggestions based on the current situation. Shin Kong cannot be like Breeze and operate CNR shopping malls with the concept of a food street. Instead, it should think about the future from the perspective of a "department store."

title_en: ASUS announces the launch of a new generation of AMD EPYC servers to accelerate enterprise-level AI applications
summary_en: ASUS, a global brand of server and data center solutions, announced today (24th) the launch of a new series of servers, all equipped with the next-generation AMD EPYC 9006 processor. Zhu Peilan, senior global vice president of ASUS, said, "In the face of the wave of large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) applications, infrastructure flexibility and scalability have become the key to success; ASUS's new server series equipped with 6th generation AMD EPYC has both, and will provide enterprises with unprecedented powerful computing power. summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Kaohsiung, 24th) Taiwan promotes an Asian capital center, and the Financial Supervisory Committee discusses the special law for the development of financial markets and asset management, and evaluates the draft version of the year-end prerequisites. The outside world is paying attention to tax incentives. The Financial Supervisory Commission pointed out that this part involves a large level of cross-department division of labor, and tax fairness must be considered. Currently, it plans to focus on the foreign capital part, but it cannot allow Taiwan to become a haven for tax burdens.

title_en: CSP giants smash AI infrastructure, server manufacturers accelerate North American factory expansion to meet the challenge
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Wu Jiahao, Taipei, 24th) Although the market has doubts about the excessive capital expenditures of cloud service giants, the artificial intelligence (AI) computing power arms race has not stopped. Analysts pointed out that the combined capital expenditures of the five largest cloud service providers (CSPs) in North America will increase by nearly 90% in 2026. Benefiting from the huge demand for infrastructure construction, the order visibility of major Taiwanese AI server manufacturers has been extended to 2027, and they are accelerating production expansion in North America and globally.

title: 輝達AI-RAN卡位6G　基地台變身AI伺服器 榮群、互動、智邦迎商機
summary:
榮群擔任了Infinera產品在台灣的第一線運維保固代表，當電信商回報問題時，由榮群的在地工程師先進行除錯與搶修。如果遇到底層PIC晶片或核心韌體問題，再向Infinera美國總部申請最高層級的技術支援(Tier 3 Support)。

當Infinera與諾基亞的產品線合二為一後，榮群在台灣Pre-6G與高階光通訊局端建設的專案金額將會顯著拉高。2026年EPS預估約0.65元、2027年約1.75元，受限於專案時程，處於營收調整期。

台灣電信業經歷了台灣大併台灣之星，與遠傳併亞太的龐大網路整合作業。互動主攻電信網路的局端布建工程，協助電信商將不同頻段、不同世代的舊設備，與諾基亞的新世代5G/5GA設備進行無縫合網。

互動本身就是Infinera在台灣的端到端WDM解決方案的夥伴，當Infinera納入諾基亞旗下後，互動等於同時掌握了諾基亞的無線通訊(RAN)與Infinera的超高階光傳輸兩大武器，能為電信商或大型企業資料中心(DCI)提供更完整的網算一體解決方案。

title_en: Huida AI-RAN card slot 6G base station transformed into AI server Rongqun, Interactive, Zhibang welcome business opportunities
summary_en:
Rongqun serves as the front-line operation and maintenance representative for Infinera products in Taiwan. When telecom operators report problems, Rongqun's local engineers first perform debugging and repairs. If you encounter problems with the underlying PIC chip or core firmware, apply for the highest level of technical support (Tier 3 Support) from Infinera's US headquarters.

When the product lines of Infinera and Nokia are merged into one, Rongqun's projects in Taiwan's Pre-6G and high-end optical communication central offices will increase significantly. The EPS is estimated to be about 0.65 yuan in 2026 and about 1.75 yuan in 2027. It is limited by the project schedule and is in the revenue adjustment period.

Taiwan's telecommunications industry has experienced the massive network integration operations of Taiwan's merger with Taiwan Star and Far EasTone's merger with Asia Pacific. Interactive focuses on the central office deployment project of telecommunications networks, assisting telecommunications companies in seamlessly connecting old equipment of different frequency bands and different generations with Nokia's new generation 5G/5GA equipment.

Interactive itself is Infinera's end-to-end WDM solution partner in Taiwan. When Infinera becomes a subsidiary of Nokia, Interactive has mastered both Nokia's wireless communications (RAN) and Infinera's ultra-high-end optical transmission. It can provide telecom operators or large enterprise data centers (DCI) with more complete integrated network and computing solutions.

summary_en: As artificial intelligence sweeps the world, everyone's requirements for network transmission speed are getting higher and higher. While data centers around the world are frantically computing AI, the backend data transmission network is facing a serious "big traffic jam." In order to solve this global problem, Hon Hai Research Institute (HHRI), a subsidiary of Hon Hai (2317) Group, teamed up with National Yang-Ming Chiao Tung University to successfully develop the latest "high-capacity silicon photon emitter" technology. summary_en: Yaxiang (6139), a major clean room and electromechanical engineering company, held a briefing on the 24th. title: 愛吃飯又怕胖？醫揭這種澱粉不只不長肉，還能幫助燃脂防癌
summary:
對於熱愛白飯、麵條與馬鈴薯的人來說，「澱粉」兩個字常常伴隨罪惡感。但如果有一種澱粉，不僅不容易讓你發胖，還能餵養腸道益菌、提升胰島素敏感性，甚至可能降低大腸癌風險，你會不會重新愛上碳水化合物？「醫界福爾摩斯」曾嶔元醫師在其新書《精準飲食》中指出，對於喜歡吃澱粉的人來說，一個聰明的解套方式，就是選擇抗性澱粉。

抗性澱粉的特別之處，在於它獨特的消化路徑。曾嶔元說明，一般澱粉會在小腸中被分解成糖類，但抗性澱粉能完整通過小腸，直到抵達大腸。在那裡，它不會被人體的消化酵素分解，而是成為結腸中數十億益生菌的「食物」。這個過程稱為發酵，也讓抗性澱粉成為一種天然的益生元。益生菌藉此大量繁殖，優化腸道菌群，進而提升消化與免疫功能。對於進行高強度訓練的人而言，健康的腸道更是恢復與表現的關鍵。

當腸道微生物分解抗性澱粉時，會產生一類稱為短鏈脂肪酸（縮寫為SCFAs）的代謝物，其中最重要的是丁酸鹽。這些SCFAs本身就具有調節新陳代謝與免疫力的潛力。更值得一提的是，抗性澱粉帶來的益處，並不需要像某些益生菌飲品那樣付出高昂的代價，卻能自然地支持腸道與整體健康。
