title: 韌性台灣論壇／台灣企業最怕供應鏈中斷　勤業眾信揭4維度避雷管制紅線
summary: 在地緣政治新常態下，全球貿易制裁與出口管制影響供應鏈韌性，其中地緣經濟對抗已躍升為未來兩年全球最嚴重的短期風險。勤業眾信策略、風險與交易服務資深執行副總經理陳鴻棋今（7）日於「韌性台灣高峰論壇」指出，大國將貿易、科技與供應鏈武器化，透過制裁與出口管制進行博弈。面對供應鏈中斷的風險，他建議，企業應從追求生產效率，轉向建立具備適應力、高耐受度的「韌性網路」。

title: 韌性台灣論壇／雷虎科技打造無人機非紅供應鏈　陳冠如：全面提升台灣國防韌性
summary: 受惠於國防預算創新高與「國防自主無人載具採購特別條例」草案推動，台灣軍工股如火朝天。在「韌性台灣論壇」上，雷虎科技（Thunder Tiger）董事長陳冠如，從無人機到供應鏈，從台灣到歐美市場開拓，無所不談。雷虎科技無人機發展是創新中的一個縮影，也描繪出台灣韌性國防網的一面。

title: 韌性台灣論壇／務實建立台灣能源韌性 童子賢：應重啟核一歡迎來辯論

title: 韌性台灣論壇／韌性是台灣標籤！　經長龔明鑫：顧好中小企就不怕風險

title: 韌性台灣論壇／強化台灣韌性　數發部長林宜敬：網路不能斷、系統不能停、關鍵資料不能丟
summary: 數發部部長林宜敬表示，數發部在強化台灣韌性的時候有三個重要目標，第一個是網路不能斷，第二是系統不能讓駭客入侵導致停止運作，第三個是關鍵資料不能丟失。林宜敬強調，這些事情對台灣非常重要，數發部將會做一系列的防範措施。

title: 韌性台灣論壇／國安會副祕書長林飛帆：台灣要避免現狀被中國破壞　以實力捍衛和平
summary: 國家安全會議副秘書長林飛帆表示，台灣要避免現狀被中國破壞，必須要以實力捍衛和平，因為韌性並非從天而降，而是需要被投資，並且透過政府和社會的參與，不斷強化，如果今天不做，明天不會無中生有，連SOP（標準作業程序）都不知道。

title: 4字頭還買得到！通車倒數　三鶯線3大卡位熱區曝光
summary: 台北捷運「三鶯線」在6月底展開為期2個月的免費試乘，通車進入最終倒數階段，歷經10年建設的新北交通大動脈，打破三峽、鶯歌長久以來的「邊緣感」，軌道經濟點燃房市，儘管今年受房市管控政策影響，漲勢和緩下來，但專家認為，未來在地的人口移入、生活圈升級等利多，房市正式從「預期行情」走向「實質行情」，持續受到自住買盤的青睞。

title: 00685L「1拆24」首日爆量逾60萬張　小資瘋搶正2 ETF
summary: 今年上半年以 136.84% 的驚人漲幅奪下台股 ETF 績效冠軍的群益臺灣加權正2（00685L），在進行「1拆24」的股票分割後，於今（7）日正式恢復交易。分割後的買賣參考價為 12.75 元，今日早盤以 13.09 元開高，隨即吸引買盤瘋搶，盤中成交量一舉突破60萬張。

title: 張國煒親駕首架藝術機「空山銀」返台　8月再迎「空山金」
summary: 星宇航空首架特別塗裝機「STARLUX AIRSORAYAMA 空山銀」，昨（5）日正式飛抵台灣，這架由星宇航空攜手日本藝術家空山基打造的A350-1000（機身編號B-58553），由星宇航空董事長張國煒親赴法國土魯斯接機，並親自執飛返台，班機於昨日上午11時38分降落桃園國際機場，銀色機身首度現身台灣，也吸引不少航空迷到場迎接。

title: 星宇深耕台中第二營運基地  10/2開航札幌唯一中部定期航班
summary: 星宇航空台中航點持續拓展！台中出發旅客人次突破百萬，星宇航空昨（1）日正式宣布將於10月2日開航台中-札幌航線，成為目前唯一由台中直飛北海道的定期航班。航線將以Airbus A321neo機型執飛，夏季班表每週五班，為中部旅客提供更便利的日本航程選擇，也更深化星宇航空深耕台中、打造第二營運基地的決心。

title: 中東戰事降溫＋AI需求持續    台經院5月製造業燈號已近黃紅燈
summary: 台灣經濟研究院今（30）日公布5月製造業景氣概況，5月製造業景氣信號值為15.75分，較上月修正後之14.03增加1.72分，持續為代表景氣持平的綠燈，離16分的黃紅燈不遠了，若以不同產業燈號來看，象徵繁榮的紅燈已由4.09%大增至24.35%。

title: 神祕後勤部隊番外／每天都在想回收　她連風電葉片、火箭都想拆解
summary: 七年級生陳麗麗身兼台鎔科技及翰陽綠能董事長，靠著不斷鑽研，從門外漢成為環保資源產業專家。如今，她甚至養成了「職業病」，只要看到大型設備或廢棄物，腦中第一個浮現的就是：「有沒有機會回收再利用？」不過，除了垃圾如何變成生意，她實際上更在意的，還有每天在高溫廠區工作的第一線員工。

title: 神祕後勤部隊1／晶片愈先進、垃圾愈多　她靠處理神山群廢液穩站巨頭供應鏈
summary:
AI帶動半導體大擴產，晶片愈先進、垃圾愈多，產生的化學廢棄物也愈複雜，當市場焦點都放在晶圓廠、AI伺服器與先進封裝時，一門鮮少曝光的「垃圾生意」正默默成為半導體供應鏈不可或缺的一環。

2012年成立的台鎔科技，雖不是科技廠，但也不僅是單純「燒垃圾」，它專攻半導體廢汙泥、廢溶劑處理與循環再利用，每月處理數千噸，客戶涵蓋世界最重要科技大廠，是其強勁後勤部隊。2020年接任董事長的陳麗麗，外界原本以為她只是企業二代，卻在短短幾年間從零開始鑽研，每天駐廠10小時，連坐月子都與客戶視訊開會搶單。她不只推動公司走向資本市場，更大膽砸下60億元成立子公司翰陽綠能，試圖證明一件事：垃圾不是終點，而是下一門生意的起點。

title: 神祕後勤部隊3／她坐月子還在搶單！更豪砸60億蓋焚化爐　如今熬出新金雞
summary: 穩坐半導體廢棄物處理前三大業者後，台鎔科技董事長陳麗麗沒有停下腳步，而是豪擲60億元轉投資翰陽綠能蓋焚化爐。只是，興建過程一路遭遇疫情、缺工、缺料等挑戰，甚至讓她壓力大到洗澡時偷偷落淚。歷經四年，翰陽綠能終於正式商轉，不僅成為台鎔新的成長引擎，也將替公司帶來穩定的20年現金流。

title: 達人理財／斷掉物欲與個股焦慮　整理師靠2檔ETF滾千萬
summary: 40歲的林小印，是一位將「整理收納」與投資理財結合的跨界顧問；她曾是重度購物狂，家中堆滿公仔、動漫周邊與各式收藏，數量多到能開店。後來被父親趕出家門，她才逼自己斷捨離；又因為失戀、被迫學投資，最後化繁為簡，只靠定期定額2檔ETF，提早享受財富自由。

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 10th) The Financial Supervisory Commission today invited the insurance industry to hold a meeting to discuss three major issues in medical insurance claims, including whether to relax inpatient claims after inpatient surgeries are changed to outpatient surgeries; the definition of "one-day surgery" claims due to the introduction of three shifts of nursing staff into the law, and home emergency care insurance. Among them, as to whether one-day surgery can be extended to hospitalization claims under medical insurance, many industry players believe that it is not appropriate to relax the policy and should return to the terms of the policy contract.

title_en: <Real Estate> The fertility rate is low but they prefer cute furry babies. There are more furry babies than children in 15 counties and cities in Taiwan.
summary_en: Real estate agents observed data from the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of the Interior. The total number of domestic dogs and cats in Taiwan is estimated to reach 3.205 million in 2025, but compared with the population of children aged 0-14 in the same year, it is only about 2.682 million. Among them, the number of cats and dogs in 15 counties and cities far exceeds that of children.

title_en: U.S. technology stocks fluctuated and expanded. The U.S. power ETF has defensive characteristics and the number of regular quotas has increased sharply.
summary_en: Recently, U.S. technology stocks have encountered headwinds of high valuations, and market profit selling pressure has emerged, causing the Nasdaq index, which is dominated by technology stocks, to expand its decline since June. This shows that funds have withdrawn from technology stocks and turned to public utilities and consumer staples stocks for risk avoidance. Among them, U.S. power stocks have the defensive characteristics of public infrastructure and have dual themes of AI energy infrastructure. This year, they have continued to attract an increase in the number of regular fixed deductions. According to statistics from the Investment Trust and Investment Consultants Association, as of the end of April 2026, among the regular quotas of overseas power energy ETFs, Shin Kong U.S. Power Infrastructure ETF (009805) has the largest increase in the number of monthly debits of 2,626 people, an increase of approximately 179%. The latest scale has also exceeded 10 billion and reached 10.921 billion yuan, making it currently the largest overseas energy ETF.

summary_en: Geopolitical risks in the Middle East have heated up, and market risk aversion has become stronger. Taiwan stocks opened lower on the 10th and fell below the 44K mark. However, the market shock did not extinguish Taiwanese investors' willingness to enter the market. Instead, it stimulated the motivation to buy more as the prices fell, just like Japan's Mrs. Watanabe who dominated the foreign exchange market back then. With the influx of funds, the trading volume of ETFs continues to increase, and active ETFs have become the focus of attracting gold. Taiwan's retail investors have shown an astonishing iron will to buy more as they fall.

title_en: Chailease’s after-tax net income in the first five months grew by 4% annually, with EPS of 4.91 yuan.
summary_en: Chailease-KY (5871) announced today (10th) that its self-consolidated consolidated revenue in May 2026 was NT$8.37 billion, an increase of 1% from the same period last year. The cumulative revenue in the first five months was NT$40.32 billion, a year-on-year decrease of 2%. After tax, self-consolidated consolidation in May Net profit was 1.91 billion yuan, with an annual growth of 21% and a monthly growth of 11 months. The cumulative consolidated after-tax net profit for the first five months was 9.19 billion yuan, with an annual growth of 4%. The cumulative after-tax net profit per share (EPS) was 4.91 yuan, mainly in Taiwan and the ASEAN region. The business has heated up significantly.

title_en: Guo Zherong: Skyrocketing + Plunging = Short?
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market has been on a roller coaster ride recently, with violent market fluctuations: it fell by more than 1,500 points on Monday, then immediately retaliated by rising by more than 1,200 points on Tuesday. As a result, it fell by nearly 1,500 points today, giving up all the gains from the previous day. Faced with such a violent rise and fall, many investors were frightened and asked whether this meant that the short market had arrived? Although the market has been extremely volatile in the past few days, I think this is not a short-selling counterattack, but because the market has been intensively facing the interference of several major economic events in the past week, causing funds to panic and wait and see in the short term.

title_en: Ministry of Finance: Promoting electronic treasury payments, accounting for 99.01% last year
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Lu Yanci, Taipei, 10th) The Treasury Department of the Ministry of Finance has actively promoted the electronic operation of treasury payments in recent years. According to statistics, last year, NT$4.9597 billion was allocated to the treasury, and 2.16 million payees were paid. The electronic operation of treasury payments and the rate of inter-bank remittance of payees to collect treasury funds reached 99.01% and 98.96%, respectively, an increase of 3.8 percentage points and 1.99 percentage points from 2015.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Pan Ziyu, Taipei, 10th) The United States is about to release the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for May. If inflation heats up, it may strengthen market expectations for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates. Before the release of key data, foreign investors continued to adopt adjustment strategies, aggressively overselling Taiwan stocks and remittances. The stock exchange rate fell simultaneously. The New Taiwan dollar closed at 31.668 yuan against the US dollar, down 5 cents, setting a new low in the past two months.

title_en: Billionaire Youde Feng hopes the national team will take over. Guo Taiqiang: Sorry for the small shareholders
summary_en: When Senwei Energy (referred to as: Senwei) was contracted by Fuwei Energy to undertake the second phase of the Taipower Offshore Wind Power Generation Project (referred to as: Taipower Phase 2), it suffered a series of natural and man-made disasters and misjudged failures, and even reached the point where it had to be delisted. It was quite heartbreaking in the eyes of small shareholders, and the hard-earned money became wallpaper. What the industry is more concerned about is, "Taipower's second phase is like this, what about the other larger Youde wind field?" In this regard, Guo Taiqiang, chairman of Zhengwei and Senwei, revealed in an exclusive interview with this magazine: "We have been looking for someone to talk to, hoping to let other players take the lead." title_en: Power Semiconductor successfully raised US$886 million to strengthen investment in future momentum
summary_en: Power Semiconductor (6770) On June 9, 2026, US$886 million was raised through the issuance of overseas depositary receipts and employee stock subscriptions. The overseas depositary receipts (GDS) of this issuance will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. Each unit of GDS is 15 shares of Power Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., Ltd., and the issue price is US$31.65. The GDS price is equivalent to NT$66.68 per Taiwanese stock, which is approximately 5.73% discount to the average trading price of the company's stock on the 9th. Based on future operational development, Power Semiconductor will make good use of funds to purchase machinery and equipment and introduce new technologies to strengthen its international competitiveness. title_en: LINE Pay expands consumption scenarios; revenue in May reached 747 million, the second highest in a single month
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Wu Jiahao, Taipei, 10th) Mobile payment brand LINE Pay announced today that its revenue in May was approximately NT$747 million, an annual increase of 17.2%, the second highest in single-month history. title: 茂訊強固電腦軍工訂單強勁 看好今年營運優於去年
summary: 茂訊（3213）10日召開股東會，展望後市，茂訊預期今年強固電腦及通路事業皆維持成長態勢。董事長沈頤同表示，茂訊目前強固電腦營收已超越通路業務，將成為公司最主要的成長引擎，在全球各國增加軍費開支下，茂訊強固電腦在軍工領域訂單持續成長，預估今年整體營收成長幅度可望落在10~30%，獲利表現亦將優於去年。

title_en: Maoxun has strong computer and military orders and is optimistic that this year’s operations will be better than last year’s
summary_en: Maoxun (3213) held a shareholders' meeting on the 10th. Looking ahead to the market outlook, Maoxun expects that both its computer and distribution businesses will maintain growth this year. Chairman Shen Yitong said that Maoxun's rugged computer revenue has surpassed the channel business and will become the company's most important growth engine. As countries around the world increase military expenditures, Maoxun rugged computer orders in the military industry continue to grow. It is estimated that the overall revenue growth rate this year is expected to be 10 to 30%, and profit performance will also be better than last year.

title: 華航集團5月營收212.3億元 創歷年新高
summary: 華航（2610）集團 5 月合併營業收入為 212.30 億元，較去年同期增幅 27.73%，創歷年單月新高。其中客運收入 110.98 億元，較去年同期增幅 11.86%，寫下歷年同期新高；貨運收入 82.63 億元，較去年同期增幅 53.50%，亦較上月增加 12.8%，創下今年新高。

title_en: China Airlines Group’s May revenue reached 21.23 billion yuan, a record high
summary_en: China Airlines (2610) Group’s consolidated operating income in May was 21.230 billion yuan, an increase of 27.73% from the same period last year, setting a new monthly high in history. Among them, passenger revenue was 11.098 billion yuan, an increase of 11.86% over the same period last year, setting a new high for the same period in the past; cargo revenue was 8.263 billion yuan, an increase of 53.50% over the same period last year, and an increase of 12.8% over the previous month, setting a new high this year.

title_en: Foreign investment sales exceeded 93.5 billion yuan! These 4 active ETFs were so popular that they actually bought more than 30,000 shares of the first fund.
summary_en: The Taiwan stock market closed at 43,225.54 points on the 10th, a sharp drop of 1,478.9 points. Among the three major legal entities, only investment funds oversold, while foreign investors sold over 93.574 billion yuan. According to statistics, foreign investors oversold the top ten, and active ETFs accounted for 4. The overselling active unified upgrade 50 (00403A) reached the most with 94,398 contracts, followed by the selling Chaokai Fund (2883) with 92,625 contracts. However, it was favored by foreign investors. The top spot for overselling was First Gold (2892).

summary_en: Industrial computer manufacturer Weitian (6570) announced that its consolidated revenue in May reached 117 million yuan, a monthly increase of 27.91% and an annual increase of 32.11%, continuing to achieve double annual and monthly growth. Cumulative revenue from January to May was 450 million yuan, an increase of 19.23% over the same period last year, and operations remained high-end. title_en: Yuanyu's revenue in May was 180 million yuan, memory shortage disrupted shipments
summary_en: Flexible board factory Yuanyu Enterprise (6835) announced today that its consolidated revenue in May was 180 million yuan, and its cumulative revenue from January to May was 979 million yuan, a decrease of 19.29% and 7.29% respectively compared with the same period last year. Affected by the shortage of materials for automotive electronics and laptop memory, the shipments of the four major application products decreased in May, affecting revenue performance. Yuan Yu said that memory shortages may continue for some time. The company will continue to develop new customers, strive for diversified and mass-production product orders, and cooperate with the Thai factory's back-end SMT process to enter mass production to achieve economies of scale.

title_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission considers raising the threshold for attention stocks and shortening the "lockdown" time for disposal stocks
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Su Siyun, Taipei, 10th) The recent trading situation of high-priced stock MediaTek violated the stock exchange's definition of abnormality and was "closed", triggering discussion. According to the review report of the Financial Supervisory Commission, considering the continued growth of Taiwan's capital market in recent years, relevant announcements of stock precautions and disposal standards should be appropriately reviewed in line with changes in market structure. The Financial Supervisory Commission will supervise stock exchanges and over-the-counter buying centers to adjust to the extent of stock price increases, evaluate the planned and reasonable announcement of stock warning standards, and at the same time evaluate the feasibility of shortening the disposal period.

summary_en: The Taiwan stock market staged a sharp plunge on the 10th. In early trading, the decline was narrowed to within 30 points under the support of passive components and optical groups. However, after midday, the selling pressure on weighted stocks was fully released, with TSMC (2330), MediaTek (2454), Hon Hai (2317) and other electronics companies Equity stocks led the decline, and the passive component, memory and ABF carrier board groups simultaneously weakened, dragging the index down 1,478.9 points to close at 43,225.54 points. Not only did it fall below the monthly line, but it also set one of the largest single-day drops in recent times, with a transaction value of 1.3 trillion yuan. The three major legal entities entered the fifth day of overselling and continued to adjust to 117.364 billion yuan.

title_en: Taiwan stocks plunged 1,478 points, closing at a low of 43,225 points and falling below the monthly line
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporters Zeng Renkai and He Xiuling, Taipei, 10th) Selling pressure emerged on technology stocks. Taiwan stocks were under pressure today and sold sharply after midday. The concentrated market index closed at the lowest point of the day, down 1,478.90 points, closing at 43,225.54 points, falling below the monthly line of about 43,349 points, the sixth largest closing point in history. Yesterday, it rebounded by 1,201 points, and it was all forfeited today. The transaction value was approximately NT$1.324 billion.

title_en: The sidewalk on Zhengzhou Road in North City collapsed and a transformer box collapsed. Taipower: No power outage was caused.
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Xie Yixuan, Taipei, 10th) A sidewalk on Zhengzhou Road in Taipei City collapsed this morning, and the transformer box above collapsed. Taipower stated that the tilt of the transformer box did not cause power outages for users. Due to severe soil loss under the road, potholes were formed, which caused the transformer to collapse due to insufficient foundation support. It has mobilized manpower for emergency repairs.

title_en: Chuangkong’s revenue/May 40.93 million hit a new high for the same period, an annual increase of 51.32% AMC has strong rigid demand
summary_en: Chuangkong Technology (6909), a major manufacturer of advanced semiconductor process AMC nano-monitoring equipment, announced on the 10th that its revenue in May was 40.93 million yuan, an increase of 51.32% over the same period last year, and a record high for the same period last year. The cumulative revenue from January to May was 179 million yuan, close to the record high for the same period last year. The company continues to diversify its product application fields and customers, and its overall operations are expanding steadily. While maintaining the normal rhythm of off-peak and peak seasons that increases quarter by quarter, it is expected that the annual operating growth will be better than the overall industry level.

title_en: Who can hold on when the Taiwan stock market collapses by 1,400 points? Musk unveils blueprint for space AI1 satellite, Maodi lights up, Yuanjing explodes
summary_en: Taiwan stocks suffered a bloodbath from short sellers in midday trading on the 10th. The market collapsed by more than 1,400 points and fell below the 44,000-point mark. Even the strong passive components in early trading suffered setbacks. However, the solar energy group bucked the trend and attracted buyers. The main reason is that SpaceX CEO Musk disclosed the "AI1" space AI satellite planning for the first time, aiming to build a large-scale space AI computing platform in 2027 and introduce large-scale solar power generation, which detonated the market's imagination of space energy demand, driving Motech (6244), Yuanjing (6443), United Regeneration (3576) and other stocks to buck the trend and strengthen.

title_en: Huineng Technology and OPmobility signed MOU to start cooperation evaluation of solid-state battery modules
summary_en: Solid-state battery manufacturer Huineng Technology announced on June 9, French time, that it has signed a memorandum of cooperation with OPmobility, a global leader in the field of sustainable mobility and a technology partner for global mobile industry participants. The two parties will cooperate and discuss the integration and joint development of "Huineng solid-state battery cells" into "electric vehicle battery modules and/or battery packs", hoping to respond to the rapid growth of the global electric vehicle market with higher-performance and more competitive system solutions.

title_en: New opportunities for semiconductor wastewater regeneration: National Taiwan University proposes electric-driven separation and concentration technology
summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Zhao Minya, Taipei, 10th) Taiwan’s semiconductor industry is highly dependent on water resources. The fluoride-containing wastewater generated by the manufacturing process has long been regarded as a high-cost and high-load thorny problem due to the difficulty of treatment and reuse. The National Taiwan University team proposed electric-driven separation and concentration technology to convert low-concentration fluorine-containing wastewater that is difficult to use into a reusable recycling resource. It also helps reduce the cost of semiconductor wastewater regeneration and treatment.

summary_en: (Central News Agency reporter Jiang Mingyan, Taipei, 10th) Cargo agent Taihua said that the container shipping market improved significantly in May compared with the first quarter, with demand for ocean routes recovering, demand for stocking before the peak season increasing, and freight rates on European and American lines rising in June. title: 月送600隻毛孩1／參選連敗轉行　他用服務選民熱情做寵物殯葬　兩年衝上北台灣前三
summary:
當少子化成為社會現實，毛小孩正補上家庭情感缺口，寵物往生，也早已從過往的廢棄物處理，走向擬人化與儀式化，甚至更精緻的喪禮需求。

曾3度投入選戰、差點當選桃園市議員的賴立竹，於2024年創立「陶花源寵物天堂」，將多年跑白帖、做選民服務的精神搬進產業。創業初期，甚至到菜市場買雞，苦練火化及撿骨技術，還曾與太太半夜跨縣市載運毛孩大體，只為圓滿飼主的寄託。憑藉非典型服務，短短2年，單店年營收已衝破3千萬元。昔日政壇失意的賴立竹，如今在這門溫柔生意中，實現另一種選民服務。

title: 月送600隻毛孩2／孫大千前助理改當毛孩禮儀師　市場買雞勤練火化撿骨　鳥喙都能保留
summary:
從國會助理、政黨幹部到3度投入選戰，賴立竹人生前半段幾乎都與政治綁在一起。長年跑白帖、參加公祭，讓他比一般人更熟悉人生最後一程的產業樣貌。直到攻讀法學碩士期間，研究寵物管理法規，加上觀察少子化下毛孩地位日益擬人化，他嗅到一個尚未被滿足的新需求：當寵物成為家人，身後事也將走向更專業化與精緻化。

他投入需求高、門檻高，目前卻還沒有專法、仍處灰色地帶的寵物殯葬市場，甚至從市場買雞回來練習火化與撿骨技術，為自己開啟另一場人生選戰。

title: 月送600隻毛孩3／拒絕高抽成潛規則　他靠Line群組與口碑　從月送別20隻到600隻
summary: 創業最難的，往往不是技術，而是客源。2024年初，陶花源寵物天堂開幕後門可羅雀，賴立竹帶著名片一家家拜訪動物醫院，卻發現寵物殯葬市場存在高額回饋的潛規則，甚至有診所開出「七三分帳」條件。面對通路壓力，他選擇不跟進，而是把資源投入網路行銷與服務品質，從接體、火化到告別儀式全程紀錄，累積口碑。短短2年，月服務量從不到20隻成長到600隻，也讓他證明，陪伴與信任，才是這門溫柔生意最重要的競爭力。

title: 月送600隻毛孩／有人沒錢下葬　有人卻願意花千元　安葬路邊一隻蝴蝶
summary: 當寵物被視為家人，告別的形式也不再有標準答案。賴立竹從事寵物殯葬兩年，看過無數生離死別。他說，每個家庭表達愛的方式都不同，但無論動物大小、身價高低，那份感情都一樣真實。還有很多好心人，願意自掏腰包，請他們幫忙安葬流浪動物。

title: 群創首季本業轉盈　傳FOPLP搭上台積電列車股價亮燈漲停
summary: 面板大廠群創光電11日不僅繳出睽違多季的獲利成績單，更因市場盛傳其扇出型面板級封裝（FOPLP）技術有望與台積電合作，成為AI先進封裝供應鏈新成員，激勵股價開盤不到30分鐘即攻上漲停，盤中排隊買單一度超過28萬張。

title: 棄政從商賣酒1／堅持不賣商業啤酒　他從縣長秘書做到全台規模最大比利時啤酒連鎖品牌
summary: 20年前，比利時啤酒在台仍在萌芽，29歲的李勁毅在一場餐會中無意間喝到，驚豔於它擁有的獨特風味，因而決定開一間以比利時啤酒為主題的餐廳，取名「布娜飛比利時啤酒餐廳」，現在全台有4品牌、9間店，營收達1億元。

title: 棄政從商賣酒2／營收一天只有90元　他因這理由借錢也要開分店　現在年收破億元
summary: 朋友推薦兄弟飯店廚師掌廚，游曉芸則擔任服務生兼會計，而李勁毅仍在縣府上班，利用中午休息及下班時間幫忙。由於餐廳地點極為隱密，人流很少，一天路過的人不到50位，初期生意慘淡。

title: 棄政從商賣酒3／台中人消費力讓他驚呆　積極南下開多店　今年買地建總部拚轉型
summary: 布娜飛第2間商場店則是2011年，台中大魯閣新時代購物中心來招商，「當時訴求精釀啤酒的餐廳很少，他們提供很好的條件，像是抽成等，我覺得風險很低，再來是位置不錯。」同年12月，台中大遠百開幕也來招商，「這是第三間商場店，有198坪、180個座位。」

title: 操盤手退休配置1／每月1萬、24年滾出6173萬？　前投資長揭定期定額致富術
summary: 2年前外商投信投資長安柏姐從職場畢業；退休前，她靠著定期定額投資台股及全球股票基金，積極累積資產；退休後佛系理財，透過跨資產、跨區域且高達五成的類現金占比，保守穩健的開啟人生精彩下半場，不但旅居加拿大、寫了一本小說，更轉型成為職涯諮詢師。

title: 漂流木變小提琴1／這個偏鄉沒有半個音樂老師　千名住戶竟有百人會拉小提琴跟製琴
summary:
去年底剛頒發的全國「觀光亮點獎」，「曾文水庫漂流木提琴村」擠下阿里山、海生館，拿到南台灣的最佳人氣獎，讓嘉義大埔鄉頓時成為注目焦點。

這個僅有千人長住的聚落，從老到小卻有近百人會拉小提琴，原本用作生火、驅蚊的漂流木，變身國產小提琴。當琴聲開始，改變就已啟動。這些全是製琴師黃聖彥與返鄉投入社區發展的吳倚豪2人無間的合作。

如今，大埔不只靠曾文水庫，也透過音樂、工藝與社區參與，讓本地人找到歸屬、外地客願意停留，創造出屬於自己獨特的復興。

title: 漂流木變小提琴2／晚上7點後只剩便利店最亮！竹科工程師返鄉想振興小鎮　下場是天天茫到不敢再出門
summary: 黃聖彥說：「我那時在屏科大教學，原本使用的是進口木材，但想嘗試製作國產小提琴，希望能夠取得漂流木，於是找上理事長。」大埔鄉旁的曾文水庫位處阿里山下，只要颱風過後，就有大量的木材沖刷下來。吳倚豪說：「那些材料隨便撿都有，我們從小撿漂流木生火，或用香樟、牛樟驅蚊，那都是我們生活的一部分。」

title: 漂流木變小提琴3／通膨物價漲　為了財產保值！他爸爸重押所有退休金買一把小提琴給他
summary: 受琴聲震撼的吳倚豪，開始研究世界各地以製琴聞名的小鎮，其中最讓他振奮的，是義大利小鎮克雷莫納（Cremona）。他說：「克雷莫納也是一個偏鄉小鎮，300前開始發展手工製琴，現在有很多座提琴博物館，每把琴都有它的故事，每年吸引全世界數百萬人去參觀，是義大利第三富有的地方。」

title: 台灣老店／改名戰逆局　1＋1燒臘
summary:
開業於1979年的東門鴨莊，由第一代陳松根、姚美貞夫婦創立，以獨特的台式燒臘美味，馳名台北城區數十年。2人離婚後，姚美貞成為東門鴨莊的主人，交棒給兒子陳載聞。

5年前，陳載聞車禍過世、太太陳亞涵接著離世，經營權落入親家手中。姚美貞頓失依靠，頂著70歲高齡，去年另創1＋1燒臘繼以為生，也要讓食客重新尋回東門鴨莊的好味道。

title: 改名戰逆局1／警察父被誣陷入獄發瘋　她為離家嫁給廚師創東門鴨莊
summary: 開業於1979年的東門鴨莊，由第一代陳松根、姚美貞夫婦創立，以獨特的台式燒臘美味，馳名台北城區數十年。2人離婚後，姚美貞成為東門鴨莊的主人，交棒給兒子陳載聞。

title: 改名戰逆局3／一家燒臘店年收可破億　少東夫妻雙亡全變調
summary: 姚美貞50歲時，某次收店出來看到路燈，還以為已經天亮，她驚覺從來沒有自己的生活。兒子既然成家，就照傳統觀念，讓兒子接班。陳載聞也很爭氣，新開2間分店，增設中央廚房，業績最高衝到每月1千2百萬元。姚美貞自己則遊山玩水，去哪裡都長住幾個月，在台東甚至學會衝浪。她終於可以享受人生，但噩耗也隨之而來。

title: 改名戰逆局番外／40多年燒臘名店被親家整盤端走　創辦人不得再踏入　律師呂秋遠呼籲：不要提早分產
summary:
1979年開業的東門鴨莊，由第一代陳松根、姚美貞夫婦創立。1984年兩人離婚後，姚美貞改良傳統作法，以台式燒臘口味，造就東門鴨莊的40年的榮光。

但2025年，東門鴨莊卻爆發商標之爭，敗訴的姚美貞只能以「1+1燒臘」另起爐灶。

title: 封面故事／專訪！國票金改選前哨戰開打　耐斯二代陳冠如：支持公股解決亂象
summary: 今年來耐斯二代陳冠如常上媒體版面，全與一樁被國票證券員工指控的霸凌案有關，這樁霸凌案背後牽涉國票金控2大民股—人旺蔡家與耐斯陳家間多年恩怨，為一勞永逸解決民股糾紛，公股已出手大買國票金股票，並找耐斯陳家與台鋼集團組成聯盟，明年國票金經營權極可能由公股主導。日前陳冠如接受本刊專訪，完整說明耐斯集團為何支持公股，以及這段期間所受委屈，「我們希望解決亂象，讓國票金重歸公司治理。」

title: 國票金勢力洗牌3／「入股國票金就是純投資」　陳冠如喊話：公股主導後井水不犯河水
summary: 為爭奪國票金控經營權，人旺蔡家與耐斯陳家兩大民股已多次交鋒，這次更因霸凌案鬧得不可開交，為一勞永逸解決民股糾紛，國票金關鍵第三方大股東—公股決定出手，不排除在下一屆改選主導經營權。

title: 財經時事／大缺工潮襲擊服務業　餐飲新兵拚上市與巨頭搶人
summary: 疫後報復性消費帶旺餐飲業，受少子化衝擊，服務業正面臨嚴重的缺工問題，日前包括王品、鼎泰豐等餐飲大咖紛紛調整薪酬或啟動招募計畫，掀起史上最激烈搶才大戰。本刊調查，不少欠缺集團奧援的餐飲業者，近期吹起一股上市熱，像是主打無菜單料理以「初魚」品牌打響名號的豊漁餐飲，以及靠著精釀啤酒獲得好評的金色三麥都加入資本市場，不僅要以差異化戰法獲得投資人青睞，更希望在搶人大作戰不輸餐飲巨頭們。

title: 00919配息將腰斬？　超馬芭樂：「現有條件仍可維持0.6至0.72元」
summary:
00919配息將腰斬？超馬芭樂：「現有條件仍可維持0.6至0.72元」

被譽為高股息ETF四大天王之一的00919（群益台灣精選高息），即將在近期公布第三季配息。多數專家預測，00919為了因應金管會提出的收益平準金新規定，恐難維持0.7元的高配息，甚至可能「腰斬」至0.4元。
